name: LA FORTUNA MEXICAN RESTAURANT
reviews: ['Food is great and people is very nice.', 'Im a Staten Island native and I enjoy all types of food but my favorite being Mexican. And I have to admit that, This is simply the best Mexican restaurant on the island. The service is amazing with regards to the quality food but the speed in which they deliver. I’ve never have to wait more than 5 to 10 minutes while waiting for my food. The service is always top tier. The staff is always friendly and welcoming. I give this place a 10 out of 10 every time. 💯', 'The food was very tasty, authentic and served very fast. But the best was the service, super kind people and always making sure we were all good. 100% recommended.', 'Everything here is SO FRESH. I came here with my family of 5 and all of our dishes were extraordinary. Everything came out piping hot and very delicious. We ordered the guacamole, shrimp with garlic sauce, mixed fajitas, chicken burritos and breaded chicken and breaded fish filet. The hot, fresh churros with chocolate sauce at the end were absolutely melt-in-your-mouth divine. We would definitely come here again. 5 stars!', 'Service was great, the food came in a timely manner and was made fresh. I was there from 9p(closes at 10p). Definitely worth trying!']

name: JIMMY MAX
reviews:
['New Pictures

Terrific atmosphere and extremely friendly service. We do not often have the opportunity to visit this area, so we were excited to go. We had a special event for my son’s school and even though the place was jam packed due to games, the staff and service did not skip a beat. The food is really great and the bar is very popular.
Highly Recommend', 'Jimmy Max has always been a Staten Island staple to me, but I recently hosted a first party for my daughter there and can now double down on that sentiment. :-) Erin was so wonderful to work with leading up to the party. She was quick to respond via email, answered all of my questions, and sat with us in person to sort out final details. The day of the event, Erin and the rest of the staff worked so hard to make sure that everyone was happy throughout the day. It’s the first party I’ve hosted where I felt relaxed from start to finish - and that’s all thanks to the staff at Jimmy Max. The food was delicious and plentiful! The space was beautiful! And the staff was an a+ team! Highly recommend for a party of any kind!', 'The food is really good depending on the dish. I’d highly recommend the caeser salad with blackened chicken.Service was hit or miss as people who later were getting food earlier. Restaurant management did comp the late arriving dish.', 'Staple of Staten Island. Bar but you can bring your kids.so the Rangers are in the playoffs and we decided to do some take out. Ready right before puck drop. Food and service never disappoints, if you’re going on a game night go early for a bar seat but tables have Tv’s  as well. Try everything you can here.', 'The food is delicious.  The atmosphere is welcoming.  Owner and staff are professional & courteous.

Has a great bar and you can watch the game and have a drink or watch the games while you dine!']

name: CHILI'S GRILL & BAR
reviews:
["Love this Chilli's. Wait time is normally not bad but even when it's a bit longer they give you a realistic wait time and take your name and number down. They even send a link that updates you about how long the wait will be so you don't have to wait around. Maury is the most amazing server!! Served me two times and was awesome and very memorable.", 'Chili’s always delivers an amazing experience, and this visit was no exception! We kicked things off with the Triple Dipper and the Dip Trio, and let me tell you, it was the perfect start to our meal. The Triple Dipper was like a dream—getting to mix and match our favorite appetizers was a treat, and every single bite was bursting with flavor. The Dip Trio was just as fantastic, with creamy, zesty dips that paired perfectly with the fresh, crispy chips. It was the ideal way to start our evening.

When it came to the main course, I couldn’t resist the Cajun Chicken Pasta. It was everything I hoped for—rich, creamy, with just the right amount of spice to keep things interesting. My partner went for the Texas Dry Rub Ribs, and they were simply divine—fall-off-the-bone tender with a smoky flavor that lingered in the best way possible.

The atmosphere at Chili’s is always welcoming, but this time it felt extra special. The staff was incredibly attentive, making sure our drinks were always full and that we were enjoying every moment. We also treated ourselves to a couple of their signature margaritas, and they were the perfect blend of tart and sweet, refreshing and satisfying.

Overall, it was a perfect night out. Chili’s has a special way of making you feel right at home while treating you to top-notch food and service. It’s definitely our go-to spot, and after this visit, I’m already looking forward to our next meal there!', "Great Service!! Thanks to Felicia, our server! She made suggestions upon our request and was very patient with giving us tyme to peruse the menu.
Our Go-To appetizer was the Bottomless Tortilla Chips with Salsa (quite filling, especially when sipping a tasty libation). My libation of choice  was the Tiki Beach Party Marg (lightly salted glass rim 👌🏽), and my friend had two Strawberry Margeritas (Happy Hour Tyme).
After much thought, we both ordered the Smokehouse Combos two meats each: ribs & chicken crispers for me and chicken quesadillas & honey-chipotle ribs). Our entrees were served hot & delicious (of course, the portions that we could eat lol). The meals were served with fries, seasoned corn, and garlic bread.
Felicia checked on us, always graced with a smile.
This Chili's is a Pleasantly comfortable atmosphere, with light music and TV monitors at the bar area

Pics: Tiki Beach Party Marg & Bottomless Tortilla Chips", "The highlight of our dining experience is definitely Gabbie's exemplary service, she was friendly, efficient, and even brought us refills when she saw we were running low, demonstrating amazing observation skills and attunement! The burger was pretty decent, although it was salted unevenly where some bites were very salty and others flavorless. Additionally, the bread didn't hold the burger well and quickly deconstructed, resulting in a fork and knife experience. The steak in the steak fajita was surprisingly tender and flavorful with its various components, so that's highly recommended! Overall we had a wonderful experience and I just want to thank Gabbie for her amazing service which definitely enhanced our experience!

Thank you for reading and best of luck! (:", 'Visited yesterday and it was amazing we had a bit of a complicated order and our waitress and kitchen staff handled it like a pro . We love her . Wish I could remember her name , she seriously needs a raise . She went above and beyond for us :) I took a pic of her , if anyone knows her name please let me know . I want her to be our waitress again :)']

name: OSTERIA SANTINA
reviews:
['First time dining here and I was very impressed with the food and service. Appetizers we ordered were the usual fried calamari, which was excellent. Also got scungili fra diavlo, also very good, but was not spicy hot enough for my taste. Entrees were pappardelle bolognese, stuffed chicken filet of sole oreganata and grilled salmon. We all commented how good our food was and were so full that we passed up desert. Servers were very attentive making sure we had everything we needed.  Was a very enjoyable evening that I look forward to in the near future.', 'The food was out of this world delicious. The raw oysters, clams and shrimp were delectable.  The pasta was supreme and the filet mignon was perfection. Never mind the wonderful deserts, were fantastic. The servers were very nice and attentive, the atmosphere was beautiful. I should have taken more pictures as the presentation of the food was beautiful
I highly recommend this five star restaurant', "I recently hosted my bridal shower here and it was an absolutely perfect experience from start to finish. The staff went above and beyond to make sure everything ran smoothly—they were so kind, attentive, and incredibly accommodating to our needs.

The food was phenomenal! Every single guest raved about how delicious it was, and the variety of options made sure everyone was happy. The space itself was ideal for our event—spacious, beautifully set up, and perfect for mingling and dancing.

If you're looking for a venue for a special event, I can't recommend Osteria enough. They helped make my bridal shower a truly unforgettable day!", "I want to start off by extending my gratitude towards Walter, who was so friendly, funny, warm, witty, and helped make this dinner as perfect as it was. All the staff were also very friendly and welcoming.

The ambiance from once you walk in is very elegant and gives off a high class vibe. We started the meal off with roasted garlic oil that accompanied the bread, which was extremely flavorful, so be careful not to fill up on bread for it's so easy to do so! Then came our chocolate milk, which I know sounds weird in an Italian restaurant, but it was delicious and not overwhelmingly sweet. Then came the pasta Fagioli soup that was very tasty and had a good variety of veggies.

Then the only issue arose; the long wait time between our side salad and the main entrees, which was a 35 minute wait. This long time wait unfortunately made us quite full and really siphoned away our initial excitement, especially since everything was going so well!

Now the entrees! The salmon Wellington was SO GOOD! The puff pastry was crisp and paired perfectly with the salmon and the dill cream sauce! It was a special but totally worth trying if you see it available! Our carbonara came out extra Al dente, then when they tried to remedy it it ended up being overly watery and just as Al dente. However, Walter was friendly and open about the experience, where he did everything to make sure we enjoyed our experience. The fresh fettuccini that Walter recommended was so delicious and came out mild in flavor so we could adjust it to our liking with cheese, salt and black pepper.

But despite the delay and hiccups with the carbonara, we still had a wonderful experience thanks to Walter's amazing hospitality and service. So if you come here, ask for Walter and definitely try either the salmon Wellington or the fresh fettuccini!

Thank you Walter and everyone who served us today!

Thank you for reading and best of luck! (:", 'Me and my family have eatin here at least 12 times in the past year. Every time is as good as the last. Exceptional service, the owners are available to talk to anytime for a comment on the food or to just say hello. Perfect place for a party of any occasion.  Even the valet parking guys are very nice and fast service.  Great atmosphere all around. Trust me you will love it.']

name: ANGELINA'S KITCHEN
reviews: ["My sons favorite restaurant on Staten Island!! The service is always on point. They also donate food to a local charity for kids with special needs around Easter time. WE LOVE A RESTAURANT THAT GIVES BACK!!! I had the tagliatelle al Parmigiano... I added shrimp, cheese, and a little pepper. It was delicious! You know a restaurant is a good place when you see the same wait staff working their for years.  I'm not a fan of all of the dishes but I can definitely recommend the ravioli with the eggplant, the pizza, of course the bread, the spaghetti vongole pachino, and the fritters di calamari as an appetizer. The drinks are good... They don't skimp on the liquor. Just bring cash because they do charge a credit card processing fee. Definitely a recommend spot!", 'Just had my son’s christening dinner here for about 30 people and we were so impressed with everything. The rustic look was beautiful. The room set up, the food, the service .. everything was wonderful. Would definitely have another event here. Thank you to Chiara and Baldo for everything!', 'You feel right at home when you visit this location. I’ve had the pleasure to visit both as a guest and vendor and every time I go I am treated with such kindness and respect.\nFood and drinks are great but the people keep you coming for more ❤️\U0001faf6🏼', "Angelina's Kitchen definitely needs some improvement. The fried calamari is usually always good but this time was undercooked, the drinks were terrible, and the pizza is average. The bread they serve is absolutely amazing, the environment is really nice and the waiters/ waitresses are always awesome people. I recommend but but for the price theres so much better out there.", 'I always loved this place. I’ve been suffering from long Covid since September 2021. Pretty much everything smells and tastes rotten and weird. I haven’t been able to enjoy food for a long time now. Little by little, I’m able to have certain things that taste okay but not totally normal yet. I have to say that our server Joe was very attentive and understanding. He was great. I ended up ordering a margherita pizza for my son, and decided to taste it since it didn’t smell bad. Surprisingly one little bite after another, i sort of liked it. Even with the basil, which is shocking, since herbs, spices and sauce bothered me with the smells and tastes for so long. This was the first place that i was able to tolerate it and even eat more than one slice. I’m also able to eat their bread broken into little pieces, dipped into their ricotta honey mixture. Their food is high quality and tastes great, especially for when i was able to eat almost anything. It’s big that i was able to eat what i was at this point, so this resistant was awesome. The server gets 100 thumbs up for dealing with what I’m going through and being understanding, making sure all was well and that i was ok with what i was trying. Love this place. A bit pricey, but nowadays what isn’t pricy? Especially when it’s so high quality!']

name: GUAC TIME MEXICAN GRILL
reviews:
["I have seen this place before & I thought it closed down because doors were closed. Was kinda disappointed but I recently seen a post in insta & realized they are just opening it here & got lucky with that. I always change my bus infront of that area & I got off and seen the line ! So I was like I gotta try this ! And on top of it they were giving away free food, I bought a drink to show support.

Very happy because it's a halal place & don't serve alcohol(if I am not mistaken) and also the owner is from Pakistan or India, So extra happy about it.

Customer service was great for a hectic busy day, I will definitely be a regular! Will let you know how the food & service is on a daily basis .", 'the food slapped it was so good but there was a piece of metal inside my crunchwrap that i didn’t notice until it was lodged inside my tooth in the back. it was scary when i had to pull it out and lowkey was scared i swallowed a piece. i called them to let them know and they just apologized and asked if i wanted another crunchwrap if i came to get it but i was traumatized enough for one day so decided not to get it.', 'I recently dined at Quac Time and had an amazing experience! From the moment I walked in, the ambiance was vibrant and inviting, with a modern take on Mexican decor. The service was exceptional, the staff and Manager were friendly and attentive, making sure I had everything I needed. The food was outstanding, with fresh ingredients and authentic flavors in every dish. Their guacamole was some of the best I’ve had, and the burrito bowl was flavorful and perfectly seasoned. Quac Time is definitely a place I’d recommend to anyone looking for great Mexican food with a unique, modern twist and quick service, Can’t wait to go back!', 'Workers are very kind and took our orders very understandingly since it was our first time there. The food was so flavorful and delicious, and it was also very affordable. Would highly recommend for those who enjoy the create-your-own style. I really recommend the crunchwrap, it was very filling!', 'First time ordering from guac time. There was a BOGO going on for several items except that if you ordered like say a burrito or a dish you had to order the exact same one for the second one. I ordered the burrito and I got a second one which I gave away, but the other person wanted rice so that means I had to race. The race was over Overbearing there was a great abundance of rice that it’s falling all over the place and maybe because I’m not a big rice eater it seemed to me like too much. The burrito itself is tasty. I couldn’t really taste the meat or anything but the rice but it was tasty enough. It was huge. You can either share it if you’re not a big eater or definitely could make two meals. I also ordered a guac and chips and a container of queso a small container to try it because I hadn’t tried either and both were delicious the queso that was a tad bit watery. Maybe could’ve been a little bit thicker but the guacamole was good and if I go there, I would get those again. Next time I think I would’ve ordered a case again and another, sidenote the proteins and some of the extras cost extra. I had to pay 399 for chop meat and all I taste is rice so just think about that maybe you want to get no rice so you could taste what you’re paying for other than that. It’s good. It’s well worth the visit. it’s a bit pricey so bring your wallet and credit cards, but it’s worth it. The restaurants are clean and the only thing about the staff. I noticed when I was in there picking up orders for Uber a couple weeks ago they had one person making the orders at one person in the kitchen and you have people walking in people ordering to pick up and it’s a lot of work for one person so you know it could be a little bit slow. I’m waiting and I waited a long time for the orders I was picking up because I had one order that had two items and the other order had like about 20 but again they only had one person doing the orders and one person working in the kitchen']

name: JOE & PAT'S PIZZERIA & RESTAURANT
reviews:
['Absolutely incredible. The “regular” pizza is delicious in its own right, but the vodka sauced pizza is downright breathtaking. This is the pizza that keeps you up at night thinking about it. I plan to order more to have shipped across the country to my home via Goldbelly, that’s how amazing it is. Staff are friendly, location is nice, this one is worth the trek.', "Thin style pie. Plenty of sauce. I thought it was a little on the salty side. Garlic bread was tasty though I felt like it had too much pepper. Would I recommend the pizza, yeah. It's a good pie. 7.5", 'REAL. PIZZA. Worth the trip from NJ any day! Going during lunchtime on a weekday was awesome- no wait and quick service. We got a pasta fagioli soup, half Tri-pie, half with fresh tomatoes and sausage. And runny chip with ice cream :)', 'My favorite pie anywhere. Thin crust, crisp on the edges and delicious sauce. Lighter on cheese than most anywhere else in NYC which brings out the great flavor and no greasiness. They have a large menu if you want something else for some reason… on the side the escarole and broccoli rabe are top tier- it’s hard to find them prepared well anywhere else.', 'Excellent. The vodka slices are so perfect they can’t be described.
On the margarita slices they use a sweeter sauce which I would usually associate with inferior store bought sauce but combined with the super fresh mozzarella it’s a perfect pairing.

The slices are thin so order more than you think 😂']

name: CUCINA FRESCA
reviews: ['We stumbled upon this place and we didn’t expected the top tier customer service and delicious food that they offer! We even met the owner of this establishment by accident yesterday and he was very kind. He even offered on the house salad and did not disappoint us when he said that their lamb chops is one of their best! It was cooked perfectly and seasoned well. The gnocchi bolognese was also phenomenal! We definitely did not expected how HUUGGEE the portions were, haha. But definitely a really good authentic Italian restaurant with good ol’ classical music that fits the vibe. Highly recommended this place if you are looking for a good Italian restaurant for a reasonable price.', 'First time going back under new management and they have returned to greatness! For appetizers we got the baked clams and calamari. I have a very high standard for baked clams and they surpassed my expectations! For our main course I got the mixed seafood pasta and my girlfriend got the lamb chops. Both of which were excellent and we would get again. The owner is great and kept making sure we were enjoying our food and overall dining experience. Overall, really happy they are open again and they stayed as BYOB!', 'My wife and I visited this cute little Italian restaurant recently to celebrate our first anniversary. When we got there, we were greeted by the owner who acted as our server as well as the cook. We started off with the meatballs as a starter. They were made old school, like my great grandmother would make it with pine nuts and raisins. They were delicious and the sauce was fantastic. My wife had the surf and turf and I had the rib eye special. Both were cooked a perfect medium-rare. The owner (who’s name I unfortunately have forgotten), heard us raving about the meatballs and brought us out a complimentary bowl of freshly made pappardelle pasta with red sauce and more meatballs. Needless to say, we were beyond stuffed. When he heard that it was our anniversary, he then proceeded to insist we stay for a surprise dessert on the house. This was an offer we couldn’t refuse! A few minutes later he dropped a warm funnel cake in front of us, topped with strawberries, vanilla ice cream, salted caramel and whipped cream. It was fantastic! I really can’t recommend this place enough. If you’re looking for a great meal at a great price, this is the place for you!', 'We had dinner tonight. The food was amazing! Service was great! The owner Frank was so accommodating, welcoming & worked so hard to make our evening enjoyable! Highly recommend!!', 'Great food - Frank the owner makes you feel like family -2nd rime  we drove up from. South Jersey  worth the Trip - the pork chop was incredible!']

name: NORI SUSHI AND RAMEN
reviews:
['What an amazing experience we had at Izakaya Nori Restaurant ! An amazing tranquil environment with a lot of natural light and beautiful ambiance filled with traditional Japanese cherry blossoms at the entrance and greenery decorations everywhere. The tables have very nice ornaments that truly give off the Japanese culture vibes. Now the food was incredible ! Started off with some edamame on the house ! (They serve it to us before we placed our order) We ordered the 3 roll special and I ordered the Tokyo Ice Tea. In the pictures you can see the drink looks refreshing and was actually very tasty. Please take notice of the presentation of the plates and why I want to give this place 6 stars!  The Philadelphia, California, Boston, Salmon, Eel Avocado, and Shrimp rolls were all amazing! Ended the dinner with two Sapporo beers and gave a nice tip! Would come again and again and again!', "The ribeye yakitori was pretty good, tender and a good amount of sauce to pair it quite well. The chicken skin yakitori was very crispy and delicious, with just a tad too much sauce which made some pieces overly salty, but no biggie. The salmon tartar was just okay, with the yuzu sauce being very sour. I think if the amount of avocado being increased a bit, it would have helped equalize its sourness with the creaminess of the avocado. The three rolls lunch special is very fresh and had more ingredients than rice, just like the special dancing lobster roll which had so much lobster (as evident in the pictures)! The rock shrimp lunch bento was also just mediocre, potentially due to it being overly battered and pieces were combined together. Overall, we really loved the freshness and generosity of the fishes in their normal and special sushi rolls! The restaurant also looks very pretty with beautiful floral decorations and is incredibly spacious and clean. The staff were all very friendly and quick with their service, with pretty plates and utensils. Will definitely be back and I'm sure with a little adjustment, the quality of their food will only continue to enhance!

Thank you for reading and best of luck! (:", "The restaurant itself is very pretty, and feels very open and clean. I initially had ordered fried rice for delivery as I had a craving, and what I received was so good I had to come in person. My partner and I got rolls this time as well. The tempura are some of my favorite that I've had in a long time. The sushi was very fresh and satisfying. I also always love a good tempura ice cream for dessert. We couldn't recommend this place enough and look forward to coming back soon!", "We came from NJ looking for another Sushi place but stumbled on Nori's thru a search and decided to give it a try. The place is very very clean and crisp. The decor is top notch and seating is very nicely arranged. The food presentation is very nice and in some way appetizing. The sushi was very fresh and tasted very well. The sushi selection is great and we tried a number of their offerings. Prices are very reasonable and the service is great. Based on location parking might be a bit of a challenge. I'd highly recommend giving the place a visit. You'll be happy as my family and I did.", 'This location truly delighted me.
The cuisine was actually excellent.   Perfect not-too-saucy ramen! There are numerous item alternatives.  Lunch special rolls were also tasty.']

name: CAFE MILANO PIZZERIA AND RESTAURANT
reviews:
['Really great pizza in the area. We live on South Shore so we do not usually come by, but we had basketball and we’re in area.

Really great pizza. Cooked perfect with excellent undercarriage. No flop at all.

Sauce was very good and complimented their dough well.

Perfect spice.', 'I been ordering from Milano for awhile now, I will say there was a time I was about to stop.  I felt like the kitchen was putting my orders together with no care in the world.  Continued to order, since it was just simple orders who can mess that up but it happened until Erica, she is amazing.  She is polite, and always makes sure my order is perfect.  Erica is definitely the reason I started to branch out in my orders.  Thank you for her kindness, her sweet way she answers and ends the call.  I definitely know i am in good hands with her.', 'Where is the powdered sugar tho?
3rd time I ordered zepoles and its delivered like this (even in the winter)

9/26/24
Were these even cooked tho??
Ask yaself would you eat these  they are horrible no taste slimy not crunchy ughhhh
Are there new owners?', 'Ordered food from here for NYE. We asked for extra bread and this is what they gave us. Cold hard as a rock spread out inside the box. Also asked for extra dressing and this is what they provided. Food was okay. Going to stop wasting money on food that i know i can make better at home. Save yourself the trouble and trip', 'My family came here for a birthday dinner to see the new dining space and it was such a lovely time!! The food was great and really generous portions. But to be honest the staff really made the night special. I wish I got their names - lovely spot - I’m glad we came!']

name: LA PIAZZA PIZZERIA & RESTAURANT
reviews:
["Rude driver. He doesn't call you but instead bangs on the door like a maniac and has the audacity to expect tip. The Buffalo pizza topins is oily enough to fall to the ground if it's slightly down. Never ordering from here again.", 'RUDE STAFF!!!I asked my husband to get pizzas from this place for my class Halloween party. Their website says they opened at11 so my husband was there at that time. It was still closed so my husband called, he wanted to know what time they will open. The staff who answered the phone was nasty saying “I told you 10 mins”( he apparently signalled 10 with his hands, which my husband did not see).Instead of apologizing for not opening on time, he appeared annoyed.How could one be SO RUDE when he could have just said it nicely. I will not reccommend this place', 'Good balance of cheese to sauce.
Decent flavor.
A little too much oregano.
Medium thin crust with a little chew,
edges are crispy. Good flavor.
Size is okay for $3 a slice, but would prefer a little less crust and a little more topping. Slice overall, is a bit dry because of the excess crust.
Give it a rating of 92.', 'The chicken bacon ranch and calamari pizza.

Even better than it looked.', "Pizza is here is so good it feels like I am doing drugs. Came here for a slice, left eating 3. Super thin, buttery sauce, melted cheese. It's fire"]

name: SHAKE SHACK EMPIRE OUTLETS - STATEN ISLAND FERRY
reviews: ['The place was clean and quiet, not very crowded at the time. The ordering process was simple, and the service was quick. Staff found to be welcoming and friendly. They have ample indoor and outdoor seating arrangements. Their burgers, fries, drinks, and shakes are popular. But, the items appeared to be a bit overpriced.', "This was a nice place to stop by to grab a quick bite. You order through kiosk and grab a number, and they call the number when it's ready. I went during weekdays, so the restaurant wasn't busy, and I got my food quicker than I expected. The place was nice and clean. I just didn't like the burger that I ordered, which is why I  am giving it a 4 star.", 'As you enter the brooms and dust bin is by the entrance. Very ironic since the floor is grossly dirty and we had to beg someone to clean a table (since non was clean) for us to sit at when only two other families were seated in the large space. Not cool! The food also took a long time and they were not that busy inside.', 'Very good shake shack experience! Food was even brought to the table. Compared to other shake shack restaurants the burger was extremely crispy and well salted. Korean bbq options are also very tasty!', 'Ok I have tried a shroom burger and loved it... And ever since I have tried it in Washington I always looked forward to getting it if they had it on the menue, but here it was not good at all. It was smaller in size and had an aftertaste that was not pleasant. My and my husbands stomachs hurted afterwards. The atmosphere is nice, lots of open space. One of the bathrooms was clogged and lots of people were waiting to use the other one.']

name: THE LOCAL
reviews: ['We live near The Local, but this was our first time there. We’ll be going back. The food (a very fine variety to choose from) was delicious, freshly prepared, and definitely made to order. The service, especially Frank our server, was professional, courteous, knowledgeable, and friendly. The place itself is attractive, spacious, and a calm place to enjoy a meal. It’s couple friendly, kid friendly, family friendly, and available for larger gatherings. This is a great part of our community and a great place to eat in Staten Island.', 'I rarely give a restaurant five stars but this is well deserved. Super friendly service which is always important to me. We had the French onion soup and sirloin tips for appetizer and they were delicious. I had the Blackened Burger and it was cooked to perfection. My wife had the Caesar Salad and enjoyed every bite. Another big plus for me was that the place was very clean. Thoroughly enjoyed our meal, would definitely visit again.', 'My Wife and I had a delicious brunch at the at this fine establishment! The strip steak and eggs I ordered were extra delicious, as were the eggs Benedict Marge had. Our meals came with breakfast sausage, bacon, and crispy home fries. We highly recommend this restaurant for its excellent food and service!', 'James is the best waiter. He always on his game. I always look forward to seeing him. The bartender is so sweet. And on her game. You never have to wait for her.', 'Local bar / Restaurant just like the name. It has a happy hour crowd from the neighborhood.  If there is a local sports game on TV, It gets a bit lively and loud. Overall great neighborhood place.']

name: ORIENTAL PLAZA
reviews:
["Went today for lunch with my hubby. The women who seated us didn't say a word nor crack a smile. The place is very outdated and needs a complete make over!
Getting servers to take our order was very slow, but once they did food came quick.
Wonton soup very doughy and was a bit cold.
Beef & broccoli sauce super heavy
General tsao had heavy batter, but was OK.
Noodles & duck sauce were my favorite part.", 'I used the website to place an order and I picked it up.

Ordering on the website was easy. I didn’t see any options for a drink.

My order was ready in 20 minutes.

I got the general tso meal, fried dumplings and wonton soup.

General chicken was tasty but the inside was a little dry. But it was very tasty and the portion was a good size.

Wonton soup was excellent!

Fried dumplings were very good!

Egg roll was very good.', "We catered food for our organization's Board Meeting and it got rave reviews from our attendees. Delivery was on time and his service was great. The trays we ordered were generously portioned and tasted great. We were happy to support this wonderful restaurant as they have always been very generous with donations for our special events.", "First time here. So many recommendations off of fb in a group formed with residents who live in Staten Island. Restaurant is VERY OUTDATED. Needs major upgrade. Food wasn't so good. Only thing that was delicious was the shrimp and broccoli, ribs and the spring rolls. Fried chicken wings were freshly fried which was great but had no seasoning what so ever and there was to much batter on the chicken. My boyfriend ate them. The general tso chicken had way to much batter and the vegetable fried Rice smelled spoiled and was way too soft. We told the waiter and he told us they sell alot of the general tso chicken and  they pay so much for it so for it to be thrown away wasn't good. Wouldn't go back here again to dine in. I would just take the ribs and shrimp and broccoli to go. The alcohol drinks were very strong and good. The sushi was also good as an appetizer. Older crowd in there 50's and up. Didn't get to take a picture of the sushi.  My boyfriend ordered a large ribs to go after eating the small for an appetizer. Bbq sauce was delicious on them", "Wasn't too busy, so we were sat quickly. The dumplings were great and would highly recommend, teriyaki was tender and sauce was on point, the rice was so fluffy and not hard at all, and the california roll was so refreshing."]

name: DRAGON HOUSE
reviews: ["Better for pick up I will not be ordering again my driver argued with me that he called my phone I did not get anything sent to me. Long story short my meal was 12.50 I told the driver that I never said he can have a tip so I'm supposed to get 7.50 back and I only get 5$ so he took 2.50 it's not about the tip it's the rudeness I keep dealing with and now 2.50 taken without permission I called the shop and the guy said next time he will give me two dollars credit there is no next time I am officially done all that for a order of crab ragoon a beef and cheese egg roll and a soda 12.50 and a headache no thank you.  Edit: The beef and cheese eggroll I can't break or bite it's solid like a brick", 'This is absolutely ONE  of the WORST Chinese food places on the island. Everything is either always hard or or doesn’t even taste like food to begin with OR COOKING IT ALL THE WAY . Please pleasee please save your money or suggest spending it elsewhere where .  I’m truly scared there not even feeding the people actual food . Please be aware and always CHECK YOUR FOOD BEFORE YOU LEAVE', 'No fortune cookies which disappointed my son but the food is decent and they are fast. My husband loves their lemonade', 'We ordered chick wings over pork fried rice and beef & broccoli. So delicious!', 'This place is awesome the staff is super friendly on the phone and they deliver almost anywhere on the island so cool']

name: Z ONE DINER
reviews:
['Went for lunch. They have a nice lunch specia.  it includes soup, lunch, coffee & desert for $18.95.  Great price so much food.  Staff was very attentive.', 'I went here for the first time today and I was absolutely blown away. The food was amazing and the atmosphere was very welcoming. Pricing is great and staff is friendly which is very hard to find on the island. 10/10 recommend will definitely be visiting again soon.', 'We loved this place so much, we went twice in three days. Excellent food, more than enough options (even for the pickiest of eaters), and the staff is top tier. Very quick and attentive, and super kind and accommodating.', 'I came here for the first time today for breakfast. This place is so cute. Half of the restaurant looks like a classic diner and the other half a fancy bar/restaurant. They have a decent size menu and in my opinion the prices are pretty reasonable. I ordered the pancakes with banana and pecans and they were very flavorful. They also make a really good cup of coffee. The overall appearance of the entire restaurant itself is clean, but the bathroom needs a little work. My waitress was friendly and my food came out fast. There is also plenty of parking, which for this Brooklynite it is a huge plus! I definitely stop by again the next time I drive through the area.', 'So I had a Dr.s apt & end up here because In the morning I had a final & didn’t get a chance to eat anything until now. Before my apt I had some time so I said let’s try it out.

From outside I wasn’t sure if I can find any vegetarian items to try out. Obviously this is not a halal restaurant. But they actually had couple of vegetarian items & seafood !

When I went inside I was surprised, the interior is pretty nice. Restaurant looks clean & loved the vibe of everything. They also have a nice looking huge bar. I don’t drink but I had to pass it on my way to the restroom. The restroom needs little work, doesn’t match with the restaurant look. That’s one reason I gave this place 4 stars.

I ordered mozzarella sticks, strawberry lemonade & vegetarian melt. With good portions & great taste I enjoyed my food .

The stuff were wonderful & knowledgeable about the menu & the taste. That’s always a plus while trying out new restaurants.

Now comes the price, for all I have ordered the bill came out almost 40$ . As a student like me can I effort this a regular basis? NO! For me it was little costly but I am sure for others price isn’t a matter.
I was too full to try their coffee, next time Ofcource.

Thank you all for the hospitality, I will highly recommend to try their food. And Ofcource u know me 🤣have to take pictures 😜']

name: LA BOTTIGLIA ITALIAN RESTAURANT
reviews: ["Saw so many great reviews and finally tried it. We are so mad we didn't get here sooner. Food was delicious and service was great. One of the best Alla Vodka sauces I have had. We will most definitely be back. Shout out to our server Chris.", 'Just had my first meal at La Bottiglia and I am a happy customer. The service was impeccable and the food was delicious!! We had the Antipasto Caldo for two was a nice selection of their apps (everything was yummy.) The bolognese was delicious as was the chicken parmigiana. Highly recommend.', 'New Italian restaurant that I finally  visited & had a Wonderful  anniversary dinner ! Food was Excellent,  Staff was attentive & friendly & Owner introduced himself as we entered & returned  to table to make sure everything was good ! I Highly recommend the pitcher of Sangria so good. We shared an Octopus 🐙 appetizer that was delish. Our main dishes were the Bronzeno with fresh veggies & Borratta filled Ravioli  with red sauce 😋', 'House wine was good. White sangria was week. Meatball appetizer was ok. Tomahawk was good. We ordered a little above rare because after they slice it, you can cook it a little more on the hot plate. The sauce that comes with it is tasty.  I will definitely be back.', 'I dined here twice and I enjoyed it. The food was delicious and good portions. Everyone was extremely friendly and kind. The owner came to my table and thank us for our company. We should support Staten Island businesses especially when the service and food is top tier.']

name: ISLAND GARDEN
reviews:
['Just ordered delivery food from here:

Two orders of fried chicken wings with fried rice, General Tso’s chicken, and seafood pan fried noodles.

General Tso’s chicken was not good.  It’s soggy, and is dark red—darkest red I’ve ever seen for this dish.  Asked them for extra spicy and there’s no hint of spiciness.  Just sweet and salty.

Fried chicken wings taste like leftover/overnight chicken wings that were reheated again.

Pan fried noodles are so salty we practically have to throw it away.  Need to add our own noodles in to dilute some of saltiness in order to be edible.  Ingredients were also cheap and soggy.  No hint of stir-fry.

Overall wasn’t cheap either—over $50 with tax and tip.

If you can’t get General Tso’s chicken or fried chicken wings right, you’re not a good Chinese take out restaurant.  Would never order from here again.', 'Co workers and myself frequently come to this location when we’re working around the Verrazano Bridge.

Food is nonetheless outstandingly good, especially their Shrimp with Broccoli and house special fried rice to mixed into the sauce. Chicken Wings have a nice crisp which I like most.

Staff already knows us so its a mutual thing when it comes to customer service. Best Chinese food in SI so far (my opinion).', 'Delivery guy on point with door step delivery but the food is NOT fresh. My husband immediately threw up after eating a chicken wing. Mind you pay attention they don’t even eat the food they prepare there. You HAVE been warned.', 'I paid with my debit card over the phone and they never brought my food. I’ve been ordering from this Chinese store for years and some young man/woman was taking the orders and after over an hour of waiting I asked to be refunded. The young man/woman said “ok bye” and hung up. I’ve never felt so disrespected and annoyed. But I better get my money back', 'The food was inedible their half chicken was super dry and hard. It seem that the chef took it out of the freezer then put it in the microwave and finished in the fryer. The result was a super dry inedible piece of meat. The fried rice was flavorless, overall this restaurant lacks in tasty food. The worst Chinese food I’ve tried in a while, cautious when ordering from this restaurant. I would consider you skip them and order elsewhere. Yuck!']

name: EMPIRE EAST
reviews:
['Empire is definitely my place to go when I’m craving Chinese food. I usually order the chicken chow Mein and my Wonton In Egg Drop Soup which this is the only place that I feel makes the soup perfect. I just order Thai Basil Chicken , which I have to say it was delicious definitely be ordering that more often. All the years eating from Empire I never had a bad experience.', 'I came here because I just tooked a break doing UE deliveries and decide to go to a chincese place.

When I ordered the Chow Main Shrimp and a tea,  pay and wait patiently. When the girl at the front desk gaved me or receive the plate, for my surprise  that looks like something else.  For me it does looks like lobster sauce or something, plate looks slammy/sloppy and  not apetizing and they didnt gaved me the tea that I request it.

I went back to the girl and explain what kind of food is this one? She reply and told me that I maybe was thinking “Lo Main” and not Chow Main.

But didnt offer an exception of exchange the correct plate.

In addition to this the rice felt uncooked!

Ive been 30 years in Staten Island and have ate chinese all my life.

I dont know what kind of service is this but for sure I wont comeback!

This is a restaurant with poor quality overall.

I know because I am a Chef in NYC and I do UE on the side.

I know what is good service and poor service in the kitchen.

This is a poor service served.', "Their food is pretty good.  However, it's very inconvenient when ordering online for delivery for two reasons.  One, they do not accept credit card.  I would definitely order much more frequent if they do.

Secondly, they always charge more than the price shown online when they arrive, every single time, this is false advertising and it's annoying especially it's cash only.", "I visited your restaurant yesterday and ordered two all-day combos (sesame chicken and General Tso's chicken), shrimp fried wontons, a side of mixed vegetables (sauce on the side), and a seltzer. The total came to $66, which was much higher than expected. After reviewing the receipt, I noticed that the shrimp wonton appetizer was $14.95, and I was charged an additional $1.50 for each extra sauce. I also upgraded my combos to chicken fried rice and vegetable fried rice instead of pork.

Unfortunately, the food was inedible. The chicken tasted like it was fried in old oil, and some pieces, although white, tasted like old meat. I’ve eaten here once before and had a decent experience, which is why I returned. However, this time my family refused to eat the food and even asked me to get a refund, which I might consider doing.

The only positive aspect of my visit was the friendly service from the woman who took my order. I’m sharing this feedback in the hope that it will lead to improvements, as I’m now reconsidering whether to return or leave a review to inform others.", "I've been searching for a good chinese restaurant since I've moved to Staten Island. Empire East is the only good place I've found.  The food is hot, fresh, and tastes great! And they have homemade traditional hot mustard! Those little packets are bunk..."]

name: SIMPLE ASIA
reviews: ['The sushi burrito is really interesting it’s basically a jumbo sized sushi roll. It’s super delicious but very very  filling compared to getting multiple smaller rolls. I ordered the tuna/spicy tuna burrito 10/10 would definitely order again. I also got a spicy tuna onigiri, the apple Kani salad, and the roasted duck buns.', 'It’s my first time ordering in this place coz my co worker said that somebody tried and looks good. So I ordered. Food came and I started eating it. But unfortunately, towards the end, I saw a human hair on my food. I feel so disgusted. The food is good until I saw the hair. Staff needs to use hair nets when preparing food so it won’t go to the food.', 'This place is wonderful. I used to come with my wife before Covid, and we since moved to NJ. The food was always out of this world amazing. I went back recently and was pleasantly surprised to see that the prices on the menu were almost unchanged from before Covid, which is virtually unheard of, and the food was still just as amazing. It’s a family run business and they take so much pride in their work and are the sweetest people. Give it a shot, you won’t be disappointed.', 'My life would be over if this place ever closed. I’ve moved to Jersey and I think about Simple Asia every day. You will never find a sushi burrito like this anywhere on earth. I will carry Simple Asia with me until the day I die.', "I'm giving 5 ⭐ to the old restaurant that just closed down. The new place doesn't carry  poke bowls or other original items that I thought were the best on the island. Sad."]

name: SAHARA MEDITERRANEAN GRILL
reviews:
['Stopped in for lunch. I selected the chicken soup and Mediterranean Salad. Both were delicious. My meal was accompanied with fresh warm bread.  It was delicious.
The staff was friendly and efficient. Parking was easy.
I highly recommend!!!

Only a few needs improvement.
The front door is a very heavy pull to open.
The front entrance area needs improvement. There is no decoration.  In essence you are walking into the takeout stand, dishes, and kitchen. Things are taped everywhere. You do not feel welcomed into a nice clean restaurant.', 'My parents have been coming here for years. So happy I finally tagged along to try it with them. The food is fresh. The portions are big. They even sent out complementary ice cream for my kids. Would definitely recommend', 'Been coming here for years, The best place for Turkish food on the island , service is impeccable and the food is always fresh and delicious. Highly recommend!', 'Tried this restaurant for a dinner take out for the family and everyone liked it.
The adana kabab was very flavorful and cooked to perfection. The only disappointment was the calves liver. The portions were very small and it seemed like it was a mixture of beef and calves liver not just calves liver.
Overall a decent restaurant.', "Recently visited Sahara Mediterranean Grill in Staten Island and was thoroughly impressed. The Grand Mix Meal was exceptional, a true testament to the authentic Mediterranean flavors they promise. Not only was the food remarkable, but the beautiful waitresses and the restaurant's captivating aesthetic contributed to a memorable dining experience."]

name: EVAS TAQUERIA LINDO CAFETAL MEXICAN RESTAURANT
reviews:
['Tacos bistec, pastor and chicharrón gordita today, very fresh, very nice!! I have to come back to try the rest of the menu.
If you want you can order delivery with Grubhub.', "Fantastic Food, flavorful, large portions. The Hostess was amazing, sweet, inviting, and friendly. The own was also very welcoming. Overall honestly some of the best Mexican food I've eaten. Will definitely return here!", 'The food is excellent and the staff and owners are wonderful!', 'Chicken quesdillas was great
Also chicken fingers and French fries.
Quesdillas was not oily and a lot of salad.
Chicken fingers was cooked in very clean oil.
Homemade salsa and sauce.
Place was remodeled.
Nice table cloth.
New tiles and  very clean
Prices are great.
Quality and quality.
Very high standards!!!!!', "Incredibly clean, lovely atmosphere, delicious food. It's more cozy and intimate than nearby restaurants or diners. Standard competitive prices, but it's definitely worth the cost and the wait."]

name: EL SABOR PERUANO
reviews:
['Walked in and was properly seated with my party.... All through attention was okay...
The Parihuela was a two at best... Was missing that wao on the broth + fish was okay... The rest of us were okay with our meals + non were salty but did lack authentic flavors ... Can handle large crowds
Priced right for neighborhood/service added
May return to try something different and then update the review...', 'The restaurant is a little small, and the service is a little slow but friendly. The food definitely makes up for it. Everything tastes so fresh. You have to try.', 'I am extremely disappointed with the service we received for our catering order. We left a down payment in advance and expected our food to be ready when we arrived, as agreed. Instead, we had to wait a full hour for the food to be prepared. This caused a significant delay and inconvenience for our event.

What’s worse is that there was no proper communication or apology for the situation. This level of unprofessionalism is unacceptable, especially for catering services where timeliness is crucial.

I cannot recommend this restaurant for catering, and I hope they improve their processes in the future to avoid causing other customers similar frustration.', 'Was in the area and wanted a quick bite. Awesome little spot, server was very friendly and food was really tasty! Will go again.', 'Absolutely phenomenal Peruvian cuisine. It’s a small place, sorely lacking in ambiance, but the food is what you are there for. I recently enjoyed the Lomo Saltado and Tallarín Saltado. They serve mountains of food. You can easily split one dish  between two people.']

name: TOMMYS TAVERN + TAP
reviews: ['It was my first time at this restaurant/bar/pizzeria I have got to say it was amazing. I noticed the place is very spacious and clean. The staff are professional and friendly. My waiter was wonderful. The menu is huge with unique dishes I haven’t seen at other bars. The food was so good I had started with two appetizers and a entree. The pretzel was fresh, soft and delicious, I just wish it had less salt on it. The spinach and artichoke dip was too good, it was thick, creamy and cheesy. The sushi was my favorite dish, it was of the best sushi I ever had. I also tried the grilled chicken & mushrooms with fresh basil pizza it was fresh and fantastic. I’m very impressed with this business.', 'We go to Tommy’s every week and absolutely love the place. The food, service, atmosphere are all top notch. The fact that the managers care enough to always come over and ask if everything is ok is a plus because most places don’t do this. Also the wait staff is not only friendly but very attentive. My husband and i love this place. Especially the fire roasted wings', 'Alexa was very friendly, witty and social, providing us with a fun and enjoyable experience! The food was good and flavorful, with a unique twist to its original format (I.e., fried onion strips on top of the French onion soup - which was delicious!). The prices were reasonable as well and the selection is incredibly varied, so will definitely come back to try some of their many other selections! The ambiance is pretty comfortable with a sports bar vibe and definitely felt welcoming.\n\nThank you for reading and best of luck! (:', 'Food is delicious and nice and Hot. Waiters very attentive', 'The food here is always on point and never disappointed. The atmosphere is great with good music always playing. The bartenders are always nice especially Jennifer, Ya Ya, Jessica, Jennifer, Krystal, Frank and Elisa. Managers always come around and say hi. This place has so far never disappointed me.']

name: YEMEN CAFE & RESTAURANT
reviews:
['Update 1 - 2 Stars - September 2024
Major disappointment this time around. Probably won’t try this location again.

Original review: 5 Stars - June 2024
Yemeni food is one of the my favorite cuisines. So much flavor and the taste is simply amazing!
I have dined at their other locations around NYC and this was my first time at this location.
They did not disappoint! Amazing food, great service and staff were friendly and attentive.
We had dinner here on a Tuesday night and the place was packed. You probably will need reservations for weekend dinners.
I absolutely love this place!', 'Was delicious and the meat was so tender it was falling off the bone. The traditional Yemeni bread is so soft, but with a crisp outer layer. They greeted us and gave us soup and tea. So delicious 🤤 it was very interesting that our waiter spoke four languages. I’d highly recommend this restaurant if you’re interested in having delicious rice with tendered meat, whether it be lamb or chicken.', 'Tried this place for the first time after a long road trip. Mashallah mashallah mashallah haven’t had good Yemeni food like this in a while. The service was fast and always checked up on us. The ambiance was amazing love the interior. The food was great alhamdulilah really enjoyed it the meat was so nice and tender the soup and salad with the bread was all so yummy and fresh. Would highly recommend to check this place out inshallah. Will be back again inshallah!', 'Order a takeout today. The Lamb Haneeth(I can’t even pronounce the word)is excellent, but even better is the bread and dipping sauce that come with it. The combo deserves five stars!!! First time here, will be back soon.', 'Great atmosphere, available parking, very kind and polite staff, and very good quality Yemeni food. Check it out and you will not be disappointed.']

name: THE MANOR
reviews:
['I had dinner with my friend and he’s two daughters at this restaurant today. We four of us went there for lunch. The restaurant welcomed us with warm and friendly.

the place was clean and waiters with their uniforms were clean and behaving polite so one of them took our orders.a few moment later the side dishes was brought to us we really enjoyed it. The mains was good with all of meals we love.  We had few beers and few shots, it was amazing thanks to Eddy, and I want to thanks specially Michelle and Eddy for the great service,
We really recommend the restaurant, because the taste of the food is incredible, the prices are affordable and the atmosphere and attention from the staff is amazing. Thank you and wish you all the best❤️', 'The new renovation inside is absolutely fantastic! Great place to get a quick bite to eat. Outdoor area is very nice, service is always really good and food is pretty good. Definitely recommend the burgers and french onion soup! Do not recommend the baked clams!', 'Food is delicious and prices are reasonable. Every time i have gone there i was not disapointed. Excellent food and service. Highly approve.', "It's a nice cozy place, we had brunch and we really enjoyed it. The price is great for the pre fixed brunch special. The food was really good, parking was kind of tight", 'Great food, great service
A little noisy sometimes']

name: STATEN ISLAND DINER
reviews: ['Small place.  We can in around 5 with 3 ppl .1 old and big, 1 big n tall(me) and big mentally ill...  1 of my party had an allergic reaction so he needed to calm down before eating j the waiter was cool that after explaining.  but the bad thing was after ordering we had to flag him down too many times. Fries could have cooked longer.. My chicken cordon bleu panini was missing the sauce very dry, barely cheesed.  I ordered a drink and  2 apps mac n cheese bites and wings. Both great. But my ice tea was gone ...asked for another tea and a water.. Still waiting on the waiter. We even took 2 more things home. Philly cheese steak with a little skimpy buy good. I even decently tipped 15$ on 130$ with iffy service.', 'Great service by the staff... always attentive to our needs. Food had big servings... to big for us filipinos. The taste and quality of the food was great for us... the ambiance was clean... though parking was a bit small. There is also an alfresco option.', 'Absolutely love this diner! Food is good, staff is amazing. They are all so friendly. I come here at least once a week for breakfast, and now and then lunch. I highly recommend!', "Very creative breakfast menu. You must try the Rick Flair, but you really can't go wrong with their specialties. Been ordering on Uber Eats for a while, finally decided to actually see the place for myself. Ambience is very blue collar: first response patches and union stickers in the front door. A lot of interesting collectibles and figurines about on mantles. This place has personality as great as it's food! 5 Stars!", 'When you’re looking to fill up this is the place. Always a friendly atmosphere, and always greeted when you walk through the door. Most weekend  mornings are busy so get there early. this is what i ordered today for lunch. This is usually my weekend breakfast spot when we want to treat ourselves. They have the craziest breakfast combinations and plates so big even i cant finish all the food and your coffee cup is never empty. Great pricing for the service, atmosphere and food Quality and quantity. If there was an option for a 6th star this place would get it.']

name: CHINAR ON THE ISLAND
reviews:
["The restaurant's elegant decor creates an enjoyable ambience for any occasion.  The food was delicious. I loved the sweet duck and the mixed meat grill along with the potatoes and mushrooms.  Music and atmosphere was relaxing and energetic.  Owner was very nice in assisting us in planning our next event with Chinar.", 'So amazing! Went there yesterday to celebrate my grandmas birthday and everything was perfect!', 'Met a friend of mine while visiting from Ireland and was advised to come for a meal while I was around Staten Island.

The food quality brought me back to where I was from and tasted better than whatever my mum used to make! To say that I was impressed by the lamb chops is to say absolutely nothing.

Great vibe. The place, not too loud, not too quiet. Fountain was quite deadly. Will definitely recommend my mates to stop by when they take the ferry from Manhattan.
The fellas are doing a great job', 'Simply, the best! From amazing food and great service to very personal attention from both the owner and manager Zaza! We had a huge birthday party there, and everyone absolutely loved the place, food and service! Huge thanks to all the staff!', "I came all the way from London to visit Chinar! I had the best experience at this restaurant. The staff at Chinar are friendly and knowledgeable, always ready to assist and make your experience special. The restaurant's attention to detail extends to its elegant decor, creating a pleasant ambience for any occasion. My favourite meal was the lamb chops, alongside the potatoes! Their food goes above and beyond any restaurant I have been to before. Couldn't recommend enough!"]

name: CAFE BELLA VITA ITALIAN RESTAURANT
reviews:
['The portions were enormous and the place was surprisingly elegantly appointed for a place in a strip mall!

For $40 we got essentially a 5 course meal: bread, salad, appetizer, entree, and dessert. Basically 2 whole meals for $40. Not too shabby!

Their salmon with champagne sauce was quite good. Their tomatoes were unfortunately just so-so which is surprising given it was summertime when we dined. The "parfait" was literally just ice cream and the other desserts were pretty average as well. Clearly not a place that employs an Italian pastry chef.

One of the waiters seemed very cranky to be there but the other staff were charming and lovely.

Overall, great value!', 'I dined here for Thanksgiving dinner. Many times, holiday service is spotty. You don’t get a good representation of what a restaurant can offer when there is a holiday menu. I found their menu to have a lot of great options, including traditional Italian dishes, as well as traditional Thanksgiving fair.

Most importantly, service was great. While the restaurant was quite crowded, the service was never hurried, rushed, or lacking. The wait staff was on point.

The food was delicious. The atmosphere was relaxing, not too noisy or chaotic. Even the restrooms were immaculate. I met the owner and thanked her for a lovely Thanksgiving meal experience. We will be back to dine and try their regular menu one day soon. Highly recommend Café Bella Vita.', "This place is a Staten Island institution, the staff are so friendly and knowledgeable, and make no mistake, just because you don't see what you want on the menu doesn't mean the chef won't do his best to make you exactly what you want. There isn't a dish on the that won't knock your socks off but my favorite is the osso bucco. I've been to Bella Vita for so many family birthdays, it's like a second home to me and my big fat Italian family. We just love it\U0001fa77", "I have a genuine love for this place; it has left a lasting impression on me. Having been there twice, I can confidently say that I absolutely adore it. The combination of great prices, exceptional service, and delicious food makes it an outstanding dining experience. What captivated me even more was the inviting atmosphere that enveloped me as soon as I walked in.

It's not just a place to eat; it's an experience that you cherish. Every moment spent there is delightful, and the staff goes above and beyond to ensure you have a memorable time. They are always attentive, making sure you're content with your choices and genuinely caring about your satisfaction.

Believe me when I say, you will thoroughly enjoy your time there!!!", 'Had a luncheon event at Bella Vita and was impressed with the service and food quality. Nick took care of us from the start to the end. He was very prompt with our request and needs. He made our lunch very pleasant. He was very attentive to all the guests. Definitely will be back.']

name: KINGS ARMS DINER
reviews:
['Very good place to grab what you looking for vast and rich menu seafood snacks Italian Greek American Mexican breakfast lunch and dinner
Burgers steaks soups coffee smoothies extra', "It's been several times that I've been here and the food is always good atmosphere is fun music is good very much what a diner should feel like.", "I ordered the big breakfast which came out to $32. I wanted it delivered to my job. The girl dropped off the food and didn't have change so she said. I gave her $40 so she got an $8 tip. They fail to bring me a fork and ketchup. The food was pretty tasty. I asked the girl if she had ketchup and a fork and her vehicle and she told me it's not her responsibility. It is her responsibility though. I don't think I'm going to do business with them anymore.", 'Childhood favorite! I love this place and have been going here for years. Visited with the family while back on the island and great service, food and environment. $20+ for a sandwich isn’t ideal; however, definitely worth it for a treat!

Very happy here. If I were to give any feedback, avocado was browned.', "Excellent meal with very good service, atmosphere gets a four because it's after all a diner, for better or worse, that's all."]

name: NINO'S RESTAURANT
reviews:
['Spacious eating area and excellent service. My friend ordered something on the menu and I ordered something off the menu and both dishes came out perfect. Very flavorful and delicious. this is not the first time I’ve been here and it will never be the last time. If you don’t come here, you’re missing out.', 'I really cant say enough about this spot. The BEST service I have ever had. They make you feel like family and the food is great. My wife and I stumbled upon this place through our travels in NY and we are glad we found it. We would truly go back every week if we lived closer. If there was a higher rating I would give it. Every thing was 10 out of 10', 'Today I celebrated one of my best friend’s birthdays at Nino’s over lunch.

We started with their goat cheese & walnut salad and grilled portobello with gorgonzola.

For main courses, I had the chicken Sorrentino with prosciutto, eggplant & fontina; she had the eggplant parmigiana with spaghetti, along with an excellent Etna Rosso.

I’ve been eating here for years and I am never disappointed!  Food and service are top-notch!', 'We went there as a package -  dinner and show. While the room does feel a little "banquety" the food and the service is beyond excellent.  The staff moves like a well oiled machine.  I mean they don't miss a beat! The food is anything but banquet.  It is delicious!  We went to see our friend perform and the show did not disappoint.  Excellent overall experience.', 'Mom loves this place, so brought her here for dinner. Now I understand why this is her favorite restaurant. The food was delicious, servers were very attentive and we left happily full (with leftovers). The baked clams appetizer was cooked perfectly, the shrimp scampi over saffron risotto was tasty and mom thoroughly enjoyed her filet of sole oreganata. Looking forward to going back and trying other dishes.']

name: MY PIZZA AND RESTAURANT
reviews: ['Not worth it ordered chicken fajita pizza for take and looks here’s pizza comes up with curry whoever made it have no idea what they doing it was mess eating it I don’t know how somone can call it pizza I dont live close so have to take it as is as I live 45 miles away don’t have time to going there again to make it  order correct kindly do the right thing by looking in atleast YouTube how to make pizza by far that’s worst pizza I ever eat', 'This pizzeria is AMAZING! The food was delicious I got a halal beef pepperoni pie & penne and meat sauce and I was very impressed! The staff is very nice the two Italian siblings have extremely good manners and respect and know how to do their job. Great energy! Pizza is great and so is the pasta I highly recommend THANK YOU! Much respect', "Very affordable pizza shop. $12.99 pie. This reminded me of Jersey Shore boardwalk pizza though. The cheese could be better. That Deviant, Disrespectful Doug gave it a 4.2. A bit harsh. It's a 6.8. May or may not have been the cause of an urgent bowels evacuation a few hours after eating. Can't say for sure, but the possibility remains.", 'The Chicken Alfredo pizza🍕 was bland and I had to say "it\'s for here" twice they offered me a bag and didn\'t bring it to the table I had to get it myself as if they didn\'t want me there.The cook that told me the names of the pizzas was nice. Almost $8 for a slice of pizza that\'s been sitting there for hrs and a bottle of xxx vitamin water. I was hungry I ate all of it and used their bathroom twice that is not really out of order despite the sign on the door.  I was really hungry. my first time there the pizza was awesome and it wasn\'t crowded. Overall it was ok.', 'Halal yes plz!!! I love the pizza outside of Brooklyn the yummiest pizza ever I love the lasagna yum yum I love everything about this place']

name: TACK'S CHINESE TAKE OUT
reviews: ["Tacks has had my heart since i lived in SI. I remember saving up to get a lunch special of general tso's and pork fried rice and eating it up faster than you can say scrumlicious! Tacks is still family owned and operated from what i can tell (and they work hard), flying in from the west coast to eat a childhood guilty pleasure of mind did not dissapoint. Best local chinese takeout place in staten island bar none.", 'Don’t k ow what happened to this place but it’s crap now…. Try listening to what your customers ask for on the phone.\n\ncouldn’t even eat my food it was so gross never ordering from here again', 'I used to know the owner personally. When he sold it to whomever owns it now, it has went downhill. What a shame it used to be top notch. I would never order from them again.', 'What a bitter sweet ending to a brisk fall day. After a long relaxing walk in the trails of Staten Island, one could work up an appetite or two! That’s when we were shadowed with a lovely lake side restaurant with lovely decor that lured us all in! After settling in, we couldn’t help but notice that we were about to spend a pretty penny on dinner! What shall we do!? It’s only Thursday and payday hasn’t even arrived yet! That’s when Tacks Chinese Restaurant was brought to our attention. Having eaten here once before I knew this was the choice for us. For roughly $85 we were more than satisfied and Tacks didn’t miss a beat! From the mouth watering chicken wings to the crispy noodles with sweet duck sauce. I highly recommend this to everyone on Staten Island.  Everyone was able to have their own fortune cookie after as well. Did I mention they now take Credit Card in store as well! Score!!!!! i will definitely be ordering from them again! 10/10!', 'Driver took 40 minutes to deliver my food, Got lost inside the property which is One big circle food was cold']

name: SEAFOOD HIBACHI
reviews: ['The food was delicious the 1st time I had it  after my 2nd,3rd & 4th visit the food became very inconsistent. My most recent visit I ordered a shrimp & broccoli with plain lo mein which came out to $10.20 and they literally gave me 5 pieces of shrimp & the lo mein had a burnt taste to it.  Lately takeout has been over priced & not tasteful.', "This always happens...Delivery driver don't even want to get out of the car,  bad enough you don't come upstairs in the building but at least meet me at the lobby door. What am I tipping Yall for\nGuess I just need to stop spending my money here.", 'I live the seafood boil, I get it spicy. The steak hibachi also good. The steak is always cooked to my liking. I also saw the fresh cut steak when I ordered my food and it was definitely fresh steak and not frozen. 8/10 because the portions  size is small.', 'The food is good but they don’t ever have the driver come up. Every single other place I call brings the food up. This is not the ghetto or the 90’s, no one is going to rob you. I just won’t tip. Some people are handicap and have injuries and some have kids they can’t leave behind. In the city in the projects no matter how bad everyone comes up. In Staten Island ya are afraid or entitled. If you don’t tip I’m sure it will show as a result. The first thing they did when I placed my order was call me to tell me to come down stairs. 😂', 'Food was Great!! finally some good Chinese food Rice was perfect, chicken fresh juice cook to perfection egg roll 10/10']

name: HOLLAND BAY RESTAURANT
reviews: ['As a fellow Jamaican sometimes it’s hard to find good Jamaican food on the island. They are other places, but the food doesn’t even come close. Holland Bay comes very, very close. The best chicken patty I’ve ever had. They are very pleasant and friendly.\n\nWhen I want home cooked food but don’t feel like cooking I think of this place. I’m so glad they are in Staten Island. Blessings to this place❤️', 'Their food is definitely a better option to other culture food places. You get a lot of food for the price and every dish is very tasty. My favorite is the rice and peas with oxtail and plantains. They are very hygienic; They changed gloves after each serving.', "The food was nasty if my child that is eats like a garbage disposal doesn’t want the food as well then it’s not just me I would have been better off cooking it at home that was horrible y'all cheating people out here in real authentic Jamaican cuisine this the second one that was that disappointing", 'The man at the register is very rude and makes nasty comments to the customers. Not good customer service. The small eating area appears run down and they fill most of the takeout plates with rice and less of the dish you ordered.  The jerk chicken was overcooked and some meat was hard and dry. Will take the drive to Brooklyn for better Caribbean food and service.', 'Super affordable and friendly service! Ordered a large ox tail that came with rice and peas plus a side of my choice. There were at least 8 pieces of oxtail, enough of a meal for 2.']

name: MEXICAN CANTINA RESTAURANT & BAR
reviews: ['Today I went to this restaurant. Because last time I  did an online Oder. It was so delicious. Place is so beautiful. It was a Sunday night. Place is not busy. It’s clean and beautiful. Food was delicious. I didn’t get much help from lady who worked there. I wanted to know what kind of food good there. It’s okay she treat me well. I had so many beers and foods. I had hot batter calamari, soft shell tacos. Chicken, pork, beef, fish, shrimp everything is so good with there three sauces . And there is an onion pickles too. Oh my goodness you will love it. I ate them all. And I would love if they have goat meat options but they didn’t carry them. Pls guys add it your menu. Next time I’ll come with my friends.', 'One of my favorite places to get a drink. Wish I lived closer but that would be detrimental to my health anyway. I never had food or a drink here I didn’t like. They have a ridiculous selection of flavored margaritas, mojitos, and sangrias. Last time I went I was hooked on the coconut margarita. Oh and get the empanadas and guacamole.', 'Excellent spot. The drinks might be pricey ($12 for a margarita) but they are worth every cent. Different days have different rates (e.g. Mondays are 2 for 1 margaritas). Sauces are excellent. Warning: the restaurant door faces a very busy Victory Blvd. The tables by the door may ruin your ambience with the sounds from mean traffic and construction events.', 'Amazing and delicious food! The guacamole is the best one I’ve tasted on this island. The drinks were really good. The nachos and sauces were all really good. Anything you order, you will not be disappointed with.', 'This place is awesome! You have such nice customer service,a great bar tender and good music! The food is so mouth watering and fills you up! I love this place I am coming back!']

name: EL PATRON RESTAURANT & LOUNGE
reviews: ['Loved the atmosphere. The passion fruit sangria we ordered was yummy. I ordered the skirt steak with shrimp and it was delicious. A little overcooked than I wanted it to be but seasoned very well and was still tender. The shrimp were perfect. My sides were delicious as well. I ordered the white rice and potatoes which was cooked perfectly and I absolutely loved it.  Will most certainly make another visit soon!', 'I really like this place, they making delicious Mexican foods. I always go for this place when I’m hungry. Good hospitality, clean place, you can have beer to. Thank you guys I enjoyed your food,', 'I’ve come since a little kid and have for the most part ordered the same thing. A couple of weeks ago I had ordered my usual and the waiter seem to have mixed it up. When I got my food it was not what I ordered and I brought it to her attention. She came up to me and when I explained to her what was wrong she rolled her eyes and with a nasty and rude attitude took my food and the gave me the incorrect order again. Once I explained to her in detail she accused me of not ordering my usual and that she heard me say something different. Then she took my plate and asked “ Are you going to pay for this?” In a rude voice. Finally she got the manger involved and he calmly and respectfully gave me the correct order. This is the only reason I’m giving a 1 star for the service manager saved it. The waiter was rude and after the little incident I asked her to bring me a drink she never gave it to me and only gave my friend his drink. To make it all worse when I saw the cheack I had  tipped  her 8$?!? (Tips are included in the check)  keep in mind her service was terrible.  Sad to say never comming here again.', 'I went there for the first time on Memorial Day after enjoying a tour of the USS Milwaukee that was docked at Homeport. The food was amazing, large portions, and the service was attentive and professional. I had the steak burrito meal shown in my picture. I will definitely return, and I highly recommend this restaurant.', "Disgusting business owner. Came in for an order late at night and the owner chased me out with a baseball bat.\nOwner refused to hand over an order that's already been paid for. Disgusting business, do not recommend. Food takes forever to make too. 0/10."]

name: EL POLLO RESTAURANT & BAR
reviews: ["I ordered the T-bone steak with fries. The fries where good and crispy I had to send the steak back because it tasted burnt. Then  I got the pig feet it was very good. I went close to closing time they should keep the grill clean not wait till the end to clean it. But overall I thoroughly enjoyed the pigfeet and fries and the waitress was very nice and professional if I had cash I would've tipped her", "This restaurant always has the slowest delivery. If the drivers comes to pick up the food, they always pretend not to hear it. They always give priority to the customers in the restaurant. You wait for half an hour but no one pays attention to you. If you talk to the staff, they always pretend to be busy and don't hear you. I hope they don't cooperate with the delivery company so that we can guarantee our income.", "They always have great food.  Great neighborhood place for delicious tasting Spanish food.  Haven't had a bad meal yet!", 'First time about 2 weeks ago and to be a Spanish restaurant I can say that my pernil is much better than then and my yuca with pickle red onions.My friend didn’t like her soup at all.My opinion,they have to season their food more .', "Ordered for delivery, food arrived cold and I am 5 minute drive.
