I ordered yellow rice and beans and they put the beans on top of rice instead of separate bowl, I don't eat beans, had to toss the rice. Could have at least put them on the side and not on top if you are trying to save money on bowls!!"]

name: EL PATRON RESTAURANT & LOUNGE 2
reviews:
['Amazing authentic Mexican food ! Portions are great !!! Food is delicious . We had the chicken fajitas and I had the chicken enchiladas . Can’t wait to come back !!!', 'The food was just okay.  However make sure you compare the price on the menu to whats on the check.  I caught them on 2 items overcharging. First they said oops they gave me an old menu.  But then they gave me  the new paper menu and the price on that menu was still much lower than what was on the check. When I questioned them (20 minutes) they realized they were caught and I wasn’t stupid.
They eventually.charged me the original price from the menu that I used to order.  Difference of Price was almost 24.00 dollars.  I will never go there again.
I just read some reviews and noticed what happened to me had happened to many people as well.  ( 7 months ago and even 3 years ago).  The woman there should get an Oscar for best actress “playing dumb to the price”
Now I know this is a deliberate overcharging I will contact whomever to stop other people from being taken advantage of.', 'Ordered the nachos, birria quesadilla, tacos and a gordita. Everything was DELICIOUS!! This was our first time here, definitely coming back!!', 'Food was good and drinks were buy 1 get one even better great Margheritas', 'Everything I’ve ordered from here so far is delicious! Birria tacos, nachos with meat, sopes, tacos, rice/beans, quesadilla! I keep trying something new each time! Highly recommend.']

name: M & K

Today I saw their Sanitary Inspection Grade. A Big Fat C!
Please see pictures attatched and take care. So sad won't be coming here again. Extremely disappointed.", 'This place is the worst gave a whole chicken from the day before was barely chewable had to throw it straight in the garbage']

name: CASA VERDE RESTAURANT
reviews:
['I’m not big fans of pasta, but this place foods were so delicious!!!! All the staffs were super friendly, we were celebrating my husband birthday today and we had wonderful time here!', 'A gem  local Italian restaurant!
We had amazing chicken Marsala with green salad and lentil soup for appetizer.
One of the best Italian places on New York in our opinion!
And good service, nice warm ambiance.
We drove from New Jersey here, worth every minute we spent in traffic.
Highly recommended !', "An absolute gem in Staten Island! From the moment I walked in, the warm and welcoming atmosphere set the stage for an unforgettable dining experience. The staff was incredibly friendly, and the host's hospitality made us feel right at home. Now, let's talk about the food – the Chicken Parmesan was a masterpiece! Each bite was a perfect harmony of flavors, leaving me craving more. This Italian restaurant deserves a solid 5 out of 5 for its exceptional service, inviting ambiance, and, of course, mouthwatering dishes. Highly recommend for anyone looking to indulge in authentic and delightful Italian cuisine!", 'Excellent Italian food. Large choice of dishes to choice from. They have a dinner menu at a set price. It includes an appetizer,  a salad, a main course, a desert, and a coffee ☕️  or espresso.  They have an excellent wine selection as well.  The service is outstanding,  friendly, courteous,  and very professional.  Thank you Shendi (our waiter) for making our dining experience so enjoyable.  I recommend this Italian restaurant without a second thought.  It is excellent! If you want great food and service on Staten Island,  this is the place to go!', 'I had their chicken triestina and my husband had the chicken parm. Both were delicious! Fresh and cane to our table quickly. Great service as well! Bread and water served to us as soon as we sat down.']

name: MAIZAL RESTAURANT
reviews:
['This place is, by far, our favorite Mexican restaurant.  It is a beautiful spot with a very friendly staff.  The food is excellent.  Worth the drive from Manhattan.  We always order too much food so we have leftovers.  Drinks are great.  I can go about two months at the most and then I start craving their food and there is no substitute.  Thanks for being so consistently amazing.', 'Maizal is an excellent spot for authentic Mexican cuisine. The restaurant is family owned and operated which seems to enhance the care of their service. My family and I frequent this place often; we’ve been here as a couple, a trio, and in groups of 4-12 ppl. The service is always efficient and friendly. The dishes are deliciously reliable and the atmosphere is warm and inviting. There is a back patio for dining when weather permits which is enjoyable in the spring and summer. Additionally, the restaurant has a cute bar where you can enjoy well-crafted cocktails, wait for your friends, or watch the chefs! Ample street parking is available. Highly recommend! Definitely get the mole!', "I went in and I asked if I can sit at the table which I pointed out to the host.  I called him over asking where the restroom was and he thought I was ready to order,  I don't know how that request that mixed up but I asked again and he pointed to the restrooms.  I returned to be waited on , a lady came by ready to take my order.   I asked her the price of the skirt steak entree since it wasn't on the menu and everything else was,  it was $34 which let me too decide for the special instead since it brought more and it was $35 for the skirt steak special.   The wait for the food was long so I suggest to order an appetizer cause the portions are small and they make it fresh so that's how come the wait too.  Finally the food came,  omg it's so delicious,  fresh , my hats off to the chef who made this amazing meal.   The ambience very relaxing,  the food amazing,  the service could be better though.   The lady asked me how was the food when I was almost done with it and offered water when I was done paying the bill.  The lady offered desert with the menu in her hand , usually a server asks if I would like dessert or a coffee if I say yes then I'll ask for the dessert menu.  Overall place was very clean and the food is great.   It's a hidden treasure in Staten Island but the service needs to improve to bring back customers,  I'll still come back cause the chef cooked amazing,  best yellow plantains ever!", 'Maizal continues to be a favorite place of mine for Mexican food and drinks. The atmosphere is always comforting and homey complete with art decorating the walls, plants in the window, and little vases on the tables.

They have gluten free and vegan dishes as well as vegetarian dishes that can be made vegan if ordered without the cheese and sour cream. I had their spinach and mushroom burrito bowl and it was delicious. The vegan enchiladas verde are another go-to choice that I have gotten many times.

They also have great flavored margaritas. The hibiscus is my fav. And their homemade guacamole is a must-have to start off your meal.

The staff is also always super nice and the bathrooms are clean which we love to see.

They recently added some new menu items so I included some screenshots of the menu from their website since I forgot to take a picture in person.', 'Maizal has been one of my favorites for years. This is delicious Mexican (not Tex Mex!) The atmosphere is quaint & authentic feeling, the food is always delicious, the bar is great with so many great tequila selections & the service is always wonderful & welcoming. Highly recommend.']

name: J'S ON THE BAY
reviews: ['My Top 10 must try restaurants on Staten Island. If you value excellent food with great service at a reasonable price, then look no more. I pity anyone who hasn’t tried J’s On The Bay’s classic chicken and waffles, and who can forget the croissants and chocolate butter spread that comes out fresh with each meal! Delectable- Delicious - Definitely worth it!!! I personally don’t consider anyone a true Staten Islander who hasn’t been there at least once.', 'We enjoyed a really nice dining experience here this morning. The food was delicious and prepared PERFECTLY! Our host was such a nice young man who was so pleasant to talk with and tell us about the city. He is a terrific ambassador for his restaurant and for the city.', 'Awesome food! I almost needed a "wheelchair" after my breakfast! Staff was great and the food was to die for! One of Staten Islands gems! Bourdain would be proud of the Chef and his staff. I\'ll be back...as Arnold would say.', "I took my daughter here to enjoy a girl's brunch for her 14th birthday. It was a great time! We enjoyed our food and the service was great! I'm so thankful we were able to get a seat as I learned (upon arrival) that it's best to have a reservation on Sundays as they fill up quickly. We enjoyed the food we ordered, plus the complimentary croissants w/chocolate butter. Every single bite was eaten 😋.  Great job!", 'Been frequenting this place since diner days. Chef Joe has elevated the menu and it doesn’t disappoint. Everything was good. Went for a birthday breakfast/brunch. The steak, chicken and fries that day was a tad over done.. But I’ll definitely be back, everything else was delicious! Especially the appetizer. I heard Chef Joe wasn’t there that day.']

name: M & K SPANISH RESTAURANT
reviews:
['The food is just okay. They should clean the chicken a bit more though. I paid $11 for a medium chicken and rice plate. I think that should’ve been on a lunch special but they don’t have one. The service was good though and the restaurant is clean.', 'Lack of clarity and disrespect for pet owners

After sitting down and starting to eat with my dog by my side, I was informed that pets were not allowed. However, there was no sign at the entrance indicating that pets were prohibited. This is unacceptable, as customers need to be aware of such restrictions before entering.

According to legislation (Federal Law 11.126/2005), which addresses support animals, establishments must clearly indicate whether animals are permitted or not.

I recommend that other pet owners avoid this place until this issue is resolved. I suggest the owner provide proper signage at the entrance to avoid future inconveniences.', 'All food is dried out the warming trays must be destroying the food.  I visited yesterday and I got roast pork and barbecue chicken with white rice and the food is beyond dry!', 'Food was sooooo oily. I was eating straight bacalao oil. Not only that but they need people who communicate better. The ladies barely know English and some just don’t. They have bad attitudes because they don’t understand anything you’re saying or asking.', 'This is one of two of the same Dominican owned Spanish restaurant. Their food is excellent. The white, yellow or black rice with pink beans is always very good. They serve chicken, beef, pork, goat and fish either fried, boiled/stewed or baked. The soups are also very good. They also offer appetizers such as pasteles, empanadas as well desserts including flan (custard pudding) and cake.
The food can be  eaten either in the restaurant or can be taken to go.
They are well staffed with usually four or five employees at the counter serving food and taking orders.']

name: LOS CHARROS MEXICAN RESTAURANT & BAR
reviews: ['The Best Mexican food I’ve had in the entirety of New York. The food is authentic and delicious, while the atmosphere is lowkey and not tacky like so many other places. The staff are kind, genuine, and diligent, and the food got out very quick. I’d definitely recommend this gem to anyone seeking anything to eat not only in Staten Island, but the whole of New York.', 'BEST MEXICAN RESTAURANT ON STATEN ISLAND! I’ve tried many Mexican restaurants on Staten Island but nothing beats this place! The food is always fresh and taste amazing, the owners are a lovely family who truly appreciate their customers. The food takes me back to home, I highly recommend everything on their menu, but nothing out beats their Burritos. Amazing customer service.', 'The most authentic Mexican food there is in Staten Island! My go to pick up spot and dine in during the weekends for some delicious margaritas on the rocks! recommend 10/10', 'The best Mexican food on Staten Island! Always fresh and delicious!!!!', 'I never come back here. Not worthy']

name: LAS CAZUELAS RESTAURANT
reviews:
['Awesome place!!!

Service is great! Jasmine and her father run the place and its really nice to see owners really taking care of their customers!
Lots of food options.
Fresh juice everyday!
Refrigerated drinks as well and ton of house hold prepackaged food and snacks!
Baked bread too!

Will definitely come back, has vegan options too!', 'I physically can’t order my food for delivery because the person on the phone doesn’t speak any English and apparently nobody in the building does either because I met with silence when ask to speak with someone it’s not how you should run a business you’re in America. You should have at least one staff member. who can speak to customers', 'I order costillas de puerco en salsa verde .. omg ..!! I was shock when I got home and open the bag .. those dishes was for two people.!!! Bean rice and the meat was all well serve cook and delicious.!!! I can no way to order the same or try something different… I just want to say thank you so much for you work and services .!!never change you service or you recipes ….consistency in the food is the key for coming back for more .!!!', 'I have to say this is the perfect little spot, the food is authentic & soo delicious .

Only warning is that you should practice your spanish, you dont get tacos this good without speaking spanish for them. If you like steak and shrimp tacos, When you arrive say
"Hola ¿como estas usted? Quiero tres tacos de bistec y tres tacos de camarones"
"Para volver" means "to go" if thats what you want to do.

Thank me never bc you wouldnt be able to stop. 😉', 'Super slow service. Kills the whole mood. We waited about 50 mins for the food. Then another for 30 for a refill of drinks. Then another 30 for the check. Kills the whole eating experience despite the good food. Only 1 waitress with 10 tables. How?']

name: ZARA CAFE GRILL
reviews:
['I usually order take out but this was my first time dining here. I have only ever gotten the lamb gyro but I don’t doubt the rest of the menu is served the same- absolutely  exquisite. The gyro is cut nice and thin, perfectly seasoned and cooked. The rice is buttery and the salad has the perfect amount of dressing. All the ingredients taste fresh and the portions are perfectly sized.

The employees are also very prompt and hospitable. Plus the interior of the restaurant is extremely clean and decorated very nicely.

I grew up eating a lot of Turkish food and this is by far the best that I have tried thus far in NYC.

Highly recommend!!', 'The food
Tasty food with good seasoning we order the Zara mix grill and the fish fillet. Good amount of food portion, and the food came out in a matter of time we didn’t wait long for it.

The service
Was above and beyond from welcoming us by the door and all staff were smiling and friendly.

Atmosphere
The place has plenty of seating even an outdoor seating as well. It’s clean and decent with a parking lot on the back of the restaurant. Give them a try and you won’t regret!', 'Everything about the restaurant is amazing, food, music, staff (staff are all very kind.)', 'Came here with my family for breakfast. Their breakfast platter which is 27$ features 4 pieces of cheese, three pieces of baloney, some lettuce, some cucumbers and some tomatoes. It also comes with a two egg omelette and honey, clotted cheese and jam.
For starters, the honey tasted like was bad. The consistency was very thin. The bread wasn’t fresh . And seriously the cheese was a joke. I wish I took a picture of this platter when it came. Such a disappointment. We came here and ordered this platter because we have gone to the forest Avenue location which provided with a much larger portion and more variety. I can stay with all certainty. I will not be returning to this. Also, the atmosphere is kind of nice, but the tables are very close together. You can barely fit between them. I came in with a stroller, which was very hard to manage in the space. Overall, I give this place two stars although the service and the people who work here were very nice.', 'Good price and great taste   and large portions of the food,  Waiters are  friendly . I recomended']

name: ABEY AFRICAN & MEDITERRANEAN RESTAURANT
reviews: ['My wife and I took a trip to NY. It was my first time in the city. Being a man who loves food, I always love to try new ethnic foods. It was a quaint little place and very inviting. Abey and her daughter were so kind. The food was absolutely amazing. If it is your first visit to Stanten Island or you have lived there for years, Abeys is a must!', 'Walked over from the SI Ferry, it was a pleasant, delightful experience.\nGot the stewed chicken over yellow rice. Very spicy. Really got the juices flowing. Absolutely loved it. The small plate was ten dollars.', 'Food was yummy but service was not great! Reasonable price and decent quantity of food. Recommended for take out!!', 'Nigerian soups and pounded fufu was good. The rice portion was so plenty and filling. Peppered soup was fresh. I have not been disappointed.   I would definitely recommend this place. Quick service and really good customer service.', 'Girl at restaurant tried to charge me 1.25 for a clearly marked 99 cent can of Arizona Ice Tea. I will be contacting the Better Business Beauru and Dept. Of Consumer Affairs. It is illegal to sell anything other than the price marked on the can. Reataurant looks abandoned, hardly any food out on display and it has an odor that is not acceptable to sny eating environment.  I strongly DONOT RECOMMEND. Nasty attitudes.']

name: CINCO DE MAYO RESTAURANT & BAR
reviews: ['Food was delicious, fast and friendly staff. Recomend if your in the area and want somthing quick. Generous portions and always give extra sauce.', 'The food is chefs kiss good - clean, flavorful, delicious. Great service and atmosphere. Did I mention  the food was good good. The food was goo', 'I don’t even like burritos ! But there steak burrito has steak through who whole burrito even till the end where it closes off ! It’s just a perfect burrito! I had one yesterday and also having one now currently! BOMBBBB! It’s deff my go to now !', "I'm sorry. As good as it looked visually, I could not finish it. I chewed into so many pieces of bones. It was chicken bones but still. It wasn't edible. The flavor was a bit unbalanced as well. Sad really", 'Excellent service, they are very attentive.  Super clean and calm environment.\nThe food is always fresh and very tasty. 💗']

name: LILYA'S RESTAURANT & GRILL CAFE GOURMAND
reviews:
["My wife and I came here for the first time. Recommended by my wife's friend. Rusian,Eastern European,  Mediterranean food. Prices were a little high for the portions that you received. Some dishes were a little too salty for our tastes. Very quite,  but it was a Wednesday night. The service was excellent. I diffently will go back to try other dishes, and to try their dessert, unfortunately we did not have any on this visit. Large menu, big variety.", "The ambiance of this restaurant is simply fantastic! The cozy atmosphere, soft lighting, and elegant decor create the perfect setting for any special occasion.Great music ! If you’re a foodie like me, you’ll love this place! The menu has a fantastic selection of dishes, and we loved everything we tried .I can't wait to come back again!The staff here truly cares about their guests. A big thank you to  Roman, for providing outstanding service throughout our meal. Roman made us feel like VIPs :)", 'Well ok, this place in Staten Island is a fancy restaurant and is a great place to eat if you want good food and a nice place to eat. Seems like they even have weddings at this place.
I was there with family end of December in the afternoon. Food was great and they have many different culturally diverse dishes but Middle Eastern food is their concentration but yummy food after all.

Overall, was a great place to eat and price may seem high but you don’t eat here every day so it’s worthwhile.  Definitely try their Dolma which is the stuffed grape leaves.
I would recommend this restaurant to everyone at least once.', 'This restaurant is outstanding! The music, atmosphere, and food are all top-notch. We hosted four banquets (for 20+) here in two weeks, and each one surpassed the last. Highly recommend for any event!', 'Went to dinner at this Georgia (Russian) restaurant in Staten Island.  I ordered the lamb Shish kabob.  The lamb was very tasty but a little over cooked with some pieces very tuff to chew.  Other pieces of lamb were a little more tender.  The palmeini was veal stuffed and delicious. The other appetizer,  the cheese stuffed bread, was also very good and there was plenty of it.  For desert, cream puff and espresso.  Delicious!  For a while the service was excellent,  but later the waiter was busy somewhere else so we had to wait for a while for the check. Also, I must say that this restaurant is a little pricey.']

name: CINDERELLAS MEXICAN RESTAURANT
reviews:
['Take a look at the pictures. If you want to eat a sandwich with breads hard as rock, barely any meat and looks rotten, wings that are undercooked and nastiest onion rings, then this might be the place for you. Else, please save your money and buy food that you will enjoy and not having to wait for an hour to pick up this garbage food.', "Joe Castro makes you comfortable the moment you walk in. He's super friendly and easy to talk to. The portions are huge and food is very delicious. Will highly recommend. Was there to shoot for Grubhub.", 'Good job on never delivering my food. Got my refund and $10 discount which is even better🤡.', "Ordered from doordash and it's always arrived fast and hot. Order any of the gorditas and always go for the fries with chorizo! Guac was fresh and tasty. Always go for the late night treat here.", 'Super disappointed since this used to be one of my favorite restaurants. The quality of the food and ingredients has severely worsened since changing ownership. I used to LOVE their nachos and would order them frequently- now they no longer use the super melty muenster or Oaxaca cheeses, and instead use gross cheap shredded cheese. The meat portions are tiny and the variety of toppings on the nachos are nothing like they used to be. Their nachos used to be a banger and now they’re lame.

Their burritos are also significantly smaller and don’t taste the same. Do they even season their meat?

The last time I picked up take out they argued with me and showed sass saying that I had never placed my order. After showing them the receipt on my phone (it was their mistake) and having to wait longer since they hadn’t even started my food, they did nothing to rectify besides a half apology.

I keep giving them grace hoping that I’m having one-off bad experiences, but it’s obvious that this is the new normal. This Cinderellas is different and not worth their high costs.']

name: CHENG'S RESTAURANT
reviews: ['They sent us rotten broccoli that was completely inedible, so we had to throw it away. When we called to explain the situation, the lady acted like she had no idea what we were talking about and insisted it was fresh, despite sending us the rotten broccoli. I wouldn\'t even feed that food to my pets. My sister had a similar experience. She found fingernails in her food. Despite her warnings I continued to order now, I learned my lesson.  Overall, I do not recommend this place. I regret my decision, and if I could give zero stars, I would."', 'My wife and I enjoy our food we order from here. The food is fresh and hot.', 'They have poor customer service, the cashier lady is very rude when I tried to take my order back they didn’t even try to make it better they just threw some onions on my food and called it a day', 'Great food!! I got four half chickens,', 'This is the first time i ordered from this place and i tell you omg. The food is so good meaty sweet and sour chicken and Sesame chicken .when i called to order they were very nice and polite even the Delivery driver. I will definitely be ordering from them again']

name: FAVA RESTAURANT
reviews:
["This was my first time at this restaurant and I was not disappointed.  The starters were amazing (fritto misto, fava spread, zucchini chips and mom's spanakopita).  The main course was just as amazing as the starters. The beef skewers were tender and tasty.  The Greek Burger with fava sauce was a delight with copious amounts of Greek fries.

Our server was very professional and accommodating.  The atmosphere was calm and welcoming. A great place for a quiet family dinner  or romantic one.

I will highly recommend this place.", "We came here two weeks in a row. Bartender was very welcoming.  We were seated immediately with no reservation. The menu was reasonably priced and filled with a variety of Mediterranean dishes. For a drink, I had the cucumber spritzer which was  fresh made. For dinner, I had shrimp skewers and my husband had steak skewers. What a plentiful meal with skewers, salad and pita with vegetables.  Yummy. Service was great, food was delish and staff qas friendly. The second time we came back, we weren't so lucky with wait time. We brought our son and grand daughter bc we knew the food was delish. This time, food was equally delicious but this time, with a 1 1/2 year old, we waited a longggggg time for our food. A little too long. I know there was a restaurant festival earlier in the day but it was over when we arrived and the restaurant was not packed. Restaurant is kid friendly, my son got a pizza and we were allowed to eat adult food. The baby shared our meal. High chairs are available,  parking is a little tough but both time we went we lucked out with parking across the street. It's metered but not after 7:00. We will be back but hopefully next time, the wait will not be too long and the food will still be delicious! Bathroom was also clean both times.", 'Had an amazing dinner here! One of the best calamari appetizers I have had. Perfectly cooked and the sauce was delicious. Entrees were also great, place itself is really nice and the service was exceptional. I would definitely recommend giving this place a try.', 'The Fava experience was beyond delightful. From the moment you set eyes on the place and the beautiful flower arch outside the door, you know you’re in for a great experience. Then you walk in the door, and you’re in the Mediterranean without even leaving Staten Island. The service was quick without being rushed, the food was delicious and affordable, and the drinks were great. A new restaurant on the island scene, but I’m very glad we found this place and we will without a doubt be back often.', '1st time dining here and I was very pleased with the food and service. The grilled octopus was excellent, as was the fried calamari, shrimp and zucchini appetizers. Our entrees of chimichuri steak and lamb chops were perfectly prepared and very tasty. Staff was friendly and attentive, returning to the table to refill drinks. Overall, a very pleasant dining experience.']

name: NEW DINETTE RESTAURANT
reviews:
["The food and the environment is great. Bit I noticed that I get overcharged the lady Dora overcharged and think people don't realize for that reason I stopped going. 27 dollar for 2 plats with just sausage, egg and potatoes. And then she looks at you with a guilt face expecting you to not notice. I don't want to go to a place that I'm over charged and have to complain to some elderly about it. I'm sorry but that's so abusive and sad.", 'Been coming here since i moved to the island as a child and it’s one of the simplest but best breakfast platters you could buy in Staten Island, their breakfast sausages are on point which transports me to old school diners. Now a days u can’t find that old school breakfast sausage taste. My pops used to have a diner in Brooklyn back in the day so I know a thing or two lol. But over all it’s 10/10 solid breakfast and nice customer service', "This is a new place for me. It's a little hole in the wall easy to miss. But they've been here for a long time. The food and the service will both good as far as atmosphere goes to no frills place. And the prices were reasonable too.", "This place is dirty..how they got send me.old bread with mold..don't buy from these dirty m.f..My kids was about to eat them when I notice..the food department should go over there and double check their kitchen..with all this going on they getting people sick", 'Excellent place for a meal.
I have had breakfast, lunch and dinner here.
The food is always good.
I work right across the street,
So it is very convenient.
Parking outside is pretty good as well.

Best Regards,
VIP AUTO NYC
208 Port Richmond Avenue
Staten Island NY 10302']

name: FARINGTON'S CAFE AND RESTAURANT
reviews:
['This place is amazing! The star of the show was the calamari and the delicious cajun mayo sauce. For our entrees, we had the spinach and garlic ravioli and the New York strip steak, both were excellent. We were served by the owner, Farington, and he made
sure our dinner went perfectly!', 'This place is such a gem. Farington and his wife were so welcoming as we were first timer diners. I had the spinach and garlic ravioli with tomato basil sauce and it was so creamy and flavorful. However, the calamari was defineitly the star of the show specifically for their Cajun Mayo! The atmosphere was so calming with jazz music and decorative lighting. The tartufo dessert was a great way to end the delicious meal.', "We really enjoyed a fantastic brunch here . The portions were generous and the food was incredibly tasty and fresh, especially the Shakshuka (a must-try!). The price was very reasonable, making it even more enjoyable.

Before our main courses arrived, we were treated to a continental-style plate and a selection of drinks. This was a great touch that added to the overall value.

While the atmosphere could use some improvement, it didn't detract from the delicious food and friendly service. We'll definitely be back soon!", 'Very good healthy food! Coconut Shrimp was so delicious! Service is excellent! Arugula salad was so refreshing.', "Came to Farington's Cafe and Restaurant
For brunch today and wow! This was one of the best tasting and most affordable brunches I’ve been to. A wide selection to pick from and a drink included for only $18.95. My partner and I were very impressed. Farington, the owner and head chef comes out and greets his guest and introduces himself which was very nice. Our waiter, who we unfortunately didn’t catch the name of was amazing, so kind and gave us great recommendations and made awesome drinks. Highly highly recommend the Shakshouka. Portions are perfect and we left 100% satisfied. Couldn’t recommend this place more. Best brunch ever and such a cute spot!"]

name: SING BO
reviews: ['It was super nice! went there with my friend, we got to sit the fish tank and was able to chat a bit before ordering. We got the crab rangoons, sweet and sour chicken with pork fried rice and egg drop soup which was the lunch special ! super good! sweet and sour sauce was amazing!! crab rangoons were a bit sweet for my tastes but still good! Guy at the front was super nice and helpful with our orders, will be coming again.', 'Worst Chinese food I’ve ever had in my life pure disgusting. Do not order', 'I Ordered for pickup while walking and my order was correct, yummy and ahead of schedule. Seats were available while you wait for your food. Nice people as well.', 'Have tried many Chinese take out places for delivery in our area and this one is the most consistent. Respectful and polite on the phone.  Food is not greasy or stale. Brown rice always tender and never dry. Vegetables always cooked properly and never swimming in sauce. We’ve only ever gotten take out so I can’t comment on dine-in. Love Sing Bo!', 'Food is delicious. Delivery is always on time and you can easily order directly online with an immediate text message that they got your order. I highly recommend the wonton soup especially on the cold days. Try the Thai spring rolls as well for a good appetizer. Their Thai chicken. Wings are a good spicy twist on the normal Chinese food chicken wings you normally get.']

name: VIVA MEXICO RESTAURANT
reviews: ["Viva Mexico restaurant bar is an exceptional dining destination with a perfect rating. The service is outstanding, with attentive and friendly staff who provide excellent recommendations. The food is delicious and authentic, featuring high-quality ingredients and a diverse menu. The atmosphere is warm and inviting, with a tasteful decor and lively music. Definitely try the sponge cake, if you haven't yet!", 'This is one of my favorite places to eat not just for the food, but the customer service as well Rita is so attentive and treats you like family. I love this place I’d recommend it to anyone!', 'The restaurant is located in the Bensonhurst section of Brooklyn.  They have a nice variety of food and drink options.  The food includes salads, tacos, enchiladas and burritos.   The drinks include beer, wine and mixed drinks. Side orders of rice and beans, plantains,  tortillas and avocado are also available.   I ordered the tacos de pescado that was very good and was made with fish, cabbage salad and chile de Arnold salsa.  I added a side order of rice and beans.  Nice friendly and helpful staff.', 'I can\'t say enough about this place.  They do everything right.  A wonderful blend of modern Latin and European music.  The menu adjusts every so often to keep things spicy and alive.  The Al Pastor or the shrimp.....you\'ll never go wrong..... The guacamole is perfect.  I always add salt and lime but it really doesn\'t need any.\n\nJustino was knowledgeable, friendly and his recommendations were "on point".', 'The cleanest, kindest and the most tasty cafe in Brooklyn in my opinion😍 this place has supper delicious food and drinks. Not only that but the people who work there are so kind, and joyful. One of the best Mexican spots']

name: SOFIA'S TAQUERIA
reviews:
['This place has several delicious dishes! Try ‘em all! My most recent trip, we had the Adobo Burrito, Beef Empanadas, and Chicken Tacos and they were each very good!', 'An excellent hidden spot in Staten Island with some of the best Mexican food around. The ambience is also first rate along with some outstanding customer service. Stop reading this review and head out there today!', 'We were a group of 5 for dinner on a Friday night. Dani who took the reservation over the phone was great and assured me I would love my first visit there and she was absolutely  right. I was struck by the beautiful decor immediately upon arrival. everywhere you looked there were eye-catching , colorful pieces not too much or overdone. Just perfect . Our server was Ricky who was amazing, very attentive and patiently went over the specials a couple of times with us. We were never left waiting, which was especially impressive for a busy Friday night. Loved the margaritas, secret guac, fish tacos, chicken & steak special. Everything was delicious. Highly recommend this restaurant and will definitely go back.', "If you you're looking for a 5 star date night experience, this is it. The staff is friendly and welcoming. The environment is festive, decorative and well kept. The food is great especially the guacamole, it has a unique flavor profile. If you want a place where you are well treated and respected with amazing food and music I highly recommend giving Sofia's a try. You'll love it so much it'll make you want to comeback.", "By far, the best mexican food I've tasted.
Been here twice and I love it.
The empanadas, OMG. Absolutely delicious.  Definitely will be ordering that again.
The drinks, delicious. Atmosphere,  amazing. 10/10"]

name: VESUVIO RESTAURANT & PIZZERIA
reviews: ['Everyone was very nice, and able to accommodate requests. Service was fast. Calamari was cooked to perfection crispy and not rubbery, the pepper and cherry tomato sauce was delicious as well. Good portion sizes for the price. Chicken parm was good and was the bread.', 'The Italian restaurant in the Bay Ridge section of Brooklyn has consistently very good food.  The restaurant has late hours for takeout, delivery and dining in.  I ordered individual slices of pizza which were a nice size.  The veal parmigiana hero was on soft bread and the veal was easy to eat.  The linguine with clam sauce was a generous portion accompanied with a separate tray of clams.   The side order of meatballs were firm.', "Went here for lunch.   I've been wanting to go here for awhile.   I had their lunch specials.   I had the baked ziti.  It was delicious!   The sauce was not too acidic.   Just right.  Love the decor.  Service was terrific.   Place was very clean.   Will go back again when I'm in the area.", 'I always love the food here. Pizza, pasta, or a classic chicken parm on a hero always hits. My family always comes here to eat. Even ordering catered food from here is great. Always a reliable place to get food for catering if you have a party.\nThe restaurant has a formal dining and a front section where you can sit and just grab a slice. It’s almost has the atmosphere of a formal restaurant and also a classic neighborhood pizzeria.\nThe servers are always nice and helpful. Always checking up on you during dinner. It feels very family friendly.', "I'm from Staten Island, I think we have great pizza but this was absolutely delicious!! It was worth the trip. I will definitely be coming back!"]

name: NO 1 CHINESE KITCHEN
reviews:
["I see why they are #1 Chinese food. I ordered food last night the garlic and butter dumplings where amazing, along with the sesame seed chicken was delicious. I would definitely come back for the dumplings again! I'll give it 10/10  🔥", "We usually order from another Chinese takeout spot but, earlier in the week we got spoiled food. We thought it was time to try another spot. We ordered our favorite - chicken, and broccoli with chicken/pork fried rice. The food came quickly and was hot. However, this place was cheap in supplying sauce and gave no utensils or napkins. We spent over $75 and most places give free items when you spend over a certain amount. This place doesn't offer any promotions like that.

The fried rice was bland almost to the point of being tasteless. I felt like the rice needed a bit more seasoning and salt. The sauce from chicken and broccoli was tasty but, congealed and had very little. The food tasted fresh at least. Not the best experience and I am not sure if we would order again.", 'Im coming out of my way to say this. I ordered General Tso and expected the usual.......wrong! This General Tso actually has a nice kick to it like its supposed to!. I found my new spot!', 'So let me first start off by saying this is my number one go to Chinese restaurant on Staten Island. Me & my family has been enjoying the great food that comes from number one for the past 24 years. The customer service is great as well. This by far is our best spot when it comes to Chinese food. No other place can compare, clean environment & great quality of food. 1B', "I used to be a patron of another Chinese food spot, but their quality has taken a dive. Decided to give No. 1 Kitchen a shot. Just got some takeout from here. Solid overall experience!
Will be back for more! Thanks

General Tso's Chicken and Fried Pork Dumplings were tasty!"]

name: LAS CHELITAS
reviews:
['Came here around 6pm for dinner.  We were the only table.  There were several takeouts. The service was a bit slow.  We ordered fried calamari, fish rice bowl, and half a chicken.  It is the saddest and skinniest calamari I have ever had.  I had to confirmed with the server what they were.  The calamari was very dry. The fish and chicken was ok but the calamari throw me off so much I wasn’t having any high expectations.', 'decided to stop by this beautiful family-owned business one day and they were having one of my now favorite specials.. the ribeye steak! it was delicious, and i still think about it 😆 not to mention the service; they were very sweet and kind towards me, it felt like eating at my own home. definitely will frequent here more often, thank you guys ☺️💗', 'This is a really really good family restaurant. We had the shrimp ceviche, and nachos for appetizers. Both were amazing and filling. For main courses, we had the fish tacos, e chicken enchilada, steak and fish. All very flavorful and good. Don’t forget to get some candy on your way out!', 'We had lunch there I it was ok,until we asked for the check.
It came out to $64,50 plus tax so they added $17 on tip (no choice) $81,50
I told her I only had $80 cash and she said I had to pay everything including the tip
So I pay with my credit card I ended up paying $85,49 what a ripoff!', 'amazing local mexican- I was recommended the ribs by the staff and they were so tender and flavorful. I also ordered the fish tacos which were just as good. delicious and family owned local spot that you must try!']

name: TEQUILA RESTAURANT
reviews:
['Got enchiladas to go, it ended up being closer to soup. The whole thing was drenched in sauce, practically the only bit of flavoring in it. Tortillas may or may not have been used, because it all was falling apart that much.', 'Great local mexican place to eat.  Service was attentive. Food was delicious. Mojito was refreshing.  Guacamole was made fresh.  The burrito was huge and delicious. All the food is certainly cooked to order.  Will go back.', "Honestly had no expectations coming in because most Mexican restaurants in the area aren't really that good BUT when I say this place shut me up....it did! Lol
My homegirl (who also LOVES Mexican food) were shocked at how good the food was.

I had a few tacos and she had an enchilada. This is a no frills, authentic Mexican restaurant.
The only negative is that they didn't have a drink menu. Be aware of the margarita...taste like juice so it's dangerous! Lol.

The place got packed - diverse crowd, heavy on the Latino/Hispanic side so you already know, it's good.

Definitely, can't wait to go back again.

No pictures of the food or dranks because it was devoured", '12oz steak was cooked perfectly and seasoned well. Fresh guac and salsa.', 'Great local Mexican food in Bay Ridge. You can taste the fresh ingredients and the love that is put in every dish that comes out of the kitchen. Definitely a hidden gem and one of my favorite places to eat that always hits the spot and never disappoints!']

name: EL CACTUS MEXICAN RESTAURANT
reviews:
["The most DELICIOUS food ever!!
My new favorite go to Mexican restaurant for sure...
I can't even pick out one thing to say it tastes delicious because everything does.
I got the Huarache carnitas.
We were literally fighting over it!
Homemade dough.. succulent tender meat.
The best guacamole they make it to order.
Inside is very cute... Very well decorated.
I definitely 100% recommend this place", 'AMAZING !  , 3 bowls was to put on the food & it taste amazing . First time here nd will be retiring when in the area . 9/10 , don’t mind the mozzarella stick my child loves finger food', 'If you’re craving tacos, this charming little taco joint is an absolute gem! The moment I walked in, I was welcomed by a cozy and inviting atmosphere, decorated with vibrant colors that reflect the lively culture. The tacos are incredible—each bite is packed with fresh ingredients and bold flavors that transport you straight to Mexico. I tried the birria tacos and chicken tacos, both of which were tender, perfectly seasoned, and topped with just the right amount of salsa. The staff is wonderfully friendly and hospitable; our server, Angel, made us feel at home, fostering a sense of family and pride in the food they serve. Plus, the prices are very reasonable for the quality and portion sizes! Don’t forget to sample their homemade salsa, aguas frescas, and the delightful flan for dessert. If you’re looking for hearty, soul-satisfying tacos, this is definitely the place to be, and I can’t wait to return for more! (Just a heads up, it’s street parking only.)', 'Came over to Staten Island for a day trip from NYC and I wanted tacos so came here. I ordered the tacos Al pastor and they were the best tacos of my life. So don’t hesitate to come here. Just do it!! Very friendly staff also!', 'It was an amazing experience, very excellent service, I’m not those type of people to lie cuz I love food, I’m a foodie, when I say the food here is amazing I love there chicken Quesadilla, the Molcajete is very flavory and the sauce with the nachos chips were great. 5 star on everything. I’ll definitely make this place my go to place.😊🙏🏼']

name: NEW RUAN'S RESTAURANT
reviews:
["This is a nice restaurant. Management and staff know their customers well and care, often by name. This is a restaurant geared towards the American pallet, although I have no doubt they'd have the skills to produce something more authentic. Much nicer and a bit pricier than the usual takeout type of place, but we'll worth it to us. They've expertly configured the menu so that the food comes out quickly, with generous portions and is hot and tasty.", 'Delicious food both in the restaurant and takeout! The staff is very friendly and accommodating. Continue to come here pretty regularly for a couple of years now and the staff are friendly and efficient and even remember our vegetarian order!', "I have to say come here it's really a great experience the steak is perfectly cooked along with the the greens the broccoli and of course a little appletini on the side this year is truly a place I will come back to I can't wait to see what else they're going to cook up on my next visit", 'The worst Chinese food around!!

$25.00 for a Sesame chicken (2023)

Here was the experience:
There was 1 waitress for the entire fully seated restaurant and she did not come to take my order and she did not ask me a single time if I needed anything.  There was terrible service.  The front manager was the only one who took my order and refilled my water.

The chicken rice soup side dish was disgusting.  It was cheap instant powdered soup powder in water with some rice in it.

The general Tsos chicken had burned sauce and burned chili’s.

The sesame chicken portion arrived not very hot and it was overcooked and dry.
To me it seems like a weak effort at imitating other authentic Chinese restaurants.  I would not recommend this place.  The quality is terrible!!', "This is THE most old school Chinese restaurant in Brooklyn, now that Sun Shai Kai and Richard Yee's are closed.

Delicious food, perfect service and great value! The staff is so friendly and helpful, making sure you're well taken care of when ordering."]

name: NEW DYKER RESTAURANT
reviews: ["Super nice staff, took care of me right away when I came in. The food came out quickly and was delicious. I love this Americana diner. Apparently it used to be a larger space before Covid. I'm so glad they still exist! Made my morning.", "20240423::gyro with fries r good, love the split pea soup. chicken parm pasta was good too\n20240310::i love these diners, especially sitting at the counters on the spinning stool. though the burger was premade, it was inexpensive enough that it was better than mic-key-d's burgers.  i liked the egg salid sandwich.  the omlette was good too.  i was not a fan of the lobster bisque,  too thick and it was the fake crab meat.  just try it.\n20240217:: first time here and i love it,  burger is ok, and the barley soup was yummy", 'A great breakfast option if you’re looking for a quick bite to eat. Classic diner food and staff is friendly.', "Old school diner. You get what you get and you don't complain. With that said, this place is great. Food was decent. The breakfast combo deal is good price. $11 for eggs bacon home fries toast oj and coffee. Dine in price", "I've been going there for many many years unfortunately the prices have gone up but it is a cozy place they treat you with respect the food is good but like I said I've been going there for many many many many many years Honestly I have no complaint"]

name: TRATTORIA OLIVETO
reviews: ["This place is great for a quick bite, lunch and perfect for date night. Came here with my husband for dinner and as soon as we walked in we were welcomed in by Roberto and he seated us right away. The holiday decor is very eye catching and so pretty. The restaurant is spotless! The ambiance is very refreshing and the food is absolutely delicious; so good we couldn’t help but take some leftovers home and we also requested a container of their delicious tomato sauce. The food was very fresh and the dessert's were very very delicious. Can’t wait to come back!", "4 stars, only because it's pricey.\nJust a tad too pricey. Likely wont be back because of the $$$. 2 adults, 2 kids, (one just a ceaser salad) our bill was $250. Overall, we enjoyed our food, but its pasta w/ a hefty price tag!. The service was very good. The drink as well was tasty.", 'It was my first time in this restaurant and we went there on Mothers Day and it was extremeley buisy. But nevertheless the food was delicious and service was great. We loved everything we have ordered. And rasberry tartufo with white chocholate was amazing!', 'Trattoria Oliveteo is a great Italian restaurant on hylan! Definitely a must try if your in the area. Highly recommend!', 'Went there last night with 2 friends. The food was delicious. The service was excellent. The drinks were made perfect. We had chocolate martinis and cosmos. The owner bought us a round of drinks he even kept the restaurant open till our ride arrived. I Highly recommend this restaurant. I will be going back.']

name: RESTAURANT EL MAGUEY
reviews: ['CASH only. 100% delicious and they have an extensive Vegan menu. They served us chips with pico de gallo. From the vegan menu I had the Vegan Al Pastor, Vegan El Carne, Vegan Pollo & Vegan El Filete tacos with their dairy sour cream. The vegan pollo tostados and the vegan al pastor empanadas were also very delicious. The lady who took our order was super informative and friendly. For dessert we had the tres leche cake which was delicious and the best was the Horchata. 10/10 would recommend!', 'Vegan al pastor taco is excellent! Comes with grilled pineapple. Make sure to get it with guacamole.', "I went here months ago and it was just alright, so decided to give it another try. Got the pork pozole soup. This soup didn't smell right from the moment i opened the container. The soup was hot, yet the broth itself was almost jello-like consistency, almost congealed. The pozole texture is 100000% not supposed to be congealed. The broth did not taste right at all and the meat was borderline starting to go bad. I just don't know how you serve a customer with a soup that both smells bad and looks bad. Would like a refund but I know that's likely not to happen.\n\nYou guys have to do better than this.", 'Delicious Vegan Mexican Food, this is my 2nd time here and I would eat here everyday if I could. Strongly recommend the soy chorizo.', 'I ordered food todo many times, very tasty the only thing they always forget something, not a big deal , food is great']

name: PARKWAY RESTAURANT
reviews: ['The best diner in NYC! The food was amazing, fresh and delicious. The three of us had some sandwiches and a burger, everything was great!\nThe service was excellent, Nacho, the waiter, is the best 🥰  The atmosphere of the diner is also wonderful.\nIt was a great pleasure to return to this place after 23 years. I strongly recommend Parkway diner!', '20240428:: on my diner quest, i found this.  got the burger, and omlette.  see for yourself', 'I’ve never reviewed a diner before because I usually find them to all be more or less the same but Parkway pleasantly surprised me. The staff was so incredibly kind and welcoming. My breakfast was served very quickly while still being perfectly cooked at hot which was great. Their COVID-19 indoor dining regulations also helped ease my nerves about eating inside on a very chilly autumn morning. They only allow 18 people inside at once, do temperature checks before you’re seated, and have plexiglass partitions between booths. They also space diners in booths about 15+ feet away from each other and clean off the booths very well. Overall I had a very good experience. I stumbled across them by chance and would definitely come back for a tasty breakfast next time I’m in the area.', 'Neighborhood staple. Hours recently changed so we waited about 15 mins for it to open (9am during week).  Food is good, service good. Place Is clean.', 'Very good breakfast, and the best Greek salad in town, olives and feta cheese from the Peloponnese .']

name: DA NOI
reviews: ["My husband and I celebrated our 34th Anniversary at Da Noi. My had his heart set on Veal Parmigiana. He so sad when he didn't see it on the menu. He asked our waiter if they could make Veal Parmigiana. He was so surprised and happy that they could make it for him. I had ordered the Shrimp Parmigiana. Both dishes came with a generous serving of spaghetti. For desert I had a delicious Tiramisu. My husband opted for the Lemon sherbet which he absolutely enjoyed.", 'I recently tried Da Noi on Staten Island, and it was a great find. Right from the start, they served up hot, fresh bread that set a perfect tone for the meal. I had the mussels and calamari to start, and both were delicious—fresh and cooked just right. For my main course, I had the ravioli, which was fantastic with its tender pasta and rich filling. There are a lot of other tempting dishes on the menu that I’m looking forward to trying next time. What really stood out was how authentic and cozy the place felt. The food is top-notch, and it’s so much easier than heading into Manhattan, Brooklyn. The place is clean, the vibe is warm, and the staff is really friendly. If you’re on Staten Island and want a great Italian meal without the commute, Da Noi is definitely worth a visit. They have two locations on Staten Island and also one in New Jersey. I’m already looking forward to going back!', 'Restaurant felt warm welcoming for my family of 5 but also sophisticated. I had top service, charming to my kiddos, customized drinks and plates for 8 and 11 yr old, and most importantly the food was excellent and authentic. Got appitizers, entrees, and dessert. They brought out complementary plate of vegetables with amazing sweet potato croquettes. Make sure you get a cappuccino with dessert. Did i mention great service. I loved our experience. Thanks!!', "I have been a part of the Da Noi family for over 25 years! I love all the servers! And management! I am also accommodated and greeted with respect! In addition, I've met and networking with so many wonderful and professional people!", 'We were visiting my son at college and decided to give it a try. We went at 12n on a Sunday when it opened. The waiters were so kind and friendly. Never had an empty water glass. Food was phenomenal. Great first experience for us eating at a great Italian place on Staten Island']

name: BOCELLI
reviews:
['Service was exceptional and the complimentary Limoncello after dinner was so appreciated and such a kind gesture by the restaurant.  The food was so delicious and the Lychee Martini was spectacular.', 'March 2023:
Wonderful service with friendly staffs.

Food is pretty good though I didn’t had an authentic Italian carbonara it was still better than any other “carbonara” I had on the island.

Baked clams tasted fresh than Campania.

I shouldn’t even compare them to Campania but because we love the baked clams there but Bocelli’s tasted way better.

The first baguette 🥖 came cold but when we asked for second baguette it was warm of course better.

New favorite Italian restaurant.

We’ll be back again very soon perhaps tomorrow.

Update: March 2023

I’ve had the best steak in NYC hands down.
Oh and tiramisu with ice cream was phenomenal 😋

Update: April 2023

They didn’t have my favorite tiramisu and ribeye steak :(

We asked for the clam pasta if it’s not going to be spicy prior to ordering and was told it won’t be due to my sister can’t eat spicy but it still came spicy :(.

Otherwise, very pleased by the service with the usual servers that who already recognized me.', 'Went for our anniversary, beautiful interior and lovely service. Food was great!

(Side note love the lychee martini)', 'Delicious food! Everything we ordered was delicious. I’m normally not a raw food eater, but even the raw options were delicious! Great atmosphere and ambience. Staff is also wonderful.', "Bocelli's is a fantastic restaurant. Staff is well trained, friendly and willing to help with recommendations. The specials of the day are always amazing and well thought out. Highly recommend the pasta and the scallop oreganata!"]

name: CAFE LUNA
reviews:
['We went here on a Tuesday night so the restaurant was relatively quiet. Staff was very attentive and pleasant. Food was served quickly nobody had any complaints about their meals and everything was delicious. I personally had the pork chops and peppers very flavorful cooked well and large size portions for all.', 'Cafe Luna is truly a hidden gem that left me beyond impressed, with a warm ambiance and service that exceeded all expectations. From the moment I walked in, I was enveloped in an atmosphere that felt both upscale and welcoming, setting the stage for a perfect evening.

A special shout-out to Alessandro, the remarkable bartender whose passion for his craft shines through in every drink he makes. He not only crafted an espresso martini that was flawless—perfectly balanced with the rich coffee flavor complemented by a velvety smoothness—but also infused the experience with his friendly, personable nature. Alessandro’s warmth and attentiveness made every interaction feel special. It’s rare to find someone who combines skill with such a genuine, inviting spirit, and it made the evening unforgettable.

Cafe Luna’s service standards are exceptional, and Alessandro sets the bar even higher. Every restaurant could benefit from someone with his charm, talent, and dedication to making patrons feel at home. If you’re lucky enough to stop by, make sure to let Alessandro surprise you with one of his creations—it’s an experience that will make you look forward to coming back. Highly recommend this fantastic establishment!', 'The hospitality was amazing and so was the food!! Everything there tastes very fresh and definitely expresses the classic dishes from the Italian cuisine.', "I've been eating here for the past 15+ years. I've tried almost everything on the menu and have yet to get stuck. The food has always been great, with no issues. The pizza options are excellent, too. The atmosphere is very relaxing. All the employees are well-versed and polite. Every time I eat at Cafe Luna, I leave satisfied. The prices are reasonable for the portions served.", 'Why go to dominos when you can get this beautiful pizza 3 stores down! Cafe Luna has the best pizza in Staten Island hands down!']

name: KUSHI ASIAN FUSION
reviews:
['The anime walls and One Piece decor at Kushi Asian Fusion added to its fun ramen shop vibe. Friendly staff made the experience even better.

The food was decent for a budget-friendly, casual restaurant, with generous portions that left us satisfied, though the sushi rolls fell apart easily and the spicy miso ramen broth tasted a bit like instant seasoning.

Overall, a solid spot for a casual meal with a cool atmosphere.', 'This is an Asian fusion restaurant with Japanese, Chinese and Thai food.  The restaurant has a long section for preparing sushi.  I ordered the sushi and sashimi combination which included a California roll.  I also added an eel avocado roll with a side salad.   The food was fresh and had very good taste.  Friendly and helpful staff.', 'Amazing Udon and Pork belly. Buns are great as well. This place is delicious, looks great (fusion), really well priced. I think 2 people can eat dinner here and pay $30-$40. I was surprised there reviews here are not closer to 5 stars. I lived in Brooklyn all my life and work in Midtown Manhattan. I can compare this place to quite a few places but it’s absolutely delicious and cheap and the atmosphere is fantastic. Highly recommend!', 'My wife and I really loved this place and came here all the time. The waiter Sandra remembered us and always greeted us warmly and smiled. Now she is gone and this place seems to have lost its life for us, the portions have become smaller, the waiter guy and the new girl with glasses are not friendly, they serve rudely and look with contempt as if this is their establishment. Most likely today is our last visit to this establishment 💔 and the last time they served us food with a spoon today, which finally finished me off 😐', "20240424:; love the one piece references, though i have not watched one episode yet.  i got N1, the tonkatsu noodle with an extra set of noodle.  the pork was dry , not soft as it should be.   but the soup and noodle made up for it. the pork katsu rice was yummy especially with the spicy mayo that's normally for rolls"]

name: JAC MAO
reviews:
["Our first time visiting. Nicely decorated big open room. The staff and owner super personable. The food was absolutely fantastic. We got the ribs, general tsao, beef  with broccoli and young chow fried rice. I can't wait to go back to try more things!", "I came here a few weeks ago with some friends and the place was really busy but we were able to get seating fairly quickly. The staff was very welcoming as we walked in. Despite it being very busy, the service was great. Everything we asked for we got without having to ask twice.

I'm a pretty picky sushi eater but I have to say that their sushi was so fresh and top notch. You can definitely tell they source great fish. For the amount of food we ordered, I thought it was a great value for premium sushi.

Even though we didn't sit at the bar, the bartender seemed very nice and engaging to all the guests. Seems like a great place to come for happy hour. I'll definitely check out next time for that! Keep up the good work.", 'Food was OK. Not the best Chinese I’ve had. Had zero taste and didn’t taste fresh. I don’t know. I’ve always heard they’re the best on Staten Island. Maybe I caught them on a bad day.', "We ordered a soup and it tasted really bad an old. We didn't even finish eating it after 2 spoons. Second, the person serving didn't even ask us why we didn't eat it. The waiter just took the soup upset we didn't eat it.  Then he gave us a plate that had grease on it and dirty. No apologies or anything. The waiter just said here take this plate. When a person goes out for dinner to a restaurant the minimum people expect is decent service, the food and service were horrible.  Hopefully, they change their ways. It's not free we paying for the food.", "I started with vegetable wonton soup. We were served plenty of (2 servings) of crispy noodles  w/mustard  & duck sauce. House special fried rice (w/shrimp,chicken,beef). Egg roll, Dim Sim, boneless spareribs, pan fried vegetable wonton, and a few sushi rolls. All delicious! Not rushed. Waiter was pleasant. Plenty of parking. Martinis🍸🍸 from the bar were also perfect👌. Great sit down chinese food dinner I'm Staten Island."]

name: EL MEXICANO RESTAURANT & CAFE IV
reviews: ['If I can give. 10 stars. I would. The food really good. The birria tacos taste good. And the shrimp soup tasted amazing has some spice to it with that seafood taste. Their quesadillas are a good size. And their cemitas will fill you up. Definitely will be coming back', 'Update: I have found a staple in my food on THREE occasions. My shrimp have come still raw on two occasions. The girl answering the phone is rude. She ignores any requests made so if we asked for dressing on the side, she has them put it on anyway so my coworker can’t eat it. Countless times we have not received pita bread and dressings that are supposed to come with it. But again, STAPLES IN OUR FOOD! RAW seafood. This place has really gone down the drain. Oh! And if you order through an online platform, they will adjust your price AFTER it’s been ordered for unknown reasons that they do not if you order over the phone. FINALLY, when you call to see where your food is after an hour, the girl answering the phone will tell you that Iver allows them more time. However if you call Uber, they will refund ok because it has already been more than the latest time they allow. SUCKS!', 'Its a small place, almost cozy. The food was great, got a salmon quesadilla for 11 dollars and got this humongous plate i wasnt expecting. My family got other things for the same price and got equally big quatities. Althought i would ask for a little more spice next time', 'Really fast and attentive. The guy working the cashier is friendly, helpful and always picks up the phone with good manners.\n\nThe food is always neatly packed and tasty.', 'I order delivery from here often. The food and service is consistently great! I would give more than 5 stars if I could!']

name: ASSAIA RESTAURANT CLUB & LOUNGE
reviews:
['Great khachapuri, mediocre service, heavily overpriced.

Our family visited Assaia restaurant in Sep 2024 to celebrate a birthday. Expectations were high based on good reviews, the menu, and the pictures, but unfortunately it turned out to be a 3-star experience :(

Good
The food was mostly very tasty and delightful. Some dishes were truly delicious (Khachapuri Adjaruli and Megruli, Elarji), others were good with some flaws. See details on each dish at the bottom.
The atmosphere and ambience on the patio were nice.

Bad
We were seated on backyard patio, at metal tables with perforated surface with no table cloth. Later in the evening the oil from khachapuri dripped through the table holes and stained our clothes. Metal chairs were uneven with no pillows. The umbrellas above the tables were shabby with holes on top.
I pre-ordered few appetizers and a bread. Appetizers were on the table and there were number of flies sitting on them which immediately made a bad impression. There was no bread and we didn't get it until much later when we were already eating.
They didn't have any still or just tap water and no non-sparkling soft drinks except home-made "compote" from feijoa. No juice, no lemonade. One of us had to go out to a grocery store to buy some juice for kids. They only had Georgian mineral sparkling water "Borjomi". I don't mind "Borjomi", but kids won't drink it! For each bottle of Borjomi (small) we got charged $5.
The entrees came all at different times so some people were eating and others were watching.
At the end we were told there was no dessert available. None.
The prices on some dishes were ridiculously high and all prices were substantially higher than ones listed on restaurant's website. The most bizarre prices were on chicken shish kebab of 5 pieces (big) at $20 with no side included, the side of French fries at $10, and pkhali trio (three little rolls of Georgian salads) at $22(!).

Food ordered
Adjapsandali (eggplant salad) - though looking good it was plain and tasteless. I tried the dish before in many different places and this adjapsandali was by far the worst.
Pkhali trio (three little rolls of Georgian salads) - these were good, like you would usually get in a Georgian restaurant.
Bazhe (walnut dipping sauce) with Chicken - the bazhe itself (sauce) was delicious and perfect. Chicken was dry, tough, and had a lot of bones.
Elarji (Georgian cheese baked with corn flour) - this was excellent and was gone in no time! Best elarji I tried so far!
Khachapuri Adjaruli - fresh, perfectly baked, generously filled with cheese - it was scrumptious! Perfect! We had to stir the egg and butter with cheese ourselves though... I would come to this restaurant again despite all the bads just to have this Adjaruli.
Khachapuri Megruli - delicious, juicy, with tons of cheese! It was somewhat salty, but I liked it and I believe it's supposed to be like this.
Megruli Kharcho - kharcho itself was great with good amount meat. Some meat pieces however were very tough and hardly chewable. We ordered two of this. For some reason one portion had mostly good and tender meat pieces while the second had mostly not chewable ones.
Chakapuli (veal with tarragon and herbs) - this one was good and tasty, like you would usually get in a Georgian restaurant. Nothing extraordinary. No side included.
Shkmeruli (chicken in white garlic sauce) - the sauce was delicious, but the chicken pieces were so bony there was almost no meat! And the portion itself was tiny (see the picture) though priced at $24. I'm sure it could be done better :( No side included.
Khinkali (Georgian dumplings) with lamb - the filling meat and the broth were very tasty and flavorful. The dumplings however were too big and hence had too much dough for the amount of filling in them. Certainly not the best khinkali.
Chicken Mtsvadi (shish kebab) - chicken was fresh, tender, and juicy. Our kids loved it! Not including fries or any side with it was shame.

Unfortunately, we cannot recommend this restaurant except just for a perfect khachapuri.', 'OMG! What an incredible find! We stumbled upon this restaurant and were warmly welcomed by DAVID who provided outstanding recommendations on Georgian cuisine. I was so surprised to find a few extraordinary vegan and gluten free items on the menu that blew me away! Their classic Georgian salad and bean stew offered exciting flavors and presentation. My friend took a more traditional route and ordered the beef dumplings and the cheese bread with the poached egg (apologies for not citing the correct Georgian dishes). All of her dishes were delicious and could easily feed 2-3 people. Portions are generous, food us fresh, and the hospitality is 10 stars! We are not from the area, and really appreciated the vibe of the place. We will definitely come back!! Bravo to the chef!!!', 'Some of the best Georgian food I’ve ever had. Beautiful space and gracious service. Definitely make a special trip for this one!', 'I don't like to put negative reviews, but in this case, I have to do it.

The real food not like at the photo.

I ordered mtsabi (lamb kebab) and grilled vegetables. Bitter meat, vegetables are not tasty.
Worst of all, my colleague was not given her order as it looks in the photo.

The girl in the restaurant tried to deal with me because of a complaint from my colleague, and in the end she agreed to provide bread, but twice told "this is a "jift".

Keep your gift, you just lost a few new clients.

P.S. After reading the response

Thank you for your bread/lavash, which I had to come for, spent the time and listen to the whims of the waiter, but this cannot be a "gift", the bread is part of the dish (see your pictures better). As the response of the management is the same as the service, I hope it will be unchanged shown the prospective clients who they'll have to deal with.

I had to look firstly the reviews, not your pictures, this is my bad :)', "Didn't have a chance to eat inside, so ordered to go.
The food is great ( hinkali, manty, harcho )
Prices are average
Recommended"]

name: CHF CHINESE RESTAURANT
reviews: ['I stumbled across CHF at lunchtime. Great $7.95 lunch specials. The bean curd with mushrooms was fresh and delicious. Friendly service and restaurant is very clean.', 'They serve good portions, and the food taste good. The lo mein roast pork and chicken has a nice garlic taste. The sesame chicken you get a whole tray full of it with a side of white rice and drink for lunch special. Had a small party and the food was all good.', 'This is my first order from this restaurant and what I got was so unexpectedly amazing. I’ve never seen better price with such good food in another place. In other places lunch meals are way more expensive, but here they have great price and comes with bottle soda too. Their chicken is from white meat back then was always dark meat; I’m always going to order from them now. Great quality food and awesome price.', "I didn't want to leave NY without having Chinese food. This place was not a  disappointment. Will definitely be back when I'm in town. My meal was less than $11", 'The best Chinese food in Sunset Park with cheap prices + generous portions. Been to many others in the area and none of them compare to the taste + price + portions + cleanliness + & the nice people there. CHF is a must-try.']

name: LUCKY EIGHT
reviews:
["We had a fantastic lunch at this Cantonese restaurant! The staff was exceptionally friendly, making us feel welcome right away. The food, especially the roasted duck and honey roasted pork, was a hit with the whole family – flavorful, perfectly cooked, and clearly made with care. Even my kids couldn’t get enough of it! The prices were reasonable, adding to the overall great value. It’s a cozy spot with an inviting atmosphere and a menu that impresses. We'll definitely be back for more of their delicious offerings!", 'It’s been a while since we were here and a lot has changed. They closed down their huge basement dining area and the food could use a pick me up. Service is great thou.

We had a good time since we pretty much the only customer booked for the whole dining room for a birthday. They are very accommodating  and service is good enough.

Food is good but I remember they used to be better. Sizzling beef should be sizzling but it barely any smoke. Rest of the food is up par but just not really good.

The positive part is the fact the place is quieter and spacious than rest of the other places. We get to have a quiet and decent family dinner.', 'While this spot may not look like much from the outside it’s a solid choice for great food.

We decided to explore the Sunset Park area, and while browsing reviews, menus and windows, we settled on Lucky eight.

To be 100% honest there were at least three groups of women that went in before us, and to me that was an indication that the food must be good as they might traditionally be the ones preparing food in their homes, and if they want to eat here, so do I .

The dining room is simple with a tank of lobsters and fish when you walk in, not all looking that spry but who would.

We ordered slightly blindly off the lunch special menu, which was a great value. The egg drop soup was delicious and all of the other portions were quite large. Sweet-and-sour chicken scored, high marks, and there was some “boiled chicken” that came with a delicious ginger garlic sauce on the side that I can highly recommend.

We always order snow pea leaves as they are often super fresh and delicious and that is exactly what we received here at Lucky eight. Another great choice if you want to get your greens in.

I had wanted to order roasted pork ribs, but ended up with sweet-and-sour pork, which was good, but was heavy on the pineapple, I should be expected, my bad.

The tea was on the table instantly and dark and delicious. The service was jovial and fun and efficient.

If you were in the area and looking for a quick and easy lunch this is a great option.', 'Pretty tasty food.  Our family just got back from Guangzhou and we were craving authentic Cantonese food— Lucky Eight hit the spot.   We went there for dinner and the restaurant was 2/3 full and it was mostly large groups that came in.   Food came fairly quickly.  Everything tastes good albeit a tad on the saltier side.   Pricing was moderate $48 for 4 dishes.  Portion size was decent.  Roast pork was a lot of food!  We’d definitely come back. p.s. the salty peanuts we so yummy.  My 4 year old wanted me to ask the waiter to box them up. I opted to put them in a napkin instead.  :)', 'Long Live Lucky Eight.
My family and I have been coming here for many moons and while adjusting to the new menu/management we were able to feel right at home. The key here is knowing what to order, and that can only be done with a little trial and error or by following our lead with the pictured dishes : )

This is authentic cuisine and not your typical take-out establishment. Be a little adventurous and enjoy the Michelin Recommended Restaurant.']

name: HYLAN CURRY & GRILL
reviews:
['Visited this place for a group dinner party yesterday. The food was delicious with very friendly service. This corner institution offers good Indian/Nepali food on this busy thoroughfare (Hylan Ave) in Staten Island, NY. It has a small parking lot behind for about 6 vehicles, but there is lots of street parking available in the residential neighborhood behind. We were a group of about 65 adults and booked the place for our event. Will definitely patronize this place again!', 'Excellent. Formerly Indian Xpress 2, Hylan Curry & Grill has been operational for about a year now. Stopped in for a quick bite and tried their fantastic lunch menu.

Lots of vegan and vegetarian options, which is always welcome. The food was spectacular; it is a huge step up from Taste of India II in New Dorp.

Will definitely be back.', "Tasty, definitely a little different from other Indian places I've been. I'll be back to try some Nepalese dishes. Came back today to check out the Sunday buffet. Everything was delicious and for $16.95 per person its a great deal too.", "We had dinner here on a weeknight. First the positives - (1) the food was excellent -  we ordered the samosa chat, chicken momo, mixed grill and paneer makhani along with a mixed bread basket (2) everything was good quality, well-prepared and portions were quite generous. (3) Prices are very fair, good value. (4) tables are nicely set with tablecloths and cloth napkins and seats are pretty comfortable. (5) service is friendly and we were not rushed at all. Now the negatives - (1) the lighting is terrible, very bright and harsh like fluorescent lights, not at all conducive to a relaxing dining experience. (2) they play the same monotonous flute music constantly - it's on the loud side and we found it pretty annoying (3) they have a liquor license but don't seem to know what to do with it - they basically sell liquor by the shot, and you can mix it with soda if you want, they didn't even have tonic water and also didn't have the mixers needed for the few cocktails offered on the menu. We saw some bottles of wine and beer in a cooler next to the bar but there is no wine list or even a list of beers available provided. Highly recommend the food but not a great in-house dining experience.", "This place is phenomenal. I was in the mood for Indian food and just threw it into a Google search and drove to this place. Parking in the back. Ordered Samosas and butter chicken with basmati rice. This is the closest thing to authentic Indian food that I've had in a while. Happy for the delicious food and great experience."]

name: ALELI MEXICAN RESTAURANT
reviews: ['Spacious, clean  smiling staff and the food is fantastic! Fresh, tasty and unique menu. Not a ridiculously large menu which I appreciate and enough unique items to make it a must come back type of place .
