Congrats!', 'I got a chicken burrito with guacamole to go and it was absolutely delicious. Perfect flavors, and portion size. Chicken was juicy and as a healthy eater I appreciate the spinach inside. The guacamole was tasty and fresh. Also the restaurant has a very modern and minimalist aesthetic that makes it great to dine in at any time of the day. I am coming back to try the tacos and enchiladas next. Great restaurant in Bay Ridge.', 'Absolutely delicious experience every time we go there. A gem in the heart of Bay Ridge. Some of our favorite dishes are fish tacos, octopus appetizer, street corn, shrimp quesadillas and high quality drinks. Pleasant atmosphere, excellent service, great music, this is our go to for Mexican food!', "Update: still amazingly fresh and delicious. Strong quality drinks.\n\nAlways fresh and flavorful--presentation on point.  I've dined here since the pandemic, and the quality has always been excellent. Ambiance is so peaceful and vibrant. The owners of this business are incredibly humble. They had to push their grand opening once the pandemic hit but I'm glad they persevered. If you're surprised it's a quiet spot, enjoy it while it lasts. Every dish is made delicately and bursting with flavour. And forgot to mention: ample vegan and gluten free options", 'Oh my God sooooo freaking good!!! This has got to be one of the best authentic Mexican restaurants I’ve tried here in bay ridge. Everything was so flavorful and beautifully presented. Nice atmosphere cool waiters! 10/10 try it ASAP they have taco Tuesday specials and Margaritas for Thursdays.']

name: THE CHINESE KITCHEN
reviews:
["It was one of the worst dining experiences you can ever have. I know it's New Year's Eve and you're getting slammed food didn't come out on time we had no silverware I ordered of soda we had no cups. At the end of dinner no fortune cookies no offer to purchase dessert. My bill was $450 you would think they would offer a fortune cookie and some fruit. Can't blame the waiter you was all alone. This is bad management.", 'Great beef on a stick. ........
Why would you serve grand marnier shrimp on lettuce? No fruits or anything with the plate? Sizzling steak sauce was a little too rich with soy sauce.
However,  I cannot fault the service.  Our server was excellent. And the hostess was very kind to our son.', 'The best spareribs in the five boroughs! Tons of meat on them, not skimpy. Best restaurant on the island. The food is always fresh and delicious, with large portions. Furthermore, the restaurant is clean, and Jackie the owner is very accommodating. Highly recommended!', "Very old school place with the best egg rolls on the island (you can hear a snap when you break them open...perfect.)
Dining room service was wonderful. And while I like the vintage 70's look of the place, it does give off a bit of a dingy vibe.", 'Never been to this place before, I decided to come here with my boyfriend and his father for dinner. The food was just horrible. We ordered spare ribs. They came out dry and tough to chew. Instead of complaining in front of everyone in the dining area I got up and went to speak with the lady privately. I informed her that the ribs were dry and tough. Hard to chew. She just looked at me like I was crazy. She then came over to our table. Full platesof food just sitting there and basically just stared at us. Winton soup was bland and had no flavor at all. Paid 52.00 for food that none of us even ate. I will not recommend this place to anyone. Horrible first time experience and we will not be going back there!!!']

name: ROUNDABOUT RESTAURANT
reviews: ['I recently enjoyed a visit to this restaurant, savoring their tacos de res, chuchito de pollo, and a refreshing strawberry shake. The dining area was comfortable and beautifully decorated, and the service was friendly and efficient. I appreciated the quick takeout process, though I regret not dining in to enjoy a few more tacos. Definitely a must-visit for a memorable and delicious meal!', 'The milkshake was a tad thin, but the chicken sandwich was the best I have ever eaten.', 'Delicious tamales rice with chicken best I ever had and there big and not expensive', 'If you found roundabout restaurant, congratulations, amazing Guatemalan food.', 'Got the chuchitos (kind of like tamales from some other countries, Guatemalan tamales have rice). Really delicious and inexpensive. A hidden gem']

name: POLONICA RESTAURANT
reviews:
['Never did like perogies, that is until I had them here. Went to college in the Wilkes-Barre/Scranton area of Northeastern PA. Large Polish population there and it seemed everything had something pierogi, even milkshakes (just kidding as that would be a horrible combo). Just never developed a taste for them. One day after passing by this place a million times my wife suggested we stop in and check it out. Should have stopped in much sooner. Great place. We go there regularly now. Neither the food nor service has ever disappointed us. Nice and cozy inside and it's not loud. Common theme in my reviews...hate loud.

On our last go round there my son and grandson  (they both love eating here) accompanied us. Of course we ordered perogies (cheese and potato) and gobbled these tasty fellows in a heartbeat. We usually get the fried ones, but the boiled ones are just as good. A must have appetizer. Surowka, which is the house salad, is especially good and is provided with most entrees. It consists of petit servings of red cabbage, sauerkraut, cole slaw, beets and shredded carrots. Was a surprise the first time we ate there as we didn't know it was included with our entrée. Looked at each other and said "what's this?". Now we look forward to it. So many different flavors. So tasty and a perfect accompaniment to your meal. Had another favorite that we've ordered quite a few times...Hungarian pancakes. Indescribably delicious. A must have. Portion size is such that you could easily share it. The Kotlet Szefowski,  Chef's Pork Chop, is another must have. Melts in your mouth...so tender. It is topped with mushrooms and mozzarella that adds a bang to the tender and delicious pork chop residing underneath. The menu description notes "it will melt in your mouth" and they are not kidding. Could go on and on about the various dishes we've had here, but I don't want this to be the longest review ever. So definitely try their Stuffed Kielbasa,  Stuffed Chicken breast, Beef Goulash and even their decidedly not Polish Fish and Chips (a safe bet for a friend or child who is not adventurous or doesn't like authentic ethnic food). Every one a solid choice that are10 stars out of ten.  BTW...Don't forget  to order a Blintz for dessert. They are amazing. My son is a beer aficionado and usually has a Tyskie beer to go with his meal. A nice smooth beer.', 'I think this is the best restaurant in Bay Ridge.  Granted I have a Polish family so I grew up on this style of food but it’s simply outstanding.  Light dumplings, delicious and perfectly done meat dishes and the soups are fantastic.  Everything tastes home made and it even holds up to delivery.  Can’t recommend this place enough!', 'Great pyzy and Hungarian pancakes (placki ziemniaczane)! I highly recommend! The tripe soup (flaki) was mouth-gasmic! Run to this place!', "I had a very enjoyable lunch here. I got the sampler to go with boiled perogies and kielbasa.

The Kielbasa was very flavorful, the stuffed cabbage was loaded with meat, and the perogies were so moist. The sides all had distinctly different tasts. Tart saurkraut, sweet carrots, earthy sweet beets, light cole slaw, and strong purple cabbage.

Can't wait to get a perogie sampler and some borscht next time.", "Authentic food and very generous plates. Service was great once we got our servers attention. Atmosphere is amazing and the place fills up quickly.
The stroganoff is different than what I'm used to - it has more of tomato forward taste - perhaps there's a difference in stroganoff flavor profiles from different countries."]

name: ISTANBUL BAY AUTHENTIC MEDITERRANEAN RESTAURANT
reviews:
['Amazing place, I just came back from Turkey and this place is on par, if not better than best restaurants in Turkey. They use good quality olive oil, which is a rare find among restaurants these days. Atmosphere is amazing. They have a covered outside terrace. Highly recommended.', 'Absolutely incredible food. Everything is so flavorful! And the service was excellent. My husband and I stopped here after taking the Staten Island ferry back from NYC. This place is only 5 min away from the ferry terminal. This will definitely be a regular stop on our trips back from New York City.', 'I live nearby and was excited to hear we have a new restaurant in the area. We sat outside in the outdoor space and it was truly gorgeous. The vibe and aesthetic definitely made me feel like I was no longer in Staten Island. All of the wait staff were extremely kind and the service was excellent.
The food was delicious and it was a cute surprise when they brought out the Turkish black tea and fresh fruit.
We did bring our own bottle of wine to enjoy with the meal. I would definitely be back to enjoy summer meals in the backyard.', 'Came for lunch with my girlfriend and Alper was our waiter and overall it was a fantastic experience. The service, the ambiance, the music was superb. The outdoor seating area was so cozy and comfortable I felt at home. I would recommend to anyone who wants to try a new restaurant and have amazing food! 10/10!', 'Okay, wow. This place deserves all the reputation, all the stars, and a permanent place in my bookmarks. Very underrated.

Their outdoor seating area in the back TRANSPORTS you. It’s a vibe you just have to experience, and they have their own branded blankets in case you’re chilly (seriously, this hospitality).

The staff? So professional, so kind, and so patient (…my first experience was in a party of ~15 of us yuppies).
Okay, and THE FOOD? Actually incredible too 😭. So many options, amazing value.
Balloon bread with their dips is a trip, I enjoyed the Turkish tea, their falafel with hummus — wow, and I also shared their small doner — also wow😭. They appeared to be BYOB since friends went out to pick up bottles of wine nearby; the staff accommodated with chilling the white wine.

I don’t know what else to say. We were all blown away. This is a case where I’m glad I’m a cyclist/fisherman who regularly visits Staten Island (…I’m guilty that I’m a Manhattan slicker). I’ll personally be back with eager enthusiasm. Thanks so much, guys.']

name: YEMEN WHDAH RESTAURANT
reviews:
['Deserves less than 3 stars! I usually support Muslim Owned Restaurants, as soon as I walked in, it was a mess!! NO ONE TO ASK, NO ONE TO CLEAN a table which had plates and bones all over. The place was dirty, napkins, forks, food, bones all on the floor. The chairs were torn, I literally dried the table myself!! Took 10+ min just to get a menu. Smh! UNLESS THEY KNOW YOU, THEY DON'T GREET YOU! SAD!
A really bad experience. NO PRIVACY IF YOUR COMING WITH FAMILY.
Nevertheless when the food arrived it was warm, fresh looking, 🍗🍖🍚 , the Lamb Haneeth was okay, nothing crazy👍.
GET YOUR LAMB HANEETH TO GO AND EAT IN THE CAR!!! SMH!
The soup was okay. But definitely helps the throat and appetite. The Lamb Haneeth is like $33 (**smth about the bill seemed off**) for a plate of rice and normal amount of meat and on the side they add their veggie/potato curry.
They have Qahwah available to customers that can drink, and have condensed milk if they prefer to add. Loved the Qahwah! "something about the spiced"', 'Delicious food, good service, the price is not high', 'My first time eating food from Yemen was excellent,  I liked the taste.
Affordable prices and fast service.
Just pay more attention when cleaning tables and floor.', 'Alhamdulillah, Halal food we found on Brooklyn. Marshallah, Their food is very tasty and delicious. We enjoyed tho... $$ price with delicious food more than fair enough..', 'Remember my last experience?!    Not so good , but now this is the real Yemen food , and better is the service, just amazing, I recommend to everyone! Try it !']

name: ANTOJITOS MEXICANOS RESTAURANT II
reviews:
['Loved the pace, good design and details in the decor. Both waitresses we had were wonderful, professional food was delicious, the alcoholic drinks were well balanced!', 'The steak platter and torta de milanesa were just okay. However, the tamarind Margarita with chile had too much pulp, making it difficult to drink, and I believe the seeds were crushed, so be cautious. It was quite spicy, and my stomach was upset afterward. The lemonade drink was not enjoyable. On a positive note, the customer service was good.', 'We had an unforgettable experience at an authentic Mexican restaurant where we celebrated a birthday with friends. From the warm hospitality to the inviting ambiance, we were impressed from the moment we walked in. The beautifully decorated interior and extensive menu options, ranging from classic dishes to more adventurous choices, made it easy to find something for everyone.

We started with nachos, which were loaded with fresh ingredients and perfectly crispy chips. The steak was cooked to perfection, incredibly tender and flavorful, while the al pastor and carne asada tacos were a standout dish, with expertly seasoned fillings and handmade tortillas. Overall, the outstanding food and festive atmosphere made it a memorable dining experience that we highly recommend to anyone looking for authentic Mexican cuisine.', 'We stopped in for a bite and after reading reviews thought it would great but the food was meh. Our server did not speak any English so it was hard to ask questions or place an order.', 'Tonight I had a cheeseburger
And it wasn’t good
Cuz the beef wasn’t a good beef
It was frozen beef!
While I was eating it was dry completely
I guess cheeseburger are for kids
Imagine if our kids eat freeze food like that

This restaurant has good recipes

Mixiotes are amazing
Tamales are good
Seafood soup is really good

I recommend for the owners work in cheeseburger lil more

Its like I paid 20 bucks for a burger like that

I love their food but it wasn’t what I expected about cheeseburger']

name: AL AQSA RESTAURANT FALAFEL HOUSE
reviews:
['This restaurant makes most fresh and authentic middle eastern food in Staten Island. The owner treats his customers like family. Authentic Baklava, great quality food, great atmosphere and I will definitely visit again! Thank you!', 'This is by far the best falafel 🥙 I have ever had! My partner and I were visiting from NJ and I wanted to have lunch before we went to our family’s house. Saw this place online with 4.9 stars and said to myself I HAVE to try this. After finishing our leftovers just now, I am definitely going back for more when I am in the area. The service was lovely 😊 they gave us some falafel to try and it did not disappoint. Everything is so flavorful. Keep up the amazing work!
Parking is available in front of the store or on the street.', "I am hesitant to write this review as I selfishly want to keep this gem all to myself, but this place truly deserves a raving review so here we go…

The food here is phenomenal.  Today we had the chicken shish kebab wrap with pickles which was packed with tender, flavorful chicken and a perfect crunch. The lamb shawarma on pita was equally impressive, boasting rich, savory spices. We also had the beautifully presented falafel platter, which is the best I’ve had anywhere, ever.

The restaurant itself is small, with some indoor and outdoor seatings.  Most customers order take out but it is very comfortable to dine in as well if you prefer to eat your food right away, like me.

The ambiance is welcoming, and the service is friendly and efficient, making the whole experience even more enjoyable. Whether you're seated indoors or enjoying the breeze outside, Al Aqsa provides a comfortable and inviting atmosphere to enjoy some truly outstanding food.

Since they’ve opened couple years ago, I’ve been here no less than 40 times.  You’re truly missing out if you don’t give this place a try!", 'The place to be ! :)
The team especially the owner is so welcoming.
We ordered Chicken Shawarma, Falafel, hummus salad. The food was so delicious! The Chicken Shawarma was tender and flavorful, the Falafel was crispy and tasty, and the Mojitos were refreshing. I highly recommend this restaurant for a tasty meal.', 'I recently had the pleasure of dining at the Al Aqsa restaurant Falafel house in the heart of Staten Island, which seamlessly blends Egyptian and Palestinian cuisines. The food was incredibly fresh, made from organic ingredients, and served with an authenticity that transported me straight to the Middle East. The dishes were not only delicious but also beautifully presented, capturing the essence of traditional Mediterranean flavors. This restaurant is a hidden gem for anyone seeking an authentic and delightful Middle Eastern breakfast experience.']

name: KARAM RESTAURANT
reviews: ['The restaurant in the Bay Ridge section of Brooklyn has Lebanese/Mediterranean food.   I ordered the zaatar pie, shawarma combination with a small salad, fried cauliflower and lentils.  The food was average in taste.  The portion size was average.  The restaurant has two separate sections-one is for takeout and the second is for dining in.  However,  if you dine in they call you that your food is ready.  The customer is expected to pick up the food and then take a seat at an available table.  Customer service could use an upgrade.  Workers handling food wash your hands after touching and wiping face.', 'Came here for lunch and got a falafel sandwich. It was delicious, and the workers were so hospitable and friendly ☺️ the atmosphere in the dining area was very nice too. Will come again!', 'Cannot recommend this place nearly enough! It’s a hole in the wall that’s been at the top of the Lebanese list of best flavors since forever, with the most delicious sandwiches and plates that you can either enjoy in their tiny dining spot or order for takeout. But what  was even more impressive was their catering service that I tried for the first time earlier this month. Outstanding on all fronts, from the seamless menu building and pricing with Shawki, to the spotless delivery and beautiful buffet of authentic cold and hot mezze staples along with the warming mains that they set up themselves, to the generosity and quality of the dishes! On top of the perfectly seasoned hummus babaghannouj tabbouleh fattouch and cheese rekakat, crowd favorites were the vegan eggplant toasted nuts makloubeh rice, and the chicken taouk skewers for the meat eaters. Their gigantic servings of fresh fruit salad and sweet cheese dessert (halewet el jebn) were perfection!! We had so much food, every guest left with full bellies carrying out their own leftover platters! Happiness galore!', 'I had an amazing meal at Karam Restaurant The shawarma was so tasty and full of flavor, and the shish was perfectly grilled and juicy. The food was fresh, and the staff was very friendly. I highly recommend this place to anyone who loves great food!”', 'The best chicken shawarma sandwich you can have is here ! Great food, service, and atmosphere.\nFast, warm, and fresh pies 24/7.']

name: AVOCADO MEXICAN RESTAURANT & COFFEE SHOP
reviews: ['Stopped by for a quick lunch. Really good birria tacos, juicy beef, the consume was flavorful and not greasy. Server was attentive and friendly too.\n\nLoved the interior. Nice and clean! Will return.', 'Wow, if heaven called out for Mexican food, they would call this place. Fantastic food! I had the steak and the shrimp, simply wonderful!', 'My family and I went last week to the restaurant and the food was excellent! Everyone at the restaurant was so friendly and made us feel comfortable right away. We enjoyed the food so much that we ordered catering for our Daughters’ birthday and the food was incredible. Every single one of our guests loved it so much that everyone wanted to take food home. Highly highly recommend! Both times, Parking was very easy on Shaughnessy lane.', 'Really cute place. Everything is new so it’s sparkling clean. We ordered the chips and guac, veggie quesadilla, tortilla soup, and an al pastor taco. All the food was extremely fresh. The chips just came out of the fryer. Highly recommend. Happy to support this new business.', "Been here twice and did 3 take outs so far! As someome who lived in Queens for years and got used to generous sized and authentic Mexican food I can say that I dont need a trip to Queens anymore. Everything they make here is so perfect, tasty, fresh garnishes, crispy nachos, juicy and even the black coffee is good! Plus, they are open all the time!  I love this place and im always happy to support they're hard work and business.😋😋😋😋"]

name: CARAVAN RESTAURANT & COFFEE
reviews:
['We had an incredible dining experience with all the dishes we ordered. The sushi was exceptionally tasty, with the fish being incredibly fresh, practically melting in our mouths. The cost is also very affordable. The Uzbek dishes, including kuksu and pilov, were also excellent, with kuksu being particularly refreshing. The kebabs were also very tasty. The restaurant itself is impeccably clean, and the service is top-notch, with respectful and attentive staff.', "Amazing! Sincerely a hidden gem. Great food and wonderful service! The chicken kebab was so juicy and tender, beef stroganoff had Amazing flavor. We went for lunch and I got the lunch with the sour salad,I wasn't sure what to expect but it was delicious! Pickled onion cabbage tomatoes and cucumber, was a great addition to the dish.  Dessert was a little sweet for my taste, but delicious and I'm more of a savory type anyway. The cheesey dessert was amazing, and they've got a whole café attached. Overall wonderful experience with the friendliest staff and we can't wait to go back!", "It's a wonderful place to try the most delicious dishes from Koreans of Central Asia. «Guksu» noodles are made according to a unique recipe preserved by Koreans from Uzbekistan and Kazakhstan for centuries. Pleasant atmosphere, excellent service, and outstanding quality! Highly recommended!", 'I loved this place the sushi’s was incredibly fresh. And the Uzbek food like the Kyksi was amaaazzzing. Definitely have to try this', "I always knew that hot food there is bad, I always knew that they mix old food with new food, I always knew that you don’t need to buy anything there, but sometimes I buy food that supposedly shouldn’t spoil And here is another surprise today...

last time the dumplings that I bought by weight, it rotted in the freezer... (I thought it was my freezer problem, but now I'm sure it's not)

🤷🏻‍♂️"]

name: DELIA'S LOUNGE & RESTAURANT
reviews:
['This place is adorable. The ambiance and coziness is great, the drinks are good. It’s the perfect date spot and honestly the music was surprisingly good. It’s been around 25 years and deserves to stay. I’d totally recommend this place to anyone looking to go on a date and be able to have a conversation while being comfortable.', "Absolutely enjoy this low key gem in my neighborhood. The whole place is a vibe. Their chic menu has generous portions and great taste - especially their burgers! Their service, Danielle in particular, matched our energy, and the music tied it all together. I'll be back soon!", "Had a nice respite here with my wife after a very irksome day. The drinks were generous and mixed to perfection. The dry-aged burgers were great. Cooked exactly to order and rather quickly. They were served with plenty of nice fries and with a big smile from Danielle our server; even late in the evening with a full house. The owner, Simon, and his daughter, McKenzie, were very gracious. We enjoyed the music and the unique atmosphere. Even heard tunes from performers we hadn't heard in ages. Thanks to all at Delia's for a great time.", "Fantastic lounge/bar/restaurant in the heart of Bay Ridge on 3rd Avenue.
Proprietor Simon is a fixture in the neighborhood since making his way to Brooklyn from Ireland decades ago.
Great place to sit outside to have a drink or two and perhaps smoke a cigar (there's a humidor a few doors down).
Standouts on the menu include absolutely delicious skirt steak skewers served with Peter Luger dipping sauce and off-menu (🤫) chicken dumplings with thai chili sauce.
Amenities include cozy couches to sink into, a fireplace, eclectic artwork, varied entertainment events like trivia and live music along with sports broadcasts, as well as good company every time I'm there.
Highly recommended for date night or to watch the game.

Off menu chicken dumplings still a winner.
Grilled chicken ceasar salad delicious too!", 'Delia’s is by far my favorite spot in Bay Ridge. The atmosphere is phenomenal, the bartenders and wait staff are amazing and so kind. I tell everyone about this place and try to get everyone to come here; I just introduced my two friends to Delia’s the other night and they LOVED IT!! Simon and Danielle are the kindest, best people ever and deliver spectacular service. Truly the best cocktails in Bay Ridge. I seriously cannot stop raving about this place because there is nothing similar in Bay Ridge! This is my go to for a place to have a drink with a friend or to go on a date! Seriously, stop by and you will also find your new FAVORITE SPOT! \U0001fa77']

name: BASILIO INN
reviews: ["The food is fresh, the atmosphere is small and intimate and the service is impeccable! Even though it was our first visit, it felt comfortable and familiar. The owner, who was so kind and easy to speak with, came over quite a few times to our table to make recommendations, give some background on the dishes and spoke about his time in Italy. The martinis were fabulous! This is a wonderful place for a date night or with a group of friends! It's authentic Italian food that I plan to show off to out of town family!!", 'Old-school Italian since 1921. Fresh pasta and produce. Warm/welcoming environment. One of our all-time favorites.', 'Over one hundred years old...\nBut the food was fresh and delish!\nWe had a wonderful time...', 'Came here on a Sunday afternoon. Place was packed, they got plus a table for two and treated us like family. Delicious food, based on the manager’s recommendation.   Definitely will return when in the area.', 'Very nice restaurant with great staff and fresh homemade food. Open seasonally it has some iconic Italian dishes along with some fresh vegetables from the garden']

name: KUZINA
reviews: ['Really disgusted with this place. I order 2-3 times per week on uber eats. every single time i order, it’s always missing something in the order. so today i decided to call and let them know, the guy who answered the phone was so rude. i know this isn’t the owner cause i’ve walked in to eat before and the owner doesn’t sound like this. the guy on the phone pretty much refused to make it right and told me he refuses to add walnuts to the yogurt with the cherry preserve sauce if that’s how i order it. i explained i was a regular customer ordering weekly and he didn’t care. i actually hung up on him cause he was so rude. unfortunately ill have to take my business elsewhere.', 'Mixed grilled was delicious. Nice portions, everything fresh. Even the house salad was delicious!', 'The food is always delicious! The service is always great. Also, thanks so much for double wrapping the potatoes. That was very thoughtful and much appreciated!', "There are tables for eatting in the restruant, but food is served with a picnic package of plastic fork, knife salt, pepper and napkin.  Had gyro which tasted like it was missing something.  Wine on the menu but they don't serve alcohol so no wine.", 'Always 10/10 when I order from here! The dolmades, chicken souvlaki, pita and tzatziki are the best!']

name: PICAZO'S PIZZA & RESTAURANT PLACE CORP
reviews: ['Amazing food. The staff are wonderful. Well deserved at all cost.', 'I am vegetarian and their vegetarian options are not the best i have had, but love the vibe and the staff is super helpful :)', 'The food was delicious', 'Best pizza I have eaten in years', 'One of my favorite places to grab a quick bite.']

name: MAI'S VIETNAMESE RESTAURANT
reviews: ['We found this place recently and we love it. Finally a good Vietnamese place in south Brooklyn! The staff is very sweet and the food is delicious. The beef curry soup/stew is probably the best we’ve had and we have tried many Vietnamese places both in Manhattan and Brooklyn. The broth feels like it can cure anything.  I highly recommend it!', 'Came here to have dinner with a friend. Super friendly service, very clean, nice music selection. price is affordable and food tastes great. We ordered grilled chicken noodle soup. Grilled pork noodle soup, and the grilled beef summer roll. They were all delicious. My friend and I especially liked the grilled beef summer roll. Definitely will be coming back ❤️', 'This place is a gem! 10/10 experience. My boyfriend and I both ordered banh mi, and spring rolls. It was so good. We are definitely going back to try more of the other plates that they offer. Everything on menu looked so great.', 'Okay. Lovely interior and vibes, super cute. When we walked in, we were immediately seated. The food was amazing, but i would skip the spring & summer rolls and just go for the pho. Worth it for the price. However, the workers literally kept looking as they were eating their own food. Maybe cus we were the only customers, but i was annoyed.', 'This place is awesome, in every way from taste of food, to portions, to service and cost. The hot tea they offer when they seat you is tasty, and the staff was very attentive. We got a bahn mi, spring rolls, chicken satay, a large bowl of pho, and 2 iced coffee/boba drinks all for under $50. The large bowl of pho being only $12.50 is a great deal for how much food it is. The chicken satay skewer was some of the tastiest chicken I’ve ever eaten. I’m glad this place came to Bay Ridge, and I hope they’re here for a very long time!']

name: AMALFI COAST PIZZERIA AND RESTAURANT INC
reviews:
['Don’t judge a book by its cover this place has some amazing food great quality great prices.   The pizza has a nice old Brooklyn taste.', 'Felt like a neighbor hood gem. Was coming back from practice and had a triple sauce slice(name probably not accurate) was pretty damn good. The chef even made it fresh for us. The dough was soft chewy and crispy all at the same time. Very nice !', 'Best PIZZA in STATEN ISLAND. SEE SAMMY.', 'I preferred the vodka square over the plain slice.  The sesame seeds by the crust on the vodka square was a unique touch. 6.5', "Small slice for $3.
Crispy, medium thin crust.
Cheese is well cooked, but couldn't taste the sauce.
Plus, it pretty much taste like a grilled cheese slice.
It was okay, but nothing to write home about.
Rate this at 82."]

name: RUZANA
reviews: ['Been back here 3x in 2 weeks. As a restaurant owner myself, i can say this food is fresh and consistent. Get a mixed grill to share, it’ll have every kind of meat on there and you’ll be able to see which your favorites are. I will be back probably once a week!', 'The restaurant is located in the Bay Ridge section of Brooklyn.  It is on 85th Street near 5th Avenue.  The Palestinian food is similar to other Mediterranean food.  I ordered the Vegetable Sambousek.  They were small triangular-shaped dough filled with vegetables and some spices.  The Qudsia is a cold appetizer that is a combination of hummus and beans.  The Musakhan was similar to a,chicken wrap.  It was generous in size.  The food had a nice taste.  Friendly staff in the restaurant.  The bill was confusing because the prices on the web site are different than in the restaurant.', 'The food is absolutely phenomenal, the taste is 10/10, all the meats were so tender and juicy, The portions are very good. The restaurant decor is beautiful and the people working are also kind, they accommodated to all our allergy requests. I will for sure be back here', "Wow, what a hidden gem!! As a Palestinian American, it's rare to find authentic good\nPalestinian food, so when I come across this wonderful restaurant, I was fortunate!  First of all, the ambience is so cute and charming with some tables inside and outside.  They do lots of take out and catering-tells you how good the food and service is!  Abdel-Rahman was so professional, friendly and accommodating.  He answered all my questions and the chef was so friendly and handled all my allergy requests like a professional!  Everything came out of the kitchen with love and amazing presentation.  So much detail to spices and taste to ensure perfection.  They don't take shortcuts and focus on quality and flavor.  This will now be our regular place for Palestinian food and also just a wonderful place for veggie options for me.  Plenty of meat and seafood dishes as well that look so delicious. Ruzana is  authentic and as close as it gets to how my mom cooks.  Super clean establishment with charm in every corner.   Thank you chef and Abdul-Rahman!  See later this week!", 'Worst beef shawarma i have ever had in my entire life , sauce expired , shawarma not well done , not tasty at all. The cashier had an attitude also. Never Again , not sure if their food every day is bad but today wS the worst 😕']

name: CHRIS'S
reviews:
['The restaurant serves Polish food.   I ordered the mushroom barley soup.  It has three size options:  cup, small or large.  The soup was good but was salty.  I ordered the Polish platter.  It consisted of 1 piece of stuffed cabbage, 1 piece of kielbasa, 3 pierogies and sauerkraut.  It was very good and had a nice taste.  The restaurant has a bar and some seating outdoors.  Friendly and helpful staff.', "They don't give you the menu right away unless you remind them. The table is a mess, and no one cares. Tripe soup is delicious!! Beef tartare is good.", 'This was my first introduction to Polish food and it was amazing. The atmosphere inside was very welcoming. The wait staff were friendly, attentive and very helpful. The food came out promptly and was delicious. 5 out of 5, I would recommend.', "Incredible food, amazing prices - well worth the schlep out to the area. The pierogi are to die for!!! We ordered the small portion of 4 pieces and just got one of each flavor - they were all good but the best one was the mushroom/sourkraut.

They have a huge array of borscht to try as well. Alas, I was only there with 1 adult and a small child so we couldn't order a ton of things to try. Next time I will visit with a group so we can get a lot more food to try!

The pork neck special was also soooo tasty and plentiful. We ended up with leftovers enough for a whole other meal.

Staff is very nice and accommodating as well.", 'Food was amazing. We had the Polish sampler platter, borscht, potato pancakes and drinks. The kielbasa was especially delicious. Great atmosphere and service. Very reasonable prices. Overall a real hidden gem in the area!']

name: HING WONG
reviews:
['This has been our favorite take out and delivery Chinese restaurant for a few years. We always get the free General Tso’s chicken when you spend $40/$45 dollars. Tonight we tried the lobster, Cantonese style. The Ginger scallion is breaded and deep fried in the shell like soft shell crab. The Cantonese was served in a bowl of very hot gooey liquid with peas and carrots in it. I highly recommend most of their food, but I’d skip the lobster.', 'This is the usual place I go to in Bayridge, best Buddhist Delight and pan fried dumplings!!!!Other dishes are delicious too. Delivery is fast.', 'The lady who always works at the restaurant is very nice. The food in there is ok to try also.

Actually, I do not go there often because my workplace is near China town (more convenient to buy Chinese food). This afternoon, I cost around $25. When I picked up the food and opened them at home. I noticed there was one steamed rice.

I called her to confirm if it is free. She said it was free.

Wow!!!

I strongly recommend this restaurant.', 'Food is good and delivery is within 20 mins', 'Our go to spot for Chinese take out. The lady is nice. Our usual dishes are chicken broccoli, chicken lo mein, eggplant with garlic sauce, Singapore Mei fun. Delish! Sometimes they will give u pork instead of chicken so remind them you want chicken if you don’t eat pork for any reason.']

name: CIELO
reviews:
['Came on a Saturday night, it wasn’t too crowded. The pre fixe menu was nice and affordable. The calamari was so so, the batter wasn’t too great. The bread was nice. We then had our pasta - one seafood linguine (Linguine Pescatore) and the other angel hair seafood pasta (Capellini Sinatra). Both pastas were great! Then finished our meal with coffee and tiramisu - the tiramisu was really delicious as well! Overall, very happy with the meal. The portions are also huge that we had to pack some of our pasta.', 'Wonderful Italian restaurant. The food was delicious,  service: extraordinary and the atmosphere intimate. Perfect date night restaurant. My wife and I enjoyed our night out. Sangria was beyond tasty. Highly recommend this restaurant as I will be returning.', 'Highly recommend! Gluten free pasta looks and tastes homemade, salmon is unbelievably flaky and crispy, burrata was the freshest and creamiest I have ever had, and the dessert was also hands down the best I have had in a while. Above all, brilliant service- I felt very appreciated and attended to.', "This is a really nice Italian restaurant if you’re going to be in Staten Island. The value that you get far exceeded my expectations. They offer a price fixed menu that is available any time that comes with a starter, main entre and dessert. The options were really good. I started with the mussels in white sauce and for my main entrée ordered the gluten-free pasta with pesto sauce. we had eight people all together and everyone had something slightly differently. The soup was a great starter and there are several options. The salads are all so nice in the summertime. Among the others on the table we had the lobster tail, veal marsala, chicken Parm and the linguine with seafood. My favorite meal was the dessert. The two most popular desserts among us was the chocolate soufflé and the traditional tiramisu.

This is the local and small very unpretentious kind of place that is welcoming for families with children. Last night they happen to have a party going on in the upstairs room. When the room is open it serves as additional seating space for the restaurant. Because of the party the service was a little slower than usual but we didn’t mind because we were having a casual night out and we weren’t in it a rush.

I must say that the gluten-free pasta that I had here was among the best I’ve had anywhere. I especially love their pesto because it wasn’t overly filled with garlic. It met with the approval of my 11-year-old niece who is usually a very finicky eater and she said that she was going to come back and have the gluten-free pasta next time.That was a pretty hearty endorsement.

It’s not a very chic chic experience but it's a great place to get together with family and friends. Give it a try if you're in the neighborhood.", "Our daughter's engagement was celebrated at Cielo's last weekend! From the planning months ago to the actual day,  we were treated with kindness and respect! The day of the event was seamless! The staff helped us set up and were attentive to us and all our guests. The food was excellent as well! We would not hesitate to have future events at Cielo's!"]

name: 1468 HYLAN CAFE
reviews:
['So glad that this place in Staten island. No need to go to Brooklyn for the same dish. The place is a little bit small but they have decent design to maximize available space usage. They have some Chinese buns. Food has large portion and worth ever penny. Staff is nice and friendly. Avoid rush hour for overcrowding', 'I am so happy we have delicious authentic Cantonese style Chinese food on Staten Island now. Every week my family and I go here at least twice a week. The food is delicious, reasonably priced and big
Portions. All the staff are wonderful and so accomodating. The owners are also so
Appreciative of their clients. Everything is so delicious there. Our favorites are roast duck yellow noodle soup,
Soy sauce chicken leg flat white noodle soup and rice with crispy pork and soy sauce chicken. We also are fans of sponge
Cakes and roast pork buns. You really cannot go wrong here. Tip: pay cash and it
Will be a lower price', 'I ordered two of the 3 choices bbq combination over rice and it was the best I’ve had in NYC! I was very surprised by the huge portions. It was super tasty and authentic. I will definitely order from this place again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a comfort spot in Staten Island', 'This cafe has authentic Cantonese food and it is SO delicious! The star of the show is their roast pork, roasted pig (crispy skin), and roast duck leg! Other items we ordered: Asian vegetables (choy sum), beef fried noodle, shu mai, shrimp rice noodle, and chicken feet. They have sauces on the table for you (soysauce, chili oil, hot sauce). They do sit down (4 seaters and a bar stool area) or take out. They also have a selection of steam buns that you can take home to steam (bbq roast pork bun, pork bun, chicken bun etc), we got the steam pork bun and it was delicious! It had bits of shrimp in it too! We microwaved it at home. They also have baked goods like pineapple bun, custard pineapple bun, hot dog bun and so on. Prices are reasonable! I will come back! The staff are so nice and attentive. When you come here you MUST get a roasted meat with rice!!! Staff speaks English, Cantonese, and mandarin.

They have a parking lot. Credit card (no extra fee) and cash accepted.

For people who don’t usually eat this and don’t know what to order:
—Entrees: get the roast pork over rice, crispy beef noodles (stir fry), wonton noodle soup with wonton in soup, beef chow fun (dry or gravy style)
—Dimsum: egg tart (like Portuguese egg tarts), shrimp dumplings, siu mai
—Drinks: ice lemon tea (will taste like ice tea)', "I'm very happy that there's really traditional Chinese food was grand opening in island. I've tasted tonight. It was really surprised me. The quality and taste was so great than other Chinese restaurant in Brooklyn.  I strongly recommend you guys coming and try. You won't be disappointed it."]

name: PARCEROS RESTAURANT
reviews:
['My food was Salchipapa and was so delicious, the service was very good, the waitress was very to attentive to see everything was and that was very kind. I really liked. I really recommend because the place is very beautiful as well.', "If you're looking for a new spot with great vibes and authentic flavors, I highly recommend trying out the new Colombian restaurant in Bay Ridge. The space is amazing, with a welcoming atmosphere that’s perfect for a casual meal or gathering. The backyard is so nice!

We only sampled two small things from the menu. “Sancocho” and my favorite passion fruit juice, but they were delicious and generously portioned. The staff was incredibly friendly, making the experience even better. As a Colombian with a multicultural family. We are excited to support this place around the area. Wishing them the best of luck—this is definitely a gem worth checking out!

We’ll be back!", 'It a new. Place.  With  a lovely  surroundings  an great. Worker  a must. Try. Restaurant', 'Awesome awesome awesome! Inviting, friendly, attentive staff. My partner an I initially ordered 3 appetizers and 1 entree to crave our hunger in fear that the portions would be small. But, behold by after the first appetizer we were beginning to feel full. A+ for portion size, presentation is on point, and food was jam packed with flavor. Not only was the food good, the bartender was an awesome mixologist. He was knowledgeable and his drinks were superior. Highly recommend this new restaurant, please don’t let this place flop!', 'Great friendly service, Oscar made great drinks. Super nice and easy going. Good time, good vibes, good food!']

name: MAGUEY RESTAURANT
reviews: ['Such a nice restaurant! Very clean and nice people. Food was delicious. Great location and very well kept considering other restaurants around.', "Amazing service. Friendly staff. Kind servers. Delicious horchata! One of the best tacos I've ever had. I'm Salvadoran but these tacos made feel like l'm half Mexican!! Will definitely come again!", 'Everything was fresh and made to order. Had a tamarind juice and it was one of the best ones I ever had. I personally don’t do reviews but the tamarind alone, needed its recognition. Food is good and the owner is so nice! She greeted me and my family and made sure everything was to our liking. I think they recently opened up for business. 1st time there and highly recommend them. Don’t skip on the tamarind!', 'The service was really nice and portions were big. Generous with the meat. I got guac, birria queso, lamb soup and lamb barbacoa tacos. Lamb soup was reallllly good.', 'I was short on time and needed a quick bite. I am on a strict diet. I explained to the lady what I can eat and she offered me the most delicious and huge chicken salad. The place has a clean bathroom and the seating area is clean. I appreciated the fact that the place to sit did not smell like food or any cleaning detergents marks or smells. The code was great as well. I could not finish the salad and asked it to go. I forgot to leave a tip so I will definitely come back again and support this business.']

name: PALMYRA RESTAURANT BROOKLYN
reviews: ['Great Central Asian cuisine. The food was great and the kebabs were amazing.', 'Made my birthday everything was in high level as food and atmosphere especially manager Rustam was taking care all small details', 'Professional and friendly team! There is service is very good and very delicious foods! Thank you very much!', 'It was a birthday party of our friend, the hall was  brightly-colored ,beautiful flowers,  professional service,  tasty dishes', 'This place is one of a kind with its amazing atmosphere and delicious cuisine a must go for those who seek something different and delicious. And the service is top notch with the waiters constantly checking on you making sure you have what you want.']

name: OLIVE GARDEN ITALIAN RESTAURANT
reviews:
['Update (September 2024)
Unfortunately, we just had two negative experiences with this branch. They seem to be severely understaffed. First we came on a random Tuesday night at 7 pm and the restaurant was pretty empty. Still, there were many people waiting outside. We asked for a table for 3 and they said the wait time was about 40 minutes. I questioned the many tables available and they said they decided to close half the restaurant. Because we couldn't wait that long with a hungry toddler, we asked if they took reservations. They said "Monday through Thursday only". Then we asked for a reservation for the next day (Wednesday) at 6 pm for 3. They said "oh, no, reservations only for big groups, Monday through Thursday". And I said I really wanted to have dinner there, what should I do. The host then said, "oh, just log into the app and pre-order a table". Just out of curiosity, I checked the app right there. And the app said there was no wait! \U0001fae0
But the host said if we had the app reservation, then we would get priority seating. So we did that the following Saturday. We went online, checked the queue, and it said "no to little wait, check in when you get there". We checked-in and got a text "you have a brief, few minute wait, we'll text you when your table is ready". We talked to the hostess and she said "it will be 5 minutes". I said "we are checked in" and she said "even so, 5 min". Then we waited 10 minutes and asked again. She said people who were there first had priority. I said "you should really update the app to let us know what the real wait is" and she said "I don't work with the app and it has nothing to do with me", with support from her supervisor. We were seated briefly after that, but frustrated and upset. The food is still good (I still recommend the chicken alfredo) and the cocktail was also good (7$ for a spiked strawberry lemonade). Our waitress, Chelsie, was great if a bit overworked dealing with taking orders, delivering the food, and preparing drinks. Overall, I'm disappointed and not planning on coming back in person.
Original post:
We had a great experience here. We visited on a Thursday night and it wasn't too busy. We didn't have to wait more than 3 minutes for a table. The server was kind and accommodating to our requests. We ordered the meatball appetizer and ate it with the famous (free) breadsticks that were delicious - warm and salty. Then we ordered the sirloin (about 20$) and the chicken fettuccine (about 20$). The entrées were amazing. (Note that we swapped the grilled chicken for the breaded chicken and loved it) The only thing that was not so tasty were the soups (complimentary when you order an entry). We had the minestrone and the chicken gnocchi and both were kind of bland. The sodas had free refill which is always appreciated. After all of this, we didn't have space for dessert but we were definitely tempted by the chocolate lasagna, the strawberry cake, and a decadent chocolate pie. A bonus was the take-home pasta (3 possible flavors) for 6 dollars.', "Went there for lunch. Loved the atmosphere. Restaurant was very clean. Our server Emily was very friendly, polite and extremely helpful. Restaurant's manger was also very friendly. He was greeting every customer and was going table to table introducing himself, also telling every customer that if they need any help, they can speak with him. Eggplant parmigiana was excellent. Excellent food and excellent customer service.", "This was truly a memorable experience my family was treated like family for that thank you. There was a wait but worth it. the food I Explain below in video there's also photos below. They where funny, friendly, caring. The young man was astonishing and made sure we felt welcome and had an amazing experience from start to finish. Thank you. Everyone that worked yesterday thank you to the chef your food truly tasted like love  in every bite it was like a sympathy it took me to a peaceful place keep growing I am proud of you all. this fine establishment for me and my family is a 10/10 we can not wait to come back soon. My children where very pleased this was a pleasant location. The bread, soup, and food I highly recommend.", 'A great place to take family and friends. (No matter what age) The staff are friendly and attentive, and the food is always amazing !! 10 stars skip 5 lol', 'Loved the food.  Shrimp Scampi and chicken parmigiana tasted so so good.  My favorite of all are the breadsticks and the salad we get as appetizers.']

name: MELANY RESTAURANT
reviews:
['The only thing that tastes good was the Tostones. The steak is a cheap piece of meat with so much fat on it.

We ordered an order of yellow rice and white rice, both portions of rice was hard as a rock.

There was a long black kinky curly hair in one of our steak platters.

They forgot to give us our Maduros when I first called to place my order the lady was so rude.

She put me on hold and forgot to come back to the phone.

I had to call back several times to get someone to answer the phone just to take my order.

The lady was rude, and said that she was very busy. She was also very impatient with me.

I had this order delivered to my house.

But, I will not order from this place again.
I am shocked that they serve such yucky food for a Dominican Restaurant.

What ever happened to people taking pride in their cooking and serving the public???
NYC has gone down the drain.', 'The food was delicious It was a shareable plate. If you are ordering a beverage I suggest the fresh squeezed OJ yummy', 'The prices are completely wrong. I clearly showed which I wanted to buy and everything that was ordered was charged way more. I showed her on the menu again which I bought and nothing was corrected. Would not recommend here unless you like places that lie about the prices.', 'Delicious rotisserie chicken chicken and rice and beans. Casual little neighborhood spot with a variety of foods to choose from.', "Food is ok at best sometimes.. little variety same choices . & not the best at it . Weekend they have a Corona crowd & some good music..awesome mural on the side of the building. Luv that part. But it's cool if u have a taste for some  Spanish food it will do .but not the best spot by far but they have what u need if u need it near by."]

name: 718 BISTRO
reviews:
['As always the food is just amazing.  Every time going there get to try something knew and it never disappoints.  There are still plenty more dishes to try.  This time the eel dish just made my day and was amazing.  Too bad were too full to try their new chocolate desert, but hopefully will save room for it next time', 'Delicious food, great menu, reasonable, excellent service!!!
Once again, me with family and friends had a dinner. As always, food was fresh and tasty, and we all truly enjoyed it. You can bring your own liquor, no cork charge.', 'Wow, Wow …. It’s been a long time since We’ve seen such level of service and food preparation. The freshest and absolutely delicious banquet menu. Our party left fuller than full and exceptionally happy. The service was to notch and so attentive. Thank you for making our celebration so perfect.', 'I went to this restaurant 2× I truly loved it.
The food is out of this world.
As a Brazilian woman I appreciate a good food I said this bistro is the best and is close to my house, for me is very convenient. When I get opportunity I will come back again.', 'Nice place 👌 Pretty friendly staff,  cozy atmosphere and tasty cuisine! We love this place.  Big choice and everything delicious.  Highly recommend!']

name: TIA ELI'S RESTAURANT
reviews: ['Loved their tacos and fajitas. The food tasted very authentic and the steak in the fajitas were well seasoned. We also tried the chips and guac and it was amazing. Overall I had a good experience with the food and service.', 'The food here was so delicious! It was the best veggie taco I’ve ever had! The chorizo tostado was also very good! The food tasted homemade and the ambiance was cozy. Everyone was super nice. They even had these fried chilies on the table that were so delicious! Be careful - they are very hot but so yummy. The woman behind the counter was so nice and gave me a small container of the chilis to go after I told her how much I enjoyed them. Not in my neighborhood but I’m def coming back!', "If you want a tasty chicken burrito with no chicken in it.This is the place for you!.. I bought a chicken burrito, started eating it and realized there was practically no chicken in it, then poured it out on the plate. There was barely a shot glass full of tiny little shredded pieces of chicken. I paid thirteen dollars for rice and a few beans. The burrito tasted fine. My problem is paying $13 and getting no chicken. I have no problem paying $13... I usually pay fifteen dollars, but I was at work and couldn't get to my usual spot. I don't mind paying fifteen dollars for a burrito that is full of chicken.", 'I tried this place out & it was okay. I had the tacos, rice and beans which was very good. And tacos dorado , I enjoyed those but the chicken was a bit on the dry side. Overall it was a good experience and I would go again.', 'Delicious food! Clean and very kind friendly staff. One woman told me they’re about to hit 7 month mark. Together my friend and I tried tacos of chorizo, steak and Al pastor. And then had two gorditas, we were stuffed. Very reasonably priced and they had a good pink drink similar to horchata with fruit at the bottom. Also have a bunch of fresh fruit to make juices by the order. Will definitely come again.']

name: ACHERRY RESTAURANT
reviews:
['The food here is absolutely delicious! Every dish we tried was bursting with flavor and cooked to perfection. Highly recommend the Steaks, From appetizers to desserts, this restaurant exceeded all our expectations! Our family especially enjoyed the appetizers, the variety of desserts! The cheesecake was a crowd-pleaser! Highly recommended', 'Went here for lunch because it was one of our coworkers birthday.Had a great time ,the place had a parking lot,out door seating as well.It was a site to see ,the inside was beautifully decorated,the bathroom was very beautiful and extremely clean also.We ordered one lobster tail and 3 chicken shiskebab dinners and drank beer,wine ,soda and coffee latte.The food was fantastic!We listen to some French music at the time which was very nice while eating,but they play all kinds of music.We met up with one of the owners and she was more than happy to talk to us and even took a picture with me.They can reserve the place for different events if you want ,or just visit like us and kick back with some friends and enjoy.We bought food to go as well .We are definitely going to be visiting here alot more with friends and family.Thanks for a great time❤️', 'This restaurant impresses with its exceptional food quality and the friendliness of its staff. The owner, who is often present, warmly welcomes guests and remembers regulars, adding a personal touch to the dining experience. As someone with a discerning palate, I can attest to the freshness and deliciousness of the produce and meats; they left me feeling great afterward.

For dessert lovers, the Künefe here is a standout. Though many places claim to make it well, this restaurant achieves perfection with its delightful crunch, taste, and sweetness. It’s worth visiting just for this dessert.yummmy

Im someone who isn’t usually fond of seafood, I found the grilled fish here to be exceptional and worth trying. The restaurant also offers a fantastic margarita that evokes a beachside ambiance, enhancing the overall experience.

The atmosphere is charming and aesthetically pleasing, complemented by ample parking in a busy area. Additionally, the venue features a private room, making it an excellent choice for small gatherings. Oops almost forgot they have a hooka area for those who want to come and enjoy some down time I’ll be going back for that', 'Went there on a heat-wave day for early lunch. Didn’t have A/C on yet indoor. So we sat outdoor. Good thing there was a breeze.
Would not be going back in the summer if they stay cheap about the A/C. There are plentiful Turkish restaurants in Brooklyn with A/C.
Mixed grill was very good, though the chicken was just a tad dry. The lamb adana and lamb chops were perfect. The seafood linguine was very good. However, The drinks were a bit artificial, and not made from fresh fruits.
Minus one star for the lack of A/C and the artificial drinks.', "I love the food here. I'm a huge fan of Mediterranean/Turkish food. The dimly lit decor there is beautiful. And I must say the service is awesome 👌. Our servers made sure that we were good. Me and my friends were here on Old Years Night and had a good time. I took my mom here for her birthday dinner. Trust me, she was pleasantly surprised. I'll always look forward to eating here again and again.😄😄"]

name: SURF CITY PIZZERIA
reviews:
['my gratitude for the wonderful dining experience I had at your restaurant recently. From the moment I walked in, I was greeted with warm and friendly service that made me feel right at home.

Not only was the food absolutely delicious, but meeting the owner was a special touch that truly added to the personal and welcoming atmosphere of your establishment. The Auntie tiramisu dessert was a delightful surprise and the perfect way to end a fantastic meal.', "The food is very tasty, abundant portions, the place is clean and quiet, the bell ringer is friendly and attentive. A highly recommended place. There are no complaints. I'll come back if I can", 'Surf City is the best restaurant after a half marathon!! It has been my 3rd year eating here after Brooklyn Half and it does not disappoint!

Location: It is located in Coney Island. Right in front of Cyclone. There a lot of seatings inside and outside!

Service: the staff were nice, they are very attentive and give us recommendations.

Food: The food is always good! 3 years I have been going here and everything was delicious.

PENNE ALA VODKA with SHRIMP: it is probably my favorite! The pasta is cooked al dente and the sauce was just delicious! They topped it with grilled shrimp and it was the perfect addition to the sauce!

MARGHERITA PIZZA: best type of pizza here for me! The crust is crispy and cooked properly. The sauce and mozzarella is delicious. 1 slice and I’m already full.

SPAGHETTI with MEATBALLS: very authentic! The meatballs is juicy and flavorful inside. The sauce is af course tomato base and tangy. The pasta again is cooked al dente!

Price rating: 6/10. To be honest the price is not bad for authentic Italian food.

I will definitely come back here to try other food!', "Very friendly staff. Prices were reasonable. I would recommend the buffalo chicken wrap and pizza. The Stromboli was more like a hot ham and cheese sandwich and I didn't love it, but it didn't taste bad. To each there own. I would recommend trying it.", "pepperoni xtra cheese pizza pie is very good. atmosphere is chill, outside dining is good too, it's hot but you still get a breeze. lots of room for my guest, kids and a stroller. nice place to enjoy a meal. would definitely go back. one suggestion, staff should be more aware of the outside guest because sometimes we go unnoticed out there. looking forward to my next visit"]

name: IL COLOSSEO RISTORANTE BROOKLYN | ITALIAN RESTAURANT
reviews: ["A1 service. Plates were cleared quickly and our glasses always filled. Food was very good also. The charcuterie board was OK, I've had better. The main dishes were very good and on par with prices. This place is definitely worth a visit if you're in the mood for Italian cuisine.", 'I had an absolutely great experience! From the moment we walked in, we were greeted with warm smiles and a cozy, inviting atmosphere. The service was great, with the staff being attentive and knowledgeable about the menu.\n\nThe food was delicious! Every dish we tried was bursting with authentic Italian flavors and beautifully presented. The pasta was perfectly cooked, and the sauces were rich and flavorful. The highlight for me was the tiramisu.', 'The food was pretty good. Enough so that I really wanted to go back after trying their marinara. Service had been really good until towards the end of the meal, our waiter started being short and rude. We asked to split the check and were refused before he just turned and walked away. We asked again upfront but were told it was too “late in the game”. I’ve never been anywhere that I had to tell them to split the check before eating. Other than the one rude waiter, the rest of the staff were delightful.', 'We had our small wedding here. I can’t believe the service, the food and the kindness of everyone. They are so  respectful caring and always made sure our glasses were full. The food was amazing like a true Italian mom in the  kitchen.  We will always have party’s here without any hesitation.', 'Excellent experience.  I have been here numerous times.  Never disappoints.  Tonight we had Sharon for our waitress.  She was awesome a complete pleasure for our dining experience. Xoxo.  Thank you']

name: CASA MARIAS RESTAURANT
reviews: ['Food is delicious and staff are very friendly and great.. Maria is a great server and David was also a great greeter and server thank you guys so much! I’m loving the food and drinks prices are great. We will be here very often! Keep up the good work🙏🏼', "Best Huarache I've ever had, and I eat a lot of Mexican food. The tortilla was a perfect mix of crunch with soft insides. The drinks were great made fresh with  fruit. Traveled 40 min and will definitely do it again", 'I’m in the area for work and found this place in walking distance from where I am staying. I had the chicken fajitas and the strawberry milkshake to go. The food was tasty, the portions were generous, and the prices were reasonable. The atmosphere is okay and the music was a bit loud, but my wait for the food wasn’t too long, considering everything was fresh. I’ll be back next time I’m in town.', "Ever since we heard about Maria's being open, we have enjoyed the food, both take-out and dine-in. The food is amazing and their drinks have been amazing! Especially the micheladas! If you guys get Maria as your server, you'll be in good hands.", 'Casa Maria’s a great family restaurant. Had tacos Al Pastor and Tacos de carne enchilada which the meat was so meaty and tender. My wife had the plate of Milanesa de pollo & she enjoyed every bite of it. We highly recommend this family restaurant, they make you feel like at home with a nice enjoyable warm and cooked meal. Also can’t forget about the bartender behind the bar ! Killed it with the drinks, frozen margaritas were on point might have had two or three of them ( don’t really remember 😇).']

name: TEURA ^ IL PONTE ITALIAN RESTAURANT
reviews:
["What a gem to have in Coney Island! The pastas are homemade and simply delicious. Service is fantastic. Waitstaff is attentive and super friendly. If you're willing to pay $15 for over oily fried fish and chips on the boardwalk, come here instead. The atmosphere is lovely, very calming and the food is DELICIOUS! The pasta entrees range between $17 - $24. Other entrees around $21, great salad selections, starters, kids menu, healthy side offerings, reasonable wine and beer prices, and pizza, too.", 'This was an excellent choice for my family. I love that they have round tables. I recommend the lobster ravioli, the Sophia Loren pizza, the linguini seafood. I’m glad the tomatoes are not pastey like some other places. I also enjoyed the panna cotta which used real vanilla bean. I will be back. My sister lives near here and also recommends the lemon chicken.', 'Well, what do you know...there actually is fine dining in Coney Island. Right to the point... this place is fantastic.  Google reviews have this as a $$$ restaurant, but it's really $$. Nothing on the menu is expensive (i.e. most pasta dishes are $20 or less, most entrees less than $30) and the portions are generous, but most importantly they are scrumptious. This place checks all the boxes since the service and atmosphere are a solid 10 out of 10. Really attentive service as our waiter and the owner came by more than once to ensure everything was ok. Speaking about the owner really nice guy and enjoyable to talk with.

Dropped in here on a whim because we were hungry and nothing else around it looked all that great. My wife after we ate said "that was a find". It certainly was. She had a mixed salad. Nice presentation, fresh greens and perfect portion size. She also ordered Polenta that was excellent. Portion was a little bit too much for her so I ate some of it too. Man, it was real good. My son and grandson wanted the BBQ pizza, which I also ate. Wasn't too sure about it since I had something else in mind, but decided to go with the flow. Glad I did. Didn't realize it was wood fired pizza despite it saying so on the menu. Wake up Jeff ( that's my real first name not my nom de plume of mimitaan...lol). Love wood fired pizza when it's done right. That's a major point. So many times it has a thick doughy crust or it's drenched with oil and who knows what else is wrong. Wood firing means nothing if it is not done right. At Teura^il Ponte it is done right. Nice thin crust and sublime taste. It was a large pie that I thought was too much to finish. I had two slices along with some Polenta from my wife's dish. There were quite a few slices left and thought no way my son and grandson could eat what was left of the pie. I was wrong. They polished it off because it was simply delicious.

So here's a real kicker. The grand finale and what a grand finale it was. We all shared a slice of cheese cake for dessert. It was very light and not heavy or super dense like a NY style cheese cake. It was somehow oddly familiar. My wife commented "this is just like your aunt used to make". Oh, aunt Josephina I miss you. She made everything from scratch and it was always beyond good. If you are thinking about dessert after your meal this would be a great choice. Spoke with the owner and he noted it was an Albanian recipe and pointed out it is all homemade. He was very proud of it and rightfully so. Terrific tasting. So glad we ate there.', 'A wonderful cozy place, a great evening! The staff is very attentive, the portions are large and the price is quite affordable, the food is delicious and a pleasant bonus is live music. The atmosphere is awesome, we will come again', 'A delight to find this lovely restaurant in amidst the noise, sugar and fast food of Coney Island. A perfect place to relax after a walk along the beach - in my case on a bright November day.

Delicious freshly baked bread, an excellent bowl of linguine vongole and a wonderfully fresh salad.

Top marks all round!']

name: BLUE CORN RESTAURANT
reviews:
["A hidden Gem. First time here. The service was amazing. The server was very sweet and attentive. The decor beautiful and the food delicious. I loved that when you get seated the server comes with water and freshly warmed chips and salsa. The Margaritas were also very good. They have fun games nights like bingo and family fued. I'm glad I discovered this place I will recommend to all my friends, family and will come to try all there dishes!", 'First time trying this place,  I decided to go something with not too heavy so I got the avocado toast, it came with two eggs, two bread toast and some salad, the salad was amazing…! Very seasoned as well as how I liked it! I wish there some butter on top of that would be less dry. But I love the plátanos ! It was amazing cook  as how crispy how I like it, and coming with the appetizer the tortillas chips dip with sauce was 10/10- the sauce was so good I thought it was spicy but it wasn’t. The service was amazing there the guy server were checking on us. And apologize for the inconvenience. The environment was pretty clean and calm I like the design of that place. I can’t wait to try something else definitely coming back again 😌😊', 'So I was so happy I got to experience this place being it’s right in the neighborhood and I never knew about it. The drinks were delicious and they were strong. The food was absolutely delicious. The service was so attentive. I will say a lot of Mexican restaurants in the neighborhood never bring you nachos and salsa anymore unless they charge you for it. Also, a lot of restaurants do not bring you ice water this restaurant did and for me that was a 10 out of 10 and it is very affordable for great service and delicious time.', 'Hidden gem?

I had low expectations.. this place was good. Chips and salsa were so good! The homemade hot sauces, chicken sandwich, enchiladas.. service was amazing as well!

Def will be back!', 'Came here with a couple of friends for dinner. We had a really pleasant experience. The staff are really friendly and warm. They have comfortable booths for seating.
At first I felt the price was a little higher than I was used to paying, but as soon as our meals were served, I understood why. The portions were huge! Also, the staff kept refilling our freshly fried tortilla chips.
Will be coming back to try their other dishes.']

name: BANANA BOAT RESTAURANT
reviews: ['The customer service was not the best. My total was $22 and change and I asked why it came out to that price since the buffet rate is $6 and change per pound and the cashier was being smart with me and answered my question with another question. "What did you get?" So because I had half of a salmon (which you\'re not supposed to cut the salmon in half but there was one already cut in half and that\'s the one that I picked) she charged me the full salmon rate which is $13 and change per pound. My plate was 1.6 lb, I got the lo mein which was tasty but greasy, rasta pasta, cabbage, one chunk of yam, two pieces of fried chicken was perfection and half a salmon which was salty. I think $22 is wild for a plate of pasta and veggies with three little pieces of protein, weighing your food for it\'s price and the rate is dependent on which protein you get feels like a scam.', 'The food is decent but the cost per pound is crazy 90 dollars for rice, chicken oh and crab legs beef stew for two people so many other options in the neighborhood at a better price. All of the food is shown below. It was still delicious.', 'FOOD IS AMAZING! I only wish we had the opportunity to weigh food as we go to budget well', 'Very inexpensive compared to other restaurants. They have everything a black brother needs', 'Banana boat has mouth watering food that has exquisite taste. The food will fill you up in 2 bites and leaving you wanting more. I’ve been buying food since they opened years ago and I’ll always stay true. The  employee service is good too they’re funny, sweet, and great individuals. Sher was a great cashier and stayed patient because we were having issues. I love the owner and his daughter as well so this is my spot.']

name: GOLDEN BLUE BAR & RESTAURANT INC
reviews:
["We chose this restaurant for a special occasion. We had a party of at least 30 and the food was exceptional from the salads, the appetizers to the main entrée. I recommend any and everything that they have to offer. My only complaint was that we only had one server for such a large party, and it was her FIRST day! It took hours for our main entrée to arrive, and we just ended up packing it to go. She was still very polite and tried her best. Poor planning on their part, but that won't stop me from returning because the food is just too good!", "I love this Haitian family owned hidden gem nestled in the heart of Flatbush, Brooklyn. The restaurant is spacious, clean, and has a huge bar. They also have co a private room for parties. I came here twice within a week.

Mini  Golden Delights
Coconut Shrimp
Shrimp  Tacos

Ra Ra Pasta
Stew Snapper w/ rice and beans And plantains

special cocktail made by the bartender
The golden delights are plantain cups that were stuffed with succulent fried pork. The plantains were fried to perfection. I haven't had plantains like that in forever. The shrimp tacos were mouthwatering they are pricey, but it is worth it and it comes with a lot of shrimp. Big pieces of shrimp. You can tell that is made with good quality shrimp. Also the sauce that comes with it is spicy crack.
The sauce that comes with the shrimp is spicy, but really good. The stellar item besides the tacos was the Ra Ra pasta. It is similar to Rasta pasta, but with a spicy cake it was so delicious and the shrimp was grilled to perfection. I enjoyed the snapper and it was huge. It does take a little while for the food to come out because it is made fresh and it’s worth the wait.

It is easily shareable and they do give big portions here the cocktails are good here and the staff are so friendly. They also have another room for private events.Friday night is Kompa Night. They give out shots and you can also learn how to dance.", 'My dish was good. Staff was friendly and owner is super cool. Often you go to a Haitian restaurant and the servers are sometimes ehh…here they are polite and friendly. We were there with out of town family the night before laying my grandmother to rest. So it was a nerve biting time but turned out to be a good time. **Disclaimer I do know the owner however if it wasn’t good trust I wouldn’t say anything on here. I take pride in my reviews. Check me on Yelp :) Happy dining.', "This is a must visit restaurant! We ended up here by chance and had the most memorable restaurant experience of our lives.

The food is absolutely amazing, that goes without saying. The thing about Golden Blue that sets it above the rest is the people that work there. The hospitality is unprecedented! The boss played our country's music and we all had a blast together! I've never felt so welcome at a restaurant and so sad leaving one. We will all be crossing the Verrazzano Bridge to make our way back to Brooklyn just to go eat at Golden Blue again.

If you're in the area or even if you aren't, you have to go eat and drink here! No bad options and a guaranteed amazing time.", 'Cozy spot with 5 star food.
We had the oxtail, jerk wings and shrimp salad. All tasty dishes. Even their side veggies were made with care.
Highly recommended spot to hang out with friends and have a tasty meal.']

name: NOTA BENE RESTAURANT
reviews: ['We came in late for dinner, first time experiencing any Georgian cuisine. Absolutely blown away by the flavors, textures, and timing of all the foods. Highly recommend any of the Khachapuri Staff was very friendly, and service was excellent. I’ll be coming back next time I’m in NYC for sure.', 'Food is actually disgusting had to spit it out. Ordered it from uber eats. Bread seemed barely cooked. Cheese was awful only good part was the pepperoni on the pizza. Dollar slices taste better than this.', 'A special gem within Brighton Beach. Ordered an assortment of Khachapuri, sausage, and kebab. You’ll be talking about it for months.', 'The best Khachipuri in Brooklyn hands down, handmade and packed with cheese it is a large portion for 1 person even a hungry one. Also they bake their own bread fresh daily from scratch, most restaurants do not do this and buy from a large bakery distributor.', 'Absolutely delicious! Clean and large space. Highly recommend the pkhali (vegetable spread) as an appetizer.']

name: GOLDEN KRUST CARIBBEAN RESTAURANT
reviews: ["I always come here for the SaltFish and Festival, but this morning, I wasted my money, and the customer service lacks customer service. This is not the islands. I sent out someone to go pick up my food, and I got Orka in my saltfish, and I don't eat orka and I felt like the plate was halfway full, and the plate was mainly Orka. I work in the food business as well, and I do management, so I tried to take out the Orka and not complain but today I  had a long day ahead of me and i wanted some good breakfast to full me up and it was pointless because it it was 80% Orka, 10% fish, 10% empty and i couldn't enjoy it. This is not my first time here, and I always and only buy saltfish from the store, nothing else.  The lightskin lady usually serves me, and she's usually nice, but today, a darker shade lady served me. I was disappointed.  I went back out in the freezing cold to see if they can exchange it with another chicken soup because I don't eat Orka and the plate wasn't presentable at all and when I got there and explained to lightskin lady like you know I always come and we never have an issue I don't want to be refunded because I support all my blacks and Caribbean store's , I just don't like to played about MY food.
