I didn't touch nothing in the bag so they can see what i was served and why im upset about it The lightskin lady didn't care enough that she just ignored me and started to talk to someone else instead of trying to fix the issue to make sure all parties is happy she just rolled her eyes saying I can't take it back ( all she had to do was give me a chicken soup that cost less than what I payed for the food  and she could of threw the food out or handed it to a homeless ) she never offered My cash back , she didn't care enough to hear me , she didn't solve the issue , she flat-out ignored me in my face and talked to someone else with an attitude  and her enegry and face wasn't as pleasing as the food.  I thought it was unprofessional and tasteless. Especially since i'm regular, this will be my last time spending any dollar in this franchise. You can keep the change. I was so disgusted that I handed my food to a homeless person. Waste of money, energy, & time. I'm officially done with this location.", 'Bought this breakfast from Golden Krust on Nostrand and Newkirk Ave. this morning for a Jamaican friend. The response... "Dis Nah \'Yardie Food,\' Dan! Fyah fi bun dat! 👎🏽👎🏽". I\'m rollin\'🤣\nAfter leaving this review, I saw the response which was eventually taken down and here\'s why. The person(s) words were a bit unnerving. But not enough to erase the aforementioned facts, so...', 'This location is very small. I ordered a breakfast (salt fish) seemed like it lost the salted flavor, I had to add.  Portions are decent,  staff is nice.', "A storm of people started to come in & I guess the girl started to rush & didn't close it properly & everything is soaked in oil because it wasn't closed properly. But the bigger issue is why is the salt fish so oily???", 'Never open at 8 despite advertised hours, forever running out of things that you know you should make extra of and more. We good lol I won’t step foot in another.']

name: CHINA DRAGON
reviews: ['Got a late night delivery. I\'ve visited almost every "typical" Chinese take out in the local neighborhood. Almost all are about the same. Some do things better than others, some miss the mark on a few things, so I pretty much know what to order. This was my first time trying this place, and I must say:  just expecting typical take out fare\n.. I was actually impressed! The delivery was right on time, even for how late it was, and the food was absolutely FRESH! The egg rolls were crispy and perfect filling to crust ratio. The dumplings were full, juicy, flavorful, and had a nice thin skin (often, some places are just thick dough and chewy). The moo goo gai pan looked bland and a bit boring, but man, was it a banger! So much flavor! not too salty, didn\'t cheat me on the protein, and a perfect portion size. Would love to try their other staples. Definitely trying again!', "The food here is SO GOOD.. first I got the wings and fried rice with egg roll... DELISH.  Then I got the chicken Lo Mein,  with egg roll... cause it's just so good! And that was divine... this time I got the general tso shrimp.. which honestly isn't wat it used to be anywhere u get it nowadays. But the flavors were still there! I'm still working my way thru the menu\n#ForkJab all thru this🤌🏾", 'Probably my favorite Chinese food spot thus far. Not a lot of places do pineapple chicken for one and not a lot of places do it right either but these guys got it. They’re also one of the few to still do Chinese donuts. Those aren’t always too easy to find either depending where you are in NYC. Their food is always fresh. Always filling. They even follow special instructions well if you order through Uber Eats or whatever. The value is great too because they’re not expensive while still tasting better than most Chinese food options available otherwise. They’re also pretty welcoming in store as well. Never rude, always helpful. I promise it’s worth every penny. Speaking of which, it’s cash only. I’m not sure if they’ve changed anything as it’s been a little while since last order but bring cash to be safe if you’re going there physically.', 'My new favorite local spot. They are cash only. The ingredient quality is great. Fresh vegetables, good quality meat. the won ton egg drop soup was perfect when I was sick. The fried rice, chicken wings and beef and broccoli is really good.  The staff is also very friendly and nice. They deliver through door dash, and have their own delivery men if you call the location directly.', 'My food was fresh and delicious. I had the General Tso Chicken $9.25. I would definitely go back. Cash only restaurant.']

name: HOME
reviews:
['I was nervous about ordering from here because of some of the previous reviews but I ordered them from Ubereats and it came on time and the food taste amazing', 'Food was burnt and refused to give me a refund or correct the issue. The food was inedible. I don’t understand how you could give a paying customer this and not think it’s your responsibility to correct the issue. DO NOT ORDER FROM THIS RESTAURANT!', "I believe that we have almost made our  way through half of the menu. The pasta is amazing had both the salmon and lobster and it was seasoned perfectly. We eat fried catfish every Friday and decided to try it from here. My husband got the fried catfish and shrimp. Again very good would like the option of adding an additional piece(s) since only one comes with meals. Decided to order the catfish and grits the next day. Loved the grits and the food traveled well. We have literally ordered from here almost daily for a week. Now to the wings, we prefer our wings crispy and seasoned well. They were both but we did have to put them in the crisper just to get a bit more crunch. The Cajun seasoning with the pepper sauce on the side is my preference. The food here has exceeded our expectations and we are looking forward to trying out the tacos tomorrow. The owners are extremely nice and want to develop relationships with the customers in the neighborhood. I'm looking forward to trying everything on the menu.", 'Shrimp and fish tacos had great flavor, but the shells were beyond hard and stale to the point the tacos were inedible - very disappointing over the quality they sent out to the customer. They should know better and have more respect for their customers money.
They felt the shells while they were making the tacos so obviously they didn’t care.
However, the fries & wings are awesome!', 'This place!

I’ve ordered in person and ordered through Seamless.

Never had a bad experience.

The food, always seasoned to its best. Always hot. Always fresh.

If you have a chance, stop in and meet the owners.

We love it here and we will back them up 100%!

And trust me, we are picky with food and complain about most restaurants and how they are afraid of seasonings.

& to the owners, keep up the great work and we will see you soon!

- Coast Guard Couple, Jay and Kristen. :)']

name: CARNATION RESTAURANT INC. 康乃馨
reviews: ['I have become a regular! My favorite to go food is their rice rolls. They make it fresh and tasty with side of soy sauce! If I dine in their roast pork and roast pig is so tasty! I also enjoy their rice dishes such as the eggplant salty fish! I recommend this restaurant if anyone wants to try good Chinese fresh food!', 'Had the beef Chow Fun and salted fish eggplant chicken over rice.  Tasty, generous portions and relatively cheap compared to other Cantonese restaurants on 86th st.  Their beef congee and beef rice rolls are also really good.  Congee texture on point, good amount of beef and seasoned just right.', 'Our go to place for beef or century egg congee. Wonderful steamed rice rolls, fresh and great texture. Roast pork and chicken are excellent.  Really like the staff.', 'Very good roast duck. The bbq pork is pretty good too. Came back for their siu yok, congee and rice rolls. All very very good.', "First time here and it's clean and airy space. Beef chow fun is very good and hot. Its low price compare to $16-$20 at other restaurants. Definitely will come back for other dishes and bbq meat."]

name: EL SUEÑITO RESTAURANT
reviews: ['This place is very decorative and authentic.  Service is absolutely great, the only downfall in my opinion is that the food is a bit bland.  Even adding toppings, and sauces, it’s just no flavor.  The portions are small too, and if you choose to switch from soft shell to hard they charge extra.', 'The nachos were so delicious that we finished them in less than 8 minutes. The main course was alright. My bf wasn’t a big fan. I had ordered pollo a la Mexicana and my bf ordered bistec a la mexicana. We both ended up getting bistec a la mexicana. I didn’t mind too much about the mishap since we were in a rush but I’m curious as to how the two would’ve differed in flavor. The flavor of the meat & beans were a bit underwhelming but overall experience was good.', 'The food was amazing, Tacos were good and the salsas were delicious,\nDefinitely coming back for more !', 'Great places, good food, nice  people!!', 'This is a great place in this area. The decor is really colorful and cozy. They serve one of the best nachos I’ve ever tried. We got different types of tacos and loved every one of them. The guacamole is made in house and fresh. Absolutely delicious food! Will be coming back for sure !']

name: JIMMY’S MEXICAN RESTAURANT
reviews:
['Sat for dinner in a Sunday. Low fuss, great food, and a great way to end a long week.
Pozole was amazing 10/10.', 'The service was satisfactory. The food was average and the prices not too bad.', 'Great Mexican restaurant and the food here is amazing! The people who own this restaurant are really nice and they always have different specials everyday but they are a cash only restaurant. They have several varieties of Mexican food but I recommend the costillas con arroz y frijoles. It is tasty and filling. They also have different desserts which my favorite is the churros! Me and my partner come here most of the time and they never disappoint with the portions. They are a great addition to the community as I don’t see many Mexican restaurants around here to sit, eat, and enjoy!', 'We came in here for a quick lunch and got the Sopes Con Cecina and they were delicious. We got our food pretty quickly. Would definitely come back.', 'Amazing tamales! Loved the tamales de chile rojo and tamales de mole!  Apparently the tamales are only available on weekends.

We also got the enchiladas de rojo con pollo, which was very good too. I only wish the cheese was melted when they served it.

Im excited to go back and try their other dishes 😋!']

name: VIS-A-VIS RESTAURANT
reviews:
['Wonderful! I have been to Brighton  Beach many times and never ate at this amazing restaurant. It has a peaceful front door and unless you are looking for this place it is easy to miss. A relative who has lived in the area for 40 years did not know about it.

This restaurant is French with heavy Russian influence. My friend, who is from Russia knew to order the Salo Borodinsky. If you go here it is a must order for everyone. The dish explodes in your mouth with flavor, spice and textures. It consists of pork which is fatty and smooth like butter while being white not red. It is served with fresh Russian rye bread, powerful mustard and fresh garlic. It is off the charts delicious and for me was the star.

We shared a Greek salad which was extremely good. I had borscht and for the main course the shrimp scampi. The shrimp was excellent with a tasty cream sauce and wild rice.

For dessert we had coffee and the napoleon. It was fairly sweet but very addicting. As someone who does not eat sugar couldn’t stop eating it. The flavors were so fun to swish around in my mouth.

I can’t wait to go back so I can try other items. The staff is kind, friendly and thoughtful. The atmosphere is very spacious, fun, elegant and relaxing. GO EAT HERE! It is expensive and worth it!', 'Vis a vis is a beautiful restaurant with elegant decoration. The food is amazing and they have a great selection of wines. A must try if u are arround Coney Island.', 'Authentic, a great French restaurant! We will be back again 🤗', "I've been performing in the live events industry for almost 25 years. There are few restaurants I would recommend that offer the entire package between great food, drinks, entertainment and atmosphere.

Vis-a-Vis is most definitely one of the better ones where you can enjoy a delectable dinner with dancing or host your private event. There are two rooms at this restaurant. One is a private room that can fit about 70-80 people and a small dance floor.

The main restaurant can probably fit a little more. They have a large screen video wall, TV screens and great music by a DJ.

The wait staff is attentive and make sure that your plates and glasses are full always.

You will have to valet your car unless you don't mind circling around a couple times for parking as it is Brighton Beach, Brooklyn. I'm positive you will enjoy your experience at Vis-a-vis as every dish is fantastic and the vibe is just right.", 'As a First time customer at the Vis-a-Vis Restaurant It was an  Incredible experience. Very friendly and professional staff. The food was excellent, amazing service. I’ll definitely return to this great restaurant.']

name: GOLDEN KRUST CARIBBEAN RESTAURANT
reviews: ["The food here is really good. The cooks here are very good. I've been to a Golden Krust in the city and the food SUCKED compared to this branch.\n\nIt's a little pricey but the cooks here really know what they're doing. Grab a Peanut Punch, Sea Moss or Sorrel while you're here.", 'Always out of jerk chicken on uber eats take it off your menu now they turn off there app claiming the store is too busy worst GOLDEN KRUST EVER ON THE MAP OF BROOKLYN', 'I ordered a Curry chicken Roti and I was very disappointed. This was my first time at this restaurant and my Roti was hard. I mean I couldn’t even bite through, the chicken was bland.', 'I love the oxtail. Getting it for my wife today for her birthday!', 'Firstly, the place is a mess. It looks dark and gloomy in there which really drives me away as a customer, not to mention, it stinks in there and flies are everywhere. The food itself didn’t feel authentic, it just felt like it’s been under the heat lamp forever then tossed in the microwave to warm up the meat inside. I don’t even know how this is still open, I really do love beef Patties but theirs are terrible. I hope it goes under new management soon.']

name: YUMMY
reviews:
['Food here is not bad for fast food, however the female cashier can be very rude and for no reason at all. God knows if that’s a cultural thing but it’s like she always mad!
Like hello ….
We are customers, just be nice!', "We've been ordering from here for years and it's always good. Today, they did not disappoint!
We ordered broccoli & beancurd lunch special and 4 wings w/ shrimp fr. rice.
1. Ordering went smoothly
2. Delivery was fast and courteous. He called when he was 1 minute away to lmk he was en route.
3. The broccoli and beancurd were super fresh! The wings nice and crispy, and the beverages ice cold.", 'They reheat old food and serve it. The food was sour, and not edible I nearly vomited. Unacceptable. You guys need to cook fresh food. This is not a soup kitchen people are paying for quality food', "I order shrimp fried rice with chicken wings every night and I don't even need the sauce.. Its sooo good all the time.", "I'm not sure if when I ordered my food I was hungry but the beef and broccoli was EXTREMELY GOOD. I ordered at the place and it was very clean and the man who took my order was friendly. If I'm in the area again I'll most definitely buy again from here."]

name: FAROS RESTAURANT
reviews: ['Small diner to get quick food. Service is great and prices are somewhat reasonable.\n\nWe got coffee, 2 egg platters- one with beef sausage and turkey sausage with eggs and toast and the other just eggs and grits and cheese and toast. This came out to $33 and we left 7 tip.', 'We sat outside to eat our breakfast which made this place nicer..however it was not as friendly or pleasant environment bc of how busy or little wait staff was available during our visit.  Food was just ok.  I would go back to again to see if there’s a difference.', 'This is my first time here and the food and service is great, the staff is friendly and the atmosphere is very welcoming. The only thing I can say is that the price for the portions your getting is a little too high but I would highly recommend the place for the overall experience', 'I stopped by Faros for the first time today since the start of COVID-19. The food and service is still great since the last time I have eaten here indoors. The place is small and cute and kept very clean. They have a pretty extensive menu and the prices are very reasonable. Coffee is great here too! Since I live nearby I really need to stop by more often to this great diner.', "Come pick it up? I order 12 pieces of turkey bacon well done burnt, along with other food spending $35. She also cofirmed I said well done burnt. Where's my cheese? COME PICK IT UP? Not the place to spend money. Thank you for selling my family food going in the trash. I'm still hungry"]

name: PUNJAB RESTAURANT
reviews: ['The best Afghan food in Brooklyn. I try many dishes and all are delicious. My favorite is Borani Banjan, the famous eggplant Afghan style. I highly recommend to visit and enjoy the international food, available in our neighborhood.', 'Service and food was excellent very friendly all around i recommend this place totally the best fried fish in New York', 'Food was fresh and very testy. But they had few empty barrels next to entrance. Which was making place look horrible. Small things can improve the looks . The tea was very average and might has been cooked hours ago.', 'I have always had a good experience with the food here. I have ordered takeout while at work and the service is always fast. I have enjoyed   their selection of naans.  Highly recommend', 'This is very bad restaurant no one go there and the food was very bad it was literally like bad  trust me it was not good we ordered something and they gave us the wrong thing it’s just so bad']

name: DUCK WONG
reviews:
['AFFORDABLE. So so so affordable, I got a curry based noodle (right) and it was only $12, the one on the left was a regular braised beef noodle for $10. The curry broth was so flavorful and my little brother had the one on the left and he finished it all, he even drank all the broth as well. We got 5 items in total and I believe the total came out to about $50-$60.

The only downside I would mention is that left one had more meat whereas the curry barely had any meat, just fat or collagen. Same goes for the fried chicken poppers, there was barely any meat, just the fried batter around it, it tasted more like oil than chicken.', 'I moved out of Brooklyn 8 years ago, and whenever I can go back I always miss the food in Duck Wong, the chef’s talent is beyond amazing and their staff is so attentive, not only you going to enjoy the comfort food here you definitely get treated with love 👌
Must try their curry pork chop or curry chicken on fry rice 😋
And  one of the side dish that I absolutely enjoy is the pickle, bitter melon squash. 凉拌苦瓜This is a dish that I won’t be able to make it at home and it’s so refreshing and crunchy and garlicky, maybe not on first date 😂 but is a must !', 'We’ve been coming here for years and it always hits the spot. My normal go-to dishes are the jaja meat sauce fried rice, sweet and sour chicken, or the goo lo pineapple pork. My bf always likes ordering the curry chicken fried rice. This spot is affordable, delicious, and quick. Highly recommend!', 'Food is average. Price is reasonable. Here is the most recent menu.', 'Great food, great service!
The wonton noodles soup tastes just like Hong Kong’s! Curry fish ball is good for me, but some people might think it’s not spicy enough. Fried chicken wing is crispy and juicy. Duck is flavorful, soft and tasty.']

name: PRIMAVERA RESTAURANT
reviews:
["So I'll start with the first time I went there. I asked the lady to try the pig feet. Cause I'd never had a pig feet before. And she looked at me like I was crazy and said no. She was a taller lady. I went back a couple weeks later and did the same thing with a shorter lady, and she graciously offered me a fork full of pigs feet which was absolutely delicious. I then ordered  the pulled pork with white rice and the pig feet juice over it, which, thanks to the feet juice, was very tasty.  My cousin got the beef stew and white rice, which he says was tender and seasoned properly... he devoured it just as fast as she brought out the heafty plates to our table. She was an absolute peach.  Great vibes great plates. Will be back to try more dishes ..  .. Sooo we went back again the next day.. judge not! This is definitely the type of restaurant food u can have several times a week.. my cousin got the beef stew again,  cause he's a creature of habit.. but he also said he had been thinking about it since we left the place.. I don't eat beef, but I have a carrot, and lemme just say I can see why it was on his mind so heavy.. DELISH.. this time I got the ribs.. tender and flavorful, I will say.. their hot sauce compliments the dishes so well and just adds the right amount of UMPH to the plate. And the lady today was just as sweet.. so they're on quite a roll!
#ForkJab all thru this 🤌🏾", 'Excellent establishment - don’t understand the negative reviews; there’s always people with personal/entitlement issues, which doesn’t reflect at all the attitude of the staff at this spot. Won’t be back.', "The food was ok, but prices were high.  At least compared to where I usually go in Bushwick. name: REGISTAN RESTAURANT
reviews:
['I ordered the Kazan kebab and was extremely disappointed. The packaging was poor, and the taste was equally unsatisfactory. The meat had an unpleasant odor, and the potatoes were undercooked and hard. The deep-frying was poorly done, and the overall flavor of the dish was terrible. I would not recommend this to anyone.', 'Always delicious😊 and I recommend must registrants salad', 'I recently had my first experience with Uzbek cuisine at Registan Restaurant, and it left a wonderful impression on me. The service was fast, the atmosphere felt cozy and welcoming, the salad was tasty, and the meat dishes were tender and full of flavor. Plus, the prices were fair. I wholeheartedly recommend this place without hesitation.', "New year eve dinner. 4 of us came from Jersey and 1 person from Staten Island. Nice decor and clean place. I liked the quite atmosphere (w/o blasting music disrupting) and TV display showcasing traditional ethic foods. Was surprised to be charged for bread, $2 a piece when its free at all other similar restaurants. Manti was OK. Samsa was OK. Kazan Kebab left much to be desired as it is usually a lot spicier. Steak came very late for 2 people when the rest of us were almost done with our food and was overly salty and very subpar. Mashed potatoes tasted strange. Shurpa was very subpar with a giant potato and beef in it was not tender but rather chewy. Lagman was OK as per my friends. Plov was overly oily, almost swimming in oil, not as much meat as the price. That excess inflamatory oil creates a stress response in the body. Komput atleast was not that bad. We were surprised on the slow service for stakes as there was only one more table filled at that time, so it was not that busy. Beware of 4% service charge if you pay by CC. name: TANOREEN
reviews: ['This was my first time here. The service was above and beyond without being overbearing. Our server asked if we were ready for our entrees after we were done with appetizers. We were never rushed. The atmosphere is low light and a relaxed vibe. And the food?? To. Die. For. Everything was fresh and tasted amazing. And the bonus…the leftovers reheated well the next day. I highly recommend.', 'I grew up on this food, and this place did not disappoint overall. The grape leaves (warak einab) was the standout dish for me, as it was cooked perfectly in a well-made broth. The lamb shank special was okay, it was a bit under seasoned and under salted but was coked perfectly. The complimentary pickles and bread was appreciated, especially the one with delicious za’atar. The service was incredible, I felt like the staff extended the authenticity of the palestinian culture beyond just the food, but also the hospitality.', 'Wow- the food blew me away. Everything was so flavorful and the portions were large. My personal favorite was the Musakhan, a large flatbread with caramelized onions, lemon, almond slivers, topped with juicy baked chicken. It’s earthy and sweet and bright, just a fantastic and well-balanced dish.\nOur server was so sweet and helpful with recommendations.\nI heard their knafeh is a must for dessert. I’ll definitely be back to try it.', 'I can confidently take my mother here for truly authentic Palestinian dishes. The delicate spices and preparation remind us of my grandmother’s dishes. That says it all.', 'Nice atmosphere, excellent service. The menu is interesting and authentic, and great cocktails. The food was delicious and full of flavor.']

name: SAN REMO PIZZERIA & RESTAURANT
reviews:
['Have you eaten at San Remo Pizzeria Restaurant established in 1976 in Brooklyn, New York? It was a busy little place! My first pitstop after arriving in New York. Classic New York style… And I enjoyed watching the Bizzy pizzeria do their thing.
Went from Maryland to New York, about 181 mile to pick up my wife. I stayed at an Airbnb in Brooklyn. So after unpacking I walked around a bit and my first meal I had was at a local pizza joint, SAN REMO Pizzeria & Restaurant. I just looked around, watched people coming in and ordering! It was NY! It had that Atmosphere, attitude, the pizza joint hustle. Pizzas looked great! They had a good selection. And they were 21 inch pies! They were whipping out pizzas, the guy at the register was singing and humming a tune. No music playing. But everyone had there roll. I got a few different slices. I was hoping to come back again, time flew by. Was it worth it? Yesss! Definitely! I went to a few other pizza joints around but they didn’t have the spunk, attitude, atmosphere, and quality this joint had!

#newyorkpizza #brooklynnewyork #pizzeria
#nystylepizza', 'The pizza is good. The vibe is of the neighborhood and it shows in who comes in and buys pizza. Although the owner is loud and expressive, he is a man whose heart is in the right place. Try their chicken and sausage roles excellent. Their vegetable slice is very good. I have revisited and feel my first review wasn’t accurate. San Remo’s is a home away from home, with an attentive and kind staff. Oh and the Sicilian slice excellent!', 'Terrible experience. The owner had an attitude. It’s very small & dingy in the establishment. I bought 1 pepperoni slice for $4.68 which was ridiculous. Especially when it tasted like it’d been out for hours and just put it in the oven. It’s not worth the price. I wouldn’t recommend.', "I ordered from San Remo's for the first time last week.  Their food is amazing, so fresh. I had a white pie which was the best I've had in a while, garlic knots which were so soft and perfectly garlicky and a cannoli that was delicious. I will be ordering again.", "Tried their pizzas for the 1st time tonight. Got 2 cheese squares, a margarita square and a pepperoni slice.The margarita slice was my favorite. Try them out. They're great and so is the staff."]

name: LITTLE ISTANBUL RESTAURANT
reviews:
['Due to a change of routes, my friend and I ended up coming to Little Istanbul Restaurant. Despite its small size the atmosphere, customer service, and taste of food left a great impact.

Over the phone and in person customer service was excellent. Waiters and managers greeted us as we entered the store. When we asked for recommendations they kindly guided as needed.

Food delivery took an appropriate amount of time and were proportioned well for the amount spent. Each dish was well cooked, fresh, and had no bad after taste.

While eating, we were amazed at the decor of the restaurant.

This is one of my new go tos for Turkish food.', 'Oh, let me tell you about Little Istanbul in Brooklyn – it's like stepping into a Turkish delight factory, but with more kebabs and fewer calories! 🍢✨

First things first, the **Adana Kebab** here is the stuff of legends. Imagine a skewer of perfectly spiced, juicy meat that makes your taste buds do a happy dance. It's like a flavor explosion in your mouth, and trust me, you'll be dreaming about it for days.

But don't just stop at the kebabs! Kick off your culinary adventure with some fresh-cooked falafel or a mixed appetizer platter. It's like a party on your plate, and everyone's invited. The falafel is crispy on the outside, tender on the inside, and the mixed appetizers are a delightful medley of flavors that will have you saying "yum" with every bite.

Next up, dive into the kebab platters. These are not just meals; they're experiences. Each platter is a masterpiece, with succulent meats and perfectly grilled veggies that will make you wonder why you ever ate anything else.

And then there's the **Lahmacun** – think of it as a Turkish pizza, but way cooler. It's a thin-crusted, oven-baked delight topped with savory minced meat and spices. One bite, and you'll be hooked.

Feeling adventurous? Order the lamb gyro with special aromatic rice. The lamb is tender and flavorful, and the rice is so aromatic, you'll want to bottle the scent and wear it as perfume.

Now, for the grand finale: the hot and cheesy **Kunafe**. This dessert is like a warm hug from the inside out. It's gooey, cheesy, and sweet – the perfect ending to a perfect meal. Pair it with a cup of famous Turkish tea, and you'll be in dessert heaven.

And let's not forget the service! The staff at Little Istanbul are so warm and welcoming, you'll feel like you're dining with family. They're attentive, friendly, and always ready with a smile or a joke.

Best of all, the prices are so reasonable, you'll feel like you got away with a steal. So, if you're in Brooklyn and craving some authentic Turkish cuisine, head over to Little Istanbul. Your taste buds will thank you, and you might just leave with a new favorite restaurant. 🥙❤️

Afiyet olsun! (That's Turkish for "enjoy your meal!")', 'As a Turkish person living in New York, finding authentic Turkish food can be tough, but Little Istanbul in Brooklyn is a rare gem. The cozy, authentic decor and friendly staff made us feel at home right away.

We enjoyed the mixed kebab and Adana platters, both grilled to perfection. The baklava for dessert, paired with complimentary Turkish tea, was a delightful touch.

Though it’s a bit far from where I live, I’ll definitely be coming back and highly recommend it to anyone looking for real Turkish flavors.', "Food was delicious. Cannot recommend this place enough. The atmosphere was like I was literally in Turkey: people around me speaking Turkish, the tea was strong and flavorful (didn't have to ask for refills, staff was on point) and the decor including a chandelier from the byzantine empire was cool.  The lamb kebab was A1. I could have eaten 3 of these plates.  A but pricy but I didn't make it in time for the lunch special. I'll definitely be back again!", 'Excellent and authentic Turkish/Mediterranean food! You would not be disappointed. The food, ambience, and even the Customer Service aspect are tens across-the-board. All the employees are Turkish and they all seem very courteous, welcoming, hospitable, and considerate although their English isn’t 100%, their Prowess when it comes to providing excellent Turkish food and customer accommodation is top-notch! Prices are very reasonable too!']

The woman working was sweet. There’s a little seating too but I took it to go!

It’s a true Jamaican restaurant with legit Jamaican food! No complaints here', 'BEST goat curry in the world. Goat meat is soft and tender like nothing you will ever experience. Not overly oily. Very good with coleslaw!! 1000% will return', 'One of my favorite Jamaican restaurants in NYC!

A few of my favorite things:

- the curry goat meal, some of the BEST goat dinners that I’ve had from a restaurant, this the go to dinner for my mother and I

- the porridge is just the right amount of sweet and thickness and really all the breakfast items are a hit

- the shrimp meal is one of my favorites

name: YEMEN CAFÉ & RESTAURANT
reviews:
['It was my first time trying Yemeni cuisine, and I believe I chose the right place!

We sampled several dishes, and I especially enjoyed the charcoal-grilled chicken—it was perfectly cooked with great flavor. The rice was also very tasty, and I loved the vegetables on top paired with the accompanying sauce. The hummus, bread, and chickpea dish were also fantastic. The tea provided a nice finish to the meal. I highly recommend giving this place a try if you’re in the area.', 'The restaurant is located in the Bay Ridge section of Brooklyn.  They have an additional location at 176 Atlantic Avenue which is located in downtown Brooklyn. They serve food from the country of Yemen.  Yemen is a small country in the Middle East.  The food is similar to Mediterranean cuisine.   I ordered the chicken glaba which consisted of minced chicken, root vegetables sauteed with rice.  It was accompanied with a large bread similar to a pita bread with a small side salad and a small cup of marag soup.  The soup a lamb broth with minced onions and mixed Yemeni spices.  Very generous portion and food was tasty.  Friendly and helpful staff.', 'This place was recommended to me by my friend who is native to Egypt.

When he first brought me here, I felt like I was family.

There are no restaurants I can compare this place to.

You can only find a place like this outside of America.

If you are looking for the most authentic and real food experience for Hala and other types of dishes.

This is the place you have to go.', 'No one can make meat as good as Yemenis MashAllah 👏🏼 10/10 would recommend the lamb haneeth. They also give complimentary salad and soup !', 'I certainly enjoy this place. It’s very fast paced, but they don’t shove you out the door! It’s convenient for large groups or just 1 person. The place may be busy but they keep their eye on you for good service! Any time Ive gone, they’re very pleasant and their food always delicious.
I have gone many times and also ordered delivery. Highly recommended!']

name: LA VILLA PIZZERIA
reviews:
['Most amazing parmigiana and very friendly staff! This was more than lunch stop for me. I travelled from Utah to stop by this location as this was the exact location of my grandfather’s pizzeria in the 60’s (different restaurant).  I wanted to sit, have lunch, and soak in the views & vibes as corny as that sounds. Turns out, the food & atmosphere here was great. I met Frank the owner who was super friendly, and waitress Sydney who was on-top of her game in the middle of the lunch-rush.  The chicken parmigiana and Arancini (rice balls) were delicious! Most certainly enjoyed my lunch experience and will be back when in NY in the future!', 'Bugs in Food and Manager lady yells at us.

We’ve been loyal customers of La Villa for a while, but after our latest experience, we won’t be returning. My wife ordered for delivery a grandma pie, a large Caesar salad, and a small one. Total? $60. Unfortunately, upon opening the large salad, she found a bug right on top. She was disgusted and lost her appetite immediately.

I called the manager to inform her of the situation, hoping they’d take responsibility and issue a full refund. Instead, she insisted that bugs can occasionally "make it through" in lettuce and would only refund the salad. I explained that finding a bug in our food was not acceptable, especially for the price we paid, and requested a full refund since the experience was thoroughly ruined.

To my shock, the manager argued that there was “no reason” to refund the pizza because the sauce is acidic and a bug "wouldn't survive in it." She even went as far as to accuse me of trying to "scam" them out of the $60! When I asked to speak with the owner, Frank, she refused and claimed he would agree with her stance. Throughout the call, she was rude, confrontational, and dismissive of our concerns.

If you’re thinking of ordering from La Villa, beware. The management seems to have lost both quality control and respect for their customers. I expected at least an apology or an offer to make things right, but instead was met with hostility. It’s a shame to see a once-great spot lose its standards. I’d suggest supporting businesses that actually value their customers.', 'Wonderful service & super attentive waiter (thank you Nikita!) Great food and very generous portions!!!! 🥰 We will definitely be back!!! 💖', 'Our server Nikita was amazing, so attentive, sweet, helpful, and provided such great service. I came here for dinner with a party of 7 for my birthday and had a wonderful time. I ordered the alla vodka with rigatoni and my group shared two large wood fired pizzas (one speciale, one vegetale). These are definitely must haves! This is my first time at this location but I have been to two other La Villa locations. I always have a good time at La Villa and I get great service and great food every time!', 'My husband and I were busy all day yesterday and truly wanted A moment to regroup and relax I told my husband let’s get some pizza and wine and he loved the idea. I knew I wanted to sit down and have quality pizza and wine. I didn’t want the food chains. I wanted a truly family sit down place. With quality food. I went on Google to look for a nice spot and I wasn’t having the best of luck finding, after swapping out a few words and just using keywords of Italian restaurants near me I landed here. The pictures alone and the wonderful reviews were all I needed to see. Experiencing the restaurant was even better. I loved how busy the restaurant was and how families were together having a good time. We had a very kind waiter. He was a Hispanic man very sweet. We ordered the fried mozzarella, some white wine and the Especiale pizza. Our first slices were placed on our plates by our fabulous waiter and the beauty in that slice of pizza was unbelievable. There was so many toppings. I told my husband I’m gonna need a fork and knife lol that first bite of the heavenly fennel, sausage and peppers and mushroom was truly mind blowing. This was the best pizza I’ve ever had. I’m literally talking about this the next morning of having this pizza we asked for some ricotta on it and it was just divine. I can’t wait to come back. me and my husband felt so good after visiting. It was just what we needed after a busy day. Oh yess that onion bread was delicious!!!!']
