name: LOTUS ASIAN FUSION RESTAURANT
reviews: ['The restaurant is located in the Marine Park section of Brooklyn near the Kings Plaza shopping mall.  They prepare Chinese cuisine and is basically a takeout with several tables for dining in.  I ordered the shrimp/pork wonton soup.  The wontons are small and the soup broth consists of cabbage instead of the usual bok choy.  The egg rolls and dumplings were good.  The shrimp and lobster sauce consisted of a nice thick egg-based sauce with small shrimps.  Peas and carrots were in the sauce.  The pan-fried noodles with chicken were separated.  The pan-fried noodles were fresh and crunchy.  The staff is very friendly and helpful.', 'The pad see ew had a nice chewy noodle texture with a balanced sweet soy sauce mixture along with the pad Thai which had an extra crunchy peanut topping. The crispy beef had a delightful crispy outside while maintaining its soft inside.', 'One of the newly opened Asian restaurants in the neighborhood and very tasty, authentic and fresh👍🏻service is super, friendly and go above beyond to meet my specific food requests!', 'The staff was very friendly, service was quick too. The place had a welcoming atmosphere and very clean. The food was delicious, I would recommend all the dishes I had: sesame chicken, fried rice with a side of beef and broccoli, and steak hibachi. I will definitely come back for more!', 'This is a new Chinese / sushi  restaurant in the neighborhood. I had take out but the restaurant looked clean and spacious. They had really generous portions and the food was fresh. Definitely give this place a chance.']

name: TAILAI KITCHEN
reviews: ["One of the best Chinese food in town. Please  have a look at the menu and price. It is a very quick bit. It will even deliver to your home or work place for free. You may have complain about the food quality. Off course, it wouldn't be like a candlelight restaurant food. However, don't forget the price and time. Again, please have a close look at manufacturer and price.", 'called to get a delivery and when i was on the phone with the lady i said “can i get chicken and broccoli with no garlic sauce” (cause where i’m from they put garlic sauce on it and the regular browning sauce) she said “no” i said “yeah no garlic sauce “. so when it get here and i open it i see this..', 'Came here for the first time to try the Lo Mein and let me just say 0/5 no flavor at all, it was not what I expected. Definitely they need to improve on the cooking here.', 'Horrible service the lady taking my order she was very loud and screaming on  the phone and was ignoring me and taking orders while I was telling her mines I asked for 2 white rice shrimp broccoli when i got the food it came with everything but shrimp and they still charged me full price 🙄🖕', 'Refuse to place. My order because I told her I needed them to bring it to my door because am a heart patient said she don’t want no problems and hung up on me very unprofessional']

name: DYNASTY CHINESE RESTAURANT - BROOKLYN
reviews:
['Dumplings (steamed) are my go to choice as it is made in the style I am accustomed.  Traditional Chinese style of thin wrappers filled with ground pork, to dip in a spicy vinegar soy sauce mixture to dip in. Cannot tell if it’s handmade. Irregardless, it doesn’t matter as it pleases my palate.

Other items on the menu are fine, and quite acceptable for a quick meal. Ingredients are fresh and cooked with care. The sauces are light enough to enjoy natural flavors, though it feels like they use a diluted version of usual hood Chinese sauces that have a sweet and tangy flavor and a generous amount of cornstarch in thickened sauces.

Besides dumplings, I would likely order chicken and cashew next as it reminds me of kung pao chicken the way I am accustomed to. I hope they include more traditional Chinese food items over time to stand out even more from nearby Chinese takeout spots.

Delivery service is more than satisfactory, as it arrives quickly. I have not yet ordered at a peak time, however, whenever I have made an order they are efficient and food is spanking hot, so that’s how you know it’s coming from right off the stove. It’s nice that they include fortune cookies.', 'It’s an awesome place definitely the best Chinese place in the area. Highly pricey though, and well as others have said the delivery service isn’t flawless. From the moment you order it’s some hassle lol That’s their one flaw because the food is excellent. I’d recommend going in person, and doing pick-up that’s much more easier plus solves all the problems with delivery.', 'Clean. Great customer service. Foods are fresh
Accessible by the B14, B13 and Q8. Open to 9pm Monday to Saturday.  Closes at 7pm on Sunday.', 'I am delighted to share my exceptional experience at Dynasty Chinese Restaurant. From the moment I stepped in, the atmosphere was inviting and warm. The staff was incredibly attentive, ensuring that every need was promptly met with a smile. The food was beyond delicious, boasting authentic flavors and impeccable presentation. Each dish was a delightful journey through Chinese cuisine. Without hesitation, I highly recommend Dynasty Chinese Restaurant for anyone craving top-notch service and delectable food. Five stars well-deserved!', 'The food is good but I spent $58.00 and when I asked for my free soda. They told me no because I didn’t pay in cash I paid with my card. I’m verryyy upset I have been going here for years more than 10 years but they lost a costumer']

name: A MIX 47
reviews:
['Their food is fresh and tasty. I also like how affordable everything is! The gyoza is great and their lunch special is definitely worth it!', 'Shrimp with broccoli was ready in 5 minutes. They were generous with the shrimp, it had more shrimp than most places I’ve ever been as well as one of the tastiest shrimp with broccoli I’ve ever had. The staff was very friendly and sweet.
If I lived in the area I would be ordering breakfast, lunch, and dinner from them everyday', 'I had a lunch delivered from A Mix 47. Sashimi and the Kani salad.

The portions were so small that I was left hungry after having it.  (the pics make it appears better then it actually was.  You may see how thin the yellow tail sashimi is).

I don’t think I will order again. For $20 lunch I at least expect to be full. 🤷‍♂️', 'Not sure what was going on with the food, but I bought some chicken and broccoli and it has a strange taste, and after taste, there was also a type of sweetness associated with those strange "tastes".  Spoke to a friend and we think it was too much msg, or at least that's what I told myself, so I could let go of the idea of not knowing what I ingested.  Needless to say I won't be going back.  Not only was the taste off, but the chicken and broccoli was SOOO soft and drowning in the strange tasting white sauce.

Food was quite cheap for the dish and area, so that didn't help my mind.', 'Dry fresh and tasty food!! Always order from here.']

name: CHINA RESTAURANT
reviews: ['Listen, I don’t care what you see any other review say about the notorious “Snyder Wings,” all you need to know is that they’re it. They’ve been it. And there’s a reason why no one calls this spot by its actual name. I will say the wings are the only thing I’ve tried because they’re that good and I never feel the need to stray. Maybe one of these days I’ll try something else.\n\nThe first time I had these wings I was in high school, at my friends birthday party. Thank God for her because had I not shown up, I would’ve never found out about them. I grew up in a completely different part of Brooklyn. I’m 27 years old now and they’re still just as amazing as the first time. My friends family still gets wings catered for every special occasion too. This is a spot that you either grew up on or got put on to. I hope they never change and wish them much continued success.', "I don't know what's the hype for this soy fried wings,  they are ok.. will be better if they follow introductions as crispy  wings.", "Famous for their Chicken Wings, they don't sell 1/2 a chicken, Wings are pretty good but a little salty for my liking.", "Be careful when buying things here, the food is average, the food is not fresh, it's like robbing money, it's outrageous", 'Very racist , they are rude and scream very loudly while taking orders. The place was very unwelcoming. The staff has a large counter separating them from customers in result they slide your food to you and take your money with a grabber on a long stick.']

name: EAST GARDEN
reviews:
["Small shrimp fried rice  and 6 chicken wings... 18.50 ripped off
Thought that this would be something fulfilling but definitely wrong.

Shrimp Fried rice is just fried rice and bean sprouts and onion with shrimp. Okay flavor like a 6/10

The wings they are pretty good 8/10
Was told a small SFR is 7$ and 6 chicken wings is 11.50
But a plain 4pc is 6.25..

I'll take the loss to show people the truth. Business might be slow, but don't take advantage of those who support you.
Truthfully, yall lost a long-time customer, I'm been coming here for 10 years, I guess it stops now. 👋🏿", 'Best tasting Chinese food I've ever had. But they rob you on the food. I paid $22 for a large dish of mongolian beef. $2 extra beef, $2 extra broccoli. I counted about 5 - 6 pieces of beef and the rest was all onion. I understand the beef is expensive, and I'm ok with paying for more. But I'm not ok with paying for more and not receiving what I paid for. Look at this picture and tell me if you think it's worth $22.

When I called about this, they were very defensive and shifted the blame to me. I was given very nasty service and attitude, with no real  resolution other than "next time you ask no onion".', "Hi! So I'll be honest, I had just moved to New York and the first place we went to did us so dirty. So when I saw East Garden I was very hesitant on going in but eventually decided to take a chance at fate, little did I know how much their General Tao's chicken with shrimp lo mein would change my life for the better.

See I can't handle too-too much spice, so I was reluctant to get it but the aroma brought back memories of my grandparents eating the General Tao's chicken from back home and got it anyway.

Once I saw it, I noticed it had just the right amount of sticky sauce, it was churchy but soft too (Which I loved) and from the moment I tasted it, I was immediately reminded of the times I had with my grandparents. Since I recently lost my grandmother, this moment made me burst into tears (Happy ones of course) when I had gotten home. It wasn't too spicy and had a tint of sweetness, an paired with the Shrimp Lo Mein turned out to be the right choice, The dish was very very Delicious. I do recommend this fine restaurant with all my heart, I hope you visit and enjoy these wonderful dishes.", 'The food is so good!  The cooking has really brought out all many flavors.East garden have really good meal, and it’s also my favorite Chinese restaurant.I order food there almost everyday!', "Found roach in food. The owner refused  refund, didn't even offer to remake the dish. I was willing to show food with the roach. The other food stunk of rancid oil. Eat here at your own risk. Plenty of better takeouts only blocks away."]

name: BAMBOO WALK CARIBBEAN RESTAURANT
reviews:
['I recently had the pleasure of visiting bamboo walk for an amazing celebratory brunch. This restaurant is a beautiful, the ambiance is romantic and inviting. The customer service is top notch we had several servers that remained attentive to our large group. I really enjoyed the music selection and everything about the setting. The food and drinks were spectacular like literally mouth watering dishes everything I tasted was so good, I want more. There were a few things that I found very unique and delicious such as the shrimp, the bamboo salt fish  roll was a surprise, and the bamboo special ginger cocktail. Thank you Bamboo Walk for such a special experience from food and impeccable service, Cant wait to return!', "Top of the line service upon entering the door. Everyone was professionally friendly, the atmosphere was really really great, and the food was amazing. This place shouts 'MUST GO'. For a first time visit, it exceeded our expectations and we'll surely be going back. Tieka was our waitress and she made the vibe a whole lot better with her excellent customer service, warm smile and good energy. Kudos to the staff working that night(10/8/2024)", 'Finally, an upscale Caribbean restaurant with exceptional food and amazing service! For the grown folk who would like a Caribbean dining experience in a beautiful setting without loud club music, check out Bamboo Walk. The ambiance is modern and upscale with Tropical accents. The cocktails and the food are top notch and is only matched by the warm service. One of my favorite aspects was the three televisions that featured the restaurant and its community and team building activities and events. The images portray us as Caribbean people in a positive light. The restaurant has a dress code. They offer valet parking and reservations are required.
Cheers!🥂', 'Brought my whole family from California and we had to try the Sunday brunch. I had the Ackee and Saltfish and I must say it was spot on. Food was served hot and Everything was cooked to perfection. The manager Jermaine made sure we had a great experience. I will definitely comeback and they the various delicious dishes on the menu.', 'This was hands down the best Caribbean restaurant I have ever been to. I went there to celebrate my graduation.

When you first enter, you are greeted by the staff who are super welcoming and kind. They are respectful and very accommodating.

The ambiance of the place is really beautiful and the food…the food is just amazing. Everything we had tasted amazing. My mom got the escovitch fish which was humongous and tasty. My grandma and boyfriend had the oxtail which was also amazing. My younger sister had the jerk chicken with festival and she loved it. And I had the pineapple chicken which was well cooked and delicious. We all shared a mac and cheese and I must say, this is the first Jamaican Caribbean restaurant I have been to that makes mac and cheese good. The food did sell off❗️❗️

Our waiters name was Jackson, we called him 6-star Jackson, that’s how amazing our experience once.

Like I mentioned earlier, I was celebrating my graduation. They surprised me with a cake, free of charge, with sparks and played a celebration song for me. This was such a kind gesture.']

name: ISLAND GRILL CAFE
reviews:
['One Friday
Me and my fiance was looking for A "Bar"  that we could call our own.
Several bars did not make the cut . The bartender "Misha" on that shift won us over. She made the perfect "Screwdriver" for my fiance and the comfortability and hospitality was awesome. there always make us feel comfortable.  Along with the existing everyday customers, they also make you feel welcome. Kind of give you that family feeling. The seafood soup was once Elite, but now it seems they take the cheap way out and it's more yucca than seafood but the rest of the food is awesome.
I gotta have my Ox Tails with Pasta and one Friday  became every Friday.
Facts!', "This neighborhood rum bar is the best hidden gem in a undeserved community. It promises welcoming environment, tasty traditional Caribbean food and indoor and outdoor dining. The rum punches are strong the beers are ice cold and the food is prepared fresh. I'll always come back here no matter the day no matter the time it's always the right time to visit and stop by to say hi", 'I’m jamaican & a chef so when I tell you it’s a nice vibe it’s a nice vibe! The food is delicious especially the jerk - how they get so smoky and juicy is impressive when there’s no “jerk pan” in sight. The music is fantastic and its a nice respectful mixed crowd after midnight . Dj Friday & Saturday night is definitely fun! And the Bartenders are cordial and happy to serve u up some Carribean hospitality- no attitude ! You can go casual or bring your hotness fashion if u like ! Glad it’s local & worth it.', 'Food SUCKS, dj Fridays and Saturdays night SUCKS and the security SUCKS this place is not a club and they collect every weekend nights and putting up a war with person for the $10 they charging, they loose  because who would come and spend already pay that $10 which they coukd had to their liquor and buy more.', "It was great, I've been here a couple times,  but beware if your surroundings , left my bag to go purchase a drink, however someone went into bag and took one of my credit cards.  Just careful,  females pretend to talk to you and distract you."]

name: BKLN DINER
reviews: ["I want to write a review about this place from two sides. From my work side - I work as a food delivery person and from the side of the client of this establishment. From the courier: this is a really cool place! Very kind, intelligent attitude towards me as a courier. They cook quickly, if I'm standing outside, they can bring out the customer's order. In general, a deep bow and respect to the administration and employees of this place! Thank you very much for this! This is rare! From the client: this evening my wife and I were in this place. We were delighted! Excellent work of the staff! It was very pleasant to communicate! The food is very tasty and the portions are huge. Take care of yourself. Success, development and prosperity to your business! We will definitely come back to you again.", "The AC was on today and I'm not sure why. However it is a nice place, our waitress was a bit slow maybe bcuz it's a busier day than usual, but she was very pleasant. Scrambled eggs are the easiest thing to make and they were absolutely horrible, I had to disect my bacon because even tho I asked for it to be very well done and crispy and I got so much fat which I do not like. The only great thing on the plate was the home fries, the waitress forgot to ask what toast we wanted and we reminded her and then had to wait 15 mins after our food came to get the toast. My mom enjoyed her stuff so that's what's important, I am still hungry tho. The waitress didn't come and ask what we thought of the food or anything. I am throughly dissatisfied and disappointed in thos place. I didn't want to tip our waitress cuz I felt she did nothing to deserve one, but since my mom used to be a waitress she tipped her 😕", 'Lovely staff. Chill vibe. I will be back. Love the lobster bisque.\nThe tables with robe design are very cool. Spacious table sets. I belive there are two tvs. Where I was  sitting it was visible but not sure you can see from all angles.', 'Everything went well until the food came. In an attempt to change my order , I was ignored . The food came out and it was the worst. Almost everything was disgusting and tasteless. I sent my entire meal back. I wouldn’t recommend this restaurant. How do you mess up breakfast', 'A place that is just a great restaurant, would definitely recommend others. The food is great and customer service is also very good.']

name: MARTINE'S BISTRO
reviews:
['What a beautiful and delicious spot to enjoy authentic Haitian food. We were welcomed as soon as we walked with. A sweet young girl who was our waitress started us off with a Haitian lemonade, which blew my mind! I never tasted such a tastee lemonade. It has a vanilla flavor to it. We then ordered one plate of fried turkey and one of fried pork. Both orders came with plantains, onions, picklies, sausage, 2 soft fluffy like dumplings, and 2 okra flour strips. Everything was outstanding, and I loved the beautiful decor. Thank you for the wonderful experience and food!', 'Quite a disappointment today, the reviews and pictures were very promising. Longwinded but truthful and good to know.
1. You walk into a counter with a bell, "ring for service". To the left is a room divider with signage but not welcoming at all, obstructs the view to the dining area.
2. The lady at the counter said hi, I asked if we could eat indoors and I she then pointed at take out containers and asked if I wanted that. I repeated that I wanted to eat indoors. She came around the other way and halfway opened the partitioned even though she saw us standing with a stroller. So I proceeded to move the divider myself to make adequate space. ** the inside decor is beautiful, very inviting, and homie unlike the service**
3. We sit down looking over menus (behind us was another couple with more than half their food and full drinks still on the table **red flag** they were talking on the phone with someone about their bill and an extra $10 charge) we placed our order, then the lady asked if we wanted to eat in regular plates (pointed at the other table) or the take out plates. After some and forth trying to understand the question, she informed us that there was a $10 uncharge on the food if we were to eat in dinner plates.
4. The Food: the black rice was not black rice in any aspect, flavor, look, texture, we barely ate any. The macaroni (one of my favs!) had little to no taste, each took a bite and left it. The griot, meat was fresh but the flavor was simply not there. Fritay, was ok, more plantains than everything else, flavor was just ok, also first time I've had fritay with only a piece of
sausage, we took this home to pair it with better rice. Grape soda $5.
5. The establishment looked very clean. Oh! Almost forgot, when our food was ready, the waitress rang the bell from the front of the counter, and yelled out "Monsieur" to which my husband got up from the table opened the partition and picked up the food to bring it back to our table. I think that added to his loss of interest in the food as well.', 'I recently ordered from this restaurant and was extremely disappointed. The food arrived uncooked and inedible, which is unacceptable. When I reached out for a refund, I encountered a frustrating delay and had to follow up multiple times before they finally agreed to process it.

This lack of quality control and poor customer service has left a bad impression. I won’t be returning.', 'Amazing vibes; the food was so delicious; and the owner was so welcoming and professional. My family and I will definitely be back for dinner. This place is a hidden gem that needs to be discovered.', 'I definitely enjoyed this restaurant, my favorite take out restaurant for authentic Haitian cuisine. The aura and the aesthetics of the restaurant is so beautiful & cozy. My favorite is the fritay ,Tassot, jerk chicken & soup joumou, everything is so fresh and flavorful. Always look forward to going back. My new go to restaurant!']

name: SALVI
reviews: ["Love this place.  Delicious Italian fare in upscale but friendly Brooklyn neighborhood just off Flatbush Ave.  Meatballs and Caprese were perfect start to our meal, followed by delicious chicken, veal and pasta dishes.  And the atmosphere was so pleasant.  A family birthday was taking place and the staff were so friendly celebrating the young man's occasion.  Plus the local musician played piano and accordion for the guests and took requests which was a wonderful addition to the experience.", 'Great Italian food I had the Samoan and it was delicious. They have live music and a piano.', 'Seems the food has slipped a bit over the last couple years. Pity, I used to love the place. Prices are moderate-high.', "My sister passed away and it's been an awful time for my family.  Literally everything felt like a challenge except when our funeral director Anthony from McManus suggested Salvi's for the Repast (luncheon) after my sister's funeral. Everything was very early so we were looking for a location that would allow us in at 11:00 a.m.  Every other location we looked at was either insanely expensive or wouldn't open until 2:00 p.m. Clearly that wasn't an option for us.  From the moment I walked into the restaurant to get prices, a menu, etc. Salvi's staff was compassionate, sympathetic, understanding & incredibly flexible. I could only give them a ballpark number of 20 potential diners. I was supposed to call them when we were on our way over but due to the stress of the morning I completely forgot.  When I showed up with nearly double the amount I had initially told them (35) Not once did the staff seem irritated or put out by the new number of customers. They just rearranged some extra tables in a flash and our entire party was seated & eating their DELICIOUS food that kept coming & coming & coming in what felt like no time at all!!  I purchased package #3 ($55.00 per person) & some of the items were served family style with way more than I ever expected. Every plate served was overflowing & never empty once.  A majority of our guests were Italian & they were all incredibly impressed, as was I.  It's been an emotional and exhausting time for my entire family, but Salvi's gave us a place to gather & celebrate my sister's life and give my family precious time to spend together sharing stories and simply enjoying each other's company after an extremely draining morning. I can't thank them ALL enough for the amazing food & their genuinely generous souls.  God bless every kind, attentive individual in Salvi's employ, especially those who worked on Saturday, June 11, 2022.  My family and I will all absolutely be back to this wonderful restaurant BECAUSE of both the delicious food & their lovely & loving staff.", 'The waiter was very nice and the accordion guy was nice. Food 🔥🔥🔥\n5 stars']

name: EL RANCHITO POBLANO RESTAURANT
reviews: ['As a first-timer, I was a bit skeptical, but I ordered the shrimp taco and the pork with pineapple, and they turned out to be really good! Both were well-cooked with great portions. However, I felt the pricing was a bit on the high side.', 'The best Mexican Cuisine on Flatbush by far. Their food was delicious & fresh.', 'Pretty good, burrito was tasty and warm! But hard pass on the cheese dip tho. $8 for cold cheez wiz is kinda crazy', 'I ordered delivery around 10pm on a weeknight. I got a burrito with the shredded beef, Mexican rice, pinto beans, guac, corn salsa, cheese etc. I really enjoyed it. Beef was neither dry nor overly fatty. Appreciated the customizable options although I do wish there was an option to choose no lettuce. I have definitely had larger, more delicious burritos from other places but overall this was a solid order.', 'I am basing the stars/review on this order placed tonight. Typically their food is alright but tonight it definitely was not. I wish I could get a refund but who knows how that would go. I decided to take a risk and get there sampler which brings onions rings, mozzarella sticks, buffalo wings, french fries, fried baby shrimp and chicken tenders. All of that for only 13 bux sounds great right? Well it was horrible, not sure how long they have these in their freezer and took out to make today. I only had 2 pieces of “buffalo wings” but there was no flavor of buffalo at all, no sauce nothing. The mozzarella stick looked really as you can see is gross as well. Onion rings are scary looking. I also ordered Caldo de Res and it was subpar, basically make it at home if you plan on using this recipe; celery sticks, a sliver of carrot, chopped up beef, and garnish with onion, cilantro and limes. Sucks i won’t be eating this sampler!! DO NOT ORDER THE SAMPLER!']

name: IL POSTO
reviews:
['I post ad nauseam about supporting local businesses, especially dining establishments. Indulge me today as I wax poetic about Il Posto Ristorante (@ 7409 Avenue U). Valentine’s Day was quite an event @ Il Posto. The menu was attractively presented with a variety of choices. The romantic atmosphere was courtesy of a beautifully adorned table setting. The food is amazing; the service is attentive; entertainment on weekends is top notch. Christian is our favorite server, but Fernando, Luis and Marcos are close seconds. Rounding out the staff, Gregory is the manager while Ramona and Mike bartend. For historians, Il Posto is the successor to the Gran Torino and End East restaurants.', 'Nice restaurant, very good impression. Waiters are very very helpful, paying attention to your requests and overall pleasant people. Food is nice, typical to a good Italian restaurant. I liked mozzarella carrozza, calamari not so much, steak was good, large plate, veal parmesan was nice, thin while juicy.', "My family and I go here whenever we want a fancier meal without strict dress code or difficult to get reservations.

I highly recommend the lamb chops, I order them every single time. I've literally never had lamb chops as good as they are here, even when I prepare them myself. My wife nearly always gets the T-bone steak and it is a fantastic, massive piece of steak. The veal is also extremely good.

For dessert I recommend the tartufo, it's excellent and just the right amount of you want a large dessert and perfect to share on a date for a smaller portion.

My only real critique is that the music can be a bit too loud on some nights, sometimes a live singer and sometimes a DJ. I find it a bit difficult to hear one another speak at the table sometimes; however, if you plan to have a few drinks and dance to some disco era music maybe it will be a plus for you. They have a full bar as well.

There is usually street parking nearby, it's a mostly residential area in a pretty low-crime neighborhood.", 'Advertised music, when we went there with our group, they said the singers cancelled.  Food good, but very expensive for a Brooklyn neighborhood.', 'The food and service were excellent 👌']

name: LILLI RESTAURANT
reviews:
['This place was a complete VIBE!!!! The music was what actually caught my attention. The place was visually appealing! We were greeted by the saff who were authentically friendly and checked in on us multiple times. They even apologized for our food taking long (in my opinion the wait was pretty short). The food and drinks were AMAZING!!!! THIS will definitely be my new go to brunch spot for a girlfriends day out!!!!', 'Absolutely loved our experience at LILLI’s on Utica Ave in Brooklyn! We celebrated my sister-in-law’s birthday here, with family coming from as far as Boston and Georgia. From the moment we walked in, the ambiance and decor set the mood—simply breathtaking! 🤩

The drinks were stellar, especially my lemon drop, which was spot-on. We started with the veggie spring rolls, and other family members tried different appetizers; every single one was just as delicious. For the main course, I went with the steamed snapper, and my husband had the mango snapper—both were perfectly prepared and bursting with flavor. Everyone at the table raved about their dishes! 🤩

The experience was made even better by our server, Mimi. She was attentive, friendly, and truly made us feel welcome. An added bonus was the in-house photographer, who took amazing pictures that captured our celebration beautifully.

And all this for a very reasonable price! If you’re ever in Brooklyn, LILLI’s is a must-visit. Very satisfied and can’t wait to return!', 'I celebrated my best friends birthday there and we were thoroughly impressed. The food, atmosphere and staff were all top notch. Jordan was our waiter and if he didn’t tell us he was relatively new we would have never known. Simone made the drinks to perfection!!!!! We will definitely return with others.', 'The appetizers were delicious, the ambiance was pleasant, and the drinks were excellent. However, it was a little on the expensive side. The new waitress was outstanding. Despite her slow service and lack of menu knowledge, I ordered the snapper, which was well-seasoned but not particularly tasty. The fried rice was slightly salty.', 'At Lilli, the Caribbean vibes hit just right, and so did the food. The green curry mussels? Pure fire—fresh, tender mussels swimming in a creamy, flavorful curry with just the right kick. And the jerk chicken spring rolls? Crispy on the outside, smoky and spicy on the inside, with a dipping sauce that brought it all together. The flavors were bold and unapologetic, just how I like it. All i needed was a peppa sauce! The whole spot had that island feel—laid-back but the music and vibes was right. Definitely a vibe and a must-try for anyone looking for a taste of the Caribbean! Shout out to Chef Omar!']

name: FONTANA´S ITALIAN RESTAURANT
reviews: ["Fontana's is a good spot for local Italian style food. I've been here twice for lunch. Each time I've gotten the Chicken Parm on a Hero and it's been consistently good. The atmosphere is clean, and nicely decorated. The staff is friendly. I need to try and replicate the Garlic chili flake oil they serve with the fresh bread, its simple but tasty. Definitely my new spot", 'Very disappointed with my order. I purchased salmon and pasta on the side. I usually get Rigatoni but for some reason, they decided to put spaghetti without notifying me. Spaghetti was horrible.\n\nThe salmon was dry & tasteless. Dinner was not good at all, I ended up throwing it out. Do better !', 'Delicious food. Great service. Beautiful and happy atmosphere. Highly recommend this  wonderful restaurant. Try everything, because everything is great!💖', 'Excellent food, good service, great chef and very friendly owner Carlos.when you go there tell him Orlando recommended this place.', 'Food was amazing, Sangria was great (We prefer with no ice, it tasted even more amazing)']

name: OSAKA
reviews:
['First time going here. Found this awesome restaurant on Google. Amazing service. Food was delicious and fresh. The manager is great has great recommendations when it comes to his menu. Will definitely be back.', 'Love the food - if you like Japanese food you should try them out. It’s in a great neighborhood near DUMBO. Would definitely recommend!', 'G.O.A.T sushi spot in south Brooklyn. Price, portion, taste all a+. Highly recommend. Staff is always extremely friendly and grateful for business.', 'Food is delicious! Yummy! The kitchen chefs work so fast, 5-10 min.
Service is excellent, the waiters are attentive and caring.
Please, add function to order party tray in the restaurant (without pick up).
By the way, I searched in google maps “sushi” and I didn’t find Osaka.', 'Great place, great food and prices.  Never leave not satisfied, drive from Howard Beach to get!  Owner is a great guy and treats you like a friend!']

name: OASIS DINER
reviews:
['Pretty nice diner. Seated immediately. Service was pleasant and attentive. Whereas the coffee was always hot and flavorful, last time it was rather bland. And the two hamburgers ordered by my two daughters last time featured bad meat. We returned them and received  credit for one dish. Place was redesigned several years ago.
No excuse for bad meat. Cannot come here again.', 'This is the diner that this part of Brooklyn has been looking for! Friendly staff, consistently delicious food, and warm inviting ambiance. This spot is my sister’s go-to for her weekend brunch delivery meal via Uber Eats so I decided to try it out in real life. The space is lovely and can easily fit large groups or families. The food was exactly as I expected & did not disappoint.', 'This diner was recommended by a friend, and I love food so I had to check it out. Well I been here 3 times in the last 2 weeks, and with each visit it just keep getting better and better.

The first thing that stands out for me was the friendly welcome from the staff. The ambiance, is everything. Especially when you looking for something cozy warm and inviting.

The food, I want to try everything on the menu to most likely I will be adding to this review later on.

Try the waffles 🧇 Belgian are my favorite with fruits. Especially after a bike ride. But so far my favorite is the vegetarian burger 🔥🔥🔥🔥

Go try them out and see for yourself.', 'In the area getting my car serviced and stumbled across this diner. Very clean and welcoming atmosphere the minute you walk in the door. Prices were reasonable, the food was great and our server (wish I caught her name) was superb.', 'Good diner! Great standard options for a diner and plenty of room for large groups. We had the BLT which had so much bacon! The chicken souvlaki was good, the tsatsiki sauce is a little garlicky but tastes legit. The service was a little slow but that’s my only complaint.']

name: SAKURA JAPANESE RESTAURANT
reviews: ['I ordered the beef teriyaki lunch and 2 spicy salmon rolls. Because they were the lunch specials, both were reasonably priced. The server filled my cup as soon as it was empty. Definitely good service.\n\nWill stop by again later.', 'Great filet mignon! Why drive into NYC, when we have the best steak in NYC.  Congenial atmosphere with great food and service.', "It's my favorite sushi spot in all of Brooklyn. I'm not the only one who thinks so. When going inside, they have many customer letters and pictures on display. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!!", "I ordered sushi (shrimp tempura). Indoor dining wasn't available during the time. The food was okay. I'd recommend.", 'The fish is always so fresh! And presentation is beautiful.']

name: PANINO RUSTICO OF MILL BASIN
reviews:
["There is a lot to like about Panino Rustico. 🙂

Just had a W2 (wrap #2) where I was able to swap out the turkey for grilled chicken, and add avocado. Loved it! 🌯🤩

Their food has been consistently good over time. The P20, P25 and P50 are favorites that we've returned to again and again.

The only thing I didn't enjoy as much was the grilled chicken Cesar wrap, and I found the Salmon panini a bit too salty.

One note of caution though, be sure to check your bill and your order. I have had experiences where my bill was incorrect, or they forgot to bag an item I had ordered and paid for.

But the food is so good, those occasions haven't stopped me from patronizing their business. 😊", 'Had a salad and my oh my. It was packed with nutrient. Talk about a “nutrient dense” meal. My Nutrition colleagues would love this place. The salad has mixed greens, cranberry, grilled chicken, strawberries, blue/blackberries, cheese , and crunchy green apples. I enjoyed every bit. I don’t care for the selected dressing and hope to choose another in the future/ I had thousand island at home so I swapped it out.', 'Good service, nice outdoor seating, no problem parking on street, and amazing food!!!', "My fiance and I used to go there weekly but do to my work schedule I haven't been there in a while only for take out. My favorite is the smoke salmon and goat cheese  so delicious.
The ower  thing is very hospitable and friendly as well as the staff.  I would highly recommend panini rustico of Mill basin.", 'The food and service is amazing. Everything is fresh and delicious. We got the E1 (goat cheese, strawberry, fig glazed candied walnuts) and. P37 (grilled chicken, bacon and ranch dressing). Highly recommend.']

name: FLORIDIAN PLAZA DINER
reviews:
['Great place for a family dinner or couple dinner. Very beautiful place, staff and professionals. All the food taste fresh and delicious. They have pretty much everything since burgers , seafood steak and ribs. Also pasta and Italian food, paninis, wines. They serve fast and the place is big and they have private parking. If one day you’re looking to dine out there is a good choice.', "It's been 35 years since I was last here. Service is good.
Pickles were definitely from a jar, Cole slaw was crunchy bit sweet. Matzo ball soup was decent.
Order Ruben sandwich, got an open faced one instead. To messy. But good. Daughter got the corned beef hash. The hash was undercooked
French toast was delicious.
We ordered an orange juice in the beginning, but it never came.

Overall, the food was ok. The service was ok. They do have karaoke and different themes. But I don't go to a diner cause they have karaoke", 'The atmosphere in Floridian Diner is always so inviting, my waitress was very professional and friendly. The food is hot, fresh and tasty. Took my sister there for her birthday and boy did she enjoy her meal. The waitress surprised her with a free slice of cake when we were about to leave . Highly recommend this lovely place . And by the way, the price was not bad for the amount of food we purchased', 'We came from Florida and my husband was raving about this place I was very disappointed. My husband ordered Louisiana chicken panini and its was supposed to have blacked chicken and Cajun seasonings and there was none to be found  my son ordered Greek chicken panini and there was supposed to have spinach on it and instead they put lettuce on it and no dressing my iced tea was sour and my husband ordered an egg cream it wasn’t what he expected. Fries were not fresh either . Will never come back', 'First, I was impressed with how clean it was. The staff was welcoming. The food was really good. Loved the coffee as well. The atmosphere was socomfortable. We just sat and ate and talked. They checked on us often. Will definitely be back.']

name: WING HING SEAFOOD RESTAURANT
reviews:
['Have you ever tried an authentic food? You should try. New York is an amazing place where diversity of culture is shared. If you want to try Chinese cuisine you can start from Ave U in Brooklyn. Freshly made, delicious and very affordable.
Wing Hing Seafood Restaurant is one of my favourite ones. 20$ bill for two in lunch time. Isn’t that amazing? And overall you will never regret the food. Hot, fresh appetisers such as SiuMai, shrimp rice rolls, dumplings and on and on….Especially in lunch time you can try all kinds of them. You are getting a special list just for all those delicious things. And if you’re still not full order any main dish on rice. For example, Roast pig over rice. 😋 Tiny, crispy fried skin on top of juicy and tender meat. Or try pork chops Pekin style. Flavorful  sweet and sour red sauce made this dish always a winner. There is a choice of beef, pork, chicken. And I f you are a vegetarian you will be happy with the variety of different dishes for you too. All food extremely fresh and tasty. And on the top you always get a free pot of green tea.', 'No frills. Just good food made to order.

We absolutely loved the preparation of the purple eggplant. It came out piping hot and remained that way for the entire meal. The walnut shrimp plate was a delight as well, I was super happy that even the broccoli was well seasoned. The salt level was great and freshness of the shrimp. The quality of the meat in the sweet-and-sour chicken was exactly what we were hoping for. Usually restaurants slack off in this department because it’s fried and covered in sauce but this plate did not disappoint.

In addition to these three main course options we had an order of white rice on the side and enjoyed the lovely tea. Usually we go to Chinatown for this style of cuisine but appears we have this gem among us here in Brooklyn. As we were eating we noticed a lot of people had some beautiful and extravagant dishes being dropped off to their table. Can’t wait to go back and try more ( like one of the meat platters or the lobster fried rice).

This place is definitely recommended for family style dining because all of the portions are so huge and definitely worth sharing. This place would also be great for a celebration, they have bigger tables and once all the food is on the table it all looks so beautiful and special. Not sure if they have drinks because we ended up drinking the tea that was served on arrival the whole time. Also we requested hot sauce and hot chili oil which is a must on the side.', "Haven't been here in a few years. But this neighborhood place does not disappoint! It had a great crowd and the takeout was so busy we had to wait longer to get our food. We ordered the curry seafood special. It goes great with rice though they give you noodles.Also, the General Tso's chicken was one of the best I ever had.", 'My family and I have visited winghing so many times over the past couple of years. This place offers amazing and authentic food! We have tried all the dishes here and everything is worth trying! We also befriended the owners there who have always been very friendly to us.', 'Delicious Chinese food!!!

Today we got lemon chicken (a childhood classic), jumbo fried shrimp, pea shoots, fried calamari (a staple for my family), fish with bean curd and mushroom, and yee-mein (remains as one of my favorite places for this). The lemon chicken was lightly crispy and had a delicious lemon sauce with a slight tang. The shrimp was slightly over cooked but still enjoyable. Fried calamari is a must order if you go here - the seasoning of salt, white pepper, and garlic are perfect! The calamari is perfectly tender and the crust is wonderfully crisp! Finally the yee-mein is something we always order here because it’s the best one (and I’ve tried many!). Wing Hing is an excellent place to eat really good Cantonese food and we’ve been coming back here for more than 10 years!']

name: JJ'S FRITAILLE- - HAITIAN RESTAURANT BROOKLYN NY
reviews: ['Fresh. Top notch. Absolutely delicious.', 'if you haitian this aint the place.it lacks flavor its decent but really bland and the meat is old and mostly fatty its just oil with no flavor kinda sad', 'It is well worth the money. I had the goat with plantains and almost ate myself into a comma. It was a lot of food and very delicious I could not stop eating.', 'Great service!!! Great Food!!!', 'The best of the best! Been eating here since childhood and my my is it delicious. Great guy owns it too. Amazing cook, business owner, and conversationalist.']

name: GOSHT | RESTAURANT | HALAL STEAKHOUSE & BURGERS
reviews:
['We really enjoyed this restaurant! The food was absolutely delicious and had a unique, creative flavor. The salad dressings were especially interesting and added a special touch to the meal. The only downside was that we couldn’t sit inside because a kids’ workshop was taking place at the time. However, this didn’t upset us, and we’re sure to come back again many times in the future. Highly recommended!', 'I recently visited Ghost in NY and absolutely loved the food! Every dish was delicious, from the steak burger to the pina colada—everything was top-notch. My favorite was definitely the burgers. Although I haven’t tried the chicken burger yet, I’m excited to give it a shot next time because it seems promising.

A great perk for families is the kids’ play area, where volunteers can watch over your kids for $15 each. If you’re planning a celebration, like a birthday or anniversary, Ghost is an excellent spot—you can enjoy quality time and delicious food while the kids have fun nearby.

The only concern I have is that it’s a bit pricey, and the portions could be larger for the price. Overall, though, highly recommend!”', 'It’s one of the best halal steakhouses in New York. Even though the area feels kind of far on a busy day and parking in the neighborhood is a bit hassle but it’s worth it when you get the food.

We took some of the popular items on the menu like beef bone marrow, Ghost burger and lukum over spinach.

The ghost burger was the star of the show today. It was so juicy and tender. The meat was just melting in the mouth and it was so flavorsome. Hands down it made into the top 3 of my favorite list.

The bone marrow was something different that I have tried and the toast and picked onion complemented it really nicely. Though it felt like a bit pricey compared to the quantity we got.

I was not a big fan of the lukum over spinach but it was one of their popular items on the menu. I felt like the meat was missing some seasoning and I had to add additional salt and pepper. But it was tender and easy to cut.

We also took the fried rice and it was going well with the steak.

Besides the atmosphere and the service was top notch.', 'Amazing restaurant, welcoming atmosphere. The staff were friendly, especially waitress Lia, her attentiveness, service, and recommendations were fantastic. The food is delectable. Overall highly recommended \U0001fa76', 'The food was amazing. Dawood, our server knew exactly what he was recommending us, and to my surprise, the steak was very juicy from inside. I am a Texan, and I would rate this place a 1000/10 if that was an option. Located in Brooklyn, this place is a hidden gem, and I strongly recommend having this place on ur list when traveling to NYC. Dawood again is a gentleman and an amazing, hardworking person who kept checking on us from time to time.']

name: D'AMORE , ITALIAN RESTAURANT, BAR ,DINING & PIZZERIA - MILL BASIN , BROOKLYN, NY
reviews:
['I cannot say enough wonderful things about our experience at this restaurant. We planned a funeral repass for our family on short notice and finding the perfect place felt like a challenge, but this spot in Mill Basin was truly a hidden gem. Born and raised in Canarsie/Mill Basin, it felt meaningful to return and find such a welcoming and accommodating venue that could host our group of 35-40 people.

From the moment we walked in, the staff went above and beyond to make us feel cared for, showing genuine empathy and offering their condolences. They handled everything we needed without hesitation, including making sure our two children and elderly, grieving parent were attended to promptly.

Every aspect of the meal was phenomenal. The appetizers and main courses were delicious—there was not a single dish, drink, or interaction that fell short. Each server was attentive and kind, ensuring our gathering was seamless. The back room we used was beautifully set up, creating a warm, comforting atmosphere.

We received nothing but positive feedback from everyone who attended and it’s safe to say this restaurant has my highest recommendation.

“Thank you for providing such a wonderful experience during my difficult time. I’m beyond grateful!” - Ruth', "I had my sicilian pizza delivered today, I don't care that the pizza is thin crust but it's very oily, it taste artificial and weird tasting, not to mention when I was writing this review my family member ran to me to show and tell me there was a piece of staple in the pizza 🤢 I called to let the person who picked up the phone aware of what was found , she said she would make the cook aware. Then me seeing reviews of someone else saying there was a bug in the food, I do wish I had saw that before ordering , I probably wouldn't have ordered . Anyway no more pizza for me or really outside food because I've become accustomed to preparing my own food anyway. As with any food you don't personally handle yourself eat at your own risk", 'Amazing food all there location are slamming they moved from sheepshead bay but I still drive to eat there food definitely delicious they know how to make pizza taste good THANK YOU Mikey', 'We had a private here tonight! The staff was amazing. Very accommodating, warm, welcoming. They took great care of us.

The food was excellent. Shells and chicken were our favorite.

They allowed us to come in early and decorate as we liked and even helped with decor.

Looking forward to coming back. Thanks again!', 'Hunter was an absolute delight. The food was quick and prepared well! I would certainly return!']

name: BEST BITES RESTAURANT
reviews: ['The cow heel soup has saved my life on many occasions. Phoulori is always on point.. the King fish is delectable. I hope they continue to serve up great Trini food 🥑', 'Very disappointed today. Brought some soup tasteless.  Brought some jerk wings very dry near burnt no hint of moisture or tenderness. Brought a piece of macaroni pie… a new experience with this version. Peas and carrots in pie. Out if the three things only the soup made it to my stomach out of pure hunger.  This can’t be the same cook as my previous experience was nothing but pure joy to my pallet.', "This review is from April of 2018 when the world was a different place! Imagine, I can remember this day so well because this is an incredible restaurant with delicious food! We arrived specifically for the Trinidad Doubles. Doubles are a street food in Trinidad and they're not easy to prep so we called ahead first to make sure they were making Doubles that day. We were in luck! They were delicious and my regret is that I didn't eat more! This place is clean, plenty of seating, people working there that day were nice and helpful, and the prices were very good! I have to thank my buddy from Trinidad for taking us there!", "I ordered the kingfish and salad. I must've got the jr cause there's nothing king about this small pieces they gave me. The HOT fish was placed on top of my COLD salad,(which is literally only lettuce) now I have wilted lettuce stew. The amount of chewing that I'm doing to eat this overcooked fish has my jaws hurting. This my first time having fish jerky lol.. The fish cakes were ok, next time I'll get the sauce on the side.", 'How you are a trini restaurant and have no solo. Never have fry bake and saltfish. Failure! Do better!']

name: NEW THREE STAR RESTAURANT
reviews:
['We arrived and everything was clean and bright. We were seated right away at a clean table and provided with menus.

The food selection was huge! It took a little while to look at everything, but we decided, and the waitress came over. She was very polite, provided great service, and did so with a smile.

There were free pickles, coleslaw, and dill, chickpea, and onion salad with rolls, crackers, and breadsticks.

Our meals were delicious. We would come again!', 'We’ve eaten at this diner several times since they opened and have never been disappointed! The food is always fresh and delicious. The portions for the price can’t be beat! The staff and service is great, the atmosphere is great and the restaurant is always spotless! Old school Greek Diner with new school vibes! You won’t be disappointed.', 'My family and I had Thanksgiving dinner here this evening. The turkey stuffing soup and stuffed clams were delicious, but the mashed potatoes were tasteless, and instead of candied sweet potatoes they served baked sweet potatoes. The portions are nice.', 'Love this little gem!
Wide selection of delicious food with a lot of variety.
Nice atmosphere, friendly attentative staff & very clean A+++++', "It is one of my mom's and sister's favorite restaurant,  so I decided to join them one evening, and I could see why they like it. They have very friendly staff, and the food is served in big portions and made homestyle. I would definitely come back again.

Update: I decided to dine there again, and ordered a chocolate cheesecake.  It was one of the tastiest I ever tried. Likewise, they use fresh fruit for their smoothies unlike many places."]

name: QUEZADA RESTAURANT CORP.
reviews:
["This was another happy discovery, and a nice place to stop in for old-fashioned Spanish comfort food.  My favorite dish from here is the garlic chicken with rice and beans, as well as the fresh juices.  One can make a dish off of the snack foods and smaller dishes by themselves; the standard rice platter that came with the aforementioned chicken lasted me for a few days, there was so much.  They also have a wide variety of breakfast dishes and don't mind customizing them as needed.", 'The food was Authentic and delicious 😋. The customer service is great 👍🏾.  I will be returning back!', 'A great Spanish food spot in the Flatbush area. I ordered yellow rice with stewed lentils and yuca. They have a variety of dishes you can choose from. The ladies doing all the client facing work are verily kind as well. I would return to get some lunch when I’m in the Flatbush area again.', 'little dissatisfied with the breakfast. Just made. no care or taste. couldn’t really enjoy it. drinks are good!', 'Grubhub can sometimes be a pain in the butt but this restaurant makes ordering worth it!
I realize last year I left a review that did not do this place justice! I was upset over an undelivered order and left a bad review. (I feel awful).
The customer service here is immaculate. Juan one of the workers goes above and beyond to ensure regular customers get their hearts desires as well as new customers!
They are extremely patient and kind (even after being given a bad review!)
I grew up eating Spanish food and they put a lot of love into their food it makes it feel like home. \U0001fa77🥲']

name: OLIVE GARDEN ITALIAN RESTAURANT
reviews:
['From the start the waitress was very short not sure if she was upset that the added another table to he line or wht ! It’s a table of 4 and we only place two orders b4 being asked it that’s was all… in a tone that was kinda like I have better things to do… we continues ordering salad came and she walked away to get the breadsticks.

When she got back I was ready to order a drink I asked  her if they did the wine samples she said no which is no fault to her and also asked her why were we jus giving that garden salad vs being able to choose the Caesar salad, to which she said that that salad is the only salad that Olive Garden offers now and that’s really bad on Olive Garden’s part because not only do you not know what people are allergic to to just offer one thing of salad and then have olives in it, which most people don’t eat olives most people are sometimes allergic to olives.
That’s an Olive Garden situation that’s to show you how long I have not been at Olive Garden. The last time I was there they still had the Caesar salad on the menu that was my favorite how ever the breadsticks that came that’s was not good and not wht I remember  of Olive Garden because those breadsticks were not great at all.
I ordered mac & cheese for my son and let me tell you I could’ve gotten craft macaroni box cheese, and had it taste much better than what they served us at Olive Garden. Needless to say it stayed on the plate went back to the kitchen as is cause I even asked her I said what is this and she said mac & cheese I said that is not mac & cheese . I ordered the shrimp carbonara no bacon let’s just say that also stayed on the plate and went back to the kitchen the other person that was with me ordered the shrimp scampi. I think the only thing she had out of there was the shrimp and the other person ordered pizza that we took to go. That was the only thing that Left. I’m not sure what’s happening in Olive Garden. What’s happening with the people that are cooking now but this is not the Olive Garden. I remember they need to do better.', 'Me and my partner ordered Alfredo seafood and creamy and vegetable soups! Christian the waiter is an amazing guy professional and kind he offered my partner’s birthday cake on house ! It was so kind from him I recommend highly 🎉❤️', 'Instead of enjoying traffic on the Belt we decided to pull over for a quick bite. Just before 5pm on a Friday so I called ahead to ensure it wasn’t too busy. They informed us there was a 10 minute wait which we were fine with. We arrived about 5 mins later to very polite hosts. The wait was 15 minutes but the turn around time was fair because 2 large parties left in the time we were waiting.

The restaurant was very clean and the cleaning staff was diligent. I’m the type of person who pays attention to how quickly tables are cleaned once a family leaves. Turnaround was consistently less than 3 minutes with proper sanitizing as well.

Our server was Zakyra (please excuse my misspelling) and she was fantastic. Very pleasant and patient with my endless requests- because as much as I try not to be I’m definitely one of “those” customers. She went above and beyond to accommodate my dietary needs with genuine kindness. Forgive me for not asking her name but the tall young lady with the black headscarf also extended herself to us although she was not our server- great job team.

The food was hot, fresh, and good! I ordered endless soup, salad, & breadsticks; my partner had the crispy chicken fettuccine alfredo. Overall great job, it’s so nice to see the staff working so cohesively together. Zakyra even extended a favor to one of her coworkers while seamlessly managing her tables. We look forward to passing by again the next time we’re in the vicinity & will make sure to sit in her section.', 'It was our first time visiting any Olive Garden restaurant and it was by far a great experience! Our server had a warm personality and our food didn’t take too long to reach our table. Delicious and enough for take home!', 'Great food, portions are massive compared to the European standard we know…']

name: HARBOR LIGHT PUB
reviews:
['Great food and fast and friendly service. Our server Annie made us feel like we were family.', 'Completely uncooked in army uniform sweet potato hunks not fries
Barry bland Philly cheesesteak blend chicken
But the worst part it completely will uncooked sweet potatoes
Also chick not probably trimmed chicken fatty piece has lot of fat not cooked properly', 'Harbor Light has been a neighborhood staple for decades.  The menu selection is simple and satisfying. Service

Brunch is quite popular, omelettes are the size of the plate.  Best brunch around, outdoor seating a vailable as well.  Enjoy.']

name: SHAKE SHACK KINGS PLAZA
address: Floor 1, Kings Plaza Shopping Center, 5100 Kings Plz, Brooklyn
reviews:
["Ordered bacon burger fries and drink for $25 including tip....Long wait, (30 min) seemed like they didn't start cooking until they had more orders. Food was good, service was fine but I probably wont be back due to the price. You cant tell by the pic but the burer was small and why are you asking for tips?!", 'Beware and eat at your own risk but I do not recommend. This is a warning because I would know, I got food poisoning from a Smoke Shack burger I ordered from this location on October 5th, 2023 at 8:36pm - verified by my bank. I am still traumatized and bothered by the pain and suffering I’ve endured and experienced days following the  consumption of the food sold to me. They are serving undercooked, raw bacon which is extremely dangerous, unhealthy and can land you in the hospital with one of the most notorious illnesses and parasitic infections called trichinellosis. Shake Shack do better, this is not a joking matter and needs to be taken serious and rectified immediately because y’all are playing with people lives which is completely unacceptable and just utterly absurd.', 'Burgers are good, fries and lemonade good. Service wasn’t the best, but have had worse. Only a few seats inside restaurant, other seating in middle of mall. Not always the best to sit. Very crowded.', "I understand that it is fast food but it is not justified that a white woman, I don't know if she is a manager or works in the kitchen, I refuse a ranch sauce, lovers of eating chicken know how delicious it is to eat with it! My experience was fatal, I do not recommend it The other girls are very nice but this woman 'I won't be back", 'Train your employees!!!

Second time I’ve ordered the smoky classic bbq burger and received smokeshack instead

If they can’t read/comprehend more than “smoke” they shouldn’t be employed, or treat them as they are, Illiterate, and try not to confuse them with multiple items that include any of the same words I guess…

Really earning those minimum wage increases huh?']

name: DRIFT BK RESTAURANT & LOUNGE
reviews:
['I went on a Tuesday evening to celebrate a friend’s birthday,  my friends and I definitely enjoyed ourselves. Stephan (hopefully I’m spelling his name correctly) was a great host! From his hospitality, to the drinks, to the customer service he was top tier. I enjoyed the music (Dancehall, Reggae, and Soca) and the food was very good. The restaurant was aesthetically pleasing. I wish there were more people dining to create more of an ambience, but it was a Tuesday night so I do understand. Thanks again to Stephan made the experience worth it for my first visit!', 'Went to Drift today for a retirement party and it was so HOT in the restaurant. There was no AC and the ceiling fans were blowing hot air. The retirement party was planned in advance and staff at Drift knew about how many people would be in attendance. However, they were understaffed. The food took a long time to come out. Staff needed repeated reminders to check on our food. Additionally, I ordered shrimp tacos to go. Each taco had ONE piece of shrimp (a total of 3 shrimp for 3 tacos). The taco was also very sloppy. I ordered the shrimp tacos because my colleagues stated that they were good and filled with shrimp. Well, as you can see by the photos, I did not get the same order they had. Furthermore, I ordered Mac and cheese and was told that they ran out. Not one person I was with ordered Mac and cheese and we were literally the only people in the restaurant. Therefore I am not sure how they ran out. We arrived at 2:45pm to the restaurant. Early enough for Mac and cheese to still be available for order.

I will not go back! Bring BKLYN Prime back to this location!!!

I moved the shrimp to a paper plate so that I can take a picture that shows how my tacos look on the inside.', 'Thank you For wasting my time and money I spent 298.00 dollars went here for my baby sister Birthday and do I wish i would’ve went somewhere else 11/10/24, The drinks are maybe the only good thing there Beware they feed you your food in the dark which I don’t think is right cause what if they’re bringing a roach on your plate you wouldn’t know I ordered lamb chops with mash potatoes a stir fry vegetables first of all they put thyme in the food so I proceeded to eat the food and keep picking pieces away not realizing Iam also pulling out hair I get home start throwing up and it’s hair in it ,when I went look back at my pic I saw it was hair wrapped around the vegetables. Which made me feel even worst I then proceeded to call and a staff member told me why did I wait so long , it’s only men that works in the kitchen and it was probably a piece of hair just just flew in it I said really and it’s wrapped into the food. No accountability at all I have box braid and my hair is brownish blonde so I know it’s not mine sad to say this is why black owned businesses can’t flourish cause Bad things like this happens or worst

Sincerely, A disappointed customer', 'I had an amazing HAPPY HOUR 4pm-7pm on  Monday. Our bartender was OSCAR he was so so amazing. Great great service. He made a Coconut Margarita it was great great.  We also had shrimp tacos it was very tasty......

I would return. ...

Thank you for a great time Oscar.', 'Food was horrible and customer service was terrible.
Food was cooked and Mac and cheese had so much oil.
Bartender doesn’t know how to make a drink. Rum punch was water down and they just put rum on top.']

name: DJONDJON
reviews:
["We're really enjoy the food and the music. We like the presentation of the black rice. The punch was delicious not too sweet. Nice and clean place. Clean bathroom.  Nice personal, the server was so nice she's doing a good job. The food 😋 tasty.  See you soon.  Thanks for your business.", 'Have to try the griot sliders!!! They were delicious. Also ordered the Djon Dion Box with chicken, sweet plantains, and the pate kode (codfish) to go. The food was delicious, service was great, and the music and atmosphere was perfect for a chill Sunday evening. Will definitely be coming back!', 'I visited the restaurant last night and I was pleased with my overall experience. Among the other Haitian restaurants that I have visited, I will say that this one got my heart. The place was clean, the music choice was great on point the whole time. The food was absolutely delicious, the portion was decent for the price, the pikliz was to die for. The only thing is I wish they gave a more decent size for the black rice. Overall, good vibe and great food. I will visit again soon. I will recommend this place to anyone looking for a great Haitian restaurant.💯', 'Food and service was great. I got the Legime and Accra as well as banan peze while my friend got the macaroni and diri djon djon. Neither one of us had problems with our food it exceeded expectations. Also our waitress Anaya did a great job was very helpful and listening.', "I recently had the pleasure of dining at DjonDjon in Brooklyn, and it was an exceptional experience from start to finish! As always, the owner, Wesly, came over to say hi, adding a personal touch to our visit. Having frequented his other restaurants, I can confidently say that DjonDjon is another phenomenal addition to his impressive portfolio. Wesly consistently does an excellent job, and this latest venture is no exception.

Our server was incredibly helpful and attentive, ensuring that our meal was enjoyable and seamless. The dishes we ordered were nothing short of spectacular:

MUSSELS - Fresh mussels steamed in their signature Creole sauce—each bite was a burst of flavor, perfectly cooked and seasoned.

KAFOU WINGS - Fried chicken wings tossed in our choice of Kreyol and Honey Jerk sauce—crispy, succulent, and packed with a delightful mix of spices.

GRILLED OCTOPUS- The grilled octopus was tender & the portion size was excellent- this was the best octopus I’ve ever had!

LOBEY FRITAY- Our choice of fried pork, served with plantains, a beef sausage, and house-made pikliz—a wonderful combination of textures and flavors that truly embodied the essence of Haitian cuisine.

Djon Djon, located in the vibrant neighborhood of Prospect Lefferts Gardens, offers a unique culinary journey that masterfully blends tradition and innovation. The restaurant's commitment to authenticity is evident in every dish.

This restaurant stands out by celebrating Haitian heritage through a modern lens, creating a dining experience that is both familiar and refreshingly novel. If you're looking to savor the essence of Haiti through a tapestry of flavors, DjonDjon is the place to be. Highly recommended!"]

name: RICHARD'S RESTAURANT AND BAR
reviews:
['Great restaurant and bar with a live DJ, I ordered Hennessy wings, fried shrimp, chicken and shrimp pasta , steam red snapper, and a side of bammy and bread fruit.
The food and service were wonderful, friendly staff, great owner & overall a great experience.', 'Excuse me, I’m not sure if it’s just me, but from my experience, this place felt like a rip-off. The first round of drinks (double shots were ) $23, and the second round jumped to $32, even though the menu lists shots at $8 each. They claimed the first round was discounted before 12am but even $23 seems overpriced for what should have been $16.

went ahead and paid to avoid any conflict, but the pricing felt very underhanded. Just a heads-up~be cautious and confirm drink prices beforehand to avoid surprises. Apart from that, the experience was okay, but I wouldn’t recommend this place due to the overcharging.', "Always a great time when you come to Richard's. It's a local lounge with classic authentic Jamaican food. The individuals who run and operate this restaurant are always friendly. The staff is always kind and willing to meet your every need. The space is beautiful and can host a party to several parties throughout the well made facility. On top of that, drink prices are more than fair and the owner is more than willing to work with you if you should choose to rent an event space here.", 'Ambiance, Music, Bar service all gets a A+ for me. Will definitely be going back. I was there for a Video release..but stayed till the karaoke..and had a blast.', 'Wasn’t even able to get food. Waste of time. Will not be back. Was only tending to the white guests. My sister & I were not helped at all. Sitting at a bar with only 4 other people. Shame.']

name: ANVAR’S RESTAURANT
reviews: ['Just tried Anvar’s restaurant in Brooklyn, and it was fantastic! The flavors were fresh and authentic, and the service was warm and inviting. The staff was friendly and attentive, making sure we had a great experience. Highly recommend the steak and Spanish style beef tongue - it’s a must-try! Looking forward to coming back soon.', "One of the best Dinner I've ever had in my life. The atmosphere, the ambience, the food, the service, the music, the aroma and then the personal touch by the owner, simply out of this world.\nThe newly renovated restaurant is marvel. If you have not visited it till now, then you're missing a rare gem.\nYou won't be disappointed, I guarantee 💯.", 'I passed by this place a couple of times and finally gave it a try. When I walked in, I was seated very quickly and they offered me some off menu specials. I chose the tuna salad and salmon shrimp plate, it was absolutely amazing. They came out soon after I ordered and I was very pleasantly surprised at how low the bill was. I suggest that if you have the chance try this new place.', 'My sister recommended this place and we decided to give it a try. I enjoyed the food, it was delicious and unique. Nice and cozy, very inviting atmosphere with polite staff. If you want to try  juicy, flavorful salmon, this is the place to go!', 'I had the pleasure of visiting a brand-new restaurant in Brooklyn. The shish kebab was cooked to perfection on real hardwood charcoal. The salads were fresh and prepared right in front of us. The waiting staff were very knowledgeable and created a positive atmosphere. The way they served the main dish with a fire show and perfect music made my day. I definitely recommend this place if you are in Brooklyn. Ask for their tuna salad; it will not disappoint you.']

name: CARIBBEAN JERKEE'S DELIGHT RESTAURANT
reviews: ['My friends and I visited this place this evening and the food was terrible. We got Oxtail, Curry Goat, Brown Stew, Sweet Chili wings and bake. The Oxtail was okay but mediocre at best. The Curry Goat was very tough and the curry sauce was very bland, the Brown stew was salty and bland. The Sweet chili wings were okay, they lacked sauce. I was Hopeful that this carry out would give me a good taste of Jamaican food in Brooklyn but I am very disappointed.', 'Second time coming here and I’m never disappointed. Jerk pork with veggies and pasta and this was at 11 pm……. On point', 'They’re open on Sunday’s! Great choice for hot food on the run. I get a few different items each time I go - they have all the usual offerings.', "They charged me $8 for a mini/special size jerk chicken meal as a small meal, which should be $5 Everything packed on top of each other like it's a frigging 3 layer cake. #Disgusted#NotGettingRippedOffThereAgain", 'So I brought this at 12:45am & let me tell you this food is AMAZING ! The jerk chicken is so good ! Would go again !']

name: IRIE BLISS RESTAURANT
reviews:
['The food was absolutely amazing! Well seasoned with fast and loving customer service. Can’t wait to come back! It felt like a warm hug.', 'Omg 8$ . rice very very good
I like the people who work here. Thx you .', 'I am a Trinidadian and I have tried different foods around Brooklyn this Irie Bliss is by far the best tasting and most authentic. U have to give them a try u wound go wrong.💯', "I recently had the pleasure of dining at Irie Bliss, and I must say it was an exceptional experience. Located in a bustling part of town, the restaurant offers a warm and inviting atmosphere with a distinct Caribbean vibe.

Ambiance: The moment you step inside Irie Bliss, you're greeted by lively Caribbean music, vibrant colors, and a relaxed ambiance. The decor incorporates elements of tropical paradise, with beach-inspired accents, and comfortable seating. The overall atmosphere is upbeat and energetic, transporting you to the islands.

Service: The service at Irie Bliss was top-notch. The staff was friendly, attentive, and knowledgeable about the menu. They made sure to provide helpful recommendations and catered to dietary restrictions with ease. The waiting time for the food was superb, and the staff consistently checked on us throughout the meal, ensuring a pleasant dining experience.

Cuisine: The highlight of Irie Bliss is undoubtedly the delicious Carribean cuisine. The menu boasts an array of authentic dishes bursting with flavors. From jerk chicken to curried goat and plantain fritters to ackee and saltfish, the options were diverse and enticing. Each dish we tried was skillfully prepared, using fresh ingredients and aromatic spices that tantalized the taste buds. The jerk chicken was succulent and packed with the perfect balance of smoky and spicy flavors. The curried goat was tender, and the curry sauce had a rich complexity that was truly delightful. The plantain fritters, served with a tangy dipping sauce, were a delightful blend of sweet and savory. And let's not forget the traditional rice and peas, which accompanied the main courses perfectly. The portion sizes were generous, and the presentation was visually appealing.

Overall, Irie Bliss exceeded my expectations in every aspect. From the vibrant atmosphere and friendly service to the mouthwatering Caribbean cuisine, it's a restaurant that transports you to the sunny shores of the Caribbean. Whether you're a fan of jerk dishes or craving some tropical flavors, I highly recommend paying a visit to Irie Bliss.

Thank you ;)  10 stars!", 'Jamaican food can be amazing & have good customer service. Don’t listen to the internet ! I was received warmly by Auntie & received my food rather quickly. The jerk chicken & fried chicken was amazing ! Next time I’m in brooklyn, I’m definitely pulling right back up.']

name: BROOKLYN WAFFLE HOUSE
reviews: ['This place is a joke. 1 star because 0 isn’t  an option. I ordered from Uber eats. My food showed up with a plastic utensil cooked into the waffle!!! Which I thought was white chocolate until I bit into it.  Not only that but I did a group order and half the order was missing. 3 beverages were missing from the order. Eggs were missing from the order. Their “Home fries” are  regular fries. pancakes were salty. grits were salty.  And Uber eats said I would get a refund but Is still trying to charge my card for this trash. First and last time ordering from this place. I should’ve paid more  attention to the 3.2 stars they gave a google. We were excited for a good breakfast and this was a huge let down', 'Everything on their menu is soooooooo delicious 😋 the French toast and pancakes were definitely my go to for breakfast along with the waffles 😋😊', 'To the person who packed my Uber Eats order this morning, you’re a real one! All I wanted was a thigh but minimum order amount I had to order more and got the red velvet waffles— blazing by the way—thank you for the pleasant surprise. And yall are making the ancestors proud with that fried chicken—which is seasoned to perfection and fried just so. And your shrimp and grits is praise dance worthy!\nSomebody in there got family from the Carolinas because it just isn’t fair what y’all are doing.', "I bought the curry chicken and the oxtail dinner. Both were very good, haven't been here in a while. The food tends to be up and down. These two plates were UP and I would definitely purchase these plates again.\n2nd visit and purchased the curry chicken again. Looks and taste even better. (Bigger photo).", "Ordered from uber eats it was fast delivery. Waffle was ok. The chicken had no flavor no seasoning and it was tough. Ketchuch hardly helped I was spitting it out. I'm sorry I ordered an extra piece. Couldn't even finish it.😖"]

reviews: ['I love to support my country, people restaurants. I am sorry that I have to write such a not so nice review but that’s how you improve on your business and not lose support/customers. I urge all food lovers to patronize this restaurant.', 'The food and service was TOP notch.
