name: KATOU RESTAURANT
reviews: ['Best haitian food in Brooklyn, been going there for years the cook never changed so same quality of food since over 10 years ago and oh yea they now have kids menu fries and chicken tenders made from scratch.', "They're a little hole in the wall mom and pop restaurant. There is nothing remarkable about it. The customer service is lackluster. They need to recruit someone one to teach them on how customer service works, and maybe their business can go to the next level. However, the food is AMAZING!!!", 'Best Haitian food in brooklyn! They’ve been consistent for years. My Orders are always correct and just as good every time. However, just be sure to order about a hour before hand because they do take long. Absolutely worth the wait though!', 'Delicious food. Nice owner!', "I don't like to cater hot soup in a plastic container that could be used for paint. Although I told him a security deposit for an aluminum container, the extremely hot soup was put in a plastic container. The whole thing would have been put in a heavy-duty doubled up aluminum tray."]

name: N’JOY FAMILY CAFE
reviews:
["Amazing place hidden the way you'd walk by and wouldn't know it's there, which would be a loss for you - food is great, waiters are there to accommodate any of your reasonable requests. Sushi are good, meats are good, salads are nice too. Octopus was fine and tender. A lot of room for kids to play. There are dedicated people to entertain  them, although you can see that takes toll on them. I enjoyed my time there, good place, good people.", 'I recently visited this fantastic restaurant in Brooklyn and was thoroughly impressed by the experience. The highlight of our visit was the exceptional service provided by a young gentleman at the counter, who reminded me of a character from “Peaky Blinders.” His professionalism, eloquence, and courteous demeanor made a lasting impression.

The restaurant features a wonderful children’s playground, making it an ideal destination for families. My children had a great time playing while we enjoyed our meal in a relaxed and welcoming atmosphere.

In a city filled with dining options, this restaurant truly stands out with the best service in Brooklyn. I highly recommend it to anyone seeking a delightful dining experience combined with top-notch hospitality. We will definitely be returning soon!', 'Amazing place! This was our third year cerebrating our kid’s birthday at Njoy and I hope we celebrate many more at this place. Food is so delicious, staff is very polite and friendly, I have absolutely zero complaints.
So if you are looking for a place for your next event or just a place to drink coffee while your kids play at the playground, look no further,
I promise you, you will not regret!', 'Very unprofessional dirty place. They charge for playroom and have no one to watch kids. They let big kids in the play with small kids and they bullie and kick and stuff does nothing. Never coming back and think twice before bringing your kids here. Half kids are sick, coughing and sneezing.
Disgusting place.', "What a gem! Don't let the name fool you, this place serves up delicious food like a real restaurant. There is a play area for the kids and restaurant area for adults to dine. We were invited as guests to a birthday party and had a wonderful time."]

name: UZ EXOTICS RESTAURANT
reviews: ['Great place! Very delicious food! Amazing presentation. Great service! Highly recommended.', 'Excellent food & amazing service. Highly recommended🙌🏻', 'very tasty and clean, I recommend', 'Waited for delivery for 3 hours and then they closed', 'Amazing']

name: SALLY'S SOUTHERN & BBQ
reviews: ["There Wings were fresh and amazing.  We got the horseradish and hot sauce wings. The burger was tastey and big. I got the brisket. It was juicy.  Nice portion and cooked perfect. We got the burnt pork ends. I prefer it  crispier than the way it came out. Ann was our server. She was on point in every aspect.  Beer was cold and no line taste. I'll be back!", 'YES! SO GOOD! I was happy to enjoy a lovely and delicious Saturday brunch here and I was super impressed. We enjoyed the cauliflower appetizer, bbq pastrami Reuben, smash burger, pulled pork, and some waffles with blueberry compote. EVERYTHING WAS GREAT! Our server was super attentive and kind. We were very thankful for all her recommendations. Give this place a try!', 'Food was amazing, but I definitely did not get the same amount of brisket as the last time.  It was chopped up and about 2 oz.\n\nThe first time I ordered it was at least 6 oz.  For $25 I expect to at least get one full serving of meat.  Again everything tasted amazing just short changed on the meat portion.  Also, I didn’t get a piece of bread this time either. Won’t get my money again.', 'Boy oh boy was the food here so goood! We started off with the pickle fries and they were so freaking delicious! I love pickles and this was the perfect starter. Normally places only have pickle chips rather than fries but I can definitely say that I’m a big fan of pickle fries instead. The breading for this was perfect and it was fried to perfection! It was still piping hot when they came out. We also got the fried chicken, burnt ends, and the Mac n cheese. We got two sides: coleslaw and mashed potatoes. The friend chicken was so juicy and it came with two types of sauces on the side (I believe one was a hot honey and the other was a spicy bbq?). The burnt ends were so savory, fatty, and flavorful. It melted so easily in my mouth and the bbq sauce that it was in was the perfect blend of smokiness and tartness. The mashed potatoes were super creamy and smooth and it was super rich and savory. The Mac n cheese was possibly my fav Mac n cheese I’ve ever had at a bbq joint. Everything was soo sooo sooooo amazing and we will definitely be coming back here. 100000/10!!!', 'The hostess, Jia, was very friendly and extremely helpful. I forgot my reading glasses and she helped me by read the menu. She even offered some suggestions. She was very patient when taking my order. I ordered the brisket, fried chicken, and burnt ends. Everything was worth the wait. It was delicious. 😋']

name: GYRO KING (STATEN ISLAND )
reviews: ['I had chicken biriyani from this restaurant. I literally loved this. The chicken was tender, well cooked, salad was fresh. As I like spicy, the spice level was perfect. Looking forward to visiting again. Nice staffs.Highly recommended.', 'I was with the family visiting Children Museum of Staten Island and was looking for halal restaurants nearby and found this hidden gem. It was definitely hard to find parking but eventually I was able to find it. They do have 2 reserved parking spots for the restaurant. I entered the restaurant and was amazed with great gesture the custom service personnel with her greeting us and handing us a menu to decide on what to get. She has made a space for us so my family can sit. We tried their Chicken Gyro, Philly Cheesesteak and Chicken Wings. I must say that everting was made fresh and the taste was delicious. I like how they have a small menu which does help in keeping better quality of the food. I would highly recommend this restaurant if you are around the area.', 'My first time eating here, I was impressed. I had the chicken and lamb combo gyro. It was tasty and delicious. I was pleasantly surprised with how much meat was packed in the pita bread. The store is very small with only about three tables. For a small restaurant, the menu has four pages of dishes to pick from. The owners are very friendly and the service is fast.', 'Great food! Service is exceptional and this is my 2nd time frequenting this establishment. I love their fried chicken and the lamb and chicken with rice platter.', 'VERY DELICIOUS FOOD! I ordered a chicken biriyani and it was very tasty and flavorful. Excellent fast food place. The service was good and was very quick!']

name: PANINI GRILL
reviews: ['Amazing food made even better by the excellent service! Ashley walked us through the menu with some great advice. The live band and Christmas decor made for a great atmosphere . We follow Peter on social media which lead us there. He came out to greet us and also sent us a pizza . Thanks again\nI have to say the last time I have had such a delicious Italian dinner was when I was in Rome!', "Highly recommend this place for date night or a night out with friends! My sister and I have been ordering take out from here for years. I've also come here several times to dine in as well. Each time I've visited, the service was always great. Tonight was no exception, Rey our server was so accommodating. We loved our food. Definitely will be back again.", 'I’ve been following this restaurant/Chef Pete on IG for a few years and for the first time for myself, my fiancé Arlene and I went last night for an early dinner. She was there last week with her family for the first time and she loved it too. She was super excited for all the beautiful Christmas decorations. The atmosphere is beautiful, warm and inviting. the stone and old style brick walls makes you feel like you’re in Italy ! Our waitress Jillian was great, she checked on us and made sure everything was ok. My heritage is southern Italy, all four of my grandparents come from Bari (Andria) and Salerno on my dad’s side and Calabria and Sicily from my mom’s side. We had to try the Panzoretti which is a staple food in Bari as an appetizer and boy that was delicious. Hot honey, figs and mozzarella gave it a nice blend of different flavors. Her pasta Rustica and my Penne Al Vodka with crispy chicken were both delicious! We will be back soon to try your pizza !!', 'Really impressed. Popped in for lunch before going to the zoo. Lovely setting. Great lunchtime menu. I decided on a salad and a panini for 14 dollars. Husband got a four cheese pizza for 14 dollars and added sausage. Were served the most delicious home made bread and dips. I got a sangria which was filled to the brim and really good. husband got a cocktail which was strong and well presented. Really genuinely impressed and would be back. Lunch for two with tax tip and a cocktail each was 80 dollars.', 'The garden was quiet and pleasant to eat in. The music and ambiance matched the menu options. The server, Michelle was amazing and attentive throughout our dinner experience. The food was delicious and large portions. Would highly recommend.']

name: WEST CORK GRILL
reviews: ['Was staying at a Richmond Hospital for 3 days and needed some good food for myself and to bring some food to nurses there. Started to look through the nearby food  places and found this small restaurant. West Cork Grill is a family-owned and operated restaurant located in Staten Island, New York. The restaurant serves a variety of Italian-American cuisine, including pizza, pasta, and sandwiches.\nI ended up taking a small catering platter of wraps, 2 extra sandwiches and a salad. All together set me back for $150. They prepared everything in a out half an hour and I was ready to go. Food tasted fresh and looked good. Chicken parm wrap was very good, ton of chicken in it. Staff was polite and quick. Good place, would do again.', 'Was invited there for a Press Night and it was fantastic. The people were friendly and warm and pizza and sandwiches were EXCELLENT. To too is all off, the night ended with a special dessert (and he doesn’t generally do desserts) by Executive Chef Mike DiLeo. It was a great night and met some great people.', 'Great place with lots of options of food. The staff is really friendly and the food came out in a decent amount of time. This place is really clean with indoor and outdoor seating and I would recommend anyone to go here.', 'Pizza is so delicious! We tried this instead of our usual Friday pizza place, and we loved it! So fresh and really great flavor. We will definitely return! Highly recommend the Margherita pizza - best I’ve had outside of Italy 🙂', "Ok, I have been meaning to do this for a while now. This place is just amazing!!! You can eat in or take out. Close knit family ownership with a nice Cafe feel. I had two slices of Buffalo chicken pizza & could barely finish them. Wasn't too hot & spicy... very pleasant. The taste was there without the discomfort. They clearly make the recipe for the sauce themselves because it's very unique. Most delicious Buffalo chicken I have ever had in my life. The slices & portions of anything you buy are on another level. Far exceedingly more than was needed to fill the stomach of this hard working construction worker, believe me. The owner is always there to greet his customers warmly, knows his regulars by name & I'm sure looks forward to you being his next new regular. It's a bit hidden... blink & you'll drive right by it on Henderson Ave... but mark my words... you want to find a parking spot & go in this place. It's you're absolute loss I'd you miss out on the amazing food & spectacular service here!!! Absolutely love this place... 5 stars just doesn't do enough here."]

name: NO. 1

They can be inconsistent."]

name: MAMA ROSARIA'S PIZZA & RESTAURANT
reviews: ['Ordered online and the pizza was really good.  We especially liked the Grandma pie.  Fresh ingredients (basil, mozzarella and pizza sauce on a thin rectangular crust).  My husband loved the stromboli.  Very good.  Highly recommend.', "It's a large pie with large slices. If you prefer a more well done pie then this isn't the place for you. That being said, i did consider it a decent pie. Best on the Island, no. Worst? Far from it.", 'I did a catering order for 50 people and had enough for 70+. The food was amazing. The penne vodka was gone in under an hour it was so good! Great red sauce on the eggplant parm and stuffed shells. All the food was great. I will now do all my catering from Mama😊', 'Bomb 🍕 pizza  it was really cheesy and the slices were pretty big. The sauce was perfect with the right amount of basil just fantastic, stop in grab a pie or get one of there many entrees and goodies. Great 👍', 'Generous amount of sauce and cheese.\nFlavor is good but not  exceptional. Crust is crispy and chewy, but too thin,  watery sauce makes it collapse when you try to fold it and hold it.\nDefinitely worth $2.50 though.']

name: CRISPY PIZZA
reviews: ['This place is definitely a hidden gem BUT they’re never consistent. They’ve been open for so many years therefore it’s surprising that I found a hair in my pizza. Not only that but it was a pie that we had gotten for take out so who knows how many hairs were actually in the pizza. Very  disappointing.', 'Pizza was good, sauce was a lil sweet calamari was good, wished they were a lil more seasoned. Inside the restaurant was super hot no ac and they do not accept Apple Pay or tap and go.', 'Crispy Pizza offers y hin-crust pizza, heroes and hearty pasta dishes served in a simple setting or for delivery. They’re located at 782 Richmond Avenue, Staten Island, NY 10301. They’re open every day as of 10:00 am and Sunday at 11:00 am and close at 10:00 pm. Service is quick and the staff is friendly. The pizza is delicious!', "The old Boro Fence Co where I worked for 3 years was replaced by crispy pizza sometime around 2012. The food was delicious Everytime I've ordered or walked in. Inside is beautiful. Amazing change from when I worked in the building. Great job.", 'I ordered the crispy fried panini took one bite and it tasted horrible bread is bland and this is the garbage I got. Rotten lettuce and tomatoes and rubber for chicken no taste to the chicken or breading at all. I called back they made me a new one and this time for no toppings on it and yet the chicken it harder rubber then the first one. When you cut costs to save a buck you use old chicken and reheat it and serve old rotten lettuce and tomato’s. Only thing I ate were the fries.']

name: YUMMY MACHI
reviews:
['Been here 3 times so far I am vegetarian but I love their rolls I got the special deal 3 for 13.95 amazing rolls tastes absolutely amazing. The lady in the front is very sweet and friendly. My go to place for sushi in staten island best for takeout as it is a small place. I also got miso soup has no fish broth. So far I tried the avocado cucumber, sweet potato, tofu, pumpkin roll all excellent.', "I love bubble tea & only reason I visit this place because of that lol. I can't eat their yummy food because it's not halal . Is very conveniently located near my area.

My mom was saying she always seen people eating something black from a drink lol, what's that ! So I took her the other day so she can try some . She has a very particular taste when comes to food. I played safe & got her a coconut bubble tea lol, nothing fancy ! Thank God she liked it. So if she likes it then I can confirm that it was good . And I got coffee flavored one .

Customer service could be better, store isn't that clean. They still have those plastic things in-front & I feel little  suffocated. But I understand that they just wanna stay safe & there is  nothing wrong in that .", 'In town for work and had sushi delivered to my hotel. 9pc sashimi and Tokyo roll. Both very good!', "The staff is so friendly. It's a family run business and everyone in there is really sweet including the little kids who hang with their parents. The food is really good for their prices, and they have great bubble tea. Always had pork dumplings, had chicken dumplings for the first time and I'm craving them already !", "The sushi was fresh, tasty, and not overpriced. The Kani Salad was amazing, beef and chicken terriyaki was cooked to perfection. We actually did take out catering for my daughter's birthday. Will definitely be ordering from here again for another event."]

name: LA CATRACHA
reviews:
['3 tacos ,a small plate of 2 slices of thin steak, with rice and beans, a 1$ Poland spring bottle, and a 1$ small 12 oz can of coke.

The total charge was 37$, 3 tacos were 12$, and they charged the rice beans and "steak" with water and soda at 27$. 100% not worth purchasing anything other than the tacos. The rice and beans were a rip off. And drinks were a rip off aswell.

Come for tacos, don't stay for the indoor dining or service.', 'Definitely one of my favorite places in Staten Island!  Thanks to el flaco and Diana, they are super kind and always treats me like family! \U0001faf6🏼', 'I had passed by La Tuna Restaurant (Even though it has the La Catracha sign in the window, the menus say La Tuna) several times when I parked to grab a slice from Brother’s Pizza across the street, and the restaurant always seemed to be filled with people, some of them dancing from time to time.

This time as I passed the restaurant, i stopped to look at the menu in the front window, and one of the folks in the restaurant came outside to see if I would like a menu and to come in. I am glad that I took an opportunity to try the place.

I had the Enchiladas Rojas for twelve dollars and my friend had a burrito for eight. The food is simple, tasty and filling. The portions are generous. As decor goes, the restaurant is pretty sparse. There are only about eight tables in the restaurant, and a small bar area that seats four folks. The restaurant is very much geared to be a local restaurant serving a Hispanic crowd, but I never felt unwelcome.

While there is a bit of a language barrier with some of the staff if you don’t speak Spanish, the warmth of service more than makes up for it. I recommend this place for a quick and tasty sit down meal.', "Its a Nice spot if you want to feel and taste a bit of of Mexico 🇲🇽 and Honduras 🇭🇳!!
Food was Amazing Service was appreciated and atmosphere was inviting and music playing while you eat definitely a plus! So check out La Tuna's (La Catracha) you won't be disappointed. 🥑🌮🍻🍹🍛🎵🎶😁🤗🤗🥑🌮🍻🍹🍛🎵🎶", "This place has amazing food. They do the little things right, that most places overlook. It's because they take pride in their work.
An unexpected piece of fatty chicharon in my pork taco is what won me over. Only someone who cares about the experience they deliver, would do something like that. Everything I've tried since then has not let me down, or let up."]

name: DI DI
reviews: ['I miss there a lot. I never had problems with the food. I remember playing Marvel vs Capcom back in the early 2000s. Why people are criticizing the food? People should enjoy it and respect the food. I left Staten Island summer 2015. name: J AND B PIZZERIA RESTAURANT
reviews: ['This is the pizzeria that someone mentioned as they were judging me for buying 2/$2 pizza slices from the nearby 7-Eleven. (I was hungry and that was all my budget for that day could afford.) “Some of the best pizza right over there,” was what Mr. Judgement said, referring to J&B Pizzeria. In my opinion (eating a straight up regular cheese slice), it’s good but not great pizza. I believe a high quality and distinctive sauce puts a pizza in the upper echelon. The sauce on this pizza kind of just blended in; the slice was carried more by the cheese. Very good amount of cheese; I was reminded of a classic greasy NYC slice. 3 out of 5 stars. Doesn’t qualify as “best” for me. I would probably enjoy slice more with some seasoning added. The crust is just a handle. The mark of super elite pizza is if you willingly eat crust. So many pizzerias have trash cans full of white paper plates & pizza crust. Final Answer: Way better than 7-Eleven, obviously. Price was fair ($3 and change per regular slice). I would eat again if in the area and wanting pizza, but wouldn’t go out of my way to return.', "$15.75 for 1 regular cheese slice and 1 order of mozzarella sticks(7 sticks)  I was dumb enough to pay so much for so little. Then to find that the pizza was OK and the mozzarella sticks were store bought!!! They didn't even make it themselves!!!!! I'm only one person, but it's definitely my First and last time here.", "over priced pizza $22.oo for a small personal Pepperoni pie extremely rip off I pay 10.00 every ware else don't recommend this place complete rip off not even a good pizzas", 'I purchased food from this establishment numerous times. Same order,same time same house. The price is never the same. They charge you $3.00 extra for a half slice of Italian bread. The straw that broke the camels back is when I order my kids slices of pizza only to get them home and open the box to 4 rock hard burnt slices of cardboard!!  I’ll never ever go to this place again!!!', 'I see a lot of bad reviews for this place complaining about the price, but nobody is noting that this pizza is not sweet. A lot of pizza places with "cheap" pizza have been stretching their ingredients with high fructose corn syrup and the result is a SWEET pizza instead of savory. I won\'t name other restaurants that do this, but it\'s a trend now. This place does NOT, the pizza is savory as it should be, the crust is thick and firm, a solid NYC slice of regular. I went during an off-hour so it was near empty but the service was spectacular. Yes, a slice is $3 and a pie is $20, but at least they make ACTUAL pizza.']

name: FARIDA - CENTRAL ASIAN CUISINE & GRILL
reviews:
['Having been to their 9th Avenue location, we were excited to have Farida open in our neighborhood. Have now been here twice. The menu significantly expanded in our most recent visit. Favorite is the pumpkin dumpling and baked buns. Food is good and attentive service. However, wish they could make more vegan versions of the Uzbekistan dishes such as plov so vegans can enjoy too.', "We had a great experience in this restaurant. The main traditional dish was amazing, but we didn't like their lamb kebab. The dumpling with the meat was great. Also, we tried the Mojito drink, and it was absolutely refreshing. The honey cake as well was great. The staff very friendly and respectful. Decoration was nice.
My only problem was the bathroom light that was blue and very hard to see. I don't know if It's always like that or only when we visited.", 'Incredible food, service and atmosphere and i don’t say that often. Food was very different and incredible. Our server made a few suggestions that definitely added to the taste. Service was amazing. Honestly couldn’t possibly ask for anything more.', 'Delicious and unique food. Great flavors, price, quantity. I wish there was one closer to me in Westchester. The service was exceptional too. To speak to a native Uzbekistan raised server who gave us advise on what to choose and if it was enough food for two hungry guys. The lunch specials are well worth it. I also got meat pies but ate them too quickly to take a picture. The pumpkin and cheese puff pastry appetizer is great too. Anything steak related is also good because they fire everything fresh', 'Food was good.
The level of service didn’t deserve my 20% tip. And I don’t want to come again.
1. No one came to our table to provide menus/water after we sat down for 10+ minutes. I tried making eye contacts, waving, and saying “excuse me” to multiple servers who walked past our table for at least 10 times because I really needed some water. Nobody responded or even noticed. Finally, one server came and told us they ran out of menus and asked us to check the menu online.
2. While we were waiting for the servers to notice our table, a “photographer “ came to offer taking some pictures of us. I thought it was weird and asked why. He clarified that we could buy the pictures if we liked any. I wasn’t feeling too good that night so I said no. But he presided and held up the camera to try taking pictures, saying “why not I take a few just you could see”. Like, NO MEANS NO! I have to say it in 3 different ways for the person to leave us alone.
Overall, the food tasted good but the service was the reason I wouldn’t choose to visit again.']

name: X-HALE CAFE/LOUNGE
reviews:
['I recently visited Afandina cafe and Hookah and was thoroughly impressed with both the hookah and the food. The ambiance of the place is warm and inviting, perfect for a relaxing evening. The hookah was outstanding—smooth, flavorful, and long-lasting. They offer a variety of flavors, catering to both traditional and adventurous tastes. The staff is attentive, ensuring that the hookah is always in perfect condition.', 'A very atmospheric place with a great variety of dishes on the menu. You can choose from something for lunch (with the option to assemble your own dish) to a sweet snack! I really like the salads and lunch bowls, and the new waffles with different fruit fillings will not leave anyone indifferent🥰', 'Had a few mango Tajeen and Pistachio Tajeen with tea and hookahs. Gotta tell you we were pleasantly surprised how tasty it was. Very nice atmosphere in the back area.
Thanks for the great service and we definitely are coming back.', 'So, I ordered a kale Caesar salad and asked for tuna instead of chicken. They served me what looked like cat food on the salad. I asked the cashier what was with the brown fish gunk on my salad. She went and brought me the can.

It was literal cat food.

Absolutely insane story to tell people lol', "I expected to see some interesting Turkish pastries but the box looked sparse of anything other than cupcakes/cookies. My iced coffee was fine but the vibe in the place just wasn't too great (no music playing). The menu also seems like a jumble to me and can use better design. Pricing looks high with a signature cheeseburger at $19.99. I think this place is riding partially off previous reviews before rebranding and that seems a little disingenuous. Overall I'd love to have a solid Turkish/Arabic cafe and the backyard is promising but the menu and ambiance can use some improvement"]

name: JOSEPH'S RESTAURANT
reviews:
['La cena perfetta …
We had the an amazing dining experience at Joseph’s. Astro and his team truly are world class restaurateurs. The food, service and our comfort level were perfect. It’s always nice to get treated like family, enjoy really tasty food and dine in comfort.
Grazie mille a tutti 💋', 'the Bass, it was delicious, skin was crispy and was just cook perfectly! Waiters were very efficient, definitely recommend.', 'Tucked away in the bustling heart of NYC’s Financial District, Joseph’s Italian Restaurant offers a pre-fix dinner option within a setting that exudes comfort and a welcoming atmosphere. Its proximity to the lively Stone Street and the renowned Harry’s Steakhouse adds to its allure as a dining destination in FiDi. The interior ambiance strikes the right note for a pleasant dining experience, offering a respite from the urban rush.

My decision to dine at Joseph’s was influenced by the promise of a serene environment paired with the convenience of its location. However, while the setting met expectations, certain aspects of the service and culinary experience left room for improvement.

The service was adequate up until the conclusion of our meal, when the attentiveness of our server notably diminished. The prolonged wait to request our check, seemingly forgotten after our table was cleared, detracted from the overall dining experience. Furthermore, the presentation of my leftovers in a simple plastic ‘Thank You’ bag, placed unceremoniously on the table before dessert was even served, lacked the finesse one might expect from an establishment of Joseph’s caliber.

Culinary-wise, the dishes were satisfactory, yet unremarkable. The steak, requested medium, leaned towards medium-rare, verging on rare at its core. Additionally, a specific request to substitute the mushroom sauce due to allergies resulted in a plain, sauceless steak, rather than an alternative concoction from the chef. This oversight was disappointing and contributed to the overall oddity of the meal.

The dessert course brought its own set of mixed feelings. While the tiramisu I received was enjoyable, the portion size compared to my friend’s—visibly about 20% larger—left me feeling somewhat overlooked. Whether my slice was unusually small or my friend’s was generously oversized, it introduced a sense of inconsistency that marred the end of our meal.

The value proposition of dining at Joseph’s Italian Restaurant is debatable. While the location is undoubtedly prime, nestled within the FiDi area and surrounded by ample dining alternatives, the culinary and service missteps suggest that there’s room for refinement.

In conclusion, Joseph’s Italian Restaurant earns a solid three stars from me. It stands as a nice spot in the Financial District with potential for greatness, yet the inconsistencies in service, culinary execution, and the dessert disparity suggest that there is yet some way to go in fully realizing its promise.', 'What a gem!  We had a meeting a few blocks away, found this on Google Maps, it looked interesting with Northern Italian cuisine. Early on a Wednesday evening—No reservation no problem. Great service from the staff, (many from Albania) wonderful atmosphere. Joseph’s is a gem. Food was excellent. Wine was great. Service very friendly, and accommodating.', 'Food was delicious.   Service was horrible.   We had to finally go to hostess and ask for our bill after we had sat there for 10 minutes after they emptied our table.  The manager brought 2 shots of tequila as an apology (which we did not want) but at least he made an effort.']

name: TWIST
reviews: ['I ordered the Deluxe special boil with garlic butter sauce and my wife ordered the shrimp roll. I thought the clams and shrimp were exceptionally big and juicy, and the garlic bread that comes with it is perfect to dip in the sauce. Delicious meal!', 'Lobster roll , garlic butter mussel very tasty & fresh. Lobster soup clam chowder just soso. Not real surprise. Service is very good. Definitely will be back for other seafood item next time.', '1-10 it was a 9 food was great fresh and they were very attentive happy hour is a must for us oysters are delicious and shrimp cocktail a def must', 'Definitely better the first two times I came around, this time the clams was not too fresh and the sauce was a bit bland. Needed a lil bit extra seasoning or something was missing. Garlic bread was still good, ambiance was just as good, and very calming background music.\n\nService was attentive, we were taken good care of and the bathroom is spacious and smells good.', "This place is great! The seafood is very fresh, and delicious. I tried the calamari, shrimp seafood boil, and the fried fish sandwich. All were great! The prices and portion sizes were good. They provide plastic gloves and bibs for the seafood boils. The restaurant is cute and clean, and the service was amazing. I definitely recommend checking this place out, if you're in the area!"]

name: EL SALVADORIN
reviews:
['Came in looking for the pollo guisado lunch special and was given a nice filling plate and ordered a pupusa revuelta to go.
The time to order was fairly quick but the pupusa took longer than I thought. The place seems to be managed by a few people and sold other products inside.
Interior isn’t as cute as other restaurants in the area but the food was definitely delicious.', "EL SALVADOR 🇸🇻
Excerpt from Eat the World NYC:
Quietly over the past decade or so, in addition to a few restaurants here and there, Central American-owned businesses have popped up offering money transfers and other services, and almost every Mexican grocery made sure to stock the goods that Guatemalans and Salvadorans were looking for to fill their homes.

As Industry City attempts to mine the neighborhood for profit and give nothing in return except to those already privileged, Sunset Park's thriving communities continue to say no and show there is another way. EL SALVADORin is not only a bustling restaurant with an expansive menu, it stocks products from the country and coffees from the region.", 'I really enjoy their pupusas, they’re amazing. Would recommend, it’s very rare to find a good pupusa place in Brooklyn but this was recommended to me and it’s great!', "Men, the tamales was on point, pupusas wa on fire 🔥 really enjoy the food. It was so good that I had to order a take out. I leave in New Jersey, can't wait to go back to El Salvador Restaurant. Perhaps next Saturday 😋😁", 'Honestly the food was great! But the sad part is how Loooong they take. No one is really available to take your order for one and then once you place your order it’s about a 30 minute wait. Then on top of that I ordered some things for take out and that was an additional 30 minutes. It’s sad because if they were any quicker this place would have some potential!!']

name: WRAPTOR RESTAURANT BAR
reviews:
['We stayed at The Lodge Red Hook. One minute walk to the corner you will find a wonderful little restaurant/cafe called Wraptor. We had the best meal in New York at this restaurant. Great menu, cocktail bar, and lovely staff.  Big shout out to our server Maribel, truly lovely person.
Food is beautifully presented and good servings. The atmosphere is really nice with music to your liking available. Open 10am to 2am. You can sit inside or out. Definitely coming back if we travel to New York again. Pricing is more than fair and the whole menu including breakfast items are available all day. Loved it!', 'I ordered the ribs. They were tender with the perfect amount of sauce. I also got the chocolate mousse. It was decadent and the flavor popped.', 'Stopped here since it was close to our hotel-very glad we did!
Awesome, friendly staff, great atmosphere, and tasty food.
Good price for the amount, and quality, of the food.
Would absolutely return!', "3 stars ... Food was good , could've been better if it was seasoned a Little more . Service was good , staff was friendly and attentive making our lunch quite pleasant, Given that we were the only customers at the time. However, I did find a significant aspect of my experience that could use improvement. While  browsing through the menu, I noticed that half of the selections did not have prices or pictures. This made it quite awkward to order, as I had to look up the items online to get a sense of their cost and appearance. I believe including this information directly on the menu would make the ordering process smoother and more comfortable for your guests. 20% gratuity was automatically added to the bill. Which is a bit excessive given the time, location, and number of party which is not mention on the menu as well.", 'Great place to eat. Friendly staff. Super accommodating to dietary restrictions. Great atmosphere. Generous portions']

name: DUMPLING CHINESE RESTAURANT
reviews:
["This is an amazing place to get Chinese food, the people are very nice and they were very fast in making everything. So happy they are grand opening for here If you're in the area and would love some great Chinese food from very neighborhood friendly people!", "I stopped by to try the lunch special. I got two chicken dishes.

The food was piping hot, tastes fresh, and was nicely seasoned. For the price, the amount of food is generous. This will definitely be my new post workout lunch spot.

The interior is small, and a little cramped. I'll maybe eat in there sometime; but I'm more likely to take my food home, or even take it into Blockhill Station next door to grab a beer with my meal.", 'I rarely write reviews, especially for takeout, but WOW.
Seriously, Dumpling Chinese Restaurant is some of the highest quality Chinese takeout I’ve ever had in my life.
I’ve ordered about 3 times now and nothing has disappointed. The wonton soup (and I find it very difficult to find great wonton soup at most takeout spots) is phenomenal. The portions and prices are fantastic as well.

I just got the Beef Pad Thai lunch special today and I couldn’t be more satisfied. SO flavorful. You guys have yourself a regular!', 'Ordered takeout after stopping by. The owner is a nice guy. Prompt delivery, food was hot and delicious. Will definitely be ordering from them again.', "This is a good Chinese restaurant, the owner's service is very good, and the dumplings are handmade like no other."]

name: RYAN MAGUIRE'S BAR & RESTAURANT
reviews:
['Had a blackened salmon salad and Guinness 0%. Say at the bar. Beautiful bar, bar keep, Annie, was not very kind, not a good sign as I am very sweet and usually loved by all. Salad was good not great. Salmon was not blackened, which is searing with an iron skillet with a lot of spice, Cajun style. It was instead obviously cooked on a griddle, rather dry, cooked through, not seared, should have known better than to order a Cajun dish at an Irish pub but then why was it on the menu instead of something more Irish such as prawns or something? The arugula and other ingredients were first rate though and the place is so pretty that I give it 4 stars!❤️', 'Great pub! Highly recommend fish and chips, and chicken wrap 👌🏻
Oh, and their cheesecake is pretty good too 😋', "A very spacious Irish pub walking distance from the South Street Seaport. We came here for brunch and had the Irish Eggs Benedict and Avocado Toast (with a poached egg).

We topped it off with a chocolate mousse cake (for good measure 😁).

Bonus: Maguire's has plenty of TV screens along the bar so this is a good spot to catch the big game!", "Nice Irish pub located in downtown, New York City. We've been there twice and the experience was amazing. Staffing was so lovely with us both times. Food is amazing - first time we've had the Ref Snapper, a special in the menu that was delicious. Good variety of draft beers, and a lovely atmosphere.", "Took some notes when I visited here on September 12, 2020 at 4:00 PM. My party and I were seated outdoors in this nice little alleyway where there wasn't much foot traffic around the restaurant. There were only a couple other parties besides mine eating outdoors so it didn't feel too busy and so the outdoor atmosphere was calming and the nice weather was a great bonus. The waitress was also very nice and attentive. As for the food, everything looked and tasted pretty good!

Two minor things that I would want them to improve on is for them to season their vegetables! A little bit of salt, black pepper, and/or butter can go a long way to make cooked vegetables taste a little bit better (otherwise they're completely flavorless!). Obviously this draws away from the healthiness of the vegetables, but when cooked vegetables are not seasoned well and paired with a steak and fries, I can't help but desire just a little bit of more flavor. Another thing I took note of was their Coke/Pepsi (I didn't write down which one), tasted VERY watered down which was especially surprising because it didn't even contain much ice. I asked for a refill at some point and the second one also tasted very watered down, so maybe their soda fountain wasn't mixing properly or something, but I didn't deem it as something worth making a complaint about.

Overall, the food and the service was great and those two things I mentioned are definitely not enough to drop their rating down a full star. I enjoyed eating here regardless and will return again soon to try other items on their menu."]

name: CASTILLO RESTAURANT
reviews: ['This “fritadita” with more (white corn) 🌽 and tortilla (potato patties) was superb! 👌🏼🤤😋😋 will comeback 🔜', 'Came with some friends on an early Sunday evening. name: HADRAMOUT RESTAURANT
reviews:
['I’ve been going here for over a decade and still really love it! They’ve really redesigned the space well, food is solid, and the staff are so kind. I always get the lamb ghalaba which you can’t go wrong with. Tanzina was my server and she was attentive, kind and gracious. The staff also gave me a plate of rice and chicken just because! Super generous and will continue to come back.', 'Restaurant was small in the basement but clean. Staff and owner was very friendly. Service was quick. Salad and soup was complimentary. Meal portion was huge. Food was fresh. Soup was delicious. Chicken Fahsa was exceptional. My friend ate lamb haneeth first time and she loved it. Brought half of the food at home. Loved the place. Would definitely go back.', "I've heard a lot about Hadramout and visited a couple of times, each visit offering a different experience. The first time was good, but the second time was disappointing. The food wasn't tasty, and the service was pretty bad. Although the ‘lamb Khabsa’ is usually really good, I noticed cleanliness issues during my second visit, with food scattered all over the small kitchen. I believe Hadramout can and should do better. With improvements, we could proudly visit them for the best Yemeni food! ✨🍲", 'Delicious authentic yemeni food. Service was great and efficients. Prices were reasonable.', 'This place is a hidden gem in Brooklyn Heights. This is one of my favorite restaurants in the area and I go here frequently. There is not a single dish that you can get that isn’t great.

The lamb is amazing. Fahsa Lamb in particular is phenomenal. The free warm tea is delicious and the deserts are great as well. The staff are so friendly and make the experience great

I will continue to come here for as long as I live in the area!!']

name: FERDINANDO'S FOCACCERIA
reviews:
['The food simply isn’t good at all. It’s actually kinda bad. It wasn’t fresh and heated in chef mike. That doesn’t work well for fried food (the chick peas) which should be freshly made. That’s kinda the whole point of going to a restaurant, to get decent food. The rice ball was badly made, oldish, and not heated up evenly/properly. It’s pretty clear that this place has been ruined. After 130 years it doesn’t deserve to stay in business with all the great alternatives out there. We were joking about how if desperate, we still wouldn’t eat this food and use it as bait instead.

The reviewers have clearly been deprived of decent food.

Also FYI it’s cash only and while I found out from reviews they really should make that clearer.', 'Brooklyn Staple Carroll Gardens Bring CASH we Ol’School ova here. Walking into this establishment brings you back in time. It’s simple and delicious. Order everything on the menu you wont be disappointed. I’ve been coming here for what feels like a lifetime and ordering the same thing. And it’s just as good as when i ordered it 30 years ago. When you make something good you just continue todo so no reason to change it. Also if you never had a Manhattan special ( espresso drink) they have it on tap. It’s the only spot i know that has it.MUST TRY. I hope they never change. Thanks as always', 'Because of the Google ratings, I had high expectations for this old-school joint. Once Joe’s of Avenue U was bought by Russians, the food went downhill; although, I hear it’s back in Sicilian hands. So pickings are slim for Sicilian food in this city. I guess because we can probably make it better ourselves.

The only good thing about this meal was the cannoli—the shell was crisp and the cream was delectable. However, the panelles were inedible. In general, nothing looked or tasted fresh, just warmed up in the microwave, but these had the most horrible flavor. I asked for a little sauce to see if that would help, and it tasted like they opened a can of plain tomato sauce, dumped it in a bowl, and then watered it down. Then they charged me $3 for that!! The caponata and rice ball were good but nothing special. I could make them both better myself or find them better at any Italian deli or butcher. It was very expensive and so disappointing. I would never come here again.

If you ever had a panelle from Joe’s of Avenue U, that is the best. Give them a try if you want Sicilian. Not this place.', 'Super nice waiter, patient with our group- we had an elderly indecisive relative with us who is not the easiest. My dad and I loved our food- we all shared the panelle special, he got the seafood salad and I got the spaghetti with clams and white sauce. It was all great!  Very cool to visit such an old part of the borough we are from.', 'Their food is literally so good. We cannot let this old school gem die!!']

name: 豐味轩海鲜餐馆 BIG 5 SEAFOOD RESTAURANT
reviews: ["Authentic and quick. Book ahead for large parties on holidays. For specialty dishes, some have to be requested before the day as they require importing of the more expensive ingredients or more work food items. We tried to order the stuffed large fried tofu but didn't know it was an order ahead item. We will have to come back for it one day because the picture of it inside the restaurant looks so good. The fried Lobster with sticky rice and salt and pepper fried fish pieces were amazing. Really good food. Street meter parking is up and down on 13th Ave. We took a menu from when we went back in 2023.", 'Came here for big dinner. Got a private room , free wifi , was about to link the TV and phone for photo slide during family gathering. Food was delicious. Service was decent. Only 1 bathroom in first floor, other bathrooms are in the basement. The way down is slightly scary.', 'Truly one of the most authentic chinese restaurant I’ve ever been to in New York. Whenever I’m in the neighborhood, I always come here knowing I’ll have a great dinner and an excellent time. This place may not look like much on the outside but the food here is amazing. It is truly a hidden gem.', "didn't get a chance to take pictures but the foods are absolutely delicious 🤤 big portions, budget, friendly waitress, 100% family friendly because the space they also have second floor with private room plus karaoke 😁 perfect for party and family reunion. so best option is to call in to reserve then you will enjoy everything", "Amazing food. I was hoeslty quite impressed with it all. Taste was there and the authenticity as well. The inside felt a little dirty but it's a Chinese restaurant. Price was fair and expect to pay for the quality. Stadf was ok, they weren't really focused on us as we were upstairs and it was during dinner time. Try the chicken, roast pork, duck. Etc"]

name: PROGRESO
reviews:
["Don't waste your money there!! If I could give this place zero stars I would, no air conditioning in 85° -90° weather, barely any lights, not even cushions on the seats, literally, hard cheap seats to sit on! Now the food, smh not worth it, cheap cheese that'll have a person in the bathroom with the runs all night! Everything else is poorly cooked & just simply not worth the money, time & effort to go there, if you can find a better Honduran place to eat, please do so, this place surely isn't worth it!!", "This review and images are based on orders from 2 different days. Some of the reviews I read of this restaurant almost diverted me from placing my first order, but Im glad I didn't bc their baleadas and pupusas are awesome. Yes, there will be a wait on orders you place for pick-up or delivery, especially on busy days/times (think Fridays & Saturdays). My first order was placed for a Saturday night's dinner, I asked how long the wait would be and the person who took my order had an accurate estimate of the waiting period. The wait was a long but I agreed to it, he was efficient and straightforward.

From what I've tried-Baleadas sencillas are great. Pupusas de queso y mixtas, are also great. Pollo con tajadas; I appreciated to be asked if I wanted my tajadas thick or thin, that was unexpected, specially after reading a handful of reviews about their customer service. The chicken thigh was juicy, however, the chicken leg was slightly undercooked, enough for me to not finish eating it. If you are a manager/owner reading this, a meat thermometer can easily prevent this from happening, losing customers and more importantly avoiding food poisoning! -☆

Over the phone and in person two different people took my orders, both were placed with no trouble, except for meeting the minimum requirement for delivery, I live a bit far but once I increased my total they were kind to deliver. Will give the pollo con tajadas a second try just in case the day I called the restaurant was saturated with orders and will adjust/update rating thereafter.

What I noticed from my second order and what consisted of first visit to the restaurant, everything is made to order, they sale home-cooked style meals, do keep this in mind and order before getting hAngry. I wanted to make sure I included this in my review bc some people seem to be expecting fast food from here and many have left harsh comments as if the pandemic hasn't taught many of us to be kind-er, people are making your meals in a kitchen not machines at a food factory.", "The food wasn't great.
I asked the waiter to turn on the 16 lights from the ceiling because they used 6 lights on the wall only not the ceiling.
She did turn the lights from the ceiling but than she was told by the owner to turn the lights off from the ceiling because it's how he wants for people to eat at his place with 6 lights on the wall.
If you want to eat here bring your flashlight.
I see how others gave good reviews but they must be family related.", 'They messed up my order but the food was still good', "Best Honduran food ever tried   it's a great place to hace dinner not the best atmosphere but the best food and good service"]

name: DARNA FALAFEL
reviews:
['A small place with pleasant music. The service was good: the staff was friendly, willing to help with the choice and give the best advice. The waiting time for an order was minimal.

👍The menu has everything you need - breakfast, falafel, platters, salads.
I tried the lamb platter ($14.95 + tax) - it was delicious, a big portion, you can take it for two.

💲The prices are reasonable, especially considering the quality of the products and the portions.

Darna Falafel is well worth a visit.
I will definitely come back!', 'Excellent falafels.
And excellent smoothies with lots of choices.
They also seem to have a large selections of salads etc.
Fun to fit on the street when the weather allows.', 'Hellz yea! This place will absolutely scratch the falafel itch you are having. The platters are also very good with and will leave you feeling full but not painfully stuffed. I would absolutely recommend checking out Darna if you are around and maybe even try their juices and smoothies.', 'Absolutely amazing…
I would say it’s more of a takeout restaurant than a dine-in experience.
I took the lamb platter with 2 extra falafels, and it was more than perfect!
The falafel might be the best I ever had, and the lamb was so crispy, savoury and delightful!
I highly recommend this wonderful restaurant!
10/10 ❤️', "Absolutely delicious! I've been here multiple times at this point and always have a great experience. The steak plate is so good and I love getting a side of their crunchy fries to go with it."]

name: NEW ASHA SRI LANKA RESTAURANT
reviews:
['The food had so much flavor and was seasoned so well. The owner Viji was very sweet and welcoming. She made sure you had the best dining experience. I felt like I was welcomed into her home. Coming here was worth the ferry commute.', 'If one looks for authentic home cooked Sri Lankan food, this is the place. The woman behind the counter (I assume she is the owner ) helps you out to make sure what you are looking for is met.
The food definitely reminded me of what I ate at home and absolutely carry the deliciousness of home cooked food.
The place is unassuming and very clean.
The day’s buffet is laid out in the counter. The owner will help you out with her friendly service to explain what is on offer each day and also will ask what your level of tolerance for spicy food.
With regard to drinks try out their passion fruit juice or if you have a sweet tooth the Sri Lankan Faluda!
This is the place for ultimate home cooked food in New York and the place makes all it worth to ride on the boat from Manhattan to Staten Island.', "It's just homemade Sri Lankan food, that is sooooo DELICIOUS! DELICIOUS! And the service comes with a genuine smile 😃! Hidden Gem 💎 in Staten Island. I guess not anymore. Don't go on Tuesdays they are closed. I eat there at least once a week! New Asha is Thee Best!!! Get that passion fruit drink! Thank me later!", "Being a Sri Lankan myself I can assure you, you can't expect anything more. Aunty Viji and her sis-in-law makes sure that you're being treated in the most hospitable way and you're being poured out with so much love and generosity for what you pay. I think that's what most special about this place. It's not just about the amazing food it's also everything else about that place. 2 of us from our group there were from KS, but I was wishing I could take aunty Viji to KS with me cuz she felt like home. I loooooved all the food I ate there and she even made us chai though it wasn't in the menu. (She does that to the special customers😉) I've added all the pics I took of the food and aunty Viji and her sis in law as well. රසම රසයි. ரொம்ப ருசி😍😇", "Best of Staten Hand's down. Make sure to go early to get the last Sago pudding!

The Mutton croquettes are too good, try not to eat a dozen!"]

name: UNDERHILL CAFE BROOKLYN
reviews:
['The owner, Isidoro, came to our table and took time to explain the dishes and made great suggestions. The fried feta with coating of honey was a great appetizer. We also ordered salmon and chicken gyros. I definitely recommend this restaurant for a taste of Greece.', 'Quite possibly the best gyro I have ever had, amazing ceasar salad and absolutely perfectly crispy and delicious calamari.

Also very nice and attentive service with nice outfoor seating on a beautiful block.

I can’t recommend this place enough!', 'First time here, we had a great experience. It doesn’t offer only Greek food, you can chose among many different dishes and the food is amazing. The owner was super nice, extremely kind and friendly.
We will come back for sure.', "This cosy place is fantastic. The Greek food is all cooked to perfection and authentic. The French toast is the best I've ever had and their wine list is stellar. The owners are the nicest guys too. Great food great vibes!", 'Great meal and service! Octopus, ribeye, and shrimp dishes were all phenomenal. Free baklava for dessert was a really nice touch. Looking forward to coming back and trying more!']

name: CHERYL'S GLOBAL SOUL
reviews:
['I came here with my girlfriend for brunch on a whim and we both thought that everything was perfect. The staff was warm and accommodating, the atmosphere was lively and inviting, but the food was still the most memorable aspect of our experience. I got the tilapia sandwich and she got the fried chicken sandwich. Both were delicious and cooked perfectly. I cannot recommend this place enough. We will be back for dinner soon.', 'Update 8/18
Walked In Had the Blackened Catfish 🎏 with Macaroni and cheese and spinach. I was able to taste the Jerk 🐖 Pork. Everything was good. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

To-go beverage Red Sangria that hits the spot. Flavorful with fresh fruits and other ingredient’s. A total recommendation.', 'This a fantastic establishment! I came with brunch/lunch with my mom. The staff were very welcoming and friendly and overall went above and beyond in their service. I had the pancakes with sausages and they were both sensational. My mother, who is pescatarian, had the portobello burger with fries and she enjoy every bite. I absolutely will be coming back in the future!', 'I love the vibe here. I’ve lived in the babe forever but just never made it here. It’s a cute neighborhood staple. By observation you can see how much the locals love to come and support and that they feel welcomed here. The servers are attentive and everything is clean. The menu is small but diverse. I had the fish and chips, my partner had wings and macaroni pie. The Mac was delicious. A little oily but that what cheese does. My partner said the wings were really good also. Ithought the fish and chips platter ok. The fries are delicious and the fish was crispy. I just am not a fan of tilapia. It’s a cheap fish that oftentimes takes on this muddy characteristic flavor wise. If they switched to another flakey white fish that isn’t basa then this would be a ten for me! I also wish the homemade hot sauce had a little more body to it. It’s so watery.', "The staff there are friendly and efficient. I've only been here during breakfast/brunch. Be sure to fill out the paper menu to order. If you like spicy ginger flavor, then I recommend their housemade gingerade. Food is hearty and tasty 😋"]

name: BLACK IRIS
reviews:
['The food is nice and the portions are good. The atmosphere is a bit fine dining but more homey and local style. The service is great. You should give it a try if you are the neighbor here.', '10/10 would recommend and a great option if in Brooklyn. I LOVE Turkish food, but hadn’t eaten much of it since moving to NYC.
I have found my place! The crust on the pizza is just delicious. The salads taste so fresh. And the lamb! I never clean my bone but had to with the lamb chops', 'Honestly i forgot  names but
1. The Dip Hummus plater was bussin and worth every bite esp the bana ganoush
2. Zaatar bread was super unique in the taste profile which i reccomend geting and the consistency of the bread was like thin pizza but also a pita??
3. The main dish with salmon, lamb chops and shrimp in skewers were a highlight. The  salmon was my favourite of all.

A really decent pricing quality and portion', "I was looking for a high end yet casual spot to eat while I was nearby working with my cousin and her associate.  Black Iris exeded expectations after I read a review about the hummus being bussin'.  Can confirm the bussin'", 'Was very excited to come here, but ended up being very disappointed. Came here for lunch and the restaurant was pretty much empty, but the service was unfortunately not great. As far as the food goes, I believe it is outrageous to serve canned grape leaves for $11. The beet salad was alright. My friend and I both got the chicken wrap and they were very bland- we only ate half each. The restaurant itself is very beautiful and I wish the rest was as good as the ambience.']

name: BIJAN'S
reviews: ['When you start dancing when you also start eating you know it’s a good vibe. Give it to me was playing while I ate the delicious eggs Benedict. The Persian slices give the flavors a great difference than the norm. Coming back again', 'Had a great time at Bijan’s in Brooklyn! The burgers are fantastic—juicy and full of flavor. They have a wide selection of draft beers, so there’s something for everyone. The atmosphere is really chill, with a friendly crowd that adds to the vibe. Definitely recommend checking it out if you’re in the area!', 'I have been stopping by this place for years and the crack soup and Persian wings are to live for! Also the service is great and the truffle flies are also delicious! Highly recommend. In a day that I need “a day”, I travel from Washington Heights just for something familiar that I love and this place is it. Hits every time.', "Very cosy place with a nice community feel. Staff are very friendly and attentive. The food is well priced and yummy! Bijan's serves unique Persian / American fusion.\nI had a flatbread with plenty of topping and a to die for chocolate mousse. Love the place!", "I am lucky to live around the corner from Bijan's. The food is wonderful but I have to say as always, the most important thing for me is the people. The owner Jahan kicked my derriere on a chessboard once and the food is amazing (especially the pistachio encrusted salmon!). You will most certainly not be disappointed by either the food or the people here. ♥️"]

name: THE SOUL SPOT
reviews:
['This place saved my life! A few weeks ago I had walked from the west village to across the Brooklyn bridge, and by the time I got to this place I was dehydrated, hot, and starving. The reason I walked over here in the first place was actually for another restaurant but upon arriving there it was CLOSED. And as I said I was SO HUNGRY and had no clue what to do. Just as I was about to lose all hope and plopped down on some stone steps, I looked to my left and laid eyes on the Soul Spot. It truly saved my life. The air conditioning was cranked up and the food was well prepared. Very reasonable prices, with a great selection. Everyone was so nice! As soon as the Mac and cheese touched my lips all feelings of hunger and tiredness melted away. I owe this place my life.', "We ordered several different dishes so we could mix and match our dinner. Had the oxtail, beef ribs, and turkey wings for our meats. For the sides, we had mac n cheese, cabbage, potato salad, and white rice. All the meats were delicious, very different taste than what I'm used to and I loved it. The ribs sauce had a sweetness to it. I didn't enjoy the cabbage or potato salad, which is why I gave a 4. but the mac n cheese was amazing. The ladies at the counter were super nice and welcoming.", 'This place is AMAZING. First and foremost food is halal! Restaurants diversifying halal cuisines in NYC are always welcome !

They have a huge hot display of a variety of classic Caribbean/ southern soul remixes. I ordered chicken 2 ways and my cousin ordered the fried chicken.  The chicken was succulent and flavorful while maintaining juiciness!  The sides (Mac and cheese , tostinas, okra) were filling and well made as well.

My only complaint is I receive the same type of chicken when I ordered two different types. 😢
Would love to see this expand as a restaurant for family dining.', 'I was craving some oxtails and ran into this place on google and I tried it out the two ladies were friendly and they pack the container very well .

I had gotten oxtail with rice and peas and Mac and cheese.

Oxtail was very tasty but seasoned
Rice and peas was very good as well
Mac and cheese was delicious and perfect texture for me .

I had also gotten a cheesecake and banana pudding.

Cheese cake was delicious
Not really a fan of Banana pudding but this one was good too.', 'We heard good things about this online so when we were staying in Manhattan we couldn’t not get the subway over to Brooklyn and as part of our final day in NYC before going back to London we ate here. Very small but just about able to pull 5 chairs together to eat. Between us we had some curried goat, fried chicken, oxtail, rice n peas, veg rice, Mac n cheese and the cornbreads. The food is amazing. The service is great- very friendly and welcoming. Great to see a black owned business (we are all Black British). Wish we lived closer! The portions were humungous! Great spot to eat. If you’re close enough and lucky enough to live near here - you will have plenty of food for your leftovers the next day!']

name: CHAMA MAMA
reviews:
['A Must-Try Georgian Gem in Brooklyn, NYC

This is hands down one of the best, if not the best, restaurants I’ve eaten at in Brooklyn, New York City, from an ingredient quality and flavor perspective. The Georgian Salad is absolutely sensational—fresh, vibrant, and full of flavor. The bread with cheese (a mix of four different cheeses and egg) was good, though slightly overrated in my opinion; it could benefit from a bit more seasoning to balance the cheesiness.

The Khinkali with lamb was decent, but the lamb could use more seasoning, and the dough could be thinner to enhance the overall experience. On the other hand, the cabbage dish was out of this world, and the chicken was fantastic—tender, flavorful, and perfectly cooked. The Georgian wine was another highlight, and I would highly recommend trying it.

The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, making it a great spot to hang out with friends. The staff were incredibly hospitable and provided excellent service. While it is a bit pricey for the portion sizes, the overall experience makes it worth a visit. If you’re in Brooklyn and looking to try authentic Georgian cuisine, this place is a must!', 'Georgia is basically in the middle of where Europe and Asia meets within the Silk Road. At Chama Mama, you can find the flavors of those cultural influences where foreign ingredients and styles are incorporated together. Step foot in this beautiful restaurant with real lit candles with amazing hospitality for flavors of the world. Try out some appetizers, salads, and soups then Chama Mama’s famous kebabs and mtsvadi. Add a bread for a complete meal. Stop by Chama Mama and try some delicious Georgian cuisine with three convenient locations located in Chelsea, Upper West, and Brooklyn Heights.', 'The food, service and setting were all great! There were so many different menu options to try. There were three of us and we ordered a variety of things to share. The food was so fresh and the dumplings were very unique and delicious! We also each tried a wine flight- which was fun!', 'This is hands down one of the best if not the best restaurant I’ve eaten at in NYC by ingredient quality and flavor POV. The Georgian salad is sensational. The bread with cheese was unforgettable. The cabbage was out of this world and the chicken was fantastic. Also the wine flight was AMAZING. We wanted to go straight back the next day and Michael was so welcoming and gave the best service.', 'Great place to taste Georgian food, big highlight to the Kachapuri - delicious combination of egg and cheese in a crusty bread. The service was excellent. My only suggestion is that we also ordered the Taste of Georgia but is a little bit expensive for what the dish is. But genuinely an amazing that we will go back again to taste the rest of the menu and repeat the Kachapuri']

name: AL BADAWI
reviews:
['An outstanding restaurant with exceptional service and a great atmosphere. The appetizers were delightful, and the main courses did not disappoint. I especially loved the rice, and the quipes and lamb were absolutely delicious. I’ll definitely be coming back soon!', 'Al Badawi is truly a gem for anyone who loves authentic Palestinian and Middle Eastern cuisine. From the moment you walk in, you’re greeted with warm hospitality that makes you feel like family. The atmosphere is cozy and inviting, with beautiful touches that transport you straight to the heart of the Levant.
The food? Absolutely phenomenal. The flavors are vibrant, rich, and deeply satisfying. Their musakhan is a standout—perfectly seasoned and tender, with just the right balance of spices. The fresh-baked bread is heavenly and pairs perfectly with their creamy hummus and smoky baba ghanoush. Every dish feels like it’s been made with love and care.
What sets Al Badawi apart is the attention to detail, both in the food and the service. The staff is attentive and happy to explain the dishes, making the whole experience even more enjoyable.
If you’re looking for a place that serves incredible, authentic Palestinian food in a warm and welcoming environment, Al Badawi is a must-visit. I can’t wait to go back and try more from their menu!', 'Middle Eastern restaurant serving fresh and delicious food. We sat at the bar and got a great view of the staff making fresh pita (which was fluffy and chewy). Our main dish was a fall off the bone tender lamb in a seasoned rice mixed with some veggies. The spice flavor was outstanding and the dish was filling.

Service was friendly and top notch, overall a great experience and highly recommend.', "I visited Brooklyn a few years ago, and ate beside this restaurant so I made a mental note to come back again. Came here in Feb while on a trip to NYC, and we trekked out to Brooklyn specifically to show support to an awesome local Palestinian restaurant.

It was a busy night when we walked in, but they still seated us and the vibes were bustling inside. Service was fast but not as attentive in terms of filling up water etc, but no fault of their own!! They were incredibly busy and doing their best, as this is a family run business. The food was bomb, love zaatar always. The hummus was so authentic and fresh, delicious, and same with the fresh hot pita that came with. My partner's platter was also very filling for him.

Hope we get to visit again!", 'The mix shawarma was out of this world — likely the best I’ve ever had. I will remember this meal, the atmosphere and music, and the above and beyond service for a very long time. There’s not many restaurants I would go to multiple times in NYC, but this is absolutely an exception. It is worth going out of your way for.']

name: EL COFRE
reviews:
["I tried this place cuz a coworker brought chicken from here the other day that was pretty good.

I ordered and was disappointed :(

'mixed vegetable salad'...is actually just lettuce, some tomato slices and cucumber. Literally not mixed vegetables. I hate lettuce

Also the Bistec is overcooked shoe leather. Had so much trouble cutting it with a knife, i just threw it out.

I spent $40 for this??? :(", 'I went to the store on Wednesday September 4 at 6:07 pm. The lady at counter was on phone. I waited for her to finish but she didn’t bother to even acknowledge my presence. After 5 min wait, another gentleman came, as soon as I opened the door to leave she started speaking to the other gentleman man. They will only serve you based on your good looks.', 'Ordered four dishes around 95 dollars through seamless. Food was cold upon delivery, missing one item. Called and spoke to the manager. He said they don’t deliver through seamless so there was nothing he could do. I told him I have an email with my order number and his restaurant’s number in it, hence how I called him. Asked him how I ordered from his restaurant when they don’t use seamless. He said he had no idea. Don’t order from the restaurant.', 'This is an indispensable neighborhood spot. Authentic, cafeteria style Dominican food. They have many roast meats options, lots of stews, puff pastries that looked similar to empanadas, and different kinds of rice as well as beans. They also do a variety of soups.
The lady who made my plate was so sweet and gave me recommendations, and filled my plate with HEAPS of food, thank you!
The roast pork with red beans and rice was delicious. The pork was succulent and generously portioned. They put a few spoonfuls of meat sauce over the food which made the plate extra juicy and flavorful.
Very cheap prices! Best value on Myrtle Ave 100%.  My plate of sooo much rice, beans and roast port was only $11. It was really two servings worth of food.
They also do a lunch deal for $10.
I am so glad I tried this place out. I will be back! The roast chicken looked amaaaazing!', 'First, I went around like brunch. The people that run it are unprofessional. They are talking to eachother and on a phone call. She saw me come in and there wasn’t alot of people. She didn’t help me untill I basically went over the counter said hello excuse me. The food is hella expensive because it’s in a expensive area. A meal that would cost me $15 with a drink cost me $28 with no drink. The food. OH NAUR. The chicken it’s old. The save the food from previous days and just heat it up. The chicken is like dry and sour. The rice is either cooked like soup or raw with pieces of raw rice. The mangu was okay barely any seasoning tasted like nothing. The cheese was hard and cold. I wouldn’t recommend please just go somewhere else where u can have good warm food.']

name: KITCHEN GRILL
reviews: ['This is a great neighborhood spot. The food is packed with flavor and the service is top notch. The samosas and chutneys are stand out apps, the lentil soup and daal are absolutely divine and there’s a really good choice of curries. Will be back for a biryahni next time!', 'Cute restaurant with great service and food. The server was very attentive and they have great deals like two entrees and an app with bread for only $32. Food was very tasty and they even gave free dessert', "Super duper delicious spot with lovely staff and great prices. My favorite bite was the goat in the biryani, it was so tender and succulent! Everything else was very good. My only complaint is that the chicken in the butter chicken was just chicken breast, and overall there wasn't much spice in anything, but I think both of those issues are just a byproduct of being in Clinton Hill and not a significantly Indian neighborhood. Overall great flavors and great prices!", 'I live very close to this restaurant and I love their Indian food.  My fiends literally come over and would rather order food from here than make dinner together. Also they have a great dinner special. Main, appetizer and Nan  for like $21. They give very generous portions.', 'This food was so good, I came in hungry after a long day. Our meal was so relaxed and yummy. I left feeling warm and full - not only of quality food but also of the kind service and great atmosphere.']

name: LA'MODE BK
reviews: ["My family and I enjoyed this Carribean Asian inspired restaurant. You can tell the chef and cooking staff take proud in preparing each dish. Every bite was flavorful. Nay was our server, and very attentive. Lastly, the atmosphere is welcoming.  I can't wait to visit again 😊.", 'The food was truly delicious, with each dish delivering a satisfying burst of flavors. The jerk chicken, served with creamy rasta pasta, was perfectly seasoned with just the right amount of spice. The meatballs offered a delightful mix of sweetness and heat, creating a memorable taste experience. The oxtail, rich and spicy, paired wonderfully with the steamed cabbage and rice, bringing all the flavors together for a balanced and hearty meal.', 'My boo surprised me and brought me to La Mode BK as a post birthday celebration and I must say from beginning to end it was beautiful. Our server Shenese was very attentive and her recommendations did not disappoint. Let’s not talk about the special red velvet birthday cake! It was an amazing experience and we will definitely come again! Thank you La Mode BK for making my birthday extra special. Muah!', 'We came here for my moms birthday and the atmosphere, music, and food was all 10s. Our server Nay was so nice and attentive the whole time. There was a big group here and she made sure our orders were put in asap. The drinks took a while to come out because of the big group but she was very apologetic and after that they came out fast. Highly recommend going here!', 'It was amazing experience. It was my first time and I enjoyed it all . The food was great Mock tails were great. Nay our server was very friendly and  good to us . Will\nCome back soon. Thank you NAY !!!']

name: EL CONTINENTAL RESTAURANT
reviews: ["I just stopped by for a quick bite. There's a lot of seating. Besides the seating at the front of the restaurant there's another room for more guests. The staff is friendly and pretty quick to respond. I had Papusas and an horchata. They food and drinks was okay but didn't particularly stick out.", 'finally got the try the spot and it was good overall. had the chicarron, pupusa, horchata, and steak with onions. good vibes with people chillin over coffee and futbol.', 'A pre-cooked soup , nothing like a good fresh beef soup .', 'Service is great and fast. Food is awesome and flavorful. Place is clean and has a good vibe. Great for families. Overall my experience was great can’t complain. If you are in the area and want some authentic Salvadorean food then try them out.', "Great place for regional Central American fare. Chicken Tamales we're great, but I come here for pupusas! The bean and chicharrón are amazing and the toppings are great. Ask for their jalapeno sauce for an added kick. Great prices and nice homey interior! Highly recommended!"]

name: DAO PALATE
reviews:
['They have delicious vegan dish! I ordered TomYum noodle soup with meifun and it was delicious. It had plenty of veggies including mushrooms and I loved the taste.
It’s a cozy place to have a meal! I recommend if you love veggies!', 'Delivery via DoorDash was super quick and food arrived boiling hot. We liked most of our food, and they’re a solid option for vegetarian Asian cousin nearby. We will order again.

Pad see ew was good, shumai too. We didn’t like the tom yam soup.', 'Amazing vegan spot so close to Barclays stadium and Brooklyn Museum/Prospect Park. The menu is entirely vegan and has delicious classics like the vegan sweet and sour chicken, drunken noodles, and miso soup. The miso soup really hit the spot with this colder weather

Place felt super low key and you could easily miss it walking by. Pretty spacious and open dining area. We were the only people there! Would love to come back and try some more selections 🤘🏽', "I've gone here several times with my friend for lunch and we're always the only ones there! The food is scrumptious and the prices are super reasonable... give them some business! You will not be sorry!", "Would be cool to see Dao Palate go full vegan someday (they offer dairy for coffee), but all the food is vegan!  Cheap lunch special price for the size and delicious food. Will definitely be returning to try more. Would be cool if they could serve the miso soup in something other than a Styrofoam bowl, and could maybe tone down the saltiness, I always pass on it.  Lately I've been getting the dinner size for the higher price because they give much more food, and you can choose just brown rice and salad on the side.  They don't usually respect requests over the phone to forego the pastic bag, napkin or utensils unfortunately, would be nice if they asked you if you want them each time.

I've tried, the scallion pancake starter (delicious), and for lunch specials: green tea cold noodle (tasty but could have had some more ingredients than a single grape tomato), Mai Fun Noodle w/ fish cake, Red Curry Seitan, Malaysian Curry stew (excellent), and Eggplant & String beans (surprisingly incredible sauce)."]

name: IKEA RESTAURANT
reviews:
