['After hours of shopping, we got hungry and stopped by the restaurant. Food there is always fresh, delicious and cheap. We had  the Swedish meatballs ( both original and plant based ones) and they were delightfully flavorful, perfectly complemented by the creamy gravy and tart lingonberry sauce. Baled cod was also delicious. Of course we finished with desserts - cheesecake and almond caramel cake.', "Love the Swedish meatball plate here. Great value for money. The staff is surprisingly pleasant considering the crowds they deal with. Lines can be long, especially if both service sides are not open. The soda machines are often not working that well and you have to be careful about which flavor you choose, if you like carbonation.

Note I think the restaurant opens at 10am, but they don't serve the meatballs until 11am. That is not clear on their website or on any signage. There is plenty of open and well lit seating due to the floor to ceiling windows.", 'French fries were wet because of the salad they were added to the dish. Which was unpalatable actually. As a result, the entire impression of the dish was spoiled. My recommendation is to avoid their meals and pick your portion  by yourself. Generally I like IKEA restaurants very much.
Also could you provide a Stockholm salad recipe?', 'The good is IKEA like any IKEA any ware. It’s cheap and it’s tasty.
Today the cafeteria here in the Brooklyn IKEA was a disaster. No staff. The poor 3 or 4 people behind the counter had no back up and had to do all the refill as well as the service. Both lines periodically came to a total stop.
What a circus.
Dear management. Are we cutting down on staff or are we not paying them enough so no one wants to come to work ???
???????', 'It was great but she didn’t eat her peas!']

name: MOLKAJETE RESTAURANT BAR
reviews:
['We were celebrating a birthday there. What a welcoming beautiful place with delicious food. Literally every dish we ordered was tasty. We loved the atmosphere,  excellent service and great food. Definitely coming back for the best ceviche.', 'Beautiful dinner this evening! I forgot to take photos of the amazing and perfectly cooked chicken wings, and of our lovely margaritas!  Our dinner was spectacular! Enchiladas were delicious, the chicken tender, the sauce tangy and perfect temperature. The flan for dessert and beautiful dessert shot topped everything off perfectly. The manger and sister were both so attentive and helpful. We will definitely be back!!', 'Went here on a friday night last week. The place was empty but we decided to give it a try.
Everything was great - the food, the drinks, the service and the ambiance.
For drinks we ordered smoky paloma and a sangria. Both were very well made.
Then we got a classic ceviche to share, which was also very tasty and with the right amount of spice. I got fish tacos as the main course, which i loved. My hubby got the roasted half chicken, which arrived with the side of rice and beans, as well as a salad. His chicken was a bit dry, but he ate most of it nevertheless.
We will definitely come back!', 'We came specifically for the ceviche and it did not disappoint! The portions and the presentation were just as well thought out as the flavors. The mocktails and dessert were very tasty as well.', 'Food was good. Service was great. I recommend the enchiladas, and the half chicken was good with the green sauce but lacked some juice and flavor. Same with beans and rice. Drinks were great and price point was also nice. Good ambiance for a date!']

name: IX RESTAURANT
reviews:
["Pepian soup was 4 out of 5, besides the great flavor and taste that I was getting from each ingredient I couldn't stop tasting the bitter note at the end of each spoonful, perhaps too much cinnamon was added.
The sandwich veg, egg, and cheese was 4.8 - when I held the sandwich, the bottom bun was soggy but the flavor was very good.
The salad served with the sandwich was a 5. Simple, flavorful and pleasant smell.
The best part was me and my partner planned to divide our food when we got it, but we received two separate dishes, each had a small sandwich and bowl of soup, I was so excited! Top tier customer service.", "Great rice and beans! The ribs were savory and the Guava drink was so refreshing. Highly recommended! Don't forget to ask for the Hot Chocolate before you leave!", "I think this might be my favorite restaurant in the city. The service is wonderful, the food is so good- the vegetarian options as well. I rarely have room for dessert but this place is worth a stop by during the day for the hot chocolate and dessert and a separate return for dinner because it's fantastic and substantial. The art, ambiance, and music make for a wonderful experience. I learned they have live music on Saturdays and few other occasions as well. 10/10 zingy salad is so good and I usually go for a soup!", 'A very welcoming restaurant. I’ve never eaten Guatemalan food before the weight. Staff was very helpful in explaining the menu and I had it delicious Caldo soup bowl, which really hit the spot!', 'This is a hidden gem that I almost wanted to keep to myself! Super adorable! I happened to be at a nearby place and heard Jazz music playing from this spot. I walked over and was greeted by a great band and vibe! The staff here; super-friendly, welcoming and warm and the Cacao was soooo good. This is the perfect Fall hangout spot. Love it!']

name: NAMES
reviews:
['Solid neighborhood spot. The spicy chili garlic paste was amazing and added a ton of delicious flavor to the ramen. The ramen was pretty good too. Honestly I usually like non-traditional ramen more and this was no exception. The broth was delicate and not overly salty. Would love to come back to try the mushroom ramen sometime. The fries are good too.

Was not a huge fan of the drinks, though the descriptions were enticing.

The service was excellent and there is plenty of outdoor, covered seating.', 'Spicey chili ramen topped with fresh ingredients and the warm cheesey mushroom pizza were delicious! Got food to go and came back the next day to dine in. Cool atmosphere and small bar have a great vibe. We shared one bagel platter for two people. Fresh made herb cream cheese with delicious salmon, crunchy garlic pickled cucumbers, red onion, capers, and fresh sliced tomato on a toasted everything bagel. Yum! Check their Instagram for pics and videos. This place will be your fave in the hood too!', 'Good food, fresh and tasty.
I was surprised how quickly we got our food, almost like fast food.
Very poor-tasting drinks, badly prepared, concentrate only!!!!
I do not recommend.  Next time I will only drink beer.', 'The service can be a little weird here depending on who your server is. Been here a couple times now and there are two servers I experienced that were wonderful and two who were not (not really welcoming or prompt with taking orders and filling water) but the food (which is always tasty), the live plants and the music is what brings me back.', 'Solid first visit. Took advantage of the Happy Hour Cocktail of the Day and it did not disappoint (think old fashioned with tequila). And the Spicy Curry Ramen was solid in terms of flavor though certainly could’ve been more dynamic/more spice. The wait staff was alright and service was fast— certainly gave off a quick-dining experience. Seems like the sort of place though that the more you go the better decorum you build with the staff.']

name: TERRACE RESTAURANT & BAKERY
reviews:
['We stopped by here for lunch while checking out the Fifth Avenue Street fair. We got seating in the shade. It was a very sunny afternoon.

Not sure if it was the crowd of the day or us not knowing exactly what we wanted, but the lady taking the orders seemed to be very bothered. We love it when the host can help us find the specials and house favorites.

We ordered Mexican, which is always a safety for us, as I am vegetarian. The food was very tasty and the drinks did the trick! Seems like a nice local place. I guess the normal brunch is a nice experience!', 'We loved our experience at the "Mexican Diner" Terrace Restaurant. We came here at the end of a fun day just looking for a quick snack and drinks. We ordered three drinks and some appetizers, all of which came out wonderfully!

I didn't know exactly what to expect, but if you take your everyday diner and combine it with mostly Mexican offerings, it is a complementary combination with wonderful options! Will definitely be back –\xa0especially when we show new people around town.', "I really liked this place! I wanted to have a delicious breakfast because I didn't have time at home. I ordered a Seeley Croissant sandwich and latte coffee. Everything was very tasty! If I'm here, I'll definitely come here for breakfast.", 'Very large menu with so many different options to pick from! Definitely a diner experience with some fun twists to it!! I would definitely suggest checking them out!', 'I recently dined in and had an outstanding experience! From the moment we walked in, the vibrant atmosphere and welcoming staff set the tone for a fantastic meal. The menu offers a wide variety of authentic Mexican dishes, and everything we ordered was bursting with flavor. The guacamole was fresh, the tacos were perfectly seasoned, and the enchiladas were melt-in-your-mouth delicious. The margaritas were also top-notch and complemented the meal perfectly. The service was prompt and friendly, making us feel right at home. This is hands down one of the best Mexican restaurants I’ve ever visited. Highly recommend!
Our server Juan is the best!']

name: GOLDEN KRUST CARIBBEAN RESTAURANT
reviews:
['Firstly, the price was ridiculous as you can see from the photo receipt I uploaded. Okay so, I have bought Golden Krust in Queens, Harlem & Brooklyn before, but none of them tasted as bad as this one. I bought jerk chicken and rice & peas for one of the order. The rice & peas is usually ONE type of peas, but the peas was a mix of another kind of peas, which had me totally confused. The chicken was kind old/stale, I don't really know to explain it & of course, it was not spicy. The other order was curry chicken and rice & peas, but had the same issue, the chicken seemed "old" and the peas were a mixture of two different kinds of peas. The bright side about this is my son said that the curry chicken tasted good.
I also bought a beef patty and coco-bread along with 1 soda, which came up to over $30.
The atmosphere seemed as if we were at a place back in the early 2000's, it was not appealing to the eyes.', 'Today Thursday 11/21/ 24 . I stop by and ordered Breakfast! !! Wish was very  good 😃  as a real Jamaican 🇯🇲 their fry  Dumping  was great 👍🏿 not oily .like some other golden krust 😎', 'I stumbled into this spot and didn’t regret it!! Oxtails are always a winner. I ordered the small portion and it was packed with the rice and bean and tender oxtail. The oxtail was tender and flavorful! The lady that took my order was helpful and sweet. I finished the whole order in the car. I didn’t want to share it with anyone.', 'PURCHASE AT YOUR OWN RISK
This the last time I order from an establishment with NO PRICES of the food. Was charged $11.96 for a SMALL container of 3 plantains 2 piece fish and cabbage. FISH IS NOT FRESH IT IS HARD AND STALE (picture enclosed) I have purchased in past/days/weeks and the price of the food was never the same. Unfair to the community.', 'DO NOT EAT HERE THE FOOD IS DANGEROUS . I FOUND A BUG INSIDE MY FOOD AS SOON AS I OPENED IT. I CALELD THE RESTAURANT 10 MINUTES AGO AND THE LADY SAID “OH” …. BE CAREFUL BELIEVE THE RATINGS. GO TO ANOTHER GOLDEN KRUST EVEN ITS A 3MILES FROM HOME.']

name: GOLDEN KRUST CARIBBEAN RESTAURANT
reviews:
["I paid too much money for the quality of food that I received. This place used to be my favorite Golden Krust location, but not anymore. I bought 2 oxtails dinners and they were HORRIBLE! I don't know if they got a new chef or they get their oxtails from a different company now, but whichever it is, it's not worth the money that I paid. I traveled far just to go to this particular restaurant. The 1st day I got home and we started to eat our food we could not continue eating it. The oxtails were very tough and dry, they weren't edible at all, even the rice and peas tasted different. I called the restaurant to tell them about my experience and the person I spoke to was very nice about the situation. She said she would give the info to the boss and they would call me soon, but make sure I keep the receipt. 3 days passed by and nobody ever called me back, so I decided to take that journey and go in person. I gave my receipt and explained what happened, it took a few minutes for them to call the boss for a decision. So the guy (not so friendly) started to make 2 of the same dinners that I had an issue with. I get home (mind you I traveled far), the oxtails were a little  bit softer but the taste and the texture was just HORRIBLE, again. Their oxtails are definitely NOT the same anymore. Different texture and taste and they were filled with oil, even the fat on the meat was different, very rubbery like, definitely shouldn't be eaten. It tastes like the recipe has completely changed but for the worse. This was my go to restaurant even from a distance, but not anymore. The prices went up a few years ago and you still get the same amount of meat (not fair), but I was still a loyal customer. I didn't bother to call again because what's the point? I had had enough.. I won't be returning, I'm better off making my own...", 'Great no frills takeout spot with tasty Caribbean cuisine. Portions are huge.', 'If I could give zero stars, I would! Service was slow. Wanted to weigh my meal but didn’t know the cost per pound. Then, only gave three pieces of cut up chicken - not a whole leg/thigh with a whole heap of rice for a medium order. Chicken was dry. This Golden Krust was a complete disappointment. Better off going to a local Jamaican restaurant. The mom and pops will take care of you - quality and quantity wise. Support small businesses!', 'Stopped in to dine with my brother, visiting me from out of town.
Ordered curry chicken, brown rice with peas, and cabbage.
Unbeknowest to my my brother had dined an hour before meeting me.  Nevertheless, he opted for a beef patty.
The food was not as delicious as the last time, but I was happy, nonetheless, and glad to support this particular establishment.
We were serviced by Ms. Denise.  A lovely representative, and I promised her that I would draft a review of my experience 😀
There was also a gentleman server, and he was equally as pleasant and charming as Ms. Denise.
I look forward to my next visit to Gokden Crust and will try the jersey chicken!
Until then, take care and thank you to the Golden Crust Team 💛', "There is few restaurant that can get this jamaica cuisine right.  They staff at this golden Krystal never disappointment.  No matter what I choose to order.  You can't go wrong eating here."]

name: YEMEN CAFÉ & RESTAURANT
reviews: ['Simple and authentic. Great hospitality, they welcomed us with a cup of the popular soup and bread. We ordered 2 plates and they were so good. Maybe the best lamb liver I had so far in the US!', 'Excellent tasty food especially their bread is very crispy and tasty as well as the meat is very fresh and delicious! Hands down best Yemeni restaurant in the whole tri state area\nWe ordered lamb haneeth lamb Mandi lamb kibdeh lamb fahsa which is so hot and delicious with steam coming out of meat like the video', 'Small place but very busy. Staff was friendly. Service was quick. Went there with a friend for the first time. In the beginning they served soup, flat bread and salad. Soup was okay, it had too much black pepper. Flat bread was little dry. Special house salad was good and fresh. Soup and salad is complimentary. I ordered chicken kebab with rice. Rice were okay but chicken kebab was delicious. My friend ordered lamb haneeth which has a large portion. Yemeni tea was also free. Overall, it was a good experience.', 'As soon as you sit down, help yourself to some homemade tea from the corner (it’s free). Dip the naan in the complimentary soup, but don’t fill up too much—you’ll want to save room for the main dish. We’re here for the lamb #19. The portion is a bit too large for one person but not quite enough for two. The lamb is tender and falls off the bone. On our first visit, it was more moist and flavorful, but this time it was slightly dry. Still, adding some soup to it helped. We also ordered the baba ganoush, which was smoky and rich, perfect with the naan. You can refill the soup, naan, salad, and tea as needed. Overall, always a great experience.', 'I had a fantastic experience at Yemen Cafe in Brooklyn. The service was quick and efficient, and the food was outstanding. The lamb haneeth was tender and full of flavor, and the complimentary bread with ají and salad added a nice touch. Highly recommend this spot for authentic Yemeni cuisine!']

name: SOUTH SLOPE RESTAURANT & BAR
reviews: ['Chicken pesto panini was good but a bit dry, bread was not very fresh. Service was lovely! Atmosphere a was a bit odd, outside had some random decorations that may not have been intentional. Overall good experience. Mainly writing this to say that there is funny wording on the menu, paninis, wraps & bowls come with "some blue chips". Was curious as to what that meant, see photo for their answer!', "There are so many things on the menu here. My california tuna melt was just what I was in the mood for, and my husband's BBQ burger was great too. We wanted a casual weekday lunch and sat outside, which was nice.", 'Very delicious, generous, and affordable place to eat in Brooklyn near a major subway hub.', 'So many options here. The bison wrap was pretty basic but well seasoned. The spicy mango salmon wrap was great though. Drinks with ginger were definitely strong; very much an acquired taste but every unique. The website was annoying to order on but the pick up process was seamless.', 'Food can be a little bit better. Fries had a lot of oil. The other time when I went there the salad didn’t really have any seasoning.\nDrinks and service were good though.']

name: GOLDEN KRUST CARIBBEAN RESTAURANT
reviews: ['I’ve had meal at this golden krust before, however, I felt obligated talk about this stew chicken.  I don’t know who the cook was on that day but believe me when I tell you flavor.  I could taste the hint of ginger in the rice and peas, just the way we did it back home. Couple that with the season chicken; my taste buds keep buzzing.  They got three stars because of the ambiance. It’s poorly lit, the rainbow cake seem damp for pastry.  The staff is efficient and you just can’t get beef patties wrong.', '2nd time ordering from this store on Uber eats and still got old stale food! First order the Tito was hard and dry like sand paper! My coco bread a had a section that completely dried out. I decided to try again and todays SAME THING coco bread was old as if it was left out. Beef patty was soft and flimsy! Horrible location out of all Brooklyn locations', "If I could give them a zero, I would. I ordered food online. the MAIN portion of the food I ordered was not available however...they not only had it on the site but also it went thru in the order. I was never contacted about the food not being available. They were supposed to also refund the 3 portions that were unavailable...they only refunded 1. When I called, the woman who answered was rude and then hung up the phone on. She also then decided to not answer the line or continuously hang up every time I called. I will never solicit them again and I see why most of the people I know don't go there any longer either.", 'The food here is delicious. I ordered a small oxtail for $20.70 . I don’t   Understand why this dish is so expensive. It was delicious and they give you enough food for one.. I will always get my oxtail from them. Also they make the best Jamaican beef Patties.', 'They need better customer service it takes way too long to get a order.']

name: MIRIAM STREET FOOD
reviews:
['I was craving latkes. But got two tiny overfried patties that are hard to cut. The poached eggs are also overcooked. The caviar is bitter. The salad is a huge pile of boring greens, the dressing is to tart.
There were almost no guests but I waited a long time for this food and even the mint tea that costs too much for a small cup of dried herb tea with a mint leaf (so it looked like made with fresh one?).
I am truly disappointed, spotted those latkes the day before and was getting up thinking about that breakfast…

Can’t give 1 or 0 bc haven’t tried their other food (maybe it’s just this dish) but can’t go higher than 2 for this experience :(', 'Skewers were good, best one lamb, worst one beef. Skip the chicken wings. Fries were ok! Pita and hummus was the best thing here. For the quality of the food, price could be lower. Still a nice dinner!', 'Miriam Street Food is a locally sourced and culturally inspired Mediterranean cuisine in a New York setting. Their dishes also reflect the rich cultural history of the Middle East. We ordered a couple Blue Moon drafts to go with their delicious hummus, shawarma, and skewers including kofta. You may ask yourself, how good can skewers be? Try it and you’ll understand the quality and flavor of Miriam Street Food. It is a great environment with an awesome crew of staff that are super friendly and helpful.', "I feel like this is still an undiscovered gem.  We're so used to seeing the main Miriam restaurant and automatically going there, that we didnt bother to try this place.  Honestly, I now prefer Miriam Street Food.  Much bigger menu with greater variety and more of the flavors I love.  My son went first with a bunch of kids for a birthday and was raving.  So I went with the family last night and holy crap, its going to be my new go-to.  Portions were enormous (I should have kept half for a second meal, but was too busy devouring it like an animal that I am) especially considering the price.  We decided we were going to keep going until we tried everything on the menu.  I'm not a salad fan at all, but those were amazing and now I want to eat em all.  Clearly these days with politics, I'm noticing fake negative reviews by haters.  Don't listen to them, try this out and thank me later.", 'Ordered the vegan shawarma plate and a side of mashed potatoes. Every item was perfect, never had soy chickn so flavorful. Service was great. A bit pricey but will absolutely return.']

name: PARK PLAZA
reviews:
['I absolutely love Park Plaza! The owner is such a wonderful person. I have celebrated most of my best moments there. My wedding, my college graduation and today my daughter’s birthday. The employees are so welcoming and kind.
I am always excited to visit when I go back to Brooklyn.
Please make sure when you’re visiting to tell a friend or two or three. The place holds a lot of people for any event. The new outdoor space is beautiful at night.', 'I enjoy coming to this diner for breakfast and lunch. I love the omelettes and their homemade french fries. For lunch, they have some really nice salads which are fresh and have great ingredient combos.

The inside is very comfortable with mostly booths and there is also an outside patio which is really nice in the warmer weather. The staff could not be friendlier or more attentive.', 'Forget about the fancy places around or in the market, this is it.
Great food, great service and fair prices.', 'The food at this restaurant is delicious and offers good value for the price.

However, the service leaves much to be desired. During my visit, I ordered a coffee refill twice, but the server forgot it both times. Instead, the server sat at the bar doing nothing.

This significant lapse in service was disappointing and detracted from an otherwise enjoyable dining experience. Improvements in service reliability and attentiveness would greatly enhance the overall experience for patrons.', "Spanakopita was best I've ever had. I was told it was a family recipe brought over by the grandfather. Best Meal of my NY trip."]

name: PUNTA CANA
reviews: ["The breakfast food that I received was good.  I had asked for home fries with my grits and bacon and didn't receive them.  Yet I was not charged for them either.  No atmosphere; it's just a diner.", 'I enjoy their rice meals very much but I would be careful about ordering other foods like burrito.  I recently ordered vegetarian burrito and it took them longer to make it than the rice dishes.  Also, I realized halfway thru the meal that they did not put guac as mentioned in the menu.  -1 star for the burrito experience.', "The food can be better! It use to be very good food.\nNow the rice is always dry or looks old, the breakfast taste rushed and the meat some times seem like left overs from the previous night. I guess it's because of the location. The coffee tastes like instant coffee or just watered down.", "The staff is friendly and treat you like family, the menu has a myriad of options. I tried cassava for the first time (awesome) you would almost want to eat every meal here. When I visit the city again I'll go back.", 'Food is amazinggg! They never miss a beat!\nSometime they take a while to answer the phone when I try to place and order to pick up but they are great! They make their food with love']

name: 7 OLD FULTON
reviews:
['We stopped in for a late dinner after walking around Brooklyn. The weather was great and their outdoor dining was very nice. Where we sat we had a view of the skyline and it was great. We ordered the steak and fries which were tasty and came with broccoli. We also got the Mediterranean salad which was really good. Lastly we got cheesecake which was excellent and came with strawberries on top and drizzled lightly with chocolate sauce and raspberry sauce. The waiter we had was very kind and attentive.', "I was there in a party of 6, we all had such an amazing experience. Julia (the host) was very kind and received as really well. The service was great, and the food astonishing. I highly recommend this place if you wish to have a perfect gastronomic experience!
ps: the low rating in google doesn't reflect my experience at all.", 'Looked for a restaurant to sit outdoors on a hot September afternoon. The staff were attentive with continual filling of our water.
We only ate main courses for lunch.
Partner ate manicotti and I had the spaghetti/meatballs dish with a side of fries, we both enjoyed very much, we were rather hungry.  Washed it down with a glass of Chardonnay which was rather good.', 'This place is so beautiful and amazing. The food was delicious and fresh. The servers were great and service was excellent. The Manager Julia was very friendly and kindly. Really enjoyed my dinner.', 'Food and drinks were just bad, not tasty at all, sloppy, my sandwich had different ingredients than advertised and the pasta was bland and dry- also expensive af. Very very disappointing. Service was not great either.']

name: THE SIMPSON RESTAURANT AND BAR
reviews:
['On 10/5/24 I went to this restaurant to celebrate my best Tracey Ann’s birthday and let me tell you. This place is the real deal when it comes to real authentic Jamaican cuisine.Please don’t hesitate to dine at this restaurant, the service was amazing and our servers were amazingly pleasant and friendly. Diamond and Omar make sure our experience was impeccable, the food tastes great and full of flavor also the presentation of the food was absolutely fantastic.
Kudos to the amazing staff at Simpsons, I will definitely be coming back.', 'One of the best Caribbean spot in Brooklyn. Visiting our family in NY, we saw a review on social and decided to go, did not disappoint, from the warm and welcoming atmosphere to a fantastic service, great attention to details, attentive, fast, and well organized sums up our server Dorothy. One of the owners K (Boss Lady) came over to greet us, one of the nicest person you could ever meet, being from Toronto and BC, great change to the service of similar establishments, oxtails was fantastic, fish and lobster was great! Jerk pork could use some more spices for my taste, would love to see home made hot sauce on the side. As a chef for over 20 years please listen to when I say
RUN, Don’t WALK', 'This is a really good restaurant. A very good Jamaican restaurant at that. The atmosphere was also great, and the food was tremendous. Before you go, make sure you have a reservation; you can walk in, but the wait time will be long because of space due to the popularity. This was my second time visiting in the past 2 years. 100% will go again.', 'Visited here several times and they never disappoint. From drinks to appetizers to desert everything was excellent and tasty. Yadira our waitress was excellent and patient with her service. Will definitely revisit.', 'This SPOT was okay ! The drinks were the best part as well as the service. The honey curry wings were lacking in flavor ! Great concept but yeah no.

The MAC AND CHEESE DIVINE. I would go back but not my first choice. Definitely an urban establishment.']

name: OSTERIA BROOKLYN
reviews:
['Osteria Brooklyn is a hidden gem that captures the essence of old-school Italian dining right in the heart of Brooklyn. The restaurant exudes an authentic Italian ambiance, reminiscent of Little Italy, with its cozy, rustic decor and warm, inviting atmosphere. The food is exceptional, featuring classic Italian dishes prepared with a modern twist, perfect for a family-style dinner. Each plate is crafted with care, offering rich flavors that make you feel like you’re dining in a small Italian village. The staff is incredibly attentive, ensuring a pleasant dining experience from start to finish. Osteria Brooklyn is the perfect spot for a delightful meal that transports you straight to Italy without leaving Brooklyn.', 'It has a pleasant and luxurious atmosphere. The shrimp was so fresh that it was as if it had just been caught and the dessert was wonderful.', 'The vibe and the staff are wonderful, but the food is pretty mid and extremely overpriced for sure. $42 for a weak caraf of aperol spritz is not okay. I will say the server we had was nice, she brought out a little bowl of water for my little panting dog (he gets very anxious) so that was much appreciated, 25% tip for you kind lady. But, there are other places in the area with better food for the price.', "Ordered delivery on a July 4th evening, food arrived after just under 40 minutes, within their estimated time window.

The $25 linguine alle vongole was good. I got the sense that some of the clams weren't as good or fresh as some of the other places I have had this dish, but there were more than 20 of them, so that was nice. 4 ⭐

The $16 caprese definitely wasn't as good as other places I've been. There was no balsamic that I could see or taste. And the mozzarella and tomatoes were not as fresh as I had come to expect. I'd say a 3 ⭐ for this one.

Overall 4 ⭐", 'We arrived at an awkward time between lunch and dinner. I had intended on trying the prefix lunch which was advertised conspicuously on the sidewalk (with a large fold out sign) between the entrance and a nicely maintained outdoor seating area.

When we arrived at approximately 3:35 pm, the restaurant was empty inside. I ordered the lunch special, however the waitress very politely refused to honor my request because it was 5 mins past the end of lunch (slightly disappointing).

We chose to try the oxtail pappardelle, the lobster risotto and the fried cauliflower milanese. The major surprise was the complimentary and excellent hot bread with tomato dip. We ordered an extra portion it was so good.

The entrees were both good to very good, I especially recommend the risotto (very good). The value for the standard portion size was also fine.

Overall the meal was very good and you got what you paid for, but the only extraordinary element of the meal was the bread!']

name: LE FATIMA
reviews:
['I recently dined at this incredible family-owned restaurant in Brooklyn, and it’s a true gem! For over 30 years, they’ve been serving up authentic Spanish, Latin, and Caribbean dishes that are simply amazing.

The baked chicken and roast pork are must-tries—both are juicy and full of flavor. The fried chicken is crispy and delicious, while the BBQ chicken adds a nice smoky kick. Don’t forget to pair your meal with their perfectly crispy plantains!

The warm, welcoming atmosphere makes you feel right at home, and the staff treats you like family. And if you have room for dessert, their homemade flan is a delightful way to end your meal.

This place is a celebration of culture and great food. Whether you’re a local or just visiting, make sure to stop by— you won’t be disappointed! I can’t wait to return!', "Went here on a whim and don't do that. Sat outside this place and saw a lot of people go in, and we figured it must be good. We also went around the early evening, which plays a factor. I had the chicken breast with some type of onions and something else. Now it looked good, but it had such a high salt content that it started bothering me, and my friend had the baked chicken, and instantly, he had gotten a bad headache. The food has too much seasoning, and that's not good.", 'You can smell the food from down the block! Customer service is impeccable . I’ve tasted just about everything on the menu and nothing disappointed. To top it off the prices are very reasonable. You would not be disappointed!', 'I stumbled upon this place accidentally.. wasn’t even hungry but the smell of the food alone drew me in. The workers were very friendly and the food tastes like a home cooked meal. The lunch deals are pretty affordable too & come packed with a lot of food. I did take out so I didn’t get too much out of the atmosphere but it’s your classic small local food stop, so don’t expect anything extravagant besides the food and hospitality.', 'Wonderful little shop selling the most delicious roast pork.']

name: BLOSSOM'S SOUL FOOD FUSION
reviews:
['Stepping into this cozy spot felt like going to Grandma’s house in the early 90s.

We loved all the little details and can safely say this is a one of a kind place!

We loved this menu too, a fusion of homemade soul food and an interesting cocktail list! Here were our faves:

🦐 Mermaid Mac
🍖Oxtail Empanada
🌽 Cornbread
🍖Oxtail and grits
🥩 Smothered BBQ Ribs
🍌 Banana Pudding

Will be back soon to explore that brunch menu', 'The atmosphere was amazing, friendly, and welcoming. The food was amazing and mouth watering. I have never tried a better mac and cheese or grits! I definitely will be returning, it is now one of my favorite restaurants to go to. I recommend anyone this restaurant, I guarantee the visit will not be regretted!', "So me and some friends went to blossom yesterday. We were greeted when we first came in . Which was nice . Even a man idk if he was the owner or not but he asked if we wanted anything to drink while we waited which also was a nice touch . The ambiance is like your grandmas living room which is cute but it can run stale very quickly . As we were sitting I noticed a pile of dust on the table that was in front of us . That should have set the tone for the afternoon  but we stayed . I also have severe allergies to dust and I know for sure they don't clean the couch as much as they should nor dust . Anyway we were seated , and got the menu . I was excited because it was some really nice stuff on the menu . I got the shrimp po boy and steak fries and my mom got the seafood and grits and another friend got the shrimp and grits and etc . The po boy is extremely small and comes with 3 shrimps . It was absolutely delicious don't get me wrong but it was small . And hard to eat . And it looked like it was on a brioche hot dog bun . The fries were fresh and slamming . It took a turn when my mom got her food . It was the smallest cute little thing of grits and seafood . And my other friend only had 2 shrimp with her shrimp and grits . If you're going to charge these prices people should be getting a bang for their buck . It was disappointing. What else bothered me Is that our food was brought out different times . So by time I finished my food my mom had just got hers . I don't think I will return personally . Our server was extremely sweet that was really nice . I think the place has potential but I personally won't be back .", 'Great feel as soon as you walk in. Almost feels like family Sunday dinner! The cornbread is so amazing! Empanadas are tasty! Great drinks! The staff is welcoming and open! Definitely a great place to try! Going back for the snapper next, or ribs.. still haven’t decided!', "I really loved this place and how much it feels like I'm visiting someplace familiar. Family owned businesses with food that tastes like it's straight out of Grandma's kitchen.

I took my wife on a date and it was a surprising location because I walked by it so many times and didn't realize this hidden gem was there.

Very happy with the food but the service and atmosphere are what set it apart."]

name: SOMETHIN’ ON MYRTLE
reviews:
["If you're looking for a spot with great vibes, amazing happy hour deals, and some of the best wings in the area, Something on Myrtle is the place! Their drinks are on point, and the happy hour prices make it even better. Plus, they've got hookah for just $25, which is a steal. The real surprise? It’s not even packed! You can chill  out with your drinks, wings, and hookah without fighting for space. If you haven't been, you’re missing out—thank me later!", 'Yesterday, we visited this restaurant for lunch after seeing it on Instagram. The ambiance and decor are beautiful. The DJ played throwback hip-hop and R&B, which was awesome. The food was delicious and flavorful. The waiter was professional, polite, and friendly. I would definitely recommend this place.', '“I recently visited Somethin’ on Myrtle, and it exceeded my expectations in every way. The star of the meal was the stuffed shrimp and grits, which were absolutely phenomenal. The shrimp were perfectly cooked, with savory stuffing crab meat that added so much flavor, while the creamy grits and sauce provided the perfect base for this delicious dish.

The drinks were equally impressive, with a creative cocktail menu. The holy grail cocktail was amazing, I had two…  Each drink was expertly crafted, refreshing, and paired perfectly with the meal.

The atmosphere of Somethin’ on Myrtle was cozy and inviting, with a lively yet laid-back vibe. Whether you’re there for a casual dinner or a night out with friends, it’s the kind of place that makes you feel right at home. The staff were attentive and friendly, contributing to an overall fantastic dining experience. “A must try on your visit to New York!”

Sincerely just a Florida Girl in a big city….', 'I went there last night for my Birthday dinner and I will be back. The food came out fast and was so so tasty. The music was great! I was singing and eating simultaneously lol… Coco our waitress was awesome! She was attentive and answered our questions with good energy (I loved that)! She also gave me a complimentary drink for my Birthday! Thanks Luv! We’ll be back!', "I'm always having a spot saved on my Google and my cousin and I decided to try this place. It was a great choice. We came in and it was quiet so we were able to get seating right away.
I ordered the Holy Grail but I found it to be a little sweet for me so I went with the French Kiss which was really good. My cousin and I picked the shrimp dumplings and lemon pepper wings as appetizers. The shrimp dumplings are AMAZING!!!! OMG! I ordered the snapper which was really amazing as well.
Service was good. Place was nice and clean. Will definitely return"]

name: MOMINETTE BISTRO
reviews: ['lovely place with attentive and caring staff. we were celebrating a birthday and our server noticed when the birthday girl left the table to come ask us which dessert she would prefer. the food was delicious. recommend the oysters and the chicken. not primarily vegetarian options but they do have some. hope to return soon!', 'Came here on a Monday for their happy hour. Their inside is cozy with bar and wall seating. Weather was great so we sat outback in their patio. Oysters came with lemon wedges, vinaigrette and cocktail sauce. The lemon wasn’t the freshest (see pic) but the oysters were. Cute lil spot, will be back!', 'Went here a couple of Sundays ago in the early evening. It was pretty much empty so we got to pick our seat!! Servers were so kind. We had oysters, escargot, and I got the handsome, the incredible, the tantalizing Beef Bourguignon. It was So good. It was everything I’ve ever wanted in a beef stew. The perfect amount of food. I haven’t stopped thinking about it, which means I WILL be coming back so we can be reunited once more!!!', "We decided to visit this spot on a weekend morning for brunch. We walked in without a reservation and were able to find seating without any issue. I'd arrive coming during the less busy times because they could get packed pretty fast. We opted for the mimosa carafe and I got the house burger. Great service and good dishes made for an enjoyable experience. The restaurant itself is quaint and gives off Parisian Brasserie vibes with wood finishes and a high top bar. I'd definitely come back for brunch and other meals too.", 'Had a really lovely solo brunch here today. I was worried it was too hot for the garden seating but it was perfect as was the omelette and the potatoes. Unintrusive service that was Gracious and friendly. I will definitely be back to try the Croque Madam!']

name: OLEA
reviews:
['Cozy neighborhood Mediterranean restaurant. Absolutely adore the interior and the dishes are fabulous. We ordered the dips, garlic shrimp, seafood paella, short ribs, lamb pasta and warm salad, and they were all delicious. The warm salad is definitely not something to sleep on! Highly recommend and great place to have a long dinner with friends. 5/5', 'Second time at Olea and another great dinner! I love their smaller pocket pitas that’s warm, fresh and soft. Warm salad is very good, and always love their seafood paella and branzino! I’ve had better fried halloumi cheese elsewhere, and the space can feel cramped when busy. But overall a lovely and lively place with great food and service. Will be back again.', 'The food was phenomenal but the service was mediocre at best.

Greek grilled cheese - probably one of the best grilled cheeses I’ve ever had
Croquettes - not my favorite but my family loved it so probably just a taste preference
Brussels - nice char, good flavor and drizzled with balsamic
Dip trio- good way to try many options and the mini pitas were hot and fresh
Falafel - fresh and crispy but didn’t really taste the artichoke much

As for the service - our waiter was pretty rude, she gave us the check before we even asked/she asked us for it and we were going to order another round of drinks. But oh well, we just paid and left. We got out apps first and when the other server came with the entrees he pretty much rolled his eyes at us because we asked him to clear the dishes from the apps first. We only asked because the tables are small and there was no space for the new plates. It didn’t feel like an unreasonable request

Ambiance -  beautiful decor, nice homey vibe', "We went here for my birthday after going here 2 years ago and loving it. The ambience of the inside is truly unbeatable - the high ceilings, cozy lighting, and mindfully decorated space makes you forget that you're in a bustling city. Dre was our server and he just completed the vibe. He has a great energy.  We got the carafe of red sangria which is a fav of our at any spot, but Olea is especially good at it. The trio of dips was definitely too much for 2 people, but I can't complain about an abundance of the best dips ever. Just come ready with an appetite.  THEN we got one of the specials, it was a shrimp in garlic olive oil in a mini cast iron skillet and uhhhh oh my god it was so good. I have been thinking about it ever since. We will be back! :)", 'Just tried this place for the first time last night and wow! The service was wonderful and accommodating and the food was fresh and delicious. I went with a friend and we ordered a bunch of tapas; the vegan meatballs, brussel sprouts, roasted mushrooms, falafel crusted artichokes, fried green olives, and chocolate cake with ice cream for dessert. I can’t believe it took me so long to get there and I can’t wait to go back again. 😋']

name: BORN
reviews: ['I stumbled upon this place after a pretty disappointing experience with a Thai place nearby and let me tell you saving grace doesn’t even begin to cover it! Not only did they have mango sticky rice late into the season, but a full bar and delicious food. The place is small but set up in such a cute and cozy way. Grace was the bartender/server for me and she was just wonderful. I had such a great time I will definitely be back for more!', 'Decided to try this before a concert, it was very close to Barclays. The duck wrap appetizer was a 2/5 one little small piece with extra lettuce definitely not enough duck. The pineapple chicken fried rice was just okay it needs a little more heat or flavor. The drinks were a 5/5, lychee martini was great. It was pricey.', 'I had an amazing dining experience at Born Restaurant! The ambiance was cozy and inviting, the staff were friendly and attentive, and the food was absolutely delicious. I ordered the Papaya Salad and it was perfectly cooked and seasoned. The portion sizes were generous and the presentation was beautiful. I also appreciated the wide selection of wines available to complement my meal. Overall, I highly recommend Born Restaurant for a wonderful dining experience.', 'We’ve come twice already and each time was amazing. I think we’ve tried most of the menu and you cannot go wrong with anything! The waitress Anna recommended Mango sticky rice to finish the meal and it was amazing and reasonable price as well!', 'Great local spot with a nice intimate ambience. Wait staff is friendly and food comes out pretty quickly. Tried the born buns, curry puffs and the pad kee mao (medium spice) which were all delicious. An fyi- gratuity is included in the bill.']

name: LESLIE'S KITCHEN
reviews:
['What an amazing  spot. Right across the street from where I went to JHS so it was kinda special. One word… WOOOOOW!! We had the Mexican burger and the pull pork sandwich. Amazing, great portions and the taste was incredible. Fair prices and the AC was in blastttttt 😎😎😎
Definitely worth it!!!', "What a win! We went here after my aunts funeral and they were AMAZING! Great service with a large party, the food was delicious, it came out of the kitchen fresh and warm despite there being a large number of us.

The guacamole was delicious, sweet potato fries (HUGE portion) were perfection. Can't say enough good things about this place. Go! You won't regret it.", 'The chicken taquitos were amazing, my fiancé and  I split the pan roasted chicken and it was fantastic. A huge serving for only $24', "Gluten free friendly, extremely delicious. We had the chicken and the shell steak and it did not disappoint. Salads dressings are next level and the chopped salad with jicima is just ridiculous. Order the maduros you won't regret it. Non greasy perfectly cooked. Reasonably priced considering the portion and the quality. Will return every time were in BK if we can. Thank you David for great service, and thanks to the chefs for providing this awesome food experience.", "Giving it 5 stars right now for quality of food. First time here. Restaurant itself is pretty unassuming. But what we ordered was outstanding. My companion ordered the Cilantro Caesar Salad with Chicken and she raved about it. For me, I can't resist when a Patty Melt is on the menu and I went with that. Very glad I did. Came with a ton of fries. Both of us brought food home!  Will be going back for other meals so recommended."]

name: EL REY V RESTAURANT
reviews: ["I was told before ordering here not to order here lol but I decided to anyway because I was craving this kind of food , when people say looks are deceiving that goes for food as well because the food looked good but it was not , the rice and peas tasted like it was burnt every single grain of rice tasted like it was burnt I tried to eat it but I could not I had my family try just to make sure I wasn’t tripping and they agreed smh . The pork had no flavor it just wasnt  good at all. They fell off terribly I used to come when I was a child and this was the spot but that'll be the last time .", 'We tried this place based on the ratings. It did not exceed our expectations. The food was set up buffet style but cold. We were sold large portions. The beef was tough and the chicken was dry. It was not seasoned to my expectations. I felt robbed even though I left a tip. The staff was very nice. But we were not greeted. They also wore no gloves.', 'Great little local restaurant. Was staying in Brooklyn for a bit and there’s nothing like these type of spots. Great home cooked type food! Came here twice, once for some quick empanadas for breakfast and the other for lunch. Rotisserie chicken, rice, beans and vegetables for $20(USD). Great price, great portion, great food & great people.', 'I’ve gotten food from here quite a few times, usually the same thing and it’s good. This morning I got two chicken empanadas and came home to eat it. My first bite, there was something hard in my mouth, and when I took it out, it was a piece of bone. Not wanting to ruin my first meal of the day I took a few more bites, hoping it was a one time thing, but instead found two more pieces of bone. I didn’t finish the first one and definitely didn’t start the second one. I called the store to let them know since I couldn’t go back in and the woman said “oh I’m so sorry.” Yeah, I’m sorry I could’ve cracked a tooth or choked on a bone too.', 'Skip the new chichi places in the neighborhood and experience authentic Latin American soul food from this local stalwart. The cooks are courteous, accessible, and will cook anything anyway you want. The portions are generous and the prices are affordable. There are tasty vegetarian dishes options too.']

name: RUTA OAXACA MEXICAN CUISINE
reviews:
['I love Ruta!
We are so happy that this Mexican restaurant is in our neighborhood now. We have seen this large restaurant change to different types of food and businesses and finally landed in a sophisticated and yet warm Mexican cuisine. We came here twice this week.
Service is wonderful! Definitely try the short ribs!', 'Went for the first time with my husband and we absolutely loved it. They don’t have their liquor license yet but we got a regular and strawberry lemonade that tasted so fresh and perfect for the summertime heat. They started off giving complimentary tortilla chips. We order the taco Tuesday deal (3 for $14) which you could mix and match. They tasted so flavorful and very filling. For  dessert we got churros that came with this coffee sauce that was surprisingly very delicious. Everything was perfect right when we stepped inside. Great customer service, clean, and of course food tasted 1000/10. Can’t wait to try other stuff', 'I am so glad I was walking by with my sister when we did. The wonderful staff was handing out flyers for the restaurant while we were on our way to another Mexican eatery we always go to. We took a look at the menus and turned right around and went into Ruta. Everything was amazing. I have been obsessed with Chicken Mole for a few weeks now trying it almost everywhere I can. So when I say everything was good, everything was good. The salsa that comes with the chips is so rich and hearty. We got two orders of chips and salsa. We got the Mexican street corn. I got the Mole and my sister has the shrimp tacos. I got rice and beans too. Everything was so flavorful. I definitely will
be back. This place is about to be packed all summer I can just feel it, I can taste it!', "Oh man! Awesome place. Feels like a local joint, waiters are super nice and bring out free avocado and strawberry for our infant and the food feels like I'm south of the border in a local, non-touristy town. Tacos, guacamole, salsa, michelada, seabass, quesadilla.... you name it, it's all unreal.", '20 out of 10!!! The Ribs Istmenas are ridiculously delicious! The chipotle guava glaze on them is just phenomenal. The Steak Oaxaqueño was thought out so well and each bite was paired with a delicious melted chihuahua cheese, sweet plantain, nopales salad and an amazing mole coloradito. To be honest there’s so many great plates my review would be 10 pages long. The ceviche, the calamari, the buñuelos, the cochinita tacos, the Pulpo every time I eat here the flavors are so good I just want to try the next thing on the menu! Chef Felipe is a master of his craft and puts a lot of thought and care into what comes out of his kitchen. They have awesome brunch options from 12-4pm as well. The service is very welcoming and attentive. The drinks… Just WOW! I think I’ve nearly tried everything and I love coming here.']

name: MYRTLE THAI
reviews:
['Wonderful service and food.
10% student discount for Pratt students!

Ordered the Shrimp Karee and Thai Ice Coffee. Both were extremely delicious.

The portions were generous. I got served 8 shrimp with my curry.

The restaurant was clean and beautiful.', "Glad I discovered this hidden gem. The ambiance and vibes of this place is amazing. As soon you walked in, you'll see the fall the decor they have and it gives me the cozy vibes. Me & my family loved the food. Thai cuisines just never disappoint. From their appetizer to dessert, it was amazing. My main FAVORITES are spicy wing, crab meat fried rice and the sweet coconut sticky rice w/ custard. Def would recommend!", 'We been back one a week from lunch to dinner , drive from queens to this gem place for months now. Been tried almost half of the menu. Best to get is the garlic wings, Thai dumplings, basil eggplants, pad kee mew with beef. And pork special needle soup. Great service, absolutely delicious food! Super friendly staff, it is pleasant coming back every time. The Thai tea with ice cream is the best drink I even have , is a MUST try !!!!!', 'The food was bursting with authentic Thai flavors—every dish was perfectly seasoned and beautifully presented. The shrimp curry and crab meat fried rice were especially delicious, full of fresh ingredients and rich spices. The staff was friendly and attentive, always making sure our needs were met. The restaurant has a cozy and inviting atmosphere, perfect for both casual dining and special occasions. Highly recommend for anyone craving great Thai cuisine! I’ll definitely be back soon!', 'This Thai restaurant was fantastic! Every dish was packed with authentic flavors, from the savory fried rice with sausage to the rich, noodle soup. The portions were generous, and the food was beautifully presented. Highly recommended for a satisfying and flavorful Thai meal!']

name: LA ISLA
reviews:
['Convenient location right next to the subway. Very casual- everyone sits at the bar or take-out, there isn’t any table service. The service was good and the food had great prices. Haven’t tried their fruit juice but it looks popular. Atmosphere was nice, the inside is clean.

I had the shrimp mofongo. It was fresh, came out hot and with a side salad which was nice and refreshing. It also came with a side of sauce to add. A lot of food, I came close to finishing it all. I like that all mofongo options come with pork regardless of which protein you pick. Sometimes that’s hard to find, but I found the pork pieces throughout the mofongo were either not fresh or just not prepared properly like chicharron (crispy). Nonetheless, the flavor was good, not sure if there was any actual shrimp throughout the mofongo, just on the side. If I return I’d like to try the chicken mofongo. My food was prepared surprisingly quick, this is a busy spot. But, many of the options are already pre-prepared.', 'The pics aren’t very good but! This was the best comfort food to get delivered. We got a special that came with ribs, rice and beans and salad that we split. The beans are off the chain! I probably would have been happy with just the rice and beans they were so flavorful but the ribs were tender and tasty - not over seasoned so I used a little hot sauce because I’m a salt freak but they’re great on their own. Their soup was truly a delight - I got their house soup they had that day which was like a stew with big pieces of chicken, carrot and potato. The broth was so savory and silky with a nice amount of lime or some citrus making it extra flavorful. Last but not least - their chicken pastelillos were insanely tasty and you should order extra in case someone tries to eat yours… because they will.', 'This is "buen sabor" good flavor.i had the mondongo soup (tripe) with white rice.plus an alcapurria.the soup was well seasoned and tops most other spots. 230 am we pulled up at LA Isla for some excellent dine in food.the place is clean and smells good.', 'This place is not what it used to be like about seven years ago or 10 years ago. For those of us that have been around the block for very long time know that they’re known for their arcapuria, Bacaladahitos and other finger food.( if you know you know) ! Today mannnn I spot by to get a taste of the good old days ! Those finger food was drenched in oil, you couldn’t even taste the flavor. You only tasted the oil which defeats the purpose The plastic bag, they usually give you the finger foods was full of oil.  I don’t who’s cooking back there but we need some Puerto Rican seasoning and soul put into these finger foods for those who know what I’m talking about to bring back those memories of our youths .', 'This place has undergone remarkable changes and is truly a part of local history. My father-in-law, a Puerto Rican, grew up in the neighborhood and gave us a fascinating history lesson. As an Asian, I fell in love with the food—it opened the door to a vibrant cultural experience. Brooklyn is home to some amazing spots, and this is definitely one of them. We used to drive by at night, drawn in by the inviting energy.
The staff here is fantastic—polite and helpful. Although I don’t speak Spanish, I’ve learned the names of the dishes. The Sopa de Pollo, Sopa de Salchicha, Arroz Blanco, and Alcapuria are all excellent choices. Eating here feels like coming home, as the food evokes memories without needing to know the full history.

I encourage you to stop by and be patient with the line; it’s a testament to how amazing the food is. Enjoy the neighborhood, and take a moment to sit down and savor the experience.']

name: MIRIAM RESTAURANT
reviews:
['I have never been disappointed with a meal at Miriam’s. I would recommend getting a few plates to share because pretty much everything they have is delicious.

The hummus is so creamy and the pita served with it is always warm and fluffy. If there is one dish I recommend as a, ‘must get,’ it would be the brussel sprouts. I don’t know what sort of magic they put in them but they are delicious.', "Me & my husband recently dined at Miriam restaurant and sampled a couple of their lamb shawarma dishes. Unfortunately, the lamb shawarma with rice wasn't to my liking. The meat was a bit burnt, resulting in a bitter taste that overshadowed the dish. On the other hand, the lamb shawarma served with hummus was much better and more enjoyable. The mint lemonade was ok type, nothing extraordinary, but it complemented the meal well enough.

I was a bit disappointed to find that the beef shawarma and wrapped prawn, which were available on their earlier menu, are no longer offered. These were dishes I was looking forward to trying.

Despite the mixed experience with the food, the service was excellent, and the ambience was delightful. The staff were attentive and friendly.", 'Truly one of my favorite brunch places in the neighborhood. Everything I’ve had is filling without being too heavy and is hangover friendly (esp if you get the dishes with egg in them).

I’ve been here now over 5 times and ordered delivery once. Definitely recommend dining in instead of delivery, my only complaint is the pancakes were a little bit dry and the “bagel” tastes a little strange to me (I expected something closer to a traditional bagel though).

Everything else I’ve had has been delicious and I would highly recommend to others. Israeli breakfast is my go to.

Hope to try dinner options in the future.', '4.5 🌟
Food was really good, a little pricier than we were anticipating, but worth it especially if you have leftovers for the next day.
*was able to just get one meze appetizer instead of choosing 3 for $24. Just got the labneh with pita for $10.
The Brussel sprouts were delicious, just a kiss of heat, really enjoyed my halloumi salad, and the chicken shawarma was delicious and filling (plenty of food to share or to have for leftovers)', 'Holy moly the “vegan chunk steak” is incredible!! I cannot believe that was vegan! And the roasted vegetables, wow.

And I love the Middle Eastern atmosphere and the desserts selection was great. That Halva mousse was yum.']

name: WYCKOFF RESTAURANT
reviews: ['Great food but hard to find parking. Come here early if you are driving. Try the lattes they are good!', 'Its not horrible. Its worse than that. Its non refundable, non replaceable garbage. Medium rare, low quality buffalo chicken and the mac & cheese looked like red soup. Ever seen red, watery, mac&cheese? Me neither. I was so mad with how the mng responded to my call back, I almost went over there, just to throw it at his face! They really need to start giving us the option to give no stars and still be able to review...its that bad. Dont take it from me only, also from everyone else who got stiffed by this place.', 'The food was great Good customer service I will go here again the food was great', "The low rating is mind-blowing. 5 stars, e.g. the tortilla is hand made from scratch. I am a major foodie. Note: I've only had the Mexican food. I would never order non-Mexican at Mexican joint.", 'Horrible ... My tacos look like paper sheets, 4 dollars for horribles tacos ... 0 Stars . never again.']

name: CHEZ OSKAR
reviews:
['the lamb in the lambburger was surprisingly not juicy / oozing with oil and fat. it was more firm. this is not a problem but just very different from what i imagined. the sides were pretty good; i really enjoyed a ridiculous amount of the fries.. great atmosphere and good price.', "We stumbled upon this place by chance and were delighted by its charming and decorative outdoor and indoor seating. Since it wasn’t busy when we arrived, we were seated quickly.

The cocktail selection was impressive, and the food menu had a good variety. My friends and I tried the steak frites, mussels, risotto, shrimp, and lamb burger. Everything was flavorful and well-cooked.

A couple of minor points: the steak was just average compared to other places, and it would have been nice to have some butter or olive oil with the bread they provide at the start.

Overall, it's a great spot for a nice meal and enjoyable drinks.", 'Stopped by for brunch and was pleasantly surprised by how courteous the staff were. The dining room is BEAUTIFUL as is the outdoor seating. The food was fairly priced (typical NY prices for drinks 14-17$). Eggs were a bit overcooked for my Benedict but it was still delicious. I felt that it brought the presentation down by serving the bread in a cheap, carnival style basket but it’s free, I guess? It was hard and cold. Our server was kind but slightly pushy even though it was fairly empty. Nevertheless, good portions and beautiful environment.', "The space was funky, beautiful, fun and delightful, our waiter (Gino) was also fun, friendly, helpful and did a really superb job, and oh yeah, the meal wasn't bad either! Haha Delicious lunches, fresh, light, tasty...all in all a perfect dining experience! Thanks again Gino and the chef and the interior decorator...we will be back!", 'Never a bad word to say. They changed loactions but I made sure to find them. The staff’s customer service is comparable to going to a friend’s home for a special occasion dinner. The atmosphere is cozy, just the right temperature, beautiful colors and artwork, with music from an array of genres that somehow seem to flow flawlessly. Then there’s the food. My taste buds haven’t been disappointed in the least. Every dish is flavorful, never salty, arranged beautifully and slight substitutions are never an issue, like swapping a boiled egg for a sunny side up one. Of course you can wash it down with one of their wonderful beverages, from sparkling water to strawberry margaritas and their specialty drinks. Great price point as well and family friendly. Tell’em I sent ya and enjoy']

name: ALTA CALIDAD
reviews:
['There is a lot of great food here. The guacamole was delicious. I really enjoyed the brussel sprouts and my chicken tacos. Also its been a while since I’ve been to a mexican spot that actually salted their rice and beans.  My partner thought their tempura tacos were a bit burnt. Honestly the food was good but the price didnt match. Like 2 tacos being $18 is kind of absurd. It was just a little too expensive. But i do think it is worth going back. Their cocktails were good as well.', 'Honestly some of the best Mexican food I’ve had in NYC. Delicious flavors, fresh ingredients, and good portions.

We had the chips and guacamole + salsa to share. Wow so delicious. They put tajin on the chips for that extra flavor.

Also ordered the shrimp tacos - amazing. Fresh, flavorful, and not doing too much while still be so delicious. And the torta - wow. So so so delicious.

Definitely recommended and will be back again.', 'Tried out the brunch menu at @altacalidadbk and my breakfast roti was giant! There was a lot of topping (too much for me personally) so actually ok to share with another person. The restaurant is smaller than I expected but very nice vibes and the staff were friendly.', "The atmosphere and service are the only redeeming aspects of this restaurant. It has plenty of potential but our food arrived burnt, dry, or mediocre at best, considering the steep prices. The queso fundido came in a skillet and was charred to the point where it became very tough and took forever to chew. The yucca fries were dry and stiff, and the rest of the food was just ok considering the average 20$ price tag. The atmosphere was very nice and the service was great, I just hope this isn't the standard for their kitchen. Edit:
margaritas were solid, good quality tequila and balance of refreshing flavors.", 'Every single bite was delicious. The drinks were amazing, super smooth. Service was exceptional. Not a single bad moment in the entire experience. In my top 10 list for NYC restaurants!']

name: GOLDEN KRUST CARIBBEAN RESTAURANT
reviews:
["I was just at this location, excited about having some rice and peas, but apparently, they have a problem explaining or even speaking to customers they dont want to. I wanna say it's because of my complexion, but i have no proof, only the vibes EVERYONE was giving.
They have an ox tail patty promotional pic on the window and in the store with absolutely NO PRICE on it. I ordered 2 sides of rice and peas (no meat), 3 chicken patties, and one ox tail, and with no explanation or confirmation, they rung us up, and the bill was $50. When i asked for the breakdown, they had 3 different women try to explain. When i saw the receipt, the rice and peas were 2 different prices. There was an order of pasta that was NEVER ordered, and then the ox tail patty, which was $15 ALONE!!! 🙄 I have never known a beef patty with some sauce on it to be more money than had I ordered a small plate of ox tail with a side.... seriously!?!? And the fact that no one said anything and when asked none of the 3 women, including the manager, could not explain properly until i went and got my man to handle it. They then took the original receipt with the mistakes and gave me a new one because they had to know i was gonna post it.
I dont care about paying for food but the same way they wouldn't like problems with my money, i shouldn't have problems with the service period!
BTW... the Ox tail patty got nothing but fat in it and mac & cheese which my fiancé did NOT want. $50 for this?!?!", 'Portion was decent, but it was all bland. I got rice and peas, jerk chicken, mac salad and mac n cheese. Rice was bland and the Jerk chicken was super dry. The mac salad was decent but the Mac n cheese was yet again dry and bland.', "We weren't sure of what they hv on their menu when we arrived late evening. The fella over the counter was friendly n emphasised their food Halal status which made our selection much easier. That made us return next coupla days for an early breakfast before we departed for Atlantic City..", 'Several issues here, I put these issues on the owners shoulders. I bought Pattie’s here several times. They were very good. The young ladies are always polite and courteous. Today I wanted some lunch for work, which is close by. I ordered a large stew chicken. I believe in supporting black business, but the business should seek to please the customer in a reasonable way. The portion of food was befitting of a small. All the chicken was boney and too salty. What I noticed as the lady was sharing the food, the manager/owner basically stood next to her watching how she shared the food. This is not the first time I’ve seen this here. I tried to call hoping that there could be a conversation, the phone is not on. I hope someone that knows the owner can communicate with him about the atmosphere he has created in this shop. In the future I will not spend my money here. He has a great staff, he must do better and will see bigger returns for his efforts. See attached photos. I separated the chicken so you can see what the pieces looked like🤔\U0001fae4 this is not a large', 'First off let me just say I never felt impaled to write a review, but today I must. I sent my son to get us two large oxtail dinners, let me just say the meat they are serving was not oxtail I believe it was beef neckbones and I was pissed. How are you charging oxtail prices and not serving oxtail. The reason I knew it wasn’t oxtail is because when I broke off a piece of the meat, it was red inside, oxtail meat is not red inside after it’s been cooked, plus it had a different texture then oxtail so I decided to call the store..problem number two the phone number is not in service. I wanted to let them know personally that what they are doing is wrong on so many levels. And yes I’ve heard the customer service there is trash. I will never patronize them ever again.']

name: KAR RESTAURANT
reviews:
["This is the best cheap Chinese food you're going to find around here!

The best General Tso's chicken I have ever had. Specifically, the breading was very crisp and firm. Many restaurants get this wrong and don't make them crispy enough!! The sauce was great of course. I also tried their roasted pork bun and it was fire.

Their iced tea is the most delicious tea I have tasted.

VERY affordable and good deals.", 'This place was amazing!! No need to go to Chinatown anymore. This was delicious, and the restaurant was very clean. Great portions. It is mostly for takeout but it was still great!!', 'This place was good.... now it sucks. The owner is rude, and food quality went way down. They open their doors at 11:00 and tell you they are closed at 11;30 AM. They will go out of business soon if they keep doing this. Learn some English in America so you can communicate with potential customers.', 'I love, love, love their food. It is fresh, tasty and they give you just the right amount of food. I love their Shrimp in Lobster sauce, the best, the shrimps are big, succulent and taste like butter. Their Orange chicken, General Tao’s chicken, Chicken/French fries combo, Boneless Ribs, Egg Drop and Won Ton soups, are very good and tasty as well. Their delivery service is on time, 30-45 min. max, the drivers are friendly and the food arrives nice and hot. I give them 10!!!! I hope they stay a 10!!!', 'When Kar first opened up, the food was really good. Nice and fresh. Great taste. But now, I will never go back there. Something changed a few months ago. The rice was very bland. The flavor just wasn’t the same. A few weeks ago they expanded to a more traditional Chinese Restaurant menu. The rib tips taste amazing so I decided to get a plate yesterday 6/13. This will be my LAST time going there. Along with my rib tips I ordered pork fried rice. Which I’ve ordered in the past. I get home to see I literally have four pieces of pork in my container of rice. There were no vegetables in the rice. No onions, carrots, peas… NOTHING! Rice bland, dry and sticking together. Some pieces weren’t even cooked thoroughly. I call to let them know about this and the manager tells me “combo orders don’t have the same amount of food as non-combo orders”. This was a complete lie! First, my order wasn’t a combo. I had two separate containers. One with the tips and the other with the rice. Then he says “if you want extra pork you have to pay extra”. So I’m supposed to pay $2 for another four little pieces of pork? Places like this really need to stop getting our business because they take our business for granted.']

name: GOLDEN KRUST CARIBBEAN RESTAURANT
reviews: ["There is few restaurant that can get this jamaica cuisine right.  They staff at this golden Krust never disappointment.  No matter what I choose to order.  You can't go wrong eating here.  They even expand the menu to include vegan theme and Chinese options.  Best of all you won't find the staff distracted by cellphones.", 'I bought current goat rice and peas, got home started dishing it out and I got a strand of hair no less than 20 inches in my food 😭. I was angry I threw it away b4 taking a pic of the hair but below 👇 all the food is in the trash 😡😡.', "Was in the area and ordered two beef patties. It was horrible. It was definitely old and stale.  I didn't even finish it. Should have took a picture.  The beef was so dried out and it got stiff and hard to pull apart. Instead of throwing away days old patties they rather sell it and give customers bad food, mess up their reputation snd get you potentially sick.  If I  had seen these stars before I went in, I  wouldn't have step foot in there. However I wanted some patties and when I was going to the bank I saw it right there.", 'I\'ll suggest you train the employees properly before making them serve other people, there\'s only so much someone could tolerate.\nYou mean to tell me you could buy a side of white rice one day or maybe 1 or 2 pieces of fried chicken by it self and it\'s okay but if you walk in and try to buy the side of white rice and 2 pcs of fried chicken separately is a problem because "You\'re robbing the company" that\'s what she said to me, so how does that make sense? If I go in to buy a side of white rice and go back later to buy 2 pcs of fried chicken, that\'s okay, but not in one transaction, and not only that buy be madd rude about it.... Keep the "great" job this location is gonna go places..', 'Bought 2 small chicken  soups for 14.37 at Golden crust on rockaway & Ave M .first of all  2 small CHICKEN   soup for this price  Is way overpriced.  And to top it off the soup did not have any seasoning no taste except a lot of SALT . I dont know who made it but it cant be a real jamaican cook . Soup  was horrible  no taste just  SALTY.']

name: RICO CHIMI
reviews:
['I’m very buy very picky went it comes to eat in the street but this restaurant really deserves my respect 10 of 10 food fresh , lovely service, and the price was very cheap I totally recommend in this restaurant your money is worth 👌', 'Now this place is a nyc must go to if your looking for Dominican food and bachata playing in the calmly throughout the dining area - I can tell this spot is lit late night- but yes I really enjoyed every about this place 👍🏾👍🏾 I ordered and chicken chimi and fries with a Latin cherry drink. Don’t forget the MayoKetchup mixture too', 'Traditional Dominican Chimichurri burger lends its name to this small chain of just several locations in NYC. Sandwiches (chimis) are so rich flavor that they call themselves “Rico Chimi”. Obvious.
Place on Myrtle Ave is surprisingly much better looking inside that outside. Its bright, plenty of air, lots of wood panels. Feels like family place to me.
There are 7 tables inside with some outdoor seating. Though nearby subway makes so much noise that seating outside is only for hearing-challenged people.
Menu is varied - lots of drinks including natural juices, lots of Dominican and Spanish-influenced dishes such as quesadillas, patacones, fritura , picao, emoanadas, monfongos, yaroas, burritos and even gyros!
Every dish comes in variety of options, I counted about 15 variants only for fritura.
I chose myself traditional chicken chimi and I wasn’t disappointed. Pieces of chicken, lots of vegetables (always a good idea) and juicy cabbage. I really enjoyed. And its comes in a size enough to satisfy a hungry man.
So don’t skip this place over. Come and enjoy.', 'This has to be one of the worst food experiences in NYC. The staff is so rude. She took my order incorrectly, and it had the nerve to be rolling her eyes and making all types of faces when I confronted her about it. It says I wasn’t supposed to care!  If you value your money, please don’t come here. Everything is overpriced. The food is not nearly as good for what they’re charging you for. Highly recommend any other chimi spot smh', 'Me and my friends ordered the 5 carnes  snack it was amazing, delivery super fast food was still hot, different options of payment definitely recommend']

name: TABBOULEH CAFE & RESTAURANT
reviews: ['Family is the first thing that comes to mind when I arrive . I am very proud of the growth  of this fine family establishment.  I was mesmerized by the atmosphere it is extremely peaceful ✌️.  The food is amazing, cozy, and made with ❤️ love. Thank you for a wonderful yet memorable experience ✨️ 💖 me and my sister and I had. I am recommending them at a 10/10 drop by with good zen and tip well when you go. Photos below. Ps. My sister witnessed Osama give to a person in need of a meal to eat. I just saved this location as my favorite. That was so honorable. I am grateful 🙏 it was my pleasure to stop by. All the employees are amazing. Thank you. The music is on point 👉.', 'The Chicken Brussels Bowl was filling and delicious. I asked for the non-spicy version with garlic sauce and tzatziki. The portion size was huge compared to other similar restaurants. I could easily stretch my bowl into 2-3 meals. The chefs were also very friendly. We’ll be back to try more!', 'I was craving some middle eastern/Mediterranean food and this place did not disappoint! A great selection and the ingredients are all very fresh with the shish kebab made upon ordering. I had the build your own bowl and highly recommend. To top it off, the staff is very friendly and warm, even asking how the food was after!', 'I’m blown away by the love and care Osa puts into every dish. The service and his passion for cooking shows and the flavors are out of this world.
