Got the salmon bowl with lentil rice I’m gonna spend the rest of the day finishing this baby because boy was it BIG \U0001faf6🏼 heart & belly full!!', 'The beef pita sandwich and the chicken bowl were both very great, filling yet healthy and packed with flavor. Prices weren’t too crazy for the quality of the food. Based on what you order you may have to wait a bit but it should be worth it.']

name: IV PURPOSE
reviews: ['This is my second time coming here. Their cheeseburger was delicious and the fries were delicious also. It was a pricey burger with tax it came up to $39.00. Even though they forgot my extra cheese it was still good. The meat was thick and juicy. Nice size for the price. Nice little local sports bar.', 'IV purpose has delivered quality service with amazing food and drinks for my non-profit event. When you arrive, ask for Gabby she gave my group excellent customer service by being attentive. I would undoubtedly book again with this fine establishments for my next event or just come to hang out.', 'I Ordered The Blackened Salmon Entree , The Other Dishes Were The Jerk Chicken ,& A Salmon Burger & Cheesesteak Egg Rolls. Great Service , Good Music & The Server Was Very Caring About Why My Sister Was Upset. I Really Appreciated That Sentiment. Food Was Amazing.  10/10 Will Return', 'I can’t recommend this place enough! I met with the manager a day before we wanted to host a watch party for our biggest college rivalry game. I told her that we’d have about 25-30 people and just wanted to support a Black-Owned Business. They were staffed up, people enjoyed the wings, and the rum punch had everyone lit. There’s multiple TVs, and music can be on or off. We’ll be back soon!', 'The cheesecake egg rolls is the only thing I like here. Oh Be careful with the bartenders. They like to switch up on your drinks. If you order the same drink, my first drink did not taste like any of my third fourth or fifth.']

name: RAMONITAS RESTAURANT
reviews: ["There is no service, the atmosphere it's great, very calm and Hispanic", "The restaurant is inside the Moore supermarket. We fell back in Puerto Rico! The food was delicious, and tasted like Mom's food. The prices are very affordable and everyone there was friendly.", 'The regular alcapurias are so delicious 😋 that is my go to when I come back home. They have Bacalaitos relleno de papa other foods. Good spot', 'Ive been coming here for 30 years. I’ve seen it change and elevate. It’s always great food.\nPriced very reasonable.\nFlan is also great.', 'Amazing Spanish food 😍 great atmosphere. Eat in or take out. Prices are reasonable. Great service.']

name: 4 CAMINOS MEXICAN RESTAURANT
reviews: ['are you f... kidding me???!they charged me 42$ dollars for two tiny margaritas and one orange juice,thievery!!! avoid.', 'Server tried to pull a fast one and add more tip to the bill.\nFood was mediocre at best.\nAlso so expensive for what it was. Definitely would recommend reading the menu carefully before they charge you $24 for chilaquiles. Hate to bash a local business but that feeling of being taken advantage of was worse.', 'I order my food, it never came to me. I waited an hour and called again. The lady on the end made an excuse that the delivery driver had 4 deliveries to make before me. She then proceeded to call me 2 hours later and told me that the driver was downstairs. I waited 20 minutes outside and when I tried to call again I found out that they blocked me. Never again.', 'I was here. Friday night  on Dec 2 at around 4pm Food was very horrible it didn’t have no type of flavor. And the green plantains was not fresh. And the drink didn’t even taste like a piña colada and it didn’t taste like anything and she had the nerve to charge eight dollars extra to put extra liquor on it I would not ever go back to this place ever again.', "First and foremost, the eggs, divorce style (huevos divorciados), were very delicious. You can have them with french fries, frijoles(beans), two eggs any style. Or home fries. It comes with guacamole as well. For those who don't like pork, the frijoles have pork. The coffee mug is big. The coffee is also good. It has a nice Mexican setting. It has a bar as well. You can order a bucket of 6 beers for $30. I recommend this place. By the way, the waiter, being great with child, served us real good with a smile."]

name: CAFE MADO
reviews:
["Lovely atmosphere and good food. Almost everything on the menu has bread, and while the bread is excellent, it was too much. The menu is too vague, and while I'm a fan of restaurants interpreting common dishes, this restaurant's interpretation is too heavy on the bread for me. The service at the bar was somewhat absent.", 'Absolutely delicious food, came in only for a bite and some coffee but ended up getting a few plates based on their recommendations, so happy I did. Everything is so well made and paired, savored each bite. Mushrooms were absolutely delicious, the summer melon was unique (sweet, can be a dessert) the red wine is a blend and delicious as well! Can’t wait to go back and try more!', 'Service / staff were friendly and atmosphere and vibes were great. The three food dishes we got tasted good and had a nice presentation, though took a while and wouldn’t be anything to write home about. Cocktail selection was underwhelming - the pour for my house spritz (pictured) was noticeably smaller than what was served to other tables.', 'I’m such a huge fan of Oxalis and I can’t wait for it to reopen so it’s no surprise that I ended up loving Cafe Mado!

The menu seems super understated but I promise everything is more special than it seems. My favorite were:

- Pici Pasta with Fava Beans & Mint: Super lemony and loved that the fava beans were kind of the highlight. The intermittent bites of mint were great too.

- BBQ Tri-Tip with Dried Chili: This one surprised me. The beef was so tender and I loved the chili sauce it came with.

- Grilled Mushroom Toast with Egg Yolk: I honestly love anything with a runny yolk and the grilled lion’s mane was super umami and made this mushroom lover extremely happy

- Blackened Yuba: This was like tofu skin soaked in some chili tomato situation and I wanted more.

Don’t sleep on the desserts either. I know they sound kind of uninteresting: Swiss Roll with Huckleberry and Strawberries with Chamomile, but we liked them a lot more than we assumed!

Wasn’t in the mood to drink so I got the two nonalcoholic options: the Grand Fir and the Jasmine & Pear. The Grand Fir was flavored with pine and was the “drier”option, while the Jasmine & Pear was floral (lol surprise) and slightly sweet. Both were carbonated. I really liked both!

Service was friendly as ever. The servers seemed like they were excited to share what their favorites were and it made me excited as well. The dining space was the bar area of the old Oxalis; they’ve remodeled the tasting menu area into a daytime cafe. Need to try that out as well.

Overall: I want so badly to gatekeep this place but I think everyone should try it! Will be back often.', 'All around a great visit to this spot! My friend and I got 5 different items (bread, two apps, one main, and fries). Overall the bread and apps were the stand out by far! The bean purée situation was unreal and the strawberry ricotta toast was divine. Also got the Caesar salad which was crisp and salty. I’d say the big miss for me was the main with the smoked trout. It was a TINY piece and the mushrooms were too smokey for my liking. The dish is $32 bucks and not worth it. Funny enough my friend who recommended this place also said his fish dish was his least favorite part and sadly I agree. The cocktails were great (spritz & strawberry) and the dessert was so tasty (sponge cake). Menu changes a lot! Great service. I’d go back but skip any fish dish!']

name: PJ CARIBBEAN RESTAURANT
reviews: ['The jerk chicken was good, a bit spicy. I ordered pretty close to closing so I wasn’t sure what I was going to get. I placed an Uber eats order. The portion size was perfect, not too big or small I ordered for one person (small size). The jerk chicken was definitely on the spicy side but that speaks to how authentic it is. The mac&cheese was quality, cooked well with lots of cheese throughout it; however, it was very bland. Some pepper even would’ve went a long way. I’ve had really great Mac and cheese from a Jamaican restaurant before, so my expectations might be too high. Overall, not bad, I wouldn’t mind ordering from here again.', 'So, I love this restaurant, I love their food , prices and everything however there is these two employees that is absolutely inconsiderate. They constantly tell me they don’t have enough food for the night, I just be so confused about that because , you’re supposed to serve the customers. Anyway , I am a loyal customer, I come there everytime. However this night 10/7/2024 two ladies were in the back, and I asked for extra potatoes for my only rice and gravy meal, just potatoes, and she gave me one piece of potato then told me that there isn’t enough for the night. I’ll be reporting to someone as soon as I can.', 'Im not mad at this spot. I wanted some caribbean food in the area and found this little hole in the wall. I felt like I walked into someone’s kitchen in their home but this is a business. The food looked sketchy but after my first bite, I was like “okay I can do this”. My favorite was the rice and peas. They nailed it. The mac n cheese, not so much but Im from the south so this would be hard to please for me. All in all, I could see me coming back here.', 'This is my to go to spot when ordering on Uber Eats. I order from them frequently. They never disappoint and the food is tasty. I can’t believe I’m saying this but many Jamaican restaurants these days don’t cook good food these days. PJ’s is an exception, multiple dishes from them are well cooked and well seasoned. My favorite thing from them is their Jerk Chicken with Rice & Peas with a side of macaroni salad and some oxtail gravy.', 'I ordered two meals through uber eats; jerk chicken w/ vegetable rice, cabbage, plantain and curry chicken w/ rice & peas, cabbage, plantain with a side of mac and cheese. The rice had oxtail gravy as requested but there was no sauce on the chicken even though I requested sauce. The chicken was very dry and stale. I had to throw out majority of the pieces of chicken. The vegetable rice tasted mediocre. It was just yellow rice w/ frozen mixed vegetables. The curry chicken meal was packaged very poorly. The mac n cheese was placed under the main dish causing it to be soggy. There was no cabbage with my meal, instead there was  cole slaw. Everything was piled up on top of each other. Very distasteful. I usually order from here and enjoy the food but this time was not good.']

name: MR CHEN CHINESE RESTAURANT
reviews:
['Came here bc I was at show around the corner and needed something to eat. The Chicken wings were bigger than most places are these days, everyone place seems to have smaller wings after all the inflation lately. Which made up all the onions they put in the rice. The food was ready very quickly. And they had problem
giving me extra soy and hot sauce. And there was seating.', 'Wings are not refreshed. He literally told me they refry them. My order was not fresh the wings were black inside and the you can tell they were refried multiple times. The plantains super dry and refried as well.

They have a terrible attitude. I called to ask them to send me a new order. He told me they don’t have anymore wings and that they’re fresh after he told me they refried them. Not sure of the logic here, but they need to change the oil or throw away the wings they fried the day prior.

Definitely don’t recommend.', 'Greetings to everyone, for my experience, I do not recommend this Chinese restaurant. The truth is, it is not worth ordering there. The food is stored and they sell things already stored. They are not fresh. This place is not. I do not recommend you to go shopping or eat because I ordered. shrimp fried rice with spar ribs what they gave me was the worst rice I have ever eaten in my entire life rice kept and dry without flavor and the ribs I think were made in the deep fried I do not recommend this place there are many Chinese restaurants in the area that can and offers better services, the truth is that I regret seeing my money paid and wasted there, they should be a little more aware and provide better service with the food, this place does not serve, it was the last time I bought there as', "Staff friendly food is good one of best Chinese food I've eaten fresh too", "They mess up your order and don’t fix it nor do they care. I ordered two DIET Snapples and got two regulars. I called and explained I’m diabetic and can’t drink this. name: EL SABOR DE LA ESQUINA
reviews:
['I ordered a few to go plates from this restaurant one day. I’ve ordered a steak meal with rice and beans. While the rice and beans were ok I vomited after eating the steak. The representative that took my order was a nice guy. They just don’t have much to choose from. I’ve never ate from this restaurant since and I do not plan on doing so in the future.', '¡Hola! ¿Cómo estás?
Muy lindo.
That's me walking into El Sabor de la Esquina pretty confident in my Spanish. I saw it was a Spanish joint so I was going to practice my shxt. I wasn't expecting what I got.

The lone Bartender/Server spoke ONLY Spanish! The two patrons my friend and I met at the bar spoke ONLY Spanish!
Yikes!
But I got this, I'm on day 1339 of my Spanish lessons on Duolingo.

We chose a table and staff appeared with "hola ¿dudyehr ducrcyd lbbeu icttcne?
Shamefully, that's what I heard.
My Duolingo failed me. I responded
"Can you speak S L O W L Y". She shook her head confused and then she pulled out her phone.
And that's how we communicated.
Phone, gestures and poor Spanish words/phrases from me. Aye! Hahaha.

I loved that she immediately put gloves on when we ordered drinks. She made them to our specifications.

We weren't planning on getting food as it was the Friday after Thanksgiving. But, the food on display in the warmer looked really appetizing.

My friend got rice and beans/arroz y frijoles and I got cassava and pork/yuca y cerdo.

Their food is ABSOLUTELY DELICIOUS! It's authentic Caribbean/Hispanic food. The seasoning just so just so! The textures absolutely the way I like it.

I will be back for the following reasons:
Staff (and patrons) were friendly and patient.
The spot is clean.
I can practice my Espanol with my new Dominican friend:-)
And THE FOOD IS OUT OF THIS WORLD ON PITKIN AVE GREAT!!!

YES!
Score!

The End.', 'Very fresh dominican comfort food. Friendly service and made everything to order. Chicken empanadas were amazing. I got the fritura platter which was good but the carne guisada looked amasing.', 'The food was delicious, service wasn’t the best, got drinks 10 minutes into our meal. Problem is menu they gave us had the wrong prices. Overcharged me for things like small rice and beans for $10 and didn’t remember about an order until we were about to leave. The people are friendly just don’t seem to have much service experience.', "Great food great customer service everyone is very friendly it's very clean and comfortable it's definitely a place too take your girlfriend on a date or your family out to eat I highly recommend you try it"]

name: CAOBA
reviews:
['The food is good. I go here multiple times a month. Sometimes the food is salty, but the flavor is there & I do like the food is not greasy.
I took off 1 star for the overall rating because the prices compared to the portions are truly ridiculous. Why is rice with ONE chicken $7??? This should have been a $5 meal. Especially because they put little rice compared to other Dominican spots. But the one piece of chicken for $7 upset me 😂', 'As soon as you walk in you can smell how good the food is even before you see it. Fast and friendly service. I got the lunch special with rice & beans and roast pork. Tender, juicy and full of flavor. The prices are very reasonable. If you like good food and have respect for yourself eat at Caoba.', "I ordered a medium yellow rice, beans and stewed chicken with some plantains. I wanted to add a small portion of mashed potatoes to my plate but they said it's charged as an additional side since I already have rice.

The presentation is excellent, the food looks and tastes great my only gripe is the chicken could have been cooked more. It's good as flavor goes and the portion is filling. Definetely the best spanish food in the area as others tend to be more salty. The staff seem nice.

For the largest bottle of water and my meal, I paid about $12.", 'This place states packed during work hours and especially lunch time. Great smorgasbord of different foods, proteins, pasta,soup etc. Cooked fresh daily, presented well. Establishment is very clean and staff is proficient in handling the influx of hungry patrons during a short lunch period.

Give them a try!!', 'The area has a limited selection of retail stores and restaurants, which makes Caoba the go-to spot for anyone working nearby.

name: CARIDAD
reviews: ['We had dined in at the restaurant I ordered a platter to try all of there meats let’s just say I left there throwing up with food poisoning the next couple days. I WARN YOU ALL THIS ESTABLISHMENT NOT ONLY HAS POOR CUSTOMER SERVICE BUT ARE SERVING DISEASES TO YOU ON A PLATE BE AWARE STAY AWAY AND DO NOT EAT FROM HERE I WILL BE REPORTING THIS RESTAURANT TO THE FDA AND NY FOOD AND HEALTH WERE WORKING ON GETTING THEM SHUT DOWN THIS PLACE IS KILLING PEOPLE.', 'No season at all on fries so upset not even salt  do not order breakfast from here I could imagine the other food if you can’t even season some potatoes', 'This location has been going down hill. The moment you step inside, you’re wrapped in an aroma that feels like a warm hug from a familiar place. For anyone seeking a Dominican dining experience, Caridad Restaurant is the place to go, where the perfect reminder of Santiago's food is."]

name: JOE'S RESTAURANT
reviews:
['Joe's Restaurant in Ridgewood, NY is the real deal, folks! I mean, I've had my fair share of Italian food, but this place is the cousin that always brings the best dishes to the family reunion!

I went in expecting the usual pasta and sauce, but oh no, Joe's brought out the big guns! The ribeye steak was so tender, I thought I was in a scene from The Godfather. And don't even get me started on the lobster - it was like a taste explosion in my mouth!

But the real MVP was the mash potatoes - who knew those humble spuds could be so... exciting? And the spaghetti marinara? Classic, just like Nonna used to make!

And let's not forget the appetizers - shrimp cocktail that was so fresh, I thought I saw the shrimp waving at me, and a green salad with bread and garlic olive oil dip that was basically a taste sensation!

All this, plus a warm and fuzzy family atmosphere that made me feel like I was part of the crew. And the coffee? Fuhgeddaboutit! It was like a hug in a mug!

In short, Joe's Restaurant is the real deal. Go there, eat all the things, and thank me later. Five stars, ten stars, a million stars - it's not enough!" Boun appetito!!', "I went to Joe's Restaurant for the first time with my mother and daughter for dinner before heading to a show.   The atmosphere is soothing with low lighting and a great Playlist playing i the background.   The service was friendly and attentive.   The food was delicious, nice portions, and enough to take some home for a snack the next day.  I was pleasantly surprised by this gem in my neighborhood.   I will be visiting again.", 'Amazing food! Will be going back soon. I enjoyed every meal. Steak was juicy! Bread made fresh! And good serving size portions.', 'Hidden Gem!! We had attended a wake a few blocks away and discovered Joe’s Restaurant. We were a party of 8 on a Friday night without a reservation and they were kind enough to accommodate us. The food and service was outstanding! We even met the owner who made sure we were well taken care of. Everything is made fresh and you can taste the difference. Can’t wait to go back! ❤️', 'Classic spot. One of my favorite places in queens to get good Italian food. No thrills, just good food.']

reviews:
['Tacos can be made wrong. They don’t do that here. Top 5 best tacos I’ve had in NYC! The Horchata could use more flavor. 9/10! Coming again', 'Very delicious!! Loved the fish tacos and the steak nachos!!!  I’ve now been here 5 times and it’s always good. I’ve also tried the French toast and the chilaquiles. They are both so good!!! I keep coming back', "I believe this is a family-owned restaurant. One of the better Mexican spots in the neighborhood.

The cashier and staff are very nice. The Chipotle sauce and tacos adds lots of flavor.

I haven't had any bad food here or gotten sick as opposed to other (more expensive restaurants).", "My Belly is Happy and full now. When I finally got home I started with the chicken and to my surprise they only used one taco I am use to 2 soft taco tortillas. The same for the fish only one. Had me scratching my head. So the fish was fried nicely just a little hard but the flavors together worked wonderfully on my taste buds. The chicken was not the way I am use to it , it was kinda sweet. So it took away from the expected flavor of down home tacos. But my greedy self ate them. Lol. I have to try a few other things here before I give this place a five-star. I'm hoping everything is as good as good can be.", 'Delicious, flavorful, and affordable tacos! I came upon this place because I had a craving, and the food was amazinggg! I dined in and the service was great, definitely coming back here to try more of the menu! 😋🌮']

name: IMMANUEL RESTAURANT INC
reviews:
["⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

**A Hidden Gem in East New York!**

This Panamanian restaurant in East New York, Brooklyn, is an absolute treasure! From the moment I walked in, I was welcomed with warm smiles and exceptional customer service that made me feel like family. The authenticity of the food is unmatched—every dish bursts with rich, traditional flavors that transport you straight to Panama.I highly recommend trying their mangu con salami they were cooked to perfection. The portion sizes are generous! The ambiance is cozy and inviting, making it a perfect spot for both casual dining and take out ! If you're looking for a true taste of Panama with service that goes above and beyond, this is the place to be. I can't wait to return and explore more of their delicious menu!", 'This is an excellent location for purchasing Panamanian fritura. The empanadas and carrimañola are outstanding, with my eight-year-old daughter having two by herself. They offer authentic chrorriso picante. The ojalda (fried dumplings, or bake), were exceptional. They prepare the fritura to order, which I greatly appreciate. My family thoroughly enjoyed everything they consumed. The proprietor, Janet, is exceedingly pleasant and accommodating. Despite driving 33 miles to eat at this establishment, I was not disappointed. I will be returning .Qué  viva Panamá hoy mañana y siempre 🇵🇦', "I lived in the neighborhood for over 15 years, and this is the first and last time I'll eat at this establishment. All I wanted was a small chicken soup and a small white rice. The server dumped the rice in the soup, and the soup was more oil, chicken fat, and bones than anything else. On top of that, she charged me for a large soup. I suggest any other restaurant before this one. I really would give my 1st ZERO star ever if I could. Truthfully, I couldn't even eat it.", 'Food was excellent and I had a great experience because the customer service was extremely great. If you’re looking for good Spanish, West Indian and American food this is the place to be. I heard the breakfast is even better. This is definitely my new spot.', 'I love this restaurant. I go to this place every morning and they are so nice in there every time. They are quick as well so that’s always a plus. If your ever in East NY stope here for a bite to eat.']

My 3rd time coming here and is always the same energy', 'Bro I wish this restaurant is near my apartment. Food is cheap, delicions and prepared with love. The servers are very nice! They have alcohol too if you want! Will definitely come here again!!', 'DO NOT come to this place.. the service is disgraceful.. they have disgusting customer service and a very horrible attitude. Not only that they love to steal from clients like myself because they have a preference of South Americans only.. THEY DO NOT LIKE BLACK PEOPLE.. They will triple charge you and skimp you on the food and when you see the South Americans eating their plates are full meanwhile yours is counted and very skimpy and they want to over charge you. Not only that theirs location is super dirty and many other people have gotten sick eating in this place. Please save yourself. Read all the other comments. I will be reaching out to 311 on this location', 'Best place , in my opinion, food is way too good . And the best chicharron in Brooklyn, para mi es uno de los mejores lugares .', "Woah regular Fish was crazy salty. messed up to serve someone that. Trying to recall what have done to chef that he's trying to kill me. And like that cheap iodized stuff that contains chemical agents.

And this is from someone who regularly enjoys salted beef and salted fish on menus.

I would be scared to order here again."]

name: SAJOMA
reviews:
["Stay far away from this place!!! My child got food poisoning from their food! Do not buy food from them under any circumstances! When we went to their cafe to discuss the poor quality of their food, they initially spoke English. Then they switched to Spanish, claiming they didn't understand any English. We entered their kitchen where they prepare food and witnessed appalling filth. The kitchen was completely dirty, with a greasy, filthy floor. The stove was caked in grime and grease. Several foul-smelling chickens that reeked of rot were lying on the table. We took several photos of this kitchen and will definitely post them on Google Maps to protect others from getting sick. Protect yourself and your loved ones from this cafe!!! Keep your distance!!!", "Absolutely appalling service! And it gets worse - I found a dead fly in my food from this cafe. The kicker? I couldn't even confront them about it because I'd gotten takeout and was miles away when I started eating.
Steer clear of this place, folks! I'm not even mad about the money I wasted - I'm kicking myself for not reading the reviews before buying anything there.
Word to the wise: think twice before getting food from this joint. You've been warned!", 'Idk how people eat here or even call this Spanish food. Everything tastes the same and it’s all very underwhelming. I’ve always said you can tell when someone puts a lot of love into their food and this place is just not it. Their prices are ridiculous and they do overcharge. A coworker of mine bought a Mangu plate from here for 9 dollars. I ordered the same plate the next day and they charged me 12.', 'Horrible customer service! Would act like they don’t understand English unless you in person! Do not play with people on the phones! And make sure you pay attention to your charges, they will charge extra!
Oh & all the food has the same taste!', "I really use to enjoy going to this place every so often, because the prices were great and it's convenient, it's walking distance from my home. But now they are starting to overcharge  the customers, and they have become money greedy. I went there today and 1 of the ladies in the front charged me $9 for a small lunch. I understand I got a vegetable, but it was only supposed to be $1 more. When I called to address it, they hung up the phone on me. Not acceptable, and I will NOT be spending anymore money with them. Be warned people!!!"]

name: THE AVENUE RESTAURANT & BAR
reviews: ["I called the Avenue from out of state to have food delivered for family who lost their loved one. Rob, the owner was extremely helpful, honest and kind in organizing a catering order to feed about 10 people for a few days. With in a few hours, after speaking, the food was delivered to the family ready to eat. I received pictures and an abundance of compliments about how delicious the food was and how the choices were spot on. I ordered trays; pasta, wings, sandwiches, chicken, and a salad. This restaurant has a wide variety of choices so there's lots to choose from. I will definitely call again if I should ever need food delivered in the area again, AND I will definitely take a trip there on my next visit to NY so I can personally thank Rob for his help and eat some of this delicious food myself.", 'I have been ordering for delivery from this local restaurant for a little while now and definitely need to make a visit.  The burgers are delicious and even with delivery- I love the sweet potato fries (which are not usually my go to). Their sauces and accompaniments are always tasty and fresh. They do offer live entertainment....', "The girls serving us were really sweet. Didn't like my drink too much, it was a simple cranberry and vodka that had no taste whatsoever. The food was ok. Nothing to brag about. Did enjoy the loaded nachos most of all. Food really wasn't what I expected or hoped to be. Should have tried the wings 🤷\u200d♀️", 'The restaurant is clean, service is fast, employees are extra friendly, nice, welcoming\nThis restaurant is one of the best restaurants in the neighborhood, the food and the drinks are outstanding.\nI arrived of here couple of the times, I had been extremely satisfied. The food is fresh, tastes amazing. I love the food here, the drinks additionally. This is a desired atmosphere, I only wish this restaurant was more popular, I love it here. The atmosphere, environment, workforce, is only great. I will arrive in here often.', 'I gave this place 5 stars but have never been there. The reason I do not wish to provide a negative review but this comes up in Google as a Lithuanian restaurant. In viewing the menu it seems this place is more of a pub that serves American bar food. Can anyone enlighten me as far as Lithuanian food they serve?']

name: FOUR T RESTAURANT INC
reviews: ['I ordered "Ackee & Saltfish" from Ubereats you guys seriously gotta get together. Would you feel comfortable knowing you paid 20 dollars for just saltfish. Seriously where is the ackee of this photo this is ridiculous.', 'Service was good. Food had flavor. I ordered a veggie platter, cabbage, rice, chick peas and plantain. Washed it down with a cream soda.', 'Always a delight. Good customer service.  Food is great... I really love their soup . Definitely get your money worth with portions and good taste.', 'Ordered mostly breakfast from this place many times and some lunch and dinner dishes. I am never disappointed by the food here. I especially love their liver and dumplings. The customer service is very good as well. I had an issue with my food and they were quick to offer an apology and a discount for next time. I will definitely be a customer for the foreseeable future.', 'Super friendly and helpful woman behind the counter. We got the curry goat roti and it was delicious.']

name: DURAN RESTAURANT
reviews: ['I always order food from this tiny restaurant and it is always fantastic.  I have had events catered by Duran and I can’t complain.  Juan is a great host and very polite.  Reyna is an amazing p  we son that always greets me with a smile.  Alicia is a great person too, her food is delicious.  Also Reyna cooks too, and the food is always delicious.  Perfect family atmosphere for Dominican food.', 'I ordered two mangus and they put one cheese one salami slice and one egg on each service, they charged me 20 dollars for a small plate as you can see in the picture above In other restaurants it’s usually one cheese , 2-3 salamis and 2 eggs. When I Called back they told me it’s been like that because meat and things are expensive. Horrible customer service.', "I ordered a few trays for my mom's birthday party. Omg the food was amazing, delicious talk of the party. Will definitely be doing business again and definitely recommend.", 'The people  there are very nice and the food it good', "While I was eating a roach was walking on the wall, Place need some cleaning stay safe when you going to eat. I couldn't finish my empanada🤢🤢🤢🤮🤮🤮. The name of the restaurant is not Rancho Cibaeño. The New Name is Tavares Restaurant."]

name: DOUBLE RESTAURANT
reviews: ['Double Restaurant is doubling the gameeee! The food was yummy, fresh off the wok, and came out quickly. It was nice and clean inside. If you want good chinese take out, then Double Restaurant is where it’s at.', 'I was in the area and decided to stop in and I’ve been back twice already! Food is tasty and delicious! Service was great as well! Def one of my new favorite Chinese restaurants!', 'I love this place. The food is always fresh and the kitchen is clean. I come here after work and the lady in the front is always so welcoming.', "After work, I've wanted to find a good spot for some chinese food. I've come here to order some chicken broccoli with egg fried rice, and it tasted very good. The restaurant looked clean and elegant and the staff was also very nice and friendly. The cashier was also nice to recommend to me their chicken wings and iced tea, which also tasted really good. The food was amazing, and I would recommend this spot for some good Chinese food.", 'Honestly the best takeout in the area. Best food and staff around, the renovation work and the owner are really good too. I love coming to this place. The food is made super quick and it is always fresh']

name: TONY'S PIZZA
reviews:
['Excellent vegan pizza! You can create individual slices with whatever toppings they have (vegan chicken, sausage, pepperoni, cheese + regular pizza toppings). They are made to order. Crust was doughy and crunchy but not too thick. I got one veggie and one sausage. The slices are huge and around $6 each. My partner enjoyed his non-vegan pizza as well. They have vegan desserts but they didn’t look great. The people working there were so helpful and nice explaining how the vegan options work. Bathroom was clean. Definitely recommend.', 'Had takeaway Pizza and dessert, took one bite of their carrot cake dessert only to see the sides of the cake covered in Mold!!
.Not sure how long it’s been kept then. Had to throw out. I’m shocked, definitely avoid the desserts.', 'We wanted to try pizza in New York and we found Tony’s. The crust was thick and crunchy like focaccia in Italy.  The topping was tasty.

The portion was enormous.  Two people’s pizza plus two pops were $39.  I couldn’t finish.

I would recommend the pizzeria! The owner and staffs were friendly and helpful.
Clean restroom. Super near to a metro stop.', 'My friends and I always get this pizza for board game nights and it never disappoints. It’s always delicious. We get the buff chick and plain pizza. It’s excellent 11/10.', 'Some of the best pizza in the city. Crust is perfect, bready but crunchy. Cheese was very good and fresh. Ingredients seemed to be solid.

Inside the restaurant is pretty standard, decently clean too late at night. Looks like they also serve gelato and pasta, along with drinks. Not the best prices around but for the quality of pizza it’s good value.
Great spot for pizza in Bushwick, definitely recommend']

name: SHUN FENG
reviews: ["I personally truly think they're the best local Chinese food. I have been going to them for more than 20 years they've always had great service and the pricing has always been Fair. Sadly they do not provide a dine-in option anymore.", 'Always good gotta try the general tos shrimp it literally is bomb every single time I get it', 'Only thing that matters to me is getting some fresh food!', 'Preferred Chinese restaurant in the immediate area.  Food is good.', "Best Chinese food I've tried in NYC. Been coming here for almost 15 years and till this day they do not disappoint the food is cheap and delicious, the service is great , but I only give a 4 star just because it could use a face lift and maybe start to deliver for those people that aren't close but nonetheless, this food and service will always hit the spot."]

name: GINO'S
reviews:
['Don’t be deceived by the size and lack of ambiance of this pizzeria ! The food’s very good which is what really matters. Large fresh clams not canned, came with olive focaccia. Only thing missing in my take out order was the grated cheese,under $20.Cash only', 'The food is absolutely delicious.
From the Shrimp Parmesan to their Chicken Florentine,  Fried calamari and I love their Baked Clams.
The waitress in the restaurant is a doll. I do all three, take out, dine in and have deliveries.', "I want to say the food from here is great because most of the time it is. But I recently ordered pizza from here and I've never been so sick in my life after eating something. I have no idea what happened but something is definitely wrong with the pizza I ordered because I don't get sick eating anything else.", 'Pizza is good its filling but the sauce the crust could use some work. Very convenient  location tho right next to the train perfect for when your on a rush', 'I placed an order today for four slices of plain pizza, an orange soda can, and linguine alle vongole with white clam sauce. However, I was charged a price that differed from the amount listed on your printed menu. Upon calling your establishment, I informed the staff member who took my order that my soda can was missing, to which he indicated that he would contact the delivery person. After not receiving a callback, I contacted your establishment again. The same staff member mentioned that he would issue a refund of $1.25. However, I pointed out that the price of the soda can is $2.00 as per the printed menu.

The call concluded with me feeling deeply dissatisfied and requesting the contact information of the owner. The staff member informed me that the owner is in Florida and that he does not possess any contact details, which I believe to be untrue. I am deeply disappointed by the perceived lack of honesty and quality of service. Therefore, I intend to dispute the charges with my bank and cease patronizing your establishment.']

name: MR SUSHI JAPANESE RESTAURANT (RIDGEWOOD)
reviews:
['Food was delicious, the fried rice was done really good and not greasy. The appetizer was delicious and crispy. The sushi and sashimi was some of the best I’ve had in the area. I also liked their Sake their strawberry and pineapple was good. Will definitely come here again thank you.', 'we just had a second visit to the restaurant, the food is amazing, everything taste so fresh and delicious, the service was excellent, the only thing that disappointed us was the fried calamari, we were expecting a different texture (crunchy) other than chewy, but the sauce played a big role to save the dish! we definitely recommend this restaurant for those who love sushi 🍱❣️', "I've been coming to Mr. Sushi for sometime now and it is never a miss. Their dishes are always fresh, creative and most of all delicious! I would compare it with top tier Sushi restaurants I go to in the city. I am grateful to have them so close by but even if it weren't I would make the trek! If in Ridgewood definitely is a spot to have on your list to try!", 'I ordered take out from here before, but the dine-in was on another level!
The food was beautifully served, they even served a complimentary amuse-geule, which is rather common in fine-dining european restaurants.
It was not overcrowded and the waitress was very friendly.
I can recommend the Vegetable Sushi Combo.
Thank you for this amazing meal. 🙏🏻', 'Don’t get the dragon roll 😭 Overpriced and it’s majority cucumber and avocado- the eel is much smaller in person and the caviar is not real sturgeon caviar. It’s regular roe. Don’t make the mistake I made- this is just a cucumber roll with avocado.']

name: CHANG XING
reviews: ['Not Good Hood Chinese Food. Not even the chicken wings were hitting straight Trash', 'I ordered fried fish & shrimp fried rice. My fried rice had three shrimps in it, & that was it!! No onions,  no bean sprouts,  no scallons, NOTHING! Just rice & three shrimp. I WILL NEVER BUY ANYTHING FROM THIS PLACE AGAIN.  THEY WILL ONLY DO THIS IN OUR NEIGHBORHOOD! THIS IS DISRESPECTFUL & DISGUSTING!!!!!', 'The chinese cuisine in this restaurant is out of this world. I would highly recommend it.😂', 'Good neighborhood Chinese place food is good and the lady is nice at the window. Only downside is they stopped doing delivery but I understand why.', 'Very polite and very quick on the order aswell food was good and prices are reasonable']

name: NEW HAPPY GARDEN
reviews: ['The food here is the best around this neighborhood. Myself and my brother tried many different dishes an 8 out of 10 was good. Whenever you order food they come quickly. Customer service is good.... its a young boy that works behind the counter.... this kid is hilarious... he alone makes it a pleasure to come into the restaurant itself.', 'The worst Chinese food I’ve tasted so far , and very overpriced as well , I’m pretty sad since it’s the main Chinese spot around me . I got the chicken wings and fried thinking it will be decent , but it was just horrible .', "They don't pay attention to your order. I paid $40 for a see food . Boil and I didn't get no shrimp. Not only that, I was there and a lady walked in and they messed up her order and she did it out take and still had to come in.smh", 'First time ordering here. Ordered just 4 chicken wings fried hard. The wings were tiny as hell for the price of $6.50!Never again! It has no flavor and i definitely ask for salt and pepper, none put on.The\nbbq sauce and hot sauce had no taste what so ever! Plus the sauce stains! Beware', '- They became very greedy & Food ain’t what it use to be']

name: BLOSSOM CARIBBEAN RESTAURANT
reviews: ["I always come here in the morning to get some fried bakes. They are so good that I decided to try dinner here one day, but I was very disappointed. The chicken was dry, and the rice and peas were overcooked. I do not recommend coming here late; it's best to visit in the morning.", 'This is truly an amazing establishment. The food is delicious and flavorful. My favorite dish is oxtail Mac & cheese. The frozen rum punch is one of a kind, especially on a hot day that is my go to drink.', 'Nice place. My kids enjoy their plaintain chips', 'Excellent food, great take out. Got delicous jerk chicken, pumpkin and greens. Yummy.', 'Im here about every other day. Food is delicious']

name: SAN REMO PIZZERIA RESTAURANT
reviews: ['This spot offers a great outdoor view. Enjoying a thin slice of NY cheese pizza while watching the pedestrian and vehicle traffic on Cypress and Atlantic Avenues is one of the top experiences in the Ridgewood area.\nMy fav large cheese pizza pie was around $20 for in store order', 'Tried it today for the first time and it was so good!!!! Between my family and I we tried 4 different slices and they were all delicious! The bacon one was definitely my fave followed by the Sicilian, but over all, they’re all great! I highly recommend this place!\nAlso, staff is very friendly :)', 'Without a doubt one of the best vegan slices I’ve ever had and I used to work at an all vegan pizzeria. The crust was crunchy but not tough, the cheese was cooked to the right consistency. Amazing. The vegan sausage roll was good to but the slice stole the show. I didn’t get his name but the guy working was so kind. I’ll definitely be going back asap.', 'We usually order in and get the fettuccine Alfredo (which is so goood btw) but today we felt like dropping by and getting pizza. I had the vodka slice and it was so tasty and so much flavor. Def one of my fave pizza joints in the neighborhood.', 'The atmosphere here  is Great! Along with the dozens of great vegan options available their vegan meatball sub is PHENOMENAL and so is their vegan pepperoni pizza just to name a few even my non-vegan friends love it and say they can’t tell the difference this is definitely the place if you’re looking for a great tasting healthy pizza']

name: WONDERFUL ASIAN RESTAURANT
reviews: ["The best fast Chinese food in the country for the price! The food always tastes fresh. The oil for fried foods like french fries and chicken wings always tastes fresh not days old. It's a little hole in the wall restaurant but great food. Prices good too!", "Genuinely banger Chinese food. Just ordered here for the first time cause my usual closes early and super confused by the reviews. Order arrived 20mins after I placed it close to midnight, delicious lo mein, chicken & broccoli, and great mapo tofu, which can be hard to find outside the sit-down places. Plus, open til 2am? No brainer. My new spot for sure. No pics cause there's not a crumb left. Good looks 🤙🏼", 'So grateful this place closes late. Food is very tasty. Accepts cash even for online orders which is great. Which at times makes up 4 their slightly higher pricing.... speedy delivery also.', "A fews weeks ago i ordered for the first time over the phone and received a call back minutes later saying that their machine was down and i needed to pay cash in which i told them i don't have cash. i just tried to order again and was told that they could not take my card because i canceled in the past and it was noted on my address profile when it was the restaurant who canceled in the past due to their faulty pos system. in addition they tried to tell me they where closed prior to this when i called at 1:45am and menu i have says they close at 2:30am. when i tried to get an answer to if the hours changed no one could answer so they took the order just to call back and tell me my address is flagged for canceled order. due to this discrimination i will not be ordering ever again", "Waited 1 hr and 40 min for an order I didn't receive.I called 3 times within that time frame and was told they were on their way,finally they said their credit  card machine was not in service and they can only accept cash.."]

name: O'HARA'S RESTAURANT AND PUB
reviews:
['One of the best bars to visit if you or your loved one is in law enforcement. Bring a badge from your town and staple it up or just admire how many have came before you.

The guy at the door was great and helped us find a large space in the back.

They also have great reasonably priced tshirts.  Must stop if you like cop bars and are near the trade center.

Service was quick!', 'Great Irish pub.

Was full when we got there but we were seated quick enough.

We got wings, salad and toasties with fries.  Everything was great, the service was very nice and efficient etc.

The cheese on the ham cheese toasty would never be served in an Irish pub, but it brought me back to my childhood, so was authentic in its own way, haha. I didn’t dare try a Guinness, but the other beer was good.', 'This establishment was amazing to experience! The memorial to all of our brave men and women around the country! If you have a chance, please take the time to look through the Bible. It was super emotional, but very worth the look! Service was fantastic, despite being packed full of patrons, both local and not! 10/10 guys!', 'Ohara’s is a cozy and uncomplicated place, a classic Irish pub with a welcoming atmosphere. What makes it unique are the patches from various emergency services, which add a special touch and fit perfectly with the history of the area around the World Trade Center. The service was excellent, and the food overall was very good. Unfortunately, my steak was overcooked instead of medium, which was a bit disappointing. However, I have to compliment the staff for how they handled the situation. The rest of the dishes were fantastic, and I would definitely recommend this spot.', 'Lovely place. You feel so welcome and it’s like beeing your own livingroom. Best pubs I’ve ever been. All 9/11 memorial stuff are just so great and heartbreaking ❤️‍🔥']

name: CHI RESTAURANT & BAR
reviews:
["If you love spicy food, look no further. This was an authentic Sichuan food experience, the food had a lot of dimensions and flavours. 100% delicious. I highly recommend ordering and trying everything! We finished our plates clean!!!! Great Ambiance, great music and perfect food! 😃 this is Luisa's approved!", 'A modern Sichuan spot that stays busy even on a weeknight, so definitely best to reserve ahead. The menu delivers hits and occasional misses: the Boneless Pork Trotter and Birds of a Feather 毛血旺 were spicy yet well-balanced in flavor, though the string beans lacked seasoning, and the appetizer Trio was underwhelming. Overall, it was still a satisfying meal with attentive service throughout.', "Really, really tasty Sczechuan food in a cute little spot. Amazing tea cocktails, good dim sum, and delicious food.

The spice wasn't quite that hot but their chili oil was delicious.

Only miss was that we ordered a pot of tea and it never arrived. At least they took it off the bill with an apology.

Would gladly go back!", "I recently had an amazing experience at Chi Restaurant that I can't stop raving about! From the moment we walked in, the warm welcome from the host set a positive tone for the evening. The staff, including our waiters, were incredibly attentive and made sure we had everything we needed throughout our meal.

The food was absolutely delightful! Each dish was expertly prepared and bursting with flavor, making it a real treat for the taste buds. I truly enjoyed every bite and couldn't help but savor the wonderful combinations of ingredients.", 'the space is very modern and sleek. the waiters were quite attentive as well. and of course the food was good.

the chongqing spicy chicken was decently spicy and had a nice crunch. sometimes there were small bones in the pieces though which was odd. the pork soup dumplings were good. the truffle fried rice yang chow style was flavorful and had lots of meats. the mashed eggplant was a little salty but tender.']

name: TRINITY PLACE
reviews:
["We dined at Trinity Place, and it was an exceptional experience from start to finish. The highlight was the Bank vault door that was truly UNIQUE place to dine. The ambience was perfect—elegantly designed with a warm, inviting atmosphere that made us feel immediately at ease. The food was nothing short of outstanding; each dish was beautifully presented and bursting with flavor, showcasing the chef's talent and attention to detail. Service was top-notch as well; the staff was attentive, knowledgeable, and genuinely friendly, enhancing the overall dining experience. I highly recommend Trinity Place for anyone looking for a memorable meal in a fantastic setting.

The desserts were truly exceptional. Each treat was a masterpiece, both in flavor and presentation. These desserts were a perfect ending to an already fantastic meal, showcasing the chef’s creativity and skill.", "Came here spontaneously for dinner, the night before our flight home to UK.
Seated quickly, despite no reservation. Team were friendly.
Food was delicious, we especially liked the scallops & steak fillet.
Pleased to find a brulee on the dessert menu.
Atmosphere was lovely, busy initially but not overcrowded. Felt very cosy, interesting surroundings being in an old vault.
Lovely find, wish we'd found it sooner! Would absolutely recommend", 'Great FiDi location with excellent food, friendly staff and terrific atmosphere. Highly recommend this restaurant. It can be hard to find reasonably priced fine dining in Manhattan. Trinity Place achieves an elevated dining experience without breaking the bank (pun intended)!

We ordered the onion tart, filet medallions and Wagyu cheeseburger. Everything was delicious and prepared as ordered.', 'Came here for dinner on a Thursday night before flying back home the next morning. Nice restaurant and atmosphere. It was a bit busy but we were seated right away. However, we sat next to a larger party which made it a rather noisy experience. Good and drinks however were delicious!', "Atmosphere is totally worth it! You have to walk into an actual bank vault. Food was good and prices were fair. We were there for an after work thing and the service was excellent. I'd come back anytime."]

name: SEVILLA
reviews: ['Very attention, intimate dinning experience. Had chorizo appetizer to start and shrimp in garlic sauce for dinner. My wife had the sirloin which I kept stealing and dipping in my garlic shrimp sauce. Drinks were nice and strong. The waitstaff is very attentive. Highly recommended restaurant. Forgot to post dessert but got the cappuccino and vanilla custard for dessert.', 'Such a charming place, we were walking past and saw that the place was full. Immediately realized that the food must be nice!\nWe just wanted a drink & a snack as we were bar hopping, the croquetas were so good! Made of cod fish with some tartar sauce on the side. Yum!', 'Old world charm at this family owned restaurant. Owner greeted us upon arrival. We had the grilled calamari and octopus appetizers. Both very tender, esp the octopus. We ordered 3 more entrees.  All shared between the 4 of us. Our entrees are Paella Valenciana, Shrimp with parsley and olive oil, and Veal Sevilla.  Everything was fantastic and tasty. House salad was complimentary.', 'Amazing Spanish spot with incredible seafood dishes and the best paella in town! The sangria is a must-try. No reservations, but the line moves quickly—totally worth the wait!', 'Highly recommend the octopus, red sangria, and croquetas. The arroz con pollo and paella was very good as well, and each main entree is a good serving for two people. The ambience of the restaurant is very nice and traditional. Would definitely visit again.']

name: GROTTA AZZURRA
reviews:
["We stopped in quickly for drinks and they were very good! Quick service too!  Nice outdoor booths or indoor seating.

We didn't have food, so can't comment, but there was a group of 20 year-olds who seemed to like the food.", "Charus and I came here for lunch. We were going to go somewhere else but we been here before and decided that we liked the food that we could come again. We took advantage of their lunch special, they had a happy hour going but they didn't tell us about until we asked about it.

I ordered the chicken parmigiana and vodka pasta. The food was delicious and tasty. It came out piping out. I like the flavor of the breading of the chicken parm. I just wish the parm had breading on both sides. I like the flavor of the vodka sauce. The combo worked go together.

Charus got the fish oreganata. The sauce was delicious and taste. It tasted so good, I kept sticking pieces of bread to sneak some sauces. The fish was tasty but a bit mushy.

We got a few drinks and they were tasty. We ordered a white sangria and mezcaloma. We liked the mezcaloma the best. It was strong and had a good flavor. The sangria was a bit weak and too much.

And the best part, they gave fresh warm bread for free!!", 'I had the mussels with fra diavolo sauce (pictured). It was great. Mussels tasted mussel-y and the sauce was not too heavy, tomato based, tasty. Bread was nice to dip in the sauce and get a bit wet.

Also had the bruschetta (pictured). It was a little more vinegary tasting than I expected, but that made it more interesting and novel. It was good. Tasted a lot like balsamic vinegar, but definitely not too much, with some tomatoes, and a crunch from the bread.

It was easy to ask the server for dairy free options, which was nice.', 'I had family visiting the city and we stopped here for dinner - the food was absolutely delicious! We had the spaghetti carbonara, gnocchi pesto rosso, and lasagna classico - which my aunt noted did not have enough sauce and cheese compared to noodles but was still delicious (i took off 1 star for that because it did look a little bare once you got passed the top). I also order a very delicious drink that I believe was a margarita mixed with moscato (unsure exactly?) - the waiter recommended because I wanted something sweet and it did not disappoint!', 'From brunch to lunch and dinners I absolutely love coming to Grotta Azzurra! The staff is super friendly and the atmosphere makes you feel like you’re in Italy! I love their French toast, eggs Benedict and chicken parmigiana with pasta!']

name: IL CORTILE
reviews:
["A fine dining experience. The rear, enclosed atrium, appears to have been a small backyard in the past, which has been beautifully modified into its current form. In addition, the restaurant is actually larger than it's original footprint as it has what appears to be two, side by side retail spaces in the front and another third space which looks out the adjacent street. The rear atrium area ties all the spaces together wonderfully.

The combination of these spaces creates a dynamic eating experience, as one can select which area to dine in.

The pictured, little neck clams were not on the menu, however the manager was kind enough to accommodate us.

Unlike other restaurants within Little Italy, coffee here is refillable and I found some unique items in the menu, like a pie made from sausages, artichokes and mozzarella cheese (appetizer section).", 'This was a nice little Italian restaurant with a great floral garden area in the back inside. Outdoor dining also available. Food was delicious for everyone and the service was friendly. I had the Gambine Fantasia (stuffed shrimp) which had terrific flavour — would definitely recommend that dish', 'Delicious food, wonderful service, beautiful atrium, and really cool memorabilia! Also decorated so festively for Christmas. If you are ordering appetizers try the zucchini fries! We split the lobster ravioli and the penne vodka, both were fantastic.', "I had a great time at IL Cortile. The penne alla vodka was delicious and my boyfriend was very pleased with his dish as well (don't recall the name). Sangria was delicious! Service was fantastic and the restaurant itself was very cozy.

My one and only critique is that the butter was super cold when it was brought out with the bread. My big back couldn't wait for it to thaw so I ripped my bread. 😔", 'We had our wedding at Il Cortile in October 2024 and everything was PERFECT!  The ambiance is gorgeous. Almost 80 guests fit in the garden room which is illuminated with white lights and a glass ceiling. The food was delicious and perfectly cooked. Audio for the DJ and music was great. Service was professional. Signature cocktails and drinks were refreshing and special. Thank you Manny for all your guidance. Thank you to the pastry chef for an amazingly cake. Most of all, thank you, Mr Salvatore Esposito for taking the time to make every detail perfect. We could not have had a better wedding party. Our family and friends are still raving about the venue, food and service. You made our special day perfect in so many ways.']

name: CHELSEA SQUARE RESTAURANT
reviews:
['Super nice place!
I went on a Wednesday morning and a very nice man greeted us. We got pancakes and eggs w bread and hash browns etc.
We also got lattes which was good too.

My pancakes were so big that I couldn’t finish them unfortunately but the were so spongy and full but still light in a way.
Everything was quite reasonably priced!
Definitely a chill place to eat in the morning :)

They had SOOOO many options for lunch and dinner as well as for breakfast/brunch', "It was like a step back in time. Beautiful restaurant,  built for customer experience.  I wish restaurants all still had this vibe and authentic appearance! It's definitely worth your trip and money !", 'They add 3 eggs in your eggs benefits or omelette to make you feel better bc their breakfasts are around 22$-$23each. That is pretty high for diner price. The French toast was also 21$. The eggs and spinach have no flavor. I had to add my own seasonings the hollandaise seems and taste homemade by an amateur. No taste! The syrup they provide is the cheap high fructose corn syrup. It’s ok if you want to be full but the food overall is probably not fresh or healthy. Fries were pale, not fried all the way. Possibly just out of the freezer. They make you pay your bill at the cashier and they don’t let you choose your tip %. They will ask you out loud “how many % tip?” Quantity over quality kind of place.', 'Quite a spacious diner with lots of seating either at the counter, in the booths or in a sort of conservatory part with big windows that look onto 8th. All the usual diner food and drink on offer plus some specials. Service is good and friendly too.', 'Chelsea square is a really nice diner with a great and delicious breakfast. I had the fluffiest pancakes I’ve ever had. The place is welcoming, the staff is friendly and attentive, and the owner clearly takes pride in the place and appears to see everyone that comes in as his personal guest. Very recommend!']

name: BENARES
reviews: ["Went for my 25th birthday dinner and though it was a Friday night, they weren't too busy. The service was attentive, thoughtful, and honestly just a very pleasant time—not to mention the incredible food. Spicy, well-balanced, and probably some of the best Indian food I've had in the city. Definitely the best Chicken 65 I've ever had in my life. Also ordered a cocktail and the tropical flavors paired perfectly with the cuisine. Will be back, and I recommend you go, too.", 'Dined in on a Friday and had the lunch special - samosas, chicken Andhra curry (curry leaves and coconut milk base), garlic naan and a small rice pudding for dessert. I was stuffed! I loved the atmosphere, it was calm yet lively. Lots of Indian families eating lunch (always a good sign) and it’s a huge airy space compared to most other restaurants in NYC. I felt very comfortable dining solo. At 3pm they have drinks specials and would definitely come back for that! The staff were kind, courteous and so sweet!', 'My boyfriend and I spontaneously stopped in today around lunch time and we were so happy that we did! From the moment we stepped inside the service was A+. We had the pleasure of having Tere Naam serve us and we couldn’t say enough great things. The food was incredible and very fresh. The pricing was great as we got three meals but the price barely reflected such. We definitely will be coming back. 10/10 I recommend.', 'Decent Indian restaurant with some really good bar options to choose from. Went there on a weekday without reservation and was seated without any wait time. We ordered benaras kachori, chicken kali mirchi, paneer tikka masala, mint paratha, garlic naan and kathak biryani. Spice levels were decent. chicken kali mirchi tasted reallyy goodd! Would say paneer tikka masala was good. Both the breads were pretty decently prepared and tasted really nice. Kathal biryani was good but I personally felt it could have had more spices. Benaras kachori was really good and would definitely recommend it for apps! Atmosphere was quite decent and the service was okayish. Parking is not available in that area, it’s better to either walk there if you are nearby or take a cab.', 'This honestly has been my go to place this entire year. Everytime I go, everyone is so nice and the food is always amazing. The service is great, everyone cares about you and makes sure you have a great experience.  You should try their saag paneer and Paneer tikka. Also checkout their lunch special, it’s the most bang for your buck!']

name: TIO PEPE
reviews: ["This spot is low key terrific! The service was super attentive and the staff were genuinely kind and welcoming. They’ve got a solid cocktail list and the menu offers a nice variety to choose from. My date and I ordered a bunch of tapas to split —chorizo, shrimp, and octopus—and everything was tasty and well seasoned. Very satisfied with the portions sizes. It's a great place to grab a bite and drinks before heading out for a night in the area.", 'What a wonderful surprise! I love Spanish tapas and usually try this type of restaurant. I went there with my boyfriend and was extremely pleasantly surprised by how good the food was, how quick the service, how decent the prices and what cozy vibe with a full glass window view of a very quaint and vibrant street in the village. The decor was beautiful and so was the background music. The Sangria is better than at the most renowned tapas places in the city! Will be coming back here for sure!', 'The food, especially the paella, was honestly not amazing, but the sangria was very goo. Overall also a bit too expensive. I would only recommend to go to get small food and sangria with friends because the ambience is also nice.', 'We had the Paella and it was worth the 3-35 mins cooking time, it was simply the best I’ve had in years. There was a good variety and amount of seafood to please anyone appetite. The Chorizo was also very good, and it added really nice flavour to the rice. We will definitely go there again next time we are back in NYC. Cheers', 'We just happened to stop here to eat and what a pleasant surprise. The food was delicious... So good my girl ate her whole steak which she rarely does. I also finished my whole meal with no leftovers. I had the filet of sole which was perfectly cooked. The staff was very attentive. We sat in the outside seating because it was a nice night. I would definitely go again for dinner.']

name: 456 NEW SHANGHAI
reviews:
['If you’re looking for an unforgettable meal in Chinatown, 456 Shanghai on Mott Street is the place to go! We visited with our family of five, and it was hands down one of the best dining experiences we’ve had. The steamed soup dumplings—both the shrimp and pork and the pork—were the best we’ve ever had, easily the top dumplings on Mott Street. The fried soup dumplings were also great, but the steamed ones really stole the show.

The General Tso’s chicken was phenomenal—crispy, flavorful, and not overly sweet, the best we’ve ever tasted. We also tried the orange chicken and the Shanghai rice cakes, both of which were delicious. If you’re in Chinatown, don’t miss out on the best dumplings in town. The food, service, and atmosphere at 456 Shanghai make it a must-visit!', 'Traditional Chinese cuisine in Chinatown- lunch special was very good! We had the aubergine and the sesame chicken, served with rice and soup. Both were very tasty.
We also had the scallion pancake which went well with our dishes and the pork dumplings- unfortunately these were slightly undercooked.
Service is polite and food arrived quickly.
*You pay 3,5% extra for card payments.', 'I’ve been there twice.

Iam super excited for this restaurant.

Everything is so so perfect and delicious.

We ordered rice and noodles with chicken,beef and pork.

Also we ordered chicken with broccoli and chicken with soya.

The dumplings were so so tasty!!

You have to try it if you been there.', "This spot is great for a quick and cheap bite to eat. The soup dumplings were pretty good, and well portioned for sharing, alongside some of the other dumplings options we got like steamed pork dumplings and pork buns. I did think the spicy twice cooked pork wasn't all that great was expecting it moreso szchuan styled with leeks not mushrooms.

However, if you have allergies while it's a risk anywhere you go he exceptionally careful here. One of our parties has an allergy to sesame seeds (not oil) to which we explained to our waiter who said they would leave the seeds off the items. However, they served the items with sesame seeds and then reserved the same items but just tried to pick them off after mentioning it. So while that's an individual problem just bear it in mind.", 'a great spot! I ordered the General Tso Tofu and vegetable dumpling. Portions for both were very big, which is great for leftovers! Both dishes I had were very tasty; the tofu was perfectly crisp on the outside and soft on the inside, although the sauce was a touch too sweet. The servers here are really funny and sweet!']

name: 218 RESTAURANT
reviews:
['This is THE go-to Chinese restaurant in Chinatown! This is authentic Chinese food and is always so fresh and delicious. Menu is extensive, food is affordable and very generous portions.

I have brought all my friends and colleagues here for lunch and dinner and highly recommend to others.', 'Probably the best hot and sour soup I’ve ever had. The place is nothing special but it’s authentic and all foods we over there had, especially pot stickers was top. Will come back for sure.', "First time returning after the pandemic, we ordered the usual dishes.  All dishes ordered were still very good; the roast duck with thin crispy skin, very little fat is the best in Chinatown. The veggie and steamed fish were fresh and cooked just right.  The waiter was friendly.  We'll definitely return.", 'Stopped in on a Saturday for Lunch/Dinner, food was good and the staff accommodating.

Keep in mind they only take cash which isn’t terrible but I was kind of surprised when they added an extra seating charge on my final bill.

Overall a good place tho and enjoyed.', 'Whenever we come to Chinatown we always come here. Tom is the server working there and always moves in speed. Get the triple meat with rice and vegetables roast pig, duck and soy chicken. The roast pig  is one of the best in Chinatown.']

name: THE BEST SICHUAN
reviews: ['So my friends and I chose this place plainly off of their 4.6 rating on Google and we absolutely loved it. It was not busy, the service was fast and great. The waitresses were friendly and offered to give us hot tea that could help with my sore throat. The food was flavorful and tasted amazing. I’d definitely come back here again', 'The food was amazing. I got to eat something I hadn’t in 4 years and it brought back so many fond memories and tasted even better than I remembered. They also offered us warm tea when I mentioned I was feeling sick. I will definitely come back here my next time in NYC.\nService is top tier- fast and friendly. All round great food and service', 'Um wow. We got the pork dumpling in chili oil and Peking duck and it was incredible! So good after a cold night walking around the Christmas village in Bryant park. The service was actually impeccable as well. Attentive to water refills, tea refills, plate switching, more sauce etc.', 'I had a fantastic experience dining at this restaurant, which is open until 1 AM. The food was delicious and came in generous portions. Even though I’ve already eaten some in the picture, you can tell the dish is still hearty and satisfying. The service was exceptional—the staff were very friendly and efficient. I came here alone, and I felt well taken care of. Highly recommend it for anyone looking for a late-night spot with great food and service!', 'This Chinese restaurant is a fantastic find! The food is incredibly tasty, and the portions are impressively large, so come hungry. We ordered the duck and fish, and both dishes were delicious—full of flavor and cooked to perfection. The duck was tender with a crispy skin, and the fish was fresh and well-seasoned. The generous portions mean you definitely get your money’s worth. If you’re looking for a place with great food and substantial servings, this is a must-try. Highly recommended!']

name: ALTAIR RESTAURANT NYC
reviews:
['Visited Altair with three friends last night and had the best time.  Our server Troy was the best.  He was super informative about the menu and so personable too. The restaurant was gorgeous and so were each of the cocktails we had which were uniquely crafted to reflect either earth, air, fire or water which was so creative and thought out.  We started with a dinner roll which was a must and went on to try the eggplant, tomatoes and endive and melon salad which everyone loved. I got the Bass for dinner which was decadent and so flavorful and my boyfriend opted for the hangar steak which he loved.  Definitely a spot I want to come back to.  High recommend!', '10/10 LOVED our experience here! This is not just a restaurant for hotel guests - Altair should be on everyone’s radar. The service was impeccable yet not rushed. The environment is beautiful, lush, and comfortable. We could easily carry on a 5-person conversation without having to shout or repeat ourselves - which is becoming more rare these days. The cocktails were gorgeous and balanced.

We sampled several dishes and they were all complex and delicious. I think my favorite was the octopus though! By the way, the fish dish is deboned, making it easy to share.

A truly special meal! Highly recommend. Also we spent $90 per person including tip after truly going all out (cocktails, apps, mains, wine), which felt like a great value.', "Altair is a restaurant on the floor level of the Arlo hotel.
I was invited to this restaurant for a business event.

The good:
- Ambiance was gorgeous, very beautiful place.
- Staff was very attentive and nice.
- The food was a mixed bag, I ordered the scallops and I though it was very good.

The not so good:
- Others in our party ordered:
- Steak -> the feedback was that it was tough and dry.
- Bucatini pasta -> that person didn't say anything, but barely ate any of it, I could only presume she didn't like the dish.
- I ordered a cocktail that was infused with cotton candy and it was fairly decent, but I felt at $20 a pop, it was very small and was light on the tequila; I wasn't paying so didn't care, but if it was coming out of my pocket, I would have felt it was too pricy for the size of the drink, I have included a pic, and based on my memory, it was the size of maybe 3 shots ?
You can judge for yourself.

Overall, this is a upscale restaurant with upscale prices, but the portions and taste of the food was somewhere in the middle; it is a very attractive interior for sure.", 'We live in the neighborhood and thought we would try out Altair restaurant tucked away into the hotel. Our palates were buzzing from the robust flavors of our exquisite dinner here! Octopus a la plancha, Colorado lamb rack, heirloom tomatoes w stracciatella. Endive salad w strawberry vinegarette & candied almonds, Holland eggplant with sorrel mushrooms Green garlic honeycomb dinner roll . All uniquely delicious. The crafted cocktails served up in their very relaxed dining area added to our wonderful experience. Looking forward to returning soon!', 'Food & atmosphere were amazing. Our server Farouk was top notch. We will definitely be asking for his section upon our return!']

name: CHAZZ PALMINTERI ITALIAN RESTAURANT
reviews:
['We went on a Tuesday early evening so it wasn’t too crowded. My daughter had the pesto gnocchi which was amazing. That’s a pretty big compliment considering I don’t usually care for pesto (too oily) or gnocchi (too starchy). Definitely would recommend!
Service was good. The restaurant is attached to a hotel but don’t let that make you a doubter!', "They were slammed and still found time to get us in without reservations (group of 4). The server was phenomenal and cared about making our experience perfect. The food which is why you're reading this was excellent. They were willing to accommodate gluten free options on pasta as well! Highly recommend", 'I was excited to go to the restaurant belonging to a character in one of my favorite movies, but left disappointed. The food was very ordinary and bland. My seafood risotto was more like rice with seafood and the sauce on the gnocchi was tasteless. Since non of the staff were Italian I wonder who is cooking? This is not a place I would recommend for real Italian food. Perhaps if you are in Times Square and Olive Garden is busy this would be an upgraded experience.', 'A great find!  Tucked away in 46th street.  If you like Italian, you will luv this place.  Very cozy, intimate and relaxing setting (may need iPhone light to read the menu :) ).
Huge portion size with great taste, always a good combination.  Everything tasted fresh, warm and delicious.  Excellent service and great attention to detail! Dan was awesome….', 'Great food, friendly and attentive staff, and service!
We absolutely enjoyed our time here. Fish was done perfectly. Chicken was very tender and great. Delicious Italian food near Time Square']

name: RESTAURANT RELAX
reviews: ["A lovely casual restaurant with simple and clean deco. I appreciate Polish heritage/culture information is shared on their dining tables. Food will be brought to the guests after ordering from the counter. Although no draft beer or hard liquor served, the bottled Polish beers and homemade drink(fruit compote) were good options. The food was delicious and comforting. Also, while dining in I noticed there were many locals who had ordered food to be picked up. It's definitely a good sign. I would highly recommend this restaurant. I'm super eager to return and try other items on their menu. ;)", 'I wanted to try everything but we were only two people. I love trying new cuisines and will come back to try their soups! Simple delicious homemade food.', 'This place is amazing. As a Polish person, I give it my full approval :) Nothing better after a full day of sightseeing than some Polish food and a beer.\n(On the picture: roast pork in sauce, silesian potato dumplings, red cabbage & sweet sauerkraut salads)', 'An excellent place to eat. The vibe is homey and comfortable. It’s the type of place where you can get a coffee or a beer; dine with others or alone. Many good vegetarian dishes. Helpful and friendly staff. Can’t wait to come back and try more.', 'A friend recommended this restaurant when we were in town. Absolutely amazing! The food was delicious and the staff were super nice. It was a great place and we would definitely come back again.']

name: LITTLE POLAND
reviews: ['Absolutely fantastic and authentic polish restaurant. I will be dreaming of the polish platter (specifically the sweet potato pancakes) for the rest of my life! My sister got goulash and the meat was so soft and delicious. We never have had kompot before, and tried it. It tastes fruity, worth a try. For dessert we had the chocolate cake. It was good, but then we saw what the apple cake looked like and wish we had gotten that instead or in addition!', "Just wow. My meal at little Poland was one of the best I've ever had. The place felt very authentic like the food was being cooked by my own babcia. I got the combination platter and the portion was huge. I cant recommend this place enough!", "Huge size of dining! The traditional Poland dumplings made me a special experience. You would find there's old-time coin public telephone on the restaurant's wall.", 'Love the homey vibes! Soups were amazing and fried pierogis had much better texture than boiled, though both were relatively lacking in flavor. Will be back to try other dishes!', 'The staff were dismissive, bordering on rude. Food was disappointing! Who deep fries pierogi, certainly not in Poland. Staff spoke Polish among themselves so I can’t understand why they would serve up food that is so wrong. They weren’t busy with customers (only three others besides us) so it’s not like they were run off their feet and couldn’t at least acknowledge their customer and offer a smile. The pierogi fillings were bland. Very dissatisfying experience.']

name: EVA'S X CINCO DE MAYO
reviews: ['This place has been around since the 70’s, with healthy eating as their philosophy. It still looks like the 70’s and feels like the 70’s - and it kinda smells like the 70’s too.
