The longevity of this place says a lot. They don’t need a fancy interior - it’s actually quite basic, but the food and service is excellent. I come here mostly for the Mexican food, but they have a lot of options besides that - there’s some good breakfast options, burgers, sandwiches, and wraps. My favorite here is the “Steve’s Taco Special”. (I don’t know who Steve is, but he does have great taste.)', 'Always come here for lunch and never disappoint me. Good price, a lot of food and very tasty, can’t ask for more. My fav is the Birria Tacos, you have to try it, 100% recommended', "I'm not one to review places, but I had such a good experience I wanted to share my appreciation. They gave me 2 free al pastor tacos! Not only were they free, they were absolutely delicious! I was a little skeptical since they were just giving them away, but they were every bit as flavorful as I expect from a real good Mexican spot. And there was free horchata to boot! No idea why they were offering so much for free, but I'm certainly not complaining, especially around the NYU area. The only thing I paid for was my (very tasty) chips and guac, making my whole lunch a whopping $5.  Definitely will return! Even if I have to pay next time 😂", 'A hidden gem of a delicious AND healthy food option. Affordable, quality eats with plenty of relaxed, no frills cafeteria seating.', 'Had the Bronx quesadilla burger and birria tacos. Both were pretty good but could have used just a little bit more spice/flavor.']

name: HAAB
reviews:
['Really happy to see this spot doing a great selection of vegan options, however, the time I went I wasn’t impressed by what I had. Portion size of the nachos were really small, and the tacos I had tasted a little stale. The lime that came with my tacos was also clearly defrosted, because when I squeezed it no juice came out. Not as fresh as Mexican food should be.

Was an okay meal but was expecting more. Maybe a one-off as others seem to love it. Great service on the other hand!', "A casual hidden gem for an authentic Mexican food experience! Came in for lunch and was so pleased. The portions are generous and the service is super friendly.

We had the Carnitas Burrito and three different tacos (baja fish, grilled steak, al pastor) which were amazing. They stood out so much from the tacos that I've had at other places. The burrito also was one of the juiciest burritos i've ever tasted! Thank you for such high quality food.", 'Delicious and fresh. Had the gazpacho soup (huge bowl) and the mole tacos. So filling. Loved the Jamaica Aqua Fresco, not sweet and so refreshing. Service was quick and easy. Appreciated the umbrella seating outside. Second time here, will def be back!', "DON'T EAT HERE! one of the worst experiences I've ever had. I found a very sharp piece of metal in my food when I ordered take out last week. While I was eating my enchiladas, I bit down on something hard and it turned out to be a VERY sharp,  jagged piece of metal.

I called to tell the staff what happened and walked back to the restaurant with the uneaten dish and the found metal. I asked for the dish to be refunded. The staff was very polite and said it would be refunded through the online ordering platform. Now it has been almost a week and after several emails back and forth with the restaurant and the ordering platform, I still don't have a credit to my account.

This type of thing shouldn't happen but I understand that sometimes it still does. The issue isn't so much the metal in my food as it is the struggle to receive a refund for the dish in question. The food is mediocre and expensive besides. I can only hope they try to improve.", 'I ordered food from here today and it was SOOOOO GOOD! I ordered the chicken fajita and the steak quesadilla and everything was so good😋. The food was made quickly and the staff were great. I would 100% order from there again. I’ve also came here previously and I would recommend trying the plantain nachos, they are so good!!!']

name: EAST SEASON RESTAURANT
reviews:
['My husband and I are from Toronto and were quite impressed on how genuine their dishes were.
We ordered the hot pepper fried pork intestine (most impressive), 1/2 free run chicken and black pepper steak filet.  The black pepper steak fell short a bit, but not terrible.
Service was actually quite good to my surprise… very tentative. Seating is not five star, but because of the value and quality of food, I give them a 20% gratuity and an overall 5-star rating.', 'We had a wonderful dining experience at this authentic Chinese restaurant on Canal Street. From the moment we arrived, we were welcomed with warm and delicious tea. Our group shared General Tso’s Chicken, Singapore Mei Fun noodles, and the Chicken Pot. Each dish was delightful and bursting with flavor. The meal ended with the most delicious watermelon. Everything was superbly delightful. Highly recommend!', "I honestly didn't like the food.  The steamed bok choy was off.  The vegetable looked old and limp. The garlic sauce was good though.  I ordered roast pork thinking I would get the one hanging from the window.  I didn't.  I got the wet roast pork.  I had wanted the dry one.", 'Staff were friendly and service was fast. Food was ready 10 minutes after ordering.
The crispy pork over rice was good for $9 lunch special.  Not much flavor in the pork. The seafood noodle was bland with no flavor. The chicken lo mein was good and was a large portion.  The 1/4 roast duck was crispy but tasted too salty and very oily. I had to get a bowl of chilly oil to add spice to the food.', 'The food tastes great, so two stars are for food. But they automatically add an 18% tip to the bill without informing or asking.  Even the waiter just brought the food to the table without any service.']

name: SENG SEAFOOD RESTAURANT
reviews:
["first dim sum meal in a very long time at seng seafood today. we'd been once or twice before and had really liked it (probably a 4 or 5 star review if i rated my other visits in prior years). their prices used to be the same for all dish sizes, and presumably is still the same. our bill came out to $55 before tip for 10 items (which fed 3 adults and 1 child and are definitely not all pictured here ... was too hungry). the bill did include two shrimp cheung fun (rice rolls) which are usually pretty pricey at your typical dim sum establishment.

all dishes were delicious, but we were quite disappointed by how limited the selections were today (there seemed to be way more in our previous visits as well as what is listed on their website). not sure if it might have been because we were visiting a little later in the day by dim sum standards (~1:00 pm). there was also virtually no service provided (e.g., water was never refilled) but the cart ladies were really nice in trying to help find the dishes that we wanted.

we had made a reservation over the phone, but it didn't seem like they understood once we arrived. thankfully, we didn't need to wait long as we were put at an eight-person table with another party of four. considering the clientele visiting, you know that the dim sum is authentic. certainly can't go wrong here with your basic dim sum selections, though may opt to go earlier next time to see if there are more options or visit another place for more variety.", 'I came here with my uncle 70th Birthday. He chose the restaurant. I was a bit skeptical if the food is going to be any good. It’s not the top, and not the worst. I enjoyed the food. My kids ate and ate. As long as my kids like the food, I am happy m. :) my favorites are the pig intestines with fired milk. Highly recommend this restaurant in the out of the way place in Chinatown.', "This place was packed but we got seated relatively quickly in the late morning with a reservation for our party of 8. I loved everything we tried - shrimp dumplings, fried dough, fried shrimp, the list goes on. The service was fast and I will say it really really helped having someone in our party who spoke Cantonese but we did get by with a lot of pointing and earnest nodding. Honestly there are so many options I'm just gonna have to come back here again.", 'Super affordable dimsum spot! Expect a small wait for the weekend brunch hours. This place fills up and we took that as a good sign. The food was great and the service was not bad!', "This place is okay for dim sum. I found the restaurant more visually appealing than the food. The restaurant looks old and worn out from the outside and staircase. However, inside was spacious, pretty, and modern looking. I was there around 12:30pm, which is towards the tail end of dim sum brunch. I didn't see much variety both in hot food and sweet pastries. I also didn’t  see any vegetarian dishes! It could have been the time I was there. Next time I will go there earlier to be sure there is more variety. Waiters run around a lot, so you need to grab their attention for anything you need, like water and extra food off the menu. The waitors and managers are somewhat brusque as to be expected in Chinatown."]

name: PANNA II GARDEN INDIAN RESTAURANT
reviews:
["This place offers a unique experience in New York's vibrant East Village. The space is small but charming, decorated with colorful lights that create a festive atmosphere. The food is delicious and the prices are affordable. They allow you to bring your own alcohol, we brought beers and the staff kindly opened them for us. Overall, it's a delightful spot to enjoy a fun night with great food and friends.", 'A great place for a surreal experience. The lights, permanent birthday and valentines signs, wrapping paper covered ceiling, just gotta roll with it and enjoy. The food, well that’s not the star but it’s ok. It’s good enough if you go in with lowered expectations. Food is fairly oily and bland and many of the dishes taste similar, nothing bad, just not distinctive.

Service was fine and as long as no one is waiting for a table, they were laid back and let you linger as needed. It’s BYOB, make sure to bring some cold brews to make it a fun night!', "This was definitely a unique dining experience and in its own way it was memorable.

I have never been in such a tiny restaurant with so little space to maneuver. The wait staff literally pulls tables away from the wall for you to slide onto the wall side bench and then pushes it back towards you - every inch matters here. This restaurant is a bit of a machine - the waitstaff is very present and urging you onwards through your meal, they turn over tables quickly. I can see why the place was humming - people come because it's the most affordable Indian food around.

But the food itself is not memorable at all. The decor is one of a kind but all I could think of was how difficult it must be to properly clean all those strings of lights (to the point where I highly doubt they do get cleaned).  If you want affordable Indian food in a restaurant setting in lower Manhattan this fits that bill.

Would not recommend if you are a person of size (either height or width really) nor a wheel chair user nor if you have significant mobility issues.", 'We had the butter chicken, chicken biryani, Chicken Tiki Misala, Chicken simosas and Naan Bread and it was AMAZING!! Huge daredevil fan so I came for the atmosphere but this had me so fulfilled I didn’t want to stop eating. Naan bread tastes sooo good, and the mango lassis are less than $3 and are really good. Definitely a place to go with friends and eat off each others plates. p.s I went on a Monday at around 6 pm and it was pretty empty so staff was very attentive', "I do not recommend this restaurant to anyone: very bad service, outrageous food quality, dirty and dilapidated place, rude and unprofessional waiters.
I communicated my allergy and the waiter pretended to understand but he gave a damn about notify it to the kitchen.
To my repeating the allergy issue to him he always nodded his head and kept bringing me the same food without telling me whether I could eat it or not. It didn't end there, the same waiter threw two plates full of food on me on my new jacket ruining it completely, to my request to give me something to clean it and save the jacket he again said yes without ever bringing something to clean it and telling me several times that I had to wait not giving a damn about the massive damage he did.
They ruined our evening , we got up from the table and left, I strongly advise against this place, if you want to eat badly, risk feeling sick or receive damage to yourself or your belongings this is the place to be"]

name: BO KY
reviews:
['Had a late lunch here on a weekday. The restaurant is no frills but clean. They offer some tasty Viet/Chinese food. I like that each table has sealed disposable wooden chopsticks (the better ones), plastic soup spoons, and small sauce dishes. Water was served in a small disposable plastic cup. Lol. The menu was pretty extensive. This is not a vegetarian friendly restaurant! We got 2 very different noodle soups. The curry chicken had chewy egg noodles. The delicious broth was spicy and reminds us of Malyasian roti canai. The fresh shrimp noodles had silky wide rice noodles. The broth is mild and flavorful. The only complaint is the lack of green vegetables in the soups like traditional Chinese places provide. The spring rolls came out crispy and hot with a generous portion size. The food came out quickly. Prices are reasonable and is a good place to catch a quick meal. The restaurant is cash only.', 'Heard lots of good things from my friends about Bo Ky. Finally tried it last weekend. My friend and I got 1/4 duck (comes in pretty big serving and is my favorite!), beef noodle soup, mixed pork intestines and Chinese broccoli. Everything tastes great and the serving size is really big for such an affordable price. 100% recommend! (They take cash only)', 'The best Hu Tieu Bo Kho (Flat rice noodle soup with beef belly) I have ever eaten. The beef was perfectly cooked and soft. I would have liked to try the offal meat as well but I really had to pace myself for my travel tour since the noodle soup was very filling. I didn’t have issues with service nor staff', 'WARNING - spoiled meat

I have never had such a bad experience at a restaurant. This is my first negative review. I frequently go to Chinatown and have my go-tos but decided to try a new place. My friend and I shared three dishes, one of them being lemongrass beef.

The beef had an odd aftertaste and smelled a little sour. My friend (whose family
owns a restaurant) confirmed the smell and said the meat was spoiled. We were quite in shock and let a staff member know. He said it was likely the lemongrass taste. I replied saying that I’m familiar with lemongrass and that the smell was the more off putting part. I asked if he wanted to smell the beef to confirm it. He dismissed me with a wave of a hand and said they would take it off the bill.

My friend and I were flabbergasted because there was no apology or no even reassurance that they would look into it. We went up to the register to pay and the women who took our money pushed us for tip. I replied that they gave us spoiled meat. She said “yeah I know. Don’t come back”. As if I would after that experience.', 'The Teo Chew dry noodles are incredible—tastes just like home and very comforting. While the service isn’t the warmest, the quality of the food easily earns a five-star rating.']

name: HYO DONG GAK
reviews:
['We walked in looking for a fresh meal for lunch with quiet seating. We were seated immediately, the restaurant did fill up while we were eating. This was a perfect spot for some great food. Quality was exceptional, I highly recommend.', "I visited from Midwest just for a trip. This restaurant was the first korean restaurant I tried in NYC and it's been already my favorite!! I got jjajangmyeon combo & japchaebap(it is served with jjambbong broth). Me and my sister really enjoyed!", "TLDR: If you are craving for Korean-Chinese in the city, it'll get the job done. Go for lunch time and take advantage of the combo that gives a small sweet and sour beef with the spicy seafood or jajangmyun noodles.

I had walked by this place so many times so I figured let's give it a try. Price was decent, the interior is a bit dated but let's focus on the food.

Fried dumplings. Standard, crispy (almost too crispy maybe) lots of filling but what you'd expect. Crunchy, greasy, fatty meat, lots of garlic chives.

I opted for the jjampong and small sweet and sour beef combo. The beef is already dressed which I don't love the sweet sauce in general but it was still decently crispy. Spicy seafood noodles were decent, good wok flavor.

For $21.95, this kind of combo in this area; it's not bad.", 'Best Korean Chinese restaurant in ny in my opinion. Their jjajangmyun and jjambbong are amazing and also most of other dishes as well. You can’t go wrong with any dishes here', 'If y’all haven’t had Korean Chinese food, what are you waiting for?! I went to Hyo Dong Gak, which is right outside of ktown NYC and ordered their $19 split bowl, which came with a big portion of jjangmyeon and a big portion of seafood jampong.

The noodles were perfectly chewy without being too soft. The jjangmyeon had the right amount of sauce and came with tiny pieces of pork.

The jampong had a TON of seafood including big shrimp with the head on, baby shrimp, mussels and octopus. For $19 you really can’t go wrong, that’s almost unheard of in NYC!

The restaurant was crowded on a random Tuesday evening, but I didn’t have to wait long to get seated and I never felt rushed. The staff was extremely friendly and even gave us small packaged candies to take home with us! I will definitely be back!

Follow me on instagram for more! @angies_foodie_adventures']

name: MAMA PHO (OPERATING WITHIN BEDFORD GARDENS RESTAURANT)
reviews: ['Delicious and cozy.  Staff is friendly, menu is very diverse. I strongly recommend for lunch, dinner or a little moment to yourself to quiet the noise. The Pho here is on my top 3 fav in Brooklyn.', 'Great experience and food. The atmosphere is perfect for a date night and the pho + sushi is delicious. Had a great time here and good quality for the price!', "My favorite soup is Pho, and it's always been difficult for me to find a really good one. But now I've found my favorite place in Brooklyn to eat good Pho, and that's Mama Pho restaurant. Also there seems to be a different owner now, the restaurant  maintains its higher standards, now is MUCH  BETTER than before! The place looks very nice and clean, a lot of plants which gives cozy vibe! and the service is exceptional. I had a wonderful dining experience, and I will definitely be coming back.", 'Delicious rib eye pho! Big bowl with very tender beef, the broth was very tasty too. The servers were so kind to me, and the restaurant atmosphere is great for friends, family or just for yourself seating in the bar and talking to the bartenders while eating. Overall I had a good experience! The prices are reasonable. I will def be back 💯\U0001faf6🏽', 'It was nice in the cold morning to have a big bowl of soup. I came to This location before and this time I brought my uncle there. He liked it and I was so happy about that. We had mama pho and it was delicious as usual.']

name: RICE & BEANS
reviews:
["After seeing this many times from my co workers, I finally got to Rice and Beans.

My co worker got it for me as takeout (so I can't rate the inside/service), so this is just strictly based on the food.

The container was packed and very neatly packaged. The chicken is just as flavorful as it looks, however the rice and the beans didn't match. It lacked the authenticity that I was looking for, but the chicken carried the meal!

I will be getting chicken from here again yes, if it's sold alone.", "1. This is park slope. How do u hire someone who speak barely any English. 2. I haven't been here in months, but decided to come here today and they cut their portion size by half. 3. Girl who served me had her hair down. This place is a hit or a miss.", 'Food was ok, good pork & rice 🤗', 'Decided to try this Dominican spot. Rice and beans weren’t as authentic as we expected but the meats were delicious. Small but filling. Small dine in area but good for a quick to-gos.', 'I had to give 1 star cause I wanted to post a comment the food in there is disgusting it’s a Dominican restaurant with a Mexican chef no Caribbean taste to it whatsoever. The meat is overcooked no flavor at all. I regret spending my little $20 there what a waste of time and money']

name: ILILI RESTAURANT
reviews:
['This is one of the BEST Lebanese restaurants in NYC. The food is so delicious and authentic. Every bite is full of flavor and rich and satisfying! Customer service is excellent. The atmosphere is very elegant and nice. I wish I could give more than 5 starts! So good!

Aldo, they great selection of Lebanese wines that are really good.', "Delicious Lebanese food in the heart of New York. The restaurant is beautiful and elegant. The food is excellent.
The only issue, it took them some time to bring us the menu and waiters were coming and going and not paying attention that we didn't have the menus yet. Once we ordered, they served everything pretty fast. It is also very noisy in there. But in general it was a good experience.", 'Had a great experience. The Fattoush salad was fresh and flavorful, and the lamb chops were tender and perfectly cooked. The service was excellent—friendly and attentive.', 'We dined at Ilili, and can say that the food and atmosphere definitely lived up to the hype.  Unfortunately the service was less impressive.  We made reservations, and arrived on time, but were made to wait in the lounge for about 10 minutes, despite the restaurant being nearly empty, as the dinner service was just starting.  This was not an issue, in isolation.  We were then seated, and there were a handful of other diners in our section, including atleast two we could see seated just after us.  We were immediately given water, and a drink menu, but no food menu.  We noticed another server quickly attend to the other tables nearby, offering recommendations, drink orders, etc.  we waited another 10 minutes (20 minutes after our reservation started), and finally one of the runners inquired if we had been helped.  We told him the situation, and he apologized and asked the nearby server if he could attend to us.  At this point, we had looked at the menu on our phone and knew what we wanted, so we placed our order.  The food arrived quickly, and was very good.  Our water was quickly refilled throughout our dining by the attendant, but at no point were we ever approached by the waiter who took our order, or any other waiter.  By the time we had finished, we asked the attendant who had been filling out glasses for the bill, and he went to alert our waiter.  A different waiter arrived with a desert menu, and left before we could clarify we wanted the bill.  He went to attend to the newly seated neighboring table.  After all this we finally got his attention and he grabbed our bill.  For the level of restaurant, we had much higher expectations for the service.  Considering there was a 15 minute grace period for the reservation, it seemed odd we would be forced to wait for nearly 10 minutes in a mostly empty restaurant.  The disorganization of the waiter situation also forced us to wait for atleast 15 minutes longer than other tables immediately next to us.  I hope the service issues we had were an exception, as the food and space were exceptional, but the consistently poor service from the waiters left a bad impression on us.', 'Food was great! We started with spicy margaritas. Meal was several mezzes, including an unbelievable hummus and beef sausages.  The duck shwarmawas good too, but the sauce a bit sweet.

Would have preferred seating in the main room but I guess parties of two are not seated there :-/']

name: GOLDEN KRUST CARIBBEAN RESTAURANT
reviews: ["Very bad experience!! With my husband we ordered this meal, it was a waste of money, they put too much sauce and they didn't put a spoon anything, disappointed!", 'The staff was great.  The food portion sucked.  I spent 32 dollars on two meals and NO DRINK was included.   I was so mad at the prices I forgot how good the food really was.', 'i love golden krust but my bun and cheese (i got 2) both had very small amounts of cheese and i paid 5 dollars for each..', 'The food is disgusting and unedible and there was a hair in my food. Yeah don’t waste your time and come here.', 'I specifically ordered 2 chicken patties, 1 coca bread, 1 dumpling. The dumpling was left out of my bag and I didn’t realize it until I was too far away. My bread was cut ridiculously so it was hard to even have patty in the bread.']

name: SALT & PEPPER
reviews: ['Good prices in all Indian and Spanish dishes. Accesible space to dine in. Near Penn Station and Grelleey Park of trains stations, Hot and  Ready food dishes. Personnel from Spanish or Indian food servers. Cash register separate of prepare and. Attendance of serving trays. Take out.', 'Staff are nice. Average food quality but yes you will have Asian taste.', "This is the best Indian/Pakistani food restaurant in the New York city, I've had a chance to visit this restaurant multiple times and it never disappointed me and always went beyond expectations. Anybody from Indian subcontinent or indian food lover visiting new york must visit this restaurant and enjoy their cuisine. Owner himself is one of the nicest person. Highly Recommended.", 'The quality is above and beyond. Perfect blend of flavors to stimulate your palate. The staff is so generous, kind and attentive. I highly recommend you give it a try.', 'Always find myself coming here after work, the chicken and goat curry with rice is soooo good and the meat is so tender, really satisfying after a long day. They also have fresh naan and plenty of seating.']

name: WAN WAAN (THAI RESTAURANT)
reviews:
['We came in here for the lunch special. We got an appetizer and main plate for $15-$17 each. The inside is very cute and well decorated with a lot of color and charm. Service was very friendly and quick!

We enjoyed the Pad Rama Tofu (great if you like peanut butter sauce) and the Panama Curry which is a great choice if you like a very mild curry.', 'Food and drinks were amazing. Chicken was crunchy on the outside and soft on the inside, duck was perfect.  The thai tea with vodka is super reccomended. Definitly a good spot for a date, or treating yourself.', 'Ribeye panang. The coconut milk curry was so rich, with ribeye steak it was even more luscious. The steak was perfectly seared, with a nice char on the outside, and remained tender and juicy on the inside. The fat cap was so delicious melting in your mouth like butter.

Pla rui saun. Don’t let bones stop you from savoring a delicious whole fish! Crispy fried fish topped with fresh salad, served with zesty, sweet and spicy sauce, complemented by fresh herbs and crunchy cashews. This is an orchestra of flavors and textures.

Sai oua. Tried it for the first time, an iconic dish from northern Thailand. It has distinctive flavors from aromatic herb blends.

Pad thai. You can’t go wrong with this classic dish! A blend of sweet, savory, umami flavors. The noodle was chewy, al dente.

Crispy tofu salad. Love the peanut dressing, so nutty, savory, tangy and sweet!

For drinks we ordered Thai iced tea with whipped cream and mojito. Both were great!', 'Good Thai food. Service was also upto the mark and ambience was normal.', 'I am a regular here and always enjoy the food they serve. Very friendly staff, and time to plate is fast.
Their menu is classic and they have great Chicken Volcano, Pad Thai, Khao Soy, and more, but those are my go-tos.']

name: NAR MODERN TURKISH CUISINE
reviews:
['The Turkish brunch at NAR on Saturday was perfect! Four of us, cat ❤️🐈‍⬛ lovers enjoy chatting over the wine.

The family style brunch platter presentation was attractive and delicious. Recommend it for a party of 2+.

The ambiance is Turkish modern and comfortable, staff is friendly. Gotta come back here to try other dishes!', 'It’s a high-end Turkish restaurant located in a nice spot. Is the restaurant nice? Yes. Is the food delicious? Yes.

However, we spent over $300, including multiple appetizers, and everyone left the restaurant hungry. The portions are so small that you enjoy the food but do not fill yourself. That’s why I’m giving it four stars.', "Nestled in the heart of Manhattan, between the bustling avenues of Park and Broadway on 20th Street, lies a culinary gem. Recently, I had the pleasure of dining here with my colleagues after work, and it was an experience that exceeded all expectations.
I was eager to try NAR, so wanted to invite and share the experience with my colleagues. From the moment we stepped inside, we were greeted by an ambiance that perfectly blends traditional Turkish elements with a contemporary flair. The decor, inspired by the works of the great poet Rumi, adds an elegant and artistic touch to the dining experience.
The menu at NAR is a delightful fusion of traditional Turkish dishes presented in a modern and sophisticated manner. Each dish is a testament to the culinary expertise and creativity of the chefs. The service was impeccable; attentive and friendly, the staff made us feel welcomed and ensured our dining experience was top-notch.
Among the many delectable options, a few dishes stood out. The Manti, delicate Turkish dumplings filled with seasoned meat, were an absolute delight. The Stuffed Wine Leaves were perfectly balanced and refreshing. Sultan's Bliss, a rich and creamy eggplant dish, was a true indulgence. And the Nar Kebap, a perfectly grilled and seasoned kebab, was simply sublime.
NAR Modern Turkish Cuisine offers a dining experience that is both unique and memorable. The combination of traditional flavors, modern presentation, and exceptional service makes it a must-visit for anyone in Manhattan. I highly recommend this restaurant, and I am already looking forward to my next visit.", 'Upon entering Nar, we were welcomed kindly by the entire staff. Each dish was carefully crafted with attention and detail. Nar is truly one of the best modern Turkish restaurants in NYC. Some of our favorite cold appetizers ordered were Shakshuka and Sundried Eggplant and Pepper Dolma. As for hot appetizers, Grilled Iriskit and Hellim Cheese & Nar Icli Kofte were stand-out dishes. For the mains, our server advised on the Nar Kebab, which was a great kebab choice and extremely flavorful, made with minced beef and lamb, combined with pistachio. To end the meal, we ordered a few desserts. The Turkish Delight Lava Cake was outstanding; highly recommend for all diners. Look forward to going back!', 'This Turkish restaurant has been a long-missing gem in New York. It’s not your typical Turkish spot—it’s much more. The chefs have given a modern twist to some classics, and everything on the menu is amazing.

I particularly like the meatball appetizer and Nar Kebab. The profiteroles dessert is also quite successful.']

name: THE RESTAURANT
reviews: ['Awesome and fun staff. We walked in just as the kitchen was closing but the chef was awesome and said he would keep cooking for us. We got the pesto gnocchi and salmon. Both were yummy. Atmosphere was cozy and clean. We were in NY visiting. Would definitely go back on our next trip.:)', "Really enjoyed the atmosphere here but more importantly the service.  Very attentive and knowledgeable staff. Our waiter made great suggestions that we truly enjoyed. They have really delicious vegetarian options as well. Cocktail drinks are pretty good as well. Overall everything's up to par. Worth the visit.", 'The decor was better than the food. My bf ordered medium cooked steak and his ish came out over done. My chicken sandwich took me back to HS and not in a good way. Tasted just like the chicken Pattie’s I used to get for free at lunch.', "Fun place with an attentive staff and nice wine list. We reserved for a small group party in their Barn Room. The cauliflower was my favorite menu item we tried. Flatbreads were pretty good (go with the caramelized onion one). Pasta was a tad overdone but I'm chalking that up to the large group and special order we placed.", 'Was blown away by the experience at this place. The food has changed since I last walked by, so many new menu items perfect for a casual din. I had the tuna tartare to start which had a kick but not too spicy and we shared a flatbread. The owner mentioned these are made in house and I believe it.. so fresh. My main was the chicken which I asked for more juice to dip in because the skin was so perfect… when you remember you can’t cook chicken well at home come here and don’t waste your time. The owner Joey made sure we were satisfied and dropped off our drinks. My friend was also Gluten free and they were able to accommodate easy! I will be coming back to try the brunch asap.']

name: RAJ MAHAL
reviews: ['I have never had worse naan tikka. They didn’t even bother to put chicken in it they splatter the oil on the naan and charged me for it. It didn’t taste good at all. Don’t go bother.', 'Ordered a Chicken Biryani and a Butter Chicken. The biryani is very bland and the butter chicken tastes like tomato soup.', 'We’ve been going to this place for years and the staff is always so kind and welcoming and the food is delicious. The samosas are fabulous. The butter chicken was decadent and so comforting. And they always give you a free, little dessert after your meal. I highly recommend!', "My nose brought me here while walking down 6th and I'm very glad it did! The $20 dinner special is a great value backed up by the amazing food. Pakora and samosas were great appetizers and the onion chutney was out of the world. The soup is a lentil soup that's been blended giving it the perfect texture. Main courses were the lamb kurma and vegetable dhansak. The vege dhansak was amazing! One of the best dishes I've had at any Indian restaurant anywhere! I'd go back just for that! Mango custard was a nice way to finish but paying extra for a serving of rasmalai rounded out the meal in a way I wanted. It's very quiet inside the restaurant and fun chili pepper lighting helps the ceiling feel not low and gives an intimacy to the space. Would go back here again, especially for the vegetarian options", 'It was truly the worst Chana sag I’ve ever eaten. It had no flavor and was basically just boiled chickpeas and spinach. Texture was horrible. Couldn’t even eat it. Server was very nice but seemed mad I wasn’t eating. I just wanted to pay and leave - I didn’t even want to exchange it for anything else.']

name: Z HALAL RESTAURANT
reviews:
['The Halal Lamb over Rice is a must try! I also liked their Fry Fish with Fries. The guy that owns the Restaurant is very polite and accommodating. He makes it fresh. Definitely coming back again!', 'The food was great, my favorite thing to order is a meat over rice. The burger I had was 🤤😋
I’m going  to try everything on the menu and figure out what’s my favorite item. If your nearby or want some good halal food, definitely make a visit and try them out. I think they just started, let’s show some support.', 'This place is great, food is really fresh and the meat is cooked perfectly. Super friendly guys who run it too', 'Delicious food, good people. Loved the homemade burgers - made fresh to order', 'I’m so happy to come here get my everyday lunch .
Best halal food in town .
Love it']

name: JOY INDIAN RESTAURANT
reviews:
['Ordered pickup to go. Staff was nice. 10/10. Food was piping hot by the time I got home 20ish minutes later. Portion size is good for the price. I wasn’t super familiar with Indian food before I ordered & wanted to try a bunch. I got the chicken tikka masala, lamb handi, veg biryanis, garlic and cheese naan, & paratha plain. Very flavorful. I will order again.', "I recently had the chicken biryani at Joy Indian along Flatbush Ave, and it was absolutely delicious! The rice was perfectly cooked and fluffy, the chicken was tender and flavorful, and the spices were perfectly balanced. I would definitely recommend this biryani to anyone looking for a great Indian meal in Brooklyn.

The chicken was cooked in a dum style, which means that it was sealed in a pot with the rice and spices and cooked over low heat for a long period of time. This results in a very flavorful and aromatic biryani.

The rice was basmati rice, which is a long-grain rice that is perfect for biryani. It cooked up perfectly fluffy and light. The spices were perfectly balanced. There was a good amount of heat, but it wasn't too overwhelming. The flavors of the spices were all perfectly complemented each other.

Overall, I would highly recommend the chicken biryani at Joy Indian along Flatbush Ave. It is one of the best biryanis I've had in Brooklyn.", 'Favorite Indian spot in Brooklyn. Samosas, tangy gobi, and Coconut salmon curry are all divine. We order here weekly. Highly recommend!!', 'I love Indian food and I eat it once or twice a week. This restaurant is my far one of the best I’ve had and the service is amazing too.', 'This place literally made my day! The food was perfection! Super flavorful with the perfect kick of spice and the stuffed naan is seriously the best bread I’ve ever had. Not only is the food great, but also the prices are so good especially for the quality and size and the workers are angels. This will be my new go to Indian spot :)']

name: NO. 7 RESTAURANT
reviews:
['The food here is amazing! Great flavors and fresh ingredients.

We ordered the broccoli tacos, the chopped salad, and shared the burger. Everything was delicious! The burger is so good, very simple, but you can tell they use good quality meat. The salad was fresh and had great acidity to it. The tacos were crunchy with great mouthfeel and were absolutely yummy.

My only gripe was with the service! It was horrible. The hostess/waitress was rude as soon as we stepped through the door. I had to flag down staff each time we needed something. When it came to the bill, I had to get up and ask the bartender for the bill. Inexcusable, especially since the food is not cheap at all.

Will come back with lower expectations for service.', 'Broccoli Taco: order every time I go there, how are tacos made with broccoli??  But they are delicious.
Giant minimal cheeseburger: medium cook. Came with French fries. Pickles, wow sour, spicy, sweet bunch of flavor in one slice of pickle.
So yeah, No.7 highly recommend', 'We’ve been here twice—the food is good, but some things, like the burger, have gotten way more expensive. The burger is good, if a bit boring, and it comes with fries—the fries were covered in a sort of boring blue cheese, so they weren’t my favorite. The fried artichokes were great and probably the best thing we ordered.', 'Awesome spot. Artistic drinks. Rotating menu but Brocc Tacos and Sundae are amazing. Also has high chairs and the chef immediately chops up and delivers fresh fruit for kiddos.', 'Food is pretty good and big. We ordered pork chop and taco, which is enough for 2 people. Drinks are delicious too!']

name: XOLO
reviews:
['My friend and I came here for dinner on a Friday night after making reservations for restaurant week. Unfortunately, it was bland food and weak cocktails. I was not a fan of their ambience either. The yellow lighting is not very pleasant.

The food was just OK — lacked in flavor and texture as some of the other reviews noted. We ordered the fried goat cheese with honey, vegetarian and chicken enchiladas, and churros. The goat cheese didn’t have the best flavor mixture with the honey, the enchiladas were very bland, and the churros were super hard. The caramel and chocolate sauce that the churros came with were not too sweet but not too tasty either.

I ordered their Oaxaca old-fashioned, which is tequila-based instead of bourbon. I did have high hopes but alas, while it tasted nice and smoky, it was extremely weak in alcohol content.

My least favorite part about this experience is that the food came out rather quickly in between courses so we were done eating in 30 minutes. My friend ended up getting indigestion because we ate so quickly.

All in all, this place is a charming neighborhood Mexican spot in Dumbo, but I personally would not come back.', 'So, the service and atmosphere were the best parts of our experience here. I have a few qualms about the food however, and maybe I need to try it out another time?

Food: While everything seemed fresh, there was just flavor/texture missing from some of items. The guacamole was bland, it definitely needed more to it (we ended up asking for limes to add to it) and we expected salsa to be served with it. I did not expect this small container of red sauce, I wanted a real dip for all of those chips. It was just something I was surprised by considering the reviews for this place.

My boyfriend liked his tacos, but felt that it was overcooked meat. I was excited to try the vegan Xolo Burrito, but it wasn’t that great :/ the serving and plating for both dishes looked fantastic! But the flavor was muted, it didn’t really taste like much except potatoes (no vegan chorizo?) and the texture was just mushy. No crunch from vegetables or flavorful sauces. Just potato mush? Idk.

The margarita was great! It definitely had fresh fruit and the spicy rim was fantastic.

Service: the staff was incredibly quick and kind. They were wonderful throughout!

Atmosphere: the inside is intimate and fun. Like a cross between a taqueria and a club, great for dates or meeting with friends! And the view of the Williamsburg bridge is amazing.

Overall, I really wanted to like this place. But, I’m baffled by the food. It was honestly just mediocre for a place with so many good reviews, maybe I came on an off night.', 'if you like mesa coyocan your going to love this place. The steak nachos the shrimp tacos everything was so nice. it’s on a quiet street but this place is amazing would come back in a heart beat.', "Xolo, tucked away in the heart of Brooklyn, is a gem of a Mexican restaurant that effortlessly combines coziness with culinary delight. From the moment you step inside, you're enveloped in a warm, inviting atmosphere that sets the tone for a relaxed dining experience. The ambient lighting and thoughtful decor create an intimate setting, perfect for both casual diners and those seeking a spot for special occasions.

The food at Xolo is nothing short of a fiesta of flavors. Each dish is a testament to authentic Mexican cuisine, with fresh ingredients that are expertly combined to delight your taste buds. The tacos are a must-try—perfectly charred and bursting with the savory goodness of well-seasoned meats, topped with fresh herbs and chopped onions that add a refreshing crunch. Whether you're craving the slow-cooked depth of barbacoa or the vibrant zing of citrus-marinated fish, there's something on the menu to satisfy.

But the experience doesn't stop at the food. Xolo's drinks menu is a curated selection of cocktails and spirits that complement the food menu exquisitely. From classic margaritas to more inventive creations, each sip is crafted with the same attention to detail and quality as the dishes they accompany. The service, too, is a highlight—attentive without being intrusive, ensuring that your glass is never empty and your needs are met with a smile.

In all, Xolo is a delightful escape into the warm embrace of Mexican hospitality right in Brooklyn. It's a place where every meal feels like a celebration, and every visit leaves you planning the next. Whether you're a local or just passing through, make a point to stop at Xolo—you won't be disappointed.", 'Very nicely decorated and a really relaxing vibe. The food was good and it’s a nice view of the bridge too. I came in on a Saturday for brunch and overall there was plenty of seating so I wouldn’t recommend a reservation. Very cute place just to try something small.']

name: SALINAS RESTAURANT
reviews:
["Excellent experience but the tables are extra small!  It doesn't get more uncomfortable than this if you're a party of four stuck into the cubby seats on the side as you enter the restaurant.  The seats are upright and you've about 2 inches between your chest and the table (and I'm not overweight).

The food was very good though, delicate, delicious and a joy to eat. If it weren't for the cramped quarters the rating here would be a 5.", 'Amazing!! Many thanks to, Maria for making the evening so fun and memorable!! She recommended some of the best dishes and we are thankful for all her expertise. The atmosphere, the food, and the cocktails were all five stars and above!', 'Amazing! Amazing experience! Tapas were the best I’ve had. Our table tried most on the menu- the octopus, ceviche and croquettes stick out to me, but everything was outstanding. The drinks were fabulous as well. Our server, Israel, provided top-notch service and went above and beyond. At least five team members and the manager routinely checked on us. We even got a complimentary dessert!', 'Good choice for tapas in Chelsea. A very intimate ambience, great for date nights. The food was interesting, tasted good but a little too much olive oil in every dish. Maybe that’s how it’s supposed to be but it definitely stood out for me. The place is a little on the expensive side. The service was friendly and warm.', 'Salinas is a gem of a spot that truly has it all! Their happy hour is fantastic, offering excellent deals that let you enjoy their incredible food and drinks at a great value. The atmosphere is chic yet welcoming, making it perfect for both casual get-togethers and special occasions.

The food here is absolutely phenomenal — every dish is packed with flavor and beautifully presented. Here’s what we ordered:
* PULPO CON CENIZAS: Tender Canary Island octopus paired with calçot aioli, seaweed, caper berries, black beans, and meyer lemon. It’s a perfectly balanced dish with smoky, tangy, and fresh flavors that highlight the octopus beautifully.
* BRAVAS CON HUEVAS MARINAS: Crispy potatoes elevated to a whole new level with trout and black lumpfish caviar, shaved bottarga, citrus-soy, and a spicy brava sauce. It’s indulgent, creative, and an absolute must-try.
* CRUDO: Faroe Island salmon tartare with borage cress, raw beets, red onions, and spicy sesame oil. The freshness of the salmon combined with the subtle heat of the sesame oil creates a dish that’s both light and flavorful.

The bartenders were amazing — super friendly, attentive, and more than happy to offer recommendations or customize drinks to suit your tastes. It’s clear that they love what they do, and their energy adds to the overall experience.

I honestly love it here and can’t recommend it enough. Whether it’s for happy hour or a full dinner, Salinas is a place you’ll keep coming back to!']

name: SWAGAT INDIAN RESTAURANT
reviews: ['I felt the food was okay. I tried the vegetarian combo, which was reasonably priced as well.\n\nI would say Rasmalai is a Must-try. It was deliciously', "Ate here 3 times during my visit to NYC. 2 times for dinner and one time for lunch. The food is as good as any Indian restaurant I've eaten at. I highly recommend this restaurant for a quick meal or lunch.", 'Terrible place. I got stomach upset from eating here. Plus the $20 Biryani was more like fried rice put together using chicken curry where certain part of not even fried.  No pride involved here.', 'This place is à gem, when à resurant slaps this hard everyone needs to know about it. The interior is spacious and clean, the food looked great even from a distance, smells great as you enter the store..... and the best part? (This is going to sound so stupid) but actual Indian people eat here! hahaha', 'Incredibly bland Indian food. Plastic cutlery (the only option) was sharp and cut my mouth. Not much atmosphere either. All this would be forgivable if it were cheap, but expect to pay $20 per person.']

name: ESSEX RESTAURANT
reviews: ['Grabbed brunch here recently for the first time and it was such a great find! Our brunch was delicious, mimosas were great and the servers were friendly. Busy restaurant and can be a bit noisy but definitely a fun atmosphere! We will be back when in NYC again!', '4.3 /5. Fun, rockin’ Happy Hour. As I waited for my friends to arrive, the waiter was attentive and asked if I wanted to be served as she dropped off the menus. I got my drink & water before they arrived several minutes later. Water glasses were quickly filled and the waiter came by again to take drink and food orders. We started with the oysters, unfortunately, they were a bit small and not so tasty -  was not a fan of the sauces provided. I would probably try this again as it’s not really the season for oysters right now. The shrimp wantons was a table favorite, as was the calamari. The flatbread was small and just Ok. We ordered a second round of food as it was our dinner. The Manchego mac and cheese was outstanding! It was probably the best Mac n cheese I’ve had at a restaurant with a healthy amount of cheese and perfectly prepared with a toasted top. The 3 of us were almost full but we managed to finish the very good truffle fries. I probably wouldn’t order the roasted peppers next time, even though they were prepared excellently. All the food arrived piping hot, which should be easy to do but most places don’t do this. The place was buzzy with people drinking but there was still room if you wanted to drink, arrive early for a table. Fantastic happy hour! Oct 2024', 'Helena provided us optimal service. I brought my service dog along and she was so respectful to her as well. Whenever our drinks were even halfway, she made sure to refill and cater to our bottomless mimosas choice. Great experience. Ask for her if you want to make sure your brunch experience is seamless', 'Our server Katie, hands down the best person I have ever met, sis came over with the most energetic attitude, filled my water within 30 Seconds of me sitting  down, she answered any questions I had about the menu (there were quite a few) she was so attentive and made this experience one of the best ones. She made sure we were comfortable and having fun the whole time. She made our 1st time here definitely memorable for I’ll be back for my birthday in a month THANKS TO KATIE \U0001fa77\U0001fa77\U0001fa77\U0001fa77', 'This was such a VIBE for a Saturday brunch!! We brought an out of town friend and some NYC friends and everyone loved it!! Our server Helena was GENUINELY a gem!!! The most attentive bottomless brunch bestie we’ve ever met !! We will def come back!']

name: TRANZIT RESTAURANT
reviews: ["Breakfast hamburger was delicious. Didn't have certain stuff and the room was cold. And gratuity was automatically included.", "Do not pay by card. We had a couple of drinks in the bar as it was part of the hotel we were staying in. Drinks were OK  - bit pricey but you pay for convenience. Tipped the server in cash and paid the bill by card. Bit shocked to then discover a further 30% service charge loaded onto the card transaction- despite the cash tip already given. Unnecessary and greedy. Leaves a bad taste and we didn't drink there again.", 'Service was non-existent, food was ok, but never received drinks we ordered…', 'Good for a quick drink before going up to your room. Average.', 'A good place to have breakfast.']

name: SCHILLING RESTAURANT & BAR
reviews:
['We were looking for a different place to have lunch near the hotel we were staying. Very cozy atmosphere. We have tried the trout dip and the salmon, both delicious!! At the end we have the apple strudel, so yummy! Next time we would like to have The Schnitzel plate. We do not recommend to sit in the middle row if you want to enjoy more your time there 😘', "Coming here was like going to a first date with low expectations and being pleasantly surprised by how....good....everything turns out to be.

First, could this spot be any cuter? The cuteness is all the more noticeable because this restaurant is in a forgettable, nondescript slice of FiDi. Blink and you'll miss it.

Second, the food delivered. Both our Heirloom Tomatoes (farm fresh with huge portions and tasty homemade dressing) and the Spätzle (creamy and comforting) were scrumptious. Having just visited Germany again earlier this year, I was craving some good Deutsch carbs, and I loved what Schilling did.

Then, there's the Happy Hour wine, which at $8/glass is too good a deal to pass up in these inflationary times. Esp. when the wines on offer come from the German-speaking parts of the world.

Will definitely be back when I'm stuck in this boring part of Manhattan.", 'Came here for lunch on a Monday (around 1pm) and was able to walk in without needing reservation. We got the schnitzel (tried pork and chicken) and also the apple schtrudel, they were all delicious! The schnitzels also came with 3 sides, so it was a good amount of food even if you are very hungry. I also loved the vibe of this space. I will definitely be back for dinner!', "Very nice and cozy restaurant! The food was delicious, I thought that the schnitzel was just as good as any I've had in Germany or Austria.", 'Wonderful location! Absolutely underrated on Google! The veal schnitzel was incredibly tasty! The dessert (apple strudel) as well. The service was great and the location deserves a very good rating. On our next visit we will definitely come back again.']

name: MAX RESTAURANT
reviews:
['Brought me and my seven girlfriends here for my 23rd birthday on a Sunday night and although the room is definitely tight, it makes for a cozy atmosphere. our server, Sam was super patient and gave great recommendations! I will definitely be coming back here soon as me and my friends cannot stop talking about how good this food is. all the food was absolutely incredible and tasty but the ravioli definitely was my favorite. so glad I chose my birthday dinner here!', 'Stopped here for dinner on trip to NY with son. The food is delicious! Good atmosphere, good staff. Had the spaghetti with clams, and son had fettuccine. Good place to take your partner out for a nice dinner.', 'Neighbor gem in Tribeca!  Top-notch food with friendly staff who make you feel like friends no matter where you are from.  We loved the Fettuccine with Max’s meat sauce, Spaghetti with clams, and mushroom ravioli in addition to the Tartufo for dessert.  Although we live in Williamsburg (Brooklyn), we’ll definitely be back for dinner at Max’s!', 'The past test very good!
Everything fresh
Nices drinks
Good service
Bread very fresh
Love this place', 'This is my favorite Italian place in Tribeca if not Manhattan. Absolutely amazing every time. Make sure you try the fettuccine and the string beans!!']

name: LE COUCOU
reviews:
['The perfect place to impress your date or guests. The service is elite fine dining. The chefs are just incredible with the preparation of the dishes, menu selection, and design of presentation. my guests had cocktails which were an appropriate size for a classy delicious midday sip.', 'A romantic, splendid, tranquil oasis in the middle of a barren block on Lafayette St.
The staff could not have been more attentive  or helpful (which is never the case with solo diners). I felt all of them were a team working in unison and anticipated all my needs. Even my cider bottle was poured when my glass needed a refill.
The tuna and scallop appetizer was enhanced by the mild chili oil, thinly sliced white onions and a sprinkle of parsley.
The Vol-a-vent, combining lobster and sweetbreads, two of my favorite things, meticulously prepared was exquisite.
And to top it all the Marjolaine dessert (chocolate and hazelnut ) was a dream come true.
A grand lunch in a grand soaring space with a reassuring old world grandeur.', "Le Coucou offers an exceptional dining experience. The atmosphere is both elegant and intimate, creating the perfect setting for a special night out. My husband and I celebrated our anniversary and it was absolutely a gem! The lobster is a standout—easily one of the best I've had in NYC, cooked to perfection! If you're feeling adventurous, I highly recommend trying the lamb thymus. It's a unique dish, and although I'd never had it before, the preparation and presentation made it a memorable highlight. Overall, Le Coucou delivers a refined French dining experience! Oh, the restroom is super clean and pretty!", "Came here for an anniversary dinner, and they had prepared written celebratory messages for us :) The place was dim-lit and romantic.

Service was spectacular! We asked our waiter what he recommended and he described his favorites, and also considered that we'll share dishes (so they served the dishes in two plates for us). Staff also described each dish to us, describing how it was cooked.

The food presentation was amazing, it really felt like fine dining.  We were full by the end of the meal. We ordered 6 food items, and they also gave us bread. My favorite was the veal and Vacherin aux myrtilles!", 'Looks better than it tasted. Not much flavor, food was cold. Bread was cold. Only enjoyed the pudding bc it was hot and soft. Appetizer was a hard piece of toast, not sure what it was. Everything was decorative and cute but when eaten, become disappointed. Required to dress up. For that price and expectation, it’s a no for us. Different servers kept bothering us asking if we were done. Atmosphere was loud and bright although fancy looking.']

name: NORTH FORK RESTAURANT
reviews: ['Cute little spot in west village! The food and drinks were both lovely. I definitely recommend the braised goat neck that comes on top of a cheesy polenta and it was so comforting and delicious. I also really enjoyed their oysters and mussels and make sure you don’t leave without trying one of their desserts! The lavender lemon drop was my fave drink that I tried there! Definitely worth checking out!', 'I was excited to give this restaurant a try while out in the city. When I arrived I found parking nearby. I walked up to the restaurant to find indoor and outdoor seating. I walked in and was greeted by Randle, and he was great. We started with some drinks, which included an espresso martini, and it was so tasty. For my meal, I got the Thai mussels for appetizers and the black squid ink seafood pasta for my entrée. My friend had a margarita, which she liked, and the cauliflower cake for her appetizer and goat for her entrée. She enjoyed it all! We really had a good experience!', 'This is such a hidden gem! Really like their food and cocktails!\nTheir whipped feta dip with that crunchy chickpea is just so delish! Haven’t tasted anything like that! The braised goat neck is definitely their star product. Additionally their aesthetic and vibes are just perfect!', 'Bottomless Brunch!! 🥂 My best friend and I had a fantastic brunch at North Fork. Incredibly fresh and well made food. Truly one of the best brunch meals we have had in a long time. The mimosas were premade (which we were initially concerned about) but they did not disappoint! Champagne to orange juice ratio was perfect👌🏼. As North Fork is a small restaurant, I highly recommend making a reservation as walk-ins were seated at the bar.', 'My friends and I decided to meet here for brunch on a weekend. We made a reservation before and I’d highly suggest doing so because the restaurant filled up quickly shortly after we were seated. The service was fast and they were able to bring out our drinks almost immediately after we placed the order. The restaurant itself is ideal for brunch, well lit and tons of comfortable seating available. When it came time to choose what we’d be eating, I went with the baked skillet eggs which was truly tasty as well as filling. This spot is ideal to visit with family or friends for a daytime meal. They also offer a bottomless brunch option for the adventurous!']

name: KOLOMAN
reviews:
['An absolute gem in the Ace Hotel. The dining experience I had was phenomenal. They really made my anniversary extremely special. We ordered many dishes and paired them with the wine our knowledgeable servers and sommelier recommended. Definitely recommend for any occasion. The portions were quite filling', "The food, cocktails,wine, and ambiance were excellent. The wait staff and sommelier were knowledgeable and extremely polite and charismatic. Max, the sommelier, was quite knowledgeable about the wine but also the cocktails, which helped our choices. Dinner was superb. We had the duck, salmon, and the fish special turbot. The desserts were divine. We will return and I suggest going, it's a lovely place.", 'I was a regular at Chef Markus Glocker’s previous restaurant, Bâtard, in TriBeCa. Sadly the pandemic put an end to my long streak of wonderful dinners there. Once my travel to NYC returned post-pandemic I was excited to once again enjoy his blend of Viennese sophistication and French techniques. I’ve now dined at Koloman around ten times, sampling much of the menu and seeing the evolution in both the food and the service.

Koloman provides extremely high-quality food in a sophisticated but not overly-fancy/stuffy atmosphere. The remodeling done after they replaced the Breslin brings some Deco and Art Nouveau style. The bar is a particular standout with its giant clock and brass accents. Depending on where you are seated the noise level can be fairly high on a busy Friday, but most of the time it is moderate.

Stand-out dishes include the signature salmon en croute, which maintains the core strength of perfectly-cooked fish while adding visual flair and contrasting crunch. The gougeres (with shallot filling, if I recall correctly) are a perfect start to any meal. The schnitzel made its way from Bâtard and still comes with a delightful duo of lingonberry and sea buckthorn sauces (I do find the cook on this can be a bit variable at times, the breading sometimes getting a bit loose/oily). I actually appreciate that the schnitzel isn’t absolutely overwhelming in size, as they often are, so that I can enjoy other courses alongside it. The chicken, in its various incarnations, is honestly pretty much the only chicken I will order at a restaurant. I’m not anti-chicken, but I feel like I’ve mastered it at home, or at least I thought I had until I ate it at Koloman.

My favorite dish on the menu may actually be the celery root tartare; I have to fight with myself to try something else, and it’s what I always recommend when new guests ask what they should start with. It has a perfect acid-salt-bitter-sweet balance that makes me want an entire deli container of the stuff. I ate the new all-plant-based menu at Eleven Madison Park the other night and all I could think was how much better a veg dish Koloman is making than 90% of what is on offer at that three-Michelin establishment.

Desserts often include Austrian classics like Esterházy torte and apple strudel. The duck egg crème brûlée somehow manages to be both incredibly rich while also light enough to scarf down; it’s probably my favorite version of the dish, displacing the one I used to have at John Besh’s Lüke. My personal favorite is the Lübeck Marzipan. It has the most satisfying chew, and I have been known to get one to go to serve as the next morning’s breakfast at my hotel.

A cheese plate was recently added to the dessert menu (I can’t take credit, but I had been repeatedly asking after having eaten so much of the stuff at Bâtard), and the bleu I had the other night alongside (gelled?) honey and cotton candy grapes was the perfect end to a lovely meal with friends.

The wine list reflects a lingering focus on Burgundy and Champagne but also includes loads of other quirky European choices and (for obvious reasons) one of the deepest Austrian lists in the city. Current somm Max and his predecessor Hanna have both guided me to wonderful recommendations and assisted well in maintaining budgets when required.

Service at Koloman has been friendly and efficient, and I’ve noticed some improvement over the last year and a half as well, perhaps a reflection of getting into “the groove” and building a bench of more experienced staff. In addition to the aforementioned somms, I would be remiss if I didn’t mention Angélica, my several-times server who has helped me handle unexpectedly-vegan old friends, semi-awkward business meals, and solo-dining oases. Her knowledge of the menu and ability to adjust her delivery to the mood at the table have been very valuable in giving all my various guests a comfortable and memorable evening. A heartfelt thank you to her and all of the staff!', "Great meal and service. I got the Summer 2024 Restaurant Week three-course dinner: Chilled Sweetcorn Soup, Amish Chicken Breast + Charred Broccolini, Viennese Apple Strudel.

I'd recommend every dish, every dish was great. The Amish Chicken dish in particular was well balanced, had a butter sauce cut by vinegar, the mashed potato was creamy and perfectly seasoned, and the chicken breast had very soft meat with a thin & crispy skin.", 'Brunch review. Just order it all. And if you can't order it all, get these:

- Carrot Bread: Better than your grandma's

- Roasted Beets "Linzer": A deconstructed beet linzer cookie, complete with pieces of candied orange and hazelnut crust to complement the sweetness of the pink and red beets. Why hasn't anyone thought to make a salad taste like a cookie? Genius.

- Kernöl: Tasty "styrian-style" soft scrambled eggs with plenty of homemade baked bread to slather them on.

- Goulash: As good was what I had in Hungary and savory enough to make me cry tears of joy. I could eat that buttered spätzle every day.

- Viennese Apple Strudel: I generally don't care for apple desserts, but of course Koloman made me temporarily change course with its flaky, crusty, perfectly spiced pastry with rum raisins, toasted hazelnuts and frozen buttermilk. I spent a week in Vienna and don't know if I had any apple strudel there as good as this.

We first experienced Koloman at an LA Times-hosted food festival. Among so many A-list restauranteurs, their offerings stood out as one of the best. Now that the restaurant has successfully passed my brunch test, I'll quite happily shell out more for dinner. Besides, it's good practice for when I jet off to Germany in a couple of months. Mmmm, endless spätzle....']

name: UKRAINIAN EAST VILLAGE RESTAURANT
reviews: ['Stopped by blindly and loved this place! Great eats and a lovely environment. I had never eaten Ukrainian food before, so I tried the East Village Combo and loved it! Staff are also very kind. When they hit rush hour, it did take a while to get the check, but other than that, no complaints!', 'The food was really good, but the service did struggle. We wanted to split the bill but the waiter said that would not be possible and delayed us for some time, so we are not sure if we will go back. May be get delivery because the food is really nice', 'Authentic delicious old world comfort food. Borscht is top notch and the cabbage rolls are melt in your mouth tastiness. Loved it! смачно', 'This restaurant is a true gem (a bit hidden at the end of 60 feet hallway). We had halushky with feta and bacon and letcho (Hungarian goulash) with potato pancakes. We have also fried the white borscht (cold soup with buttermilk). Everything looked good and was delicious! Service was fast.  ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️', 'I cannot heap enough praise on the Ukrainian National Home Restaurant! Authentic, delicious Ukrainian food, prepared and served by real Ukrainians. The decor is humble and beautiful. So lucky to have found it!']

name: JUFU GARDEN RESTAURANT
reviews:
['Look the pics. The clumpiness, lack of evenly distributed ingredients and any char bits should tell you avoid wasting tummy space.
It’s edible and can be flavoured with soy and shiracha if you must', 'The food was great! The waiter didn’t speak English, but that wasn’t a problem. I had a wonderful time here.', "Worst Chinese restaurant I've ever been at. The restaurant's vibe was weird and sketchy. We were the only customers there during lunch. Other people seemed to be the owner's friends, they were just sitting there, having tea and speaking loudly in Mandarin. We ordered some dumplings, stir-fried noodles and soups. The foods looked plain and were mediocre.. I feel like they didn't really put effort into making these foods. Also, the server was rude, not verbally rude but her behaviors made us feel uncomfortable. When we asked for the check, the server gave us the check and she was standing right at our table and staring at me signing the check. It was an awkward moment because we didn't feel like to give them a tip, but since she was staring at me and the check so I had to put some tip on there. Bad experience after all, 200% don't recommend.", "I was here several years ago, and as someone else said, I had roast pork fried rice, which was the best I had ever tasted. Absolutely fantastic. My husband was with me then and raved about it also.

Fast forward to now. We made a special trip to this restaurant as I had kept their business card. I don't know if there are new owners, a new chef, or if it's a new restaurant, but the pork fried rice was quite unexceptional. My husband agreed. We were both extremely disappointed. I will not go back here. I can get mediocre fried rice like that anywhere. I'll be looking for another Chinese restaurant to go to when I'm in the city.", 'Would give zero stars if the system allowed. Decided to try this place out, but it was all window dressing and the photo of their takeout food looks terrific until they give you a seaweed soup that smells fishy. Then trying out the beef lo mein, the oil used smelled/tasted fishy. Why would you reuse oil to cook another dish? Horrible after taste.']

name: SAPPHIRE INDIAN RESTAURANT
reviews: ['first let me start off by saying this is the best thing i ever had. this is my first time having indian food too and everything was just so fresh and seasoned so good. 10/10 AMAZING', 'Amazing Food. Their pistachio kulfis are amazing. They are very warm and welcoming. Recommend going there.', 'Guy was nice. I ordered the samosas and they weren’t bad, but I wouldn’t seek them out again unless I was REALLY hungry. They were mostly unitexture and a little stale. Sauces were good.', 'Ordered chicken vindaloo, garlic naan, samosas. The vindaloo curry was a greasy mess that was not at all spicy, the chicken, rice, and samosas were dry, and the garlic naan was overpowering (and I say that as someone who loves garlic). I got through about half my order before tossing.', 'Absolutely delicious! We ordered cheese naan, lamb korma and lamb vindaloo and everything was distinctly different and wonderfully flavorful. This particular Sunday we enjoyed a 15% discount for dine in service. The server was also very kind and attentive. Looking forward to going back again soon!']

name: MAISON CLOSE RESTAURANT
reviews: ["The restaurant is beautiful and very atmospheric, very cozy and French. The food was delicious too, we liked all the dishes, except the steak which was a little bit dry. The standout favorite was the Linguine à la Truffe - creamy and mouthwatering. The sommelier offered excellent wine recommendations. Desserts were equally impressive. Note that prices are on the higher side. I'd definitely recommend this restaurant - the food is high quality, the ambiance is comfortable. They have a bar as well, and there's live music after 11:30 pm.", 'The restaurant is beautiful and very atmospheric.\nThe food was delicious too. I want to note that the snails were probably the most delicious I have tasted in America. The steak was the perfect temperature. And the desserts were amazing. We were also very lucky with the waiter, I don’t remember exactly her name, I think it was Kamila.  She took care of us, was friendly and a true professional. I recommend this place for dinner!', 'What a wonderful experience we had! The food was out of this world and the staff was excellent. The atmosphere of the restaurant is gorgeous. Camila was our waitress and she was the sweetest! She checked on us to make sure everything was going smoothly. Our bartender Mez was also really sweet and made us the yummiest drinks! The manager of Mason Close gave us the best recommendations. Every bite was so divine. Definitely recommend.', 'Celebrated my daughter’s birthday last night at Maison Close and it was absolutely epic! The food, service and attention to detail was exceptional! We will be back again soon!', 'This place was super lovely and the staff were extremely attentive. We loved our waitress Camille. She was super on top\nof things and made our experience amazing. Loved the cocktails and food.']

name: CATHÉDRALE RESTAURANT
reviews:
['Went for the Happy Hour at the bar and was quite impressed. The champagne was delicious and the food was fantastic! I loved every dish, and the flexibility with how many oysters you could order (no minimum like some other restaurants). You can’t beat the value! It was a bit loud, but that is to be expected. My only criticism would be the ‘stand around and grab the first available seat’ style of seating for the bar- it doesn’t seem like a practical choice for a busy restaurant, and felt a bit like a game of musical chairs. The service was great, the staff were friendly and attentive. I will absolutely go back again!', 'Absolutely lovely dining experience. The servers were very attentive and accommodating, and definitely went above and beyond for us. The restaurant itself is elegant and warm, and packed on a Friday night which I took as a good sign.

Our server gave us great recommendations for drinks and food, which did not disappoint! We started with the Campo Rosso endive salad, which was sharing size good for 2-3 people. It was light and tangy balanced by the goat cheese- I’d absolutely order again. For mains we ordered the salmon and the scallops- both cooked to perfection and well balanced. We ended the meal with the creme Brûlée, also perfect to split between two people. The espresso custard was silky and the torched sugar on top had a perfect crack, complimented by fresh raspberries and mint leaves. We tried a few cocktails as well, all were good but our favorite was the April in Paris.

I am looking forward to dining here again and trying more of the menu. Every dish is well executed and is both delicious and presented beautifully. I would highly recommend!', 'I celebrated my birthday at this beautiful venue and had a wonderful experience. The service was excellent. We ordered 3-4 different starters and oysters and steak as the main dish, along with a bottle of wine. The prices were reasonable, and the food was delicious. To top off the night, they brought out a lovely birthday dessert with a candle, which was a thoughtful touch. The interior was stunning. I absolutely love this place!', 'I absolutely loved the interior—stylish, comfortable, and inviting! The food was outstanding, every dish was packed with flavor. From start to finish, the service was exceptional. The staff were so warm, attentive, and genuinely friendly, which made the experience even better. And that bread they served at the beginning? Absolutely to die for—warm, fresh, and perfectly paired with the butter. A truly memorable dining experience!', 'Went with 4 friends for a birthday, it was an amazing experience. The overall atmosphere is good and the food is absolutely delicious. I ordered the lobster pasta, but the fettuccine pasta with black truffle was also delicious. The waiters are kind and the service is amazing. The only issue was the check took a long time to come. Overall though, the experience was great and this location is a must-visit.']

name: AI KI YA JAPANESE RESTAURANT
reviews:
['Lots of choices.  Hotpots are seemingly popular.   We got a platter of skewers.  Good Japanese skewers are done on banchotan but I am not sure if these are.  They came out a little dry.  The tonkasu is crispy on the outside.  But the curry sauce is not really that favorable.     The jumbo oyster is a bit on the salty side.    Overall good choice if you are looking for a quick bite with many food choices.', 'Had the best sukiyaki experience here, the cotton sukiyaki was really tasty and fresh🥰 the sushi, appetizers and rice was also on point. Will come back for more hot pot options 💕🥘 also free ice cream, clean environment and friendly staff', 'I am writing to share a very unpleasant experience my friend and I had after dining at AI KI YA on the evening of November 24th. We ordered the soy milk hot pot, beef tongue rice, and sashimi rice. While dining, we didn't feel any major discomfort, although we did notice an unusual issue with one of the mussels in the hot pot—its inside contained something resembling a hemp rope?? We brought this to the server's attention, but were told it was "normal." We decided not to eat that mussel, but continued with our meal.

After finishing the food and returning home, I began to feel bloated, nauseous, and extremely uncomfortable. By 3 a.m., I woke up feeling so unwell that I couldn't remain lying down. I messaged my friend who went to Ai Ki Ya with me, and realized she were also experiencing severe symptoms of diarrhea and vomiting, to the point that she couldn’t sleep either. The symptoms persisted into the next day, forcing both of us to purchase medication to manage them.

I am certain the food at this restaurant caused our symptoms, as neither of us ate anything before or after the meal at AI KI YA. Given that both soy products and seafood are highly prone to causing foodborne illnesses if not fresh, I strongly suspect the freshness or handling of the ingredients caused this incident.

I hope the restaurant takes this matter seriously and handles it appropriately. I have attached evidence of the medication and dining receipt below.', "I love izakayas but this one was mediocre at best. I did have this place bookmarked, so our group of five came in for dinner on a Wednesday evening at around 6ish, after our first two restaurant choices fell through. It's definitely meant for smaller groups because we were seated at a table meant for four people and it was pretty cramped. Service is lacking. Once you come in, they just dump this one large paper menu for you to fill out for the whole table, and then they never come back. We ordered a bunch of things to share:

-Snow crab roll - definitely not snow crab. Tasted canned tuna like, and there was way too much rice
-Beef tongue - this wasn't bad but it had too much sauce, which made it very salty
-Skewer set - this came with chicken thigh, chicken meatball, wagyu, veggie, and chicken skin. The thigh and meatball were pretty good. The wagyu was probably not wagyu. My favorite was the chicken skin
-Pork jowl - I enjoyed this. Usually can't go wrong with pork jowl
-Sea salt cream mentai udon - this wasn't bad but it cools down very quickly so you have to eat it fast
-Fried fish ball skewers - this was fine, nothing special. But the weird thing is that this was on a section of the menu where you have to order a minimum of five skewers. So there are some skewers where you can get single skewers, and some where you must order five. I don't get it

Overall, nothing really stood out to me to want to come back here again or tell someone they should try it. There are way better izakayas out there. Word of advice: you're in Ktown.
