Just stick to the Korean food.", 'They’ve got everything from cold and hot plates to skewers, sushi, ramen, donburi , hotpot and many more. It’s the perfect spot for lunch or dinner. Plus, the vibe is great, and the service is top-notch! Located in Midtown and close to the subway—definitely worth a visit!

Featuring:
-Soymilk Nabe
-Alaskan Snowbird roll
-Sashimi Platter

-Grilled Mackerel
-Salmon Tataki
-Beef Sirloin w.Oba & Cheese
-American Wagyu
-Beef Short Rib
-Chicken Breast & Chicken Thigh

Follow @spinx17 for more NYC food recs!']

name: RESTAURANT YUU
reviews:
['My 31 visit here. Why 31 visit, because my happiest place always give me the best experience. A Michelin restaurant accounts five universal criteria: the quality of the ingredients, the harmony of flavors, the mastery of techniques, the personality of the chef as expressed through their cuisine and, just as importantly, consistency both across the entire menu and\xa0over time.
Yuu’s quality of ingredients beyond any doubt. For example the classic Cavier brioche, I had many Cavier brioche in different restaurants, here is the best, Cavier is Petrossian, which add a burst of decadence to every crispy brioche bite. The amount of Cavier also touched me, everyone can see the pic of Cavier brioche,it’s a Cavier bomb. Compared with Quince’s Cavier brioche, the soul is sour cream + cream cheese, which makes it the best and the unique.
Talk about the flavors. I had all Yuu’s dishes since it open, never miss anyone. Menu is seasonal, but some food is so good and I cannot miss them. So I create my own menu which always add on wagyu brioche etc…someone think the amount is big? I don’t think so, every dish is a artwork for both eyes and mouth, the most important thing is delicious food won’t make you feel stuffed, some dishes I love so much: unagi risotto, truffle risotto, Gin pepper fish, the new dish crab and lobster, and always my classic fish pie.
Comes to service, thank you Annie always fullfill me all requirements, I’m not an easy person, often have some special requests like double amuse, sub some dishes to some new dishes, she never makes any mistake and every time makes sure me and my mom and my friends so satisfied and grateful. You can always see her busy in kitchen, control the deliver time control the diet restrictions, she is the best!
Not sure how many times I may come up eventually, as long as Yuu is open, I will keep coming my happiest place. For those who said ‘won’t come again because see little mistakes made’, I would say yes , please stay at home and be a potato couch, watch tv never go wrong and gives you a 100% correct experience. 🙏', "It was my second visit. I truly enjoyed the delicious food and had a good time with my friends.

My favorite is the eel and foie gras risotto. Its unique combination matched well, and I enjoyed the dish's creativity.

We also ordered the wine and sake pairing this time. The lineup was very satisfying, and the food tasted even better.

Although I visited only one month later, I noticed several menu items had already been replaced. I felt their enthusiasm for constantly pursuing evolution and offering seasonal cuisine.

I don't visit Brooklyn often, but every time I go to Restaurant Yuu, I feel it is worth the trip. Look forward to my next visit!", 'Fourth time here. I don’t remember that they served so much food before. (Perhaps more food is because they hiked the price by 20%.) This time I was so stuffed I had to skip one course and ask for a take-out container. Everything started well, especially the amuse bouche, until the Unagi (eel). It was doused with too much and too heavy a creamy foam. Immediately after this course I felt so stuffed. The palate cleanser of Crown Melon in the martini glass was very refreshing, and revived me a bit for the desserts. But even here with the palate cleanser, I had to ask them to stop and go easy on the creamy foam they put on it. Just too heavy-handed with the creams all throughout the courses. And there were a couple of plating missteps, resulting in slight imperfections in the visual presentation (by the new personnel in the staff.) The Master Chef had to come in and tried to salvage the situation as best as he can. (Yes, I saw that. That’s the thing about an open kitchen.) I think this probably might be my final time dining here.', "I had a great time dining at this restaurant.  It was named the Best New Restaurant in America by Robb Report magazine so I had to go to check it out for myself.  Besides, this was my parents' anniversary so this was a perfect opportunity to take them out to a nice dinner.
The service was impeccable, and the food was great in terms of plating, presentation and flavor.  The restaurant offers wine pairing and non-alcoholic pairing, and also very good selection of wines from various regions.
Oh, and I have to say that 2 cakes made by Takahashi Masaki given to us when we were leaving rhe restaurant were delicious.
I can definitely recommend this restaurant.", 'Chef Yuu Shimano opened his restaurant in May 2023, and received his first Michelin Star in November 2023! Yup, he really is THAT talented! They have around 18 counter seats for dining. We first visited Restaurant Yuu in March of 2024.

When it was time to start cooking, they dimmed the light for a second to get everyone’s attention, then they opened the curtain to reveal the beautiful kitchen and all the chefs. It was like a beginning of a theatre.

The menu is 15-couse Omakase only. The first four courses were amuse bouche: Ikura, Mussel, and Foie Gras on an artistic display. Then a hot soup was delivered immediately after, so we can have them together.

Next was Shima-Aji, then Pissaladière, and the seventh course was Oyster and Wagyu Tartare. Every thing thus far tasted like heaven. Every bite was exceptional!

We received a surprise from Chef Yuu, their gorgeous caviar dish. A generous amount of caviar with sour cream on brioche. It was as amazing as it looks!

Back to the course, number eight was Arctic Char, Abalone Risotto, Langoustine, Egg and Truffle with their homemade bread & butter. The food heaven continues, with every dish delivering amazing flavors.

A couple of the courses had a choice of dishes, and we chose a different ones so that we can taste them all. We got Monkfish, Cod, Veal, and Lamb. Also, their signature dish, Canard, with loads of shaved truffles. After all the savory dishes were done, I could not pick a favorite dish, as each and every dish was so fantastic!

Then two desserts to finish off the course. Pear & Yuzu, and Matcha & Strawberry. They were both incredible!

Once you are done, you can move over to the lounge area, and you receive complimentary hot tea and some petit fours. And, you even gets some desserts to take home with! How amazing is this? We had such a great time, we went back for more in June. The menu was mostly different, so we got to try so many different dishes, all amazing as expected. We will be sure to return again for more incredible dishes!!!']

name: PAISLEY
reviews:
["It's interesting that at any Michelin star or fine dining restaurant I've ever been to, if a patron dislikes a dish, the management and chef have never taken umbrage, accept the diner's experience for the truth or what it is, and typically bend over backwards to accommodate the patron.

In contrast, the middling establishments feel wounded when you actually don't like a dish (for whatever reason) and reflect that hurt back in their attitude towards you as if there is something wrong with you for not liking every single thing plated in front of you.

Our server began the evening by deciding for my daughter what drink she would like, and didn't pick up on any cue about our questions or concerns about sweet vs spice. Those mocktails, as well as my cocktail, were overly sweet; my wife finished maybe a third of hers and I stirred my ice literally a hundred times in hopes of diluting it and making it more well balanced. Our daughter reveled in the sweet though our wish was of course to not have that much sugar close to bedtime.

The appetizers and entrees we had were generally ok (samosas, tandoori lamb chop, dahl, chicken tikka masala, rajwadi paneer, naan, and jeera rice) were at best fine. The lamb chop was meagerly seasoned and overcooked, the chicken was dry and overdone as well, and the rice and naan were pedestrian. We didn't finish anything but none of that was an issue, if left at that it would have just been an unremarkable meal. Oh yeah, the tables are tiny, fine for a coffee shop but falling short for any sort of multi-dish family style meal. We migrated some items to the chair seat to make room.

Anyway, our server forgot about us for about 10-15 mins, even after our entree plates had been cleared for a while, so we flagged the manager to order a dessert for my wife and so we could get our daughter home for bed. The manager advised three of the desserts (the most popular ones) were unavailable and she encouraged my wife to order the malai kulfi, an Indian dessert, hyping up the taste. I've had good versions of this dish, this was not one apparently. My wife had literally one bite and pushed the bowl away.

Once our waiter finally returned and I mentioned my wife didn't care for the dessert and that it would be nice if he could take it off the bill, he immediately looked annoyed and said he was not sure if that was possible. Several minutes later, he returned and dropped down the bill without a word but an annoyed expression. It was the same one we saw from the manager on the way out.

Not sure what was more troublesome for them, that someone only had a bite of their self-lauded dessert and expressed dislike or that someone would ask for a few percent off a $200 dinner bill.

I don't leave bad reviews with any frequency, but the ones I have (and there is maybe one a year like this) is because of the service / treatment. And yeah, this is one of them. The 2 stars are because of the 3 star food vs the 1 star service.

They can do much better, and save yourself some time, so can you with your choice of Indian restaurant.", 'Real good experience. Food was great, cocktails also really nice.  Service was fantastic.

Highlight was the eggplant chaat and the Jaipuri kofta', 'Cozy restaurant with good food. Tried Chaat and Goat Curry; liked both. The owner came to check I liked the Goat Curry. Must try in my opinion. Definitely made fresh based on the taste. Will be back soon.', 'Excellent food and service. The dishes are expensive and portions small. Nice ambiance. The samosa chaat, chicken lollipop, peshawari Kabab, salmon tikka, makhani daal, were all very delicious.
The lacha paratha was disappointing because it seemed it was made from the same recipe as the naan but just fried.', 'Sensational restaurant with such  wonderful service and authentic Indian food. The proficient servers provided us with a marvellous experience on our special day. Fahad was an exceptional server who gave us with a wide variety of options and acclimated us to our specific needs. We had a great time and would definitely recommend this place.']

name: TROPICAL RESTAURANT 2
reviews: ['I was in the neighborhood fixing my car. Was looking somewhere to eat, four minutes from the mechanic;\nI found “Tropical Restaurant” the food was so delicious. I ordered a seafood soup and a shrimp fried rice. Oh my gosh it was so yummy.😋 affordable price, nice people, beautiful place.thank you guys for the experience.', 'The food is good. The service is mediocre and your charged 20% regardless the number of people in your party. The food items are charged separately. In addition, there is a surcharge if you charge with your credit card. I suggest you go\nelsewhere. The food is just not worth the price point of charges.', 'A lot of noise from the music, good service but the food takes a long time, regarding the food it is good but you have to improve the flavors a little more.', "Used to be one of the best, perhaps they change the cooks, I've had a fried fish that was like a cardboard, I believe they got straight from the freezer to the frier. The waitress told me that I had to pick a dish about the same price because the house won't loose a penny.  Over all 15% tips charge in the check, if they think they deserve that wonderful,  alittle too much for what I've got.", 'Traditional Ecuadorian restaurant staff is marginal a 2 at best. Location is great ease to LIE 495 highway. Portions are large they do an Automatic Tip on your bill and DO NOT Tell you. So when you then add To Go Items your now being charged a Tip or gratuity for to go food. The Spanish Speaking staff did not have enough common sense to wait on your courses if you ordered a Soup Appetizer and an Entry all 3 items came out together so your Entire not sits getting cold. name: THE INKAN RESTAURANT
reviews:
['Amazing Engagement Party at The INKAN!

I recently hosted my engagement party at The INKAN, and it was an unforgettable experience! The food was absolutely delicious—our guests couldn’t stop raving about the Peruvian-style ribs, vegetarian chaufa, and the mouthwatering rotisserie chicken. The Peruvian sauce was, without a doubt, the most flavorful sauce I’ve ever tasted, and my entire family loved it!

We had around 50 people at the party, and the venue was beautifully decorated, including a lovely backyard area. The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, the owner and the servers were super attentive during the whole party and made the experience that much better.  I would highly recommend coming here for delicious food and drinks (must try the sangria, although all drinks were good!), or even hosting a party.

If you’re looking for an authentic Peruvian dining experience with exceptional service, I highly recommend The INKAN—it’s the perfect spot for any celebration!', 'We’re new to the neighborhood and we love The Inkan!  Their green sauce is to diiiiiieeee for.  If you do not know, now you know.  Try it.  It is one of the best green sauces ever, put it on everything, especially their well seasoned rotisserie chicken. We also tried Chicken chicharrón y ceviche LIC, it was amazing! Their owner and staff are friendly and easygoing. Highly recommend this place!', 'Peruvian is one of my favorite cuisines and I loved this place. Everything i ordered was delicious and the service was amazing. Will definitely be back!

Highly recommend the ceviche, so fresh and tasty👌🏽', 'Went here on a weeknight and it was rather quiet and empty. The food portion was rather large but the taste and quality is ok. Price-wise there is better elsewhere.

The sweet plantains were good though!', 'The female bartender tonight was really accommodating and nice. However, the woman who was training her or at least commenting on everything she was doing, is only nice to white and spanish people. Don’t bother wasting money here if you are not either of those races and want to be treated courteously.']

name: LUGO'S RESTAURANT & LOUNGE
reviews:
['A Home Run of flavor I just devoured at Lugo's Restaurant & Lounge, and I'm still reeling from the culinary hat trick. This dish is the MVP of my food here - succulent shrimp, indulgent lobster, and tender skirt steak join forces to create a flavor trifecta that will leave you screaming 'Triple Crown!'

The shrimp was so juicy, it practically swam onto my fork. The lobster? Butter-tender and begging to be devoured. And don't even get me started on the skirt steak - cooked to perfection and practically singing 'Take Me Out to the Ball Game' with every bite.

Lugo's Triple Play is a grand slam of flavors, a culinary World Series champion. If you haven't tried it yet, drop everything and get to Lugo's - your taste buds will thank you. Five stars, ten stars, a million stars - this dish is the real MVP."', 'I love it here so much. Never had one bad thing from there. The food is amazing, good portions and great prices. The ladies that work there are so nice and helpful even though I don’t speak Spanish. Love coming here. Hope they stay around for good!!', "I've ordered from this place three times: twice for the grilled snapper and once for the pork chops. The food is always very fresh, and the passion fruit juice is delightful! I've always ordered through Uber eats. Not sure about the atmosphere and the service.", 'Very overpriced, dull aesthetics, looks like a diner not a restaurant, less than a diner, food is decent, definitely not great, they have natural juices, at least the passionfruit, you have to get up to the counter to order but they ask you to tip just for bringing food to the table?, plastic disposable cutlery? 😨', 'I recently dined at this amazing Dominican restaurant, and it was a fantastic experience from start to finish! The beans were incredibly creamy and delicious, adding a perfect touch to every dish. All the food was bursting with flavor and authenticity, and I could tell it was prepared with fresh, high-quality ingredients. Every visit here is a delight, as the food is consistently fresh and mouthwateringly good. Highly recommend this gem for anyone looking to enjoy some truly delicious Dominican cuisine! Five stars!']

name: LOS PRIMOS

I am so disappointed.  I ordered plaintain and I received (3) soft overcooked ones.  Really disappointed in my rice meal.", 'Stopped in because we saw potato balls on the sign out front as we were walking by and they did not disappoint! The food here is tasty and great prices', 'Their mondongo soup is pretty good 😌 would order again', 'The place is not what it used to be.  I remember when the food was fabulous and the place looked better. The atmosphere was bland.']

name: EL MARIACHI RESTAURANT
reviews:
['Good taco and friendly wait staff with nice service!', 'Truly an underrated Mexican restaurant - delicious flavors, fresh fish, juicy meats, and big portions! The service is also always very friendly and helpful. Highly recommend!!!', 'This restaurant has been around for about 25 years and it’s still going strong. The service was absolutely amazing and the food is to die for! Whenever I enter this restaurant I am always greeted with a friendly smile and a table of my choosing. There’s also plenty of food options so you never get bored. Personally, I consider it to be the best Mexican restaurant I’ve ever been to.', '🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

“A Flavorful Fiesta at El Mariachi!”

El Mariachi is an absolute gem! Located at 33-11 Broadway in Astoria, this restaurant brings the vibrant flavors of Mexico right to your plate. 🇲🇽

🌮Whether you’re craving tacos, burritos, or enchiladas, El Mariachi delivers. Their menu features mouthwatering dishes made with fresh ingredients and traditional recipes. The Al Pastor tacos and chicken soup are particularly delightful.

🍹 Refreshing Beverages:

Don’t miss out on their Aguas Frescas – they’re a perfect match for your meal. And if you’re a soda lover, try the Mexican sodas – they’re fizzy and fantastic!

👨‍👩‍👦‍👦 Welcoming Atmosphere:

El Mariachi’s lively ambiance makes it a great spot for family gatherings or a night out with friends. The service is generally excellent, and the portions are generous.

🌟 Customer Favorites:

Nachos Texanos: Loaded with beans, guacamole, cheese, onions, cilantro, and sour cream – a crowd-pleaser!

Huevos a la Mexicana: Scrambled eggs with tomato, onion, and jalapeno peppers – a breakfast winner.

Quesadillas De La Casa: A cheesy delight that’ll leave you wanting more.🎉

Verdict: El Mariachi is simply outstanding. The food quality, portions, and friendly service make it a must-visit. 🎉

So, if you’re in Queens and craving authentic Mexican cuisine, head over to El Mariachi. You won’t be disappointed! 🌮🎶

Enjoy your culinary adventure at El Mariachi! 🌮🎉1', 'This is our go to Mexican spot, we’ve ordered so much from here and there hasn’t been anything I haven’t liked. My favorites are the mushroom quesadilla, their enchiladas, their guacamole oh and their fajitas are so delicious.']

name: GRAND CANYON RESTAURANT CITY
reviews:
['My wife and I stopped in after our appointment that we had to go to today as we were very hungry. After perusing the wide selections that the menu offers, we made our selection and patiently waited. They brought us our smoothies which were very delightful tasty and overall smooth and delicious. As we were chatting and drinking our smoothies our main course (My choice was Mexican Wrap in a while wheat wrap. My wife chose for her wrap the ( California Wrap ). Both of our choices were very delicious and fulfilling. The chef/cook put everything together just right. I highly, highly recommend this restaurant to anyone and everyone passing through Manhattan, or living here in Manhattan either way this is the place to be. I can definitely see my wife and I coming back here numerous times in the future to try some of the other stuff that we did not have a chance to try today. I hope everyone who sees this takes the opportunity to stop in and have a delightful lunch, dinner or breakfast depending on what their palate is desiring.', 'I highly recommend this restaurant. It’s a pleasant dinning location, great food, nice staff and on point service.

The food was absolutely delicious. Our server, Gonzalo, was incredibly attentive and made excellent recommendations. The ambiance was perfect.', 'Been passing by for more than a year and today I walked in. What an amazing find and food was on point! Absolutely will be back again and service was on point as well! Check it out!', 'Really good food and service. 3pm - 8pm daily happy hour is a hit, too.

Was initially skeptic given how few people are here, but found out it’s because they are new. A solid go to place in the neighborhood', 'Really awesome food. Authentic Mexican food and great omelette. Definitely need to come here. Prices are excellent also. Big portions.']

name: BOISHAKHI RESTAURANT ASTORIA
reviews:
['Boishakhi Restaurant in Astoria offers a delightful experience with its authentic Bangladeshi flavors and fully halal menu. The food is incredibly tasty, capturing the true essence of Bangladeshi cuisine. My initial order of fried rice, noodles, tandoori chicken, and lollipop chicken was so good that I couldn’t resist ordering more—beef Bihari kabab and large tandoori chicken from the display. For takeout, I chose polao, rezala, bharta, and doi, and each dish was perfectly prepared. A must-try is their cha, which is rich and flavorful.

The service at Boishakhi is exceptional, with staff being quick, polite, and attentive. The upstairs dining area is cozy, providing an intimate atmosphere, while the downstairs space is more open and accommodating for larger groups. Regardless of where you sit, the ambiance is warm and welcoming, making it an excellent spot for both casual dining and family gatherings.

Hygiene and cleanliness are well-maintained, including their bathrooms, which are spotless and convenient. Boishakhi Restaurant has become one of our favorites for its consistently delicious food and excellent service. It’s a must-visit for anyone seeking authentic Bangladeshi cuisine in Astoria.', "This is my family's favorite Bengali restaurant! Whether it's simple takeout or catering orders, they always do a fantastic job. Their prices are very reasonable and the quality of the food is outstanding. I know there are other Bengali restaurants in Queens like in Jackson Heights or Jamaica, but trust me this spot is the best out of all of them. Can't recommend them enough for all that they do to maintain quality and service!!", 'Went here for lunch and got half beef Bihari Kabab for $10 - honestly it was below standard I give it a 2/5 stars. The naan was just like dough and a little uncooked so 1.5/5 stars. The worst was the liver Singara it was days old liver, tastes double fried 0/5. Overall this store has declined in food quality and standards. If you are management you need to fix this!', 'If you’re an Indian Bengali or Bangladeshi this is your place to enjoy and savor the best food in city. We had an amazing experience and definitely going back there soon.', 'Authentic Bangladesh cuisine. The taste is soo good. It is a very busy restaurant and that’s why the food is always fresh.']

name: TROPICAL RESTAURANT 4
reviews:
['I’ve been Tropical 1 twice before (a friends bday dinner and my own bday dinner party in ‘22) love it ! All of it
Authentic delicious Ecuadorian food nd Colombian
You won’t regretted.
Party in the wknd. Lots of fun', 'First time at this location, we went for dinner.
Food is good. It is authentic Ecuadorian (coast side of the country type)
Prices are OK.
Portions are good.
Service is good.
Place needs to update, clean and sanitize. Fabric seats have to be replace, tables needs to be better clean. Bathroom needs cleaning and to have everything in working order.
PLUS ➕  each table has a hand sanitizer bottle, I thought it was nice.
Music is way too much of loudness.
Tip is already included in the check.', 'Good neighborhood restaurant.  The restaurant is cute with outdoor seating.  The food is Ecuadorian and there are also some Colombian dishes.  The have a national dish named Guatita which is very good here.  It consists of tripe and potatoes cut into small pieces and in a peanut sauce.  It is accompanied by rice and fried plantains.  They food comes with sides and the portions are big.  The service is good and so are the prices.  This neighborhood restaurant is worth checking out at least once.', 'The food is excellent and the price is affordable.  BUT the waitress they think that can play people around with money charging tips twice. I was never given my detail recipe and then she approached with the card machine and said 68.11 would you like to leave a tip and I said yes of course. She never mentioned that the 68.11 was already included a 15% service. Out of no where I ended getting a receipts for 82 dollars … I wonder why. So I requested the detail receipts and I saw the service was already included and was never mentioned, this is actions just turn me crazy. STOP PLAYING AND FOOLING PEOPLE AROUND. The service qas ok but not for a 25 dollars  without my consent ..', 'The best Ecuadorian food in NY. Ruben who is the manager of the restaurant is a very nice person. Food, service and prices are excellent. Congratulations to the owner for the excellent person in charge that he has in this location. I’ll be back always. Highly recommended!']

name: SAMMUK THAI RESTAURANT
reviews:
['I feel the need to check this place out and I’m glad I did! It’s a hidden gem around woodside area. I ordered Som Tum Plara and  a “Yum” dish which consists of mixed yummy things (let’s say shrimp, squid,  sausages, thai pork loaf or “Moo Yor”, and salted egg yolk), both medium spicy. I could say that these are one of the best Som Tum and Yum I’ve ever had. You could find many restaurants that carry out the delicious “Som Tum” dish. But for the “Yum”, I could say that only Sammuk could offer you the authentic bold flavors like you have in Thailand, even better than most of  restaurants in Thailand. I’m a Thai and I know how Thai food should taste like. My husband cannot handle much of the heat so he ordered “Yen Ta Fo” which was also good. We also had coconut ice cream for desserts and ordered “Hoy Jor” for take out. Service was excellent. Server was attentive. The restaurant uses the quality drink and dinner wares. Good vibes with neat decorations.', 'A great little spot to get a quick bite or to come eat with your family. I went for late dinner on a Thursday and had a great experience.
-Crispy Pork Belly 1000/10
-Mango Salad 1000/10
-Fried Vanilla Ice cream 1000/10

I also had spicy margarita during Happy Hour. It’s great to find a place that has happy hour past 6pm. I will definitely be coming back!', 'Ambiance and service were great. We ordered a Thai Pink Milk smoothie, Hoy Jor, Crispy Pork, Leng Zap, and Crab Noodle. Nice little Thai spot in Woodside/Jackson Heights serving some very authentic dishes.

Hoy Jor - Deep fried pork and crab meat in a tofu skin. Really enjoyed this since it was very tender and packed with a decent amount of crab meat. Dipping sauce was a little sweet and tangy.

Crispy Pork - Super crispy, crunchy pork belly. Dipping sauce was salty, tangy/sour. Great appetizer as well.

Leng Zap - Pork bone soup. A literal mountain of tender pork spine in a very flavorful soup. We got ours with mild spice and it still had a kick to it so be mindful of Thai spiciness! The soup is very sour and bold in flavor. They give you some plastic gloves to help with pulling apart the meat and there is definitely plenty of meat. Extremely tender and fall of the both. Some parts you have to really dig out but worth it. Feeds 2-3 people for sure.

Crab noodle - Noodles with chunks of crab meat, seasoning, peanuts, boy choy, bean sprouts, and a lime. Mix together to get a nice noodle with light crab flavoring, very nice dish as well.', "💎 Love this hidden gem 💎

Amazing authentic Thai fare and the kindest staff.

I've eaten here a few times and it's always so so good. High quality seafood options with the perfect amount of spice and flavor. Excellent value for the price.

I usually try to keep my favorite spots a secret so they don't get swarmed and impossible to get a table at, but every time I go, they only have a few tables, and I NEED them to stay in business so I can keep eating those fat oysters 🦪 Definitely add it to your must-try Thai list!", 'One of the best authentic Thai restaurants in town. Tom yum soup noodles are so delicious! Coconut milkshake is soooooo good. 10 out of 10 points.']

name: I LOVE PARAGUAY RESTAURANT
reviews: ['This was my first time trying Paraguayan food though I do love a good empanada and they offer an assortment of local varieties here. Started off though with a chips gauzu and it was so good - a wonderful cakey combo of fresh corn and cheese. Then came an assortment of empanadas - nicely presented with little stamps on the parchment to indicate which was which. Nice touch! They were all good though I’d say the cheese and hearts of palm was my favorite. Service was friendly and the place has a nice homey vibe. I look forward to coming back and trying more.', 'I highly recommend this beautiful and amazing restaurant to all of my friends. I cannot stop raving about how delicious and authentic their food is! It is top on my list of favorite restaurants of all time that I have been to and have tried so many! This place never disappoints and the food is beyond incredible! A must try! Not only is the food great but the atmosphere takes me to another place where I don’t even feel like I am in NyC anymore but like I stepped into a quaint little shop in Paraguay, it’s like going on a mini vacation! The decor is so cute and peaceful and they always have nice music to set the mood. The service is always friendly and very accommodating. Really I could not ask for more! Thank you, I love Paraguay!!! My family and I love you! ❤️', 'Interesting food and restaurant. There is a guy with a harp serenading random tables which is a unique experience. The meats and cheesy bread are all pretty solid picks. Great restaurant for a bunch of hungey diners.', 'The restaurant is very cozy, with a warm and friendly atmosphere. I ordered the chicken milanesa napolitana with a side of white rice, in addition to the mashed potatoes that come with it. Everything was delicious and well-prepared.', 'It was awesome! Lovely place, nice service and love the atmosphere with the jazz music in the background. I haven’t eat alfajores for a long time so finally try some here, the size is pretty big and was delicious. We got a traditional combo, a delicious soup for the day and the rice with meat which I expected the sauce to be more thinner, but still delicious.']

name: GOLDEN KRUST CARIBBEAN RESTAURANT
reviews: ['This place must have a new chef who does not know how to cook. Today is 06/29/2024. I bought a plate of Jerk Chicken and cabbage yesterday, it was tasteless. Today I returned and complained about the poor quality of food. I placed another order of Chicken and cabbage, the chef herself serves me some types of chicken without the jerk seasoning. I tried to talk with the owner without success.\nLess people from my work want to order from this store. Look at the pictures 😔.', 'Probably one of the worst Golden Krust in Brooklyn. The staff is just blah and walk around with AirPods in their ears. I said “Good Morning” to the young lady in there and she just looked at me and kept on walking. Not very friendly. The inside seems very dark and dingy. That Patties were good, I asked for separate bags and of course the guy put them in one bag. They also require a $10 minimum purchase to use any type of cashless payments', "I ordered a plate of oxtails for $21.00 because they're very tasty. However, the female cashier gave me the same amount of oxtails as her edges...NONE! She took my plate to the back as I asked the could I see the plate because I didn't want bare bones. She opened the lid with such attitude which I ignored. I asked for more meat she was even more nastier and scooped only gravy. This isn't the first time I've been here and the guy hires these nasty attitude unprofessional females. Look at this plate... 8 cups of rice...  and barely any oxtails. If customers are willing to pay. Give them their money's worth. These tiny little pieces with a mountain of rice. The owner will continue to lose business with these type of unprofessional workers. It's very unwelcoming considering the food being one of the best in the neighborhood. To the owner step your game up. Hire someone who enjoys being there and who's nice to customers. Your food is amazing!!!! But customers aren't happy with the workers they're damaging the environment & reputation of your restaurant.", 'Just bought two patties. The crust was thick and no meat. . The patty was very hard. Server if you mad with yourself don’t take it out on others. Please serve with love and stop serving mediocre food. Because I strongly believe there was better patty to serve. Change the server she too ruff and aggressive.', 'Probably the worst golden krust in brooklyn. Just had 2 parties. Hard coco bread, hard and cold patties. And you must spend 10 dollars to use a card. Even if it’s 50 cent below.  Last time going!!']

name: FIESTA MEXICANA RESTAURANT
reviews:
['I always try to avoid certain restaurants because of my experience when I was a child. This is one of them. I remember I came into a different restaurant at 12 years old and they took a glance at me and walked away for 20 minutes. I stood there with no menu or anything for that time as if they didn’t want me there. I’m yellow in a Spanish area and  I was never concerned about my race. But this was the first time I felt hate from another minority group for no apparent reason. This service here gave me the reminisce of the past I never want to be reminded. The food was good because the meat I chose for every taco had flavor. Sometimes the chicken is usually very bland. The food took a while but that wasn’t my main concern. If it was the food I would say 3 to 4 out of 5. I ordered a side of rice and beans and from the menu there was no cheese on top of the beans. Dairy being one of the top 10 allergies, it should be the restaurants main concern to switch it out because I can’t consume it.  The beans had cheese on top of it and I told the waitress I can’t eat any dairy. She told me to take it out of the beans or if I need it switched they will charge me. This got me furious.
On top of that, they forced us to pay a tip of 15% mandatory. Definitely need to change the service snd possible this restaurant.
This location has been replaced many times before and prior there was an amazing seafood restaurant. Hope the service gets betters', "The food was good, but I didn't like how when I asked them to split the bill, they asked me what tip to leave on their POS system.  Normally, the POS device would let us select the tip, as with every other restaurant, but when they asked us for the tip, they also asked how the tip should be calculated.  I told them in Spanish to add 20% from each half, not from the total check.  They still charged us tip from the total amount instead from each half of the check.  If they don't follow your request in either English and Spanish, then they're playing ignorant just to squeeze as much money from you.  No wonder that place was empty.", 'As soon as I walked I was greeted with the vibe of friendliness, Mexican vibes. The decorations were really pretty. I had a good customer service with a kind waitress. Overall the food was terrific!', 'Kinda loud but food was good! Mango smoothie was actually really good, not too sweet nor too bland and it comes in a big container. Serving size was good too. They play classics or whatever you’d want them to, just have to write it down on the sticky note they give ya. You can request either to do karaoke or just hear the song itself.', 'Food was okay, very overpriced. They automatically charge you a 15% SERVICE fee.   Even when it’s a small group.

A one time thing.']

name: GOLDEN KRUST CARIBBEAN RESTAURANT
reviews:
["The experience here is okay, but the food is disgusting. I have no idea how people eat this food. I think it's because of the area. I ordwe from this place few times, and everytime I say I won't go back, I try again because I want to think it's a few off days. I have had them even return items because it was so nasty.

But when I tell you the food is disgusting, this is no over exaggeration. Their dumplings taste like overnight over used dumplings that was sitting in water for hours. Thier stew peas is always nasty, and the kidney, oh lord, don't even attempt to buy this. The owner needs to really do something about this restaurant. Please Golden Krust, do better! Change the chef, do something. This review is coming from a good place. I live near the area, and I'm extremely disappointed with the food quality!", 'First ..i ordered pepper steak only to receive a phone call 30 mins later..sayin it would be substituted with something else .p(see picture)it smelled like funky feet seriously', 'The food was nasty I spent over 21 dollars for a burnt beef patty & hard rice and peas it was either uncooked or burnt , the oxtails was ok i guess but never again it’s not like the old times', "This golden krust is ok only for beef patties and even those are now tasting not fresh at all and the person at the register was rude and didn't seem to care either.
The food use to be very good but the order I purchased was to salty and the peas and rice was very dry and the pieces of chicken they gave me was mostly nothing but bones with a  very little bit of gravy!!😡😠
I paid good money for a poor dinner.  I will go to the golden krust on utica ave from now on!!!", "The food is probably the best Caribbean restaurant there is. At first the food taste great. But try not to eat it every day or you might lose interest in taste,(like any other food restaurant). But the quality and texture of the oxtail is preferably satisfying,  seriously!. And the sauce is so rich poured over the brown rice. I really like it. The cabbage is actually good. It's a little expensive for a small plate. But trust me every penny is worth it. They got basically every type of Caribbean meal you can think of, especially beef patties. Give it a try you won't be disappointed."]

name: MI PEQUEÑO RESTAURANT
reviews:
['i now LOVE mexican food thanx to this place. tried ranchero, quesadillas and other vegetarian lunch and dinner options and all taste way sophisticated and yummy. ask em to make it spicy if you wanna sweat. haven’t tried any meat made food though. hats off to chef in the kitchen and sweet lady on counter. “i can eat here everyday”', "We got a torta loca and the cheese enchiladas in green sauce, comes with rice and beans. Size was enough for leftovers! both great options. Highly recommend, lady behind the counter is also very pleasant. Will definitely be returning! The space is more bar vibes, but just get take out if it's not your vibe.", 'Just stopped in during our visit to Bushwick and loved the food. I believe his name was Gray, provided great service.  Highly recommend the enchiladas.', 'Affordable breakfast, super kind and courteous staff, we ordered chilaquiles and a breakfast burrito!

Gracias por comida riquísima', "Caro y malo!
I'm not coming back!  Overpriced, such tiny portions and really salty food . It was uneatable.
And when I say overpriced is overpriced at least the dish that I got. I could eat a lot more and better food with that same price somewhere else. Or I dont know if they just wanted to take advantage of me.. but I was in shock for the price and the food that I got. There are definitely better Mexican restaurants in the area. Don't waste your time or your money here."]

name: THE GREEN PLACE
reviews: ['The Green Place is a cozy and inviting African restaurant with a warm and welcoming atmosphere.The service is friendly and attentive, and the prices are reasonable. I especially enjoyed the jollof rice and spicy goat stew with mixed meat. Overall, a great place to experience African cuisine in a relaxed setting. I highly recommend trying it out!', 'The only con about this place is that it’s cash only. But the food made up for that. We got the egusi with poundo and rice with buka stew/ayamase. Everything was 10/10. And the portions were huge! Keep in mind that it’s a very tiny space with only 4-5 tables; so not ideal for a big group. But I’ll definitely be back.', 'My Nigerian boyfriend and I always come here for their egussi and Efo riro. The flavors are simply amazing. We have also tried their jollof but it’s not our favorite as it’s a bit too smoky for us. They also only take cash which is inconvenient. Overall, I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone who loves flavor in their food.', "Egusi with Goat Meat, Pounded Yam and Jolloff Rice.  Everything was delicious and just enough spice. I definitely recommend giving this place a try if you haven't and your looking for some great West African food. Loved it!", 'I got fufu & the okra soup. There was a lot of beef fat in it. The soup was good not too much spice just enough. The fufu paired really well it. Not much meat in it. Brill be going again to try other dishes']

name: NO. 1 CHINESE RESTAURANT
reviews: ['Best spot for chicken broccoli. Before it used to be long spring garden but the owner was never there and quality dropped. This is the new new', "The food is very good and delicious, but the young girl that is there, especially on Sunday's so miserable and nasty. She's very rude I wish I knew who the owner is to complain directly", 'i ordered shrimp w/ brocolli pork fried rice egg drop soup lunch special for 8 bucks. The food was tasty, presentable, and quick.\n\nI will come to this place again to try other items.', 'OMG!! I am so much pssssst of the delivery guy I ask him very nicely and it took him less than a minute to deliver my food and it seems that he’s angry at me because I only ask him if does he need a change and then suddenly he gets angry at me and once he arrive and gave him a very good tip he shut his mouth . I hope you guys train your employees a good manners and respect eventhough there’s a language barrier but please be nice and don’t be rude . We pay delivery fee and your rude to us? After you get the tips you shut your mouth? What a good employee. You’re not worth to get a tips from other people if your people don’t have a manners. Terrible experience!!!!! Never order here again!!!', 'The food tastes great and is always fresh.']

name: WAKKYS AFRICAN RESTAURANT
reviews:
['I always order from this spot and today they really disappointed me. I ordered $90.21 through door dash and received nonsense. I ordered 1 okra soup with goat meat, 1 okra soup with mixed meat, goat pepper soup, and efo.

The order was placed at at 2:03pm and the ETA was 3:12 - 3:27. My first assigned driver had to wait for over 30 minutes and I called the restaurant at 3:25pm to check in. I was told the order just needed 5 more minutes. My first driver got tired of waiting (rightfully so) and I was then assigned a new driver. The order ended up going out at 3:51pm. That is crazy from the original ETA. Almost 2 hours!

It doesn’t end there. The first order is of okra with goat meat had ONE PIECE OF GOAT MEAT, 2 pieces of shaki, and what looks like snails? I’m honestly not sure but who asked for that? The second order of okra soup and mixed meat was just full of bones. The efo only had 1 piece of meat, 1 cow foot full of bone, and 2 pieces of small ponmo. And then to top it off, the goat pepper soup wasn’t even filled all the way. For $23 EACH? that is just insane. As if I’m giving away money for free.

Very bad experience and I’m so disappointed. It’s one thing to wait for 2 hours but to wait and then receive rubbish? I’m not even hungry anymore. I won’t be placing an order for a long time.

I advise everyone to proceed with caution or just order in person and throughly check your food. It’s very unfair to give nonsense to paying customers just because it’s delivery. We’re all still paying customers.', 'Every thing is a 5 star! I came from Boston and wanted to try authentic African food, I was very hesitant at first over the phone conversation but then when I went in the atmosphere was very different. Staff was welcoming friendly and helped me pick out what she thought I would like. And I am very satisfied the food is DELICIOUS. This will be a stop for me each time I’m in New York. Definitely worth the purchase and pricing was very reasonable!', 'The delivery guy provided prompt and polite service. The food was fresh and delicious. Authentic African food. I loved it', 'I've been in and out of this neighborhood plenty of times , sheesh I even worked at the local PCT and never saw this place. Had it not been for a buddy of mine It would still go unnoticed. It sits nearest the last last house on St. marks corner of Utica Ave in BKLYN. There is nothing pretty nor inviting about the outer appearance and sadly to say the same for the inside. The place is very small and the immediate seating area upon entering is usually cluttered with closed together chairs and papers on the tables. Judging from my statement as to usually tells you I have been here more than twice. After you enter if you look to the right there is a cut out about the size of a nook. It holds about 4 small tables and chairs, the mini bar is too the left of the entrance. The place is very untidy. I was a bit scared to eat here at first but my friend has been sick so... I was taken back when I saw the small kitchen. Unbelievably it held 3 employees. Had it not been the size difference of them all small med and large they would not have fit... LOL sounds funny but I am serious!The kitchen is not well kept but the board of health has not been here yet I guess since the openings. I don't see a NYC rating either. 🤔 Hmm. Oh well on to the food The first time I had a delicious fish soup nice and pepper like I like my food. If you like hot 🔥 here it is In This lil hole "The wall"🧱 Try it is all I have to say make sure you get the right fufu. I came back with my best friend who is from Nigeria because he didn't believe my taste buds until he tried it himself. I treated him to Seafood okra. You would think he hadn't eaten for years the way he gulped it down and looking into my plate. I admit it was good. But I don't thinthey serve this often . At the cost of $25 it was overpriced but delicious. The last time I went back I was sadly disappointed. I was hoping the rubbish I saw at the door and the untidy area would be cleaned up but I will have to at this just how they keep it. Very sad. Although I enjoyed the food I will not return because the surrounding makes a difference as to what goes into your food. If the kitchen is messy and it is then the food is not at its best even if it tastes good. Sorry guys. "Cleanliness is next to Godliness." All eateries should come from a clean surroundings.', 'One of the best food I have ever eaten ,had Pounded Yam and Egusi with Assorted meat .']

name: CARRIZAL RESTAURANT
reviews: ['Affordable Spanish food on Gates Ave in Bushwick. Miguelina is bilingual, professional and pretty.', "I wouldn't eat there again. Nothing was fresh and we went at 5pm.", 'Nasty to be honest spent 30$ on food to throw away smh', 'It’s great food and they really keep it clean throughout the whole day. Don’t forget to TIP when you can. Good price and fast service', "Food is delicious but the server don't know how to serve they will serve you no meat with soup or old dried perniel watch them when they serve you"]

name: PIERRE LOTI MEDITERRANEAN RESTAURANT
reviews:
['Wonderful restaurant! The staff was super accommodating and friendly -- making our dinner experience very pleasant. I especially liked the tuna tartar with pineapple, the delicious buttery artichokes, and the perfect cheese plates. They also had great margaritas and a nice red wine selection. Will definitely go again.', 'Sadly this place didn’t live upto the expectations. We were invited here by two good friends who live in the city and had come here a month earlier.

Firstly, we felt totally ignored by the waiting staff throughout the evening. Starters arriving without the bread, warm dishes cold.

The mains weren’t any better, cold lamb chops, lacked flavour and frankly have had better

Overall it made for a poor evening.', 'We ordered Zucchini pancake , Eggplant Caviar , Lamb , Branzino .
Service was very kind and Everything was perfect.
Except Lamb Chop came out too undercooked. but they cook it again and bring it to us when we asked for it.
I loved they have port-wines too !
Good for special night as well.
Highly recommend', 'Enjoyed an incredible dinner at Pierre Loti! Beautiful Turkish/Mediterranean flavors in every dish- they even had Turkish wine! Food was so on point- I highly recommend the tandir and all the mezes! Atmosphere was so welcoming and lovely- our server, Erdi, was fantastic! He was so knowledgeable and kind- really adding to a beautiful night. Thank you! We will definitely be back!', 'The food is good, my lamb chops were tender but a bit salty. The menu is short and they only have one dessert. The service is good and friendly.']

name: LA CANOA
reviews: ["Excellent quality service, incredible awesome food, I'm still full of last time I ate there. Delicious.", 'Food tastes ok, but is kind of expensive, and the main reason why I gave one star is because I once went there, asked for an order to take out and had to wait, believe it or not, 47 minutes to be served, literally! They only gave me a soda for free, and said “sorry for the delay” with an indifferent tone of voice. Neverrrr again!', "Always one of my favorite go to places to go to when in Brooklyn. Food portions are more than plenty, always tastes great. If you're looking for an authentic Ecuadorian meal, you're at the right place.", "Good food if you like to wait 1 to 2 hours. Bad service from waitress, waited more than 10 mis to be asked if I want a drink, I asked for a soda they brought my soda and a straw after I asked for a cup with ice.. not even full to consider the bad service only 4 other tables here it's empty", "Bad service. Overpriced bottle $110 for a Jack Daniels and it's not even a club. On top of that the included their tip that they didn't deserve."]

name: AMBATEÑO RESTAURANT
reviews: ['I was visiting a friend and ask me if I was hungry and recommended this restaurant It is clean good music not very loud.\nWe had Encebollado and Papas Fritas: both excellent flavor, they really taste as I remembered them', 'Food is very mediocre. However their prices are usually good. So if you were looking for a cheap dinner, it was always worth it. Will not be coming back!', 'Very tasty food', '👎 👎 down...', 'I recommend this place for the friendliness, the homemade cuisine with a lot of love and high quality of its products and the clean and impeccable premises. Very good price. WONDERFUL ♥️♥️♥️']

name: RIZE BROOKLYN TAKEOUT RESTAURANT
reviews: ['The food is absolutely amazing!! Nias service, along with the staffs attention to detail, the seasoning of the food, my fiancé and I can’t stop coming back!! We are so happy to have found a place that has flavor, but isn’t overly salted and still has soul in the food!', 'Was great food and nice chill vibes.  Our bartender name was Xena. She was very kind and made sure we were good the entire time!\nDj was also on point!', 'A great vibe, I had a great time at Rize. Rachel made some amazinh drinks and their shot special was perfect for getting the night in the right direction!', 'Kool spot to chill after work..nice service wings are great and fries are too..the bartenders are kool and make awesome drinks..folks need to get at the place a check it out', 'The food here is amazing they have the best happy hour deals hands down.  Great place to relax with some friends dj plays the classic r&b grown and sexy. Customer service is excellent. Bartenders are attentive and friendly. I highly highly recommend.. Try the wings they are the best 👌🏾']

name: TREADZ VYBZ JAMAICAN RESTAURANT
reviews: ['I visited this place late at night, just before closing, and experienced the worst customer service I could have imagined. The young woman at the counter seemed visibly irritated that I wanted to place an order so late. She reluctantly prepared my order, and when I asked for a drink, her response was filled with attitude. As I left, I wished her a good night, only to receive a dismissive "yeah" in return. When I got home, I was shocked by how bad the food was. The mac and cheese had a layer of cheese on top, but the bottom was just dry, baked noodles. I\'ll never eat here again—this experience wasn’t worth the hassle, and no customer should ever be treated like that.', "It is a combined store where they feel food.\nI arrived at the moon, and they didn't head many selections.\nThey serve very small on portion, and meat was very dry.", 'Stopped by this place randomly yesterday with my brother,Friendly staff and the food was packed with flavor!! One of the best beef patties 8 have had in awhile as well. Jerk chicken and stew shrimp are highly recommended.', 'I ordered 1 large curry chicken plate, 1 small jerk  chicken plate and 2 beef patties.  The jerk chicken plate was good. The large curry chicken plate was horrible, I received more rice than curry chicken. I ordered 2 beef patties ans one was substituted with a chicken pattie, which was horrible. I will never frequent again.', "I ORDER FROM DOORDASH AND THIS WAS THE WORST FOOD I'VE EVER HAD... NEVER AGAIN 😡😡😡😡😡"]

name: POP’S COCINA & BAR
reviews:
["This place is beautiful. The atmosphere was peaceful and cozy. I had breakfast with my sister on a rainy day and it was so nice. The food was perfectly cooked and coffee was so good we had two cup's.😬 The check was less than $40!! We went back for dinner the same day and just like breakfast they did not disappoint. The food was really good, flavorful and filling. I will definitely be coming back!", "My sister took me here for my birthday; one of the best places for brunch no doubt. The food was really really good. The drinks were strong. The proportions were good enough and prices appropriate. The customer service needs some help, we had two waitresses due to lack of communication and we still had to wait for minor things such as napkins and gravy for the mash potatoes, but they were both amazing so I find no need to deduct stars for that. I'd definitely go back", "So I walked into Pop's on Jamaica Avenue in Woodhaven the other day And much has changed.

Been coming here for almost 20 years but haven't been here for a few.

Sadly they've removed a lot of the beautiful wood although some remains. The old fountain counter is gone, As are the booths and other seating to be replaced by elegant tables And a bar.

I have to say it makes a cute little restaurant, although I do miss the old Pop's.

The food was good. This is no greasy spoon. It's a step above diner food, but with the ambience of a somewhat classy restaurant.

The new Pop's is a nice place for couples or families to dine; or to dine alone - as I was.", 'The place is nice, the service is good the employees are friendly. The only bad thing is that sometimes the food takes a little longer than normal but I recommend the place. It has good food at good prices.

La comida es 10/10 el servicio es 10/10 y los precios son muy accesibles… lo remiendo', 'I enjoyed my dinner here. I took myself out Saturday afternoon around 5 pm , it was not busy , the staff were pretty quick and friendly. I am not fluent in Spanish but the waitresses got my order correct and understood what I wanted. I ordered an appetizer, with a Salad , and two margaritas. Everything was good !']

name: BAROSA
reviews:
['October 14, 2024 food was delicious. The butternut squash raviolis were really good. This is one of my favorite restaurants to come to when I’m in Queens.', 'Fresh tasting, very flavorful delicious food. Had the skirt steak and their appetizer specials, beets salad, figs with prosciutto. Also italian standards like baked clams and calamari
Great service and attention.', 'came here after my run in the evening and the place was bustling with people. seated right away. Ordered an angus burger with cheese. The food was ok. Service was great. The price on the menu was 19$ for burger that came with fries. When the check came the price was $22. and then with the tax and operational fees close to 24$. I guess the American cheese on the burger cost $3. Disappointed.', "Love the food here but the singer was amplifying her voice.  She had a lovely voice but you could not have a conversation while she was singing.  After mentioning this to the waiter she did turn the Amp down but the sound  seemed to creep back up after a number or two.  Make sure if you're going out for a quiet dinner to mention it before being seated.", 'Disappointing Experience at Barosa

We recently booked a party at Barosa Restaurant, and unfortunately, the experience left much to be desired. Despite paying a deposit to secure our reservation, we arrived only to find out that they had double-booked our party. This caused a lot of confusion and frustration, especially since we had planned everything in advance and expected smooth arrangements.

This wasn’t the first time we had hosted a party here. The previous event went fine overall, but there were still issues – like the sound system not working, which meant we couldn’t play the music we had prepared for the occasion. At the time, we were willing to overlook that, hoping it was a one-off issue. However, this latest experience was a major letdown.

To be fair, the food at Barosa is good, and that was the one redeeming factor. However, the lack of organization and reliability when it comes to reservations made this celebration far more stressful than it should have been. For an establishment that prides itself on hosting events, these kinds of mistakes are unacceptable.

While the food might bring us back for a regular meal, we won’t be considering Barosa for any future events.']

name: LONGHORN STEAKHOUSE
reviews:
["Get the bread. They're running low and ask if you'd like some. It's worth it 😎

I've eaten at some of the best steakhouses in NYC so this was interesting to me as the cost was very cheap but the steak was pretty decent.

Only thing I'd say is that the consistency (medium rare for me) was very good but my sirloin was chewy. If there were no sides, I don't think i would have just enjoyed the steak.", 'Food was great! Flavour was fantastic. However the service left much to be desired. Our server was kind and sweet, but it was impossible to get his attention. At one point our table was covered in empty cups and food plates but he never came around to clear them off. Instead one of his fellow servers had to clear it off for us. Even just paying for the meal was a hassle, it took ages to get his attention and longer still to get out the check. Please keep in mind while this was a saturday we went, the place was not packed. He never came around to offer help unless we got his attention first. As such, while the food was a pleasure, the service felt lacking depending on who your server is.', 'Hands down, the best steak I’ve had in a while! The flavors and tenderness were absolutely spot on, and you can tell the quality of the meat is top-notch. My partner swears by the ribeye and raves about it every time. As for me, I can’t get enough of the steak salad—it’s a perfect blend of fresh and savory with a side of sweet potato that really completes the meal. A true “chef’s kiss” finish for both of us. Highly recommend if you’re looking for an unforgettable steak experience!', 'The food is simply amazing, especially the outlaw ribeye and the mac & cheese. The drinks are top notch as well. Our waiter was the sweetest and attentive! Overall, my family and I enjoyed ourselves :)', 'Staff is friendly and helpful. The lunch menu is amazing! They have a few options for $11 which I think it’s a great price! And the food was delicious I had the chicken salad with lobster soup and my friend had the steak salad with french onion soup!']

name: DON TEQUILA URBAN CANTINA
reviews:
["I've driven past this restaurant many times, but it wasn't until my sons took me there for my 52nd birthday in August that I discovered its greatness. I've been back several times, including last night, and the vibe is always great. The steak tacos are particularly amazing - I ordered them twice, which says it all. I'll definitely continue to visit, and I'm looking forward to checking out their Saturday night scene, as Friday nights was very busy and entertaining and enjoyable Kudos to the two Bar tenders last night they whole not down", "I enjoyed the restaurant - Food and ambiance exceeded my expectation.  The food was fresh, hot and delicious.  The staff was courteous and attentive. We celebrated my mom's birthday and she enjoyed it.  We had the corn, guacamole, nachos, mixed fajitas, fish and chicken fajitas, sweet plantain, wings, quesadilla and steak with fried plantains they were all beyond good.  The margaritas are strong and delicious.  Beers are cold and tequila on point.  Even the non alcoholic Mojita's for kids were amazing.  I highly recommend!  Beyond 5 stars.", "Very nice , the food was good I had fajitas the portion was just enough and I did enjoy the tamarind margarita , my cousin had the steak buritto which was huge .
The service i have to say was wonderful , they weren't pushy and our waitress offered suggestion because I didn't know what to order .
But the only thing I did like was the very very loud music . I understand it's for the young generation but not everyone can handle the laudness.", 'I passed by often and finally had chance to visit. I ordered the jalapeño Calamari appetizer, Salmon and Vegetables main course and Coconut Mojito Happy Hour. Very nice presentation on the food and everything taste delish. Service was great they checked on me often no matter how busy.', 'Amazing place. Great people working there.
The area was very safe and nice. The food was great. The drinks were good. The Music and DJ were amazing.']

name: THE QUEENSBORO
reviews:
['Great place with absolutely amazing staff. Came with the kids and the staff was so great with them! There’s also some Filipino style food which was also delicious. Alcohol portion is great. And completely surprising their desert was gold; try the muffins!', 'Always an amazing time at The Queensboro - I can’t believe I haven’t written a review for them before. The food is fresh and delicious - the menu evolves with the seasons which is nice. Always something new to try with their main staples sticking around. The staff is very welcoming & friendly! This is a local staple that everyone should try and make apart of their regular rotation of restaurants. Will be back and I recommend to everyone to give them a try!', "Garlic Spam Fried Rice and Morroccan Breakfast. In house spam - pretty good. Garlic Spam fried rice a little too salty for my taste. We started with their ricotta fritters. Pretty damn good. Light and fluffy, made fresh.  I could taste how fresh the cilantro on the Morroccan breakfast was. Likely from their in house herb garden. Spices were very warm and comforting. Coffee was alright. Looked the right color but nothing to write home about. Not complaining either. The happy medium for diner coffee, I'd say. A little expensive for what it is but the decor could have told you that. Family friendly and the service is great.", 'They had delicious food. It was delightful and satisfying There were a lot of nice people specifically Angelica. And I suggest the photos I putt.', "Had higher expectations for this restaurant; I was disappointed that the food didn't taste as good as the reviews stated. I got the jerk chicken with summer squash and grilled asparagus. Food came out really fast indicating that everything was already pre-cooked.

The jerk chicken was decent (you get 3 pieces), but very salty. The asparagus was hard to eat because the skin was hard and chewy. The summer squash was awful; it didn't mix well with my jerk chicken. Everything was too salty. I paid around $28 after tax and tips. I don't think the price justified for the food I got.

Service and decor were nice. They had someone playing music instruments, but honestly it was too loud and I couldn't hear my friends talk."]

name: PARK SIDE RESTAURANT
reviews:
['Had a delicious Sunday dinner here!! Very nostalgic ambiance, but it’s my favorite kind. I had the swordfish and it was cooked perfectly! very happy with the calamari and crab cake appetizers as well. the service was okay. we felt a little neglected in a corner of the restaurant but we still managed to get everything we needed', 'I haven’t been here in years.  Their crab cake is toothsome😋!  Fresh, lumps, sweet.
My guest enjoyed her Seafood Combo.
Attentive service and nice ambience with the greenery along the windows.

They serve you a variety of complimentary bread that they wrap for you to go and biscotti.

If you would like to have dinner here, make a reservation weeks in advance or they’ll tell you they have tables available at 4:30 or 8:30 p.m.  But if you aim to have lunch, they’ll likely have a table at the time you want.', 'My son and I went on a Monday night and it was PACKED! The host/ manager was friendly and helpful. Sat us within 10/15 minutes.
The service was great. We sat out in the terrace area. The space was beautiful. The food didn’t take very long and my son and I enjoyed everything. His steak was perfectly cooked and my pasta was delicious. Very fresh. It’s got to be made in house.', 'This Italian restaurant is in Corona and it makes you feel you are not in Queens or Corona but in Italy. Ambiance is beautiful and the food is delicious. I enjoyed it so much. The service was so nice and they gifted me a free cappuccino. I highly recommend it. I will be going again ♥️', 'Queens is a perfect setting for this classic, huge, Corona Italian restaurant.  It is fun, noisy, and a bit old school, which adds to its old world charm.  I loved that before we even ordered, we were served a large bread basket with a unique assortment of breads and breadsticks.  All of the traditional Italian favorites are served here.  I had the Veal Francese which was a tasty, sizable portion.  I started with the Tortellini in Broth soup which was also delicious without skimping on the tortellini.  For dessert, I shared a Chocolate Mousse Cheesecake which was fresh, creamy, and scrumptious.  Service was friendly  and attentive throughout the meal.  Valet parking was friendly and efficient.  If you love classic Italian at reasonable prices, then this is a must place to visit. 🍽']

name: CAFE RUBIO
reviews:
["I was here with a couple of friends for some food. The place is pretty nice the food is good aswell I'm not into so much seasoning but the food was good. The service is great as well, except I felt it was too much. We had our plates taken away right away kind of felt like they wanted us to finish fast and leave or buy something else couldn't really enjoy the time eating.", 'Everything we ordered was delicious and fast, unfortunately the food was BARELY warm! The vibe was great and I look forward to go back.

Almost 5 stars, but the food (main courses) were barely warm, almost room temperature.', 'Came in for drinks with friends, the place looked good and clean.

Has a full bar with great drinks and friendly staff. It  was the perfect spot to hang out. Music wasn’t too loud or too low, it was perfect.

Food was ok I guess tasted good, you just can’t see what are you eating since everything is covered with sauce and cheese. Also was a bit over priced, like if you was paying for fancy rice and beans.

Over all it’s a great chill spot. Try it.', 'Love this place anytime - dinner, hookah, DJ, live music, dancing - doesn’t matter!
Seafood plate “Plátano a la Playa” was out of this world!', "I will have to say this place surprised me.
At first glance from outside you really don't expect much but hoping that the food is good, but once you enter you see that this place is really nice it actually also has an outside area in the back which i would love to see the set up in the summer to come.
Right from the entrance is a bar that looks like it can accommodate anybody's drinking desire which is most definitely good haha.
More inside it has alot more seats and tables with better lighting. Which looks looks like it can be a dance floor at night time.
So overall in the looks department i would say spot on. The staff was very friendly and did their job well
Now food wise it was a little on the high end in price but the most important thing is the food and it was really good and up to my expectations I would personally come back again to try more dishes from the Dominican Republic."]

name: TASTE OF ITALY
reviews: ["Substandard wannabe Italian food made by non-italians. They also have Spanish food that's just as bad as the phoney Italian. Fast service, and slim beverage choices. I don't like this place.", 'A "taste" more akin to bad school cafeteria food and for the same price as if you were at a real deal Italian Restaurant, what a bad joke! The quality of this food is subpar for anyone making it especially  for Latinos, you should be ashamed of yourselves! (I\'m of Latiino descent)\nPure overpriced trash, I could still taste the burned (likely canned and expired) sauce and stale cheese!\nNever again,  please spend your money on something better! Yuck!', 'Was deceived by the name. Not authentic Italian as described! It’s Spanish made Italian. This place needs updated on google as it’s no longer called a taste of Italy. Ordered some pasta dishes, noodles were over cooked and sloppy, the tomato sauce was very watery. It’s edible, but it’s definitely not authentic. Was very disappointed in spending $50.00 on plates that did not meet expectations based on reviews. It’s like eating tacos at Taco Bell and expecting them to taste authentic from Oaxaca.', "Good food and delivery.  It doesn't use those stinky services that that charge as well as force you to tip.  The calzones are made fresh.  all the sandwiches are tremendous and taste great as are the pizzas.  The Stromboli’s,veal,meatball,chicken and other Hispanic foods are wonderful.", "The pizzas are the real deal! No fake mass production. And Oh!!! the cheese..... Would of given 5 stars if not for a couple of times we ordered take out cheeseburger deluxe and the fries were soggy and sponge like full of oil. The second time I called to complain about them the guy, I guess the owner, told me if I don't like them, don't buy them any more. Not the response I  expected or is expected of a business looking to please their regular customers."]

name: OLIVE GARDEN ITALIAN RESTAURANT
reviews:
['Olive Garden it’s definitely a must!
O.G it’s a place that offers an open invitation to stay and take a break enjoying the Italian gastronomy with a plenty of options for everyone.
Since the moment you step in you can feel the Italian ambience and the spaces are big and comfortable enough to bring large parties, perfect for special occasions.
Olive offers up new items on their menus where the variety shines around the food and drinks; also a big plus is that you can order your own pasta with different sides, so you can enjoy the food in the way you want it!
There’s no doubt that Olive Garden wins a place in your must go restaurant list with the warm and fast service, delicious food and spaces that only can give you memorable moments.
Thank you Olive Garden, it’s always a pleasure.', "Very good food, cozy place. On my last visit the drinks were not to my liking due to the way they were prepared, I had to replace my drink, most of my companions said the same, there is a lack of more staff to serve the tables due to the delay in serving you at the table as there were few waiters.

The bathrooms need much more attention since they give a lot to say, especially for being such a busy place and being in such a busy area.

I ordered the seafood Alfredo pasta it was delicious, the garden salad was bitter. This time was very different from the previous ones I have visited. It's the first time I've seen the place a little neglected.", "Horrible experience.

They didn't take away our menu's, dirty plates, or dirty bread basket until half into eating dinner.

They gave us our main course before we were even close to done to eating our appetizer.

They tried giving us our soup while we were eating our main course.

Of course, they still charged me for my soup. The one I never got to eat...", 'Terrible service, waiter isn’t kid friendly and waiter needs training on how to treat customers. Had to order extra dish because waiter didn’t want to do their job to correct something

EDIT: gave this place another try on 7/21/2024. Hugeeeee mistake . Spent almost 2 hours in the restaurant with an autistic child when it didn’t even have to be 2 hours. But wanna know why it was 2 hours? I’ll tell you! Because the waitress kept forgetting the basics we asked for and we had to wait 20 minutes in between for simple things like condiments, lemons, utensils, water, plates and ketchup. By the time the lemon came I was halfway down my drink. By the time the ketchup came my son was done eating. The salmon was dry and tasteless. I ordered “sautéed “ shrimp but clearly it was microwaved. Don’t get me started on the “medium well” steak I ordered. Well I’ll just post the pictures. We asked for the check/to go containers and bag. Each item was brought one by one 20 min apart. It was to the point we just paid on the iPad and just left. I was so so happy to finally go outside. Oh and of course we tipped. I’m sure the waitress did the best she could .', "It was a great experience. we were a pleasant party of 11 Jehovah's Witnesses and the waitress assigned to us didn't disappoint!!!! 🤗💕🙌.
We came hungry but happy to be having one last get together with our 90 yr old young sister friend who is relocating to the south!  😊 The waitress, ...sorry I forgot her name was wonderful. We had the perfect area with the large oval shaped table off to itself  that fit us all and made it the perfect atmosphere for us.
The waitress was one step ahead of us the whole time .The appetizers came out quickly and every one seemed satisfied with their entree. A few of us had drinks that were good too. Not to mention free refills on soft drinks. Thanks for a great experience."]

name: BOCA CHICA
reviews: ['Nice and fresh food , good services , and honest size ! If you’re around in Corona , please stop by !', 'Good dominican food in an unassuming restaurant.  great coffee too. Service is good.  Needs a physical upgrade. of all the things even where the waiter places the bill to give to the customer.  Otherwise  enjoy their food especially their fish soup.mmm delicious!. Right in the heart of Corona, NY one block from Junction Blvd.', 'Comida deliciosa! -1st time eating sancocho and its was sooo good. Great food, Great atmosphere, great service! Will definitely return', 'My family and I visited NYC last week and stayed at a nearby hotel in Elmhurst NYC.  We googled a nearby Dominican 🇩🇴 Restaurant and believe me when I say, "THE FOOD AND SERVICE IS SPECTACULAR " you won\'t be sorry. The fish soup 🍲 and the mixed seafood dish was out of this world. The owner, got up from her seat and even found a parking for us. The server was always attentive. We will be back, if you\'re in the area, A MUST VISIT! BEYOND MY EXPECTATIONS! Hats off to the Chef, your cuisine was on point ❤️💯🇩🇴🍲👏👏👏👏', "Just ate here with a group of 8 and the service was fantastic! The waiter was extremely kind and hospitable. And the food was out of this world. I had the BEST seafood soup I've ever ate and for a fantastic price. If you want good Dominican seafood, this is the place to go."]

name: KANTU PERUVIAN CUISINE RESTAURANT
reviews:
['Delicious and, great value! Service was excellent. Drinks are strong and affordable ($9! For HH). Lunch special came with a large soup or salad. I’d highly highly recommend can’t wait to come back.', 'Tasty food and a nice space. Enjoyed all our entrees. You can also get a side of the aji cheese sauce.
Seco de cabrito (goat stew)
Entrana a la parrilla (skirt steak)
Guacamole
Yuca Fries

For dessert we got three things but the only one I’d definitely order again is the Aguaymanto Cheesecake. Made with gooseberries, it has a nice tartness to it, really good! Chocoflan and churros were just ok.

Staff was great and look forward to trying other dishes here.', 'Me and my boyfriend decided to come to Kantu and we couldn’t be happier. The food was amazingly good, the service and hospitality was excellent. Lorena was very kind and attentive to our needs. Also, they are so clean, as soon as you walk in you can feel how refreshing this place is. As you can see my boyfriend was really happy, will definitely come back! :D', "I’ve been to this restaurant, probably over 10 times this year alone. My kids enjoy it and so do I. The food is amazing and they have great combinations. The staff, service, and food never fails! They're quick and attentive! I recommend 100%", "The food was amazing, and the drink was as well. I started off with a delicious frozen pina colada, which hit the spot just right. Then we ordered a Pollada that came with a salad, half a chicken, and french fries. The second order was a Costillitas en Chifa which comes with ribs in a mouth watering Asian tasting bbq sauce, maduro, and fried rice plate. The third order was a Chicken Arroz Chaufa, which is such a yummy chicken fried rice plate. I can say this rice was so tasty and way better than a lot of these Chinese restaurants I have gone to. The portions were perfect enough to take a little back home if you're not a big eater, lol The service overall was great as well. They are very attentive and sweet as soon as you walk in. We will definitely be back!"]

name: NICK'S BISTRO
reviews:
['We came here after watching a movie and it was after 8pm. We sat indoors (they have outdoor seating too), it was a little warm, lots of couples and a few parties. This is a hip place.
