Food was excellent, we had to take leftovers ho', "I came upon this place with a friend while walking Metropolitan Ave and I have to say I'm impressed, the food was plenty and delicious and the sangria I had was one of the yummiest ever, also the Margarita on the rocks was amazing and so refreshing! If I lived closer I would become a regular and would like to try more on their menu.", 'Great family restaurant. Delicious food and friendly service.', 'We were hungry and wanted to try new dishes and different for us both. Portobello with crab meat. Moussaka, grilled octopus and started with a share salad. Greek beer to wash it down all the good food but still hold on to the delicious taste. Still remember the well balanced moussaka that was to die for .
The octopus was tender but for me I wished it was served as a whole piece and not cut for me while the char would have been more outstanding with tones of lemon juice. I did not care for the chickpeas mixed in .
The mushrooms (2) were well prep still I wished it was more meat then fillers ( breadcrumbs and such).
We are going back this Summer for more of the Greek delicious food . I am thinking of the lemon chicken soup and more traditional Greek dishes.
The team in all cooked served and clean efficiently while the manager took care of mom to be comfortable at all times since she is elderly with mobility issues. The smile on their faces made our experience unforgetable. Keep doing the great job you had delivered to us both. See you soon  .', 'We came as a party of 6, and made reservations ahead of time. Food is wonderful, authentic, tasty, and does not make you feel heavy. The saganaki is one of the best ones we’ve tried, comparing to the ones we had locally and internationally. The tzatziki with the pita bread is delicious and comforting… Warm, soft bread with flavorful tzatziki and juicy chicken kabob, we were all amazed. The manager is very friendly, upon checking in he made sure we didn’t wait more than 2 minutes, checked on us frequently, and made sure we all had what we needed. The rest of the staff were very polite, quick, accommodating, and helpful. We all loved Nicks Bistro - cannot wait to come back soon!']

name: AGED
reviews: ["We made a reservation and got seated on time. Service was good, attentive, and professional. We ordered an appetizer that was served fairly promptly. All the food came as ordered. I had a ribeye, which was delicious. The mashed potatoes were awesome. The salad was not special. Service could have filled water a bit more often. The ambiance was good. It was tight seating but not overly cramped. I'm a bigger guy and was fine. One distraction was that there seemed to be multiple servers at times. One girl asked about drinks, and another came a bit later to take the order, and yet another brought the bill. It was a bit confusing as you didn’t know who to ask for anything. All in all, it was a nice experience and we would return. As far as the bill, expect to spend between $50 to $100 per person. Not an every night meal spot but nice for a special occasion.", "Everything just tasted average or salty, especially that French onion soup just full of salt, it's like the whole purpose of their menu is to have diners order more drinks to cleanse the saltiness away.", 'Best steakhouse in town that has a Happy Hour that never disappoints.', 'I held my sister’s baby shower here and she couldn’t have been any happier.  From the beginning, I was offered help from Mira and Emilia.  They helped strategize and helped with customizing the menu to reflect the occasion’s theme.  The food and drinks were excellent and reasonably priced.  My guests were all very happy.  Overall, I give this venue a 10/10.', 'I really enjoyed this place. From the time we walked in Sebastian catered to us. We requested to be reseated because it was very cold. We ordered a bottle of Riesling as our drink of choice. French onion soup as appetizer (it was amazing) and the Lamb Chop as main course. Everything was so delicious. Sebastian checked up on our needs, Khalil made sure our glass was always with wine and had great conversation. We definitely enjoyed the service and food at this restaurant. Very personable and intimate.']

name: IL POETA
reviews:
["**Il Poeta: A Masterpiece of Italian Culinary Art**

Il Poeta is a hidden gem that transports you straight to Italy with its authentic flavors and welcoming atmosphere. The moment you step in, you're greeted by the warm, attentive service that makes you feel like family. The star of the kitchen, Chef Mario di Chiara, is a true artist, crafting dishes that are as visually stunning as they are delicious. Every bite reflects his passion and mastery of Italian cuisine.

From homemade pasta to perfectly cooked seafood, each dish is a testament to his skill and creativity. Whether you're indulging in a classic carbonara or savoring a more contemporary creation, the flavors are nothing short of extraordinary.

The experience doesn’t stop at the food. Julio, the restaurant’s talented bartender, elevates the meal with his exceptional drink pairings. His extensive knowledge and passion for mixology are evident in every cocktail he crafts, adding the perfect touch to an unforgettable dining experience.

For anyone seeking an authentic Italian meal coupled with outstanding service, Il Poeta is 100 percent recommended. It’s more than just a meal—it’s an experience that delights all the senses.", 'In this place you feel at home, the food is made with fresh and healthy products. This is the perfect place, and the secret ingredient is the love that the owner and his staff put into making us feel good.', 'What a fantastic and authentic Italian restaurant. Chef Mario and his team are attentive to handling every detail. As an Italian living abroad, this is probably the best meal I have ever had in an Italian restaurant outside of Italy—well done Mario. Keep up the amazing job.', "Celebrated my birthday tonight at IL Poeta. I don't order calves liver often, but tonight's dish was cooked to my liking...tender and moist. Service and ambiance was terrific!
Bravo Mario for making my birthday a memorable one!", 'The food and. Services. Is. Amazing.  Definitely you need go this. Place.']

name: KUKU KOREAN CUISINE FOREST HILLS
reviews:
["Wow, I’m absolutely obsessed with the Garlic Tradition Chi-Bap at Kuku! The fried chicken was perfectly crispy and bursting with flavor. The staff was incredibly friendly and got our orders out quickly. This place is a must-try if you're in Forest Hills.", "My visit to this restaurant for dinner was a delightful surprise! The food is incredibly delicious and fresh.

We started with the calamari for appetizers, which disappeared in minutes—it was that good! Our server jokingly remarked, 'Wow, you guys finished it already? Next time, we'll order two.'

For our main courses, we ordered a variety:

Curry Shrimp Fried Rice: 10/10
Spicy Chicken Bibimbap: The spiciness caught us off guard since we weren't asked how spicy we wanted it, but it was still enjoyable.
Crispy Shrimp Chi-Bap: The portion size was generous; I couldn't finish it all and had to take some home.
Chicken tenders and waffle fries: A classic choice that did not disappoint.
Every dish scored a perfect 10 for taste and portion size.

There were some small additions served with our meals, including fish eggs, pumpkin, veggies, pickled radish, and kimchi. Each one added a delightful burst of flavor to our dining experience. Surprisingly, my favorite was the pumpkin—I usually don't care for it, but this was exceptionally tasty and I couldn't resist finishing it.

We rarely have dessert due to being full, but we made room for the mochi ice cream—and it was worth it.

Service was attentive; they cleared our table promptly after the main course and even cleaned crumbs away. They also served us a delicious tea while we waited for dessert, though I'm not sure what kind it was.

Located in the bustling area of Austin Street, parking can be a challenge, especially on weekends. It took us about 20 minutes to find a spot on the street. There are paid parking options and lots nearby.", 'I loved the vibes and interior of the restaurant. The service was amazing as well. As for the food, the soy garlic wings were good! I’d skip out on any of the fried rice dishes as they had no flavor whatsoever.', 'We came here for lunch on a cold day and ordered the 18 piece poppers, sauces(kuku spicy chili and Thai sweet chili) on the side. Also ordered the beef bulgogi lunch combo and the spicy squid lunch combo.

Everything was delicious! They give generous portions of banchan sides and the poppers were a lot more than we expected, at a decent price for Korean food. We ended up taking food home, enough for another meal the next day.

The interior is clean, spacious, and well thought out. Staff are friendly and kind, and the food came out pretty quickly.

On another occasion, I did take out for the Korean fried chicken wings, half garlic and half spicy garlic and their beef japchae. While the wings weren’t as crispy and the japchae was too soft after I got back home to eat for dinner, the taste of the food was still there. If you can, I’d recommend eating at the restaurant while the food is fresh out of the kitchen.

Would definitely come back here again! Great addition to the forest hills neighborhood!', "This restaurant was incredible!!!
We came for vacations from Orlando and we're looking for a place to have good Korean food not way to far from the airport. If you are looking for a Korean restaurant and you're are not sure if you should pick this one, let me help you with that, pick this one!!
Food was so tasteful, it's the best kitchen I've ever had in my life. Also our waitress Yuni was amazing, caring and so so kind, she made out experience even better.
Thank you so much for such an experience!"]

name: MOJO
reviews: ["I've been enjoying this place for years! The food is so delicious. The cocktails are made well ! The staff is always accommodating and super friendly. I've had so many laughs here. When my friend asked to take me here for my birthday, I was super excited. The bathroom sink is a cool idea with stones. Austin Street is a great spot to explore.", 'Such an amazing night at Mojo! First time and the Daniela’s service was perfect. We had some corn ribs for appetizer and salmon for my entree, totally recommended.', 'What an amazing experience. The atmosphere is wonderful. From the food, drinks, the friendly and awesome staff, I truly enjoyed my birthday brunch and was glad I chose this place. Thank you so much for such a great time. Will definitely return!', 'Enjoyed dining at this place. Our server was very friendly. Very nice place to hang out with friends or for a date. Smaller group is recommended as the spaces might be a little too tight. It was a beautiful atmosphere. Very well decorated. I loved their menu book. It lights up when you open it!', 'The food was absolutely delicious! I would definitely recommend coming here. And shout out to Joshua, who has been an excellent server and very kind']

name: BANGKOK CUISINE
reviews:
['I’m very happy with my dinner at Bangkok Cuisine. I got a very comforting green curry with shrimp. Good amount of shrimps! Right amount of sweetness to the base! Friend got Entry Garlic chicken with rice. Oh my! Very strong garlic flavor to it! Absolutely tasty! Chicken SATE was great too! There’s not many Thai food choices in Forest Hills, but this is definitely a good one! Will try their pad Thai next time.', "Great food and service.
Stopped with for the 2nd time and thought it def deserved a good review.
My wife loved the crispy duck and the egg fried rice that it came with was super delicious.
The crispy calamari was great but the sauce it came with could've been a little bit better.

Over all, 5 star
Excuse the messy photo of the food. It was so good we got carried away
that we finished it all", "My husband and I had lunch here today. The food was decent, but the server was very RUDE.

It has been mentioned in other reviews as well, but the servers at this restaurant relentlessly insist on a tip. Even though tipping is not mandatory, they treat it as if we are obligated to leave money, demanding it from us.

When we tried to pay the bill, she insisted we tip at least 18% when we left 10%. Since I believe tipping is something I do when I'm pleased with the service, I asked her if 18% was mandatory at this restaurant. She made a face in front of me while saying no, but still insisted that we tip more than 18%.
Her behavior was unacceptable—asking for a tip while showing such a poor attitude is absurd!

It's a shame because the food tasted good (although the plating was kind of sloppy), and I was considering returning to the restaurant, but the server's behavior has made me reconsider.", 'Came during lunch special, decent portion size for $12. Beautiful atmosphere and the waiters were very nice.
Overall, Bangkok Cuisine offers a fantastic dining experience with delicious food, welcoming atmosphere, and attentive service. I would highly recommend it to anyone looking for an inexpensive dine-in meal in the heart of Forest Hills.', 'Our first time visit along with friends.
Loved all the dishes starting from Sampler platter, Pork satay to Drunken noodles, fried rice and more. Will visit again.']

name: TU CASA
reviews: ['Very disappointed in Peruvian restaurant I got half of chicken with rice and beans. First of all chicken is not fresh burnt very dry and no flavor. Rice and beans they should call rice and water from beans. Shrimp soup that is $18 not what I would expect not so fresh and luck of flavor. They have only one person in restaurant that busy with phone orders and there’s no time for people who seat inside.', 'Maybe we made the wrong choice on the menu, but the food was not worth it. We were expecting a platter with the best of the Peruvian kitchen. However we got served a plate with nothing else than deepfried, cheap cuts of meat. Where is the love? The beef (stated on the menu) was not on there. Eventhough we mentioned, there was no compensation whatsoever. The desert was good, but not outstanding. We will probably not be back here. Staff was friendly. Restroom: super clean.', "It was empty when we came in. The food was ok but ate it anyway because I'm paying for it. The waitress seemed so kind at first but tried to scam us with $20 extra on the bill. We were 4, and I told her that 20% gratuity is only included for parties of 6 or more. It literally says on the menu . How does someone work here and doesn't read the menu??? I've been a waitress before, and I know gratuity is added manually. No wonder no one comes in ....", 'One of my favorite places to get outstanding Spanish food.  It was magnificent.  The people are very welcoming, friendly, and excellent servers.  Highly recommend to anyone.  Worth the 1 hour train ride from the financial district 👍', "I go pick up my food I have no problems everything is full. I order on line and the little chunky Spanish lady keeps sending us a half empty rice. So I called kindly and asked her why is the rice only empty when I get it delivered through the app, but when I come pick up it's always how it should be and that's full. She got nasty right away and said if you want more rice you have to buy another rice. I said back nicely I shouldn't have to purchase another one just because your leaving it half way empty. I've been going here 2 years now and she's always nasty and has no manners. You really should think about getting rid of her, because i guarantee your losing customers and service because of her. Which in the long run leads to plenty of money lost."]

name: DOS BRONCOS RESTAURANT
reviews:
['I was having a bad day until I stumble upon this place , as I went inside this handsome young man with glasses ( I think his name was Miguel ) greeted me with a warm welcome . I took a look of their menu and noticed they make Enchiladas de Mole , so I went with it . Service was pretty fast despite it being extremely busy and not to mention the amount of GrubHub drivers coming in and out . Once my food was brought out to me I noticed how authentic the dish looked  , and once I took a bite of the food it felt as if my mother made it in their kitchen !  Miguel then brought me a Tiramisu and that definitely brighten up my day , I would for sure come back to this restaurant and recommend it to the locals around the area !', "The place is bare-bones with a cafeteria-style setup. The service was a bit slow but manageable. The whole fried red snapper was well-executed with crisp skin, nicely seasoned batter, and tender fish. The rice was soft, fluffy, and well-seasoned, while the side salad was average but improved with lemon juice and salt. Overall, I'd return.", 'If you’re hungry and want fresh, delicious food, this is the place to go! You order at the counter and the food is brought out to you. The guacamole is always made fresh and it’s definitely shareable! The enchiladas de mole is the right about of sweetness and the chicken is tender. Miguel provided 5 star service! I’ll be back to try the rest of the menu!', "Been coming here or picking something up occasionally since they opened last year. Do not be fooled by the quaint setting, the food will always leave you wanting more.
Brunch menu, classic Mexican items, hearty soups, fresh drinks, and even the burger and fries have been so on point every time. Preparation is always EXCELLENT, everything is served equally hot, steak made to order and eggs are never dry.
The flavors can be rich or subtle depending on the dish. It all really tastes at least as good as it looks, and it still takes me by surprise every time.
Takeout is always packed with care, and I live around the corner, but I still like to dine in sometimes. If you're not paying with cash, make sure to mention the tip before you pay, or they might not include any in the bill.
Highly recommended.", 'This place is good, however I do wish the burrito included,sour cream, jalapeños, at least lettuce like most places. Mine didn’t come with the chipotle mayo mentioned in the description either. The tacos al pastor were good. I would definitely return to check out some of their other items.']

name: FLORENCE PRIME DINER
reviews:
['I ordered a chocolate pancake it was 5out of 5. Great portion size and warm maple syrup it was amazing. The skirt steak sandwich the first in their Sandwich menu’s, we asked for medium rare, it was a little bit over cooked however the seasoning of the meat was great, warm and fresh bread that made it taste warm we asked salad as a side for sandwich, it was not my favorite since there was a fruit (not mango)that I couldn’t find what was that and it made the flavors unbalanced. The service was really good and fair price. I see myself come back for the pancake.', 'Came here because it had good reviews, it sure did live up to every expectation.
Walking into the restaurant, nice atmosphere, bar, seating, counter, seating, and tables available, you get to pick where you sit. Servers were attentive and walking around, just in case you needed more water or to clear your plate.
My day, and I got a nice selection of food, and totally enjoyed every bike. Great flavor, not too much spice. We got crabcakes to start, eggs Benedict, he got tacos, I got a Greek omelette, but we shared. Not a lot of diners do fresh squeezed, orange juice, so I was pretty impressed even by that.
Atmosphere for Brunch was very inviting, their specialty is a seafood pasta which I’ll definitely be going back for. And this place wasn’t too pricy, which is definitely a pro.
Staff is also multilingual, so if you’re going here with friends, like my date, they can communicate other than in English', "Go here!\xa0 Best breakfast with fresh squeezed juice. Please.\xa0 I'm not begging. After over a half-dozen times with
my family, and by myself, I am confident\xa0that my opinion crosses most of their ambiance, friendliness, and (how can I possibly forget) menu and portion size. Everything, yes, everything, has not only exceeded my expectations but shared by absolutely everyone I've invited.\xa0 This is truly a refreshingly wonderful experience of friendly interaction with owners, staff, and food that I rarely experience despite over multiple years in New York City.\xa0 Whilst I've experienced plates getting smaller and more expensive, with wait staffs more defensive; well, this one stands out by so much more than a kilometer, mile, or by whatever ... including generous and very delicious portions.\xa0 Enjoy!", 'Update:  came back for dinner after my first visit last week for breakfast.  Dinner was even better!  This place is a gem.  Food is fantastic quality.  Vibe is great.  Initial review:  Food was great.  Service was perfect.', 'Went here for breakfast this Sunday. The place has a nice vibe, the waitress was very friendly and knowledgeable. The menu was interesting enough to make me want to go back. I ordered the avocado toast with a cappuccino and my partner had chicken and waffles with an espresso. We also got fresh orange juice and watermelon juice? Idk it was frozen, but delicious.']

name: JFK BAR AND GRILL
reviews: ['Marvelous Food, Pleasant Atmosphere, Friendly Staff\n\nThe guacamole is outstanding.  Food is nicely prepared and presentation is great. The place is always neat and tidy and sparkling clean!  Chef Bikki is wonderful and knows his craft well. I highly recommend.', "Holla namaste is the one of the best Mexican restaurant in this area. This place is very quit and peaceful. They play loud music outside but inside soft music and sports. We drinks mojito it's one of the best for price and quality. Thank you so much for the best services. We will obviously visit again.", 'The best place in town for the tacos and burritos. I ever eat tacos like that. Hola namaste is the best place for Mexican food and drinks. Wow ! The mojito the best. Thank you so much. We have obviously visit there again.', 'It’s the best Mexican restaurant in junction blvd. @chef_bikki make excellent  tacos and burritos...great place to eat food and cocktails. Of course we will visit always.', 'Wow . Such a good experience. The chef is very humble guy. The staffs and very gentle. Must go place.']

name: DINER BAR
reviews:
["Stopped here for quick brunch w my wife. Was greeted nicely then was told my
Service animal wasn't allowed without paperwork. I showed my service animal ID and notified the host that asking for the paperwork is illegal and he replied he was unaware and will look into it.

Everything was great  and the place was super clean. I didn't know the eggs Benedict came with ham and the staff were really nice and replaced order for me.

Great place I recommend for a quick
Bite.", 'I’ve been coming here for a while now, always receiving warm welcoming from the staff.
I enjoy the food, usually I order what you see in the pictures.
they also have great alcohol varieties especially when Rosa is preparing it.', "Diner Bar is a standout culinary gem that delivers an exceptional dining experience with its impressive service and mouthwatering menu. The moment you step in, you're greeted with a warm and inviting atmosphere that sets the tone for a memorable meal. The service is truly top-notch—attentive, friendly, and knowledgeable, ensuring that every aspect of your visit is handled with care and precision. The burgers at Diner Bar are nothing short of spectacular. Crafted with high-quality ingredients and cooked to perfection, each burger offers a delightful burst of flavor. Whether you prefer a classic cheeseburger or something more adventurous, like their signature creations with inventive toppings, you’re in for a treat. The freshness of the ingredients shines through in every bite. Beyond the burgers, the overall food selection is equally impressive. From hearty appetizers to delectable sides and indulgent desserts, each dish is prepared with a focus on quality and taste. The menu caters to a variety of preferences and dietary needs, ensuring that everyone can find something to enjoy. In summary, Diner Bar excels not only in the quality of its food but also in its outstanding service. It's a place where you can relax, enjoy a fantastic meal, and feel truly valued as a guest. If you’re looking for a memorable dining experience, Diner Bar should be at the top of your list.", '11/5/2024 Metered Parking. Greetings from Nick were pleasant. Nice and clean, great music. The food was pretty good, I had Bacon Avocado Lettuce NO TOMATO on Multigrain bread with fries and an egg on the side and a Cranberry Mimosa. My sister had a Bacon cheddar burger with fries and a Bloody Mary. Everything was pleasantly good. I do recommend this place. I will rate it as a 3/1.2', 'Went for brunch on a rainy Sunday, the restaurant was packed with families celebrating Mother’s Day and there was quite a line outside, but we somehow managed to find a table for two.
The place is absolutely gorgeous, elegant and extravagant old school style diner, with comfy booths and a sexy, well stocked bar.
The service is really good, nobody rushed us out despite the large crowd, and multiple people checked on us not intrusively throughout the whole brunch.
The food was really good, we really enjoyed the burger and apps, a bit disappointed in the chicken sandwich which was quite dry.
The absolute star of the meal was the boozy banana split milkshake, literally to die for.
Wonderful experience, def going back soon!']

name: MON CHERI BAR RESTAURANT PIZZERIA
address: Mon Cheri, 64-14 Fresh Pond Rd, Ridgewood
reviews:
['Mon Cheri is without a doubt one of my new favorite places to eat when I come into Queens from Rhode Island. The food, the drinks, the service are all top tier. Valeria is warm and welcoming and takes good care of you! We had the Marg, cheese, pepperoni, and four seasons pizza, and the lasagna. Every dish was made to perfection; very authentic flavors and fresh ingredients. I was blown away by the desserts as well. Homemade, fresh, and absolutely delicious. We devoured every plate up. I love it here!! Can’t wait to come again. Thank you Mon Cheri!', 'Family owned bar, Family owned Restaurant. The attention/ detail that the owner provides is unmatched. Great spot for drinks, food and hospitality. Tip your bartender!!', 'Went in for dessert, not knowing what to get. Friendly and helpful staff recommended a delicious slice of pistachio cake with a cup of iced latte. I would definitely go back and order the same again!', 'Great food for a great price. $5 for coffee and a sandwich! Very friendly staff
Coffee was excellent!', "I have eaten at this restaurant quite a few times.  The food here is fresh and delicious.  This restaurant is worth going to a hundred times over.  Aside from delicious food the atmosphere here is great.  When you are here you feel at home no better feeling can you get from that.
This is the place to go to in Ridgewood and leave happy and deliciously content.
I have lived in this neighborhood for many years and proud to call this restaurant a true jewel in Ridgewood.
Please don't miss the opportunity to experience true joy in a restaurant.
Thanks"]

name: PSARI
reviews: ['Came to have an early dinner with my daughter. I have dined here before with my mom so i thought to give it another try being my daughter had been craving seafood. Service was quick due to it being a Thursday and staff was friendly. Food was okay I’ve had better. The fried octopus was amazing. My daughter ordered the king crab legs with lemon potatoes and I ordered lobster tails with lemon potatoes. My daughter really didn’t like the seasoning on top of the king crab legs plus it was like six legs. What threw me off was that when the bill arrived it was $172. The crab legs alone were $76 for that portion that was outrageous. Honestly I don’t think I will ever return I have eaten in places around the world that the crab legs and they are way cheaper and I’m given a larger portion. Definitely not worth it and will not recommend or return. The bills didn’t include gratuity either. I’m definitely not cheap but I just don’t waste my money on six crab legs for $76', 'Was having a day trip in the area the other week when I was in the mood for grilled octopus and I found this place. The staff was quick, friendly, and attentive. Their lunch special pricing was great and the octopus was exactly how I was hoping it would be!', 'Not the best experience. The stuffed grape leaves were clearly microwaved and not fresh. Spinach pie was a bit better, but didn’t taste fresh either. The grilled shrimp were great. I’ve had better Greek food in this area…Staff is friendly and fast.', 'Really enjoyed our meal here on a beautiful Sunday noon. There was a beautiful outdoor setup with plenty of seating inside if it got too hot.\n\nThe two of us shared the Broiled Combo and the Greek salad. The salad refreshing but nothing that special, but the Broiled Combo was delicious. It had a good portion of salmon, flounder, shrimp, and scallops for two. The salmon was so tender and juicy that it melts in your mouth. And top the sauce with some of that homemade garlic bread (comp) was a fantastic meal for us.', 'The only good thing about this place was the garlic bread. For the price of $86 you can get rubbery crab legs that are no longer fresh. When we asked to speak to the manager they said they couldn’t do anything about it that they’ll give us a call. Even the Greek salad was bad, how can you mess that up? The calamari was also rubbery and tasted old. The octopus was decent. Far better places in Astoria for seafood. Would not recommend.']

name: LALY'S RESTAURANT & AGAVERIA
reviews:
["This place is a hidden gem 💎. I went today for brunch and everything was amazing. The service was the best I've had in a while and everyone was super nice. I knew the food was going to be good when I saw other Spanish people in there. I will definitely be back. The breakfast enchiladas was awesome and they didn't skimp on the shrimp.", 'What a hidden gem!
There is a special everyday of the weekday. Our favorite is Taco Tuesday! Every taco is $3. Our all time favorite are the Fish Tacos and Shrimp Tacos. We’ve brought all the family here and even had my birthday dinner here.

I’ve also had their mixed fajitas. Best I’ve ever had!! So delicious and flavorful. Service is also amazing! Everyone is so friendly!!', 'Nice visit with clients to have a pre closing celebratory drink and dinner. Seating in a booth was a bit cramped but when the guests behind me left, our server helped move my side back, to give more space. Music was at a perfect level for ambiance and allow conversation.
Food was tasty and price was good for the portions. Drinks are very good. My frozen margarita (I opted for no salt and no tajin) was perfect! I think I’ll be back for another one soon.  Chicken quesadilla was a generous portion with a small side of guacamole, sour cream and pico de gallo. On an incredibly hot summer night, the temperature inside was just right… not to cold and not warm. Definitely a spot to check out when visiting near the main train hub or off the LaGuardia express bus.
I also appreciate not being charged an automatic gratuity as many restaurants are starting to do.', 'The food was amazing! 😋 The fish tacos were full of flavor. 🌮 The mole enchiladas with steak were on point. 🤤 I will definitely come here again and try different plates. #foodie #delicious #mexicanfood', 'Came to Laly’s for brunch.  We really wanted to try new food. Food was great, appetizers & breakfast was still available which was a plus. Drinks were even better. Service was great as well. Definitely had a good time & will be coming back to try the enchiladas 🙃. I’ll also post some of the plates we ordered for reference 😉']

name: BEDFORD GARDENS
reviews:
['Scallop special roll was SO yum. Food tasted fresh & was very good! Service was kind but I feel like they start to ignore you when u press the button more than 2 times. But we ordered a A few items and ended up needed extra napkins , eel sauce etc…', 'Lovely food and atmosphere! There’s a beautiful backyard seating with tons of plants, and also not too loud, great place to have a conversation.

The restaurant concept is also interesting - they have two separate kitchens making Vietnamese and Japanese food, under the same house', 'I had a pleasant visit here. The ambience alone is very welcoming and picturesque. I could see this as a nice spot for most occasions. I came with a friend and we stumbled upon this place. The vegetarian dumplings were very tasty. The pho was loaded with sodium so I didn’t finish it but my friend really enjoyed his and left nothing on the table. I would come back to try the sushi. Everything looked appetizing on the menu, its definitely worth a try.

Update: I came back to try the sushi. Im saving this place as a favorite. They really have it right here. I love it!', 'This place is so incredible! From the street it doesn't look like much, but the "Garden" in the back is gorgeous. Peaceful, and serene. And all the food is so good.

The pho is phenomenal. The sushi is supreme. Soup dumplings are so delicious. Normally I avoid places that offer a variety of foods because "if they do lots of types, they make them all badly" was my conventional thinking. Bedford Gardens has proven me wrong.

It's so good. Every meal I have had here had been delicious. High quality. Service is prompt and friendly. There's a button to press when you want service, otherwise they let you enjoy the relaxing space. I kinda don't want to tell you how good they are, because I want this as my little secret. Don't come here. Lol. Just kidding. So good. Enjoy', 'My daughter and I loved this place. Food was good, the atmosphere was so respectful and restful. The presentation was beautiful.']

name: LONDON LENNIE'S
reviews: ['This place is known for seafood, so came with a buddy that has been here numerous times to try it out. I had the restaurant week dinner special, and we ordered some oysters and crab claws as appetizers. The oysters were delicious, and the main dishes were good overall. The pace of the dining experience, however, was slow paced, and by the time we were done, we spent over 2 and a half hours inside the restaurant.', 'My husband and I celebrated our wedding at London Lennie’s and I think it was the best decision. The whole staff welcomed us in a lovely way, and Amanda, our server, really shared our happiness. Her empathy, enthusiasm and kindness made our day one of the most memorable of our lives. And the food… delicious. I highly recommend this restaurant. 🥂👰🏻\u200d♀️🤵🏻🍝', "London Lennie's in Queens is a seafood lover's paradise! Last Friday night, my husband and I indulged in a delicious dinner and were not disappointed. The oysters were fresh and briny, the lobster fried to perfection, and the tower combo was a feast for the senses. While the price tag was a bit steep (we spent over $280 for two people), it was well worth it for the quality and authenticity of the food. If you're looking for a truly exceptional seafood experience, London Lennie's is definitely worth a visit.", 'As you walk in the atmosphere is classy. Fairly busy with a few birthdays. The food was excellent, I ordered restaurant week with a small side place of dumplings. Man every meal was good. They blended the flavors in such a way as to be curious of the other plates. Then dumplings are still in my brain.', "I've been here to celebrate my mother in law birthday. And we had such a good time and very good food and fresh. Taka looks at the pictures."]

name: SHI
reviews:
['I’ve come here every few years & the experience is always great. I just had a date, we did a 3 course meal and it was less than $80. To me this was insane because I thought the bill should have been $150. I tried something new this time & I woke up next morning craving more. This must have put crack in those noodles, it was so good!', 'The waiters are so sweet. Drinks are amazing! Food is delicious. I definitely recommend coming here :) looking forward to coming back!! :)', 'This is an upscale, decently crowded restaurant right opposite to Manhattan views. We enjoyed our food - flavorful and packed with good spice. My starter was a huge size and had spicy tuna + layers of pastry dough which was a good heart eat. My main course was hearty and good sized too. Service was pretty decent and we enjoyed our dinner at Shi.', 'You can definitely find a better place than this one.

I don’t recommend appetizers like shrimp dumplings there is barely shrimp it’s all mashed and mixed inside with dumpling dough.

Fried cauliflower it’s not fried it is a cauliflower with breadcrumbs doesn’t taste good.

The sushi rolls crunchy spicy salmon, a little bit of salmon is mashed with something it’s not like an original sushi very small portion of 6 pieces.

Chicken dumplings were quite good (4 pieces) but not the best.

The only good dish was sesame chicken with rice.
Although broccoli wasn’t cooked enough, cold and hard.', "I celebrated many occasions here since I live two blocks away. Always a good vibe nice looking place and the food was very solid. I went for an awesome Halloween party once and had a great time. The music wasn't necessarily my style but it was still lively and fun."]

name: CHARO RESTAURANT
reviews: ['Very good food and very friendly staff. The service is fast and good', 'The best of the best Dominican food in queens. Chivo (goat) was 🔥 even if you don’t like goat, you will like their goat. Roast chicken is amazing as well. Beans, rice, tostones, onion, all the Dominican staples are as good as they come. Huge servings, very affordable. It’s a casual restaurant with high quality service. The staff are all very polite. Good place for families - they didn’t mind that our toddler made a mess. I’m def going back again and bringing more friends and family.', 'Luis Valerio - give this man a raise!', 'Chicken is good but there’s one staff who is very rude and makes me not want to eat there anymore.', 'I recently ordered food from Charos for a birthday party and I’m super glad I did. The food was AMAZING! They are known for their Chicken for a reason! Even the side dishes were great! But more so the customer service was outstanding.']

name: SABOR LATINO
reviews: ["I came here for a birthday celebration.  It's not really the kind of Restaurant I go to, that being said, it's a nice place.  I like the decor of the place.  The space is big with a space to dance and a stage.  It has murals that are good to take photos at.  The food is mainly Ecuadorian.  The prices on the food are good.  They have a full bar.  I didn't drink so I don't know how the prices on drinks are.  After we sat down, we waited quite a long time before our order was taken.  However once we ordered, it didn't take long to get our food.  The place gives off a party atmosphere, which is fine but I wouldn't choose it for a casual lunch or to just go have a few drinks but that's just me.  Both those things can be done here.  If I were invited to another celebration or get together, I would attend.", 'Food was great!! First time trying ecuadorian food.\nRecommend; pollo a la parrilla, empanadas de verde, churrasco. The beans had a good flavor. The piña colada was on point', "First time here, and for some reason I was ID'd at the door. it was 5pm. I sat at the empty bar and waited almost an hour for any of the 3 bartenders to even say hello to me let alone ask me if I wanted a drink. Even though they were busy setting up for the evening event (televised soccer game), at least acknowledge the customer. I was very hungry and couldn't wait so I yelled over the TV volume to the bartender who thought I asked for the check. what check? anyway she took my food order from 5 feet away and waited for my food to arrive before asking me if I wanted a drink, which was a half a plastic cup cocktail with ice. I ordered an encebollado (typical Ecuadorian dish I highly recommend) and it came out with a light portion of fish and no yuca with some old tostones and popcorn on the side. I was starving and did not want to complain, I understood it was an eventful night. The taste was okay, just minimal effort. The bartender closed my check after my second half a cup cocktail without me asking, I would've bought a third lol. a 15% tip was also automatically included in the check on top of the credit card fee they charge. Overall, the place was big and seemed very nice for a dance venue and dining experience. I don't like to judge negatively but first impressions are important. Maybe I should have sat at a table. I may try this place again, but there are many other Ecuadorian restaurants that may offer better service. Disappointed, I wanted to have a great experience here.", 'The food was AMAZING and RELAXING I LOVE LOVE THE VIBE SERVER WAS GREAT!!', 'Went there to watch a soccer game (Ecuador vs Colombia). Female waitresses was very pushy and warned us that we had continue consuming otherwise we would have to give up our table. There was no mentioned of any minimum to consume at the beginning, nevertheless we order  $120 of food + drinks (3 people) and with 15mns left to the end of the game, she kept on pushing to order more food or drinks. She mentioned this is a requirement per management. Disappointing, will not go back there']

name: PUEBLA RESTAURANT
reviews: ['Best burrito I’ve ever had in my life hands down. Lovely service, the food portion was very generous and delicious. 100/10 would go again. Highly recommend!', 'I would not recommend the torta, it tasted old and not fresh. The aguas frescas were delicious though, we got the Jamaica and Horchata. The place could use an uplift, but the service was great!', "Friendly and quick service. Jamaica water was great for my pallette; it was not overbearingly sweet like many I've tried. Had Asada and Al Pastor tacos. The Al Pastor tacos may have had a more adobe than I would have liked but still enjoyable. Overall, I would come back for more.", 'Ordered tacos (al pastor, carne asada, and pollo) and a chicken quesadilla. The carne asada and pollo were all but flavorless, while the al pastor was quite good. Quesadillas were fine but nothing amazing: it came as three quesadillas, covered in cheese. No diet sodas available.', 'I love this place!!!🥰🥰 taco al pastor and carnitas very delicious and cemita de milanesa de res omg my favorite!!!!']

name: MI OTRA CASA RESTAURANT
reviews:
['Great little informal place to land!!!
Ok, this may not look like a "big luxury place", BUT, it has it all. Mexican hospitality is all over the place, it is true that is a very small space, now taking some advantage of the temporary "street seatting", this place will really make you forget where you are and transport you to a little mexican town where you feel at home.
The food was excellent, the prices slightly high, BUT, they are really worth it.
The service and knowledgeable servers are always ready to take care of you and to make certain you're comfortable!
So if it is time for you to loosen up the tie throw the jacket away and go to pass some great time with friends, this is the place.
You may even take the microphone and let go some songs on the open karaoke on Saturday's afternoons
Try the "Ceviche shots"!!!', 'this place is wonderful, food and drinks are delicious, the personal is very kind. I definitely recommend', 'Took my friend to this place. It’s a public karaoke. Food is big portions. A little over priced for a birthday celebration in my opinion. But over all fun experience. Cost $180.', 'Great place to have fun.   They have  karaoke. The food was delicious.  The drinks are crazy good.', '100% recommend this place food is delicious, seafood weekend specials are great']

name: PIMPOLLO
reviews: ['Rice was burnt. We ordered Flank steak and received 2 shredded chicken pieces. Lady’s were very nice and welcoming. Place looked ok.', 'Truly authentic Colombian food.  Rotisserie chicken is delish?  Lunch specials very afforable before 4 p.m.\n\nTodo muy sabroso y servido con cariño.', 'Just had the typical plate. Delicious!! Best Colombian food I had in a while.', 'Every time I order or eat in, the food is very good. Even the pickier eaters I know like the food a lot. Service is always great too. They really make you feel at home while there and delivery times are often way quicker than they say (45 min was 15 one time).', "Horrible customer service.  We sat for  a long time before getting  a menu,  the waitress ignored us because she was to busy drinking beer. After 30 minutes of waiting, the waitress brings my main dish and still no appetizer lol. They didn't even give us our salad. She never bothered to ask if we needed something.  She just ignored us. I cancelled my appetizer and refused to order dessert. 40 bucks went to waste. And the waitress had the nerve to ask for a tip. Here's a tip, do your damn job! I have spent money in that restaurant before , NEVER AGAIN."]

name: SEE YOU TOMORROW CAFE
reviews:
['Wow. SO good. The Kimchi soup is hot with the perfect amount of spice. I am lucky to have found it before the chilly months ahead. The scallion pancake is crispy, flaky, and shockingly flavorful. So delicious. I got the Banzai roll and it was so soft, fresh, and flavorful. The cashier was very sweet and accommodating.

DELICIOUS! Grateful to live so close.', 'Friendly, really nice stuffs. Food was great, really satisfied with the food and the price, if asking for feedback, I would recommend having even better quality of sushi rice, it will up level the taste. I still give 5 stars to the food considering the overall taste, proportion and the price. Will definitely come back to try other things', 'Hubby was in the mood to try out a new cafe and we nose dived to this cute little one especially after we saw they have sushi on their menu. We enjoyed the salmon specialty roll at the suggestion of the waitress (who is very sweet and attentive by the way). We also got two other rolls that come with a tasty seaweed tofu soup. Next time we come, we will definitely try the drinks :)', "If I could give the service more stars I would. The food and atmosphere was/is amazing but what really sold it was the service provided by the new owner of the store. My partner and I are overjoyed to have come upon this place!! Please give it a chance if you're ever in the area.

Also ty for the complimentary slush ♡♡ I wish we took more pictures of the food but it was so good It slipped my mind !!  ˚‧º·(˚ ˃̣̣̥᷄⌓˂̣̣̥᷅ )‧º·˚

Recommender Food : The Snow Crab Roll and the Tofu Bites !!", 'I went with a few friends for work. We were greeted with a kind smile and wonderful service. The food was also extremely filling and tasty. I recommend a cooked salmon poke bowl. The proportion was good and it is also affordable. I would return 100%.']

name: CHIMI EXPRESS
reviews: ['Walking up to this spot and to say that it’s unassuming is an understatement. However, everything our group of 12 ordered was absolutely delicious! Although this place is extremely far from our house we will definitely be back!', 'Great service! The girl at the front desk was super welcoming and was on top of you, updating you on your order. Definitely enjoyed the food and will go back again.', 'Food is good ! But today I had it ! I always order from this place but for some reason they always mixed my drink order every time I order a LARGE OR MEDIUM DRINK THEY GIVE ME A SMALL ONE THIS IS ALWAYS the size they give me! I never complain but today I had to and call them first that lady wanted to charge me more money instead of fixing my size drink ! Super disappointed! Super cheap when it come to the size juice!  Mind you I pay $10 for this size !!! 😭😡😡😡', 'The worst chimi! They are very clean but too expensive for the food they give you. Service is ok but they need to improve there service. -0', 'Most unsatisfactory attempt at a chimi, also should change their name from chimi Express to chimi delay a simple terrible sandwich took 45 minutes to make']

name: CHEF'S MAHAL-MANNAN RESTAURANT & GRILL
reviews:
['The service and management was beyond kind and courteous to all the guests. The location was very clean and well maintained. My friend from Michigan came to visit with his family; they are not Bengali but they love Bengali cuisine. They said it was some of the best Bengali food they had and very pleased with the meal and the service. The location is a little hard to find because they are on the second floor so it is a little out of sight from the street view. Another plus is that they are HMS certified so you can be sure the meat is in compliance with the sharia of zabiha.', "Beautiful restaurant and surprisingly hidden. I wish more people knew about it. The staff deserve so much praise for maintaining this beautiful place. I've been looking for a lovely dining experience of Desi cuisine and this is it!! The food is amazing and the portions are great. I had to take the rest of my biriyani home!", "Exceptional Experience at Chef's Mahal.

I was recommended to visit Chef's Mahal, and I’m so glad I took the advice! From the welcoming atmosphere to the impeccable service and outstanding food, this place truly impressed me. The menu offers a fantastic mix of Indian and Bangladeshi cuisine, with many Bangladeshi dishes served openly, reminiscent of the more traditional setups.

We tried a variety of dishes: chicken dum biryani (extra spicy), onion kulcha, garlic naan, beef kala bhuna, kachchi, borhani, and enjoyed complimentary mango lassi and masala tea. Each dish was delicious—the chicken was perfectly tender, and the mango lassi had a wonderfully thick consistency, even though I’m not typically a fan of lassis. The flavors were vibrant and rich, and you could tell that the chef put great care into each preparation.

That said, the kala bhuna was a bit different than expected. It tasted more like jhura mangsho (shredded meat) than the traditional kala bhuna, but it was still flavorful. The raita, while tasty on its own, had a bit too much chaat masala for my taste, especially when paired with the biryani. As for the borhani, it was a bit too spicy for my preference, but my mother absolutely loved it! My favorite out of all the dishes were chicken dum biriyani & masala tea.

One of the standout features of the visit was the attentive management. They regularly checked in with guests to ensure everything was to our liking, which is always a sign of great service.

I’m already looking forward to coming back to try their polao and chicken roast on my next visit. I’ve already recommended this place to friends and family, and I’ll definitely be returning. The food is genuinely excellent, and both the chef and the management deserve a round of applause. Keep up the fantastic work, and best of luck to Chef's Mahal for continued success!", 'Very nice experience. Atmosphere gives you nice dining experience and their service was very top notch. Not hectic and chaotic like the other food places in Jackson Heights. Would recommend everyone.', "Jackson Heights always amazes me with its variety of dishes from the Indian subcontinent. Among them, this restaurant stands out for its Biryani. We tried two different kinds, and they were phenomenal. The other dishes are good as well, and the service is excellent. I don't recommend driving there, though, as parking can be a real challenge."]

name: MACA PERUVIAN RESTAURANT
reviews:
["I had the pleasure of dining at Maca Peruvian Restaurant twice recently, and both experiences were fantastic! I went once for Friday dinner and again for Saturday brunch, each time with different friends.

Friday Dinner:

We were greeted with the lively atmosphere of karaoke night, where diners could join in the fun and sing. The vibe was incredibly enjoyable, and the food was simply outstanding. We were so thrilled with everything that my friend and I even took the stage to sing a few songs!

Saturday Brunch:

The next day, I returned for brunch and had another delightful experience. The same servers from the night before were there, and they seemed pleasantly surprised to see me again so soon. Their warm hospitality made both visits memorable.

Food Highlights:

Chicharrones de Puerco: Absolutely delicious! The chicharron was perfectly crunchy yet tender, and paired wonderfully with the pickled onions and fried sweet potato.

Lomo Saltado: Hands down the best I've had in a long time. The combination of fries, rice, savory sauce, and tender beef was a delectable treat that I can't stop thinking about.

The servers were incredibly accommodating and friendly during both visits. Overall, Maca Peruvian Restaurant exceeded my expectations with its amazing food, fun atmosphere, and excellent service. I can't wait to go back someday!", "The resturant and staff is very nice. The food is another story. As a Peruvian, I have thoughts. We tried these dishes
Picarones  1/10. All you tasted was oil from frying. The sauce was not the traditional sauce, it was simple sugar. The sugar wasn't even dissolved all the way.
$10.00
Purple Corn Pudding (Mazamorra Morada) 1/10 It had a sugary flavor. The dessert was extremely watered down. It did have the traditional prune and pineapple chunk but exactly 1 piece of each.
$14.00

Lucuma Ice Cream 10/0. This dessert saved us. It was exactly as it should be and very delicious.
$9.00

Aeropuerto 10/10 This was exactly as it should be. Very traditional Peruvian. The wonton were well made and the mix was on point.
$20.00
1
Kam-Lu Wantan 2/10 This was a very disappointing dish. It was not seasoned well. The only part of it that was good was the wonton. The sauce was overly sweet and had no flavor.
$23.00

Anticuchos con Rachi 10/10 perfectly made. It was my favorite dish. The seasoning was just a but spicy that really gave it a winning touch.
$38.00

Ceviche De Pescado 3/10. The sweet potato was not done cooking. The fish was not done either. It seems as though the lime used was mixed with something else or it wasn't pure lime. In traditional ceviche if you use pure lime, you can see the difference and taste the fish is done.
$20.00

Arroz con Leche 1/10. Terrible. Watered down. Not sweet and overwhelming taste of coconut.
$8.00

Chaufa De Pollo 10/10 not exactly how it is traditionally made. But it was delicious.
$18.00

Tallarines a La Huancaina Con Bistec 10/10 It was perfect. The steak was delicious and the tallarines perfectly seasoned.
$21.00
1
Papa Rellena 10/10 perfect. Even the onions that came with it was made amazingly.
$13.00", "The atmosphere was nice but the front door continually popped open allowing cold air in. As we were close, it was a constant distraction. My steak was supposed to be medium but was well done (no pink) and a bit tough. To give the servers the benefit of the doubt it was crowded but it took a while to.order with later tables ordering before us. They also didn't come around for a long while to top drinks or see how things were. The rice was good as were my plantains. My wife liked her food. I'd give 3.5 stars but it's not an option. Don't think we'd return.", 'Food is ok. Service ok but becareful the automatically overcharged the  tip. We were me only 2 persons. Be careful,', 'I went here for my cousins birthday! What a surprise!! The staff was extremely attentive and the food was excellent. The bonus is the karaoke we sang all night long! I highly recommend this place to anyone that wants a really good laid back time!']

name: OSTERIA BAROCCA
reviews:
['This was my first visit to New York City, and I inadvertently discovered Little Italy. It was truly a dream come true, and I was determined not to leave without experiencing an authentic New York City Italian meal.

I did not rely on reviews or recommendations; instead, I wandered up and down Mulberry Street, contemplating my options. It was at this point that a gracious young woman approached and kindly offered to show me the menu, leading me to the perfect dining spot.

The experience was exceptional. The fettucine Alfredo surpassed any I have ever tasted! Ever...no joke! The atmosphere, the attentive staff, the vibrant energy, and, above all, the outstanding food made this establishment the quintessential spot in Little Italy.', "I am sad to write this review. Unfortunately
My experience is not good.
The pasta is like the most important part of the party, it was overcooked - puffy
I ordered carbonara and the sauce is not the traditional one like a carbonara, and the taste was horrible.
I ordered rib eye steak, and the meat was perfectly cooked to perfection, but the flavor was not good, no pepper, no salt, no seasoning, nothing and the fries tasted like burnt oil.
On the bill, an extra convenience fee was charged, but I wouldn't have minded if the food was good.
The positive highlight was the octopus starter which was very delicious.
The service was excellent and the atmosphere of the restaurant is very cool, I loved it! Good music and good energy.", 'Dining at Osteria Barocca was a fantastic experience! The atmosphere is inviting, with a perfect Italian charm. The pasta was fresh and bursting with flavor, especially the Brasato Di Manzo, which was absolutely divine. My husband and I also had seared octopus and it was cooked to perfection! The service was attentive and friendly, making the evening even more enjoyable. Don’t miss out the pistachio ice cream—it’s the best I’ve had! Highly recommend this gem for a delicious Italian meal.', "Wonderful pasta experience with the mushroom ravioli special. Delightful sauce and fresh mushrooms made a dish that I will dream of. Atmosphere was loud, made it hard to hear my dining companion as the seats were very close together. Did not feel rushed but didn't feel like I could linger either. Overall a good find in Little Italy.", 'Very lively place. Food was on the average side to my taste. Being vegetarian they have good selections. Service was ok - may be it was Saturday and was a busy time.']

name: MILADY'S
reviews:
["I came specifically because I saw the chicken tenders on the menu.  I have a difficult time finding chicken tenders in the City that are to my liking.  I do believe that these were the best I've had in Manhattan :)  I wish I had sampled other foods (I will be back) but I really like this place and the ambiance.

Ed:  2nd time back here.  Tried the Mushroom appetizer, the burger, and the potato skins....and loved them all :)  A big thank you to our server,  Mai, who was so pleasant and attentive!", 'Although I love to visit places with good atmosphere and somehow a viral reputation in the city, this place caught my attention and decided to give it a chance. Service was very neutral 5/10, food was good 8/10 and atmosphere was somehow 6/10. Meh . No next time. Btw be aware of this cocktail.', 'Atmosphere 6.5/10
Not a classic bar, but a restaurant with a bar. Would describe the atmosphere as “fancy, funky diner”-vibe. The disco ball felt a bit misplaced though.

Drinks 8.5/10
Definitely good drinks! Famous for their Martini and Big Apple Martini (two different drinks, both really good). Creative presentation and nice coasters!
Bonus points for their signature jelly shots, which are served in an oyster shell. Recommend to try peach ones - they were delicious.

Service 8/10
Very friendly staff and everyone was in good mood. Got in on a Thursday night with 5 people without any wait time. Prices are average for NYC

#44 North America’s Best Bars 2024 - the ranking is a bit too ambitious IMO. Definitely a great bar for a fun night out with friends, but Top 50 is a different league, for me.', 'Beautiful restaurant. Our server was very considerate and made some great recommendations. We ordered the steak and eggs and Crab Mac n cheese. The crab Mac n cheese was AMAZING! The steak was pretty good, but nothing special. Eggs were plain. I wish I was asked how I liked my eggs. \U0001f979 Overall 4/5.', "One of the best places for drinks in the city. Lovely, moody decor and ambiance. The staff has great knowledge of what they serve and are always willing to answer any questions. The drinks were absolutely amazing, Milady's is more an experience rather than just having drinks at any bar. Wide selection of liquors and diverse drink menu. Good prices for New York too."]

name: ONIEAL'S
reviews: ['Stopped in to get out of the cold and to grab a drink.  Absolutely amazing burgers here. Just wow.  And the kitchen was able to do black n blue and nailed it.   Burger nerds rejoice.', "If you're from the UK and you see the name Onieals, you expect the worst. But this is better than any Irish bar I've been to. Decent cocktails, cute outdoor seating and a solid food menu. Pretty good for lunch or an afternoon snack.", 'Wonderful staff and great food. Outside seating with a wonderful breeze for the summer in Manhattan.\nHighly recommend', 'A great spot in the area around Little Italy and Chinatown. I really enjoyed the space and feel. They also have a great happy hour from 3-7 M-W. Well made cocktails and the service was very friendly and efficient. Would return if in the area again', 'Great for a group/couple or by yourself. Friendly staff. Amazing food and drinks.']

name: SERAFINA ITALIAN RESTAURANT MEATPACKING
reviews: ['Bresaola done right, calamari delicately breaded and fried perfectly, chicken salad and mushroom ravioli were also excellent. Very good at the classic basics, they are. They were handing out Halloween goodies to the kids and parents right next to us as we ate so it was a cute costumes mini parade on a sunny day. Expensive for what it was but a delightful experience and service was friendly and perfect at a sweet and busy intersection on Saturday at high noon. Amidst all that bustle a live band was playing early Pink Floyd and king crimson sounding cool vibes.', '“Serafina is an excellent spot located in one of the most vibrant and historic areas of New York City. The restaurant offers a charming atmosphere that combines modern style with a cozy ambiance, making it perfect for an enjoyable evening. The beautifully designed interior creates the ideal setting for a night out with friends or family. The service is top-notch — the staff is attentive and always ready to help with recommendations.\n\nThe menu offers a variety of authentic Italian dishes, prepared with fresh ingredients and a focus on traditional flavors. Each dish reflects the skill and passion of the chefs who truly love their craft. If you’re looking for a place to experience genuine Italian cuisine in the heart of New York City, Serafina is an outstanding choice. Highly recommended for an unforgettable dining experience!”', 'Very good people watching. Good food, but most of it was plain and not exciting. Portions were small and expensive compared with other NYC establishments. Nothing super special, other than the location.', "Exactly what I wanted, quiet dinner under the rain under umbrella:-) Was seated fast, server came right away. The food was delicious. I ordered a lot worried and won't be able to finish. Cheers to all happy times!", "We chose to go here with friends (group of 6) on a Friday evening in May. We had a reservation and they had a space for us no problem. We chose the outside seating, which was accommodating in the yellow cabana thing outside. The inside was super small, so we didn't want to sit in there. I'm glad the temperature was about 68 degrees and decent. We ordered drinks, including the espresso martini and dirty martini, and they were tasty. We ordered the espresso martini with no Baileys. We had to ask for more water 3 times. We decided on 3 appetizers; calamari, arugula filet mignon, prosciutto on bread with cheese. All 3 of these came quickly and were good. I would say that its too much $ for the 3 slices of bread with cheese and a little prosciutto. We ordered 2 pies and they were fine, but kind of plain with flavor. We ordered entrees and got the spicy Vodka penne added grilled chicken breast. We also got the Salmon entree and the Chicken Parmesean entree. The salmon was good and cooked nicely. The Penne was not cooked enough to suit me, there was not enough Vodka sauce (I asked for more sauce and they brought it) and I definitely didn't agree with the chicken. I paid $8 to add grilled chicken breast (according to the menu). What was served was 1/8 inch slice of chicken that didn't add any flavor to my dish. When I took a bite, I couldn't even tell I was eating chicken and pasta. The chicken Parmesean was a 12 inch wide pizza looking item. It was like a piece of very thin chicken, breaded, with sauce thrown on it. Threw us for a loop, but it tasted fine. They also added a 20% gratuity because our party had 6 people."]

name: MANGIA SOHO - ITALIAN RESTAURANT, LUNCH & CORPORATE CATERING
reviews:
["This charming little spot is a true hidden gem for anyone looking for a fresh and satisfying meal. I stopped by for a late lunch and ordered the Tuna Nicoise Salad, which was absolutely delightful. The ingredients were incredibly fresh, and though they'd run out of mesclun, I was kindly kindly choose to choose from other greens. Baby kale and arugula were just as tasty.

What I loved most was that you can customize your own salads or sandwiches, and everything is mixed right in front of you. The interior has a cozy, welcoming vibe, and the staff were incredibly friendly.

Although this place seems designed more for takeout, with all meals served in to-go boxes and limited seating, I was lucky to get a table inside. Even with the minimalist dining setup, the quality of the food and the warm atmosphere more than make up for it.

I didn’t try their pastries, but they looked irresistible and are on my list for next time. If you’re in the area, this is definitely a spot worth visiting. I truly enjoyed my visit!", "Mangia has become our favorite go-to spot and we just can't get enough. It's become such a part of our routine that we can't imagine starting our day without it. Everything about this place is outstanding, from the staff to the food to the drinks. It’s like our own little secret European cafe right in the middle of Soho! Lilo’s espresso is hands down the best in New York City, and he never fails to put a smile on our faces. The whole team at Mangia feels like family now, and that's what makes it so special. Plus, the food is consistently delicious and fresh. In a city with no shortage of great coffee shops and restaurants, Mangia stands out as one of the best in the area. Please do yourself a favor and stop by if you haven’t yet - you won't be disappointed!! P.S. watch out for the Green Goddess juice….its dangerously addictive!!", 'Busy place all the time since they offer a lot of selections from meals to snacks for both locals who work and visitors who shop around the area.

My review at this moment , straightly goes to 🍫❤️‍🔥Chocolate tart which was AMAZING. It really surprised me since I didn’t have a high expectation. The chocolate shell was crunchy, mousse was creamy with two different fillings.

The tahini cookie was delicious as well! Not too heavy but enough. Won’t go wrong.

Also, would like to go back for meals! (Staff recommended their salads.)', 'Liked the idea of the cafe. U can do ur own sandwich or salad also they have ready made. No enough place to sit neither inside or outside. One bathroom for men and women which wasn’t convenient', 'This place is a gem, quality ingredients and great presentation. We had food here 4 times and tried pretty much all the sections - live sandwich and salad is the star of the show. Great place!! Highly recommended.']

name: THE CORNER CHINESE RESTAURANT
reviews:
['Decided to give this place a shot and was pleasantly surprised. We really enjoyed all of our dishes and the food came out fresh and hot. The portion sizes are really good as well and we happily took home leftovers. We had the Sesame chicken (not pictured) and the Sweet and Sour Pork and both were really good and crispy. Hope to come back and try more dishes soon.', "Myself and 3 friends wanted Chinese food while visiting NYC, so I did a Google search and this spot was about 9 min away walking from our hotel in Times Square. My food was really good! I had Chicken w/ Broccoli and Fried Chicken Wings. The wings were crispy & hot! I would definitely eat here again whenever I'm in NYC again.", 'The service is amazing. The moment I dropped my napkins, a staff saw it and gave me a new one right away. Fresh ingredients and good meat. Sweet sour chicken is tasty and pineapple is fresh. Hot and sour soup is a bit bland for me.', "Tucked away on a quiet corner, this unassuming Chinese restaurant is a true gem. From the moment you step inside, you're greeted by a warm and inviting atmosphere. The decor is simple yet elegant, and the staff is incredibly friendly and attentive.

The menu offers a wide variety of classic Chinese dishes, all prepared with fresh, high-quality ingredients. The egg rolls are crispy and flavorful, the kung pao chicken is spicy and satisfying, and the sweet and sour pork is tangy and delicious. The portions are generous, and the prices are reasonable.

Whether you're a seasoned Chinese food enthusiast or simply looking for a delicious and affordable meal, the Corner Chinese Restaurant is a must-try. It's a place where you can truly savor the authentic flavors of Chinese cuisine in a comfortable and welcoming setting.", 'Was looking for Duck and did a little Googling and this popped up. From when I first walked in until I left everything was very welcoming.
Started with a perfect Martini and moved to billowy wonton soup. I love baby boy chop and this did not disappoint!!
The main attraction was the crispy duck chow fun. Did not expect a duck breast on top!!
The house made hoisin was off the charts.
Will be back again.']

name: PLUM VIETNAMESE RESTAURANT
reviews: ['Small portions, inauthentic taste, very little meat. The kimchi fries were nothing special. When I asked for bean sprouts, lime, and basil, they told me there were already bean sprouts in the soup. Yeah, like five pieces. They also had no basil. They didn’t disclose that they would charge me extra for the bean sprouts — good thing I spotted it before paying and called them out.\n\nDon’t come here; you will be disappointed and unsatisfied.', 'Super great food! Strongly recommend duck curry! The shaken steak and egg is very healthy. Thai tea tastes great! Will recommend everyone have a try!', 'I love this cute little authentic Vietnamese restaurant! Their pho is incredible❤️ I’ve been here twice already and every time I enjoy their food and service 🥰', 'The type of noodle they use for pho is simply just so WRONG, pho noodle should be thinner and flat. Overall the beef pho was very mediocre, nothing special. Rec to try other things only menu but not any of the pho they serve. Good service but really can’t make up for lack of authenticity and flavor.', 'Have come here twice now. The pho broth was very watery the first time and needed some salt but came back tonight and it was so delicious. Hands down the best pho I’ve had in NYC! (And if you look at my reviews you can see I’ve tried quite a few 😂 so I hope that says something!) Definitely also recommend the shaking beef, curry puffs, spring rolls, and fried dumplings.']

name: MOON KEE RESTAURANT
reviews:
['They offer an amazing dim sum experience! The staff is very friendly and prompt, and the restaurant itself is aesthetically pleasing and very clean.

The pan fried noodle Hong Kong style off the menu is exceptional. 10/10', 'I have ordered from here many times in the past and have never had bad experiences. Tonight my order included the minced beef rice roll and pork soup dumplings. Instead of minced beef, the rice roll contained a very unappetizing mush of meat, almost like a paste. We could not eat it. I’ve ordered this dish from Moon Kee before, and tonight’s version was very different.
The pork soup dumplings we got were undercooked- the dough was still too chewy.

I called the restaurant and they were very accommodating. They offered to bring me a new rice roll and soup dumplings, but since I did not want to gamble on another rice roll, I asked for 2 orders of soup dumplings. They agreed and it was delivered to me fairly quickly. The replacement soup dumplings were cooked appropriately and tasted better.

I think they used to include more than 4 dumplings in an order, or at least they used to be bigger. 4 dumplings of this size for $10 seems overpriced compared to most restaurants.

The sesame balls from here are always delicious!', 'Beautiful atmosphere large tables though would be nice with a tablecloth. Service is attentive and bring out food very often, and food is delicious. Better than chinatown and as good as dim sum in Vancouver. Lots of flavours and meat is very tender. Has cantonese flavours so it is very authentic and tastes authentic! Very pleased. Good price as well', 'The Dim sum are  good, the HK style noodle just taste like you are eating in HK. The Claypot Rice is outstanding but it takes 10-15 mins to prepare so order once you sit down. Friendly staff. A hidden gem in upper West Side. They have 3 round tables good for large group.', "I spent my childhood in Hong Kong and try to visit every year. I'm always on the lookout for good Cantonese cuisine, so I was thrilled when Moon Kee opened in my neighborhood. Hong Kong restaurants have a unique energy, and I immediately felt it upon entering. The staff recommended some dim sum options. They even shared that they made their own soy sauce and what items were coming out in the cart next. The food was fantastic, including the dim sum, barbecue meats, egg tarts, and clay pot rice. It definitely satisfied my craving for authentic Chinese food until I can return to Hong Kong. I plan on returning to Moon Kee and would highly recommend it to anyone looking for delicious Chinese food with an authentic touch in the Upper West Side."]

name: BARRIO CHINO
reviews:
['Absolutely fantastic food! Everything was so delicious and we can’t wait to go back again! Had the guacamole and house made chips, steak tacos and enchiladas verdes along with a Paloma Margarita. Yum yum yum! Our waiter Justino was fantastic and very personable - can’t wait to go back again! Delicious!', 'We had the classic margarita, tamarind mezcalita, guacamole, tuna tostada and barbacoa (the reason I come here 😋). All delicious and authentic. Service was just ok. Server not as attentive.', 'The Al Pastor & Carnitas tacos slapped. Great ambiance and friendly bartender. We loved the tequila infusions and their mezcal list. Wish we saved room for more! We will be back next time we are in town.', "Can almost never go wrong with tacos and Barrio Chino didn't disappoint. Arrived on a somewhat busy night without reservation. Outdoor seating was readily available. We had chicken, and steak tacos. You have a choice of ordering two or three tacos. You can only pick one type (chicken, or steak, etc). So we ordered two chicken and two steak tacos and switched one out. Servers were nice and attentive. The tacos came out fast and were delicious.", 'MEXcellent
Just across the street from me is @barriochinony so I had to try it! @stephbarbanell and I got some great food and drinks. I tried the barbacoa (lamb) tacos with pickled onions, chili pepper, and a salsa verde with a side of elote while Steph tried a quesadilla with chorizo topped with slices of avocado. I had a classic margarita and she tried the jalapeño grapefruit one. All was great!!

Taco bout a fiesta
Theres always a fiesta going on at @barriochinony ! Their tacos are and chips are so great that they’re always busy! I’ve been a few times now and they never disappoint, especially being conveniently located just down the block from me. We ordered chips and guac & salsa roja, steak tacos with avocado, and lamb tacos with red@pickled onions. Such simple meals yet such special flavors']

name: LEX RESTAURANT
reviews: ["We had to send back the rack of lamb, because we didn't know it was fried, so we ordered the Branzino instead. Good flavor but we prefer the skin a bit more krispy. I ordered my steak medium rare the first 25% of the steak was over cooked, but still juicy, once I got to the center part it was cooked to perfection. The fried calamari was delicious.", 'A traditional Italian restaurant with excellent service and good food. We sat at the outdoor heated seating, which was very comfortable but have also previously dined indoors. The indoor decor is very cozy. The seafood risotto was excellent, and the veal piccata was tender and well marinated. We ordered the special dessert for the day (apple crumble pie with ice cream) and the warm chocolate brownie with ice cream. Both desserts were super yummy.', 'Beef lasagna special and fettuccine were amazing. Service was top notch. Thank you!', 'Amazing food, good service. One of the Go2 Italian restaurants ever!', 'Definitely not recommending this place. The waiter was very pushy in upselling the food. Food was okay but not to come back for. It was lacking freshness and vibrance. Prices are too high for what is presented. The restroom was not clean, no towel(s) and very smelly. We had to take our own coats when we were leaving. The television(!!!!) at the bar was an annoying distraction. The courtesy to say goodbye from staff was not there. We went here because of the positive reviews. But this place has had its best days long ago…']

name: THE RED GRILL
reviews:
["Came for the margaritas. I asked for strawberry flavor, but the chick instead gave me coconut. I must admit it was pretty good, too. I also asked for wings and mozzarella sticks, but instead got wings and calamari. 👀 The wings weren't fully cooked and were big for nothing. The calamari was ok. I had better. Anyways, I guess this place gives you what they feel you need, not what you ordered. But since the drinks were two for one, I will come back. 😌 And from other post, I didn't even know they had lunch specials. The waitress should inform the customers when they are seated.", 'I have tried two main courses here and found them both lacking pleasingly good flavor. One of them was the (pictured below) Grilled Pork Chops (2). The black beans that accompanied the Pork Chops did not come close to the best that I have had elsewhere. They have what they call "The Tower," (pictured below), it is a mixture of seafood and sea bass, served at refrigerator temperature. I found it to have only the flavor of spices. Save 3% by paying with cash.', 'Not a good restaurant. We went there because we had a craving for Mexican food. The food was bland, and the service was slow and inattentive. We ordered the appetizer “Cali Nachos” and ordered our entrees. but we got our entrees first. When we asked the server about the app, she asked “oh, you wanted nachos???”
I do not recommend this place.', 'There is a 3% surcharge if you pay by credit card.

As for the food, it’s decent if not basic, nothing special. The enchilada lunch special ($15.19, tax included) needed more heat/chilies. I also had to ask for the lunch menu; if you were not aware then you’d end ordering from the more expensive dinner menu.', "Came here for lunch with my family. Nice place,with good prices. Food came out hot and the drinks were good. Its a pretty basic mexican restaurant, no frills and such but if you're looking for decent food for a decent you could definitely do worse."]

name: PIKINE
