reviews: ["I wish I could give zero stars. I went to this establishment and ordered swee plantains and lamb dibi. Something told me to check my food before leaving but I didn't.  When I got home, this was the worst sweet plantain I have ever seen.. I can't believe everyone who works there saw these alloco and decided to serve/sell this to a customer.  The plantain itself was spoiled and old. I have attached a picture.. this was my first and last time ever buying here. So disappointed!!", 'Lovely foray into Senegalese cuisine. The Thiebou Djeun (fish stew) and Thiebou Yapp (lamb dish) were phenomenally plated, generously portioned, and tasted as flavorful as meat and carbs can be. Lively, down to earth atmosphere that’s cozy and feels authentic to the area: you see mostly locals and people who know how to eat good food. Be prepared to take your time and breathe in the good vibes and good company :)', "The food was incredibly good. This spot was recommended by a Senegalese friend. We asked the cashier (who doubles as the waitress too) what dishes she would recommend and she didn't miss. The ginger juice is definitely worth having.\nIt got very noisy as more patrons came in and I wish they can try to watch this part because it can be slightly annoying when you can't hear the person you are dining with.", 'It was for lunch after my daughter’s college graduation. The service was slow to me. We sat there  for a good while before someone came to our table. I don’t think they gave us a menu. However, we ordered the food and drinks. Pineapple ginger beer was the best drink I had. Food was also very good. It was a lot of food. I wish the server explained more about the dishes. They were more attentive for other people. Maybe they were regular customers? Even though I was not impressed by their service, the food was worth it.', 'Absolutely delicious! Came twice in a span of 5 days. This is a hidden gem that l wish l knew about sooner. Portions are insane, the taste is authentic and fresh and it feels like you’re eating straight from a Senegalese home. 100% recommend. Prices are unmatchable on top of that.']

name: BELLA LUNA RESTAURANT
reviews:
['Delicious authentic Italian food! The staff were prompt and professional and our came out quickly. The pasta tasted fresh and everything was delicious. We especially enjoy the portion size and found it to be a fantastic value as well as amazing quality. The interior is comfortable and the wine selection had a good range.', 'I had a wonderful chicken parmigiana and a couple of beers while sitting on their pleasant patio. I would recommend getting their pasta in any form. My friend also raved about the lamb chops.', 'We visited Bella Luna on a Saturday afternoon in May after going to Riverside Park. We were greeted so warmly by the staff and the handsome waiter even offered to charge my phone. I had the Eggplant Parmagian which was excellent although the steamed veggies on the side were very bland. My sister had the Chicken Piccata which could have had a bit more flavor. The Bow tie pasta with marinara served on the side was very good and perfectly al dente. . Dessert was a Berry Tarte which was delish!', 'Excellent Italian restaurant on the Upper West Side.  The Calamari appetizer was tasty and delicious.  Salad appetizers fresh. A large number of main courses including brick oven pizza to choose from.
Linguine in white clam sauce absolutely delicious.  And, with "real and large clams in the shell". Shrimp scampi and Lobster Ravioli were outstanding.
The Tiramisu was one of the best I've ever had.
Nice atmosphere and very good service.
Ciao Bella!', 'PARENTS:  Good place to take kids for the price. It’s a little tight, but the bathrooms are clean and they do offer outside seating.

The pizza, minestrone (veggie soup), and julienned vegetables. The total with tax, came to $30.  Not bad! The pizza was shareable but it’s a little bigger than a personal pan pizza. Perfect for anyone who orders with a friend and you split everything. There’s enough but the other person should still order something else if you’re looking to be full from the meal. The minestrone soup wasn’t good. It lacked flavor and the zucchini chunks were under seasoned and too mushy. The cooked veggies had much more flavor!']

name: ABA TURKISH RESTAURANT
reviews:
['We happen to be in the area and came across this restaurant, I knew you could never go wrong with Turkish food, they would always have my cravings satisfied regarding chicken kebab, having to be born and raised in an Arab country. As always, I know Turkish food would always taste the best, and this restaurant is giviiiiiiiiiiiiing that vibes! A definitely a must to try and in a good neighborhood if it gets crowded while waiting for your reservation. Servers were really nice and they had given us complimentary Baklava. Also we did try the Dinner Special. That roasted eggplant with tomato is a killer! That didn’t stand a chance with the free bread they offered! The tea with Baklava too shouldn’t be missed! Will definitely come back 😍', 'Talk about don’t judge a book by its cover. I probably wouldn’t have picked this place to eat based on its rating but I’m so glad I did because it was amazing!

Service was a bit spotty at first but the food came out pretty quickly once we placed our order.

Started off with the bread which was fresh and warm. Sort of the inside and perfect crunchy on the outside. Had it with the olive oil but you should definitely ask to have it with the red sauce or the Tzatziki sauce!

Ordered the chicken chop and man it’s some of the most flavorful chicken I’ve had. The chicken was soft and well seasoned and paired really nicely with the red cabbage which I surprisingly enjoyed. Again either the red spicy sauce or the Tzatziki sauce can add extra flavor and take your meal up a notch.  You also can’t beat the value you get with this meal with three pieces of chicken thighs.

Tried some of their falafel and chicken Adana and they were really good as well.

Had the Backlava for desert and it was delectably sweet, flaky, and delicious! Had it with the Turkish tea which is absolutely a must try!

Overall I left feeling full and content. Would eat here again!', 'The food was amazing. The three course meal is the way to go. Turkish tea and the overall food made me feel like I was in Turkey & the atmosphere felt authentic. I highly recommend eating here for the lunch special.', 'Dolma (stuffed graped leaves), Manti, and Aba combo were all good!
Chicken and lamb cop were so tender.', "The most authentic Turkish I've had in the area. Lentil soup was the best I've ever had. And the complimentary bread with dipping oil is the star of the show!"]

name: SESAMO - ITALIAN RESTAURANT HELL'S KITCHEN NYC WITH ASIAN INFLUENCES
reviews:
['I saw a friend post about this restaurant on social media, and she recommended it, so I was excited to try it. It offers Asian-inspired Italian cuisine, which sounds really interesting! We ordered two appetizers and two entrees. We both loved the appetizers, but we were a bit unsure about the taste of the entrees; they were just okay. The service was a bit slow, but we enjoyed the atmosphere while we waited. Overall, it was a fun experience, and I’m glad I tried this unique blend of flavors!', 'Tried this place after googling Italian places that have vegan options. They have a vegetarian options and one vegan dish. I tried their vegan lasagne tartufo. Wasn’t bad. The sauce was good I asked for bread on the side. I tried their lemon spritz which is their version of limoncello—was refreshing. I would say they’re more American than they area Italian. They have other Asian inspired dishes on the menu. The fried artichokes are good. The matcha tiramisu is interesting. Has a crunch and enough sweetness balanced by the bitterness of the matcha. They have patio seating. Inside seating is better on a humid day. Wish it was more memorable. Their service is good at least. Our server didn’t check on us too many times like other places. Didn’t feel rushed. I’d recommend it to those who are curious about fusion food.', 'This restaurant was absolutely amazing!! We went on a Sunday evening, no wait, great food and great service. Our waitress was also our hostess and bartender and never missed a beat! We ordered the caesar salad to split.  2 of us ordered the tempura chicken parmesean, pappardelle and added clams, and the duck ragu rigatoni! Everything was simply delicious!!!', 'Came here for dinner on a Sunday night and really enjoyed everything! Each dish was delicious and our server was amazing. Can’t wait to be back!', 'Italian with an Asian twist. So....basically every Italian restaurant? As any discerning foodie can tell you, Asian "influences" are a baked-in part of any Western restaurant more upscale than McDonald's. A little soy this, yuzu that, curry here, wasabi there--you get the drill. Pasta with Asian touches is hardly novel.

So I didn't have high hopes for Sesamo when I came here, and sadly, those expectations were pretty on point.

The Branzino Crudo was fine but forgettable, without any Asian touches I could see. The Duck Ragu Pappardelle was okay as well, but I've had better noodles and sauce, and definitely more tender duck. The Matcha Tiramisu--can we stop adding matcha to everything already? I mean, it's really just used as a natural coloring agent half the time, and in the case of tiramisu, it adds nothing of value to an already tried and true classic.

At least we got to partake in happy hour before they shut it down. Though I'd skip the boba cocktails like the watered down Peach White Tea I had. These drinks don't contain any actual tapioca, which is what boba is supposed to be. More like juice-filled pearls that don't taste like anything but sugary syrup. Not great.']

name: 5 ACRES RESTAURANT
reviews:
['Food is good. The restaurant is so busy and we waited for 40 min for two bar seats. Food was good and the waiters were welcoming and quick. They included 20% gratitude which is not standard for a party of two.', "I love this location in the heart of Rockefeller Center.  It is perfect for people watching during Happy Hour or for a quick dinner before a show.  My favorites include their endless fries and the off menu espresso martini!  I also love the Chicago Beef sandwich and the seafood tower... although I haven't had something I didn't like.", 'While waiting to attend the musical Himilton, my friend and I decided to eat here for lunch. I had a salad and she had 5 cheese & macaroni. I also ordered the brussel sprouts and the key lime pie for desert. The Brussels sprouts were burnt and salty so not a good idea to order them. The pie was very good put the coconut whip didn’t taste good to me. My friend said the macaroni was very good! I enjoyed the salad and loved the real bacon bits. The honey vinaigrette salad dressing was also very tasty.
The food is pretty pricy; I added chicken and bacon bits to salad so the total was $30. Our check was $66 and they add 20% gratuity plus tax.
Our server brought us a check for $162, he stated that another server added to it by mistake so he had to redo. Overall, the service was good and the food so I recommend if in the area.', "I recently dined at Five Acres and had an overall enjoyable experience. The food was good, the prices were reasonable, and the service was satisfactory. However, the restaurant's decision to automatically add a 20% gratuity charge to the bill without informing the customers beforehand was a significant drawback. If customers are aware of this policy, there should be no issue with providing additional tips as desired.

The food at Five Acres was of decent quality, with a variety of options available on the menu. The flavors were good, and the presentation was appealing. The prices were fair, considering the quality of the food and the dining experience.

The service provided by the staff was satisfactory, The staff members were polite and attentive, ensuring that our needs were met throughout the meal.   However, the restaurant's decision to include a 20% gratuity charge on the bill without prior notice was a major disappointment. Transparency is important when it comes to such matters, and it would have been better if the restaurant had informed customers about this policy in advance.", 'Nothing really special about this place. Seemed to be the safer choice for us, our last day roaming around Rockefeller before heading to the airport. Just basic American fare, choices could have been better. Food could have been better. If you don’t like auto-tipping, keep it moving!']

name: LE BAOBAB GOUYGUI
reviews:
["First time having Senegalese food, and I was NOT disappointed! TLDR: Go here!! It's delicious!

We came in on a Sunday between 930 and 10 pm... and this place stayed busy until we left about 1045.

The portions are huge and the prices are great! We should have taken a cue from the locals and shared a big dish, but we wanted to try several things. I'm glad we did get a variety because we ate it all for leftovers the next night!

I forgot to take a picture of two of the dishes: Thiebou Yapp and Lamb Maffe... they were both excellent, though! The Lamb Maffe was a little too spicy for me, but it was still so good!! The Yapp was great also! The other two (pictured) were the Mechoui and Thieray. Delicious!!!

Definitely adding to my saved restaurants!", 'Generous portions of delicious food. Both the Thiboudienne and the okra lamb stew were amazing', 'This Senegalese restaurant I went to with my bf was so good the food was great, the service was top tier, the atmosphere there was just like eating at home with family! I was only in NY for less than 24hrs. My bf and I made it our mission to get there! I can’t wait to go back, I had the thiebou yapp (Chebb) I believe he had the lamb. Overall a great experience the owner sat next to us, I just felt so loved, she is so attentive to everyone that steps foot in those doors! I can’t wait to come back 💗', "HONESTLY YOU WONT FIND A NICE RESTAURANT AS THIS OPEN 1 AM IN THE MORNING in Harlem I had grilled Tilapia amazing everything tasted good.  I'd definitely recommend this Athuentic Senegalese Restaurant for dining in great service big meals for youre money just make sure you order from the counter and have a seat at one of the tables and shortly after I was served. Definitely going back again.", 'During my trip to New York, I enjoyed my favorite national lunch ,Rice,Fish and vegetables 😋 at this welcoming, friendly Senegalese restaurant. Enjoyed my lunch and this beautifully social, cultural friendly atmosphere of back home.']

name: INTI PERUVIAN RESTAURANT
reviews: ['Inti is a beautiful restaurant. The food is delicious 😋   I enjoy a lot with my husband. We had a good time. I recommend people to go and taste the delicious Peruvian food.', 'We had inti chicken with Peruvian drinks and it was delicious, the aji tasted like the original Peruvian flavor. We enjoyed the ambiental music as well as the place. We would definetly go back.\nJust fyi tip is automatically charged but its worth it.', 'Absolutely amazing restaurant for authentic Peruvian food in Hells Kitchen, New York. We went for a Sunday dinner and the place was filled with what seemed like regular clientele and not tourists. We tried ceviche, seafood soup, yuca fries and tres leches dessert, and everything was top-notch. The portions were huge! This intimate restaurant has a very family-run vibe. The wait staff was very cheerful. We would love to go back!', 'Great service! The food was yummy, though I could’ve gone for a bit more seasoning. The restaurant is very clean and our server was attentive and kind. Great music too!', 'Such delicious and authentic food. It’s a must visit and the staff are so lovely and gave great recommendations on dishes and amount of food. The ceviche was so divine and the paella was beyond incredible. Would recommend a visit!']

name: HEIDELBERG RESTAURANT
reviews: ['We had a fantastic dining experience! We ordered the pork shank for two, and it was incredibly tender and juicy. The sausage was also packed with flavor and perfectly seasoned. The portions were generous—so much so that we couldn’t finish the entire plate and ended up taking some home.\n\nOverall, we loved everything about the meal and the service. Highly recommend!', 'Simply exceptional, old-world German cuisine. Came here on a Bourdain-inspired food tour of New York and wasn’t disappointed. Fried cheese, cheesy German noodles with just the right amount of crispy bacon on the top? Perfection. Coupled with authentic schnitzel and (an enormous portion) of pork knuckle that’s beautifully crispy on the outside, tender delicious on the inside, this was the culinary highlight of our trip. A must eat stop in NYC, as long as you’re not a vegetarian that is.', 'This place is a fantastic German restaurant! 🇩🇪Heidelberg on the UES 🗽 serves a wonderful selection of delicious 🤤 authentic German dishes 🍽️ - definitely get the Jagerschnitzel with Noodles in Mushroom 🍄 White ⚪ Sauce. The staff 👨\u200d🍳 is friendly and professional, service is quick ⏲️, ambience 🎶 is great, and the place is beautifully decorated! 🛋️ The have lots of indoor seating 🪑 and a garden 🏡 in the back with outdoor seating. I wish I came here sooner!', "I have been craving my grandfather's sauerbraten for some time. I don't have the patience or memory to prep 3-5 days. This was a perfect compromise. The potato dumplings and red cabbage were comforting. Splurged and had the Black Forest cake too  can't speak highly enough about the service.", 'Service is great. When I come here with my fiancé we usually sit by the bar . The bartender is so friendly and she gives the best recommendations. ☺️']

name: SUPER TASTE
reviews:
['Amazing, wonderful, beautiful, outstanding. I have not stopped thinking about these noodles since I’ve put them in my mouth.

I got some kind of spicy noodle with no broth, and boyfriend got dan dan noodles I think. We also got the dumplings as an appetizer. Everything was OUTSTANDING.

We came around 8:00 on a weekday after a huge rush, and they still were able to put love into their food and get it out in a timely manner. The guy at the front was awesome and a great people person.

They also had some really delicious beverages! I’d recommend to anybody I love. This place was amazing.', 'Food was incredible and amazing value, flavours were uncompromised and perfect. The front of house dude was so nice and reminded me why the tipping system exists. Will come here and support this place until I leave NY!', 'Ambiance (5/5): The small interior can seat 4 parties (1 table being larger to fit 8). I thought the inside was brightly lit and clean. No frills in décor.
Service (N/A): I ordered at the kiosk by the front desk. The staff was friendly and no issues with the order.
Food (5/5): I only ordered 1 dish which was the Burning Noodles. The bowl is a heavy portion of noodles and a pretty good amount of flavor-packed meat and sauces. I ended up eating it take-away about 45min later so it was my fault that the sauce had congealed. However, the taste profile was still spot-on!
I plan to return to try their other dishes!

Returned again in a week. Got the Dan Dan and was also equally tasty. Authentic Chinese taste. Nice spice level and def coming back for more!', 'Omg! Their name really live up to their food!  Their food is tasty!

We ordered beef noodle soup and it was incredible! The noodles were chewy, just how
I like it, the beef pieces were generous, tyht broth was so flavorful and their chili oil was spot on!

My friends also ordered dumplings and they were huge portions! Worth the price!', 'My friend and I picked this place because it was close and we were drawn to prices. The food was 5 stars. I got the biang biang noodles and she got the stewed pork over rice. I liked how thick the noodles were and it got more and more tasty as I got closer to the bottom because all the sauce was really concentrated. My friend enjoyed her simple yet comforting pork. She says it was very hearty and the soft boiled egg was the best part of the meal. The service was also very good. I overheard the Johnson at the counter taking time to chat with his customers. I could see him leading his team and hustling to serve each bowl of noodles. The atmosphere was clean and simple. I’d definitely go back again!']

name: L'OSTERIA
reviews:
['The space is small but cozy and very clean. The star of the menu is mainly pasta. I really like the green color and basil flavor of the Fusilli Pesto, and the Shrimp Linguine has a delicious sauce mixed with the shrimp! The tiramisu is a bit sweet, but the creamy flavor is rich and tasty. It would be even better with slightly less sweetness!', 'Grabbed a simple lunch after going to the MET because this place was nearby. The service here is spectacular with attentive hosts that make great recommendations.

The swordfish steak which was an off-menu special was the highlight of the meal, it actually saved the lunch considering the pesto fusilli tasted off (like tissue paper) and the shrimp linguine was so and so. The squash blossoms were okay, not as good as other spots I’ve had them in.

Good place to have a simple lunch if you’re around the area, but not an Italian highlight.', 'Chicken parm! One of the best in the neighborhood! Not on the menu but I asked nicely and they made it happen. 36$. The texture and flavor were great. Loved the aged Parmesan that was melted on top. The garnish was cute but didn’t add a lot of flavor.

Came with a nice side salad as well. The wait staff were very nice and attentive. The bread and oil before the entree came out were not amazing but not terrible.', 'The food was a delicious experience! They have very nice italian noodles! I also loved the desserts! The waiter was very friendly and everything felt authentic italian. The restaurant is small and cozy.', 'Grabbed a simple lunch after going to the MET because this place was nearby. The service here is spectacular with attentive hosts that make great recommendations. The swordfish steak which was an off-menu special was the highlight of the meal, it actually saved the lunch considering the pesto fusilli tasted off (like tissue paper) and the shrimp linguine was so and so. The squash blossoms were okay, not as good as other spots I’ve had them in.']

name: NEW CHINATOWN RESTAURANT AND BAR | ASIAN FUSION | CHINESE AND THAI FOOD
reviews: ['We ordered coconut fried rice, crispy salty pepper shrimps, general Tso’s beef, and uptown duck tonight. The coconut fried rice really blew my mind. The flavor was good, and they even scraped out the meat of the coconut and combined it into the fried rice. The shrimps in the fried rice were pretty fresh, too. It was my favorite dish of the night. The general Tso’s beef was also outstanding. The seasoning was just spot on, and created a very balanced flavor. The uptown duck was also pretty good. The duck was crispy on the outside and tender on the inside. In addition, they were boneless!! The red curry was nice, but too mild to my taste. All the vegetables were nice and fresh, it came with pumpkins, sweet peppers, bamboo shoots, and eggplants. The crispy salty and pepper shrimps were actually kind of bland and disappointing. I thought it would be more flavorful, but the saltiness was so overpowering, and the pepper flavor was not strong enough. Overall, most of the dishes exceeded my expectations. I would like to come back and tried the other items on the menu.', 'Serene is the word that comes to mind when I think of New Chinatown Restaurant. The plant decor coupled with the classical piano renditions of popular songs makes you feel as if you have been transported to a greenhouse or garden oasis, making it the perfect place to catch up with a friend while enjoying delicious food or a quiet, peaceful dinner. They offer both Thai and Chinese and serve fairly large portions at ridiculously affordable prices, so be sure to come hungry. They have a great $12 lunch special and offer happy hour specials from 3:30 to 6:30 PM on Mondays to Saturdays.', "We started with the shuami which had a pea on top that was the best shumai I ever had .  Also started with the rainbow soup dumplings each individual dumplings had its own unique ingredient inside which made it interesting to see what you get . For entrees we did the pineapple rice with chicken. I also had an item that wasn't even on the menu but the beef was great nice spices to it very traditional tasting dish drank a lychee martini also which hit the spot for happy hour highly recommend this place for a dine in or quick bite . Enjoy", 'If you’re looking for a cute restaurant with amazing genuine Chinese cuisine, this is the right place! I love the juicy pork soup dumplings and honey walnuts shrimp! The soup dumplings are homemade and it tasted different than other dumplings I ate before. The staff Jessy was so nice and patient. Definitely rate 5 stars！', 'Had such a wonderful evening here on New Years Eve. My party of 4 were greeted quickly, and treated so nicely by all the staff. The interior is beautifully decorated. The appetizers came out promptly and the drinks were all so pretty and delicious. Finally the food was delicious! Would definitely be returning.']

name: FINE FOOD CUISINE
reviews:
['This was absolutely one of the best dining experiences I have had in New York, no, wait, maybe the United States.  It was a quiet rainy Friday night.  I called ahead to see if they had any happy hour specials and was surprised to hear that they didn’t have any alcohol, but the menu was compelling so we headed out to experience this new restaurant.  And I could not be happier!  We were fairly alone in the restaurant and could really drink in the atmosphere.  From the chandeliers to the intricate pedestals on the tables everything had a fantastic vibe.  Not a bite was taken and the scene was already set for a great meal.  The staff was great and didn’t miss a beat when I asked the waitress for the story behind the restaurant.  And it is a compelling story that most recently had them moving from the Bronx due to an electric fire.  Such sad news for them but it is definitely a benefit for east Harlem.  I had a great feeling about the meal so went right for the chefs special of a stuffed pineapple, which I chose the salmon with a spicy jerk sauce.  I decided to throw the gauntlet down and put a challenge by requesting the sides to be Mac and cheese and onion rings…. I explained that I knew it was odd.  I didn’t tell them I was doing it to see how they would take this odd, but interesting pairing together.  The chef hit the ball outta the park!  It was plated to perfection, and was a very meaty salmon (almost tasted pacific to me) with an incredible jerk glaze that dripped down on the onion rings and Mac and cheese that wee under the salmon.  This was the best version of onion rings, and fantastic Mac and cheese, but the true amazing part of the meal was the fusion of flavors.  I had no intention of eating the whole thing, but I did.  We decided to try the desert just to see what it tasted like.  It was a red velvet cake with a cheesecake frosting.  I don’t know where they got the cake but it was certainly up to the rest of the culinary challenge.  I would urge you to try this place out.  It was that good!  If I could give more stars I would.  A new bar is set for me for NYC .  I must have gushed quite a bit, the chef came out to meet me, Al was lovely and gave me a big hug.  Al was incredibly gracious, and wonderful.  He didn’t even mention that it was his restaurant.  Well Al, well done!  Very well done!  You made a huge fan of the little foodie, and you have inspired me to continue to find places like this and make sure I do my part by exposing them to new people.  Larry the manager and Gina our server were equally committed to our enjoyment.  I could write another couple of pages about my wife and daughter’s meal as well, but I have probably already bored you with the praise for my meal.  I guarantee that we will all be coming back, and my daughter who lives around the corner will be back even more.  A sincere thank you to the entire staff for a magical dining experience.  My compliments to the Chef!!!!', 'I was recommended this place shortly after moving to Florida 6 years ago. Yesterday I finally had a chance to come home and try it. I can say without a doubt I was very impressed. Every dish I ordered was something I typically don’t eat. (Shellfish and tilapia).

I had crab cakes which were soft and savory.
Lobster Mac and Cheese, which had the perfect consistency for me personally, it was not overwhelmingly cheesy, just the perfect amount. I enjoyed the fact that there was lobster in every bite. Chef did not hold back on the LOBSTER part of the lobster Mac and Cheese. Main course was the fried tilapia; the crunch and seasoning was the best fish fry I have ever had in my life. The garlic mash and sautéed spinach were the perfect sides.

I truly recommend 10/10', 'I’ve been excited to try what I’ve been seeing on instagram. They didn’t disappoint.

We got a whole mess of things: voodoo chicken, jerk chicken, shrimp, mussels, lamb, hangar steak, and the chicken chicharrones.

The meat was cooked and seasoned perfectly, with simple but gorgeous presentation that takes a cue from fine dining, and the sides were generous and tasty.

The space was inviting, R&B playlist was great, and everything was clean.

They were a little understaffed; seemed like the takeaway orders were swamping them, but everyone was having fun and the staff were friendly and helpful.

The price was definitely affordable considering it’s in Manhattan! And when you consider the portion sizes, I’d say it’s a great value.

Try the pineapple. Everyone who didn’t order it was jealous when it arrived.', 'I usually order from the Bronx noticed a Harlem location I am fully disappointed 😩 OK so one thing I hate food touching but I have to accept it. 3when I order certain things I ask for no sauce or if possible can you just give me steak and shrimp? I was also fine until I tasted it with no type of flavor.', 'It’s a nice small spot it’s definitely a vibe with the old school music service was great and the food was good I would have loved my greens on my plate but it was good food']

name: BOONTHAI BROOKLYN
reviews:
['Visit here after whole new renovations, Kitchen and management team. With Chic and rustic ambiance.

Food was so good we order shrimp shot with spicy Thai pesto sauce so yummy.
And Bangkok guacamole with touch of peanut is bomb. Watermelon salad is very recommended so refreshing and flavorful', 'The food was amazing and not expensive at all. We wanted a quick bite to eat, and this place hit the spot. Not only was the man taking the orders was nice, but gave life to the restaurant. We were the only ones there for dinner, and we came to talk to us as the only orders that came were for deliveries. This place is a huge must and is almost like a hole in the wall. The atmosphere and decorations just makes you step into another country, and the food is amazing.', "I recently tried the basil fried rice from Boon Thai, and overall, the dish was quite enjoyable. The flavors were rich and well-balanced, highlighting the skill of the chef. However, I was disappointed by the inclusion of tomatoes in the fried rice, which seemed out of place and detracted from the traditional flavor profile. Additionally, despite the menu's description mentioning eggs fried with the rice, my dish lacked any discernible egg, which was a letdown. These aspects marred an otherwise delicious meal, prompting me to reconsider my expectations for consistency in ingredient preparation.", 'I had been here before the renovations and thought it was just okay. Getting takeout after the renovations seems like a completely different experience. The pad Thai is super good and I highly recommend the peanut sauce on the side. Also got larb salad, curry with mock duck. All great options and so glad I gave them another try!', 'Came by for dinner on a whim while walking through  Manhattan ave. and I was very happy with the decision. The server was very friendly . The Duck Creamy Udon is my favorite. The ambiance was very chill. Overall a great experience leaving me full and satisfied! 10/10 would recommend.']

name: MARGON
reviews:
['Awesome lunch spot in the heart of Times Square. Cuban sandwich was extremely good, and their lunch specials are great, assume they vary the “main” and sides different days of the week.

The oxtail was great (especially paired with the sandwich) and the prices are pretty reasonable for TS prices. Quite busy inside, but has a few tables at the back for seating. Definitely recommend trying if you’re in the area!', 'Food was delicious and good price. Service was great and everyone was so nice, it was quick and easy. I got a classic Cuban sandwich and plátano (plantains)', 'This was my favorite place when I visited Times Square. I asked a bellhop where he ate when he got off work. This is authentic mouth watering Caribbean soul food. Not a fancy tourist diner. More of a real ethnic meal like when your at family and friends house. Tons of flavor and the people working were kind, funny, joyful and very outgoing. Will be my one “go to” place whenever I’m in town.
I have no idea what I ate. I only know it was lamb and chicken. The lamb had the most warm comforting flavor. Perfectly seasoned. DONT MISS THIS PLACE!', 'Was looking for a Cuban sandwich and came across this place. The bellman at the hotel I was staying at also highly recommended it. I was a bit skeptical being from Miami and knowing a good Cuban sandwich, but I wasn’t expecting very impressed. The sandwich was so…good.

The space is a little tight, so it might make make it difficult to find a spot to sit, especially during the lunch rush. But I shared a table with another gentleman and gave us the opportunity to chat - that probably sounds like a nightmare for most people - but quite enjoyed getting to know a local.

Although I didn’t try the other food, it looked really good. Just make sure you get there early since they close at 5:00 PM.', 'Cuban Sandwich and Roasted Chicken were amazing. All of them had great spices and a great amount of proportions. Also, the rice with blacm Bean and Cassava was definitely worth trying.']

name: GRATA THAI CUISINE
reviews: ['I love Thai food in general and I have had a lot of it a lot of different places. This is the best chicken pad see ew I think I’ve ever had. The view of 1st Ave is super cute and they played great music so I can’t have asked for a better atmosphere and vibe. The service was lovely and fast. Presentation of the food was also a step above and the place is super clean. I’d highly recommend and I hope I come back soon too. Only complaint was $6 for a sparkling water which I didn’t realize I’d be charged for. Oh well. I’ll skip it next time.', 'Grata Thai is a hidden gem! The food is delicious, service is friendly, and they have plenty of seating. The Panang Curry was delightful. It makes me want to explore their other curries. The highlight was the Drunken Noodles! I normally don’t go for noodle dishes at Thai restaurants, I stick to curry, but they recommended it and I have no regrets. I loved the chewiness of the noodles and the flavor of the wok on the tender chicken thins and veggies. I’ll be coming back for this dish. I topped it off with Fried Ice Cream (unconventional for Thai, I know) but it did not disappoint. It’s like a donut and ice cream in one, I loved it. The Coconut Custard was a sweet surprise — it’s served warm and is a great way to end the meal. Their drinks are beautifully crafted too. Highly recommend this place for high quality Thai cuisine!', 'My boyfriend and I have come here quite a few times and have always had a great time!\nThe food is delicious and the staff is super nice and friendly! There’s also live music sometimes and that was very nice!', 'Cute little Thai place! As authentic as it can be. We ordered lunch specials Green Curry with chicken, and Pad See Eew with beef. Both lived up to expectations. Lunch specials are indeed a great deal and service was immaculate. Like all the flowers for decoration along the walls, adding to the cuteness and pleasant ambiance of this place.', 'It’s out of my way, but totally worth it every time! The food is amazing and affordable, the people are friendly, and the restaurant is really cute-they put little flowers on every table and sometimes on the food. It’s a great spot to bring friends or to decompress by yourself.']

name: BOQUERIA UES
reviews:
["Bottom line: OK food, good vibes, not super well run, but could be much worse. Could do better for the price

Food: Average, nothing special: every plate we tried tasted a bit like home cooking, very one-dimensional, but not bad.

Paella was below expectations: bit soggy, not quite crisped on the bottom, but still tasted burnt. Very light on the saffron. Shrimp was not fresh. Paella is treated (and priced) almost like their specialty, but executed carelessly

Drinks: not well made but seems to use high quality ingredients

Service: Below average
Our waiter may have been overwhelmed by a large party and forgot to take our order, but one of the managers(?) noticed and ended up picking up the slack. Service noticeably dropped off when the manager's shift ended

Overall: food had some chain-like qualities, service may be dicey, atmosphere is on the loud side, dark and moody", 'Ordered from the tapas menu for Sunday brunch. The place wasn’t all that crowded. Except for the reed-y asparagus, the plates were great. The surprise of the day was the orange seasoned anchovies on homemade potato crisps. (Yum!)', 'This place had an amazing deal for brunch! Got three person’s worth of food with $36 and it was more than enough variety.

Good:
- Every single dish was so tasty! Liked the sliders, the croquettes, and the churros a lot and French toast
- really good variety and price value
- Solid ambiance, very good for catching up in a semi private booth

Bad:
- A little slow on service

Overall would come again!', 'We stopped in on a rainy Saturday afternoon on our way to an opening at the MET.

Seated immediately at the bar.  A few glasses of red wine, tomato bread  and sautés shrimp.

Perfect to hold us over until dinner!

Food was great, we’re coming back for a full dinner!', 'It was a great place to eat and just to have a romantic dinner. Our server was great as well. We started with the appetizer which it was mushroom croquette delicious and creamy. Then we have las patatas bravas. Nice and cruncy with the amazing sauce. Then we have the amazing gambas, the shrimp and the sauce were so delicious. My boyfriend wanted more bread to eat the sauce. Then we have the flat bread with with onions and manchego cheese and goat chesse. That was so delicious. Then we have the thin noodles with squid a la tinta. That was really good definitely recommend it. Overall great place to eat and the drinks were also good.']

name: BLACK IRON BURGER | HAMBURGER RESTAURANT
reviews:
["This place was pretty good.  I mean the burgers are the draw and they are well-made and the sides are quite nice.  NO SUBSTITUTIONS!   Well, mostly, my Mrs was able to get lettuce and tomato added but I just built my own burger.  Food came out fast, as New York goes, this historic hole-in-the-wall with a flimsy latch for the bathroom gets you in to mood for the real reason you are there.  Don't get me wrong, all of this is a vibe and adds to the experience!

I should also mention that our service was stellar!!!!  Forgive me but the young lady (server) who wore the fitted hat was really phenomenal.  In retrospect this place is pretty special and I value the awesome work they put into the craft of burger making.", "I was looking for a good burger spot in NYC, and I came across this Black Iron Burger. I have to start off saying the burger is perfect. It was very tender and juicy. Even their bun is soft texture. Service was good and quick. There's a bar inside as well for people to sit. Atmosphere felt cozy and warm. I'm definitely coming back again.", 'Such a great burger!! And I’ve tried many places, this is one of the best.
The made your own version is so good, the freshness of the avocado perfectly balancing the rest. The organic egg perfectly cooked, the patties perfectly cooked… heaven in your palate!', 'We ordered the black iron burger, chicken sandwich, and onion rings, and were pleasantly surprised with a complimentary serving of french fries. Their signature black iron burger was outstanding, featuring a tender, juicy patty and a unique, delicious sauce with sautéed onions that elevated the flavor. Although the burger bun was a bit cold, it didn’t detract much from the experience. The chicken sandwich, however, was disappointing—it was quite dry and didn’t compare favorably to similar options at other franchises. The service was attentive and friendly, and I’ll definitely be returning to try more from the menu.', 'The Masterpiece and the Epic burgers are the way to go! I would skip the Caesar salad, it’s pretty basic. And I’d rate the garlic herb fries a 7/10. The vibe of this place is very lowkey and chill. Dining tables and high tops and a bar. Come here for the burgers! Service was great too as first timers! 10/10 would recommend!']

name: GABRIEL'S BAR & RESTAURANT
reviews: ["Fantastic family own and ran restaurant. Forgotten art to  see the proprietor and his son's great and meet you during dinner service. Food is fantastic! They say the risotto is best in town... they are the truth.", 'Gabriel’s is NYC dining at it’s best. Amazing location on Central Park South. Warmly from the moment you walk in and service was exceptional throughout our delicious meal. The food was absolutely delicious with fresh homemade pasta and amazing desserts. But I have to point out how wonderful and warm service – that is a rarity in today’s world. They truly made us feel and made all the more memorable. I typically don’t write reviews but felt compelled to share my wonderful experience last night.', 'We found this gem of a bar/restaurant and visited five or six times. The atmosphere is amazing and the staff very professional and friendly. Eddie provided excellent service and Gabriel the owner is so welcoming and friendly and has time for everyone. The food was out of this world - particular mentions are Ravioli Zucca and the Brasato di Costolette di Manzo (short ribs to die for). The bomboloni (Italian doughnuts with chocolate and caramel sauces) is one of the best desserts I’ve had! We would definitely recommend this place. It’s in an excellent location opposite Central Park.', 'We had the best time! We went for there for dinner before a show at the Lincoln Center since is close by. The dishes are delicious, good size, great flavor! The restaurant ambiance and art is just a nice complement. Service was great! They have also a nice room for special events too.', 'Went in for a weekend brunch with a couple of friends. Absolutely loved the vibe and classy setting. Service was great and welcoming, food was delicious. Banana pudding from the dessert menu was absolutely mind-blowing and very fulfilling, we easily shared it between 4ppl and everyone felt satisfied. Eggs Benedict were also delicious, fresh and good portion. The place got packed by 3pm. We had a nice stroll afterwards through east side all the way up to the Guggenheim’s Museum. Will be back on my next trip to NYC!']

name: LA SANDWICHERIE UPPER EAST SIDE
reviews:
['It’s a small sandwich spot with one indoor and one outdoor sitting option. The coffee prices are quite low compared to other places in the UES. Having said that coffee seems not to be their strong suit.

I ordered smoked duck sandwich and it was delicious. The person who took our order was very friendly as well.', 'Excellent, welcoming customer service and the truffle burrata baguette sandwich was absolutely delicious and fresh tasting. Seemed authentic French also.

Just wish they had gluten free options (leaving this review for someone I picked up food for).', 'I recently visited the UES location, and I must say, their La Truffle Burrata is an absolute must-try! The combination of fresh burrata and the subtle hint of truffle creates a perfect balance of rich and delicate flavors. Every bite was creamy, decadent, and well-complemented by the quality ingredients. The atmosphere of the café itself is cozy and welcoming, making it a great spot for a relaxing meal!', "Honestly, this is the best sandwich on the UES. Very tasty, the ingredients were all high-quality, and I just loved the fig glaze on top of everything. The service was fantastic, and they have some French drinks that you can't find anywhere else. On top of all that, it was very reasonably priced, especially compared to other comparable spots in the area. Can't wait to go back.", 'Cute French sandwich shop with delightful sandwiches! Both the sandwiches we ordered were a hit — Le Truffle Buratta and the Turkey Avocado. I loved the buratta and fig glaze on Le Truffle Buratta. The Turkey Avocado was a lighter sandwich and tasted so fresh. While the sandwiches were served on a baguette (tougher than your average sandwich bread), they had the perfect amount of oil, glaze, or mayo to balance it all out. They have a table inside and outside if you want to eat it right away. Service was average but overall, I highly recommend this place for quality sandwiches made from fresh ingredients!']

name: LUPITAS RESTAURANT
reviews: ['Love the food and happy hours is a plus! The restaurant definitely transport me back to a local Mexican spot in Mexico. I love the vibe.', 'Margaritas were good until I went to use the bathroom...disgusting. dirty, no towel paper, trash everywhere.\n\nNeeds better management to keep up with the hygiene in the bathroom', 'I was visiting a friend in the area and we wanted to eat Mexican food.  The food here was good for the price, compared to other places in NY where everything is expensive, this place was nice, they serve good portions, and the food was very good and the service was excellent.', 'I loved this place. "LOVED" until the food came out not great and the live music was often too loud. I ordered esquites and got corn soup instead. Esquites isn\'t supposed to be so wet and soupy. Another time there was too much fat in my pork taco. If they educated the chef better then the food would be better. They have live music which is always cool but often put the volume soooo loud that you can\'t even talk to the person you came with.  Often I see the other patrons leave shortly after the music starts. People would probably stay longer if the volume of music and singing wasn\'t so loud. Other than the food and music, the service is really good and sweet too. I have eaten here often and my partner said to stop eating here but the drinks', "I just loved it. I am from Texas, and I've been pretty disappointed by Mexican food options in NYC. But, the quality and the value that Lupitas bring to the table are applaudable. Highly recommend enchiladas de mole."]

name: HOT JALAPENO MEXICAN RESTAURANT
reviews: ['Great little Mexican place in East Harlem.  The happy hour has drinks discounted (from 4-7pm M-F I believe) and the drinks were very tasty.  We even came back the next night just for drinks.  The food and service was excellent.  The atmosphere was perfect and relaxing.  They do have a ramp over the entrance stairs.  I would highly recommend stopping by after work for some great food and tasty drinks.', 'Was there this evening and the bartender was awesome she made great drinks I wish I got her name but she has glasses-thank you!', 'Just happened to be having a walk around the neighborhood, and I had seen this location years ago when it was under another name, I had not been inside since then.  We decided to go inside, and I loved the decor of the space, different from when I had patron before. The food and drink were good. Service was quick, polite, and professional.', 'Amazing find! The food was fresh, delicious, and quick to come out. Portions very generous. Rosario was our server - very friendly and attentive. The frozen margaritas were tasty and strong ;) Will definitely be back.', 'The name might throw you off as it being mainstream Mexican food, do not be fooled. This place is great. We had dinner in the inner patio. The atmosphere was cozy and bright. We had the happy hour frozen margaritas and they were amazing. The chilaquiles are out of this world delicious. Plus fresh guacamole you can never go wrong. Will be coming back.']

name: ANDY'S RESTAURANT
reviews:
["I asked for a Greek omelet while pointing at it on the menu. I asked for bacon, too. I got grits with bacon. A miscommunication. That's fine.
But when I clarified Greek omelet, the woman who took my order told another worker that I asked for grits. She did not know I spoke Spanish. Instead of arguing, I said I would take the grits too.

I got egg with tomatoes over bacon and grits. It was $16. Not worth it. The eggs were edible, but not what I wanted.", 'FOOD POISONING! And this is the second time I got Food poisoning from this place. I gave it another try being there were under new management but still the same service and the same food handlers. It sucks to spend your hard earned cash for something that will make you sick. Never going back again! Oh and they give you different prices each time. I guess the prices that come from on top of their head. Please be careful eating here. It used to be a good establishment decades ago. Now not so much!', 'I order breakfast every morning ima start with what I like!!
I love the mangu with salami  I recommend this dish as a great start of your day !!
I like the rotisserie chicken it’s usually fresh soft and tasty 😋
NOW
What I don’t like is the service sometimes isn’t the best, I went in this morning and ordered scrambled eggs with home fries and extra crispy bacon.
the place was packed so I guess they decided to rush my food because the egg were not fully cooked the bacon was not crispy at all and the home fries were more cold than hot !!
it really got me pissed !
They are usually good when it’s not packed but when it’s packed the atmosphere is different they don’t smile as often and it seems like the pressure gets to them

The people that work there are okay they don’t smile often I guess it’s their work environment being fast paced', 'I wish I had read the reviews before deciding to eat here. The table was filthy, and the ketchup and hot sauce bottles were sticky and gross, like they hadn’t been cleaned in ages. Despite it being 40 degrees outside, there were multiple flies buzzing around—absolutely disgusting.

The food was even worse. The chicken we ordered was undercooked, my plate had a hair on it, and the $30 seafood salad was ice-cold, with brown lettuce and avocado full of black spots. I asked for it to be wrapped up because I hate wasting food, but I ended up throwing it away as soon as I got outside—it was inedible.

To make matters worse, the workers were loudly singing along to bachata music, disrupting everyone trying to eat. For two people, the bill came to $80 for food I wouldn’t even feed a dog. This place is an overpriced health hazard and should be inspected by the health department immediately. Save yourself the trouble and avoid this place at all costs!', "I went and ordered two plates of rice & beans and baked chicken (take out). It came out to $28.25. For lunch is to expensive for something that's average. Then the lady asked if I want Garlic bread shouldn't that be included? The place is always empty no more than three or four customers. I went three times and everytime it's a different price. My co - worker went the next day it was $8.00 for the same plate of one piece of chicken rice & beans horrible a $20 difference!
I won't go back again so not worth it. $28 for lunch what about dinner or Breakfast? Or Better yet, how much more for steak, ribs, fish? I feel cheated!"]

name: ELI'S TABLE
reviews:
['Great tasting food, excellent service, and warm ambiance. The brass was great, simply addictive. The oysters were fresh, flavorful, and tiny, also expensive. All the cooked food was good, but nothing kept me wanting more. I had high expectations for the brisket, but it was slightly dry. The service was very friendly, and always ready to help.', 'Mediocre to say the least. Good quality & culinary value was not worth the price. Even presentation was sad. The only good things were the bread and service.', 'When I first entered, I thought the menu seemed a little bit lacking, but then realized that it is because they put such pride into the quality of the food they serve. The Dover soul I had was exceptional, every bite was special, and the wine it was paired with was perfect.  Jeremy, the general manager, attentive to all of the customers, while his staff perform their jobs admirably.  I learned at the end of my meal, but the kind gentleman sharing a meal at a nearby table was the owner. This is a great neighborhood restaurants that also attracts those coming into town on a periodic basis. I’ll be back!', 'Fantastic complimentary bread for breakfast, great service, very tasty food. Prices are as high as other brunch places in New York. Quiet lively music in the background sets a good mood.

Thoroughly enjoyed it!', 'We are not seen to straight way to our table.
I requested argrulla, instead was given lettuce plunked in a bowl. It appear they did not know what it was. I canceled my order.
The service was very poor! The sandwich l had was over priced. My friend and l could not leave the restaurant quick enough.
This was on a  Saturday late afternoon.']

name: FINESTRA
reviews: ['Pretty decent pasta, service was decent as well. Nothing impressive except for the bread they gave out in the beginning.', 'Oh this place! Finestra is truly a hidden gem— not in the way most people misleadingly use the term but like for real! A quaint little Restaurant on York Ave in UES that should be so packed every single service. I have never had pototo gnocchi that melted in my mouth like this one. The Gorgonzola cream sauce was perfectly balanced. It wasn’t overwhelming like so many of them. Great Chicken Parm, huge portion. But the Capellini Contadina was one of the best things I’ve had in so long!! It was so perfect. Making pasta fresh makes such a different. I would eat here everyday. The service is wonderful too, they’re very kind and attentive. Add this place to your list like ASAP!!', "My friend is a regular and brought me to this spot on a late week night... Walked into a live musician play very calmly in the corner. Service was a tad slow since it seemed like only 2 people working everything but the service was still phenomenal! The food and drinks were delicious.. Chicken Francese hit the spot. One of the best tiramisu I've ever had! I might have to become a regular too!", 'I ordered their “gourmet thin crust pizza” to go. I live close by so I started eating within 5 minutes of it being ready. The sauce was separated from the crust and cold to touch. I’m not convinced they didn’t (poorly) heat up a $5 Digiorno frozen pizza, call it gourmet and sell it for $25. It was actually disgusting. Really wanted to go back for like actual pasta but if this is what they call gourmet I don’t want any part of them', 'I like the old school Italian setting however I did eat outside it was a nice day I had the salmon by salad which was amazing I would love to go back there get nicely dressed up and go back during the evening the waiter was nice. I will definitely visit again']

name: THE MARK RESTAURANT BY JEAN-GEORGES
reviews:
['We had an amazing experience dining here for my Mother’s 70th birthday. We came here specifically for Chef Michael’s food and it exceeded our expectations. The hotel is beautiful and the bar was lively as we walked through to find the restaurant. They have a great wine list and we started with the tuna tartare which was AMAZING. The flavor was so bright and fresh. From there we had the seafood tower (caviar and oysters were the standouts)! Amazing value. From there the asparagus pizza and rigatoni finished out our main course. The rigatoni was such a unique flavor (almost smoky) so it’s not like any ordinary rigatoni bolognese you’ll see on other menus. The service was impeccable and our server brought my mom a delicious caramel corn sundae with candles. The atmosphere was so perfect for a Saturday night in the city. Absolutely dine here!', 'For a private event, sliding panels afforded privacy and cut down the noise from the main dining area. The service was attentive but unobtrusive. The food had hits and some misses. The fontina cheese pizza was excellent. The sea bass entree itself was done well but the accompanying vegetables seemed overcooked and had lost their bite. The salted caramel sundae was the only real disappointment because there was way too much popcorn and nuts for the amount of ice cream.', 'Our local friends chose this restaurant for a quick dinner catch up to celebrate a bday. We sat at the nice large  table right at the back of the restaurant Service was friendly and attentive.

We tried the warm shrimp salad and burgers. The salad was decent but the dressing was too acidic to my tastes; the burger was okay nothing special.

Thanks to the lovely gesture and brought out a dessert plate with a candle and chocolate writing of happy birthday on the plate.', 'This review is for the CHALET restaurant pop up for the holidays at the Mark.  Its outside in covered chalet style add on.  Felt like you were in Alsace.great fondue the best we ever had,  delicious salad and the service was great.  We wanted cocktails our waiter, I think k his name was Stephen had to shuttle between the hotel bar and the chalet. He did an amazing job. Great winter experience', 'This review is for The Mark Chalet by Jean-Georges. It was a terrible dining experience.  Side note - we love (LOVE) the other Jean-Georges restaurants in nyc (ABCv, abc kitchen, abc cucina) and the inn at pound ridge.

Our first course was the onion tart. I’m pretty sure my dog could have prepared something better, and she doesn’t have thumbs. It tasted like it was a frozen tart that had defrosted and re-froze many times over. It also looked like something mass produced you might buy in the frozen section of any third tier supermarket. It cost more than $30. Two thumbs down. The “salad” was a few pieces of limp and flavorless mesclun. Fail.

The fondue was boiling within 20 seconds of being on the flame - it was way too hot - we both have burnt tongues. There was no way to reduce the flame or lift the pot. The vegetables to dip in the fondue were old, limp, and soggy. That broccoli smell you get when broccoli needs to be thrown out. The bread was so stale and some pieces were wet. The cornichons were dried-out limp. It was the opposite of delicious and delightful.

Skipped dessert to get out there as fast as possible. While we waited for the bill, the staff had trouble closing our flame and burned a hole in the table cloth. There definitely was an issue with the set-up.

We wish we could time travel backwards and not spend the first day of 2024 here. 100% inedible. 100% regret. Disappointment all around.']

name: EAT HERE NOW
reviews:
['The omelettes were good.  But there are a lot better options around.
Most of the omelets were around $17. But most (all?) of them only come with only two options- tomato and cheese or spinach and cheese etc.  not really what I am used to from their competitors. The hash browns were, not quite, just somewhat browned, mashed
potatoes. So just served as a long lump. The toast was good and so was the coffee.
So it’s ok if you are in the area but you might want to shop around.', 'Taki served us, she’s a nice girl and so kind. They served our dishes super fast, and the price was okay according to the quantity of food. If I ever come back to ny I’ll come again 100%', 'My favorite is the waffles! They are SO good! (I attached pictures of my waffle, on two separate trips.)  Usually when we arrive to NYC, this is our first stop. The staff is excellent!', 'The restaurant has very good food and excellent customer service. My waitress was Veronica who was very friendly, courteous with a great heart', 'It’s been awhile since I came to dine to one of my favorite restaurant in the city.
Been greeted by the owner with his excellent customer service as well as taking my order making sure things are okay, as I’m having my coffee see one of the old timers waiters, always friendly with a happy smile. My food was brought by such a charming waitress lady that it does make a difference how she’s greeted me and placed my food on the table. I asked if I could take some pictures since I don’t come here that often. I highly recommended this restaurant when ever you are in the city.']

name: E.A.T.
reviews:
["I bought ice cream and two pieces of cake(Coconut and Radpberry). Ice cream was fine but there is a GREEN MOLE inside a cake. Please be aware when you visit this place. Don't risk your life.", 'My boyfriend and I were meeting up with my in laws to visit the MET for his birthday. We were all pretty hungry, & my boyfriend and I had walked past E.A.T a few times, so we all decided to check it out. Even though it was a busy weekend, they sat us immediately. The staff were friendly and very attentive. The menu had a variety of options, but not an overwhelming amount. The food was amazing and came out quickly. I tried motza ball soup for the first time and was very impressed! Since it was my man’s birthday, they gave us complimentary cookies and sang “Happy Birthday”. It was a wonderful lunch with a warm and welcoming atmosphere. Another great part is that you can grab a pastry to go or come sit inside for a nice meal. Will definitely be recommending to friends and family! 🗽\U0001fa75', 'Lovely café two blocks away from the MET. I took refuge from the rain here and I have to firstly appreciate the great service, they were all so quick in bringing my order even though it was pouring outside. The macchiato for me was perfect, a good, strong coffee like I enjoy, and from all the patisserie options I couldn’t decide! I tried a raspberry scone and it was great, not too sweet, not to buttery, as a scone should be.', "Ive had better ham sandwich in jail and I'm not proud of that but it's crazy $30 ham sandwich is that bad. The bread is good but definitely won't ever eat there again.", 'Nasty nasty place ! 28$ for a Ham sandwich??????

I honestly have no idea how  they are still in business!!!???

All the reviews on this place are absolutely horrible because it’s all true!!!! I hope they relocate or adjust the prices!!! I really doubt they will adjust the prices. They have to take everything off the shelves and readjust the whole business model.

This place is absolutely a scam, never buy food or drinks. I was in a rush and the cashier didn’t say the price out loud so I assumed it would be relatively priced, but was shocked about the price.

That’s probably how they scam most people when they are in a rush .

I hope this place gets shut down honestly .

Also attaching a photo of the disgusting sandwich']

name: FLOR DE MAYO RESTAURANT
reviews:
['I’ve now been to both locations over the last 5 years. Several times. It’s been 50/50 with the good/bad experiences.

I’ve given up on this hype, though. Most of the dishes are average to good, on their best days. On their off days, they can be average to poor. But, when you’re spending close to or over $50 on two dishes, it’s a dealbreaker.

Eating here is part of the experience. I have yet to do so there’s a chance it could be better than takeout? Not for me though.', "TLDR: If you've never had Chino Latino - you're depriving yourself of some crazy good stuff. Large portions, even larger flavors. Broiled pork chop, lomo saltado, squid ink fried rice, seco de res. You're welcome.

I've been eating at the Amsterdam location for years but recently I've been coming to this one. It's a family run spot with a full Chino Latino menu. Think a collision of Chinese and Peruvian/Spanish. They've got some straight up Spanish things, totally Chinese and in between.

For starters, definitely try the papa arequipena. It's a Peruvian potato either cold or fried with this red pepper sauce and hard boiled eggs and olives. It's a very unique flavor. If you're there on the weekends, grab the shrimp stew. It's an ultra tasty shrimp soup with rice, corn, a bit of spice.

The broiled pork chops are probably my favorite pork chops anywhere. They're brined incredibly well are dotted with chopped garlic that caramelizes under the flame. It's so insanely juicy.

Squid ink fried rice is a must. It's a squid ink coated fried rice with ham, shrimp, pease and a unique ginger flavor. The lomo saltado you definitely need to get. Sliced steak in a stir-fried sauce with onions, tomato and french fries on top of rice.

The other items I'd recommend are the seco de res, a cilantro-centric tender beef stew. The tallarin verde is a Peruvianish pesto pasta, it's great with the garlic shrimp.

No matter how much good stuff I've eaten, Flor de Mayo is in my list of restaurants I love going to and bringing visitors to. It's something that's tough to find but it's a testament to the melting pot that NYC is.", 'I recently dined at Flor de Mayo, and the experience was nothing short of exceptional. From the moment we walked in, the warm and inviting atmosphere set the tone for a fantastic evening. The service was top-notch—attentive, friendly, and truly accommodating. The staff made us feel welcomed and ensured that our dining experience was smooth and enjoyable from start to finish.

The food was absolutely incredible, showcasing the rich and flavorful fusion of Peruvian and Chinese cuisine that Flor de Mayo is known for. We ordered the Lomo Salteado, which was a standout dish. The beef was cooked to perfection—tender, juicy, and bursting with flavor. The mix of spices, fresh vegetables, and savory sauce created a perfect balance that made each bite better than the last. The dish was beautifully presented, and the portion size was generous, leaving us completely satisfied.

The drinks were another highlight of the evening. Whether you’re in the mood for a classic cocktail or something more adventurous, the bar at Flor de Mayo does not disappoint. The cocktails were expertly crafted, with just the right blend of flavors to complement the meal. They added a nice touch to the overall dining experience.

Overall, Flor de Mayo exceeded all expectations. The combination of amazing food, outstanding service, and delicious drinks made for an unforgettable night. Whether you’re looking to enjoy a casual dinner or celebrate a special occasion, Flor de Mayo is the place to be. We can’t wait to return and explore more of the menu!', 'Not what it used to be. Food was extremely mid. Fried chicken? Mid. White rice? Somehow mid. Beans? Tasted just like beans like no seasoning. Steak with onions + fried rice was the best thing I ate. But I’ve had just as good at the Chinese spot. The eggroll? A true fusion that idk what it was. Why does all the food have cinnamon? The Chinese spot where you pay $10 has better food. Don’t come here and pay $28 for it. Just go to your local Chinese spot. I’m now on the toilet sick just 15 minutes after finishing eating. The bathroom is gross and had graffiti all over it. Zero stars.', 'Been coming here for decades even after moving out of the city and it is truly one of my favorite restaurants. The food is fantastic the atmosphere is wonderful and the service is incredible. They take care of us as if we come in every day and if my family is ever having a big dinner all together this is our first choice!']

name: MARÍA MULATA RESTAURANT & BAR
reviews:
['“María Mulata on the Upper East Side is a true gem! The service here is absolutely top-notch—every staff member goes above and beyond to make you feel welcome and taken care of. And the food? Simply incredible! Each dish is bursting with authentic Colombian flavors, made with the freshest ingredients. If you’re looking for an unforgettable dining experience, this is the place to be. Highly recommend!”', 'María Mulata Colombian Restaurant is a hidden treasure in NYC that offers an unforgettable dining experience. The moment you step inside, you’re greeted by a warm and welcoming atmosphere that immediately puts you at ease. The staff is incredibly attentive and genuinely cares about your experience, ensuring that every need is met with a smile.

The menu is a delightful journey through the best of Colombian cuisine, with dishes that are both authentic and innovative. Every plate is bursting with flavor, from the perfectly seasoned meats to the deliciously fresh arepas. The drinks are also top-notch, with a variety of traditional and creative options to choose from.

What truly sets María Mulata apart is the passion and love that goes into every detail. The ambiance is lively yet comfortable, making it the perfect place for a casual lunch or a special dinner. The service is impeccable—quick, friendly, and always eager to make your meal special.

Whether you’re a fan of Colombian food or just looking for a fantastic dining experience, María Mulata is the place to go. The combination of incredible food, outstanding service, and a welcoming environment makes it a standout choice in the city. Highly recommended!', 'The dining experience at María Mulata is top notch! Very welcoming, friendly service with high quality food in a comfortable, elegant atmosphere. It’s the kind of place you can come with friends to enjoy a good meal paced with conversation. The Empanada Trio was delicious. The beef inside was so tender and flavorful. I loved the crunchiness of the Mandioca Bites, they pair well with chipotle mayo. It’s a great starter to get for the table. The Lomo Saltado was a highlight. The steak comes beautifully plated with veggies in a savory sauce that’s perfect for dipping your rice in. This place knows how to cook tender, flavorful meat. This was my first Colombian Tamale and I thoroughly enjoyed it. The Tres Leches cake was perfectly sweet and cold which is nice after a warm, savory meal. Highly recommend!', 'María Mulata Colombian Restaurant is a true standout in the heart of New York City. From the moment you walk in, you’re welcomed with the warmest hospitality that instantly makes you feel like family. The attention to detail and the care the staff provides are simply spectacular—they go above and beyond to ensure every aspect of your dining experience is perfect.

The food is nothing short of amazing. Each dish is a celebration of authentic Colombian flavors, prepared with fresh, high-quality ingredients. Whether you’re indulging in traditional favorites like Bandeja Paisa or trying something new, every bite transports you straight to Colombia. The portions are generous, and the presentation is beautiful, reflecting the pride the chefs take in their craft.

The ambiance of the restaurant is cozy yet vibrant, creating the perfect setting for both intimate dinners and lively gatherings. The decor is thoughtfully designed, reflecting the rich culture and heritage of Colombia. It’s clear that every element, from the menu to the service, is carefully curated to provide an unforgettable experience.

If you’re looking for a place that combines exceptional food, outstanding service, and a welcoming atmosphere, look no further than María Mulata. This is a restaurant that truly excels in every way, and I can’t recommend it highly enough. A must-visit for anyone in NYC!', "TLDR: overpriced, portions not worth the unreasonably high price, food was bland. Owner was great, the son will eavesdrop on your conversations and yell at you

Came here for a friend's birthday (she chose the location). The server Luis was an absolute gem. He was funny, attentive and welcoming. The food took 40 minutes to be served entrees the size of appetizers. We ordered the bandeja paisa (the only dish worthy to be called an entree), garlic shrimp which was mediocre and the red snapper in coconut sauce which was absolutely bland. I asked for salt and pepper which helped. It was my first meal of the day and I had to get home to so the babysitter could get home early in a school night, so I opted to just eat my meal instead of waiting 40 minutes for a new dish. While we were finishing our drinks, my friend asked me what my opinion was as I worked as a chef and am FROM Columbia. I told her I found the experience to be a far cry from the rich food our culture has to offer and what I thought each dish lacked at which point, the kid working as a host stormed over and snapped at us about how rude and disrespectful we were. I told him to relax and that I would still pay and leave a tip. He still berated us and I asked to speak to the owner. I politely explained to his mother the situation, told her that he needed to mind his business if he didn't know how to approach customers with a solution- oriented mindset. She was very kind, did all she could to make it right and offered us flan on the house (it was delicious). The bill was paid, a good tip left but had the son kept his mouth shut, this review wouldn't have been written. Normally I give peeves a second chance because people can have off days, but not this time"]

name: RUSSIAN SAMOVAR RESTAURANT AND PIANO BAR
reviews: ['Food was delicious. My first time trying Russian food. I loved the beet salad & the smoked salmon wrapped in crepes. I’d definitely recommend these dishes. They had a gypsy dancing & someone singing. It’s very authentic & culture is truly kept. I tend to love very contemporary modern spaces with multicultural crowds but it was nice to experience this traditional ambiance. It definitely had its niche. If you’re looking for authentic delicious fresh Russian food, atmosphere & ambiance, I’d recommend.', 'I love when the people who work at an ethnic restaurant speak and know the culture of the cuisine. So true with Russian Samovar. The evening jazz band was a bonus to our dining experience. We had the borscht and wild mushroom soup accompanied by two chicken dishes and cherry dumplings for dessert. All were tasty!', 'Ridiculously overpriced for what it is. Left 200$ for a small and average tasting meal. Menu prices are actually higher at the restaurant than they show online. There was nothing "fine" about this dining experience, zero presentation effort either. We appreciate history, but c\'mon, 16$ for a small borscht without meat? Crazy. Never again. PS: washrooms leave much to be desired. There was no live music when we were there.', 'The atmosphere is quite Russian and the food is delicious. However, the taste is not original- golubtsi and pirogi are very fatty and do not taste as should. The piano performance was good.\nBe careful is the female WC - lockers can get stuck.', 'This place is wonderful! The dinner was perfect and authentic... The live entertainment was superb, and the staff was warm and attentive.  another great Must when visiting NYC!']
