name: MISSION CEVICHE UPPER EAST SIDE
reviews:
['Not only was the food fantastic, but the restaurant itself was beautifully designed. From beginning to end, it was more than just a meal—it was an experience. The flavors were expertly blended and layered, creating a delightful taste sensations!. The mix of sweet and savory was simply wonderful!', 'I came here for my second time and to celebrate my mother’s birthday. Honestly it was a great choice. She loved it. Mission Ceviche never disappoints. We were satisfied with the service the food.', 'This Establishment has been on my bucket list since its grand opening. Unfortunately was not able to find till recently but all I can say is that is was so worth the wait. Came during opening hours so I was able to get the full experience without the crowd. I’ve been eyeing the menu for so long I knew exactly what I wanted. We ordered the oysters. They were the best oysters Ive ever had. The flavor is exceptional it completely opens your pallet. It left of stunned that’s how good it was. Then we wanted a few selections of Cevichi we had the classic and the Nikkei and the Roll Antituchero. That roll can with a table side torching which was incredibly to see. The Nikkei was my favorite the crunch factor gave it a great texture. The roll melted in your mouth it was the best thing i ate in 2024. We also ordered another round of oysters before we left. Yes the bill will get pricey but you’re paying for the quality of the food and it’s worth every penny.', 'Genuinely deserves all the hype it gets. Lovely service- from our waiter to the busboys, everyone was very nice and accommodating. A nice outdoor set up- good ventilation while still covered, and you’re not on top of the next table. The food: the lunch prix fix is an unbelievable deal- 35 bucks for an appetizer, main, and dessert? Can’t be beat. I strayed a bit to try other dishes though.

The ceviche is incredible- probably the best I’ve had in the country. Unless you’re a huge octopus/shrimp lover I’d skip the seafood mixto and just get the classic. The classic ceviche is hands down amazing (the added stuff is good too, but not groundbreaking). Though to be fair you get the aji Amarillo sauce with the seafood mixto- and that might be what you’re looking for. The fish of the day was mahi mahi- lovely, fresh, well prepared. There’s not much you can do to mahi mahi if you cook it well. The grilled octopus was great- really well prepared with a wonderful sauce. And a deceptively huge portion. The sushi roll were alright (very good sauce though)- but that’s not the point of this place. Finally, dessert was the cherimoya mousse- and I was obsessed. Perfectly balanced sour and sweet- a hint of salt- super refreshing and a wonderful end to the meal.

I’m not a drinker- but I heard their cocktails and wine were also nice (and they have some mocktails- I had the basil breeze, it was…ok. A bit bland and watery to be fair)', 'Mission Ceviche opened my eyes to just how delicious ceviches can be. Not only were their ceviches perfect, but all the other dishes I tried demonstrated the chefs’ mastery of flavor. The inside of the restaurant was gorgeous, and the staff were so friendly, charismatic, and passionate about their menu. As of writing this review, Mission Ceviche is my favorite Peruvian restaurant and I can’t wait to come back again!']

name: THEP THAI RESTAURANT
reviews: ['I had an amazing dining experience at this Thai restaurant! The steamed striped bass was absolutely delicious—Ploy, our fantastic waitress, recommended it, and I’m so glad she did! The balance of sour and spice was perfect. The grilled spare ribs were another standout, becoming my second favorite dish. Every dish we ordered was fantastic, and the service was equally impressive. They were so thoughtful, even bringing our dog a bottle of water, which was such a kind gesture. Our parents loved it too. We’ll definitely be coming back again!', 'We had an amazing dining experience at this Thai restaurant. The ambiance is both elegant and cozy, perfect for a relaxed meal. The Tom Kha soup was delightful—rich and aromatic, with a perfect balance of flavors. The appetizer platter offered a great selection of delicious bites, and the Pad Thai as our main dish was wonderfully satisfying. Our server, Ploy, was incredibly warm and attentive, making us feel truly welcomed. For anyone seeking authentic Thai food with excellent service, this spot is a must-visit!', 'We were eating outside in the patio surprisingly it was warm and nice even in the winter. The service was great (thanks Gift!) and the food has good varieties. My favorite dish was pad see ew with tofu, a big portion and delicious. I would recommend this place for trying different Thai food!', 'Thep Thai offers an amazing dining experience! Their Tom Yum soup is absolutely delicious—perfectly balanced with rich, tangy, and spicy flavors. The fried rice is also incredibly tasty, with a delightful aroma and fresh ingredients. A special thanks to Ms. Four, whose friendly and attentive service made the meal even better. Highly recommend this place for authentic Thai cuisine!', 'Definitely one of the best Thai meals and overall one of the best meals I have had in New York. Situated in upper east side neighbourhood of Manhattan. This is extremely accessible by the subway. The decor is modern and eclectic, and you can choose to sit either inside or outside, but given that it was a pretty hot day. We used to sit inside in the air-conditioning. I got a Thai tea to start with, and that was probably the only thing in the mail that I did not find to be enjoyable. we started the chive pancakes, which were not your traditional chi pancakes, and as you might expect a Chinese restaurant, but they had their own twist. It was so so good, and it was gone in seconds. We devoured it like we were hungry for ages. we got the basil stir fry rice, and that was very, very good. We got the green curry to go with it, and it was as good as green curry. I had in Bangkok. although you are pretty full by this point, but given that the food tasted so incredible, we went ahead and ordered some dumplings as well, which again were finished within seconds. Our hostess was a sweet lady and when she saw us fighting for the food, she actually suggested that we get more food, but I guess we were pretty full. He wanted to end the meal with a mango sticky rice, which is one of my favourite Thai deserts, but unfortunately they did not have any. I cannot recommend this place enough, and you cannot go wrong with any of the dishes on the menu. I will definitely be back to try more items.']

name: LHASA FAST FOOD
reviews:
["We loved the delicious Tibetan food. It's a limited menu, but there's a variety of appetizers, soups, or mains to choose from. Most are reasonably priced. They also serve drinks. Some more decor/ ambience and attentiveness from waitress could have been nice. We will recommend it to others who enjoy spicy food.", "Lhasa Fast Food is the perfect antidote to a dreary day. Their warm, inviting atmosphere creates a cozy escape from the cold. The food is absolutely fantastic! The chicken momo, lamb thenthuk, and beef chili are must-tries. This is my go to place whenever I am craving for momo. I was pleasantly surprised to find halal meat options, which is great for the neighborhood. To top it off, they offer a decent selection of beer and cocktails. If you're craving authentic Nepali cuisine, this is my spot. Highly recommended!
IG 📸 @adventureofourlifetime", 'I love the momos, fresh and authentic. I got the steamed beef and chive momos-- tad spicy but good! Lots of pictures of Anthony Bourdain in there! Lol', "Conveniently located on the main road, Lhasa restaurant offers a spacious setting and authentic Tibetan cuisine. From savory momos to aromatic thukpa, each dish delights the taste buds. What truly sets this spot apart is its exceptional service, ensuring every visit is memorable. Whether you're a local or traveler,  promises a satisfying dining experience with every bite.", "Embarking on a gastronomic journey at this Nepali and Tibetan restaurant was an unforgettable experience. This establishment isn't just about dumplings or momos; it's a culinary fusion masterpiece. The blend of flavors in every dish is nothing short of exceptional, creating a delightful symphony for the taste buds. The unique mix of Nepali and Tibetan influences sets the restaurant apart, providing a warm and inviting atmosphere that adds an extra layer of enjoyment to the dining experience.

What truly stood out was the carefully crafted Long Island Tea—the crown jewel of the beverage selection. This iconic cocktail was a revelation, perfectly complementing the diverse menu. Sipping on this expertly mixed concoction elevated the entire meal, turning it into a sensory adventure. The restaurant's commitment to delivering not just a meal but a cultural and culinary journey makes it a standout destination. From the first bite to the last sip, every moment at this Nepali and Tibetan gem tells a story of culinary excellence and a celebration of diverse flavors. It's more than a restaurant; it's an immersion into a world of culinary artistry."]

name: EL MANTO RESTAURANT
reviews:
["I came to have a soup, and all o got was salt water with chicken bones and 3 pieces of potato bigger than the chicken bones a corn. Half cooked rice🙄  really.  Don't they try their food before selling?.. anyway. I wouldn't recommend this place. Only to people I don't like. I would tell them is a great place. 😆", 'We walked to El Manto, a pleasant half mile from our hotel next to LGA in search of an adventure. Hotel-type food is almost always a last resort.
El Manto features a steam table with delicious, freshly made Dominican Food. It is not a fancy restaurant atmosphere. We saw a steady flow of people picking up their food, everyone with a smile.
The same person cooks, serves, tends the 5-6 tables, and hums a pleasant melody that reflects her values.
My wife and I thoroughly enjoyed our meal. As we walked back to hotel we commented how pleasant was our adventure at El Manto.
This is a neighborhood gem!', 'Thank you for great Dominikan breakfast... very friendly...', 'I ordered a chicharrone de pollo and they gave me breaded chicken. I also asked for garlic sauce they did not give it to me. The lady was nasty on the phone. She said I was giving her the wrong address so I had to talk to someone else that works there and they finally got it. My experience with this restaurant was horrible. I would not recommend to anyone. If I can give a -0 I would.', 'This is the best place I have seen in the area so far!  Huge tasty portions at a great price!  very friendly employees who remember your preferences from day to day!  there is a real place for everyone']

When I tried to ask for just a bit more, the staff said it would be of extra charge. Honestly, if your choice is to have a nice drink, this isn't it. ! The music is extremely loud.", "Totally loved the atmosphere and loved how the interior looked. The food was good but the drinks were way too strong. A few of them tasted like it wasn't mixed properly. All in all not a bad spot for a date night.", 'They will only sell you beer by the bucket.  Is a shame, there was at least 3 more couples that left because they finished their beer but the music and atmosphere was still good.  They are latterly letting money walk out the door. The Calamari was delicious,  quesadilla was just ok and no salsa sauce; not very big portions for the $.']

name: FU YING RESTAURANT
reviews: ['This is based on quality compared to area fast food restaurants— each dish was about $10 for the lunch special and they are very small-we try to give a place a second chance look - but it’s been pretty consistent- the take out containers are shallow as well as the soup continues -would not recommend - bumped it to 3 because no 2.5 rating. The fries and chicken wings was very small portion and light weight', "I'm torn about this place. I was home in NY and wanted Chinese food. Can't get good Chinese food here. Surprisingly bland. The egg rolls were not like I'm used to. No flavor. The General Tso was too sweet. The lo mein was bland but the chicken wings were the most amazing part of dinner.", "Order a half chicken with fried rice and an egg roll 15 mins later I get what's clearly not my order and lady tried to send me the wrong order which was a shrimp fried rice with something else. As I was about to check she took it to the back switched up the rice and did some sketchy replacements right in front of me smh at this point I already knew I lost my money and I wasn't gonna eat that smh I get home open it and found multiple shrimps which where not part of my order. What if I was allergic and ate it without looking??? Horrible irresponsible behavior. I recommend staying away from this place.", 'I ordered from here for about 10 years from college to my late twenties. The food was always good, they delivered rain or snow. ALWAYS OPEN, no matter what holiday. The woman that always answers the phone was amazing, she knew my order FROM THE SOUND OF MY VOICE. I moved 4 times and she always knew who I was. She is amazing, my order would only take a few seconds. Delivery guy, THE BEST. Always came super fast, always with a smile. I never knew how good they were until I MOVED to NJ. If they are reading this, 19T misses you!!!!', 'My sesame chicken was covered in hair. Absolutely disgusting, and I will never eat here again']

name: SANDY RESTAURANT
reviews:
['My order
3 beef empanadas
3 chicken empanadas!

Came in for a quick bite after my examination malfunctioned (lost internet service). It was extremely busy when I walked in. But I was immediately greeted by the staff behind the counter. I definitely recommend stopping by this restaurant. They serve breakfast, lunch and dinner! The food behind the glass (hot bar) looks extremely fresh. The staff works together and are very consistent when it comes to catering to their patrons. Family friendly, date worthy place. Please support this business for those days and nights you don’t want to cook! They also have delivery as well. Plus I just tried JUGO DE COCO for the first time…i 100% recommend!!! This is a local staple for Harlem.

Please support the locals!!!', 'Sandy, in particular, made it memorable with attentive service. Either for Dominican food lovers or just adventurous tryers, this place is a must. Definitely will return with every opportunity when I am in the area. Flavors tasted authentic; service was hospitable-10/10.', "The food is too pricey, they serve you only a half of cup of beans and white rice. Usually authentic restaurants serve you more beans then that especially if it's for two people. Their bathrooms have water saving old system which sadly they need to change asap. It gets clogged to easy and to me that's a big don't go back.  They only get 2 stars because they do have a bar and the place is bit centric for a stop and go but I would not recommend it for a picky, clean eater like myself.", 'Beans taste like tomato sauce. The beans are nasty. Their rice and peas are nasty to. They need a better cook. They serve their to go food sloppy. No presentation. Lacks customer service. This place fell off since my last visit.', "I recently had an unfortunate experience at a restaurant I frequently patronize, where I decided to order a to-go meal. Despite the establishment's reputation for excellent cuisine and my previous positive experiences dining in, this particular incident left me deeply dissatisfied. The waiting time for my to-go order was almost an hour, which was both frustrating and disappointing, considering the significant amount of money I had spent. This is what I waited for almost an hour for very dissatisfied"]

name: MICHAEL'S RESTAURANT
reviews:
["First time at Michael's. Ordered grilled octopus dinner meal. It includes choice of potatoes, salad or soup, bread, coffee/tea and dessert for $29.95. I was in haven for an hour... the olive oil and vinegar combo was delicious and I still have left overs.

Hubby ordered triple decker. It was good too!

Highly recommended.", "I've become a night owl since I've lived in this neighborhood, so it's really cool to have a chill place to go to where you can get a full, quality meal at any time. I have dietary restrictions, but the menu has so many options for everyone. The service is good too, I highly recommend coming here.", 'Classic Astoria old time restaurant. Absolutely the best. The servers are wonderful, with many of them having been here for years. This place is especially good on a winter night. The Reuben is SO good! And top off with apple pie a la mode. My favorite neighborhood restaurant in Astoria. I love it.', "We got a recommendation from a stranger that the absolute best mozzarella sticks he’s ever had is at Michael's Restaurant on Broadway. Yes, the mozzarella sticks specifically because the marinara sauce is very fresh and full of herbs, while the mozzarella sticks themselves are perfectly made and taste amazing. Not that I was out looking for the best mozzarella sticks, but he got me curious and I had to try it out for myself.

These mozzarella sticks are thinner than your typical ones, so it feels and tastes crunchier. I think the mozzarella sticks are really good but the best part about this appetizer is the sauce. You could taste all the ingredients that it’s made of, the freshness of the herbs. I'm a tomato girl, so that’s why I’m a fan of the sauce. My husband said you could tell it's elevated mozzarella sticks based on the look itself. Quality gourmet mozzarella sticks and the marinara sauce just goes so well with it. We didn't know we’d be trying someone’s mozzarella sticks recommendation tonight haha thank you for the rec, Nick! We need to meet more kind strangers by the local halal cart.", 'Great place to eat with your family!!
There a various option for food and customer service is amazing at this place will definitely recommend!!']

name: SOL MAYA RESTAURANT
reviews: ['My daughter and neighbor, after going to an open school house, decided to get something to eat. We came across this restaurant walking and decided to go in. The food was very good and the service was fast. I ordered the Cuban sandwich with a mirir soñando (it was amazing)! Everyone enjoyed their food. We will definitely go back again.', 'I’ve come to Solmaya for years as I’m a local, and nothing comes close to the quality for the price. No matter what you order on the menu, I guarantee it’ll taste amazing.', "I remember this location was named Triple A, and now it SolMaya. Love the decorations of the place. I had breakfast take out and didn't dine there, but I will come again.", 'We took my sister there to celebrate her birthday. They treated us great. We had a very enjoyable time. I highly recommend it.', 'Best el pastor taco in Harlem. Pro tip tell George to make you whatever he’s feeling and try all the different dishes & tacos you can']

name: HIMALAYAN YAK RESTAURANT
reviews:
['I was Introduce to Himalayan Yak thanks to a Yelp event.

I arrived on a Sunday afternoon and had the place all to myself. I sat at the bar and perused the menu. The gentleman greeted me and made me feel welcomed and comfortable.

As soon as I saw garlic naan that was an absolute must and then for my entrée I decided on the chicken tikka masala. The naan was perfect. It came out pipping hot with ample garlic. I love that for me. The chicken tikka masala was flavorful with a great balance of spices. However the chicken was not as tender as I would have hoped. Overall it was a nice lunch.

Just A Note:

The offer happy hour and live music.', "Delicious food and great service! A great date spot with live music on the weekends. The dishes came out fast and were packed with flavour! Highly recommend! From their Aloo Dum to Thali dish, they were all so good that it's hard to pick a favorite.", 'Lovely atmosphere between music and decor, and the crowd gave it instant authenticity.

The service was great except my waiter let me get this horrible dish, sizzler chicken…imagine chicken and noodles braised in coke…hell no!

The chicken dumplings however were not just good but exceptional! For that I will even come back despite how terrible the sizzler was…if you go dip in the 2 sauces…AND Ask for the 3rd sauce if you like spicy (dried red roasted peppers)…', 'In one word..Awesome! As per food, they had perfect combination of spices and taste. We ordered Nepali thali, veg noodles, chicken momo, veg momo, naan and one chicken dish and a veg dish. The ambience the so nice, there was a live Nepali music going on, which I absolutely loved!! I would also rate the service a five star! Would love to come back again.', 'Cozy ambiance. Traditional Neplai food. Enjoyed the food and experience. Try at least once if you are craving Neplai food.']

name: GIACOMO'S PIZZA AND RESTAURANT
reviews: ['Good pizza for a good price. My brother and I came here after a day at the MET and watched some soccer matches while enjoying our food. The staff was very nice and friendly and the service super quick!', 'I can’t comment on the negative reviews but man do I love my pizza and this place is great! Highly recommend. The vodka pizza was way more amazing than we were expecting.', "Whoa! I have never had a slice of pizza like this in MY LIFE!\nThis might be the best pizza place in all of Manhattan. Not to mention, you can sit and enjoy a slice which is so nice since other pizza shops don't offer a place to sit. The service was phenomenal. Will definitely come back when I want a slice in the area", 'I love ordering from here! The garlic knots are soooo freaking good. The Penne a la Vodka and Chicken parm are super yummy and the price is very reasonable. The chef salad is huge and I always have leftovers.', 'This is the best pizza place I’ve had in the city. The tomato sauce is so sweet I’ve never enjoyed a Margherita pizza more. Their vodka sauce melts in my mouth. The garlic knots are crunchy on the outside, soft on the inside']

name: LAS PATRONAS MEXICAN RESTAURANT
reviews: ['A wonderful Mexican family-run joint. The food is delicious and the cook would go above and beyond to make sure that you leave happy and satisfied.', 'The food was the most authentic I\'ve tasted. I can\'t wait to come back again, not just for the food but for the service and kindness extended to me by the owner; Saul. The negative comments I see here are likely by people who think salt is "spicy" 😂 don\'t let it cheat you out of a delicious meal!', 'Great food! Quick. We had a group of 12 and they made the food extremely quickly.', 'Authentic Southern Mexican cuisine in a relaxed family run atmosphere. Chef is friendly and accommodating food was fast fresh and delicious. I definitely recommend', 'Beautifull small place.. you feel very wellcomed, i dont know about mexican flavors, but i thing it was ok.. very good size and flavors.']

name: GREAT WALL CHINESE RESTAURANT
reviews: ['Ordered at 10pm.. shrimp lo mein, boneless ribs, cheese wontons, and shrimp with veggies. All very fresh and flavorful. Don’t forget to ask about the hot oil.', "Great Wall is like any other Chinese fast food restaurant in NYC - it's a greasy spoon for quick fare that's a mixture between Chinese, American Latin and Caribbean food. I won't waste your time telling you what's on the menu because you already know.  Once you've been to one of these restaurants you've been to them all. But what you don't know about Great Wall is that they are a vegetarian's dream Chinese food spot. I love this place because they do not skimp on the vegetables at all. The veggies are fresh and plentiful and in every dish. I go here just for the veggies with black bean sauce, garlic sauce or sesame sauce - with a few jumbo shrimps included too BTW.  This is a great place if your in the neighborhood. I wouldn't have you go that far just for the veggies unless that matters to you. But I highly rate this place because they care about the food and in today's world you have to appreciate that much.", "Today was my first time eating from The Great Wall, I was a little frustrated because it was very loud, and there was a bit of a mistake in the order but they were more than happy to issue me a free replacement, once I tasted the food, it was all well worth it, this was by far the best tasting chinese food we had in a long time. My son couln't stop talking about, we already recomended it to 3 friens. my son grew up eating chinese food for lunch almost every day, he likes it that much.", 'TERRIBLE!!! I am mortified! Today I ordered Spicy Singapore Mei Fun and I received a disgusting surprise in my lunch! I’ve never had this kind of experience with a restaurant before. I discovered a FULL BLOWN ROACH in my food! I am traumatized.', 'I don’t know why people are saying customer service is bad. Cause they were extremely nice. Food is pretty good, less than 15 minutes my food was ready. Went around 1pm and the place was super busy so they definitely doing something right. 9 dollars got me general chicken with rice and soup. Definitely recommend this place.']

name: ANGEL
reviews:
['Hidden Hole in the Wall in the Heart Of Jackson Heights . Once upon a time Jackson Heights was called Little India not it’s more of Gold Souk.

Been trying to check this spot for a while now , went few times and couldn’t do the hour waits . Finally made a reservation and made the trip from Long Island.

We were greeting and seated at our reservation time. Restaurant is small with about 8 tables. It was very diverse in there , I guess people traveled to eat there.

We were recommended a few dishes by our waiter but we picked what we wanted . For appetizers we went with Tandoori Chicken , Lamb Sheekh and Lamb Chops . Everything came out fast and sizzling. Portions were great and we barely had room for Main Course . But for main course we decided on traditional Butter Chicken , Chicken Dum Biryani paired with Keema Kulcha and Garlic Naan. Everything was great , it was on the spicier side but I am glad I had it as it was. Also loved the fact that they didn’t tone down the spice level as Indian food is usually spicy.

Overall , I wonder why it’s rated 4.7 out of 5 and trust me it’s better than most of these fine dining Indian restaurants in the city.', "Angel Indian Restaurant: A Queens Culinary Gem

Angel Indian Restaurant in Queens is a total must-try! Their huge menu is packed with amazing Indian dishes, all cooked perfectly with the best ingredients. You'll have a seriously tasty meal here, but make sure to book online first because it gets super busy! They don't take reservations over the phone, so keep that in mind.

Once you're seated, you'll be treated to attentive service that complements the true star of the show: the food. Whether you're a seasoned fan of Indian food or looking to embark on a culinary adventure, Angel is a must-visit destination. They even have a  well-deserved Michelin Bib Gourmand too!", 'The food was really good! The flavor of each dish was great, highly recommend. The service was attentive but also rushed so this is a place where you go to eat and leave, not necessarily stay there for an hour and a half. We were in and out in 45 minutes due to quick service but the place is small and high in demand so it’s understandable why everything needs to be quick.', 'The food the absolutely delicious, I think it’s my best Indian food I’ve in New York. When you close by, you will hear loud music from the restaurant, it brings you to India atmosphere. I ordered both Naan and rich with my dish, it’s a little and very tasty. I finished they all very soon. If you interested, please try Lassi to be drink, because it’s very special drink you ever had.', 'After some hype from close friends we finally ate at Angel. The food was very good and prepared quickly. Comforting and pleasant to eat. We had a cauliflower appetizer, garlic naan, black lentils, and saag tofu. See you again. Thanks 😊']

name: LIDO HARLEM RESTAURANT
reviews:
['I brought my boyfriend here to celebrate his birthday and it was also our first time visiting. We made a reservation and were seated promptly. Service was excellent. We enjoyed the bottomless mimosas and the server made sure to keep them coming. Food was delicious and the restaurant it spacious and super nice. I really appreciate the clean bathrooms as well. Overall 10/10 and will definitely be back to try the dinner menu!', 'Harlem’s Rarest Gem!  From the ambience to the hospitality and the food we were floored. Everything was delicious!! The staff seemed to move seamlessly. This is a definite must go. Our host Ben was a true sweetheart. Add this place to your must do list!!', 'The atmosphere was vibrant with patrons looking happy to be nestled into their seats, enjoying food, drinks and fellowship. The wine was lovely and the eggplant parmesan was light and cheesy with a bed of tangy tomato sauce.  I really wanted to try the grilled kale salad but shared a Caesar salad with my mom instead. She had a simple but delicious spaghetti and meatballs. We liked our short but enjoyable visit to Lido.', 'Lido has been one of my favorite places to eat in Harlem for a good 3-4 years now. I love the clean feel of the space and I enjoy how quiet it can be during the week… great for dining alone!

All items on the menu are created by author Chef Serena Bass who creates delicious menus , which change with the seasons, and everything, including desserts, are made in-house by Chef Bass and her team.

The Spaghettini Arrabiata I can have all day everyday, of course I won’t but it’s delicious. Those noodles are perfection and the grilled shrimp are actually grilled \U0001faf6🏼
The basil really completes this dish for me✨

The creamy Parmesan garlic bread is also delicious, the crab cake delicious (it’s unique).. we just need like one more portion of each 🤞🏽😂 The calamari were fresh and although fried they weren’t hard but airy… we like that over here!

The was the best white sangria I ever had btw, just saying !', 'First time at Lido and I loved everything. I’m lactose intolerant, request a cream-free spaghetti and they were great to offer me a yummy version. Wine list is great and the music is perfect to enjoy a beautiful evening. No reservation needed.']

name: SIENA CAFE • ITALIAN • BAR • RESTAURANT
reviews:
['Such a cute spot!!! The decor is beautiful, the music isn’t too loud. Would recommend to anyone looking for a nice dinner with friends or family. Lovely cocktails - try the Hugo Spritz. I did ask our server’s name but then I immediately forgot it :( She was absolutely lovely. Towards the end of our meal she told us she was a new hire, but we never would have guessed - she was a consummate professional, took excellent care of us and was just generally great.
The food is really good! The burger + truffle fries are great, rich and savoury. The lasagna is huge. Very filling. You’ll want to end your meal with an espresso, which here is reasonably priced and well made. I’ll definitely come here again.', 'During the course of a month, I had their Mondays only lobster and salad dinner ($30 + tax)  three times. The first time I ordered it, I asked for it to be steamed, it was delicious. The next time, again steamed, the lobster had no lobster flavor. The third time I ordered it to be roasted, again it had no lobster flavor. The lobster Mondays offering draws a large amount of diners, as a result, the service was been slow each time.

At another dinner here I ordered the Prince Edward Island mussels in garlic and olive oil, they were very tasty. I did not enjoy them with marinara broth the next time I was there. Their flavor was dominated by the marinara broth. If you order the mussels,  be sure that the waitress writes your order down, otherwise she may bring one with the wrong broth, as was done with me. Pictured below is their filet of branzino ($30) that I enjoyed that evening. The Siena Cafe is located next to a corner deli called Milano Market.', 'I recently had the pleasure of being served by Peter, and I must say, he is an absolute professional! His skill behind the bar is exceptional, and he truly knows how to make guests feel welcome. The ambiance and service were spot-on, creating an experience that was both enjoyable and memorable. Kudos to Peter for making the night exceptional—I’ll definitely be back!!!!', 'I love dining here on Sundays for brunch! It’s an amazing place to hangout, eat have drinks and enjoy great food. The food portion is a lot but it is worth every bite. Trust me!

The staff are helpful and friendly! I HIGHLY recommend this place!

Anything you order you will LOVE!', "It's beautifully decorated, service is attentive and very good and drinks were great according to my friends who had bloody Mary's for lunch. The only reason I'm giving 4 stars is because of the portion size of the skirt steaks we received at brunch. My friend and I had skirt steaks  that look like half of what we both should have received. The flavor was great, but the portion size was really disappointing. It's worth considering to come back judging by the other options on the menu."]

name: HELLO! BANGLADESH RESTAURANT (HALAL)
reviews:
['Food was really delicious. We got it to go. Friendly service. They seem very busy with plenty of seating. Fairly priced as well. Will definitely stop by again.
I forgot what the names of the dishes were but they were really good.', '2 words, Kala Bhuna. Had to try after enjoying the home cook version. It is delicious, finger licking good. Highly recommend. Went with the rice and chicken too. Place was clean. Plenty of seating. Service was friendly and very patient as we looked at the hot food and decided what we wanted.', 'I recently visited this restaurant and ordered two biryanis. Unfortunately, I was very disappointed with the food quality.

1.	The rice in the white biryani was extremely hard, making it impossible to eat.
2.	The chicken in the other biryani was too tough and not edible.

This experience was really unpleasant, and I hope the restaurant improves its food quality in the future.', "i really like this place , on my first day, it seems clean and good place to sit and have lunch or dinner . foods are really nice , not too much oily or too much spicy but i like their food . i’ll try again and recommend for everyone.
also customer service are very welcoming and good hospitality .
and pilau , chicken roast must try
second review :
I recently had a wonderful dining experience at this Bengali restaurant, and I can't recommend it enough! The atmosphere is clean and inviting, making for a pleasant meal.

I tried the goat biryani, which was flavorful and perfectly cooked, and the chicken roast with polao, which was simply delicious. The shami kebab was good, though not as standout as the other dishes. However, the highlight for me was the yogurt served in a clay pot—it was absolutely fantastic!

The staff were incredibly friendly and attentive, adding to the overall positive experience. If you're looking for authentic Bengali cuisine, this place is definitely worth a visit!", 'You can’t get any better Bangladeshi restaurant at this price in New York. Staffs are also awesome and well behaved. Food is great. But the atmosphere sometimes gets noisy for some people which is not their fault anyways. Highly recommended.']

name: QUEENS HIGH PEARL
reviews: ["This great little family-owned restaurant has been a staple in Elmhurst for years, serving up amazing and affordable food. This isn’t your typical American-Chinese fare; this is the real deal. While they do offer dishes like chicken and broccoli, that’s not why you come here.\n\nThe simplicity of the cooking is what makes the food amazing—sometimes, you don't need to overcomplicate dishes. Their lobster is particularly impressive, varying in season to give it a sweet taste, and it's quite affordable. Everything here is cooked to order, so don’t hesitate to ask for recommendations. They know what people will like and won’t like.", 'Pretty good place for chinese food when you have a large party. My favorite dishes are the three color egg and the walnut shrimp with mayo (the sauce is really good). The soup is a little like congee. The white meat in chicken is a little dry. My least favorite is the fried rice.', 'super great food! Taste of authentic chinese cuisine ! super affordable. Portion sizes are family style . If you are in new York definitely need to stop by to taste fast service, lively environment and importantly great food !', 'Good Chinese food. Really local. Family style.', 'Authentic Cantonese cuisine in the heart of Elmhurst off Broadway. Plates were big and everything we ordered came out in less than 15 minutes. Waiter was quick and responsive to our needs. Friendly staff overall. Will come back again to enjoy a hearty and fulfilling meal with family and friends.']

name: HUI
reviews:
["Take-out Review Only
I ordered via Grubhub and the order was ready within 10minutes! I thought that the soup dumplings were amazing in terms of the flavor, softness of the meat, and amount of soup. The filling inside falls apart and is not congealed, which tells me it's a fresh dumpling. I think the skin could be a little thinner.
I also ordered the Beef w/ organic mushroom & black pepper. Every single cut of the beef was *extremely* tender and well seasoned. The mushrooms were fresh and the sauce was just right.

I will definitely be ordering from here again!", 'I came here for lunch but ordered from the chef’s special since the lunch specials featured cliche westernized Chinese food and I was looking for more traditional sichuan cuisine. I ordered the boiled fish and it was mostly okay, and the soup dumplings were a bit too chewy compared to the great ones I’ve had in the past. Overall, decent spot if you’re nearby', 'Fantastic food. Braised whole fish was one of the best in years. Baby eggplant also great. Highly recommend it!', 'Their Sichuan food are the best in upper east side. Love their fish and vegetable dishes. Also the price range is very good.', 'I started coming here when I discovered this restaurant in February 2023.  It has become my go to Chinese restaurant whenever I’m in New York , which is often.  I’ve waited a year before writing a review.  They have a very friendly staff who are welcoming and always smiling.  I love the whole snapper and the fried rice is the best I’ve had in the city.  They also have great cocktails , especially the lychee martini   All cocktails are $14.  Can’t beat that anywhere in the city.  The room is cozy with soft jazz playing.  I have only come for the lunch but I definitely recommend for the food, drinks and great service. On a side note, I’ve noticed most of the patrons are Asians.  That is always a good sign that the food is authentic. I read a review where the writer said she was hassled for a tip.  I have been to the restaurant easily ten times in the last year and NEVER have been disappointed.']

name: PAKSHALA RESTAURANT & GRILL
reviews:
['I was taken aback by how the lady behind the counter was more concerned with her personal video call than packing up my order and processing my payment; my order was sitting there (I ordered by phone in advance for pickup, during which the lady taking the order seemed distracted and irritable) and she took her time attending to her video call, with her phone propped up on the counter, before finally slowly packing the items up as I stood there waiting to pay for my order. It seems this is the norm unfortunately, and perhaps these personal distractions are the reason I wasn't given the samosas I ordered when I came a previous time (although when I came a few days later they did give them to me). While the workers and the manager here generally seemed nice, this is another incident of terrible customer service.

As for the food, I thought it was fairly decent. It is standard Bangladeshi style food (even their "Indian" and "Western" dishes), and if you like Bangladeshi food, then you would probably also enjoy the food from this restaurant.  I ordered chicken biryani, pakshala mixed grill platter, samosas and naan. The samosas were very tasty.

I appreciate how this restaurant is open late, unlike a lot of other places.

I did not like how they changed additional fees for paying by credit card.', 'I tried so many times, But I always forgot to take pic. So I felt guilty for not giving reviews.
PAKSHALA’s food really fresh & delicious.
Recommend for Lollipop Malai, kabab & Salmon fish', 'One of the best Kacchi in NYC. Since they are open, I have been coming here almost every single week few times. Their food quality is always the same and fresh. I love this place❤️. Highly recommended.', 'Food is absolutely delicious! We ordered Pakshala Special Mix Kebab platter, and Chicken roast Pulao- very flavorful. The price is very reasonable for the amount and quality of the food. Small restaurant but I think it will take off quickly!', 'If you like to get the most delicious Indian and Bengali dishes (Kebabs , grills, biryani’s, vegetables and many more) in NYC you should check this restaurant out. Their foods test perfect and made of fresh ingredients. I just love to eat here. Also it’s all Halal food here.👍🏼']

name: NEW MAMA’S RESTAURANT
reviews:
['Bengali Food after a long day is always so comforting. Great meal and amazing quality and taste. Would come back again!', 'As a Bangladeshi, I always try to check out different Bangladeshi restaurant whenever I visit NYC.  Usually I love most of them & give them good review. But recently, this restaurant disappointed me a lot. Their foods are very average while the service is not enough good. The atmosphere is not hygienic. The way they serve the foods also is not very welcoming and clearly show lack of care.

Anyway, let’s talk about the foods. The beef tehari had more than enough beef pieces in it but the meats were very hard to chew for me. The amount was good too. The Morog polao and rui fish were average. I must say, the kachki fish curry is far better in other Bangladeshi restaurants. And lastly, who on earth cooks rupchada fish with string beans! That was totally eww for my tastebud! Their Chana jilapi, kalojam & 2/3 other sweets were also below average.

Definitely I don’t recommend this restaurant & won’t go further by myself!!!', 'yesterday I bought some snacks like vegetable rolls, poori, singara….it was very bad, old stuff inside, very disappointing!', 'Been going here a lot lately and I must say they keep their flavor & salt level the same EVERY time. I tried almost everything there except their biryanis. Their veggie dishes are the best. I have some iftaar photos & they had a ton of great options! I will go back again.', 'Worst experience. Food is left over from other days. They heated in ovenbefore serve, even they claim just come out of kitchen. Very small portion, not enough for kids. Old used/dried and become reddish salat, when we refused to take it they just serve to next table. But the lettuce was dried up. Rice is cooked days before kept in hot pot. Cooking quality is poor not enough salt or spices seems like just boiled with lots of tomatoes as spices . They definitely need to improve.']

name: QRICO LATIN RESTAURANT-57-03 JUNCTION BLVD
reviews:
["Pretty upset with my lunch today. Ordered chicharron and the skin is completely covered in hair. What's the point of getting chicharron if you can't eat the skin? A quick once over with a knife during preparation would have solved this problem. Usually, it's very good but I don't know what happened today. Feels like a waste of my money", 'Their food is typically good, but I dont understand what’s going on with the plantains. I ordered a combo 1 and they sent me black plantains. Like how do you give out food that looks like this ????', "The purpose of this review is not to hate or harm this business in any way. That being said, I hope you take this review as an informative review.

Atmosphere: This place is a small restaurant, clean for the most part, and you'll feel like you are in a Latin American restaurant right away.

Service: So, service can vary depending on which lady is taking orders. The times I've been there, a lady has been really wonderful in every way. There are also other ladies that simply take your order with a face that expresses stress and discontent. Thus, minus one star. I really don't mind them because you see that kind of people everywhere. Overall, I can say that I haven't felt any sort of disrespect from them. I do think there is always room for improvement.

Food: There is a mixture of good and not so good food here. First, let's point out the good side. The broiled chicken, which they call it baked chicken, is pretty good. Some dishes from their breakfast and daily lunch menus are good. Their sandwiches are big and good as well. Sometimes, they usually give a small free side. For example, today was a small salad, another day was guacamole, and one day, I remember they also gave corn chips. Now, the not so good side has to do with the seasoning. It might be personal preference, but they do have some dishes that are a bit saltier than others. It happened to me with a soup. Most of the food from the sideboard, except the rice, is also a bit oily. So, you can imagine who your plate will look like if you chose three things that sautéed with oil. I usually choose one and make my own salad. I also wanted to order a fruity bowl, but they didn't have it. Lastly, the portion of the rice is overwhelming too much. You have to ask them not to serve you too much rice because you end up with more rice than the two sides. Thus, minus one star.

Price: Prices can range between 3.25 and 27.50. Depending on what you want and taking the factors above into consideration, I'd say prices are decent.", "Food was ok, nothing to rave about. Moro rice unfortunately tasted like 'instant' and lacked flavor. Meat was tasty but salty. Lunch prices are different based on what meat you choose. I'd give it another try 😉. Oh and the woman serving can be a little nicer, she seemed annoyed by questions but with no menu and the restaurant being new you can expect customers to ask about prices and what items are.", 'This place seems solid. I can’t comment on how the food tasted but we came in because they just opened and the service was friendly. The food is typical Latin American food- rice, beans, meats, stews. The space is decent sized with a good amount of seating available. Would be a good option if you’re looking for a quick bite']

name: LA PEQUENA TASTE OF ITALY PIZZERIA & RESTAURANT
reviews: ['I always get the pernil here, the skin is always crispy and the flavor is on point, get the white sauce on the side and put a little on your rice, its amazing. I have not tried the pizza here but the hot food buffet is amazing', 'My grandma recommended me this place and I love it! The staff are nice and the taste of pizza brings me back my good-old-day pizzeria in my hometown! Love it🥰', 'Service does not come with a smile but huge attitude from this short blondish cashier.', 'Pizza is very bland. Had little to no sauce on it. It’s $3 a slice which is normal these days but definitely not worth it. I haven’t been here in many years and I was hungry so I gave it a try again but I won’t be back. Also Rude cashier. I wonder if it’s the same rude girl I encountered when I used to call my order over the phone more than 5 years ago.', 'I regret buying here! Don’t be cheap!!! Add the correct amount of marinara sauce! Never ever going back there! Nasty service too.']

name: EL TINA HARLEM RESTAURANT
reviews:
['Food here is amazing! Options are endless and authentic. I moved to Texas a year ago and while visiting this weekend I HAD to stop here and get lunch and orders to take back home. Cariña took very good care of me. She was so sweet. I went to a different place yesterday and it did not deliver the way Tina’s always does. Love them!', 'It is a busy place. Fast pace. Food waste tasty authentic Dominican flavor🇩🇴. The waitress was friendly. Space is tide. Yet enough table & seats to enjoy your meal.

We were too hungry forgot to take a picture of the food. I show you the receipt for ideas of pricing. 😄💖', "What can I say, it's a great Spanish spot we saw on the way back to the hotel. Service was great, the staff was helpful and the portions were like your Spanish friends grandma over feeding you. It was all delicious, and very tasty, chicken was amazing, as was the chicharron. Loved it and the piece was huge. We ordered dinner portions by accident, but still ate quite a bit.

Would not hesitate getting food from here again.", "I was doing my walking routine with my walking partner, and we ended up walking farther than we expected. We were hungry and wanted Dominican breakfast. We were going to get an Uber to take us to Washington Heights. As we were looking for an address to put on the app, we noticed this location. We got the breakfast we wanted and the passion fruit juice that was delicious. The servicer need to work on their customers' service policy. All credit goes to the kitchen staff for their delicious food.", 'I love this spot. They have amazing oxtail and they’re generous with the portions. The black beans have so much flavor, and the service is always friendly and welcoming. I really feel taken care of every time I come in. I love Karina, she always wants to make sure I have everything I need and is very attentive. I can’t wait to come back and try everything on their menu eventually!']

name: CARMINE'S ITALIAN RESTAURANT - UPPER WEST SIDE
reviews:
['I recommend making reservations if you’re going during weekends and during special occasions. Came here during the marathon weekend and it was packed! Otherwise, this location tends to have openings compared to Times Square.

Super big portions (family style) and good food. I highly recommend the antipasti selection. Can’t really go wrong with anything on the menu.', 'The gluten free pasta wasn’t the best but it can be a hit & a miss with that. The salad was awesome! Same for the calamari & baked mussels! Portion is crazy more than enough for two ppl, I would say more family style of dinning.', "We had an amazing dining experience at Carmine's Italian Restaurant on the Upper West Side. The food was absolutely delicious, and the drinks complemented the meal perfectly. We enjoyed so much food that we had to take some home! The portions were generous, and everything was full of flavor. We truly enjoyed our dinner and will definitely be returning. Highly recommend for a fantastic Italian meal!", 'Wowwww each plate is large enough to share. It was so much food we had to pass on desserts. The wait staff and manager were amazing constantly checking on our table.

The manager even cleaned off plates from the tables which is amazing because normally managers stay in the back and it was great to see the interaction with everybody in the restaurand that she supported her staff by actually helping clear off tables and talking to the guests.

I give this restaurant 10 stars, and I highly recommend it. We will definitely be back.

Our waiter was awesome and took the time to explain how large the dishes are so that we did not overorder are food?There were 6 of us.We ordered three meals and we still had tons of food left over.', "Carmines Upper West Side 91st Street on Broadway is a great place for larger groups to enjoy Italian cuisine.  The menu has all of the basic Italian food dishes. The selections are served family style. I think this adds to the conversation and family friendly atmosphere. The food is remarkably well prepared. I thought the spaghetti carbonara was excellent. It can be a difficult dish to get right. Some restaurants will take shortcuts that will impact the flavor of this gourmet dish. The rigatoni bolonase was ok. The Carmines salad and the cold antipasto were both wonderful dishes. My guests commented that they should not have filled up on the bread! The bread is very moist and tasty. However, the salads and the main dishes are pleantyful. I will repeat the advice from my guests. Do not fill up on the bread! Carmines is not a first choice for quiet dinnertime conversation! The place is full of chatter from the other tables. You will hear people singing happy birthday mixed with general crowd noise. Yes it can be noisy at times, but it is a happy noise that doesn't seem to get in the way of nearby conversation.  All in all, the food was delicious and the experience for my first time guests was a pleasant one. They were very happy with the food and the dining experience."]

name: CARIDAD RESTAURANT
reviews: ['The food was delicious. The service is superior. Our server Victor really paid attention to every detail. They serve traditional Dominican and American. We held a small meeting on the 2nd floor. The Best!!! Thank You Caridad ❤️', "I came in around 2:30pm. We ordered from the brunch menu. Thankfully, it didn't take too long to receive our food but we received our main dish immediately after receiving our appetizer. We didn't get salad dressing with the salad that came with our appetizer and we had to wait a while to get it. Then we had to wait a long time to have them clear our dishes and bring our dessert. It was about 45 minutes or more. It took them so long to bring our check. My friend had to go and help her walk out. When they finally took the payment, it took a long time to get my card back even though I saw him give another table their card back before me. Last but not least, the music was so loud, I couldn't talk to my friend right next to me. The live music is nice, the singer is talented but extremly overwhelming and defeating the purpose of the music, which is to bring people together... I couldn't talk to my friends who I hadn't seen in a long time. The food was tasty but a very small portion. The Churro was very greasy. the soup was great. The server was nice but he seemed overwhelmed and doing too much. It was frustrating waiting for so long. I thought we would be there for 2 hours...but it was more like 3 hours. it seemed really disorganized. Please do better.", 'I always get their lunch special rotisserie chicken with a side of their sweet plantains. If you can find yourself a good ginger beer it really makes the dish pop! The savory paired with the sweet always hits the spot. These dishes feel like family recipes too and give comfort food vibes. I usually only grab to-go but the staff seems very friendly every time I pick up.', 'The food was truly amazing 🤩 and the service with Victor was 10/10 always on time. My siblings are picky eaters but the actual enjoyed everything we got. We will be back again soon.', 'I love this place. Everyone who works here is very nice. I placed an order for delivery and they sent me some Halloween candy with my order. So very thoughtful. They always have fresh good quality food as well. Will always order from here']

name: CHEZ JACOB
reviews: ["Arrived for lunch - were given a menu, but when we ordered we were given only 1 option. At the same time we saw that other patrons could order different food. Fish smelled bad and could of been rotten before cooking, so didn't touch it. Chicken was ok, but have no idea what dish on the menu it was. In the end we had to pay 43$ for two meals, but there was nothing on the menu that was that expensive. So unless you're familiar with or know the owners, don't go.", 'I love this restaurant for traditional Senegalese takeout. (I would dine in when pandemic is over). They even have attaya, Senegalese tea, while you wait for your order!\nEverything we ordered is delicious and since I don’t live nearby I always order extra so I have leftovers. Staff have all been friendly.', 'What? Talk about friendly. From the others in there to the waitress, everyone was just like making you feel welcomed. The portions are big.  I had the red snapper and it was so good. The hot sauce is really hot, not that fake hot. The waitress was so nice. I would come back in a heartbeat.', 'I recently visited this restaurant and was extremely disappointed with the customer service. From the moment we walked in, the staff seemed uninterested and unwelcoming. We had to wait an unusually long time to be seated, even though there were plenty of empty tables. Once seated, it took forever for our server to take our order, and when the food finally arrived, it was cold and not as described on the menu. To top it off, our server was rude and dismissive when we pointed out the issues. Overall, it was a very frustrating experience, and I would not recommend this restaurant to anyone.', 'Delicious! Is the best way I can describe my meal so good I ordered  another one to go for my father. I am very glad they are reasonably priced as other places near by are inflated. I ordered jellof rice w lamb and it was full of flavor. This is hands down my second favorite African restaurant in Harlem. I did not give them a 5 star because I couldn’t get past the poor service from the cashier/waitress. She took ages to come and place order and has a serious case of RBF. She was on her phone and then having a 20 minute conversation with a friend who came inside. She totally ignored us until I began speaking pigeon English. Aside from that this is a cozy spot in Harlem where you can come and enjoy authentic dining. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for good food.']

name: AMERICAN RESTAURANT
reviews: ['I adore this place as it gives me a cozy feeling of home, anticipating a well-prepared meal. The owners are delightful and welcoming, and the establishment is consistently clean and inviting. One of my preferred dishes to order is the Shrimp pasta with vegetables. So if you ever in the neighbors stop by and check it out for yourself', 'Food is great. Its a family owned establishment. Employees are very friendly and respectful.  The place is clean . The atmosphere is great  they make you feel like you are family.', 'Very good food. Family owned and everyone is very welcoming. They can customize as per your preferences.\nGreat breakfast, lunch, and dinner options!', 'Please do not change your cooking staff  they are doing an excellent job their food is amazing !!!! First time coming and I just finish eating food was delicious, the place very clean!\nI will definitely come back again!!!!', 'Play restaurant134700']

name: MELBA'S RESTAURANT
reviews:
["This restaurant is absolutely amazing! We had the most fantastic waiter ever, Bryan!! My husband and I were there to celebrate both of our birthdays and he certainly made it very special! A dear friend that lives in New York suggested this restaurant and it certainly did not disappoint! Melba's food is seasoned to perfection, fresh and beyond delicious. The yams are to die for the dessert is really good as well we will definitely come back when visiting New York again. Do not sleep on this restaurant. Their culinary expertise is phenomenal!! 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟", "Nestled in the heart of Harlem, Melba's has long been a staple for soul food enthusiasts. We recently dined there and sampled two classic dishes: chicken and waffles, and oxtail with yams and mac & cheese.

The chicken and waffle combination was satisfying, though not particularly memorable. The chicken was well-seasoned, but it lacked the wow factor we were expecting from a place known for soul food excellence. As for the oxtail, it was tender but a bit too sweet, and the sides of yams and mac & cheese didn't quite hit the mark. The yams were sweet but slightly underwhelming, and the mac & cheese could have used a sharper kick of cheese.

Service, however, was a highlight. The staff were attentive and friendly, making the experience more enjoyable. They were quick to respond to requests and ensured our meal was served promptly.

One downside was the restaurant's ambiance. Unfortunately, the dining area had a slight mildew smell, which detracted from the overall experience.", 'Some of the best soul food we have eaten outside of the Southern US!! The spring rolls with collard greens is a great take on some classic flavors. The catfish was perfect with a great remoulade sauce. The eggnog waffles with the chicken and waffles were outstanding and the chicken very flavorful and crispy.', 'The waitress was very nice. The Greens was my absolute favorite. I can talk about this all day, not bitter, not soggy they were totally phenomenal.

The oxtails were tender.
The Yams were not too sweet, just right.
The salmon was great, and the mac and cheese were cheese.
The fries were good also.
The fried chicken was .... the outside on point, the meat was not seasoned.', 'Nestled in Harlem, this place has everything! Food , music and atmosphere! I’m literally counting down the days until me and bae go back! The catfish was fried to perfection, the sweet potatoes … I’ll have dreams about them! The red velvet cake was moist and oh-so sweet! I had to remind myself to stay still in my seat as I jammed to the music as I sipped and ate! It was a lovely experience!']

name: WIMPY'S RESTAURANT
reviews: ['Just a solid neighborhood place. You can spent 15 bucks on fast food mystery meat or a few more (or less ) and have an absolute quality meal. This is my goto at least once a week. Meat is properly seasoned and the veggies are always fresh.', 'A couple years ago my boyfriend tried buffalo wings for the first time, he got the chance to do it at this place and since then he hasn’t stopped thinking about them. I loved the bagel with cream cheese and also the vegetarian pizza. We got such a good welcome and attention here and they hablan español! Espero podamos volver algún día, de verdad nos gustó mucho.', "I have tried pizza in many restaurants in New York. This is pizza (cheese slice) similar to what I call the best. In restaurant have a sit place and play good chill music. Yup, it's not fashion restaurant, but one of the best in its segment!", 'Good food, clean environment friendly service. You can bring your whole family to enjoy a meal. The  breakfast is good but you have to try the turkey burger deluxe. The burger is flavorful and hits the spot everytime. Good spot for pancakes and crispy bacon.', 'Nice eatery for a Sunday afternoon']

name: HARLEM PUBLIC
reviews: ['I’m not sure how to rate Harlem Public. I wanted to like it, but of everything our table ordered - a burger, a loaded grilled cheese, mozzarella sticks, wings, fried cauliflower, Caesar salad, and fried pickles, the best was the wings. Nothing had any flavor. We were pouring and pouring salt on our food. I ordered a burger medium and it was more than well done. But I our server was excellent and took the burger off.', 'This was a nice little spot for a casual dinner. They have a decent selection of craft beers on tap and a good menu of pub food including some creative burgers. I got the peanut butter. My first time having peanut butter on a burger but have to say, along with the ample bacon, it compliments it quite nicely. Nice big beefy burger as well. The tater tots are quite good too - nice and crunchy. I’d come back if in the neighborhood', 'My vegetarian girlfriend’s favorite restaurant serving a completely vegetarian burger. Personally, I appreciate their creative burgers (peanut butter, for example), but I mostly come here given it’s a good compromise when looking for a good burger that has vegetarian options.', 'Finally came here for lunch and we were the first people there (they just opened) and immediately was greeted by Alley and I knew right away she was going to be a great waitress!\n\nDrinks were on point! (I’m picky) lol and the food was good too I got the loaded grilled cheese! If you like comfort food and genuine service this is THE SPOT!', "This place truly gives you the vibe 😌 of a true Irish pub! I don't eat meat, so this was a true vegan burger 😋! 10/10..... My espresso martini was delicious as well!"]

name: MOFONGO DEL VALLE
reviews: ["We ordered delivery who ever took the order on the phone , has very poor customer service, she took the order wrong and she was very nasty , slam the phone while ya asking how long they were going to take.\nWhen we finally got the order omg the ribs were burnt and dry , we had ordered costillas guisadas we were going to eat it but no way to dry, we called to let them know that what we got it was not what we order, the same female was even nastier argued on the phone that was the right order didn't even offered to send a replacement hung up and send the money with the delivery man. Bien malcriado esta chica asi como, la comida no era gratis pagamos por UN servicio.", 'Never again! A rude older woman was arguing with me, and then when I said never mind to my order, she proceeded to put the used container back onto the shelf to be used again. I gave her $7 cash for a $6 Morrir, and she proceeded to take a $1 tip. Also, the drink tasted spoiled, and I could only take two sips.', 'I reserved food here through Too Good To Go, an app that reduces food waste by buying food left over from the day at a discounted price, I paid $11. I got there 2 minutes late. 2 MINUTES!!! Because it’s July 4th and the trains packed and delayed. The staff was outside recording fireworks and refused to give me anything because “they threw everything out.” I was late by TWO MINUTES. This was the first time I’m ever had a problem picking up food through the app. I would give them 0 stars if I could!!! Never again!!! A shame too because I was looking forward to it.', 'I ask for naked chicken wing, they send me the most spicy wings ever, I finished in the hospital for a allergic reaction, I can not be near of spicy, and this people don’t even answer the phone, I will sue this people for the damage!', 'Worst place to order  food for delivery!  I ordered half of chicken, with the rice, salad & beans and an extra side beans. The food was mad late and when I called to the restaurante the lady asked me to order again so the could sand a replace order. It’s this a joke? Definitely I don’t recommend this place 😡😡']

name: FUMO HARLEM
reviews:
['Fumo was hands down on of the most wonderful dining experiences we have had in New York. Everything from the delicious food and wonderful service. The extremely friendly staff made the whole experience truly enjoyable. Francesco the owner was very involved great hospitality and just wonderful person. The baked clams were to die for. We would highly recommend this place and will come back again when we are in town.', 'I’ve been coming here since 2017 and it’s been consistently amazing. Perfect menu of pasta, pizza, and salads. They also make a killer gluten free rigatoni! Lots of dairy free options too.

Get the Fumo Spritz!', 'Came her over a year ago, but the food seems like it got better. The baked clams very good, definitely give them a try.', 'Our meal, drinks, and dessert were absolutely delicious!! We enjoyed expresso martinis, wine, fried mozzarella, pasta, seafood, spinach with fresh garlic, and the olive oil cake which is a must have.', "Fumo Restaurant exceeded all my expectations with its delectable Italian cuisine and amazing vibes. Every dish was a delight, bursting with authentic flavors that transported me straight to Italy lol. The ambiance was lit and welcoming, perfect for a dinner with your SO or a night out with friends.

A special shoutout to our waiter, Steven (with the Afro), who was top-tier in every way. His attentive service and friendly demeanor made our dining experience truly exceptional and he had the best recommendations. Fumo is definitely a Harlem gem, and I can't wait to return!"]

name: XOCHIMILCO FAMILY RESTAURANT
reviews: ["Homemade Mexican food, if my mother liked the pozole(homemade) that says it all. Our plates were delicious, first time here but I can truly say that it's my favorite Mexican restaurant. Very very happy, I live in Miami but whenever I come back to NYC,  I'll come here for Mexican food. I strongly recommend it.", "I went with a small group and shared a few dishes. My go-to dishes when getting Mexican food are birria tacos and Huaraches. I got the Huaraches here and it was cool. I would have scored it better if the shell/tortilla had a better texture to it. Mine was a little fragile and broke apart. It wasn't bad though. The mole and tacos were good. The best part was their aguafresca.", 'A small and extremely cute spot with incredible food and equally incredible service. The staff was lovely, the food was very reasonably priced, and quality was incredible.', 'The food is was favorable! The enchiladas de mole  with chicken was a bit spicy, and that came with rice and beans. The French fries were good too. The quesadilla de queso big in portion, good for the price. It was 8:30pm and it was not packed for a Wednesday. Agua de Jamaica was delicious. The margarita flavor Maracuya was exceptional!! The only thing it can improve in would be to check in with us more to ask if we needed anything else. Besides that everything was acceptable.', 'Oh wow, came here first day in the Bronx, and was really impressed with this quality delicious feast! I had a chimnichanga, which was awesome and good value, very filling, and my partner had the special cemita sandwich, which has a unique veggie in it called a Papalo ,  super tasty!']

name: SAN JOSE RESTAURANT
reviews:
["Delicious food, When I come by, I have to always finish my plate when I'm here. I love their food, and I've been coming here more often than not. The people are lovely and kind, if your looking for a Mexican restaurant this is the place to go. They have karaoke at times, singing all types of Spanish music, and it's just overall wonderful experience", "I didn't expect alot from here since I randomly went there but omg I really really enjoyed my meal.
Our dishes were all quite good and the owner was really nice to us.
Oh. If you dont like silantro, please let them know when you order the food. It is all over the plate including the sauce, toppings and decoration lol", 'I ate here yesterday September 23rd, 2023 between 10:30pm 11:15pm

So I need to address the ELEPHANT in the room…..Was I served JOLLOF RICE?!! Because when I had seen my plate come out the kitchen… I won’t lie i literally thought it was JOLLOF RICE… but after tasting it, I immediately knew it wasn’t. But LET IT BE KNOWN SAN JOSE’s RICE AND BEANS WAS PHENOMENAL! Perfectly cooked fluffy rice; beans was cooked amazingly!

My chips and salsa tasted fresh and homemade so that was enjoyable!

Now for the MAIN EVENT….

After a long day of mailman business and dropping off supplies at my family’s spot. I was craving A WRAP OR SOMETHING SIMILAR WITH EXTRA CONDIMENTS(y’all know how I do). So I had to dig deep and remember I’ve eaten at this establishment before but never reviewed this place yet.

I ordered the chicken and chorizo quesadilla (homemade corn tortilla)… FLAWLESS. The chicken was seasoned well balanced. Chorizo didn’t taste like it was cheap packaged meat. Everything to my point of view was fresh and good quality. But I must say I’d wish the ratio of bread to meat. I would of preferred a bit more meat…but there is an option for that. Bathroom was decent.. overall the night was ended beautifully with a live performance from some local artist who was singing karaoke which was also beautiful. Yeah I was mostly paying attention to my late dinner but anyway. It was goood. It’s all good. The staff were good. Food high quality made to order.

Please support the locals !', "Don't eat here. Trust me. Rats 🐀 all around the kitchen and back rooms. They store food in the basement of the building, very dirty. The owner is a bad host, no parking. If we have a yankee game, definitely no parking unless you paid for one across the street.", 'Incredible food & service. The BEST! Authentic, lots of flavor and beautifully presented. Get the Tacos Birria - amazing!']

name: LA PATRONA RESTAURANT
reviews: ['Amazing food cheap prices great atmosphere I love this place shout out to Mariana she is amazing 🤩 karaoke 🎤 Friday Saturday and Sunday I recommend this place so much', 'The food is good but ordering online or over the phone is a waste of time. I live close but the delivery guy didn’t want to deliver to my address. I ordered from two different parties & both orders were canceled. Canceled through grubhub because apparently they’re out of tacos, guacamole, chips and rice and beans lol. Don’t order through chownow even though it’s an option. Just wasted an hour of my life. If you live close just do a pickup', 'The flautas only come with 3. I don’t mind but with no rice and beans? I purchased rice on the side and they serve it in a 8oz coffee cup. The chicken was so dry and it’s not even shredded (how chicken in flautas are usually served). I will not be returning to this establishment nor would I be recommending this establishment to any of my friends or family.', 'Hello. I, unfortunately, have never been to" La Patrona" yet,  but for all of us that are interested in coming,  would you please write what the name of the meal is underneath, when taking a picture. That would be extremely  helpful.\n\nThe reviews sound good, the food looks delicious and fresh, I\'m just curious as to what delicious meal t I\'m looking at. Thank you to all in  advance, that are going to help us out.😊👍', 'Catered birthday celebration at another location and the food was superb. Delivery & set up were on point, such a joy to work with La Patrona. Highly recommend.']

name: MAISON HARLEM
reviews: ['Fantastic brunch.  The only problem was that we wanted to order the whole menu.  Eggs Benedict, the Brique & chicken ratatouille sandwich were all excellent.  Service was perfect. Ambiance excellent.  Loved it!', "The host was less than hospitable. I didn't really care for the menu. All of their pastas come in a white sauce when I asked if they can make it in a red sauce they did which I appreciate it but it was bland.", 'We were given a recommendation to try this place and we are so glad we went.  The food, atmosphere and service were excellent.  We would pass this recommendation along to anyone!', 'Cool spot. Will remember! Food was good. Had a few cocktails. Bartender was friendly and personable with a full bar! Proud of that I believe his name was Edgar.\n\nWould come back from his service alone. Manager was cool too, and the waitstaff was present and attentive!', 'Food was great. Atmosphere was awesome.  Bar at the front. Dining at the back. Great music and happy energy.  Good people watching to boot']

name: OSO
reviews:
["Oso offers a creative spin on Mexican classics that I thoroughly enjoyed. The watermelon salad struck a perfect balance of savory, fresh, and slightly sweet flavors. The birria tacos, while not traditional, were still delicious, and the consommé was so good I ended up drinking it by itself. And don't skip desserts – the churros were soooo good and the portion was generous. Highly recommend!", 'The food is decent, but the happy hour policy is confusing and your server will happily scam you if you’re not careful.

We were told that you have to order two of the same drink in order to get 50% off both. We did this for two rounds, and were ultimately charged for 4 full-priced drinks because we “weren’t supposed to change our drink order.” Even the first round, which was placed before 6pm, was charged full price. When asked to clarify the policy, our server Ariana was very condescending and did not offer to help.

The guac is nice but absolutely not worth $14. Birria tacos were flavorful and bigger than I expected, albeit the $14 price is still steep. The mole sauce on my enchiladas was flavorful but a bit watery and there was an unpleasant bitterness to the lettuce garnish or something else in the enchilada.

The food made us want to go back and try more, but we will not be returning because of the strange happy hour policy and unhelpful staff. I have been to many happy hours all over the city and have never seen such a policy.', 'ABSOLUTELY AMAZING ALL AROUND!!!
Such incredible food and drinks. Staff are friendly and knowledgeable. The Pozole was amazing. We sat at the kitchen bar and watching the chefs execute each dish was absolute food porn. RECOMMEND!!!!!', 'Love it! Very nice ambience, great food, big portions, and very very affordable. We ordered tamales, and tuna ceviche as appetizers. For mains - we ordered burrito, and quesadillas. Portions were so filling that we took half of the order to go. All with tips was about $66 for two people! (Which clearly was for more than two people as we took a lot to go). Plenty of seats -indoors, outdoors, and at the kitchen. At night, the restaurant is dimly, romantically lit, making it a perfect spot for a date.', "This restaurant is phenomenal. The food is fantastic! So much so that we came on Cinco de Mayo and waited for a table just to get in. They do have 2 for 1 specials on drinks, but otherwise no other deals or happy hour specials. The seating is well spaced considering the restaurant is smaller. Being able to see into the kitchen as they make the food makes it that much tastier. I really feel connected when I can see them fresh pressing the tortillas 😋 It's very cool. I will say, the fish taco was my least favorite of the foods we ate. I felt like the actual fish got lost under the delicious sauce and well seasoned breading. It was overall tasty, but I wasn't getting much fish flavor with all the other stuff going on. Regardless, EVERYTHING we ate was BOMB and we will be back!
Ate: guacamole, pulpo, tacos- fish, birria, al pastor"]

name: THE ORIGINAL VENICE RESTAURANT
reviews:
['I don’t know if the owners are the same from the late 60s early 70s but I remember the spaghetti and meatballs were to die for as well as the lasagna and my dad’s favorite spaghetti and meat sauce. I also remember the veal Parmesan; outstanding. I grew up in the projects a block away until 1975. Venice Restaurant was a pure slice of Italy. I remember the owner and his wife; they loved my appetite! Good memories! I’m trying to get back to eat next year since I’m in California now. Thank You', 'I liked it a lot and not just because we share the same name but because the ambiance was so inviting.
I like the music they played too.
I had the chef salad, and it was just so fresh. Would definitely return.', "If I told you there was an Italian place right here in the heart of the South Bronx, that not only was true to its name but was a relaxed sit down restaurant, what would you say?

I would assume you would laugh in my face and so would I, for good reason. Almost like a hidden treasure Original Venice is one of those locations that aren't too flashy when it comes to getting people's attention. Most likely if you lived in the area you would have walked past it, noticing the name, but also not observing the fact that it was a cool Italian spot there.

Well here is your recommendation to visit the place, take a seat, and just enjoy yourself.

Prices are good, food is plentiful, and taste. They say they do pizza but I'm all about that fried calamari.

The place is a little on the small side, so if you're a group of 200+ I'd suggest having them cater. My brother orders from them on Uber eats all the time and I have visited several times. Whether to sit in, or take out, it all out.

Thumbs up.", 'The food and the service is amazing!!!
