Make you feel welcomed and the like authentic Italian cooking.', "The first time they made was 5/5 no to much or lil sauce 2nd time not so much they drenched it in Alfredo sauce the food is good I just hope next time it's not drowning in Alfredo"]

name: LAS PALMAS RESTAURANT
reviews:
['Came with my friends for dinner and we enjoyed our time here😊 ambiance of restaurant is nice 👍 gave complimentary salsa and chips that was soo delicious and yummy 😋 10/10 experience and can’t wait to go back 😊 music is good and not too loud.', 'We dined in for the first time. The drinks are strong, the portion sizes are great, the service is amazing!!! We were basically stuffed after the appetizer. There are so many options on the menu it was hard to choose. The enchiladas were delicious, as well as the quesabirria. 10/10 experience, can’t wait to go back.', 'Had bestest Mexican food at this place in NYC.
Must visit place.
Also you can go with your baby and will get high chair.', "Atmosphere: 5/5
The restaurant is full of traditional references and vibrant colors, the music is good and is not too loud, which is really good to enjoy our food and maybe talk for moments while eating.

Service: 5/5
Service is amazing, our waitress was exceptional, really friendly, in a good mood and she was really active while serving others.
They have a small bell, which is really nice instead of screaming around and, although I didn't see the kitchen, some moments when the curtains opened, I was able to see a bit and it seemed really clean and chefs were wearing appropriate clothes.

Entrance: 4/5
The door is quite difficult to use, while it's easy for people to go in and out, it's quite difficult if you have a baby stroller or use a wheelchair.

Food: 5/5
Fries were really good, and you can choose between the fries and beans with rice, I ordered shrimp quesadilla, which had some guacamole with it. My chaperone/mother ordered an enchiladas quesadilla. And my sister enjoyed the fries!
Oh, and the champurrado was really good, and warmed the body. It was freezing outside!!", 'My intention was to grab a quick bite to go but I ended up eating at the bar.  Staff was friendly, atmosphere was lively and the taco was good.  The green and red sauce was everything. I’ve been meaning to return whenever I’m in the neighborhood.']

name: MI RANCHITO
reviews: ['Lively, fun and delicious late night meals. We were hungry and tired and craving some authentic hearty Mexican dishes, and this were right in front of us! What a pleasant surprise!\nThey have karaoke and honestly it was fun listening to latin songs and have some good food! The portion is massive for a very very reasonable price! Their guac is on another level!\nOnly downside was the staff not fluent in English, which isn’t a big problem but we had trouble communicating and got the wrong order, but it was so so delicious regardless!!!', "Delicious authentic Mexican food made with fresh ingredients. The service is great waitresses and waiters always in good spirit. The prices won't break your pocket.  I love the Tamarindo juice and the Gorditas o yeah and the mole. The drinks are great.", 'Delicious tasting Mexican food... a Great neighborhood favorite spot !!...Wonderful service in a comfortable... clean environment ...Delicious homemade recipes .A great menu... assorted Mexican dishes cooked to perfection !!...very friendly wait staff.... " Kudo\'s to the chef & staff @ Mi Ranchito !!!  5 stars here', 'I’ve always come here and it’s always been good but today it was different and horrible, the food tasted nasty! And after I complained they said I should’ve let them know first (when I didn’t even finished it, and I tried to without complaining but it was just that nasty that I couldn’t continue eating it) and I replied I’m going to pay it just give me something else (not in a rude way) and they were like we will give you something else in exchange which was okay, but what I didn’t like is that they were talking about it where I could hear them and just being messy!!! Saying it wasn’t damage and just staring back and just talking to talk when I didn’t make a big deal about it I was going to pay it either way but yeah!! Last time I will be going there plus their tacos tasted nasty as well! Bad service plus no respect for their customers! Very disappointed! 👎🏼👎🏼👎🏼', 'Hands down the best steak burrito I’ve had in Washington Heights, definitely better than Taco Inn up the block. The portions are also generous and pricing is very affordable, can’t beat $10 for a burrito!']

name: CITY ONE
address: 2726 Frederick Douglass Blvd A, New York
reviews: ['Ordered for delivery, the guy over the phone was rushing to take the order. The food is EXCELLENT. I ordered Vegetable Lo Mein with General tos chicken. The chicken was crispy, the portion was enough to feed 2 people. I also ordered shrimp fried rice and chicken wings, the chicken was amazing, very crispy, seasoned well and not too big and not too small. I have always passed this Chinese restaurant and today was the delay I decided to order. This will be my new go to Chinese', 'Very quick, tasty and excellent service. I ordered the sesame chicken, shrimp fried rice, egg roll and fried dumplings with iced tea to wash it all down. Everything was on point, I found my new go to Chinese restaurant when I’m in the area.', "Food is fantastic. Can see why they got their B rating, but with a little more cleanup, they'll be up to a 5 rating from the City. Truth.", "For many years, I lived across the street from this hidden gem -- and took it for granted. The food is always quick, fresh and delicious, and the people are always friendly. After I moved out of NYC, I came to realize how difficult it is to find truly good Chinese food.  I've moved back now, and they're as good as I remember.  Do yourself a favor and give them a try, if you haven't. You'll certainly become a regular.  There are many great items on the menu -- do some exploring.", 'Service is friendly and efficient.  The dining area and tables is always clean.  The food varies depending upon the dish yet for the most part it is above average.  Especially the standards such as Lo Mien, Chow Mien, Fried Rice, Egg/Spring Rolls and Chicken Wings.']

name: LA TERRAZA
reviews: ["Everything here is spot on I never come across anything bad the food is great sometimes I take the trip just to ear here I don't know alot of the dishes I just go and grab something new everytime", 'First time ordering and not only they accept credit cards, they delivery guy was fast. The food was properly prepared, cooked very well done, not oily or greasy and taste so good and well seasoned. Thank you for your service. Very well appreciated 😊👌', 'I’ve been going here for the last 4 years and truly I’d rather go somewhere else for Dominican food. They’re not always kind, it can be hard to get someone’s attention to order and sometimes the food is old. I bought a tin of plátanos maduros and they were dry and hard. It sucks going to a place when you’re not sure of the type quality of food or service you might get.', 'I went there on April 17 2022 in the afternoon .. they complete messed up my order didn’t give me what i asked for and the food was old and had a weird taste had to throw it out. I wouldn’t recommend this place to my worse enemy. and i tipped them extremely well', "Way overpriced for what it is.  The food wasn't that good, not nearly hot enough and they overpriced the order after the fact.  Everything tasted like heavy oil. The place didn't exactly seem clean. I would say a little on the dingy side.  I will not be going back unless of course EVERYTHING in NYC is closed."]

name: RAICES DEL VALLE RESTAURANT
reviews: ["Assuming that this is the one up in Jerome and 176th Street (Bx), it is one of the best places to eat in that neighborhood. I don't go there as often as I used to since I've moved to Staten Island. But when I'm in the area I make it a point to stop there to eat. Their portions are generous and their food is delicious. The prices aren't bad either.", 'THIS IS A WONDERFUL FRIENDLY PLACE TO EAT WITH THE WHOLE FAMILY WITH FRIENDS OR ALONE LIKE I DID 😊 THE FOOD AMAZING! CUSTOMER SERVICE AMAZING!', 'Food is delicious! Staff is amazing as well', 'Fresh food with many options to pick from, the restaurant is clean and the staff is nice and work fast. Delicious Dominican Food that feels like home! If you order Delivery is a little slow.', 'I always order from here, I usually NEVER have a problem unless their sweet plantains are old and sometimes the food can seem old. Last night I ordered at 7:50pm, waited all hours of the night until it was their closing time and my food NEVER ARRIVED. I also called TWICE in between the time that I originally ordered to their closing time to ask when is my food coming? They told me it was busy so I said cool, no problem… I call in the morning to inquire about this (and also because I paid with card and I want my money back) and the lady on the phone tells me to call after 3pm because she wasn’t working at that time. So I call after 3pm, now the lady who answers the phone is extremely rude, telling me that “it’s strange” that I’m claiming I never received my food, basically insinuating that I am LYING. Which is crazy to me because I don’t care about the food anymore, it’s the next day, I just want my $40 back on my card. And they want to act like they have no idea what’s going on and they can’t help me. This was it for me, won’t be ordering here no more. We had a good run through 🤷\u200d♀️']

name: MAX SOHA
reviews:
["The food was delicious and the service was good, but don't bother taking anyone for their birthday. Not only did I call ahead of time to let them know, but I also had to tell them again in person so that they could arrange something for my partner. (Of course, the person that I spoke to over the phone did not communicate this with the other staff). Even then they couldn't even simply write a happy birthday or even an hbd on the dessert.  I was highly disappointed in that being that that was the most important aspect of the night.", "Haven't been here since early last year. This is my new regular now.

After going to Via Carota yesterday and being extremely disappointed I wanted to come back to Max Soha and see if my first impression was blinded by not having tried many restaurants in NY at that time.

With my wife we had 2 pasta specials, 1 bruschetta and 2 desserts and I have to say everything was extremely superior to the highly hyped Via Carota (not to mention price friendly).

Pastas were extremely good and the desserts were impressive...would highly benefit from having more cocktails though!", 'I really hope no one finds this gem ever — great vibe, great homemade pasta specials, great daily fresh juice, lovely furnitures, staff and music. Woah. I will come every night if I can. But again, I really hope no one finds this place ever, so I can keep it to my heart.', 'Came here as a group of 5 people. We got a couple salads, pasta dishes and the salmon. It was very tasty and well cooked.', 'Delicious Italian restaurant. The lasagna may be better if it has a thinner pasta. The salad was good, but nothing spectacular, just salad. The desserts were really good. We have a creme brulee and a mango cake.']

name: MAMA TALA RESTAURANT
reviews: ['Food tastes good but they give you NO chicken whatsoever. I’ve been to so many Dominican food spots and they are supposed to give you more chicken than that. Plus there were bones in my rice and the rice was hard.', 'I love this restaurant Spanish food I go every time I go on lunch break and the food always taste good the lady that work there are very friendly', "I went here for mother's day. My mother enjoyed the food. I was not to enthused about the food. Was it good? Yes. Did it makes this place memorable? No. They also took very long with our order. What they do have have was an amazing display of desserts. I did order a caramel tres leches, amazing. Not high on my list but If you need a good meal and a great dessert this is the place.", "The food is tasty which is why I enjoy ordering take out, but HOW LONG HAS IT BEEN SINCE THE MENUS HERE HAVE BEEN UPDATED? The new prices are quite a surprise.  Update the menus, and there won't be any unpleasant surprizes.", 'Very good!! Everything was on point. Tostones was a little on the greasy side on some but it wasn’t the worse I’ve ever had. This was a Grubhub pickup. They initially did not have what I ordered on the app but they happily substituted for something else. Great customer service. Would come here again.']

name: GRINI'S GRILL
reviews: ['Always good service. Platter price is very reasonable and affordable. Portion is generally big. Food sometimes is good and sometimes not so much.', 'Food is delicious. Crowded most times, not enough serving staff, staff unpleasant & slow. Very few tables and too crowded to sit and eat.', "THE BEST SPANISH FOOD IN THE HOOD\nThe only issue is you gotta double park to get some food if you're driving, and they take time with your food, so you gotta wait.", 'Horrible customer service. Most of the food looks old. They were good about 15 yrs ago.', 'Best Dominican food in Harlem! Hearty portions, very flavorful & homemade tasting. My favorite is the grilled chicken salad, but everything here is amazing. Reasonable prices too!']

name: BRICIOLA HARLEM
reviews:
['Delicious food, great service and atmosphere. The pizza tastes so fresh, the pasta has great taste and everything is seasoned to perfection. The staff is so welcoming and friendly, they really take care of you here. You can sit at the bar or get a table, you’ll have a great time.', 'I am in love with this restaurant!♥️ 20/10 for sure. Best risotto EVER! The wine selection, the atmosphere, the lighting, and of course the food. Its perfect if you want to spend a lovely evening and you are a foodie. Its a MOST! 💯', 'Our party had two vegetarians and there were plenty of options.  We had a gnocchi with truffles special, the penne with artichokes and the fettuccini with mushrooms and they were all excellent although the fettuccini was the winner.  For appetizers we had the broccoli rabe which was slightly underdone for our taste but a truly outstanding eggplant caprino. Staff was very attentive especially considering we were the only ones sitting g outside.', "This tiny Italian restaurant offers a delightful culinary experience with its delectable array of pizzas, pastas, and appetizers. Each dish bursts with authentic flavors, showcasing the essence of Italian cuisine. The restaurant boasts an impressive selection of wines, perfectly complementing the savory delights on offer. Whether you're craving a classic Margherita pizza or a rich, creamy pasta dish, it delivers excellence in every bite. With its cozy atmosphere and attentive service, it's the perfect spot for a memorable dining experience.", 'Stepping into this cozy spot near 145th and St. Nicholas Ave feels like a bit of an escape from the hustle and bustle of this busy Harlem corner. You can tell the folks who dine here are regulars.

Servers are smartly dressed and greet you with a welcoming hello. Pick your own table or settle in at the bar. Daily Italian specials are handed to you on a small chalk board.

Food comes quickly and you can see into the small kitchen where chefs are working hard. Wine and beer only restaurant.']

name: THE EDGE HARLEM
reviews:
['So freaking good! Came across this place for Sunday brunch and everything was so freaking good. Pretty big space inside. The food was so delicious and big portions too. The menu has Jamaican, English and American fare. The food came out lightning fast. Every bite of my BLT with Jamaican Jerk chicken was to die for. The shrimp and grits was also perfect in every way. And plenty left over to take home. This a great place and very popular too.', 'What can I say? I love this quaint neighborhood spot! My cousin and I had a cousin-date there for brunch and the food was on point! The crispness of the fish and the creaminess of the grits was beyond great. Sorrel was really fresh and tasted just right 🥰 Service was very good as well. I thought about the grits today😉😋🤣', 'I absolutely loved this place! I was visiting from South Africa and I was looking for a great brunch spot and found this gem. The food is delicious! I recommend fish fritters and coconut fish tacos. I came here twice during my visit because the food is so good :)', 'Review of The Edge Harlem

Food:
The food at The Edge Harlem is undoubtedly a highlight. I ordered the ackee and saltfish, which was flavorful and well-prepared. However, the portion size was on the smaller side. If you’re planning to order this dish, I recommend requesting a double portion to fully satisfy your appetite.

Ambiance:
The initial atmosphere at The Edge Harlem is warm and inviting, with a chill urban vibe that complements the menu. Unfortunately, the ambiance takes a hit as the restaurant fills up, becoming quite noisy and making conversation difficult. Additionally, we were seated under the chalkboard with the daily specials, which proved to be disruptive as guests frequently interrupted our conversation to view or photograph the menu. For a more pleasant experience, avoid this seating area. Also, the restaurant isn’t wheelchair accessible and has only one washroom, so expect potential wait times if it’s busy.

Customer Service:
The service was a letdown. While the host was polite and seated us promptly, the servers seemed disingenuous and lacked enthusiasm. We had a minor issue with our order—a latte was served as an espresso. When we mentioned this, the server became defensive and involved multiple staff members in an unprofessional manner. Instead of addressing our request to adjust the bill for the incorrect item, the server insisted on removing the charge entirely, which was not what we asked for.

Overall:
Despite the service and seating issues, The Edge Harlem’s food makes it worth a visit. The ackee and saltfish, in particular, stands out, but be prepared for potential challenges with the ambiance and customer service.', 'I didn’t have the best experience today. It was almost like we got kicked out. I get it there’s a policy for brunch. Maybe ask if there’s anything else we would like to order or remind us of the time so we can move accordingly. Otherwise the food was great. I probably won’t be coming back here because of the service.']

name: PA PA THAI CUISINE ( FORMERLY PAD THAI ) HARLEM
reviews:
['The appetizer was great and i loved the tom yum soup. Creamy seafood base with plenty of tofu.

When i served myself the curry i noticed something was off. I looked into the container it was packaged in and the potatoes tasted foul with a slightly sour smell to them. There was also this growth inside most. Very unsightly. The potatoes were cut up so im left with the impression that the cooks were aware of the condition. The broth tasted of unwashed veggies.

The order arrived early and i was excited since i dined here previously and had a great experience. Dont rush to get orders out so quickly that you forget to care about the quality. A good business gives a service that makes people want to come back. Not make a gamble.

Have people come hungry and leave happy! Not scared and sick 😅', 'I have never ate Thai food before until I tried this local spot ! And I loved it !!!! Matinee is such a sweet lady and gives such nice hospitality 😊 I love the pineapple fried rice and the fried duck… sooo good 😩 !!! Anyways it’s a nice lil spot to eat at, trust you won’t be disappointed on the food 👌🏽', 'I would say this is one of the worst Thai spots in New York City. On the bright side, the outdoor atmosphere was nice, and the service was amicable, but the food was simply horrible. Please do not waste your time or money eating here.

I had the pad kee mao and ginger sauce dishes with beef and while the portions were hefty and will fill you up, I felt that the taste and quality of food was lacking. The vegetables, as you can see in the pictures, look grimy and appear to not have been washed. I appreciate the abundance of vegetables on the dishes but there appeared to be some rotten cuts of vegetables that left little to be desired.

I found the noodles on my pad kee mao to be quite soggy and over cooked, whereas the ginger sauce dish was very salty and the rice needed to be mixed in to balance the salinity of the dish. I also wish there was some spice and finesse to the dishes served. While the plates may have been colorful, I was not fully satisfied with the flavors of each dish.

Would I come back here again? Absolutely not. I don’t think this restaurant does Thai food justice, and the quality of food and flavors do not reflect the vibrancy and essence of the cuisine whatsoever.', 'Glad the dine-in area is open again. Their presentation is top notch. Never before have I seen chicken fried rice look like a teepee before.

Their Friday chicken tenders are generous in nature and the chili sauce was not at all spicy and more on the sweet side. Great service, spa-like ambience, and generous portions (except for the water).

Great to know they also deliver!', "Loved all the live plants on the table. The homemade chilli sauce was the perfect balance of sweet, spicy & sour. The lightly battered, perfectly fried calamari had no salt and the batter wasn't seasoned; however the dipping sauce made up for it. My green curry was delicious and the eggplant and melange of vegetables were perfectly cooked in the sauce. My dates pad thai was more on the sweet side but the chilli   paste they brought to the table gave it the spice it needed. I would definitely go back."]

name: CRISPIN'S HELL'S KITCHEN
address: 1792 Amsterdam Ave and, W 149th St in, New York
reviews:
['Update: tried this restaurant again and had a great experience. Our server Luis was knowledgeable and helpful in choosing some new dishes to try. The favorite was the whole branzino. It was delicious. We also tried the chicken Alfredo and the bolognese pasta. Both did not disappoint. To wrap up our meal we had the lava chocolate cake. Our daughter loved it. Everything was made fresh and to order. So if you are looking for quick service, this may not be the place for you.

Decided to try this restaurant to celebrate our friend’s 50th birthday. From the moment we walked in we were greeted by our waitress Valentina. She was super sweet and though it was just her 2nd day on the job, she was able to answer all of our questions about the menu. To start we shared the eggplant rollantini and the crabcake. Both were delicious! We each had a different pasta dish- the lobster ravioli, the black tagliatelle with crab meat, and the linguini all vongole. We loved all of our dishes but the black tagliatelle was the favorite. We can’t wait to go back to try more.', 'A small restaurant, but good enough seating, decorated beautifully, playing old school Italian music, the waiter amazing. I went during a time for lunch, it was not crowded, I was in there by myself. I gave it 3 star, i simply was not impressed with the dish. Granted I only ordered one thing, but I just felt the dish  didn’t have enough flavor I had got linguine carbonara. The bacon wasn’t crispy. Pasta was Al dente. Maybe on a different day I will try something else.', 'I saw Crispin’s appear a couple months ago and I was excited as it seemed like a nice new Italian option in the neighborhood. Luckily my expectations were not only met but exceeded! The food, service, and ambience here are all fantastic. I highly recommend Crispin’s Hell’s Kitchen and have now eaten here about 6 times in the last two months.

My favorite dish is the carbonara - so delicious. But I’ve had multiple dishes by now (and most desserts) and it’s apparent that they place a very high focus on quality and flavor. I just asked my server who mentioned that all deserts and pastas are homemade, and I am not surprised. So good!', 'It was a magically wonderful evening, having dinner with my
s🌞nshine and his beautiful lady, Jacqueline..

Michael is an amazingly attentive "dining assistant or dining guide"
I never liked the terms: waiter, waitress,  barmaid, 🤢.

The ambiance was perfect.  I didn't have to shout over my food for my guests to hear me.

It was a lovely rainy Sunday afternoon for dinner with loved ones in a cozy & warm place.
Priceless-💓💕🙏🏽😘

Thank you for the memories, Crispin's. 😊📷', "If you're looking for an unparalleled dining experience in the heart of Manhattan, you can't miss Crispin's Hell's Kitchen.  This restaurant stands out not only for its exquisite food, but also for its cozy atmosphere and the top quality service it offers to its customers.

From the moment you set foot in Crispin's Hell's Kitchen, you realize you're in for a special experience.  The decoration of the place is modern and elegant, with a warm and sophisticated atmosphere that makes you feel at home.  The soft lights, finely decorated wooden tables and artistic details on the walls create a perfect atmosphere to enjoy a memorable meal.

The real star of Crispin's Hell's Kitchen is, without a doubt, its food.  The menu is carefully crafted to offer a wide variety of dishes that reflect a perfect fusion between traditional Italian cuisine and contemporary touches.  The ingredients are always fresh and of the highest quality, guaranteeing that each dish is a delight for the palate.

To start, the starters are wonderful in themselves.  I recommend trying the tomato and basil bruschetta, crunchy and full of flavor, or the beef carpaccio with fresh arugula and parmesan cheese, a classic combination that never fails.  Caprese salad, with juicy tomatoes and buffalo mozzarella, is another excellent option to whet your appetite.

As for the main dishes, the options are as varied as they are tempting.  The pastas, handmade and cooked to perfection, are a true work of art.  Spaghetti carbonara, with a creamy sauce and crispy bacon, is simply irresistible.  If you prefer something lighter, ravioli stuffed with ricotta and spinach in tomato and basil sauce are a sublime option.

Seafood lovers can't miss the seafood risotto, a creamy and flavorful dish, with a generous amount of shrimp, mussels and squid.  For those who prefer meat, filet mignon is an excellent choice.  Cooked to perfection and served with a red wine reduction and truffled mashed potatoes, it's an experience you won't soon forget.

And, of course, no meal would be complete without a dessert worth remembering.  The tiramisu at Crispin's Hell's Kitchen is, without a doubt, one of the best in Manhattan.  Creamy, with a perfect balance between coffee and mascarpone, and sprinkled with cocoa powder, it is the perfect finishing touch to an incredible meal.  Panna cotta with berries is another delight that you cannot miss, light and refreshing.

The service at Crispin's Hell's Kitchen is impeccable.  The waiters are attentive, friendly and always willing to recommend the best dishes and wines to accompany your meal.  The chef, a true master of the kitchen, frequently comes out to greet diners and make sure everything is to his liking.  It is evident that there is a passion and love for cooking that is reflected in every detail.

In short, Crispin's Hell's Kitchen is not just a restaurant, it is a culinary experience that celebrates rich gastronomic tradition with a modern and sophisticated twist.  Whether you're a foodie or simply looking for a memorable evening in Manhattan, this is the place to be.  Don't miss the opportunity to visit Crispin's Hell's Kitchen and be seduced by its unmatched flavors.  I assure you that you will want to return again and again!"]

name: TRUFA RESTAURANT
reviews:
['Let me start by saying this cozy family restaurant led by owner/Chef Eduardo has amazing food. While most of the seating is for 2, they rearranged a few tables to accommodate my dinner party of 3.
The philosophy of Trufa, "quality ingredients from unique recipes, improving classic American staples... carefully creating a diverse menu," for ALL

We started with the Hamilton Heights Empanadas, which were flaky, seasoned well and topped off just right with a jalapeño cilantro aioli
The New England Clam Chowder, is a neighborhood fav, at 10:30pm there was only 1 order left, which was packed with clams and let me know it's made fresh daily.

The specials were enticing and 2 of the 3 of us had one, the last choosing a pasta staple.

All of our entrees were artfully presented and Delicious.

While I finished all of my Black and White mixed seafood pasta, each of my dinner companions took food home.

While I am not in Hamilton Heights often, I can definitely recommend Trufa and see why this family gem is a go to of the neighborhood.', 'Such a hidden gem on Broadway. The French Toast was so good. The watermelon sangria was fresh and delicious.', "I've always ignored this small busy looking restaurant assuming vegan options weren't available.

Needless to say how I was pleasantly surprised to say the least. I inquired and chose the
'Angel Hair Primavera' from the vegan options available. For $14 it's a pasta dish (noodles really) well seasoned (a tad salty) yet hearty, filling, heavy and enough to eat 3x over. I've included pics. Worth a taking a trip for. I took it to go. Great energy also worth noting from staff who served me with generosity", "Google says they open at 10am on Fridays.
My friend and I waited outside for them to open for about 20 minutes. At 10am, a worker at Trufa tells us that they open at 11am. It would be lovely if they updated their information so they don't waste potential patrons time.", 'Trufa is always my go to place. Food is delicious, service is supper! Eduardo the best of the best, he always so attentive and willing to accommodate our cravings. Not only did we dine in, but we also order a couple of plates to take home. Until next time.']

name: GUAJILLO RESTAURANT
reviews:
['Order the spicy pork torta - it is not on their printed menu but they still made it for us! Very fun and laid back atmosphere, we brought our toddler, who loved dancing to the music. Sometimes they have karaoke. Food is awesome, reasonably priced, and beer is cheap! Had sangria last time and it was good and strong. Very friendly staff too! Great find for excellent Mexican food in Manhattan.', "So I try not to typically post bad reviews, but in this case I had to cause it was just that bad... went there with the gf and 8yr old for dinner based on these google reviews but unfortunately that was bad timing. Service for food was extremely long, even though only one other couple was there.. the frozen margaritas had a nasty after taste and just cheaply made, ordered the following, hot wings were 6 small over cooked wings drenched in basic Buffalo sauce, nachos with chicken came out looking weird, for some reason the chicken is in super tiny cubes and was more like 'bacon bits'. Chicken in tacos was similarly cut, super dry chicken. Steak tacos were slightly better cut but same issue of being dry. Quesedillay had cheese lettuce tomatoes, that's it no onions peppers etc.... the kicker was that in the midst of dinner someone had a bright idea of having a dj and they started it up in the middle of dinner and extremely loud to where u couldn't hear each other across the table and it is a small place to begin with. Totally killed the vibe and we ran out of there.. Unless you're a much older person looking for a cheap bar I wouldn't recommend.  I would suggest lose the old dj and focus on the vibe of the culture. Didn't go into a Mexican restaurant to hear disco music at a bar instead....", 'We were going to order out but since the place was empty, we decided to dine in. They had nice music, the service was good but most of all the food was great. We enjoyed our moment there.', 'I’ve lived near here for a long time, and I’ve always seen this spot but never came in. I WAS MISSING OUT! One of the best Mexican restaurants in East Harlem or Manhattan in general! I’ve been coming here for about a year and a half now. I’ve never been disappointed! Their torta, enchiladas, burritos, tostada are AMAZING. The spicy pork torta is my favorite with jalapeños and chipotle mayo. I want this food all the time haha 😍😍😍', 'Best margaritas any kind of!!!🍸
They can compete with any other around the city 🏙️
And whiskey 🥃 cocktails
And tacos 🌮
Guacamole 🥑 with chips']

name: EL NUEVO JAYA RESTAURANT
reviews:
['Un manjar para tu paladar!!!
Come to El Jaya Restaurant and indulge your senses in this delicious food. This is the real Dominican flavor from the Jaya region of D.R. A region know for it’s culinary and musical contributions to the world. Do not miss the early mangu 3 golpes because after 8:30 am is all gone. Or my favorite -bacalo con yuca-  enjoy.', 'Food it’s good enough, but almost every time we order from there they forget something. My mom even went for a pick up order and luckily she checked before leaving because they forgot something then too. Literally eating my chicharrón de pollo and rice with no beans right now, called like 20 mins ago, it’s just a few blocks away. Like at the very least after so many times say “hey we’ll comp a meal next time” or “hey here’s some extra chicken for the last mess up” - we want to give them a break, give them a chance but they are very dismissive. For that I can’t recommend this place. They better step up because trust me there’s lots of places in the heights to get this type of food.

Edit: they never brought the replacement now. Been like an hour and a half since we initially called. Should be embarrassed. If they took card, would’ve charged back immediately. Place that messes up this many times (not even just our orders, but others’ as well) and makes 0 effort to remedy it, does not deserve your patronage.

Edit 2: Noticed they responded. Notice how they said if we made them aware they would fix, but that’s the very first thing we did. We called as soon as we opened the delivery bag and they didn’t fix anything.', 'Amazing place I’ve been eating there for 11 years!! Their staff is ever so kind to everyone. Food is affordable and delicious. The restaurant is in a good location near tons of apartments so it’s good to order food and good to go down there and dine!! 110% recommend food is fresh and cultural.kid friendly towards being treated and also with the food portions', 'Being stranger, This food makes me love and connects with espanol co-worker. It is Cheap/Delicious food. Thank You Jaya. ❤️', "Best Dominican Restaurant!!!!!
Their red beans remind me of my mother's cooking. Not too salty and not too bland
Love it!!!
And the staff is very welcoming and courteous"]

name: LA BARCA RESTAURANT
reviews: ['The food is great but honestly the customer service is ridiculous. name: PONTY BISTRO
address: 2375 Adam Clayton Powell Jr Blvd, New York
reviews:
["Apps
The calamari is sublime
The escargol lacked flavor
The oysters had a nice sauce on the side though it was too sweet for my taste.
I didn't like the macaroni and cheese I thought it was too creamy and not cheesy enough.
Main
The lobster and shrimp was good But at the price point I think they should give you more than a half of lobster and three shrimp
The shrimp were cooked to perfection but the lobster was overcooked
The muscles were divine I loved the sauce they were in but it should come with pasta instead of french fries.
I didn't like the chocolate mousse It wasn't airy enough it was too heavy.", "5+ Stars for the superbly attentive, fast and friendly service. My group rolled in at staggered times for early dinner on a rainy weekend with 3 adults and 4 little kids. Rather than being annoyed, staff treated us like their own family, warmly accommodating every request, quick to keep the drinks topped, cracking jokes to keep everyone's vibe light.

Each bite I tried was intricate and memorable. This menu is showing off deftly layered bold flavors and doesn't disappoint. We tried the Three Cheese Gougeres, Poulet Yassa (massive slab of chicken), L' Onglet a L'Echalote (juicy steak), and Niokolokoba (spicy steak). Our kids enjoyed their virgin mule mocktails, and I'll vouch for the Moroccan Old Fashioned 👌🏽

Looking forward to trying more of Ponty's menu!", 'I recently dined at a West African restaurant in Harlem. Tried for the Senegalese chicken, I was a bit disappointed as the meat turned out to be rather dry, accompanied by rice that shared the same fate. The calamari offered a slight redemption, being acceptable in taste. However, the standout feature of the experience was the friendly demeanor of the staff, who made the visit more enjoyable despite the culinary letdown.

Overall, while the ambiance and service were pleasant, the food failed to impress, leaving much to be desired in terms of flavor and texture.', 'Great food paired with a professional staff! I enjoyed the truffle man n cheese along with chicken brochette kabab and salad with light vinaigrette dressing! #Foodchiks stamps Ponty Bistro 😋😋😋', 'This cozy little spot was recommended by another friend that had eaten here sometime ago and was hoping that the food had remained the same if not better. Well indeed everything was a blast & we enjoyed every plate starting with the calamari to the lamb shank. My hubby & I hope to return.']

name: EL VALLE
reviews: ['We placed an order for bake chicken combo and the chicken was over Cooked and dry... more bones than meat', 'Ordered a dominican breakfast, it was bland. I asked the lady what my options were for meat and she just pointed and shrugged. They seem to be rude to black people so beware. Polanco up the block has way better Spanish food, prices and customer service.', "They have the best Tres Leche in Harlem & they're so friendly they treat you like family💞 Happy customer", "Horrible service and horrible food I placed an order they sent me over cooked food I then called for a replacement and then sent me a new dish as a replacement that was still over cooked then didn't pick the phone contacted them again today for a replacement then they sent some pepper steak then refused to leave the replacement pepper steak", 'I’m not sure how they can serve this food to people this is horrible. They did not offer a refund or to help.']

name: YEMENI RESTAURANT NYC
reviews:
['We came here yesterday thanksgiving eve.
The place is very welcoming, all staff are nice and approachable

We had beef kafta, we were so hungry i forgot to take a photo before we devour the food lol

We also had roasted lambchops

They were both delicious, the rice and salad were so fresh and flavorful.

I love their hummus and white whip
On the side, it compliments the dish.

We will definitely be back and try other dishes and the roasted chicken looks so delicious from the counter.', 'Delicious, authentic food and kind, welcoming service. The staff were very helpful explaining the dishes and giving their recommendations. For 3 people, we shared Fool, Fahsah, Beef Kafka, and fish soup as the main. It came with 2 massive Yemenite bread that was fresh and warm, straight from the oven.

For dessert we shared baklava and kanafa

Highly recommend!', 'My only regret was not seeing the entire menu before ordering off of the wall menu. The Shish Tawook was excellent with moist flavorful chicken chunks and great sauces. The rice was fluffy and tasty on its own. The full menu has more traditional Yemeni fare like fava beans cooked with eggs.', 'Loved the food! It was delicious. We ordered a Salta (sizzling and spiced lentil soup in a clay pot) which comes along with a traditional bread, chicken Shawarma on a bed of flavourful rice and ended with a baklava. The food tasted spectacular, highly recommend all these dishes, but the Salta stood out for us!', 'The food was SOOOOOOOOO good. I’ve had a lot of Yemeni food and this place was the best.

Their lamb broth was dynamic. The galaba was sooo good. And their haneen with the rice (I think I’m spelling it right) was delicious!

Gluten friendly!

Not to mention the owner is so amazing and super kind!!! He works very hard along with his entire staff.

Will be back as a regular!!!']

name: BUS STOP DINER
reviews:
['I had a great breakfast here after a morning run. The morning of the marathon as a matter of fact. I wasn’t in it though. I had a Florentine omelette with aside of spicy fried sweet plantains. This was the best meal I had on my trip. I witty to visit here again. Somehow I’d never had plantains before.', 'This is not your typical NYC diner. I wouldn’t get pastrami on rye or roast dinner.This is a restaurant that mainly serves Latin food which is great. But if you go in there with a notion that this is gonna be Americana diner food —you will be disappointed. We ordered chicken and waffles, this was a boneless chicken breast cut into three small strips. Chicken was tasteless and dry. Not tasty at all. Waffle was okay. Please seethe picture for reference. Also order a ham and cheese sandwich that was okay. Honestly not worth $50. Service was alright. The space is cozy and clean.', 'Horrible and disappointing place. I came here for dessert and order a lemon meringue pie that was pure sugar and tasted old. My friend got a flan and it was flavorless and tasted old too. Not one time the server asked if everything was “ok” with the food.

When we told her that the pie and flan tasted old and horrible her only response was “I’m sorry about that” but still went ahead and charge the full amount.

Never coming back to this place and wouldn’t recommend either.', 'They rip you off with getting a burger with onion rings.
They charge you for a basic burger then if you want American cheese its 1.50 and if you want just onion rings with it you have to pay for the deluxe 6$ then you have to pay a additional 3.50$ for the onion rings.

You can find better burgers a few stops away its not worth your money to even go here.
The cuban sandwich was kinda sad looked like sliced cheap ham with sliced under seasoned pork with white cheese 🧀

Personally wouldn’t come here again just a waste of time and money.

Service was poor she would fill up the water of the other people in the party and would just not do mine. I saw some bug around the tv.', 'The food was delicious. The service was excellent awesome amazing. I would highly recommended this spot for a comforting breakfast brunch. Loved the people and the food. Chicken n waffle is too good to pass! The dessert menu upfront is also very inviting.']

name: HARLEM FOOD CT
reviews: ["I had this craving  for ox tail dish, it is a buffet  style, by weight. The place has about 5 or 6 tables in the back and when it was dinner  time the place got full with people  mostly for taking out. Evan  though i came for ox tail that was a delight  I couldn't  resist  and I had a same of the ribs,plantains, black eye pees, fried fish and salmon fish in a sauce. It took me 3 days to finish the food i took way too much lol\nAll in all very good  southern food. Go try it out.", 'I eat here maybe 2 or 3 times per week.  Very reasonable prices for a lot of options.', 'Delicious food and very reasonable, so easy to walk past and miss. Friendly people and a good selection of food', 'Lady at register has bad attitude, food is good. Won’t be returning, positive energy only', 'The staff was very friendly, place was clean. Great Jamaican food. The curry goat and jerk chicken was yummy.Again Very friendly and welcoming staff. Reminds me of home.\nI went back and tried there shrimp and crabs was delectable. Very affordable as well.']

name: MI CASITA
reviews:
["12$ 8/10 Tinga Tostadas(3); Ingredients were freshly cut and and portion was enough to fill me up. A bit disappointing that the tostadas seem to be the Guerrero ones from the supermarket or those that you buy for 2$ where as other authentic mexican restaurants have them home made

I had a good time here! I stayed for a while due to La Rosa de Guadalupe playing lol and the good environment

🌮Back to FOOD, I also had a carnitas Taco🌮

Being mexican, I'd say the tortilla was little undercooked to the point of breaking by the last bite, 30 seconds would of made it just the way I like it. If youre not Mexican you probably wont mind🤷‍♂️

But! Ingredients were VERY fresh

Being that I didnt ask for crispy tortilla, I wont hurt the Tacos grading but I'll give it a 10/10

Server was friendly and fast!", 'The food is bad.  The flan had no taste and was watery.  Cheeseburger was not cooked too well.  Cheesecake had no taste.   No salad came with order, I was told only on the burger, that I was confused.   One worker hung up when I told her what happened.', "Place is like a mom and pop shop for Mexican food. taste like so as well. everything is always fresh and tastes authentic. Great lemonade great taco's. just order ahead of time, it may take a bit longer because its one or two people on staff cooking but worth the wait and i dont mind supporting this small business.", 'I wish I could leave a review for the food but we never tasted it.

Ordered from here last night via caviar. The app confirmed the restaurant received the order and it was being made.

45 minutes roll by and no food. We call them and they say it’s 10 minutes away.

20 minutes more and no food. We call them again and they say it’s 5 minutes away.

Oh, you thought it was over? No. The saga continues.

We are now 2 hours out from when we ordered and no food. We call again and they ask us to repeat the entire order. Then we asked what is going on and they hung up on us.

Finally, we got our $66 back through the app.

I wish I could comment on the quality of food but I can say the quality of service is an absolute dumpster fire. I have no idea how this restaurant has managed to stay open. Let alone in a pandemic.', 'Generous portions. Delicious food. What I ordered was definitely mild and not spicy at all. So if you enjoy Mexican but can’t take the overheating of some Tex-Mex places, this will be your new favorite local spot. They do offer some dishes with jalapeños (which I am very allergic to, so I didn’t try) if you are looking for more bite to your burrito.']

name: TU DELICIA RESTAURANT AND SEAFOOD
reviews:
['Awesome customer service.
They make you feel like family and serve you with a smile.
Great food.
Had the boneless chicharones with white rice, tostones and avocado with onions.
Clean environment and clean bathroom.
Spacious and good bright lighting.
Will come back!', "Looks like a newer restaurant in this neighborhood. I ordered takeout from here. The woman on the phone was pretty friendly and the meal was ready pretty quickly. The food was pretty good. We ordered the #2 combo and some pork chops. The sizes are pretty big and that fed four people with leftovers.

However the pork chops came with a side salad that was not very fresh. It smelled pretty bad so no one ate it. At the end of the dinner tho, I did find a bug in it so that's nice... horrible sanitation and food safety back there I guess.

The combo was good tho, it came with a big container of rice and beans as well as sweet plantains. The chicken was fried but more fried like small chicken tenders with batter than chicharron de pollo.

Overall, good food and decent prices but I won't be back.", 'Well I must say they started right ,
But Saturday June 3rd 2023, I  placed an dinner order in which the rice & steak were old,, the beans were normal , and the plaintains
Never again will I’ll order from them,,
I’m surprised we didn’t get food poisoning 😔', 'We ordered the Shrimp Pasta with white sauce. It was very good, just a bit too much cilantro.', 'This is a place you find and wonder how you lived without it. AMAZING food. Great service.']

name: LA CASITA TAQUERIA RESTAURANT
reviews: ['i orderded a carnitas burrito and thought it came with all fixings such as pico, guac, etc as it said on the menu and website and it didnt come with anything expect rice and the meat, also said the burrito was 12.95 i ended up paying 14 dollars for a 12 inch burrito with nothing in. lady who took my order was very rude and acted like she didnt wanna work there. overall the food was ok clearly not worth 14 dollars tho', 'All I’ve got to say is absolute terrible service. name: LULO RESTAURANT
reviews: ['This place has authentic dominican food. They\'re know to have "The best goat meat in New York." I couldn\'t agree more. If you\'re a goat fan, come eat here. This time I got the oxtails and it was delicious. My favorite thing here is the Gandules beans. They only make them on Thursdays and Saturdays so make sure get. The atmosphere is relaxed. Kind of like a whole in the wall place. It\'s for loyal customers who knows about this place. The food is a must try. Stop here the next time you\'re in Washington Heights.', 'I love this place OMG I am in love, the food uuuyyyyy k Riko....the atmosphere rikisimo!', 'I walked in to the establishment and asked what kind of meat did they have. I was told the meats they had so I ordered White Rice, Red beans and Oxtails. Which they are supposed to have . What I received was White Rice, Red beans and Goat meat. I ate the stuff just because I did not feel like going back outside because I was starving. Very disappointing to order my food and received the wrong thing. (My review is in English but I ordered in Spanish which I am fluent in).', 'The Chivo was totally sub par, I asked the owner did they have a new cook. She said NO, but what they served me was horrible. I told her I go there often, I know the difference!!! Boycott thus place till further notice !!!!!!!!!!!👎👎👎👎👎👎👎👎\n.', 'Terrific food! The (pork) mofongo and goat curry keep drawing me back. Super friendly staff too.']

name: EL NUEVO RINCON DEL SABOR
reviews: ['Small place but big flavor, very tasty Assorted Dominican Cusine 🇩🇴', 'Excellent food and great service!', "Best steak I've ever had from a Spanish spot everytime I'm near I have to get some can't wait to get more", 'The food there is delicious!', 'Excellent place']

name: FOOD & GRILL SAVORY
reviews:
['Cutlet on a roll & fries; can’t go wrong. Combo (lamb&chicken) over rice is great.
Good basic slice of pizza.
Excellent smoothies and juices.

If you order delivery from here, you’re more than likely getting the order fulfilled by the Savory Deli just up the block—FYI—your options may vary on whatever delivery app you use.', "Opened late. Serves fresh juices, pizza, fried chicken and operates also as a bodega. It's great as it opens late to 2am and if you happen to finish work late and really need to eat something they have options for u. They make pasta and burgers as well.", 'They are great for burgers and good-priced burger combos.  If you just call the restaurant, they almost always pick up the phone and they deliver for free if close enough to your place and with a very minimum amount spent required.

Their burgers—I’ve had their regular burger as well as the turkey burger with French fries. I’ve also tried their onion rings.  Their burgers are basic, not fancy but good and offer plenty of optional toppings.  A good value for the price you pay and what you get.

I once had an incorrect order and they sent a free replacement ASAP.

Delivery guy Ames is very nice and brings right to your door.  Their delivery has also been very quick in my experience, or if ordering in the store it takes just 5-10 minutes to get your food.', 'Good food at a good price, I ordered the large chicken parm pizza, kept me fed for 2 days. Less than $20', 'It’s okay.  It’s good for cheap and basic burgers and burger combos with fries and a soda or bottled water.

It ain’t gonna wow you, but it won’t disappoint either.  Their delivery is quite speedy and store staff are nice.  The place is clean.']

name: KISMAT
reviews:
['Kismat in Washington Heights is a true gem! The food is fantastic, offering flavorful and authentic Indian dishes. The service was equally delightful—attentive and warm without being intrusive.

But what really sets Kismat apart is its lively weekend vibe. On Friday evenings, the restaurant transforms into a live jazz bar, filling the space with smooth tunes and a cozy yet energetic ambiance. Later, the vibe shifts to karaoke, making it the perfect spot for a fun night out with friends.

And let’s talk about their happy hour—it runs from 1 pm to 8 pm daily! Yes, you read that right. Seven full hours of excellent deals to enjoy their amazing drinks.

Great food, friendly service, live music, and unbeatable happy hour—what more could you ask for? Kismat truly delivers a top-notch dining and entertainment experience.', 'The service was perfect and the food very delicious. They also allow split checks. We were a group of 14 people who went on hike and everyone was able to pay separately. I highly recommend.', 'The quantity of food was decent for two people to share. Samosa was a bit oily. In Malai kofta, I am not sure what were the Kofta made of but they tasted uncooked. Naan bread was hard. Roti was delicious and freshly-made.

We went for dinner and they had live music on a Tuesday evening. The music was loud for that space. I preferred a peaceful dinner after a work day.

Overall, a fairly decent experience!!!', 'This place was very cozy and comfortable and had amazing food at an affordable price (I had the beef masala lunch special). The customer service was great, and the decorations and lighting made the dining experience calm and soothing. Lastly, we asked for the food to be as mild as possible, and it absolutely was!', 'THE BEST FOOD EVER. My family first time Indian food and it was amazing. Sam was the best on the drinks and the service was hands on our new favorite spot.

The Caldwell’s \U0001fa77']

name: GREAT WALL
reviews: ['The food was so bad It gets no stars.\nDon’t even waste your time the food suck and it ain’t even yellow  Fried rice I ordered fried rice with broccoli and garlic sauce the garlic sauce was so  watery it was disgusting I literally had to throw it away. Better off going down the block their Chinese food is way better', 'I ordered pork fried rice with vegetables & sesame chicken. I literally had to dig through the rice to find small pieces of pork, not to mention the rice is bland & has large clumps! The sesame chicken was chewy. Delivery guy was extremely rude. Worst chinese food i’ve had in a long time. NEVER AGAIN!!!', 'Ive called for delivery about 3 to 4 times and when I say they are quick, they are quick! I live about 3 to 5 minutes away and I swear i get my food in under 20 minutes. Their prices are great. DO NOT ORDER ON DOOR DASH! Door dash charges double the price. door dash want to charge me almost $30 for two things while when i ordered for delivery with them those two things cost me 15$ and the food is good. Definitely consider making this your go to spot!', "First time ordering delivery took like an hour...Even though it's not even a block away and when I got the food it had a whole bunch of sause that I didint even ask for. Tbh they disserve a 0 star", "Amazing tasting food and service. They are truly the best around town. Some folks say they are rude but they aren't they're just very busy workers and can't attend to every little thing. If they make a mistake with an order we shouldn't put them down. Mistakes in people's orders happens in almost every restaurant. They are not rude they move quick."]

name: LOS AMIGOS RESTAURANT
reviews:
['First time here, ordered to go, small sit-down area.  Had the lunch special, chicken with rice and beans with fried bananas and it was very good, definitely coming back.', 'Why I rate it four stars.
After searching for Spanish food this restaurant came across because my experience with other Spanish restaurants has not been great. I decided to order from Doordash (I'm not promoting Doordash)
I ordered an Oven Chicken combo it comes with rice, beans, sweet plantain, soda, and a small green salad and the other Combo was the same thing but with an Onion Steak and a side order of tostones. I wrote a note in the app instead of the soda if they can send me water and they did "Thank you".
The chicken has the same taste as other chicken you buy at any Spanish restaurant lol, the beans were good, the rice needs a little bit more salt and pours some oil like the way we cook rice at home and I think in my personal opinion is (I am looking for a unique flavor of Spanish food) and no restaurant have delivered that yet!
Four days ago I ordered again from their website but this time I order 2 whole chickens, 2 orders of tostones, and Churrasco with tostones but they forgot the "churrasco sauce/onions and the
tostones were semi-raw" not cool.
Overall, I think the food is decent, not too expensive but you have to taste it for yourself and see if you like it😉.

Note➡ They follow better instructions from a third party than from their website.', 'There is a heavy set woman that works here and she has a very nasty attitude. I’m telling all of my teacher friends that work across the street NOT to come here and spend any money. She does not like her job and will give you attitude for no reason. After the third time, I refuse to go back. I will spend money somewhere else. I would give 0 stars if I could.', 'I have visited Los Amigos Restaurant a few times food is always fresh and delicious. I have also pre-ordered catering appetizers and finger food for my parties very satisfied with the service.', 'Awesome food!!! Great people working in there. You feel like home! I highly recommend it!!']

name: LIBERATO
reviews:
['The Oxtail, yellow rice, red beans and sweet plantains was delicious. The service and presentation of the food was excellent. Music was a little to loud it was hard to have a conversation with my lunch date. But I was happy with my experience.', 'I’ve been eating here for over 20 years.

They redid the restaurant and it looks very nice inside now. Cleaner.

The food is amazing. They always give good portions as well. The prices are very good too. Can’t go wrong.', 'The food was delicious! I had the grilled chicken with rice, beans and mashed potatoes. The ladies in there are absolutely attentive to all of your needs and i never had to wait for anything. If you like bachata, salsa or on the evening i was there soft rock by camilo sesto, the music can be requested to the staff setting your atmosphere. 5 stars in all categories.', 'The food, drinks & service at Liberato is always perfect. We order steak or chicken dinners. Food always fresh, area very clean for dining in. Delivery is quick too.', 'First time here, I was craving classic Dominican food and this place was just what I was looking for. Inside was clean, nice ambiance for the area.

Ordered goat, chicken and oxtail. Food slapped hard, I fell asleep after.

Ordered 3 plates and a side of oxtail, couple waters and a soda~ $68']

name: SABROSURA RESTAURANT
reviews:
["I used to patron this location when I was young. I was in the neighborhood at my Uncle's wake at the Ortiz funeral. The place was packed as always, and the food was still delicious. You can not go wrong with their chofan rice.", 'Omg I love it this place 😂\U0001f979
I came here after getting my hair braided and I am thrilled to say I made a great choice. Been here twice before and the food here never disappoints. Everything on the menu is delicious, literally. I ordered the rotisserie half chicken with the house special fried rice so so good. The best part is being able to save half for lunch the next day

Let me say, those leftovers taste so much better at work 😂', 'I rarely eat Chinese food, but I love the fusion of Latin Caribbean flavor and Chinese food together. I’ve been coming to sabrosura since I was a teenager so I would say over 35 years….so happy I can bring my kids here and they can enjoy the seafood and the same food  I used to enjoy the teenager, every time I come here I’m amazed and in aw of the flavors. Yummy!', 'The food here is trash.I. ordered the chicharron de pollo with pork fried rice and the chicken tasted like it had been frozen and looked like chicken patties you buy from the supermarket. I paid $21 for this garbage.NEVER AGAIN.', 'Really good food, best dish is the stuffed sole. Good mofongo, great tostones appetizer. If you don’t mind the bad bathrooms, I would come back. They do have a wheelchair accessible space the only down side is its in a more storage area so service is slower.  Not all the staff are rude our second waiter was really nice the first older man was really rude.']

name: RANDALL RESTAURANT
reviews: ['I had my best roasted pork here!! Very friendly service.', 'Great food and service.  Since they have 4 TVs, I asked the owner Randell if I could watch One Championship fight on YouTube.  He gave me the remote. So, thanks! I came back to eat again 2 times and had a takeout. Food is very good', 'I ordered on the phone for pick up they gave me the wrong combo then get mad at me talking shit in Spanish then give me the right order with 3 quarter full I ordered pork and rice and beans they gave me scraps and very little pork there very rude and unprofessional and should hire someone that can understand English....', "This is my go-to spot every time I'm in the Bronx.  Best #NUMBER1 Dominican Restaurant in NYC!!!!", 'It is a nice place, clean although the bathroom smells bad. The staff is nice and friendly. The food has high and low points. Yesterday I ordered a baked chop, it was a zuela, very cooked, hard, unpleasant. The chef could improve it. The appropriate form for what they offer.']

name: ROBERTA'S FINE DINING
reviews:
["I truly appreciate the hospitality that Roberta's showed myself and my family during my grandmother repast. The owner, Mr. Taylor, booking easy. He was very accommodating to my guests. We promised that he would take care of everything and he did. He even printed out pictures of her to post and added her image to a cake.

In regards to food for catering, I recommend the tuna salad, potato salad, fried chicken and fried fish. Everyone enjoyed it and took food home.

If you need a place to host a good old fashioned repast, Roberta's is the place. I felt like I was at a church cookout. It felt very familiar, down to earth and welcoming.", 'Excellent food and service! The fish was cooked to perfection! I’ll definitely return anytime I’m in Harlem.', "These reviews have to  be a joke. This place was a joke. I  ordered the chicken and waffle and it didn't look anything like this. The waffle was not crisp on the outside, it was a soggy mess with butter melted all over it. The chicken  was legs only and very salty. I  had a glass of sangria and  God know how long ago it was made.  Tasted like chilled apple cider Vigner.  Tried to support  a business in my neighborhood and it was disappointing. If you  walk by there any day nobody is in there, the lights are on but no business.  This is a honest review.
The venue is very well decorated,  however it does have a slight mildew smell.  With the right ownership and chief this place could be awesome.", 'The food was fresh and worth the wait.
The cornbread with that blueberry jam could be eaten on a daily basis.
The restaurant is small and has an intimate setting.', 'We came here to eat but the place was closed . Times online isn’t correct. The outside doesn’t even look like the pictures anymore . A waste of a walk and time . Very disappointing']

name: PINE RESTAURANT
reviews:
['My first time here and I’ve been in the Bronx my whole life. Went to celebrate a birthday and they were very accommodating. Once half our party arrived we were able to be seated. The waiter was kind and attentive. Got all the orders right…except I had to send my steak back to be cook a little more but no big deal. It was tasty and juicy and overall satisfying. The portions are big so you will definitely get ya moneys worth, be full and have left overs. Definitely recommend', 'Generous portions of fabulously delicious delicacies. From the salad to the desserts, everyone enjoyed their selections. Highly recommended, especially on birthdays! Valet parking is a bonus.', 'We were a party of 3 for dinner.  I have several severe food allergies. Our waiter, Ambrocio went through the menu and discussed all the items. He let me know why I couldn’t have certain dishes.

I was very pleased with my meal.  I don’t eat out often because of the allergies, but I felt so safe.

We will be back.', 'We had a great diner tonight in here. The atmosphere is quite nice; waiters are amazingly friendly!! And the food is pretty good, and plates are very generous.
I really recommend this place if you want to spend a great time enjoying Italian with family or friends.', 'Food was good, stuff shrimp needed more crab and flavor to much breading, trio scampi was amazing. Get doors for catering hall, way too loud during an event. Out wait staff was amazing. I’m a James Beard chef and I enjoyed the service and dessert. Sangria Red very good. Plain Zeppoles were amazing. Have someone monitor the kids during parties.']

name: GOLDEN EAGLE RESTAURANT
reviews: ["Awesome staff and awesome food! We always feel welcome here and are even recognized by some of the people who work here (we HAVE dined here A LOT). 😆 Everyone's always friendly, the food is always cooked to perfection, and it just feels like a second home. Nothing, but good vibes coming from this place! Thanks for always taking care of us, guys...you're amazing!", 'This place is the best breakfast place I have ever had in a long time. Barely any wait to be seated. The food came in no time and was amazing. As you can see, i got their nutella pancakes and the pile of fruit was an amazing bonus. I also got a delicious chocolate milkshake and a nice egg. Staff were all super nice. Come ASAP!', 'I order breakfast a few days a week from the Golden Eagle and I love how welcoming and kind Rosie is! She greets me in the morning and even remembers my phone number when I call. She is an amazing part of the Golden Eagle team!', 'Came in during my lunch break on a Tuesday.  Ambar & Jesse greeted me promptly and were attentive. Food was delicious. Place was clean! Thank you', 'This diner was recently renovated and it looks great. The arrangement was wonderfully set up. Food and service were perfect.  Will definitely be going back.']

name: EL GRANDE CHEF RESTAURANT
reviews:
["I called in my order for pickup. When I got there, the restaurant was empty. I grabbed my food and left. Got home, the pollo al carbón (roasted chicken) was undercooked. It was still bleeding. I won't ever purchase from there again.", 'employees too busy gossiping to attend, then when i get my order and start to check if all is there, i get a look like im crazy for checking. she assures me my order is complete only to then get home (an hour away!)and guess what? no side items i paid for. never order again at this place.
ps food was sudpar, like reheated leftovers', 'DONT EVER EAT THERE

name: CARIBBEAN SUNSHINE RESTAURANT
reviews: ['Very good food and plenty of parking. The service is excellent and the staff is very nice. Floors are clean and the windows are spotless', 'This is the worst Jamaican food I’ve ever had. Idk how these reviews say different. Hard white rice, stew chicken taste like tomato and cabbage like water. I ordered from here a year ago and then now both time food was disgusting', 'Great food and clean place.\nEVERY time I order from this place via Uber Eats, I always ask for no cabbage and order something to drink and I NEVER receive beverage or I’ll ask for a certain flavor and they give me something else that I don’t drink. What if I was allergic to cabbage and they don’t take the time to read the instructions on the note, which I write in all capital letters!! Literally. Also, after I submit my food order, I call and NO ONE picks up the phone. The food is good, but the service has to be better, as well.', "Great food and chill environment. Also great prices. I'm always gonna be a customer here", 'I ordered from them 1 time and the food was absolutely delicious! Naturally I wanted to order from them again; for over 3 weeks when I try, 1 of 3 things happen. Grubhub accepts the order then sends me a message stating that they have to refund me bc the restaurant is not accepting orders or they\'re closed and this is during business hours. The 2nd thing that happens is when I\'ve called to confirm my order placed on Grubhub, they either don\'t answer the phone and it rings out to a fast busy, or someone will answer the phone and say that they\'re open and don\'t know what the issue is or they\'ll answer "hello" and then hang up on me. How unfortunate that they\'ve lost a new customer and others who I may have referred to them by word of mouth.']

name: EL NUEVO VALLE #2 RESTAURANT
reviews: ['I unfortunately did get a chance to eat any food because the location makes ordering food more difficult than it needs to be. Walked into the location and "there is no menus" inside the location according to staff, single menu item on a wall, but they have TVs advertising DJ nights and Hookah at this RESTAURANT location. We notice "Combos" posted on the sides OUTSIDE of the location, (with no sort of pricing available on the poster other than the word "Price").  We go outside the location to take photos of the combo we were intrested in and walk back  into the restaurant a second time to visually show the photo to the employee to explain want we wanted (FYI, we are a family of fluent spanish speaking people, speaking to Spanish speaking employees. So there wasn\'t much of a language barrier than most people may/may not experience when walking in to order food). Only to get a price of $30 for one small combo of food. We call up family that lives in the area and we\'re told that they normally get charged $10 for lunch (which we arrive to the location around lunch and wasn\'t sold any lunch options) and usually charged $20 for combos. So we were obviously surprised when we are being charged $30 for an order. We immediately go to walk out and start to get called back as if now they are willing to negotiate a cheaper price. No thank you. I\'ve been to countless restaurants and I\'ve never experienced having to haggle my way to an AVERAGE price for a plate of food.', 'Food was trash! Chicken tasted like it was sitting under the lights all day, plantains were dry and everything else was bland and tasteless! I really wanted the food at another location but I settled for this because it was closer to home….my mistake….the best part of the order was the salad and the Pepsi!!', 'I ordered soup …I watch the lady purposely give me one small piece  chicken and  lots of carrots. She dropped the big chicken back in the pot to search for the smallest piece of chicken to serve me. This isn’t the first time but it’s the LAST time. They’re always skimming the soup putting only chicken broth.', 'The employees at the restaurant is so nice and friendly and the restaurant is so clean and then take your order right away', 'The chicken was dry, the server kept rolling his eyes at me. They overcharged me for my meal. I got the mini $10 lunch meal with $4 chinola juice. That’s $14 + tax. Please tell me why I paid $22 and I didn’t even say I wanted to tip them. Makes no sense. My Dominican friend I went with paid $16 for her meal which was grande chinola juice and a larger meal.']

name: CAFE COLONIAL RESTAURANT
reviews: ["My friends and I came here for my birthday.  The food was amazing!  We had a crab mofongo as an app.  You could actually see the chunks of crab meat.  It was delicious!  I ordered oxtail stew as an entree.  It was tender, juicy, and well flavored.  The drinks were really good as well.  My favorite is the Dominican kiss.  The restaurant had festive music and a family atmosphere.  I  can't wait to go back.", 'Very calm, good vibes with Spanish music. Made me feel at home with my mom. Food was great. One of the best mangu I had in a long time. Waiter was quick and attentive, he was also the only one on the floor.', 'Food was pretty good just a bit pricey for the quality.', 'I ordered the pernil and a mango mojito 10/10! it was so good, prices are reasonable. I recommend stopping by if you’re in the area!', "Food is delicious.  Will never stop going...But if I'm going to spend $50 for myself for dinner... The lady at the register collecting the money..should smile and say thank you...not have a conversation with the lady putting butter on the bread... I was there Saturday 11/30 at around 4pm.......take out..."]

name: JUNCTION SEAFOOD RESTAURANT / FAST & FRESH COMIDA TÍPICA
reviews: ["This restaurant is clean and  inviting great for a casual lunch or a date night they have affordable buffet style dominican dishes starting at $9.00 or made to order choices not to mention several soups to choose from great service from the staff that always offer a polite smile food is delicious this place is a can't miss i highly recommend", 'I RARELY leave reviews.. but after tasting the food I had no choice. The Pernil tasted like a spoonful of salt and looked old. The potato salad tasted like they put 3 whole onions and I’m guessing they did that because the potato salad was old and they used the onions so customers won’t notice it’s old. The oxtail meat was hard. This was by FAR THE WORST food I’ve ever ordered in my life. STAY AWAY. My stomach hurts.', "I'm so disgusted I actually threw up. This food was not fresh at all . That chicken was supposed to be half of chicken and it was so old and stale. I ordered rice and beans and received only white rice. I ordered chicharron by itself and received a order of chicharron with mofongo. It seems like they gave me someone else's order that was sitting there all day. The chicharron was so hard you couldn't bite threw it. The mofongo that I didn't ask for was also very hard like a rock. Disgusting.", 'Delicious and affordable Dominican food. All ladies are so welcoming and sweet ☺️', 'I absolute was disgusted with the behavior I received in this place. An employee in a legal place to serve the public should be able to enter without any rude  comments making this place absolutely horrible.\n\nI mean this do not go to this place, I’m a college student and majoring in criminal justice, every place has regulations or orders, and I can understand if you are having a horrible day, and your attitude is spiking but almost throwing my food out of spite and attitude is unacceptable and repulsive when an individual has done nothing to create a hostile environment. Under the court of law, discriminating for age, class, gender or even mental health issues saying that “she is crazy” and laughing after that during clock hours is horrific.']

name: TROPILYZ 116TH
reviews: ['This was one of the restaurants on my list for NY and it didn’t disappoint. Staff was friendly, food was fresh and at a great price!', "Language is an issue here, but if you know what to order then it's fine. The food isn't particularly good, but I love some of their desserts. Tres leches was bad and dry.", 'Asked for quarter chicken they said I can only get half, it was dry. Ordered tres leches and it was spoiled. Tried calling to make complaint no one answered so I took a picture of my food to bring the next day. Was told without the actual spoiled food with the receipt I couldn’t get a refund or new cake. They lost my business.', "Brought two chicken salads - okay. What I don't like is pieces were not cut up, the tomatoes were not diced, it was barbarian like. Nevertheless if I buy again will ask to chop up everything so it's bite-size. The morir soñando was very delicious and worth price. I am going to learn how to make it so yummy.", 'The food here use to be good but now it is just as terrible as their customer service.
